points.text: Same as the top-level training entry: §7.2 "Unless otherwise agreed in writing, AI21 will not use your Customer Data to train AI21's foundational or generally available AI models"
points.text_zh: 同顶层 training：§7.2「Unless otherwise agreed in writing, AI21 will not use your Customer Data to train AI21’s foundational or generally available AI models」

points.text: The exits are the license to improve the Services, any lawful purpose once data is de-identified, and whatever may be agreed otherwise in writing. The privacy policy's legal-bases table lists User Content among the principal data categories for "Operating, analyzing, improving, and developing the Services and our products", on the legal basis of legitimate interests in maintaining and improving the Services.
points.text_zh: 出口为改善服务许可、去标识化后任意合法用途、以及可另行书面约定。隐私政策的法律基础表把 User Content 列为「Operating, analyzing, improving, and developing the Services and our products」这一处理目的的主要数据类别之一，法律基础为维护与改善服务的正当利益。
points.quote: Operating, analyzing, improving, and developing the Services and our products

zdr.quote: You grant AI21 and its Affiliates and service providers a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free, sublicensable license to host, store, process, transmit, reproduce, de-identify, and modify (for formatting and operational purposes) your Customer Data and Output solely to: (a) provide, secure, maintain, develop, and improve the Services

points.text: Same as the top-level zdr entry: no public zero-retention offering, switch or application path, and at contract level §7.2 expressly licenses AI21 to host / store / reproduce / de-identify request content (Customer Data includes Input) and Output for purposes that include to "develop, and improve the Services", while the deletion clause §17.4 says only that AI21 "may delete Customer Data following a reasonable retrieval period". The evidence pointing the other way is still the blog post and the "traceless mode" page in the Trust Center metadata, which is not a commitment.
points.text_zh: 同顶层 zdr:无公开零保留方案、开关或申请入口,且合同层 §7.2 明确许可对请求内容(Customer Data 含 Input)与 Output 的 host / store / reproduce / de-identify、目的含 develop 与 improve the Services,§17.4 删除条款仅『可』删除。反向线索仍是博文与 Trust Center meta 的『traceless mode』,不构成承诺。

retention.quote: We retain Personal Data for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Policy, after which we securely delete or anonymize it.

points.text: Same as the top-level retention entry: retained as long as necessary for the stated purposes, with no quantified period at the request level
points.text_zh: 同顶层 retention：按目的所需保留、无请求级量化期限

points.text: After termination, the "reasonable retrieval period" in §17.4 is not quantified
points.text_zh: 终止后 §17.4「reasonable retrieval period」未量化
points.quote: AI21 may delete Customer Data following a reasonable retrieval period, except as required by Law.

points.text: Capped at thirty (30) days in the EU Data Act customer-switching scenario: the Retrieval Period under the Data Act Addendum, which applies only to customers headquartered in the EU that are subject to the Data Act and buy a Data Processing Service listed in Annex A. It is an upper bound on how long Exportable Data may be kept after the transition period, not a general retention period.
points.text_zh: EU Data Act 客户切换场景上限 30 天：即 Data Act Addendum 的 Retrieval Period，仅适用于总部在欧盟、受 Data Act 约束且购买 Annex A 所列 Data Processing Service 的客户。它是过渡期后 Exportable Data 可保留时长的上限，不是通用保留期。
points.quote: Customer may request AI21 to retain the Exportable Data for up to thirty (30) days following the completion of the Transition Period or the Extended Transition Period to the extent applicable (“**Retrieval Period**“).

points.text: That thirty-day cap applies to a narrower set than "EU customers": the Data Act Addendum does not apply to any Evaluation Products (§5.2), so free trials, betas, pilots and evaluation products have no quantified retention period at all. The ToS expressly cover free, trial, evaluation and self-serve Services as well, so those scenarios fall inside this tier.
points.text_zh: 该 30 天上限的适用面比「欧盟客户」更窄：Data Act Addendum 不适用于任何 Evaluation Products（§5.2），免费试用、beta、Pilot、评估产品连这唯一的量化期限也不适用。ToS 明文也约束 free / trial / evaluation / self-serve 服务，故这些场景落在本档范围内。
points.quote: The Data Act Addendum does not apply to any Evaluation Products.

points.text: Second quantified period, same EU Data Act context: a Deletion Request is honoured no later than within the Notice Period (2 months). It is an upper bound on when the deletion must happen, not a promise that every copy is gone.
points.text_zh: 同一 EU Data Act 语境下的第二个量化期限：删除请求最迟在 Notice Period（2 个月）内完成。这是删除动作的上限，不是「所有副本都已清除」的承诺。
points.quote: AI21 will support a Customer’s Deletion Request to the extent permitted by applicable law, by deleting the Exportable Data in accordance with the procedures and timeframes specified in the Agreement, however no later than within the Notice Period.

points.text: After the Retrieval Period expires, AI21 only "reserves the right to delete" Exportable Data, subject to its standard deletion practices — a reserved right, not a deletion obligation.
points.text_zh: Retrieval Period 到期后，AI21 仅「reserves the right to delete」Exportable Data，且受其标准删除实践约束——属权利保留，不是删除义务。
points.quote: Upon expiration of the Retrieval Period, the AI21 reserves the right to delete Exportable Data, subject to its standard data deletion practices, except as required under applicable laws.

points.text: Exception, privacy policy: Personal Data may be kept longer where required to comply with law, to maintain accurate records of dealings with you in the event of complaints or disputes, where litigation is reasonably anticipated, or in aggregated or de-identified form. These are the contexts in which data can outlive the purpose-bound period.
points.text_zh: 例外情形（隐私政策）：法律要求、为投诉或争议保留与你往来的准确记录、合理预期诉讼、或以聚合/去标识化形式时，个人数据可保留更久。这些就是可能超出「按目的所需」期限的语境。
points.quote: We may retain Personal Data for longer where required to comply with law, to maintain accurate records of our dealings with you in the event of complaints or disputes, where we reasonably anticipate litigation, or in aggregated or de-identified form.

processing_region.quote: Customer Data and Output may be hosted and processed by AI21, its Affiliates, and its hosting and service providers in Israel, the United States, the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, and other locations worldwide.

points.text: Same as the top-level processing_region entry: Israel, the United States, the EEA, the UK and other locations worldwide, with no public option to choose a region per request.
points.text_zh: 同顶层 processing_region：Israel/US/EEA/UK 及全球其他地点，无按请求选区域的公开选项。

role.quote: Where AI21 acts as a processor of personal data on your behalf, the parties will, where applicable, enter into AI21’s data processing agreement (“DPA”), which (when executed or otherwise made applicable) is incorporated by reference into these Terms.

points.text: Same as the top-level role entry: for business customers AI21 acts as processor and the parties enter into AI21's DPA (text not published)
points.text_zh: 同顶层 role：企业客户场景 AI21 为 processor 并需签 DPA（文本未公开）

points.text: For individual developers using the service for themselves, AI21 acts as controller.
points.text_zh: 个人开发者自用场景为 controller。

points.text: Enabling a Third-Party Service is a customer-initiated access path: §13 provides that where you enable Third-Party Services, you authorize AI21 to permit the relevant provider to access Customer Data as necessary for the interoperation. It is limited to what the interoperation requires, is not part of AI21's own subprocessor chain, and does not change the processor finding or the global processing-region conclusion.
points.text_zh: 启用第三方服务是一条由客户主动开启的访问路径：§13 规定启用 Third-Party Services 即授权 AI21 允许相关提供方在互操作必需范围内访问 Customer Data。它限于互操作所需，不属于 AI21 自有的 subprocessor 链，也不改变 processor 判定与 global 处理地结论。
points.quote: Where you enable Third-Party Services, you authorize AI21 to permit the relevant provider to access Customer Data as necessary for the interoperation.

training.quote: Unless otherwise agreed in writing, AI21 will not use your Customer Data to train AI21’s foundational or generally available AI models.

points.text: An AI21-managed private deployment is still within the Services covered by the ToS, so §7.2 applies: "Unless otherwise agreed in writing, AI21 will not use your Customer Data to train AI21's foundational or generally available AI models". The website separately has a Post-Training product line that expressly trains custom models on customer data (the model belongs to the customer), which is a training scenario agreed separately and recorded apart from this tier's default conclusion.
points.text_zh: AI21 托管私有部署仍属 ToS 的 Services 范围，适用 §7.2「Unless otherwise agreed in writing, AI21 will not use your Customer Data to train AI21’s foundational or generally available AI models」。官网另有 Post-Training 产品线明确用客户数据训练定制模型（模型归客户），属另行约定的训练场景，与本档默认结论分开记。

points.text: An AI21-managed private deployment is still within the Services covered by the ToS, so the storage license in §7.2 and the "may" delete of §17.4 apply, giving the same contract-level conclusion as the rest of this vendor (no zero-retention commitment). This tier has no policy document of its own; the /deployment/ page carries only marketing wording about deployment shapes and data residency options and has no snapshot in this repo, so it cannot serve as an anchor source.
points.text_zh: AI21 托管私有部署仍属 ToS 的 Services 范围，适用 §7.2 的存储许可与 §17.4 的『可』删除，故与本家合同层结论相同（无零保留承诺）。本档没有独立政策文档；官网 /deployment/ 只有部署形态与 data residency options 的营销表述，且本仓库没有它的快照，不能作锚点来源。

points.text: Termination is governed by §17.4, which says only that AI21 "may delete Customer Data following a reasonable retrieval period" — a permission rather than a deletion commitment, and the period is not quantified anywhere.

points.quote: AI21 may delete Customer Data following a reasonable retrieval period, except as required by Law.

points.text: Exception, privacy policy: Personal Data may be kept longer where required to comply with law, to maintain accurate records of dealings with you in the event of complaints or disputes, where litigation is reasonably anticipated, or in aggregated or de-identified form. These are the contexts in which data can outlive the purpose-bound period.
points.text_zh: 例外情形（隐私政策）：法律要求、为投诉或争议保留与你往来的准确记录、合理预期诉讼、或以聚合/去标识化形式时，个人数据可保留更久。这些就是可能超出「按目的所需」期限的语境。
points.quote: We may retain Personal Data for longer where required to comply with law, to maintain accurate records of our dealings with you in the event of complaints or disputes, where we reasonably anticipate litigation, or in aggregated or de-identified form.

points.text: The published contract contains no zero-retention commitment for this tier either: §7.2 licenses AI21 to host, store and process Customer Data and §17.4 says only that AI21 may delete it, and no switch, option or application path is documented on any page checked (searched[]).
points.text_zh: 公开合同对本档同样没有零保留承诺：§7.2 许可 AI21 host / store / process Customer Data，§17.4 仅说 AI21 可删除；查阅过的页面（searched[]）中均无开关、选项或申请入口。

points.text: The only retention clause AI21 publishes is the privacy policy's "as long as necessary" rule, which governs AI21's own processing of account and usage data (the policy itself states it does not govern Customer Data for which AI21 acts as a processor); for the customer's data in a self-managed deployment no period is published.
points.text_zh: AI21 公布的唯一保留条款是隐私政策的「按目的所需」，它管辖 AI21 自己对账户与用量数据的处理（政策自述不管辖 AI21 作为 processor 处理的 Customer Data）；自管部署中客户自有数据的保留期没有公布。

training.quote: Alibaba Cloud will not use your Member Content to develop or improve the models on Model Studio, unless you separately provide your consent.

points.text: Contract level: International Product ToS v3.8.0 §4.48.1(e), final sentence: "Alibaba Cloud will not use your Member Content to develop or improve the models on Model Studio, unless you separately provide your consent." — Member Content includes Input and Output (§4.48.1(b)), so pay-as-you-go API inputs and outputs are not used to develop or improve models on Model Studio unless the customer separately consents. Three layers of support: (1) Membership Agreement §4.1 "We will not access or use your Member Content except as necessary to maintain or provide the Services…"
points.text_zh: 合同级(contract):国际站 Product ToS v3.8.0 §4.48.1(e) 末句「Alibaba Cloud will not use your Member Content to develop or improve the models on Model Studio, unless you separately provide your consent.」——Member Content 含 Input 与 Output(§4.48.1(b)),即按量 API 的输入输出不用于开发或改进百炼上的模型,除非客户另行单独同意。佐证三层:①会员协议 §4.1「We will not access or use your Member Content except as necessary to maintain or provide the Services…」

points.text: (2) The international Model Studio privacy notice and product introduction page: "will never use your data for model training" (enterprise_privacy_faq / developer_data)
points.text_zh: ②国际站 Model Studio 隐私说明与产品介绍页「will never use your data for model training」(enterprise_privacy_faq / developer_data)

points.text: (3) The Training data summary, "Customer data policy" section: "does not use customer business data to develop or improve models without explicit consent". **Tier boundary (hard)**: the Chinese-language product page of the international site limits the no-training commitment by name to "the pay-as-you-go API and the Token Plan team edition", and the "Important" box on the same page states that the data-use terms differ for the Token Plan individual edition and Coding Plan (input and generated content while using Coding Plan will be used for service improvement and model optimization); those two tiers are outside this provider's scope. **Customer-side exception**: once inference logs are enabled, Log backflow can recycle logs into the customer's own training dataset (telemetry/backflow anchors) — that is the customer's own action, not the vendor training on the data. **Third-party model exception**: when a third-party model on Model Studio is used (DeepSeek/Kimi/GLM and others), data processing is provided directly by that vendor under that vendor's terms (§4.48.2), so this "no training" commitment covers only Alibaba Cloud's own model path
points.text_zh: ③Training data summary「Customer data policy」段「does not use customer business data to develop or improve models without explicit consent」。**档位边界(硬)**:国际站中文产品页把不训练承诺点名限定为「按量付费 API 和 Token Plan 团队版」,同页「重要」框写明 Token Plan 个人版与 Coding Plan 的数据使用条款不同(使用 Coding Plan 期间输入与生成内容将用于服务改进与模型优化),那两档不在本 provider 范围。**客户侧例外**:开启推理日志后可用 Log backflow 把日志回流入自己的训练数据集(telemetry/backflow 锚点),这是客户主动行为,不是厂商拿数据训练。**三方模型例外**:走 Model Studio 三方模型(DeepSeek/Kimi/GLM 等)时,数据处理由厂商直接提供并适用厂商条款(§4.48.2),本条的「不训练」承诺只覆盖阿里云自有模型链路

points.text: **Exception, not a training basis**: Membership Agreement §5.2 lets Alibaba Cloud access, disclose and/or remove any content you published on or submitted to us (including any Member Content) to comply with applicable law, legal process or lawful government requests, or in respect of any claims or potential claims brought against us, or our shareholders, subsidiaries or affiliates. That is an access, disclosure and removal right for enforcement, legal-process and claims purposes — it is not a licence to use Member Content to develop or improve models, and it does not alter the no-training commitment in Product ToS §4.48.1(e) or Membership Agreement §4.1.
points.text_zh: **例外而非训练依据**:会员协议 §5.2 允许阿里云为遵守适用法律、法律程序或合法政府请求,或为应对针对阿里云及其股东/子公司/关联方的索赔或潜在索赔,访问、披露和/或删除你发布或提交的任何内容(含 Member Content)。这是为执法/法律程序/索赔而设的访问、披露与删除权,不是拿 Member Content 开发或改进模型的许可,不改变 Product ToS §4.48.1(e) 与会员协议 §4.1 的不训练承诺。
points.quote: we shall have the right to access, disclose and/or remove any content you published on or submitted to us (including any Member Content) in connection therewith or to comply with applicable law, legal process or lawful government requests, or in respect of any claims or potential claims brought against us, or our shareholders, subsidiaries or affiliates.

points.text: The commitment on the Chinese-language product page of the international site goes no further than "not used for training". A distinction to keep: inference logs off by default plus delivery to the customer's own SLS only means the customer can keep content-bearing logs from being retained on Alibaba Cloud's side, which is not zero data retention (the request still has to be processed, and audit logs and monitoring metrics stay on the platform by default). Recorded as mark=no (express denial): the privacy notice states that call-generated data is stored, i.e. no zero retention is offered at terms level — this is not "undisclosed". The searched scope is kept in full
points.text_zh: 国际站中文产品页的承诺也只到「不用于训练」。注意区分:推理日志默认关闭 + 客户自有 SLS 只是「客户可不让阿里云侧留存含内容的日志」,不等于零数据保留(请求仍需处理,审计日志与监控指标默认留在平台侧)。结论记 mark=no(明确否定类):隐私说明明示会存储调用产生的数据,即条款层不提供零保留,不是「未披露」;searched 范围仍列全

retention.quote: at Your choice, delete or return all Data in Alibaba Cloud’s possession or control following the termination of the Agreement

points.text: Recorded by object, not merged: (1) **Input and output content**: the international Model Studio privacy notice states plainly that Model Studio "stores data generated from model and application calls", but no uniform retention period in days is published anywhere on the site
points.text_zh: 分对象记,不要合并:(1) **输入输出正文**:国际站 Model Studio 隐私说明明说「stores data generated from model and application calls」,但全站未公布统一保留天数

points.text: DPA §4(g) commits, following termination of the Agreement, to "at Your choice, delete or return all Data in Alibaba Cloud's possession or control", and DPA Appendix 1 (used to fill in Annex I of the EU SCCs) records the retention period as "Data will be processed and transferred for the duration of the Agreement" (period type = duration of the agreement, not a fixed number of days)
points.text_zh: DPA §4(g) 承诺协议终止时按客户选择删除或返还 Data,DPA Appendix 1(用于填 EU SCC 的 Annex I)载明保留期为「Data will be processed and transferred for the duration of the Agreement」(期限类型=协议存续期,不是固定天数)

points.text: The termination clause of the Membership Agreement instead says "we will delete such Member Content at our sole discretion unless retention is required under applicable law" — deletion after termination is **discretionary**, and data may be kept where the law requires it. (2) **Audit logs (metadata, no Prompt/Response)**: on by default, stored on the platform
points.text_zh: 会员协议终止条款则写「we will delete such Member Content at our sole discretion unless retention is required under applicable law」——即终止后删除是**裁量性**的,且法律要求可保留。(2) **审计日志(元数据,不含 Prompt/Response)**:默认开启、平台侧存储

points.text: The query window is "Last 7 days by default; supports querying logs for up to 30 days" (this is a **query window, not a deletion deadline**; no deletion after 30 days can be inferred from it). (3) **Inference logs (full Prompt/Response, truncated at 128KB)**: off by default, must be enabled manually and delivered to the customer's own SLS Logstore, and can be recycled into training datasets. (4) **Task data and result URLs of the asynchronous media APIs**: expressly "available for 24 hours and is then automatically deleted" (the only object with an explicit period). (5) **Account-level personal data**: under §F of the international-site privacy policy, kept as long as there is an ongoing legitimate business need, until the account is closed. (6) Product ToS §4.48.1(g)(iv) points the other way: data provided to or stored by Alibaba Cloud may be removed or rendered inaccessible from time to time, and customers must keep their own redundancy. Confidence medium: at contract level there is only "delete or return on termination" and "the duration of the Agreement", no default retention period, and the DPA applies only where data protection legislation requires it
points.text_zh: 查询窗口默认 7 天、最长 30 天(这是**查询窗口,不是删除期限**,不能反推 30 天后删除)。(3) **推理日志(含完整 Prompt/Response,128KB 截断)**:默认关闭、需手动开启并投递到客户自有 SLS Logstore,可回流入训练数据集。(4) **异步媒体 API 的任务数据与结果 URL**:明确「available for 24 hours and is then automatically deleted」(唯一给出明确期限的对象)。(5) **账号类个人数据**:国际站隐私政策 §F 按持续正当业务需要,账号注销为止。(6) Product ToS §4.48.1(g)(iv) 反向提示:阿里云侧数据可能被移除或不可访问,客户须自备冗余。置信度 medium:合同层只有「终止时删除/返还」与「协议存续期」,没有默认保留期限,且 DPA 仅在数据保护法要求时适用

points.text: **Monitoring metrics after delivery — delivery copies, it does not move data off the platform** (same object group as (2), audit logs and monitoring metrics): after delivery is enabled, monitoring data is stored on both the platform side and the user side. Enabling monitoring delivery therefore does not reduce platform-side retention; it is a copy, not an export. **Boundary**: that sentence covers model monitoring delivery (metrics) only — it does not cover log delivery or inference logs, which go to the customer's own SLS Logstore, and log delivery is a separate section of the same document.
points.text_zh: **监控指标开启投递后——投递是复制,不是把数据搬出平台**(与 (2) 审计日志/监控指标同属一个对象组):开启投递后,监控数据在平台侧与用户侧各存一份。故开启监控投递并不减少平台侧留存,投递=复制而非导出。**边界**:该句只覆盖 model monitoring delivery(监控数据),不覆盖日志投递与推理日志——推理日志存到客户自有 SLS Logstore,日志投递是同文档的独立小节。
points.quote: After delivery is enabled, monitoring data is stored on both the platform side and the user side.

points.text: **Licence survives termination**: Membership Agreement §8.5(c) — the licence granted by you to us to use your Member Content described in Clause 4.1 shall continue notwithstanding such suspension or termination. Read together with §8.5(b), termination does not end every right to use Member Content: deletion is discretionary and the §4.1 licence is stated to continue. **Cross-reference inconsistency, flagged rather than filled in by us**: in this snapshot §4.1 grants no such licence — it says that you retain any rights you may have in any Member Content and that the Agreement does not grant either party any rights to the other’s content except as set forth otherwise in this Agreement — and the only other licence reference in the text is the definition item §4.2(b). The sentence therefore stands as written, but the licence it points to is undefined in the current text: needs human confirmation, and must not be read as proof of a broad surviving use licence.
points.text_zh: **许可存续**:会员协议 §8.5(c)——the licence granted by you to us to use your Member Content described in Clause 4.1 shall continue notwithstanding such suspension or termination。与 §8.5(b) 并读:终止不等于使用权终止——删除是裁量性的,而 §4.1 项下的许可据本条继续存在。**交叉引用不一致,只标注不补全**:本快照 §4.1 并未授予该许可(§4.1 写的是你保留 Member Content 中的权利,且明确本协议不向任何一方授予对方内容的权利,除非本协议另有约定),全文另一处 licence 是 §4.2(b) 的定义项。故该句按原文成立,但其所指的许可在现行文本中未定义:需人工确认,不能读成一条概括的存续使用许可。
points.quote: the licence granted by you to us to use your Member Content described in Clause 4.1 shall continue notwithstanding such suspension or termination

points.text: **Exception to termination deletion (DPA §4(g), second half)**: the delete-or-return duty shall not apply to the extent that Alibaba Cloud is required or permitted by applicable law to retain some or all of the Data, **or Data archived on back-up systems**, in which event Alibaba Cloud shall securely isolate and protect such Data from any further processing except: (i) to the extent required by such law until deletion is possible; or (ii) where such Data ceases to contain personal data. So back-up copies may keep the Data past termination, isolated and no longer processed, until deletion becomes possible or the data no longer contains personal data. **Boundary**: this DPA applies only where Data Protection Legislation requires it — a contractual carve-out, not a default long-term retention commitment by the platform.
points.text_zh: **终止删除义务的例外(DPA §4(g) 后半句)**:删除或返还义务不适用于「阿里云被适用法律要求或许可保留部分或全部 Data,或备份系统中归档的 Data」的情形;此时阿里云须安全隔离并保护该 Data、停止任何进一步处理,直到 (i) 法律允许删除,或 (ii) 该 Data 不再含个人信息。即备份归档中的 Data 可在终止后继续留存,但须隔离保护、停止进一步处理。**边界**:该 DPA 仅在数据保护法要求时适用——这是合同层的例外条款,不是平台默认的长期保留承诺。
points.quote: This requirement shall not apply to the extent that Alibaba Cloud is required or permitted by applicable law to retain some or all of the Data, or Data archived on back-up systems, in which event Alibaba Cloud shall securely isolate and protect such Data from any further processing except: (i) to the extent required by such law until deletion is possible; or (ii) where such Data ceases to contain personal data

processing_region.quote: Regions determine the **access point and data storage location**.

points.text: developer_data (high): the Regions documentation — "Regions determine the access point and data storage location", "Request data is stored in that region.", "Your static data always remains in the selected region." — the storage location and access point are set by the selected region
points.text_zh: developer_data(高):地域文档「Regions determine the access point and data storage location」「Request data is stored in that region.」「Your static data always remains in the selected region.」——数据存放地与接入点由所选 region 决定

points.text: Where inference runs is set by the service deployment scope (Global or a geographic-boundary scope, one or the other; Singapore has only International, China (Beijing) has only mainland China). Contractual support: Product ToS §4.48.1(g)(viii) "Member Content … will be transferred to, stored, and processed in the country where Alibaba Cloud, its affiliates, or its sub-contractors maintain facilities for Model Studio Service", plus the customer's designation
points.text_zh: 推理执行地由 service deployment scope 决定(Global 与地理边界 scope 二选一,Singapore 只有 International、China (Beijing) 只有中国大陆)。合同佐证:Product ToS §4.48.1(g)(viii)「Member Content … will be transferred to, stored, and processed in the country where Alibaba Cloud, its affiliates, or its sub-contractors maintain facilities for Model Studio Service」+ 客户指定

points.text: DPA §6.1「You decide where to store Data (Selected Region)」

Trust Center FAQ 4.2: "only stores and processes each customer's content in the Alibaba Cloud Region(s) that is chosen by the customer". **Boundary**: with the Global scope selected, inference nodes may cross geographic boundaries (stated in the docs), so "data does not leave the selected region" holds for storage and static data but not for inference execution
points.text_zh: Trust Center FAQ 4.2「only stores and processes each customer's content in the Alibaba Cloud Region(s) that is chosen by the customer」。**边界**:选 Global scope 时推理节点可跨地理边界(文档明示),故「数据不离开所选 region」只对存储与静态数据成立,对推理执行不成立

points.text: The China site (Beijing region, dashscope.aliyuncs.com) and the Hong Kong region both sit in the alibabacloud.com region list, but the China site has a different account system and contracting entity and must be kept separate from alibaba-cn
points.text_zh: 中国站(Beijing region, dashscope.aliyuncs.com)与香港 region 同在 alibabacloud.com 的 region 列表内,但中国站账号体系与协议主体不同,须与 alibaba-cn 分开

role.quote: You (the controller or processor) appoint Alibaba Cloud as Your processor to process the Data, for the duration of the Agreement, solely for the purpose of providing the Alibaba Cloud Services to You

points.text: contract (high): DPA §3 "You (the controller or processor) appoint Alibaba Cloud as Your processor to process the Data, for the duration of the Agreement, solely for the purpose of providing the Alibaba Cloud Services to You", plus Appendix 1 for the data importer: "Role (controller/processor): Processor"
points.text_zh: contract(高):DPA §3「You (the controller or processor) appoint Alibaba Cloud as Your processor to process the Data, for the duration of the Agreement, solely for the purpose of providing the Alibaba Cloud Services to You」+ Appendix 1 数据进口方「Role (controller/processor):Processor」

points.text: Product ToS §4.48.1(b)「Any processing of Member Content … is for your purposes and on your behalf」

The DPA is incorporated into the Membership Agreement as an annex (annex list: "Data Processing Addendum to Alibaba Cloud Membership Agreement Applicable to all users"). **Two exceptions that must be stated plainly**: (1) under §1 the DPA applies only where Data Protection Legislation requires it, and only to "personal data contained in or generated in relation to Your Member Content" processed as a processor — personal data collected for Alibaba Cloud's own purposes, such as account registration, is still controller data (the international-site privacy policy carries the dual-role wording "In cases where we act as a processor…")
points.text_zh: DPA 附件形式并入会员协议(会员协议附件清单「Data Processing Addendum to Alibaba Cloud Membership Agreement Applicable to all users」)。**两个必须写清的例外**:①DPA 按 §1 仅在数据保护法要求时适用,且只覆盖「以 processor 身份处理的 Member Content 个人信息」——账号注册等以阿里云自身目的收集的个人数据仍是 controller(国际站隐私政策有「In cases where we act as a processor…」的双角色表述)

points.text: (2) When a third-party model API on Model Studio is used, Product ToS §4.48.2(c) states plainly that "Alibaba Cloud does not perform the role of data processor or controller with respect to any personal data processed by such Third-party Model Service"; the Marketplace Supplemental says the same, and the third-party model terms add that the Marketplace platform side "have no access to …; will not process …" End User Data — in that path Alibaba Cloud is not the processor of that chain, and the role is taken up by the vendor's EULA / vendor DPA (the vendor being Processor or sub-Processor). **Entity**: the default contracting entity on the international site is Alibaba Cloud (Singapore) Private Limited (with separate entities for the EEA/UK, the United States and Malaysia), not the same entity as Tongyi Yunqi (Hangzhou) on the China site
points.text_zh: ②走 Model Studio 三方模型 API 时,Product ToS §4.48.2(c) 明确「Alibaba Cloud does not perform the role of data processor or controller with respect to any personal data processed by such Third-party Model Service」,Marketplace Supplemental 同义,三方模型条款进一步写明 Marketplace 平台方对 End User Data「have no access to …; will not process …」——此时阿里云不是该链路的 processor,角色由厂商 EULA/厂商 DPA 承接(厂商为 Processor/sub-Processor)。**主体**:国际站默认签约主体 Alibaba Cloud (Singapore) Private Limited(EEA/UK/美国/马来西亚另有主体),与中国站通义云启(杭州)不是同一实体

points.text: Membership Agreement §5.2 (Investigation and Enforcement) is a second and broader exception alongside §4.1: to comply with applicable law, legal process or lawful government requests, or in respect of any claims or potential claims brought against us, or our shareholders, subsidiaries or affiliates, we shall have the right to access, disclose and/or remove any content you published on or submitted to us (including any Member Content). Object = content including Member Content (i.e. Input and Output where those are Member Content); no time limit is stated. **Boundary**: it is an access, disclosure and removal right — not a training licence and not a retention period — and it must not be merged with §4.1 into one general authorisation.
points.text_zh: 会员协议 §5.2(Investigation and Enforcement)是 §4.1 之外的第二类、更宽的例外:为遵守适用法律、法律程序或合法政府请求,或为应对针对阿里云及其股东/子公司/关联方的索赔或潜在索赔,阿里云有权访问、披露和/或删除你发布或提交的任何内容(含 Member Content)。对象=内容(含 Member Content,即属于 Member Content 的输入输出);未设期限。**边界**:这是访问、披露与删除权,不是训练授权、也不是保留期限,不能与 §4.1 合并读成一条概括授权。
points.quote: we shall have the right to access, disclose and/or remove any content you published on or submitted to us (including any Member Content) in connection therewith or to comply with applicable law, legal process or lawful government requests, or in respect of any claims or potential claims brought against us, or our shareholders, subsidiaries or affiliates.

points.text: Membership Agreement §8.5(c): the licence granted by the customer to use Member Content described in Clause 4.1 continues notwithstanding suspension or termination — the vendor's permission to use Member Content does not automatically end with the contract. **Flag**: §4.1 in this snapshot grants no such licence, so this is a cross-reference inconsistency to confirm with the vendor rather than a settled usage right.
points.text_zh: 会员协议 §8.5(c):客户就 Clause 4.1 所指 Member Content 授予的使用许可,在暂停或终止后继续存在——厂商对 Member Content 的使用权不随合同自动终止。**标注**:本快照 §4.1 并未授予该许可,属条款交叉引用不一致,需人工确认,不宜当作已确定的使用权。
points.quote: the licence granted by you to us to use your Member Content described in Clause 4.1 shall continue notwithstanding such suspension or termination

alibaba-cn.entity: 通义云启（杭州）信息技术有限公司

training.quote: 我们不会在未获您授权的情况下使用您的对话数据训练我们的模型。

points.text: §6.2.5 后半句「我们不会在未获您授权的情况下使用您的对话数据训练我们的模型」，配合 §6.2.4「除执行您的服务要求外，我们不会进行任何未获授权的使用及披露」。适用范围由产品简介 FAQ 限定为「按量付费 API 和 Token Plan 团队版」
points.text_zh: §6.2.5 后半句「我们不会在未获您授权的情况下使用您的对话数据训练我们的模型」，配合 §6.2.4「除执行您的服务要求外，我们不会进行任何未获授权的使用及披露」。适用范围由产品简介 FAQ 限定为「按量付费 API 和 Token Plan 团队版」

points.text: Token Plan 个人版/Coding Plan 反过来授权存储并使用输入输出做服务改进与模型优化（§5.2.2），属另两个 provider 档位，本档不适用。隐私说明另有平台级「绝不会将您的数据用于模型训练」。
points.text_zh: Token Plan 个人版/Coding Plan 反过来授权存储并使用输入输出做服务改进与模型优化（§5.2.2），属另两个 provider 档位，本档不适用。隐私说明另有平台级「绝不会将您的数据用于模型训练」。

points.text: A "used to improve the service" purpose does exist, but its object is customer information rather than conversation data: §6.1.2(2) says that to improve your service experience and to respond to your support or help requests, we will view and record your consultation records, fault reports, masked logs and the troubleshooting process for user faults (such as communication or call records), and use them to improve the service. §6.1.1 defines "customer information" as information you provide in order to use the service (registration details, questionnaire responses, etc.), so this clause is not a statement about input/output content. Whether "masked logs" and the "troubleshooting process" can touch input/output plaintext cannot be determined from the agreement text; this clause therefore neither supports a finding that conversation data is used for training nor serves as evidence that it is excluded.
points.text_zh: 确有一条「用于改进服务」用途，但对象是客户信息而非对话数据：§6.1.2(2)「为提升您的服务体验，以及响应您的支持或帮助请求，我们会查看和记录您的咨询记录、报障记录、脱敏日志和针对用户故障的排障过程（如通信或通话记录），以及用于改进服务」。§6.1.1 把「客户信息」定义为为使用本服务而提供的信息（注册信息、问卷信息等），故本条不是对输入输出正文的表述。「脱敏日志」与「排障过程」是否触及输入输出正文在协议文本中无法确定，因此本条既不能作为「对话数据会被用于训练」的结论，也不能作为「不会用于训练」的排除依据。
points.quote: 为提升您的服务体验，以及响应您的支持或帮助请求，我们会查看和记录您的咨询记录、报障记录、脱敏日志和针对用户故障的排障过程（如通信或通话记录），以及用于改进服务

zdr.quote: 我们承诺仅在提供服务所必需的最短时间内保留您的对话数据。

points.text: This tier has no zero-retention option. The contract-level basis is §6.2.5, which states retention instead of offering a no-retention mode: we commit only that your conversation data is retained for the shortest time necessary to provide the service, with no quantified period and no ZDR / no-log / no-storage switch anywhere in the agreement. All pages listed in searched were checked and contain no zero-retention wording for this tier. This is "the vendor has not disclosed a ZDR option for this tier", not "the vendor commits to the opposite".
points.text_zh: 本档没有零保留方案。合同级依据是 §6.2.5「我们承诺仅在提供服务所必需的最短时间内保留您的对话数据」——厂商明示会保留对话数据，只给「最短必要时间」这一非量化口径，服务协议全文无任何 ZDR/不落盘/不留存开关。searched 列出的页面均已查阅，未见本档的零保留表述。这是「厂商未公开该档零保留方案」，不是「厂商承诺相反」。
points.quote: 我们承诺仅在提供服务所必需的最短时间内保留您的对话数据。

points.text: Corroboration, platform level and not tier-specific: the Model Studio privacy notice and FAQ both state that Model Studio will store the data generated by model and application calls as required by applicable laws and regulations.
points.text_zh: 佐证（平台级口径，不区分档位）：百炼隐私说明与常见问题均写「根据相关法律法规要求，阿里云百炼将存储模型与应用调用时产生的数据」。该页是平台级说明，不能替代本档合同条款，只作同向佐证。
points.quote: 根据相关法律法规要求，阿里云百炼将存储模型与应用调用时产生的数据。

points.text: Another path by which platform personnel can reach plaintext: §4.3.1(1) gives us the right to review your input data and synthesized results by technical or manual means. This is a review right, not a retention commitment, and no period is attached to it — but it means this tier carries no architectural guarantee that no plaintext exists on the platform side.
points.text_zh: 另一条平台人员可接触明文的路径：§4.3.1(1)「我们有权采取技术或者人工方式对您的输入数据和合成结果进行审核」。性质是审核权限，不是留存承诺，也未给期限；但它说明本档不存在「平台侧无明文」的架构保证。
points.quote: 我们有权采取技术或者人工方式对您的输入数据和合成结果进行审核

points.text: The only clause-level zero-plaintext path belongs to a different tier: the standalone Confidential MaaS (CMaaS) product, whose Special Rules state that in the course of providing the service we do not record plaintext prompts, model outputs or the corresponding encryption keys, and that the prompts, outputs and keys are held by the customer. CMaaS is invite-only, requires signing the Special Rules separately and currently runs only in China North 2 (Beijing); the Special Rules are themselves scoped to the CMaaS service, so they do not cover the default pay-as-you-go API. "A zero-retention path exists but is bound to an invite-only sub-product" is the fact for this tier; it is not a default capability of it.

points.text: Another retention ground, with a regulatory-reporting context: §4.3.1(3) — if you unlawfully use this service to fabricate or spread false information, we will preserve the relevant records as required by law and report to the Cyberspace Administration and the competent authorities. The object is "the relevant records", the context is regulatory reporting in case of unlawful use, and no period is disclosed. It therefore neither contradicts point ⑥ (no quantified six-month floor of the Cybersecurity Law type appears) nor turns the statutory preservation duty into a quantified retention floor.
points.text_zh: 另一条保留依据，带监管上报语境：§4.3.1(3)「如您非法利用本服务编造、传播虚假信息的，我们会依法保存有关记录，并向网信部门和有关主管部门报告」。对象是「有关记录」，语境是违法使用情形下的监管上报，期限未披露；因此它既不与 point ⑥ 冲突，也不能把这条法定保存义务读成量化下限。
points.quote: 如您非法利用本服务编造、传播虚假信息的，我们会依法保存有关记录，并向网信部门和有关主管部门报告

points.text: A separate storage/use grant for uploaded information content: §7.1 — you agree that, for the purpose of providing this service, we may store and use the information content described above within the scope permitted by law. The object is the information content you provide, upload or publish (knowledge documents, data, text, files, etc.), the context is the service purpose, and the nature is a use authorization rather than a retention period. It does not authorize training or secondary use, and can be read together with §6.2.3(1) (documented instructions, not for our own purposes) as the customer's blanket instruction for service purposes.
points.text_zh: 客户上传信息内容的另一条独立存储/使用授权：§7.1「您同意我们为实现本服务目的，对前述信息内容在法律允许的范围内进行存储及使用」。对象是客户提供、上传、发布的知识文档、数据、文本、文件等信息内容，语境是「为实现本服务目的」，性质是使用授权而非期限约定；未授权训练或二次利用，可视为客户就服务目的给出的概括性指示，与 §6.2.3(1)「按照本协议及您可能不时做出的任何进一步有文件记录的指示且不为其自身目的处理相关数据」同向。

points.text: **Boundary of §8.5(b)**: the next sentence in the same clause, §8.5(c), reads "the licence granted by you to us to use your Member Content described in Clause 4.1 shall continue notwithstanding such suspension or termination". points.text: 对象与期限类型要分开写：①**输入输出正文（对话数据）**——协议 6.2.5『我们承诺仅在提供服务所必需的最短时间内保留您的对话数据』，是**上限式表述但未量化**（无天数）

points.text: **Scope of this value**: basis=as_needed records only the conversation data that does not fall under the §5.2.2 authorization, i.e. the §6.2.5 commitment "我们承诺仅在提供服务所必需的最短时间内保留您的对话数据。" (a cap-style statement, not quantified: no number of days). §6.2.5 does not name Coding Plan; the agreement is hosted on the China-site domain, its contracting entity is 通义云启（杭州）信息技术有限公司 and §12.1 applies mainland-China law, and the international-site related-agreements list does not include it — so the applicability of §6.2 to this international tier remains unresolved (same caveat as the training dimension)

points.text: **The §5.2.2-authorized copies sit outside §6.2.5**: §5.2.2 authorizes us to store and use the model input and output for service improvement and model optimization, and the authorization is not recalled on termination ("终止授权的范围不涵盖您已授权我们使用的相关内容和数据"). For those copies no retention period is published, so the shortest-necessary cap of §6.2.5 does not bound them — the as_needed value shown here does not cover them
points.text_zh: **因 §5.2.2 授权被存储使用的副本不受 6.2.5 约束**：5.2.2 授权我们「存储并使用」模型输入输出以实现服务改进与模型优化，且授权不因停止使用而回溯（「终止授权的范围不涵盖您已授权我们使用的相关内容和数据」，锚点 agr-training-termination-scope）。这部分副本的期限未公布，6.2.5 的「最短必要时间」不覆盖它——页面上的 as_needed 不含这部分。

points.text: Two statements about the same object are recorded side by side, not reconciled: §6.2.5 promises conversation data is kept only as long as necessary to provide the service (no number of days), while §5.2.2 separately authorizes us and our affiliates to store and use this tier's inputs and outputs for service improvement and model optimisation with no stated time limit. points.text: Contract level, same direction: Membership Agreement §4.1 "We will not access or use your Member Content except as necessary to maintain or provide the Services or as necessary to comply with applicable laws or regulations." Member Content includes Input and Output (Product ToS §4.48.1(b)), so this is a contract-level limit on the use of request content, training use included.
points.text_zh: 合同级、与 §4.48.1(e) 同向：会员协议 §4.1「We will not access or use your Member Content except as necessary to maintain or provide the Services or as necessary to comply with applicable laws or regulations.」——Member Content 含 Input 与 Output（Product ToS §4.48.1(b)），是对请求内容使用（含训练用途）的合同级限制。
points.quote: We will not access or use your Member Content except as necessary to maintain or provide the Services or as necessary to comply with applicable laws or regulations.

points.text: Scope limit: the no-training commitment is Alibaba Cloud's own commitment about Member Content. For an AI model, application or service provided by a third party and listed on Model Studio ("Third-party Service"), Product ToS §4.48.1(f) requires the customer to review, accept and abide by the third-party terms before use, and states that "Alibaba Cloud does not control or develop the Third-party Services" — so the extent to which the no-training commitment covers third-party branded models inside a tier is not disclosed at tier level. Both tier pages list third-party branded models (e.g. DeepSeek).
points.text_zh: 适用限定：不训练承诺是 Alibaba Cloud 自身对 Member Content 的使用承诺。对列在 Model Studio 上、由第三方提供的 AI 模型/应用/服务（「Third-party Service」），Product ToS §4.48.1(f) 要求客户先审阅并接受第三方条款，并写明「Alibaba Cloud does not control or develop the Third-party Services」——该不训练承诺对档内第三方品牌模型的覆盖范围没有档位级披露。两档档位页都列有第三方品牌模型（如 DeepSeek）。
points.quote: If you choose to use an AI model, application or service provided by a third party (“Third-party Service”) listed on Model Studio, you should review, accept and abide by the applicable third-party service or licensing terms, policies and/or agreements (“Third-party Terms”) prior to your use of such Third-party Service.

points.text: The telemetry page notes "Inference logs can be recycled into training datasets" (Log backflow). This is not the default behaviour: inference logs must be enabled manually and are written to the customer's own SLS Logstore, and the page does not say whose training datasets they are recycled into.
points.text_zh: 监控页另有「Inference logs can be recycled into training datasets」（Log backflow）。这不是默认行为：推理日志必须手动开启，且写入客户自己的 SLS Logstore；该页没有说明是回收进谁的数据集。
points.quote: Inference logs can be recycled into training datasets.

zdr.quote: In compliance with relevant laws and regulations, Alibaba Cloud Model Studio stores data generated from model and application calls.

retention.quote: you will lose access to any Member Content you have provided to us, and we will delete such Member Content at our sole discretion unless retention is required under applicable law

points.text: Contract level: DPA Appendix 1, the row "The period for which the personal data will be retained, or, if that is not possible, the criteria used to determine that period:" is answered with "Data will be processed and transferred for the duration of the Agreement." — object is Data/personal data, term is the duration of the Agreement. Scope: the DPA applies only where Data Protection Legislation (GDPR/UK GDPR etc.) requires it, and this is an SCC appendix entry, so it is not a request-level retention period; basis stays undisclosed.
points.text_zh: 合同级：DPA 附件一「The period for which the personal data will be retained, or, if that is not possible, the criteria used to determine that period:」一栏的答案是「Data will be processed and transferred for the duration of the Agreement.」——对象是 Data/个人数据，期限＝协议存续期。适用范围：DPA 仅在数据保护法（GDPR/UK GDPR 等）要求时适用，且该栏属 SCC 附件填写，不是请求级保留期限，basis 维持 undisclosed。
points.quote: Data will be processed and transferred for the duration of the Agreement.

points.text: Contract level: DPA §4(g) — at the customer's choice Alibaba Cloud deletes or returns all Data following termination of the Agreement, except where it is required or permitted by law to retain some or all Data, or Data archived on back-up systems (which it must isolate from further processing). Closer to a deletion commitment than Appendix 1, but still not a request-level quantified retention period.

points.text: Scope limit: the no-training commitment is Alibaba Cloud's own commitment about Member Content. points.text: Contract layer (authority above the product docs, and the same source this file already uses for role): §1.24 lists Amazon Q among the generative AI features powered by Amazon Bedrock, and §1.24.1 says that "Amazon Bedrock abuse detection mechanisms may apply to such Services". If they do, §50.12.2 discloses a period for Service inputs and outputs — "up to 30 days (unless otherwise required by law)" — object = inputs and outputs, context = abuse-detection exception, period type = cap, and only for certain models identified on the Bedrock abuse detection page. Amazon Q has no product-specific clause of its own (Kiro does, in §50.14.2), so applicability still turns on the official Bedrock abuse detection page.
points.text_zh: 合同层（权威高于产品文档，且本文件 role 已用同一来源）：§1.24 把 Amazon Q 列入 powered by Amazon Bedrock 的生成式 AI 功能，§1.24.1 写「Amazon Bedrock abuse detection mechanisms may apply to such Services」。若适用，§50.12.2 给出输入输出的已披露期限「up to 30 days (unless otherwise required by law)」——对象=输入输出、语境=滥用检测例外、类型=上限，且仅限 Bedrock abuse detection 页列出的特定模型。Amazon Q 没有 Kiro（§50.14.2）那样的产品专条，适用性仍以官方 Bedrock abuse detection 页为准。
points.quote: For certain models identified on the Bedrock abuse detection page, as part of providing the Service, Amazon Bedrock stores Service inputs and outputs for up to 30 days (unless otherwise required by law) solely to detect activity that violates our, or third-party model providers', terms of service or use policies.

points.text: §1.15 is the contract layer's deletion commitment: "Following closure of your AWS account, we will delete Your Content in accordance with the technical documentation applicable to the Services." Context = after account closure; it promises deletion by reference to the technical documentation and carries no period of its own, so it does not turn the default position into a disclosed period. It applies only to users who have an AWS account.
points.text_zh: §1.15 是合同层唯一的删除承诺：「Following closure of your AWS account, we will delete Your Content in accordance with the technical documentation applicable to the Services.」语境=账号注销后；它只承诺按技术文档删除、本身不含量化期限，故不改变默认口径「未公布期限」的判定。仅适用于有 AWS 账户的用户，Builder ID 个人账号没有 AWS 账户、不适用。
points.quote: Following closure of your AWS account, we will delete Your Content in accordance with the technical documentation applicable to the Services.

points.quote: When you use Amazon Q artifacts, your visualizations-related content is stored in a US Region. When you use Console to Code with Amazon Q, content is stored in your console Region and processed in a US Region. When you use Amazon Q generative SQL in Amazon Redshift, your content is stored and processed in your console Region. For more information, see Interacting with Amazon Q generative SQL in the Amazon Redshift Management Guide. When you create an investigation with Amazon CloudWatch investigations, your content may be stored and processed in other Regions.

points.text_zh: IAM Identity Center workforce 用户的列举功能存于 profile Region；其他功能可在美国存储处理，跨区推理可在 geography 内发生。

points.text: The same page lists features that "store data differently", and none of them is tier-specific: Amazon Q artifacts keep visualizations-related content in a US Region; Console to Code stores content in your console Region and processes it in a US Region; Amazon Q generative SQL in Amazon Redshift stores and processes content in your console Region; Amazon CloudWatch investigations may store and process content in other Regions. The US default therefore does not hold for every feature.
points.text_zh: 同页另列「store data differently」的功能例外（不区分档位）：Amazon Q artifacts 的可视化相关内容存于美国 Region；Console to Code 存于你的 console Region、处理在美国 Region；Redshift 的 Amazon Q generative SQL 存并处理于你的 console Region；CloudWatch investigations 的内容可能存并处理于其他 Region。故美国并非对所有功能都成立。
points.quote: When you use Amazon Q artifacts, your visualizations-related content is stored in a US Region. When you use Console to Code with Amazon Q, content is stored in your console Region and processed in a US Region. When you use Amazon Q generative SQL in Amazon Redshift, your content is stored and processed in your console Region. For more information, see Interacting with Amazon Q generative SQL in the Amazon Redshift Management Guide. When you create an investigation with Amazon CloudWatch investigations, your content may be stored and processed in other Regions.

role.quote: These Service Terms incorporate the [AWS Data Processing Addendum](https://d1.awsstatic.com/legal/aws-dpa/aws-dpa.pdf) (“DPA”), when you use AWS Services to process Customer Data (as defined in the DPA).

points.text: 适用链：Amazon Q 是 AWS Service Terms §50 的 AI Service；§1.14 在 AWS Services 处理 Customer Data 时纳入 AWS DPA 及 controller-to-processor / processor-to-processor SCC。仅据此判企业 AWS 账户链路，不适用于 Free/Builder ID。
points.text_zh: 适用链：Amazon Q 是 AWS Service Terms §50 的 AI Service；§1.14 在 AWS Services 处理 Customer Data 时纳入 AWS DPA 及 controller-to-processor / processor-to-processor SCC。仅据此判企业 AWS 账户链路，不适用于 Free/Builder ID。

training.quote: This Section does not apply to Amazon Comprehend Medical, Amazon Transcribe Medical, AWS HealthScribe, Amazon Comprehend Detect PII or any AI Service that is not listed in the first sentence of this Section 50.3.

points.text: AWS Service Terms §1.20 is a generic service-improvement clause: "We may use information about how you use and interact with the Services to improve those Services." Its object is information about how you use and interact with the Services — §1.19 defines Individualized Usage Data as data about your use of the Services that is specifically identified with your AWS account and treats it separately from Your Content, and §1.21 excludes resource identifiers, metadata tags, access controls and similar management items from Your Content. The wording of §1.20 does not cover the content of your requests, so it must not be read as a training authorization for Bedrock content.
points.text_zh: AWS Service Terms §1.20 是通用「改进服务」条款,对象是「你如何使用与交互服务的信息」——§1.19 把 Individualized Usage Data 定义为与你 AWS 账号相关联的使用数据,并与 Your Content 分开;§1.21 明确资源标识、元数据标签、访问控制等管理项不构成 Your Content。§1.20 的措辞不含请求正文,不能读成对 Bedrock 内容的训练授权。
points.quote: We may use information about how you use and interact with the Services to improve those Services.

points.text: The AI-Content-specific rule is §50.3: it authorizes service improvement only for a named list of AI Services and states that it "does not apply to ... any AI Service that is not listed in the first sentence of this Section 50.3". Amazon Bedrock is not in that list. §1.20 and §50.3 are two different scopes, not one permission covering Bedrock content.
points.text_zh: 针对 AI Content 的专门条款是 §50.3:只对第一句列举的 AI Services 授权服务改进,并明文不适用于任何未列入该清单的 AI Service,Amazon Bedrock 不在清单内。§50.3 与 §1.20 是两条不同口径,不能合起来读成对 Bedrock 内容的训练许可。
points.quote: This Section does not apply to Amazon Comprehend Medical, Amazon Transcribe Medical, AWS HealthScribe, Amazon Comprehend Detect PII or any AI Service that is not listed in the first sentence of this Section 50.3.

zdr.quote: Amazon Bedrock uses a zero data retention (ZDR) data security model. This means that by default, Amazon Bedrock does not store model inputs or outputs.

points.text: The default posture carries model-level exceptions: a model whose minimum requirement is `aws_review` (currently Claude Fable 5 and Claude Fable 5.1) is unavailable when the effective mode is `none` or `default` — on the bedrock-mantle endpoint it shows as unavailable, and requests to it on the bedrock-runtime endpoint return a `ValidationException`. Using such a model means accepting retention and possible AWS human review, so ZDR is not the default for it.
points.text_zh: 默认姿态带模型级例外:最低要求为 `aws_review` 的模型(当前为 Claude Fable 5 与 Claude Fable 5.1)在有效模式为 `none` 或 `default` 时不可用——bedrock-mantle 上显示为不可用,bedrock-runtime 上的请求返回 `ValidationException`。用这类模型即等于接受保留与可能的 AWS 人工审查,ZDR 对它们不是默认。
points.quote: and you invoke a model that requires retention, Amazon Bedrock will block the request and return an error

points.text: For models that require retention, ZDR is not self-serve: "ZDR access is evaluated on a per-account, per-model basis in coordination with the model provider", and you must contact your AWS account manager to discuss eligibility. Accounts approved for ZDR on a specific model see `none` added to that model's `allowed_modes`.
points.text_zh: 对需要保留的模型,ZDR 不是自助可得:ZDR 访问按账号、按模型与模型商协同评估,须联系 AWS 客户经理谈资格;获批的账号会在该模型的 `allowed_modes` 里看到 `none`。
points.quote: ZDR access is evaluated on a per-account, per-model basis in coordination with the model provider.

points.text: For Claude models the ZDR eligibility decision sits with Anthropic: "ZDR eligibility for Claude models is managed by Anthropic." Contact your Anthropic account representative for support.
points.text_zh: Claude 系列的 ZDR 资格由 Anthropic 管理,须联系 Anthropic 客户代表。
points.quote: ZDR eligibility for Claude models is managed by Anthropic. Contact your Anthropic account representative for support.

points.text: `store=false` is not a zero-retention guarantee: some models may still retain data for safety review even when `store=false`, and guaranteed zero retention requires setting `data_retention_mode` to `none`.
points.text_zh: `store=false` 不保证零保留:部分模型即使 `store=false` 仍会为安全审查保留数据;要保证零保留必须把 `data_retention_mode` 设为 `none`。
points.quote: Setting `store=false` does not guarantee zero data retention. Some models may still retain data for safety review even when `store=false` — in this case, data is retained but is not retrievable by the customer through `GET /v1/responses/{id}`. If you require guaranteed zero retention, set `data_retention_mode` to `none`.

points.text: Model-level exception that rules ZDR out in practice: for Anthropic Claude Fable 5 and Claude Fable 5.1, all traffic is retained for up to 30 days for automated offline abuse detection, and classifier-flagged traffic is subject to potential human review performed by AWS.
points.text_zh: 实际排除 ZDR 的模型级例外:Anthropic Claude Fable 5 与 Claude Fable 5.1 的全部流量都会为自动化离线滥用检测保留最多 30 天,被分类器标记的流量还可能由 AWS 人工审查。
points.quote: For Anthropic Claude Fable 5 and Claude Fable 5.1, all traffic will be retained for up to 30 days for automated offline abuse detection.

points.text: ZDR for the Enterprise Frontier Safeguards program has a stated end date: eligible customers receive ZDR only through December 31, 2026, and after ZDR ends all traffic is retained for up to 30 days for automated offline abuse detection.
points.text_zh: Enterprise Frontier Safeguards 的 ZDR 有明确截止日:合格客户只到 2026-12-31;ZDR 结束后全部流量会为自动化离线滥用检测保留最多 30 天。
points.quote: Customers that are eligible for the Enterprise Frontier Safeguards program will receive ZDR through December 31, 2026.

retention.quote: Amazon Bedrock stores Service inputs and outputs for up to 30 days (unless otherwise required by law) solely to detect activity that violates our, or third-party model providers’, terms of service or use policies

points.text: Object: Bedrock Service inputs and outputs, i.e. request and response bodies. Context: only "certain models identified on the Bedrock abuse detection page" — the models that require `aws_review`. Period type: an upper bound of 30 days, with the contract's own carve-out "unless otherwise required by law". This is the contract layer (AWS Service Terms §50.12.2), so it governs the api tier.
points.text_zh: 对象=Bedrock 服务输入输出正文(请求与响应正文);语境=仅 abuse detection 页所列的特定模型,即需 `aws_review` 的模型;期限类型=上限 30 天,并带合同自带的例外「除法律另有要求」。这是合同层(AWS Service Terms §50.12.2),对 api 档有约束力。
points.quote: Amazon Bedrock stores Service inputs and outputs for up to 30 days (unless otherwise required by law) solely to detect activity that violates our, or third-party model providers’, terms of service or use policies

points.text: Default for models not on the abuse detection list: Amazon Bedrock does not store model inputs or outputs. The 30-day period is the exception, not the default, and it does not apply to models that do not require retention.
points.text_zh: 不在 abuse detection 清单内的模型走默认:Bedrock 不存储模型输入输出。30 天是例外而非默认,不适用于不需要保留的模型。
points.quote: Amazon Bedrock uses a zero data retention (ZDR) data security model. This means that by default, Amazon Bedrock does not store model inputs or outputs.

points.text: Mandatory model-level exception: for Anthropic Claude Fable 5 and Claude Fable 5.1 all traffic (not only classifier-flagged traffic) is retained for up to 30 days for automated offline abuse detection, and classifier-flagged traffic is subject to potential human review performed by AWS. These models require `aws_review`, so this retention cannot be opted out of while using them.
points.text_zh: 强制性的模型级例外:Anthropic Claude Fable 5 与 Claude Fable 5.1 是全量流量(不只被分类器标记的流量)为自动化离线滥用检测保留最多 30 天,被标记的流量还可能由 AWS 人工审查。这两个模型要求 `aws_review`,用它就退不掉这项保留。
points.quote: For Anthropic Claude Fable 5 and Claude Fable 5.1, all traffic will be retained for up to 30 days for automated offline abuse detection.

points.text: Narrower model-level exception: for OpenAI GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.4, GPT-5.5, GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-5.6 Terra, GPT-5.6 Luna, Daybreak Red: GPT-5.6 Cyber and Daybreak Blue: GPT-5.6 Sol, only classifier-flagged traffic is retained for up to 30 days, and eligible customers may request full ZDR through their AWS account team.
points.text_zh: 范围更窄的模型级例外:OpenAI GPT-6 Astra、GPT-5.4、GPT-5.5、GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna、Daybreak Red: GPT-5.6 Cyber 与 Daybreak Blue: GPT-5.6 Sol,只有被分类器标记的流量保留最多 30 天,合格客户可通过 AWS 客户团队申请完全 ZDR。
points.quote: classifier-flagged traffic will be retained for up to 30 days for automated offline abuse detection.

points.text: Restated on the product-documentation side for the models requiring `aws_review` (currently Claude Fable 5 and Claude Fable 5.1): user prompts and completions are retained within the AWS boundary for up to 30 days and may be reviewed by AWS to meet the human review requirement the model provider imposes as a condition of access. The content is not shared with the model provider.
points.text_zh: 产品文档侧对需 `aws_review` 的模型(当前为 Claude Fable 5 与 Claude Fable 5.1)的重述:用户 prompt 与 completion 在 AWS 边界内保留最多 30 天,并可能由 AWS 审查,以满足模型商作为访问条件提出的人工审查要求;内容不与模型商共享。
points.quote: user prompts and completions are retained within the AWS boundary for up to 30 days and may be reviewed by AWS to meet the human review requirement the model provider imposes as a condition of access.

processing_region.quote: Any customer content processed by Amazon Bedrock is encrypted and stored at rest in the AWS Region where you are using Amazon Bedrock.

points.text: Default: customer content processed by Amazon Bedrock is encrypted and stored at rest in the AWS Region where you are using Amazon Bedrock, and geographic cross-Region inference profiles keep requests inside the geography (US/EU/APAC) with data remaining in the Regions where it originally resides — by default the data stays stored only in the source Region.
points.text_zh: 默认:Bedrock 处理的客户内容加密存放在你使用 Bedrock 的那个 AWS Region;地理跨区域推理(US/EU/APAC)把请求限制在同一 geography 内,数据留在原本所在的 Region,默认只存源 Region。
points.quote: Cross-Region inference requests to an inference profile tied to a geography (such as US, EU, and APAC) stay within that geography.

points.text: Documented divergence for abuse detection under cross-Region inference: "To the extent we store data for abuse detection, your input prompts and output results will be stored in the destination region." Scope is limited to requests routed through a cross-Region inference profile and to the models whose inputs and outputs are retained for abuse detection; the same page states that by default the data remains stored only in the source Region. Both statements are official, so both are kept here rather than picking one.
points.text_zh: 启用跨区域推理时,为滥用检测保留的数据落在目标 Region,与 FAQ 那句「存放在使用 Bedrock 的 Region」有适用边界上的分歧:「To the extent we store data for abuse detection, your input prompts and output results will be stored in the destination region.」适用范围仅限走跨区域推理 profile 的请求,且只涉及为滥用检测而保留输入输出的模型;同页写明默认仍只存源 Region。两句都是官方表述,并列保留、不选边。
points.quote: To the extent we store data for abuse detection, your input prompts and output results will be stored in the destination region.

points.text: Optional path outside any geography: with a global inference profile, requests may be processed in other supported AWS commercial Regions. It has to be chosen explicitly (global profile ARN plus the three-part IAM policy, or a deny SCP to switch it off), and AWS tells organizations with data residency or compliance requirements to assess whether Global cross-Region inference fits their compliance framework.
points.text_zh: 可选路径,不受 geography 限制:使用 global inference profile 时请求可能在全球其他受支持的商业 Region 处理。需显式选用(global profile ARN + 三段式 IAM 策略,禁用则用 deny SCP),官方要求有数据驻留或合规要求的组织自行评估是否适用。
points.quote: Organizations with data residency or compliance requirements should assess whether Global cross-Region inference fits their compliance framework, since requests may be processed in other supported AWS commercial Regions.

role.quote: AWS will act as processor to Customer, who can act either as controller or processor of Customer Data.

training.quote: We do not use content from [Kiro enterprise users](https://kiro.dev/docs/enterprise/concepts/#kiro-enterprise-user) for service improvement.

zdr.quote: If you are a [Kiro enterprise user](https://kiro.dev/docs/enterprise/concepts/#kiro-enterprise-user), your content, such as prompts and responses, may be stored in the region where your profile is configured in order to provide and maintain the service (for example: prompt logging, daily activity report), but it will not be used for service improvement.

points.text: 不用于服务改进不等于零保留：profile Region 可存 prompts/responses；管理员启用 prompt logging/activity reports 时写入客户 S3；模型滥用检测仍可保留。
points.text_zh: 不用于服务改进不等于零保留：profile Region 可存 prompts/responses；管理员启用 prompt logging/activity reports 时写入客户 S3；模型滥用检测仍可保留。

points.text: Page-level statement, not tier-specific: Kiro may store your questions, responses and additional context such as code and metadata about your requests. The storage scope therefore covers inputs and outputs, not inputs alone.
points.text_zh: 页面级、不分档的通用存储陈述：Kiro 可能存储你的问题、响应以及代码和请求元数据等附加上下文。存储范围因此是输入＋输出，不只是输入。
points.quote: Kiro may store your questions, responses, and additional context such as code and metadata about your requests to generate new responses to your requests and in some circumstances for abuse detection purposes (for more information, see Abuse detection).

points.text: Contract layer: §50.14.2 applies Bedrock abuse detection to Kiro use regardless of tier, including retention and potential human review of inputs and outputs when certain models are selected.
points.text_zh: 合同层：§50.14.2 的 Bedrock 滥用检测不限档位地适用于 Kiro，含选择特定模型时对输入输出的留存与可能的人工审查。
points.quote: Per Section 1.24 of the Service Terms, Amazon Bedrock abuse detection mechanisms apply to your use of Kiro, including our retention and potential human review of inputs and outputs when you select certain models. See here for more details. Additionally, only for Kiro Free Tier users, we may store your inputs for up to 60 days (unless otherwise required by law) for the purposes of detecting activity that violates the Agreement and improving our ability to detect such activity.

retention.summary: 按对象分列未公布期限

points.text: 一般内容及客户 S3 日志期限由文档/客户配置未披露；GPT 标记流量与 Fable 5.1 Preview 流量最长 30 天。代码索引/缓存期限未披露。
points.text_zh: 一般内容及客户 S3 日志期限由文档/客户配置未披露；GPT 标记流量与 Fable 5.1 Preview 流量最长 30 天。代码索引/缓存期限未披露。

points.text: Contract layer deletion commitment: following closure of your AWS account, AWS will delete Your Content in accordance with the technical documentation applicable to the Services. Context = after account closure, object = Your Content; the period type is delegated to technical documentation and is therefore undisclosed — this is not a 60/30-day style retention period.
points.text_zh: 合同层的删除承诺：AWS 账户注销后，AWS 会按适用于该服务的技术文档删除 Your Content。语境＝账号注销后，对象＝Your Content；期限类型交给技术文档，等于未披露——不是 60/30 天那样的留存期限。
points.quote: Following closure of your AWS account, we will delete Your Content in accordance with the technical documentation applicable to the Services.

points.text: Contract layer, not tier-specific: §50.14.2 applies Bedrock abuse detection to Kiro use, including retention and potential human review of inputs and outputs when certain models are selected; §50.12.2 puts a 30-day upper bound (with the "unless otherwise required by law" carve-out) on the inputs and outputs of certain models only.
points.text_zh: 合同层（不限档位）：§50.14.2 让 Bedrock 滥用检测适用于 Kiro，含选择特定模型时对输入输出的留存与可能的人工审查；§50.12.2 只对「特定模型」的输入输出给出 30 天上限，并带「unless otherwise required by law」例外。
points.quote: Per Section 1.24 of the Service Terms, Amazon Bedrock abuse detection mechanisms apply to your use of Kiro, including our retention and potential human review of inputs and outputs when you select certain models. See here for more details. Additionally, only for Kiro Free Tier users, we may store your inputs for up to 60 days (unless otherwise required by law) for the purposes of detecting activity that violates the Agreement and improving our ability to detect such activity.

points.text: Second model-level case: for Anthropic Claude Fable 5.1 (Preview) all traffic is retained up to 30 days, and classifier-flagged traffic is subject to potential human review performed by AWS.
points.text_zh: 模型级的第二种情形：Anthropic Claude Fable 5.1 (Preview) 全量流量最多 30 天，且被标记流量可能由 AWS 人工审查。
points.quote: For Anthropic Claude Fable 5.1 (Preview), all traffic will be retained for up to 30 days (unless otherwise required by law) for automated offline abuse detection.

processing_region.quote: If you are a [Kiro enterprise user](https://kiro.dev/docs/enterprise/concepts/#kiro-enterprise-user), your content, such as prompts and responses, may be stored in the region where your profile is configured in order to provide and maintain the service (for example: prompt logging, daily activity report), but it will not be used for service improvement.

points.text: 存储可在 profile Region；常规模型在 geography 内跨区推理，experimental 可在全球商业 AWS Regions 推理。
points.text_zh: 存储可在 profile Region；常规模型在 geography 内跨区推理，experimental 可在全球商业 AWS Regions 推理。

points.text: Which geography serves a request depends on the model and the profile region: GPT-5.6 models are served from the US regardless of profile region, Claude Fable 5.1 (Preview) only in US East (N. Virginia), and every other model from the geography that matches the profile.
points.text_zh: 由哪个 geography 服务取决于模型与 profile region：GPT-5.6 一律从美国服务（与 profile region 无关），Claude Fable 5.1 (Preview) 仅 US East (N. Virginia)，其余模型按 profile 所在的 geography。
points.quote: The geography that serves your request depends on both the model you select and the region of your Kiro profile. GPT-5.6 models are served from the US regardless of your profile region. Claude Fable 5.1 is currently available only in US East (N. Virginia). Every other model is served from the geography that matches your profile.

points.text: Exception that follows the model, not the tier: global cross-region inference applies only to models explicitly designated as experimental; their inference requests may be processed in multiple AWS Regions worldwide, including Regions outside the one associated with the Kiro profile, while the storage Region is unaffected.
points.text_zh: 按模型而非按档位的例外：全球跨区推理只适用于明确标注 experimental 的模型，其推理请求可能在多个 AWS Region 处理，包括与 Kiro profile 无关的 Region；存储地不受影响。
points.quote: Inference requests may be processed in multiple AWS Regions globally, including Regions outside the one associated with your Kiro profile.

points.text: Models page states the same exception: experimental models may be processed in commercial AWS Regions worldwide, including outside the profile's geography, and cross-region inference does not change where data is stored.
points.text_zh: models 页同旨：experimental 模型可能在全球商业 AWS Regions 处理，包括 profile geography 之外；跨区推理不改变数据存储地。
points.quote: Models marked experimental are an exception to the table above: they may be processed in commercial AWS Regions worldwide, including outside your profile's geography.

role.quote: These Service Terms incorporate the [AWS Data Processing Addendum](https://d1.awsstatic.com/legal/aws-dpa/aws-dpa.pdf) (“DPA”), when you use AWS Services to process Customer Data (as defined in the DPA).

points.text: 适用链：Kiro 被 AWS Service Terms §50.1 明列为 AI Service，§1.14 在 AWS Services 处理 Customer Data 时纳入 AWS DPA/SCC；仅据此判企业 AWS 账户链。
points.text_zh: 适用链：Kiro 被 AWS Service Terms §50.1 明列为 AI Service，§1.14 在 AWS Services 处理 Customer Data 时纳入 AWS DPA/SCC；仅据此判企业 AWS 账户链。

training.quote: We may use certain content from Kiro Free Tier and Kiro individual subscribers for service improvement.

points.text: Contract layer, the strongest basis for this tier's mark=no: §50.3 names "Kiro Free Tier" among the services for which AWS may "use and store AI Content ... to develop and improve the applicable AI Service and its underlying technologies", and may use AI Content that is not personal data to develop and improve AWS and affiliate machine-learning and artificial-intelligence technologies. The product-page sentence (kiro-individual-training) is the same finding from the lower-authority source.
points.text_zh: 合同层依据（本档 mark=no 的最强来源）：§50.3 点名「Kiro Free Tier」，AWS 可「use and store AI Content ... to develop and improve the applicable AI Service and its underlying technologies」，非个人数据还可用于开发改进 AWS 及关联方的机器学习/人工智能技术。产品页那句（kiro-individual-training）是同向的低层级证据。
points.quote: Kiro Free Tier, and Kiro individual subscribers (as described here): (a) we may use and store AI Content that is processed by each of the foregoing AI Services to develop and improve the applicable AI Service and its underlying technologies; (b) we may use and store AI Content that is not personal data to develop and improve AWS and affiliate machine-learning and artificial-intelligence technologies; and (c) solely in connection with the development and improvement described in clauses (a) and (b), we may store such AI Content in an AWS region outside of the AWS region where you are using such AI Service.

zdr.quote: we may store your inputs for up to 60 days (unless otherwise required by law) for the purposes of detecting activity that violates the Agreement and improving our ability to detect this activity.

points.text: Page-level statement, not tier-specific: Kiro may store your questions, responses and additional context such as code and metadata about your requests. The storage scope therefore covers inputs and outputs, not inputs alone.
points.text_zh: 页面级、不分档的通用存储陈述：Kiro 可能存储你的问题、响应以及代码和请求元数据等附加上下文。存储范围因此是输入＋输出，不只是输入。
points.quote: Kiro may store your questions, responses, and additional context such as code and metadata about your requests to generate new responses to your requests and in some circumstances for abuse detection purposes (for more information, see Abuse detection).

points.text: No zero-retention option is disclosed for this tier. Opting out of service improvement does not stop abuse-detection storage: for Free Tier the 60-day input retention still applies after opt-out.
points.text_zh: 本档未披露任何零保留方案。退出服务改进不停止滥用检测留存：Free 档退出后，输入 60 天的留存仍然适用。
points.quote: If you are a Kiro Free Tier user, opting out of sharing your data for service improvement does not affect our ability to store your inputs for abuse detection purposes as described in more detail here.

points.text: Contract layer: §50.14.2 states that Bedrock abuse detection mechanisms apply to Kiro use, including retention and potential human review of inputs and outputs when certain models are selected, and repeats the Free Tier 60-day input retention.

points.text: Period type and scope at the contract layer: §50.12.2 covers only "certain models identified on the Bedrock abuse detection page", states an upper bound of 30 days on Service inputs and outputs with the clause's own carve-out "unless otherwise required by law", and allows AWS to review inputs and outputs on a suspected violation.
