processing_region.quote: Kiro is powered by Amazon Bedrock, which uses cross-region inference to distribute requests across the Regions within a geography.

points.text: Which geography serves a request depends on the model and the profile region: GPT-5.6 models are served from the US regardless of profile region, Claude Fable 5.1 (Preview) only in US East (N. Virginia), and every other model from the geography that matches the profile.
points.text_zh: 由哪个 geography 服务取决于模型与 profile region：GPT-5.6 一律从美国服务（与 profile region 无关），Claude Fable 5.1 (Preview) 仅 US East (N. Virginia)，其余模型按 profile 所在的 geography。
points.quote: The geography that serves your request depends on both the model you select and the region of your Kiro profile. GPT-5.6 models are served from the US regardless of your profile region. Claude Fable 5.1 is currently available only in US East (N. Virginia). Every other model is served from the geography that matches your profile.

points.text: Exception that follows the model, not the tier: global cross-region inference applies only to models explicitly designated as experimental; their inference requests may be processed in multiple AWS Regions worldwide, including Regions outside the one associated with the Kiro profile, while the storage Region is unaffected.
points.text_zh: 按模型而非按档位的例外：全球跨区推理只适用于明确标注 experimental 的模型，其推理请求可能在多个 AWS Region 处理，包括与 Kiro profile 无关的 Region；存储地不受影响。
points.quote: Inference requests may be processed in multiple AWS Regions globally, including Regions outside the one associated with your Kiro profile.

points.text: Models page states the same exception: experimental models may be processed in commercial AWS Regions worldwide, including outside the profile's geography, and cross-region inference does not change where data is stored.
points.text_zh: models 页同旨：experimental 模型可能在全球商业 AWS Regions 处理，包括 profile geography 之外；跨区推理不改变数据存储地。
points.quote: Models marked experimental are an exception to the table above: they may be processed in commercial AWS Regions worldwide, including outside your profile's geography.

points.text: Downstream constraint: model availability varies by country or region, and Kiro's model offerings align with each provider's usage and geographic requirements (OpenAI, Anthropic, MiniMax, Zhipu AI, DeepSeek, Qwen).
points.text_zh: 下游约束：模型可用性因国家/地区而异，Kiro 的模型供给对齐各家提供方（OpenAI、Anthropic、MiniMax、Zhipu AI、DeepSeek、Qwen）的使用与地域要求。
points.quote: Model availability can vary by country or region. Kiro's model offerings align with each provider's usage and geographic requirements. For more information, see supported countries and regions: OpenAI, Anthropic, MiniMax, Zhipu AI (GLM), DeepSeek, and Qwen.

points.text: No official text assigns a role to this hop: the Bedrock sentence describes the inference path only (cross-region inference within a geography) and does not characterise Kiro or its model suppliers as processor, controller or subprocessor.
points.text_zh: 没有官方原文给这一跳定性：Bedrock 那句只讲推理路径（geography 内的跨区推理），没有把 Kiro 或其模型供给方写成 processor、controller 或 subprocessor。
points.quote: Kiro is powered by Amazon Bedrock, which uses cross-region inference to distribute requests across the Regions within a geography.

points.text: Third-party model providers are a separate, separately contracted hop: §50.12.1 supplies third-party models as "Third-Party Content", applies Section 20 (AWS Marketplace) to models sold by third parties, and makes Amazon Web Services, Inc. the invoicing party — independent contracting rather than a sub-processor relationship.
points.text_zh: 第三方模型提供方是独立的一跳、各自缔约：§50.12.1 把第三方模型作为「Third-Party Content」提供，第三方销售的模型适用 §20（AWS Marketplace），并由 Amazon Web Services, Inc. 开票——更像各自缔约，而不是次级受托关系。
points.quote: Third-party models are available to you on Amazon Bedrock as “Third-Party Content”. By using a third-party model, you agree to the applicable terms here. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in the Agreement or Service Terms, Section 20 (AWS Marketplace) above applies to your use of models sold by third parties, and Amazon Web Services, Inc. is the invoicing party with respect to these models.

points.text: Scope of that hop: §50.12.5 says information shared with a third-party model provider does not include Your Content. The models page lists the downstream providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, MiniMax, Zhipu AI, DeepSeek, Qwen) without any role characterisation.
points.text_zh: 这一跳的范围：§50.12.5 明确与第三方模型提供方共享的信息不含 Your Content；models 页列出下游提供方（OpenAI、Anthropic、MiniMax、Zhipu AI、DeepSeek、Qwen），但没有任何角色表述。
points.quote: We may share information, that does not include Your Content, about your use of a third-party model with the provider of that third-party model.

points.text: Official chain is Kiro → Amazon Bedrock hosted models only. No BYOK, custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint or local model capability was found, so there is no separately documented BYOK or local-inference data hop, and running the agent on your own machine is not local inference.
points.text_zh: 官方链路只有 Kiro→Amazon Bedrock 托管模型。未发现 BYOK、自定义 OpenAI-compatible endpoint 或本地模型能力；因此没有可单列的 BYOK/本地数据链，不能把本机 agent 执行误写成本地推理。

training.quote: Anthropic may not train models on Customer Content from Services.

points.text: Commercial Terms §B: "Anthropic may not train models on Customer Content from Services."
points.text_zh: Commercial Terms §B 禁止用 Customer Content 训练

points.text: Privacy Center article 7996868 for the commercial tier says the same (inputs and outputs are not used for training by default).
points.text_zh: 商业档隐私中心 7996868 同口径(默认不使用输入输出训练)。

points.text: Exception to the default prohibition, limited to material the customer chooses to submit: "If you explicitly opt in to methods to provide us with materials to train on, such as via the Development Partner Program, we may use those materials provided to train our models. An organization admin can expressly opt-in to the Development Partner Program for their organization." The programme is first-party API only ("available only for Anthropic first-party API, and not for Amazon Bedrock or Google Cloud’s Agent Platform users"). Object = materials the customer submits for training; context = an organization admin opts the organization in. It does not weaken the §B prohibition on ordinary API traffic, so mark stays yes.
points.text_zh: 默认禁止之外的例外,只限客户主动提交的材料:客户显式 opt-in(如通过 Development Partner Program)后,其提交的材料可被用于训练模型;组织管理员可为组织 opt-in。对象=客户主动提交用于训练的材料;语境=组织管理员主动加入,且该计划仅第一方 API 可用(Bedrock 与 Google Cloud Agent Platform 明示不适用)。本条不削弱 §B 对一般 API 流量的禁止,mark 仍为 yes。
points.quote: If you explicitly opt in to methods to provide us with materials to train on, such as via the Development Partner Program, we may use those materials provided to train our models. An organization admin can expressly opt-in to the Development Partner Program for their organization. Note that this program is available only for Anthropic first-party API, and not for Amazon Bedrock or Google Cloud’s Agent Platform users.

zdr.quote: Anthropic does not store their inputs or outputs except where needed to comply with law or combat misuse or harm

points.text: Based on article 8956058 (dated June 9, 2026): qualified Claude API (Claude Platform) and Claude Code for Enterprise customers can have a ZDR arrangement after Anthropic approval, under which "Anthropic does not store their inputs or outputs except where needed to comply with law or combat misuse or harm"; User Safety classification results are still retained
points.text_zh: 依据为 8956058(文章日期 June 9, 2026):合格 Claude API(Claude Platform)与 Claude Code for Enterprise 客户经 Anthropic 审批后可有 ZDR 安排,Anthropic 不存储其输入输出(除遵守法律或反滥用/防伤害所需),仍保留 User Safety 分类结果

points.text: ZDR requests are approved organization by organization ("ZDR is enabled per organization; each new organization requires ZDR to be enabled separately by your account team"), and Claude Platform users can confirm it under Settings > Privacy Controls > Data retention period. The same article states expressly that these arrangements "are distinct from Anthropic's default approach to data retention" (= the 30-day rule in 7996866). For the feature-level scope (which endpoints are eligible, and that stateful features such as Batch, Files and code execution are not), see api-and-data-retention — that page was marked contradiction this round because its retention statement conflicts with 7996866, so it is no longer used as a basis for this dimension (the anchor is kept and fetched daily).
points.text_zh: ZDR 请求按 organization 逐一审批,Claude Platform 用户可在 Settings > Privacy Controls > Data retention period 确认。该文并把 ZDR 安排与「Anthropic’s default approach to data retention」(=7996866 的 30 天口径)明确区分。功能级适用范围(哪些 endpoint 合格、Batch/Files/Code execution 等有状态功能不适用)见 api-and-data-retention——该页本轮因 retention 口径与 7996866 冲突已标 contradiction,故不再作为本维度的依据(锚点保留、每天抓)。

points.text: Model-level limit on ZDR: "Additionally, for Covered Models, we require limited data retention and review as a part of our safety work." The models concerned are Claude Fable 5 / Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5 / Mythos 5.1; the api-and-data-retention page spells out that they require 30-day data retention and are "not available under ZDR unless expressly authorized by Anthropic", and that requests from an organization whose retention configuration does not meet the requirement are rejected. That page is marked contradiction this round, so it is cited here only as the source of the specific figure — the anchor on this point is the core privacy-centre sentence. Organizations that already have a ZDR arrangement can still make these models available in a single workspace by enabling 30-day retention for that workspace only.
points.text_zh: ZDR 的模型级限定:Covered Models(Claude Fable 5 / Fable 5.1 与 Claude Mythos 5 / Mythos 5.1)强制有限期保留与安全审查;据 api-and-data-retention 页,即强制 30 天保留,未获 Anthropic 明确授权时不适用 ZDR,保留配置不满足要求的组织调用会被拒绝。该页本轮已标 contradiction,此处仅作具体数字的出处,本 point 的锚点仍是隐私中心的核心句。已有 ZDR 安排的组织仍可只为某个 workspace 开启 30 天保留来放行这些模型。
points.quote: Additionally, for Covered Models, we require limited data retention and review as a part of our safety work.

retention.quote: we automatically delete inputs and outputs on our backend within 30 days of receipt or generation

points.text: Standard retention on the commercial tier: "we automatically delete inputs and outputs on our backend within 30 days of receipt or generation" (exceptions: services where you control longer retention such as the Files API, a separate agreement with us such as a ZDR arrangement, what is needed to enforce the Usage Policy, and legal requirements)
points.text_zh: 商业档标准保留:API 输入输出在后端 30 天内自动删除(例外:你自控更长保留的服务如 Files API、你与我们另有约定如 ZDR 协议、执行 Usage Policy 所需、法律要求)

points.text: Violative content up to 2 years, trust and safety classification scores up to 7 years
points.text_zh: 违规内容最多 2 年、信任安全分类分数最多 7 年

points.text: Feedback 5 years. The developer documentation page api-and-data-retention separately states "Conversation content (your prompts and Claude's outputs) is not retained by default", which conflicts literally with this rule (same tier, same dimension, both current versions); that page was marked contradiction this round and is no longer used as a basis for this dimension
points.text_zh: Feedback 5 年。开发者文档 api-and-data-retention 另有「Conversation content … is not retained by default」口径,与本口径字面冲突(同档位、同维度、均为现行版本),本轮已把该页标 contradiction,不再作为本维度依据

points.text: See that source's contradiction_note for details.
points.text_zh: 详见该源 contradiction_note。

points.text: A separate object and context inside the same commercial policy — conversations kept inside the products: "If you use our other commercial products (e.g. Claude for Work, Claude for Enterprise, Anthropic Console, etc.) that allow you to save and continue conversations with Claude, we retain your chats and coding sessions in the product to provide you with a consistent product experience." Object = chats and coding sessions saved in those products (including a customer's own use of the Claude Console); context = default; control = the user ("You control your conversations and can delete your chats anytime from your dashboard"): a deleted conversation is "Removed from your chat history immediately" and "Deleted from our back-end storage systems within 30 days", and Incognito chats are automatically deleted within 30 days unless flagged as a Usage Policy violation. This does not apply to API request bodies, which follow the 30-day inputs/outputs rule above.
points.text_zh: 同一篇商业档政策内的另一套对象与语境——留在产品里的会话:可续聊的商业产品(Claude for Work / Claude for Enterprise / Anthropic Console 等)中的 chats 与 coding sessions 默认保留在产品中,以提供一致的体验。对象=这些产品内保存的会话与编码会话(含客户自己在 Claude Console 里的使用);语境=默认;控制权=用户(随时可在 dashboard 删除,删除后立即移出历史、后端 30 天内清除;Incognito 会话 30 天内自动删除,被标为违反 Usage Policy 的除外)。本条不适用于 API 请求正文,后者适用上文输入输出 30 天口径。

points.text: Model-level exception to the 30-day default: Covered Models "require limited data retention and review as a part of our safety work" — per the api-and-data-retention page that means a mandatory 30-day retention for Claude Fable 5 / Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5 / Mythos 5.1, so those models cannot be used under ZDR unless Anthropic expressly authorizes it. Object = inputs and outputs of those models; context = requests to Covered Models; type = mandatory lower bound of 30 days, not an optional extension.
points.text_zh: 30 天默认之外的模型级例外:Covered Models 强制有限期保留与安全审查;据 api-and-data-retention 页,即 Claude Fable 5 / Fable 5.1 与 Claude Mythos 5 / Mythos 5.1 强制 30 天保留,未获 Anthropic 明确授权时不能跑在 ZDR 下。对象=这些模型的输入输出;语境=调用 Covered Models 的请求;期限类型=强制下限 30 天,不是可选延长。
points.quote: Additionally, for Covered Models, we require limited data retention and review as a part of our safety work.

points.text: ZDR and the 30-day default do not mean that nothing in this tier is kept longer. Several retention models sit outside those arrangements: the Activity Feed (a Compliance API feature) retains data for 6 years; local session transcripts (sessions on users' machines, in apps such as Cowork and Claude Code) are stored for 6 years by default, or for the organization's custom conversation retention period when a finite one is set; remote session transcripts (Cowork in the cloud) are retained for 6 years unless the user deletes the session sooner; and chat, file and project content from claude.ai follows the organization's retention policy set in claude.ai > Organization settings > Data and privacy, unless a user deletes it sooner. The claude.ai content and the session transcripts belong to those product and client surfaces rather than to API request bodies. Source: api-and-data-retention, whose retention statement is marked contradiction this round; this paragraph is recorded as context only and carries no anchor.
points.text_zh: ZDR 与 30 天默认都不等于本档什么都不会留更久。多套保留模型在这些安排之外:Activity Feed(Compliance API 功能)保留 6 年;本地会话转写(用户机器上、Cowork 与 Claude Code 等 app 的会话)默认存 6 年,组织设置了有限的会话保留期时按该期限;远端会话转写(Cowork 云端)保留 6 年,用户提前删除除外;claude.ai 的 chat / file / project 内容随 claude.ai > Organization settings > Data and privacy 中组织的保留策略,用户提前删除除外。后两类属产品与客户端界面,不是 API 请求正文。出处为 api-and-data-retention 页(其 retention 表述本轮标 contradiction),本段仅作语境记录、不承载锚点。

points.text: Contract layer, DPA Schedule 1 (the SCC description of processing): "B.7. **Storage Limitation**: The duration is the term of the Agreement." Object = Customer Data; the duration given is the processing duration, i.e. the term of the Agreement, not a content TTL — it layers on top of, and does not replace, the 30-day in-service inputs/outputs rule above.
points.text_zh: 合同层,DPA Schedule 1(SCC 处理描述):处理期限=协议期限。对象=Customer Data;这里给的是处理期限(合同期限),不是内容 TTL,与上文在役 30 天输入输出口径并存、不替代它。
points.quote: B.7. **Storage Limitation**: The duration is the term of the Agreement.

points.text: Termination layer, DPA §H.1.b: within thirty (30) days of the date of termination or expiration of the Agreement Anthropic deletes "all copies of Customer Data (including Customer Personal Data) processed by Anthropic or any Subprocessors", except to the extent (i) Applicable Data Protection Laws or other legal or regulatory requirements require storage, (ii) retention is necessary to resolve a dispute between the parties, or (iii) retention is necessary to combat harmful use of the Services. Object = all Customer Data; context = after termination or expiration; type = upper bound, with three exceptions.
points.text_zh: 终止层,DPA §H.1.b:协议终止或到期后 30 天内删除全部 Customer Data(含 Customer Personal Data,含 Subprocessor 处理的),例外三类:法律/监管要求留存、解决双方争议所需、打击服务有害使用所需。对象=全部 Customer Data;语境=协议终止或到期后;期限类型=上限,带三条例外。
points.quote: delete all copies of Customer Data (including Customer Personal Data) processed by Anthropic or any Subprocessors, except to the extent (i) Applicable Data Protection Laws or other applicable legal or regulatory requirements requires storage of the Customer Data, (ii) retention of the Customer Data by Anthropic is necessary to resolve a dispute between the parties, or (iii) retention of the Customer Data is necessary to combat harmful use of the Services.

points.text: DPA Schedule 2 I.5: "Security-related logs are retained for appropriate timeframes to aid in the investigation of security incidents." Object = security-related logs; no fixed number and no stated upper bound.
points.text_zh: DPA Schedule 2 I.5:安全类日志保留「适当期限」以便调查安全事件。对象=安全类日志;未给具体数字,也没有明确上限。
points.quote: I.5. Security-related logs are retained for appropriate timeframes to aid in the investigation of security incidents.

processing_region.quote: Default. Inference may run in any available geography for optimal performance and availability.

points.text: Inference geo defaults to global, with us available as an option (billed at 1.1x)
points.text_zh: inference geo 默认 global、可选 us(1.1x 计费)

points.text: Workspace geo is us only and cannot be changed. DPA §I.1 separately provides the cross-border mechanism through SCC Module Two / Module Three.
points.text_zh: workspace geo 仅 us 且不可改。DPA §I.1 另有 SCC Module Two/Three 跨境机制。

role.quote: Customer is the controller and Anthropic is Customer’s processor.

points.text: DPA §B.1: "Customer is the controller and Anthropic is Customer's processor."
points.text_zh: DPA §B.1:Customer 是 controller、Anthropic 是 processor

points.text: The API documentation also states that Anthropic is the data processor.
points.text_zh: API 页亦声明 Anthropic 为 data processor。

training.quote: including training our models, unless you opt out of training through your account settings

points.text: Consumer tiers use an opt-in setting: "We will train new models using data from Free, Pro, and Max accounts when this setting is on" (including Claude Code used under those accounts)
points.text_zh: 消费档为 opt-in 开关:开启时用 Free/Pro/Max 账号(含这些账号下的 Claude Code)数据训练新模型

points.text: The Consumer Terms grant the license by default with the ability to opt out; after opting out, Feedback and safety-flagged content are still used for training.
points.text_zh: Consumer Terms 为默认许可+可退出,退出后 Feedback 与安全标记内容仍用于训练。

points.text: Session quality survey transcripts are excluded from training: "Your responses to this survey, including session transcripts submitted after the rating prompt, do not impact your data training preferences and cannot be used to train our AI models."
points.text_zh: 会话质量调查的 transcript 明确不用于训练:不影响训练偏好,也不能用于训练模型。
points.quote: Your responses to this survey, including session transcripts submitted after the rating prompt, do not impact your data training preferences and cannot be used to train our AI models.

zdr.quote: If a developer signs in to Claude Code with a personal account or with an API key from a different organization, those sessions are not covered.

points.text: No ZDR on consumer tiers: "Zero Data Retention (ZDR) for Claude Code is available to qualified accounts on Claude for Enterprise."
points.text_zh: 消费档无 ZDR:仅 Claude for Enterprise 合格账号

points.text: Sessions signed in with a personal account (Free/Pro/Max) are expressly out of scope: "If a developer signs in to Claude Code with a personal account or with an API key from a different organization, those sessions are not covered."
points.text_zh: 个人账号(Free/Pro/Max)登录的会话明确不在覆盖范围

points.text: The API article likewise excludes "Claude Free, Pro, and Max plans, including when customers on those plans use Claude's web, desktop, or mobile apps or Claude Code."
points.text_zh: API 页亦正面排除 Free/Pro/Max 及其账号下的 Claude Code。
points.quote: Claude Free, Pro, and Max plans, including when customers on those plans use Claude's web, desktop, or mobile apps or Claude Code.

retention.quote: Users who allow data use for model improvement: 5-year retention period to support model development and safety improvements

points.text: The period depends on the model-improvement privacy toggle: "Users who allow data use for model improvement: 5-year retention period to support model development and safety improvements" (upper bound of that track)
points.text_zh: 保留期限取决于「是否允许用于模型改进」的隐私开关:允许改进的轨道为 5 年(上限)

points.text: The other track is 30 days: "Users who don't allow data use for model improvement: 30-day retention period". The schema renders a single number, so days=1825 is the upper bound of the track that applies while the toggle is on (the Consumer Terms license training use by default, with an opt-out).
points.text_zh: 另一轨为 30 天:不允许用于模型改进=30 天。schema 只能渲染一个数字,故 days=1825 取开关打开那一轨的上限(Consumer Terms 默认授权训练、可退出)。
points.quote: Users who don’t allow data use for model improvement: 30-day retention period

points.text: Feedback transcripts: "Transcripts shared via /feedback, or via /bug and /share, which report through the same path, are retained for 5 years."
points.text_zh: 反馈 transcript:经 /feedback、/bug、/share(同一提交路径)提交的内容保留 5 年。
points.quote: Transcripts shared via `/feedback`, or via `/bug` and `/share`, which report through the same path, are retained for 5 years.

points.text: Deleting a cloud session: "You can delete individual cloud sessions at any time. Deleting a session permanently removes the session's event data."
points.text_zh: 云会话可随时删除;删除后永久移除该会话的事件数据。
points.quote: You can delete individual cloud sessions at any time. Deleting a session permanently removes the session’s event data.

points.text: Session quality survey transcripts, uploaded only if the user explicitly selects Yes, are retained for up to 6 months.
points.text_zh: 会话质量调查 transcript 仅在用户显式选 Yes 时上传,最多保留 6 个月。
points.quote: Shared transcripts are retained for up to 6 months.

processing_region.quote: your personal data is transferred to our servers in the US

points.text: No residency option on consumer tiers: "your personal data is transferred to our servers in the US" or to countries outside the EEA/UK. That sentence is generic consumer-product wording (the consumer tier of Claude Code is routed to the Consumer Terms + Privacy Policy by the data-usage page), not a Claude Code specific clause, hence confidence=medium.
points.text_zh: 消费档无驻留选项:个人数据传输至美国服务器或 EEA/UK 以外国家。该句是消费产品通用表述(Claude Code 消费档经 data-usage 页指向 Consumer Terms + Privacy Policy),不是 Claude Code 专属条款,故 confidence=medium。

role.quote: the data controller responsible for your personal data is Anthropic Ireland, Limited

points.text: On consumer tiers Anthropic is the controller (§9 designates Anthropic Ireland, Limited or Anthropic PBC according to the user's place of residence)
points.text_zh: 消费档 Anthropic 为 controller(§9 按居住地指定 Anthropic Ireland / Anthropic PBC)

points.text: The Privacy Policy states that it does not apply to content processed on behalf of customers of Anthropic's business offerings, such as Enterprise accounts, and that such use is governed by the customer agreements — confirming from the other side that the consumer tier is controller. No formal agreement-level controller/processor definition appears at the consumer_privacy level, hence medium.
points.text_zh: 隐私政策说明本政策不适用于代表商业客户(如 Enterprise 账号)处理的内容、那部分由客户协议管辖,反向确认消费档为 controller。consumer_privacy 层未出现 controller/processor 的正式协议定义,故 medium。
points.quote: This Privacy Policy does not apply to content that we process on behalf of customers of our business offerings, such as our Enterprise accounts. Our use of that data is governed by our customer agreements covering access to and use of those offerings.

training.quote: Anthropic does not train generative models using code or prompts sent to Claude Code under commercial terms, unless the customer has chosen to provide their data to us for model improvement

points.text: 商业档默认不使用代码或提示训练生成模型；仅客户主动选择向 Anthropic 提供数据用于模型改进时例外。
points.text_zh: 商业档默认不使用代码或提示训练生成模型；仅客户主动选择向 Anthropic 提供数据用于模型改进时例外。

zdr.quote: Zero Data Retention (ZDR) for Claude Code is available to qualified accounts on Claude for Enterprise.

points.text: ZDR 仅适用于合格 Enterprise 账号，不包含在标准 Enterprise 套餐中，须由账号团队确认资格并按组织启用。启用后提示与响应实时处理、响应返回后不存储，但法律与反滥用例外仍适用。
points.text_zh: ZDR 仅适用于合格 Enterprise 账号，不包含在标准 Enterprise 套餐中，须由账号团队确认资格并按组织启用。启用后提示与响应实时处理、响应返回后不存储，但法律与反滥用例外仍适用。

points.text: Enabling ZDR disables features that require storing prompts or completions at the backend level: cloud sessions (including those started from the Desktop app), Claude Tag, Artifacts, /feedback (with /bug and /share on the same path) and Remote Control.
points.text_zh: 启用 ZDR 会在后端禁用需要存储提示或响应的功能:云会话(含从 Desktop 启动的会话)、Claude Tag、Artifacts、/feedback(与 /bug、/share 同路径)以及 Remote Control。
points.quote:
| Cloud sessions, including those started from the Desktop app | Requires server-side storage of session data, including conversation history with prompts and completions. |
| Claude Tag | Retains channel memory and session transcripts. |
| Artifacts | Requires storing published page content on Anthropic-operated infrastructure. |
| Feedback submission (`/feedback`, `/bug`, `/share`) | Submitting feedback sends conversation data to Anthropic. |
| Remote Control | Stores the session transcript on Anthropic servers to sync the conversation across devices. |

points.text: Covered Models are an exception to ZDR: "Claude Fable 5.1 and Fable 5 are Covered Models that require data retention by default, and whether a ZDR organization or workspace can use them is governed by the Covered Models policies rather than by Claude Code." Where they cannot be used they are absent from the /model picker or shown as disabled.
points.text_zh: Covered Models 是 ZDR 的例外:Fable 5.1/Fable 5 默认要求保留数据,ZDR 组织或工作区能否使用由 Covered Models 政策而非 Claude Code 决定;不能用时在 /model 选择器里直接缺席或显示为禁用。
points.quote: Claude Fable 5.1 and Fable 5 are Covered Models that require data retention by default, and whether a ZDR organization or workspace can use them is governed by the Covered Models policies rather than by Claude Code.

points.text: Even with ZDR enabled, flagged sessions are an exception: "If a session is flagged for a policy violation, Anthropic may retain the associated inputs and outputs for up to 2 years, consistent with Anthropic's standard ZDR policy."
points.text_zh: 即使启用 ZDR,被标记违规的会话仍是例外:该会话的输入输出最多保留 2 年(与标准 ZDR 政策一致)。
points.quote: Even with ZDR enabled, Anthropic may retain data where required by law or to address Usage Policy violations. If a session is flagged for a policy violation, Anthropic may retain the associated inputs and outputs for up to 2 years, consistent with Anthropic’s standard ZDR policy.

retention.quote: Standard: 30-day retention period

points.text: 标准 Enterprise 的保留期为 30 天；合格且另行启用 ZDR 的组织可降为零保留，法律与反滥用例外除外。
points.text_zh: 标准 Enterprise 的保留期为 30 天；合格且另行启用 ZDR 的组织可降为零保留，法律与反滥用例外除外。

points.text: Under ZDR the exception is quantified: if a session is flagged for a policy violation, Anthropic may retain the associated inputs and outputs for up to 2 years (upper bound), distinct from the standard 30-day period.
points.text_zh: ZDR 档的例外有量化上限:被标记违规的会话,其输入输出最多保留 2 年,与标准档的 30 天区分。
points.quote: Even with ZDR enabled, Anthropic may retain data where required by law or to address Usage Policy violations. If a session is flagged for a policy violation, Anthropic may retain the associated inputs and outputs for up to 2 years, consistent with Anthropic’s standard ZDR policy.

points.text: Covered Models require data retention by default even for a ZDR organization, so this tier is not uniformly zero retention while they are in use.
points.text_zh: 即使组织启用了 ZDR,Covered Models 仍默认要求保留数据,故使用这些模型时本档并非一致零保留。
points.quote: Claude Fable 5.1 and Fable 5 are Covered Models that require data retention by default, and whether a ZDR organization or workspace can use them is governed by the Covered Models policies rather than by Claude Code.

points.text: Feedback submission is disabled at the backend level under ZDR, so the 5-year feedback retention of the standard commercial tier does not apply in a ZDR configuration.
points.text_zh: ZDR 下反馈提交在后端被禁用,故标准商业档的「反馈另留 5 年」口径在 ZDR 配置下不适用。
points.quote: Feedback submission (`/feedback`, `/bug`, `/share`) | Submitting feedback sends conversation data to Anthropic.

points.text: Different wording in the commercial privacy-center article: there the 30-day automatic deletion is scoped to API users — "we automatically delete inputs and outputs on our backend within 30 days of receipt or generation".
points.text_zh: 商业档隐私中心文章的另一口径:30 天自动删除只写给 API 用户——收到或生成后 30 天内在后端自动删除输入输出。
points.quote: we automatically delete inputs and outputs on our backend within 30 days of receipt or generation

points.text: The same article says other commercial products that let you save and continue conversations (Claude for Work, Claude for Enterprise, Anthropic Console) keep chats and coding sessions "in the product" with no stated period. Both wordings are official; the object boundaries are kept side by side, not averaged.
points.text_zh: 同一篇对可续聊的其他商业产品(Claude for Work / Claude for Enterprise / Console)另说聊天与编码会话在产品内保留、未给期限。两条口径都官方,并列保留、不取平均。
points.quote: If you use our other commercial products (e.g. Claude for Work, Claude for Enterprise, Anthropic Console, etc.) that allow you to save and continue conversations with Claude, we retain your chats and coding sessions in the product to provide you with a consistent product experience.

points.text: Violation handling on the commercial tier: "We retain inputs and outputs for up to 2 years and trust and safety classification scores for up to 7 years" if a chat is flagged by the automated trust and safety systems.
points.text_zh: 商业档违规处理:被自动信任安全系统标记为违反 Usage Policy 的会话,输入输出最多保留 2 年、信任安全分类分数最多保留 7 年。
points.quote: We retain inputs and outputs for up to 2 years and trust and safety classification scores for up to 7 years

points.text: Session quality survey transcripts, uploaded only if the user explicitly selects Yes, are retained for up to 6 months (organizations with ZDR never see this follow-up).

points.quote: Shared transcripts are retained for up to 6 months.

points.text: Local caching, the bullet the data-usage page lists under Commercial users (Team, Enterprise, and API): "Claude Code clients store session transcripts locally in plaintext under ~/.claude/projects/ for 30 days by default to enable session resumption. points.text: Exception to that local limit: "Transcripts of sessions started or most recently continued in Claude Desktop or Cowork are exempt from that limit by default."

points.quote: Transcripts of sessions started or most recently continued in Claude Desktop or Cowork are exempt from that limit by default.

points.text: Conflicting figure from the platform page (kept side by side, not resolved): "Local session transcripts (from sessions on users' machines, in apps such as Cowork and Claude Code) are stored for 6 years by default". training.quote: However, as a condition of your access to the Solution, you grant us the right to use your Customer Code, Output, and Usage Data to train the artificial intelligence models used in connection with the Solution for product improvements and research purposes, including those of Company and our third-party model providers, including those of potential providers ("Models")

points.text: Community Terms §1.8 goes beyond the opening grant: Augment may use, share, license, or sell anonymized versions of Customer Code, Usage Data and Output (collectively "Training Data") to develop, train and improve machine-learning or artificial-intelligence models by Augment or third parties.
points.text_zh: 社区版条款 §1.8 比首段授权更进一步：Augment 可对匿名化后的 Customer Code、Usage Data 与 Output（合称 Training Data）进行 use / share / license / sell，用于自身或第三方开发、训练与改进机器学习/人工智能模型——采购最关心的「可转售」就写在这一条。
points.quote: As mentioned herein, a condition of your use of the Solution is that you acknowledge and agree that Augment may use, share, license, or sell anonymized versions of your Customer Code, Usage Data, and Output (collectively "Training Data") for developing, training, and improving machine-learning or artificial-intelligence models by us or third parties.

retention.quote: We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to provide our Service, comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes, or enforce our agreements. Retention periods vary depending on the nature of the data and why we collect it. After the applicable retention period, we securely delete or anonymize your data.

points.text: Object evidence: opening a workspace with Augment enabled automatically uploads the codebase to Augment's secure cloud and indexes it, so code and index content is a retained object; files can be excluded with .gitignore/.augmentignore. The formal documents disclose no quantitative period for the index, prompts or server-side cache.
points.text_zh: 对象证据：工作区启用后代码库自动上传到 Augment 云端并建立索引，故代码/索引正文属于被保留对象（可用 .gitignore/.augmentignore 排除文件）；正式文档未披露索引、提示词或服务端缓存的量化期限。
points.quote: When you open a workspace with Augment enabled, your codebase will be automatically uploaded to Augment’s secure cloud.

points.text: Scope: the Privacy Policy §Data Retention wording speaks of "personal data" — retained only as long as necessary to provide the Service, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes or enforce agreements, then securely deleted or anonymized — and gives no quantified period; the ToS Effects of Termination clause only requires the customer to discontinue use and says nothing about deleting the index or server-side cache.
points.text_zh: 适用范围：隐私政策 §Data Retention 的对象是 personal data——仅在提供服务、履行法律义务、解决争议或执行协议所必要的期间内保留，到期后安全删除或匿名化，未给量化期限；ToS 的 Effects of Termination 条款只要求客户停止使用，对索引与服务端缓存的删除无任何约定。

processing_region.quote: We are headquartered in the United States and, under the default Service settings, your personal information and other information sent to the Service shall be stored and processed in the United States.

points.text: Region evidence: the Privacy Policy (incorporated into the ToS by reference) states that under the default Service settings personal information and other information sent to the Service is stored and processed in the United States, with transfers outside the US made under appropriate mechanisms such as the Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC); the ToS Providers clause only names third-party hosting providers and states no region. Scope caveat: the sentence covers personal information and other information sent to the Service — whether code and index payloads are covered on the same terms is not separately stated.
points.text_zh: 处理地证据：隐私政策（经 ToS 以引用方式并入）写明默认设置下个人信息及其他发送到服务的信息在美国存储与处理，向美国境外传输时依据 SCC 等适当机制；ToS 的 Providers 条款只提第三方托管服务商、未给处理地。适用范围：该句对象是个人信息与「其他发送到服务的信息」，代码/索引正文是否同样适用未单独声明。

training.quote: Company will not train its Models, using the Customer Code or Output.

points.text: The opening paragraph of the Enterprise Terms states the same commitment in wider terms — Customer Code or Output is never used to train any artificial intelligence models — while §1.4 puts it as Company will not train its Models, using the Customer Code or Output. The two are one commitment worded differently, so if §1.4 is ever reworded the opening paragraph still carries the verdict.
points.text_zh: 企业版条款首段以更宽的措辞给出同一承诺：Customer Code 或 Output 绝不用于训练任何人工智能模型；§1.4 的写法是 Company will not train its Models, using the Customer Code or Output。两条同源、措辞不同、方向一致，§1.4 若被改写，首段仍能支撑结论。

points.text: Scope: Azure Preview features, including Models sold by Azure in preview, may employ different privacy practices, including with respect to abuse monitoring — the no-training commitment above is stated for generally available features

points.text: Scope note, not a counter-example: the Azure DPIA (enterprise privacy FAQ layer) says Microsoft Azure processes personal data for purposes compatible with providing the online services, such as personalization, security, fraud and malware prevention, issue resolution and improvement. training.quote: 您与您的最终用户的文本对话信息还会被用来提高百川的响应速度和质量。

points.text: Same as the top-level training entry. Key points: §1.1.3 states expressly that input from API interactions is used to "improve Baichuan's response speed and quality"
points.text_zh: 同顶层 training。要点：§1.1.3 明示 API 交互输入会被用于「提高百川的响应速度和质量」

points.text: §1.4 permits anonymized information to be used to improve algorithmic models (the parenthetical example is the consumer-side "Huixie" writing feature)
points.text_zh: §1.4 允许匿名化后用于改进算法模型（括号举例是消费端「会写」）

points.text: The only grant at contract level containing the word "training" (www User Agreement §4.5(4)) is triggered by "publicly publishing, disseminating or sharing" content and does not cover API request content
points.text_zh: 合同层唯一含「训练」的授权（www 用户协议 §四.5(4)）以「公开发布、传播、分享」为触发条件，不覆盖 API 请求正文

points.text: The "use in any form" in §6.1 is a broad catch-all. There is no training authorization as such, but there is no prohibition either — and §1.1.3 does state that API input is used to improve response speed and quality, which under the house rule ("used to improve service/quality" counts as training unless model training is expressly excluded) is recorded as mark=no
points.text_zh: §六.1 的「任何形式地使用」是宽泛兜底。没有点名「训练」的授权，也没有禁止训练的表述——但 §1.1.3 明示输入会被用于提高响应速度和质量，按判定口径（未排除模型训练就不能替厂商排除）记 mark=no

points.text: §1.1.5(2) separately grants a broad right to "analyse and carry out commercial exploitation of" all data collected from you, including your personal information. It names neither training nor an exclusion of training, so it points the same way as mark=no — recorded as a broad commercial-use authorization, not upgraded to "the vendor says it trains on your data"
points.text_zh: §1.1.5(2) 另授予对「所收集的您的各项数据（包括您的个人信息）」的宽泛权利——「进行分析并开展商业化利用」。既未点名训练、也未排除训练，方向与 mark=no 一致；记作宽泛的商业化利用授权，不升级为「厂商明示会用于训练」
points.quote: 在不透露您个人信息的前提下，您同意授权我们对所收集的您的各项数据（包括您的个人信息）进行分析并开展商业化利用的权利。

zdr.quote: 我们会收集您的设备调用我们API的调用记录日志，以用于调用数量的统计分析。

points.text: Same as the top-level zdr entry. The platform privacy policy contains no zero-retention commitment, switch or application method, and the retention clauses below point the other way. Coverage caveat: of the nine URLs in searched[], only this policy has a snapshot in this repo — the other eight (platform article/user-agreement, secure-agreement, share-agreement, consume-agreement, docs, docs-v2/api, docs-v2/knowledgeBase, docs-v2/file) are recorded as search scope only and cannot be re-checked against a snapshot, so no claim is made about the terms set or the documentation site as a whole
points.text_zh: 同顶层 zdr。平台隐私政策无零保留承诺、开关或申请方式，且下列留存条款指向相反方向。覆盖面说明：searched 的九个 URL 里只有本政策在仓库中有快照，其余八个（platform 的 user-agreement、secure-agreement、share-agreement、consume-agreement、docs、docs-v2/api、docs-v2/knowledgeBase、docs-v2/file）仅作查阅范围记录、无法用快照复核，故不对「全部条款页与文档站」作整体断言

points.text: Observations to the contrary: §1.2.2 states expressly that API call logs are collected, which is the clause that bears on retention; read together with §5's shortest-necessary time these are retention statements, not a zero-retention option, so this dimension is recorded as mark=no / mode=not_disclosed (no ZDR scheme published) rather than unknown — under the house rule that a row which quotes the record cannot also say no wording was found. The improvement clause §1.1.3 is not a statement about this dimension (it says inputs are used to improve the service, not how long anything is kept), so it is not bound here — see the training entry for that clause
points.text_zh: 反向观察：§1.2.2 明示收集 API 调用日志——这才是与留存相关的条款；与 §5 的「最短必要时间」合看，两者都是留存口径而非零保留方案，故本维度记 mark=no / mode=not_disclosed（厂商未公开零保留方案），不再记 unknown——按判定口径，绑了引文就不能同时说「没找到表述」。§1.1.3 的服务改进条款不构成对 zdr 维度的表述（它说输入被用于改进服务，不涉及留存多久），故不绑在本条，该引文见 training 条目

retention.quote: 我们对您的个人信息的存储时间将限于实现您授权使用的目的所必需的最短时间。

points.text: Same as the top-level retention entry. Object and context: (1) input and output content — "the shortest time necessary to achieve the purpose you authorized", not quantified
points.text_zh: 同顶层 retention。对象与语境：①输入输出正文——「实现您授权使用的目的所必需的最短时间」，无量化

points.text: (2) API call log records — collected expressly under §1.2.2 (for statistical analysis of call volumes), with no period disclosed
points.text_zh: ②API 调用记录日志——§1.2.2 明示收集（用于调用数量统计分析），期限未披露

points.text: (3) Deleted or anonymized once a deletion request is acted on, with delayed deletion from backups (§4.2)
points.text_zh: ③删除请求响应后删除或匿名化，备份延迟删除（§4.2）

points.text: (4) Deleted or anonymized promptly after account cancellation (§4.4)
points.text_zh: ④注销后及时删除或匿名化（§4.4）

points.text: (5) Deleted or anonymized if operations cease (§5).
points.text_zh: ⑤停止运营时删除或匿名化（§5）。

points.text: (6) Statutory exception: on a request from a state regulator (public security, procuratorate, court, customs, tax, security authorities and so on) Baichuan is obliged to query your personal information and to place restrictive operations on your account (User Agreement §4.10) — a legal exception to retention and deletion, not a role self-designation
points.text_zh: ⑥法定例外：收到国家监管机关（公安、检察机关、法院、海关、税务机关、安全部门等）要求时，百川有义务查询您的个人信息并对您的账户进行限制性操作（用户协议 §四.10）——属留存/删除的法定例外，不构成角色自认

processing_region.quote: 我们会将在中国境内运营所收集和产生的个人信息存储在中国境内。

points.text: Same as the top-level processing_region entry. Terms level: "personal information" is stored within China; no cross-border clause; no subprocessor list; the endpoint api.baichuan-ai.com and the ICP filing entity are both domestic.
points.text_zh: 同顶层 processing_region。条款层：境内存储「个人信息」；无出境条款；无子处理者清单；端点 api.baichuan-ai.com 与备案主体均为境内。

role.quote: 本政策适用对象为访问、注册、登录本平台并使用本服务的访问者和开发者及其最终用户。

points.text_zh: 同顶层 role。以自己名义直接收集（§特别说明 + §1.1.3），要求开发者向最终用户告知「个人信息会共享至百川」

points.text: No DPA and no self-designation as an entrusted party
points.text_zh: 无 DPA、无受托自述

training.quote: 使用该内容训练模型和改进相关服务的权利

points.text: Conclusion for the consumer tier: there is an explicit training license for content that is "publicly published, disseminated or shared", while ordinary conversation input is covered only by service-improvement wording. Basis: Baichuan User Agreement (2025-09-28) §4.5: "your act of publicly publishing, disseminating or sharing content in any form — images, text, audio, digital works, livestreams, video and so on — through this product represents that you have the right to grant, and agree to grant, the Company a worldwide, free … (4) right to use that content to train models and improve the related services…" — the licensed object is publicly published content, and the license is obtained through conduct ("the act represents the grant") rather than per-instance consent
points.text_zh: 消费档结论：对「公开发布、传播、分享」的内容有明确的训练授权，对普通对话输入只有服务改进口径。依据：《百川用户协议》(2025-09-28) §四.5「您使用本产品将图片、文字、音频、数字作品、直播或视频等各种形式的内容…公开发布、传播、分享的行为代表了您有权许可且同意许可本公司在全世界范围内，免费…（4）使用该内容训练模型和改进相关服务的权利…」——授权对象是公开发布的内容，且以「行为代表许可」的方式取得，非逐次同意

points.text: §6.1 separately grants a worldwide, free, sublicensable license covering "all data, information or content generated in the course of your use of this product", worded as "use in any form". On the conversation-input side: main-site privacy policy §1.1.2 "your text conversation information will also be used to improve Baichuan's response speed and quality", and §1.4 uses anonymized information for academic research or statistical analysis in order to "continuously improve the algorithmic models". Evidence to the contrary: User Agreement §5.5 only prohibits users from using Baichuan data to train "other" AI products
points.text_zh: §六.1 另授予覆盖「您在使用本产品过程中产生的所有数据、信息或内容」的全球免费可转许可，措辞「任何形式地使用」。对话输入侧：主站隐私政策 §1.1.2「您的文本对话信息还会被用来提高百川的响应速度和质量」，§1.4 匿名化后用于学术研究/统计分析以「不断改进算法模型」。反向证据：用户协议 §五.5 只禁止用户用百川数据训练「其他」AI 产品

points.text: §1.1.4(2) is the consumer-tier counterpart of the same broad authorization: a right to "analyse and carry out commercial exploitation of" all data generated in the course of your use of this product, including your personal information. It is written in the same direction as the §6.1 broad licence in the User Agreement — neither names training nor excludes it, so it is recorded as a broad commercial-use authorization rather than a training authorization
points.text_zh: §1.1.4(2) 是消费档的同类宽泛授权：对「您在使用本产品的过程中，所产生的各项数据（包括您的个人信息）」有「进行分析并开展商业化利用」的权利。与用户协议 §六.1 的宽泛许可同向——两处都没点名训练、也没排除训练，故记作宽泛的商业化利用授权，而非训练授权
points.quote: 在不透露您个人信息的前提下，您同意授权我们对您在使用本产品的过程中，所产生的各项数据（包括您的个人信息）进行分析并开展商业化利用的权利。

points.text: There is no "not used for training" commitment and no description of an opt-out switch. Uncertainty: whether "improving response speed and quality" amounts to training has not been clarified by the vendor.
points.text_zh: 无「不用于训练」承诺、无退出开关说明。不确定性：「提高响应速度和质量」是否等同训练，厂商未澄清。

zdr.quote: 为履行网络信息安全义务，我们会在法律规定的时间内保留您的问答历史及对话主题。

points.text: The consumer tier has no ZDR wording and no application path; what the terms do state is retention (see below), hence mark=no rather than undisclosed
points.text_zh: 消费档无 ZDR 术语、也无申请入口；条款明示的是留存（见下条），故记 mark=no 而非「未披露」

points.text: The retention of Q&A history in main-site privacy policy §1.1.3 and the service-improvement use in §1.1.2 are incompatible with "zero retention". The main site has no sitemap.xml (404), so exhaustive enumeration through a site map is not possible and the searched list is limited to the documents actually fetched this round.
points.text_zh: 主站隐私政策 §1.1.3 的问答历史留存与 §1.1.2 的服务改进使用与「零保留」相斥。主站无 sitemap.xml（404），无法用站点地图做穷尽枚举，故 searched 列表以本轮实际抓取到的文档为限。

retention.quote: 为履行网络信息安全义务，我们会在法律规定的时间内保留您的问答历史及对话主题。

points.text: Consumer-tier retention has to be split by object: (1) Q&A history (input text conversation information and conversation topics) — main-site privacy policy §1.1.3: "in order to perform network information security obligations, we will retain your Q&A history and conversation topics for the period prescribed by law", which is a **floor**-type statement (retained as long as the law requires) and cannot be read backwards as "deleted when the period ends"
points.text_zh: 消费档 retention 要分对象：(1) 问答历史（输入文本对话信息与对话主题）——主站隐私政策 §1.1.3「为履行网络信息安全义务，我们会在法律规定的时间内保留您的问答历史及对话主题」，这是**下限**型口径（法律要求留多久就留多久），不能反推「到期即删除」

points.text: The same sentence also says "you can find and manage the Q&A history that has not yet been deleted", showing that history is retained by default and managed by the user. (2) Personal information overall — §5: "unless laws and regulations require otherwise, we will store your personal information only for the shortest time necessary to achieve the purpose you authorized". (3) Deleted or anonymized once a deletion request is acted on, with delayed deletion from backups (§4.2)
points.text_zh: 同一句还写「您可以查找并管理尚未删除的问答历史」，说明历史默认留存、由用户自行管理。(2) 个人信息总体——§5「除非法律法规另有要求，我们对您的个人信息的存储时间将限于实现您授权使用的目的所必需的最短时间」。(3) 删除请求响应后删除或匿名化，备份延迟删除（§4.2）

points.text: Deleted or anonymized promptly after account cancellation (§4.4)
points.text_zh: 注销后及时删除或匿名化（§4.4）

points.text: Deleted or anonymized if operations cease (§5). No quantified number of days anywhere. Note that the platform-tier policy has no Q&A history retention sentence; the two are not interchangeable.
points.text_zh: 停止运营时删除或匿名化（§5）。无任何量化天数。注意平台档政策没有问答历史留存句，两份不可互换。

points.text: (6) Access logs — main-site privacy policy §1.2.1 ("Log information"): the IP address is collected in order to improve the products and services, and no period is disclosed. This sentence states a collection purpose only and cannot be read as a retention-period commitment. The API tier lists the §1.2.2 API call logs as its own object; this point removes that asymmetry between the two tiers
points.text_zh: (6) 访问日志——主站隐私政策 §1.2.1「日志信息」：为改善产品与服务收集 IP 地址信息，期限未披露。该句只说明收集目的，不能读成期限承诺。API 档把 §1.2.2 的 API 调用日志单列为对象，本条补齐两档的对齐
points.quote: 当您使用百川的产品与服务时，我们会收集您的IP地址信息，以便于我们改善产品与服务，给您更好的服务体验。

points.text: (7) Statutory exception: on a request from a state regulator (public security, procuratorate, court, customs, tax, security authorities and so on) Baichuan is obliged to query your personal information and to place restrictive operations on your account (User Agreement §4.10) — a legal exception to retention and deletion, not a role self-designation
points.text_zh: (7) 法定例外：收到国家监管机关（公安、检察机关、法院、海关、税务机关、安全部门等）要求时，百川有义务查询您的个人信息并对您的账户进行限制性操作（用户协议 §四.10）——属留存/删除的法定例外，不构成角色自认
points.quote: 我们有义务按照该等监管机关的要求对您的个人信息进行查询及对您的账户进行限制性操作

processing_region.quote: 在本政策下所收集及处理的个人信息不存在出境的情况。

points.text: Main-site privacy policy §5: "we store personal information collected and generated in operations within China inside China. The personal information collected and processed under this policy is not transferred outside the territory." — one sentence more than the platform tier ("not transferred outside the territory"). Supporting: User Agreement §12.4 limits use to mainland China. The subject is still "personal information"; where the compute sits is not disclosed.
points.text_zh: 主站隐私政策 §5「我们会将在中国境内运营所收集和产生的个人信息存储在中国境内。在本政策下所收集及处理的个人信息不存在出境的情况。」——比平台档多一句「不存在出境的情况」。辅助：用户协议 §十二.4 使用地限中国大陆。对象仍是「个人信息」，未披露算力所在地。

role.quote: 在您使用百川的服务时，我们将收集您与百川进行交互过程中所输入的文本对话信息，使用这些信息向您输出内容，以提供人机交互服务。

points.text: Basis for the controller classification: main-site privacy policy §1.1.2 — "when you use Baichuan's services, we will collect the text conversation information you input in the course of interacting with Baichuan, use this information to output content to you, and thereby provide the human-machine interaction service" — Baichuan collects in its own name and decides the purpose itself. The quote previously bound to this row ("the personal information collected and processed under this policy is not transferred outside the territory") is a processing-region statement and is no longer used here
points.text_zh: 控制者判定的依据：主站隐私政策 §1.1.2——「在您使用百川的服务时，我们将收集您与百川进行交互过程中所输入的文本对话信息，使用这些信息向您输出内容，以提供人机交互服务。」百川以自己的名义收集并自行决定处理目的。原先绑在本行的「在本政策下所收集及处理的个人信息不存在出境的情况」是处理地表述，不再用于本行
points.quote: 在您使用百川的服务时，我们将收集您与百川进行交互过程中所输入的文本对话信息，使用这些信息向您输出内容，以提供人机交互服务。

points.text: On the consumer tier Baichuan provides the service directly to individual users and collects their personal information for its own purposes (§1.1.1 account, §1.1.2 human-machine conversation, §1.2.1 logs), which makes it an independent controller. The User Agreement §5.1 description of itself as "a neutral network service provider" only disclaims liability for third-party content behind search links and is not a PIPL role self-designation. No DPA and no entrusted-processing scenario. Confidence low: this tier has no role clause of any kind, the classification is inferred from the processing structure, and this row is not the provider's main tier.
points.text_zh: 消费档由百川直接向个人用户提供服务并收集其个人信息用于自身目的（§1.1.1 账户、§1.1.2 人机交互对话、§1.2.1 日志），属独立控制者。用户协议 §五.1 自称「作为中立的网络服务提供者」仅针对搜索链接的第三方内容免责，不是 PIPL 角色自认。无 DPA、无受托场景。置信度 low：本档无任何角色自认条款，纯属按处理结构推定，且本行不是本 provider 的主档。
