baidu-qianfan.entity: 北京百度网讯科技有限公司

training.quote: 为免疑义，我们不会使用您的输入和模型输出数据、上传的知识文档、数据集进行训练，也不会将您的数据集与任何第三方共享。

points.text: 千帆自营模型 API(按量)：5.1(6) 不使用输入、模型输出、知识文档、数据集训练，数据集不与第三方共享。第三方模型/组件(模型广场)适用其自身协议(用户协议 §12)，不在本结论内。
points.text_zh: 千帆自营模型 API(按量)：5.1(6) 不使用输入、模型输出、知识文档、数据集训练，数据集不与第三方共享。第三方模型/组件(模型广场)适用其自身协议(用户协议 §12)，不在本结论内。

points.text: Opposite-direction clause in the same agreement: §13.2 has the customer authorise Baidu to apply "本服务相关数据" (service-related data, not delimited to inference inputs and outputs) to "服务性能优化、系统故障排查及风险控制管理" — service performance optimisation, fault diagnosis and risk control. Under this ledger's rule that "used to improve the service" counts as training, that clause points the other way from §5.1(6). Both facts are kept side by side and are not adjudicated. Their scope differs and neither overrides the other: §5.1(6) covers inference inputs and outputs and uploaded knowledge documents/datasets, §13.2 covers undelimited service-related data.
points.text_zh: 同一协议里的相反方向条款：§13.2 由您授权百度智能云在合规处理的前提下，将「本服务相关数据」（未限定为推理输入输出）应用于「服务性能优化、系统故障排查及风险控制管理等」。按台账口径「用来改进服务算训练」，它与 §5.1(6) 方向相反，两条事实并列保留、不裁决。两者适用范围不同且互不覆盖：§5.1(6) 的对象是推理输入输出与上传的知识文档/数据集，§13.2 的对象是未限定的「本服务相关数据」。
points.quote: 将相关数据应用于服务性能优化、系统故障排查及风险控制管理等

zdr.quote: 与此同时，您理解并同意百度智能云为实现本服务目的，对前述信息内容在法律允许的范围内进行存储及使用。

points.text: 同顶层 dimensions.zdr：官方文件中无 ZDR/零保留条款或开通方式；条款层明示的是存储授权，故记 mark=no（明确否定）而非「未披露」
points.text_zh: 同顶层 dimensions.zdr：官方文件中无 ZDR/零保留条款或开通方式；条款层明示的是存储授权，故记 mark=no（明确否定）而非「未披露」

points.text: 协议授权存储 + 平台可审查输入输出 → 默认非零保留。
points.text_zh: 协议授权存储 + 平台可审查输入输出 → 默认非零保留。

retention.quote: 与此同时，您理解并同意百度智能云为实现本服务目的，对前述信息内容在法律允许的范围内进行存储及使用。

points.text: Inputs and uploaded material: the Qianfan service-specific agreement §2.3 has you agree that Baidu may store and use the information content you provide/upload/input/publish for the purpose of providing this service, to the extent the law allows — no period, no deletion trigger, no default/exception split. §1.4 of the same page defines "输出" separately, so this clause covers inputs and uploads only, not model outputs.
points.text_zh: 输入与上传内容：千帆专项约定 2.3 约定您同意百度智能云为实现本服务目的，对您提供/上传/输入/发布的信息内容在法律允许的范围内进行存储及使用——无期限、无删除触发、不分默认与例外。同页 1.4 单独定义「输出」，故该条只覆盖输入与上传，不含模型输出。
points.quote: 与此同时，您理解并同意百度智能云为实现本服务目的，对前述信息内容在法律允许的范围内进行存储及使用。

points.text: User business data: when the service term expires, the service is terminated early (including by agreement, or for any other reason) or the account is in arrears, Baidu keeps the data only during a buffer period whose length is set by the service-specific terms, product documentation or service description applicable to the service you ordered (not quantified in this document); when the buffer period expires Baidu deletes all user business data, including all cached or backup copies, and keeps none of it.
points.text_zh: 用户业务数据：服务期届满、服务提前终止（含协商一致提前终止或其他原因导致的提前终止）或您欠费时，仅在缓冲期内继续存储，缓冲期时限以您所订购的服务适用的专有条款、产品文档、服务说明所载明的时限为准（本文档未量化）；缓冲期届满删除所有用户业务数据，包括所有缓存或者备份的副本，不再保留。
points.quote: 缓冲期届满，百度智能云将删除所有用户业务数据，包括所有缓存或者备份的副本，不再保留您的任何用户业务数据

points.text: Deletion on your instruction: if you release the service or delete data yourself, Baidu deletes your online data and, as instructed, keeps none of it.
points.text_zh: 按指令删除：您自行释放服务或删除数据的，百度智能云删除您的在线数据，按照您的指令不再保留该等数据。
points.quote: 如您自行释放服务或删除数据的，百度智能云将删除您的在线数据，按照您的指令不再保留该等数据。

points.text: Exception context: the Qianfan agreement §9 states that you must not provide confidential information, that Baidu has no confidentiality obligation over any of your content, and that Baidu may disclose your content to comply with laws, perform the agreement, prevent fraud or fix security or technical problems.
points.text_zh: 例外语境：千帆用户协议 §9 约定您不得向本服务提供保密信息、百度对您的任何内容没有任何保密义务，并可为遵守法律法规、履行本协议、防止欺诈、修复安全或技术问题而披露您的内容。
points.quote: 为了遵守法律法规、履行本协议、防止欺诈、修复安全或技术问题，我们可能会披露您的内容。

processing_region.quote: 您可以指定您的内容所存储的区域。

points.text: Storage region is customer-selected: you can designate the region where your content is stored, and Baidu will not migrate your content out of the region you chose without your consent — except (a) migration required to comply with applicable laws or a binding order of a government authority, (b) migration on your instruction (you must ensure the necessary government permits and user authorisations), (c) to provide billing, management or technical services, or to investigate security incidents or breaches of this agreement.
points.text_zh: 存储区域由客户指定：您可以指定内容所存储的区域，未经您的同意不会从您选择的区域迁移——例外为 (a) 为遵守适用的法律法规或政府机关的约束性命令；(b) 依您的委托（您须确保已获得必要的政府许可及用户授权）；(c) 为提供账单、管理、技术服务，或因调查安全事件、调查违反本协议的行为。

points.text: Processing location is not delimited: Baidu may process some data in the data centre region you use, and may also process data in the regions where its maintenance, operations, support and investigation systems and teams are located. The agreement does not state that storage or processing takes place in mainland China, and it publishes no list of available regions, so this file records customer-selected rather than CN.
points.text_zh: 处理地未限定：百度智能云可能会在您使用服务的数据中心区域处理一些数据，也可能会在其维护运营、支持和调查系统及团队的区域处理这些数据。协议未说明存储或处理发生在中国境内，也未公布可选地域清单，故本文件记 customer-selected 而非 CN。
points.quote: 我们可能会在您使用服务的数据中心区域处理一些数据，我们也可能会在我们维护运营、支持和调查系统及团队的区域处理这些数据。

points.text: The data centre is agreed case by case: Baidu stores user business data in the data centre you select, as agreed between you and Baidu. No regional endpoint is documented for the Qianfan API (this file records a single global endpoint).
points.text_zh: 数据中心逐案约定：百度智能云在您选定的数据中心存储用户业务数据（经您与百度智能云协商一致）。千帆 API 无地域化 endpoint 文档（本文件只记录一个全局 endpoint）。
points.quote: 根据您与百度智能云协商一致，百度智能云在您选定的数据中心存储用户业务数据。

role.quote: 就用户业务数据，百度智能云除执行您的服务要求外，不进行任何未获授权的使用及披露

points.text: processor：用户业务数据归用户完全拥有，平台除执行服务要求外不做未获授权使用及披露，按指令删除
points.text_zh: processor：用户业务数据归用户完全拥有，平台除执行服务要求外不做未获授权使用及披露，按指令删除

points.text: Limit on the processor characterisation, from the Qianfan product-level agreement §9 (which applies alongside the platform-level agreement): you must not provide confidential information, you acknowledge and agree that Baidu has no confidentiality obligation over any of your content, and Baidu may disclose your content to comply with laws, perform the agreement, prevent fraud or fix security or technical problems. Kept alongside the platform-level clause that Baidu does not make unauthorised use or disclosure of user business data beyond executing your service request; it does not change kind=processor.
points.text_zh: 受托处理的限制（来自千帆产品层协议 §9，与平台层协议并行适用）：您不得向本服务提供保密信息，您明确承认并同意百度对您的任何内容没有任何保密义务，且百度可为遵守法律法规、履行本协议、防止欺诈、修复安全或技术问题而披露您的内容。与平台层「就用户业务数据除执行您的服务要求外不进行任何未获授权的使用及披露」并列保留，不据此改判 kind。
points.quote: 您明确承认并同意，我们对您的任何内容没有任何保密义务。

points.text: 隐私政策 §8 自认中立技术服务提供者、严格执行客户委托与指示。
points.text_zh: 隐私政策 §8 自认中立技术服务提供者、严格执行客户委托与指示。

training.quote: Baseten will not use Customer Content, including Customer Models, Model Outputs, or inference logs, to train, fine-tune, or otherwise develop machine learning or artificial intelligence models.

points.text: Same as the top level: Terms §6.3 covers Customer Content, "including Customer Models, Model Outputs, or inference logs"
points.text_zh: 同顶层：Terms §6.3 覆盖 Customer Content（含 Customer Models、Model Outputs、inference logs）

points.text: The "Model APIs" entry in the Security Practices states in the same paragraph that a ZDR posture applies to all Customer Content. For the third-party model tier the vendor's supplemental Model Labs terms (SML) are cited as saying that customer content, prompts and request-level logs included, is not forwarded to the Model Lab — that document is not declared as a [[source]] in this file and has no snapshot, so it is recorded here as a sourcing gap and not as an anchor.
points.text_zh: Security Practices「Model APIs」条目同段即声明对 all Customer Content 持 ZDR。第三方模型档另有厂商的 Model Labs 补充条款（SML）：不向 Model Lab 转发客户内容（含 prompt 与请求级日志）；该文档尚未在本文件登记为 [[source]]、也没有快照，故记为溯源缺口，不作为锚点。

points.text: Boundary of the no-training commitment: "Usage Information" is technical and operational telemetry about the use and performance of the Services (latency, throughput, error rates, utilization, feature usage data), and §1 defines Customer Content to exclude it — so it is not the customer's inference inputs or outputs. Baseten may use it to operate, maintain, secure and improve the Services; beyond the direct operation of the customer's workloads, analytics, benchmarking and product development are allowed only in aggregated or de-identified form that cannot reasonably be used to identify Customer or to reveal Customer Content.
points.text_zh: 「不用于训练」的边界：Usage Information 是服务使用与性能的技术/运营遥测（latency、throughput、error rates、utilization、feature usage data），§1 的 Customer Content 定义明确把它排除在外，故它不是客户的推理输入输出。Baseten 可用它运营、维护、保障与改进服务；超出客户负载直接运营之外的分析、基准测试与产品开发，只能用无法合理识别客户或暴露 Customer Content 的聚合或去标识形式。
points.quote: Baseten may collect technical and operational telemetry relating to the use and performance of the Services (e.g., latency, throughput, error rates, utilization, and feature usage data) ("Usage Information"), and may use Usage Information to operate, maintain, secure, and improve the Services. To the extent Baseten uses Usage Information for analytics, benchmarking, or product development purposes beyond the direct operation of Customer's workloads, Baseten will do so only in aggregated or de-identified form that cannot reasonably be used to identify Customer or to reveal Customer's Confidential Information or Customer Content.

points.text: Hard limit on that telemetry: in no event may Baseten collect or use Usage Information for the purpose of reproducing the customer's model weights or training datasets, or of developing products that replicate customer-specific deployments. Neither point changes mark=yes — they bound telemetry, not inference inputs and outputs.
points.text_zh: 该类遥测的硬性限制：Baseten 绝不得为复制客户模型权重或训练集、或为开发复刻客户专属部署的产品而收集或使用 Usage Information。两条 point 都不改变 mark=yes——它们约束的是遥测，不是推理输入输出。
points.quote: In no event will Baseten collect or use Usage Information for the purpose of reproducing Customer's model weights or training datasets or developing products that replicate Customer-specific deployments.

zdr.quote: Baseten's Model APIs product adheres to a Zero Data Retention posture for all Customer Content. Baseten will not store, retain, or otherwise make a persistent copy of model inputs or outputs during a customer's use of the Model APIs.

points.text: This product is named in the Security Practices as operating under a ZDR posture, and ZDR is the default configuration (no application required).
points.text_zh: 该产品被 Security Practices 点名为 ZDR 姿态，且 ZDR 是默认配置（无需申请）。

points.text: Scope limit on the ZDR commitment: Baseten is not in breach of these Security Practices (including the ZDR commitments) where logging, retention, storage, access, use or disclosure of Customer Content arises from (a) configurations, settings or deployment choices made by a customer or its authorized users; (b) model runtime code, packages, dependencies or other software provided or selected by a customer, including any vulnerability or compromise latent in a Customer Model or its supply chain; (c) a customer's election to enable logging, retention, abuse monitoring or any Third-Party Product; or (d) actions taken at a customer's written direction. This is an exception defining the scope of the commitment, not a withdrawal of it; mark stays yes.
points.text_zh: ZDR 承诺的适用边界（例外，非撤销）：若 Customer Content 的 logging、retention、storage、access、use 或 disclosure 源于 (a) 客户或其授权用户所作的配置、设置或部署选择；(b) 客户提供或选用的 model runtime code、packages、dependencies 等软件（含 Customer Model 或其供应链中的潜在漏洞）；(c) 客户自行开启 logging、retention、abuse monitoring 或任何 Third-Party Product；或 (d) 按客户书面指示采取的行动，则不构成 Baseten 违反 Security Practices（含 ZDR 承诺）。mark 仍为 yes。
points.quote: Baseten will not be in breach of these Security Practices (including the ZDR commitments) to the extent that any logging, retention, storage, access, use, or disclosure of Customer Content arises from (a) configurations, settings, or deployment choices made by a customer or its authorized users; (b) model runtime code, packages, dependencies, or other software provided or selected by a customer, including any vulnerability or compromise latent in a Customer Model or its supply chain; (c) a customer's election to enable logging, retention, abuse monitoring, or any Third-Party Product; or (d) actions taken at a customer's written direction.

points.text: ZDR configuration is changeable at the customer's request: customers may request changes to the applicable ZDR configuration for their workloads by written notice, and Baseten will promptly implement requested changes whenever technically supported for the applicable Service; where it cannot, it must promptly notify the customer with an explanation. This is what mode=default means here — a default the customer can have changed — and it does not mean Baseten may rewrite the default on its own.
points.text_zh: ZDR 配置可依客户书面请求变更：客户可书面请求变更其负载适用的 ZDR 配置，Baseten 在适用服务技术上支持时即迅速实现，不可实现时须迅速通知并说明原因。这解释了本档 mode=default 的成色——默认值可由客户请求改写——不等于厂商可自行变更默认值。
points.quote: Customers may request changes to the applicable ZDR configuration for their workloads by written notice, and Baseten will promptly implement requested changes whenever technically supported for the applicable Service.

retention.quote: Baseten's Model APIs product adheres to a Zero Data Retention posture for all Customer Content. Baseten will not store, retain, or otherwise make a persistent copy of model inputs or outputs during a customer's use of the Model APIs.

points.text: Security Practices「Model APIs」：Baseten will not store, retain, or otherwise make a persistent copy of model inputs or outputs during a customer's use of the Model APIs

The same section defines ZDR as (a) not logging, recording or saving Customer Content, and (b) not saving Customer Content to persistent storage (hard disk, SSD, cloud storage, database) after real-time processing.
points.text_zh: 同节把 ZDR 定义为 (a) 不 log/record/store 客户内容、(b) 不在实时处理之后把客户内容保存到持久存储（硬盘、SSD、云存储、数据库）。

points.text: Async exception, from the "Asynchronous Inference" entry of the Security Practices (the page lists it as a product entry alongside Model APIs and Dedicated Inference): where the customer elects to enable asynchronous inference, model inputs get temporarily stored and queued for the duration of the request, can stay in queue for up to 72 hours before being processed and then deleted, and Model Outputs are not stored. It applies only where the customer turns async on, and the 72 hours is an upper bound.
points.text_zh: 异步例外，出自 Security Practices「Asynchronous Inference」条（该页把它与 Model APIs、Dedicated Inference 并列为产品条）：客户启用异步推理时，模型输入在请求期间被暂存排队，最多 72 小时后处理并删除，且不存 Model Outputs。仅在客户开启 async 时适用，72 小时是上限。
points.quote: These model input requests can stay in queue for up to 72 hours before being processed and then deleted.

points.text: Multi-hop caveat on this tier: Baseten Model APIs is where Third-Party Products are made available through managed API endpoints, and if a customer connects or enables Third-Party Products for use with the Services, the providers of those products may have access to Customer Content in connection with the interoperation, and Baseten will not be responsible for any use, disclosure, modification or deletion of Customer Content by them (Terms §4.4). The retention position above therefore covers only Baseten's own hop.
points.text_zh: 本档的多跳提示：Baseten Model APIs 正是通过托管 API 端点提供 Third-Party Products 的入口；客户接入或启用第三方产品时，其提供方可能因互操作而接触 Customer Content，Baseten 不负责其对 Customer Content 的使用、披露、修改或删除（Terms §4.4）。故上面的保留结论只覆盖 Baseten 自己这一跳。
points.quote: If Customer connects or enables Third-Party Products for use with the Services, Customer acknowledges that providers of those Third-Party Products may have access to Customer Content in connection with the interoperation thereof, and Baseten will not be responsible for any use, disclosure, modification, or deletion of Customer Content by Third-Party Products.

points.text: A different object inside this dimension: Baseten's access and authentication-related security logs (access and actions taken by Baseten personnel, plus customer authentication events such as device type, IP addresses and abnormality detection) are stored for up to 4 years and cannot be deleted or modified, even by an administrator. That is an upper bound for that log class, not the retention rule for model inputs and outputs, which are covered by the ZDR posture above.
points.text_zh: 本维度内的另一类对象：Baseten 的访问与认证类安全日志（Baseten 人员的访问与操作，以及客户认证相关事件，如 device type、IP addresses、abnormality detection）最多留存 4 年，且不可删除或修改。这是该类日志的上限，不等于模型输入输出的保留口径——输入输出适用上面的 ZDR 姿态。
points.quote: Security-relevant logs are stored for up to 4 years, protected from unauthorized access, and cannot be deleted or modified, even by an administrator.

processing_region.quote: **Global** is the default when neither a deployment region nor a compliance policy limits placement. Baseten can place replicas in any region where the requested compute is available.

points.text: The public documentation does not say which region Model APIs (platform-hosted models) run in: the available-regions table on the regional deployments page covers only customer-deployed models (GPU instances) and states expressly that region selection applies to model deployments
points.text_zh: 公开文档未说明 Model APIs（平台托管模型）运行在哪个区域：regional deployments 页的可用区域表只针对客户自部署模型（GPU 实例），且明说区域选择适用于 model deployments

points.text: There is no corresponding region-selection documentation for Model APIs. Inferring from the default Global rule would overreach, so this is recorded as undisclosed rather than as a commitment.
points.text_zh: Model APIs 没有对应的区域选择说明。按默认 Global 规则推断会越界，故记未披露而非承诺。

role.quote: The Parties acknowledge and agree that with regard to the Processing of Customer Personal Data: (a) Baseten acts as a Processor; (b) Customer acts as a Controller, or as a Processor on behalf of its own controllers; and (c) Baseten will engage Sub-Processors pursuant to Section 7.

points.text: Same as the top level. On the third-party model tier, Model Lab is not a sub-processor of the customer and Baseten does not forward customer content (SML §6) — SML has no snapshot in this file yet, so this is a sourcing gap rather than an anchor.
points.text_zh: 同顶层。第三方模型档下 Model Lab 不是客户 sub-processor，Baseten 不转发客户内容（SML §6）——SML 在本文件尚无快照，故这是溯源缺口而非锚点。

training.quote: Baseten will not use Customer Content, including Customer Models, Model Outputs, or inference logs, to train, fine-tune, or otherwise develop machine learning or artificial intelligence models.

points.text: Same as the top level. The definition of Customer Model expressly includes associated weights, checkpoints, adapters and configurations, so weights are within the scope of §6.3 as well.
points.text_zh: 同顶层。Customer Model 定义明确包含 associated weights、checkpoints、adapters、configurations，故权重也在 §6.3 覆盖范围内。

points.text: Boundary of the no-training commitment: "Usage Information" is technical and operational telemetry about the use and performance of the Services (latency, throughput, error rates, utilization, feature usage data), and §1 defines Customer Content to exclude it — so it is not Customer Model inputs, outputs or weights. Baseten may use it to operate, maintain, secure and improve the Services; beyond the direct operation of the customer's workloads, analytics, benchmarking and product development are allowed only in aggregated or de-identified form that cannot reasonably be used to identify Customer or to reveal Customer Content.
points.text_zh: 「不用于训练」的边界：Usage Information 是服务使用与性能的技术/运营遥测（latency、throughput、error rates、utilization、feature usage data），§1 的 Customer Content 定义明确把它排除在外，故它不是 Customer Model 的输入、输出或权重。Baseten 可用它运营、维护、保障与改进服务；超出客户负载直接运营之外的分析、基准测试与产品开发，只能用无法合理识别客户或暴露 Customer Content 的聚合或去标识形式。
points.quote: Baseten may collect technical and operational telemetry relating to the use and performance of the Services (e.g., latency, throughput, error rates, utilization, and feature usage data) ("Usage Information"), and may use Usage Information to operate, maintain, secure, and improve the Services. To the extent Baseten uses Usage Information for analytics, benchmarking, or product development purposes beyond the direct operation of Customer's workloads, Baseten will do so only in aggregated or de-identified form that cannot reasonably be used to identify Customer or to reveal Customer's Confidential Information or Customer Content.

points.text: Hard limit on that telemetry: in no event may Baseten collect or use Usage Information for the purpose of reproducing the customer's model weights or training datasets, or of developing products that replicate customer-specific deployments. Neither point changes mark=yes — they bound telemetry, not the customer's own models and data.
points.text_zh: 该类遥测的硬性限制：Baseten 绝不得为复制客户模型权重或训练集、或为开发复刻客户专属部署的产品而收集或使用 Usage Information。两条 point 都不改变 mark=yes——它们约束的是遥测，不是客户自己的模型与数据。
points.quote: In no event will Baseten collect or use Usage Information for the purpose of reproducing Customer's model weights or training datasets or developing products that replicate Customer-specific deployments.

zdr.quote: Baseten's Dedicated Inference product adheres to a Zero Data Retention posture for Customer Model inputs and outputs.

points.text: This product is named as operating under a ZDR posture
points.text_zh: 该产品被点名持 ZDR 姿态

points.text: ZDR is the default configuration.
points.text_zh: ZDR 是默认配置。

points.text: Scope limit on the ZDR commitment: Baseten is not in breach of these Security Practices (including the ZDR commitments) where logging, retention, storage, access, use or disclosure of Customer Content arises from (a) configurations, settings or deployment choices made by a customer or its authorized users; (b) model runtime code, packages, dependencies or other software provided or selected by a customer, including any vulnerability or compromise latent in a Customer Model or its supply chain; (c) a customer's election to enable logging, retention, abuse monitoring or any Third-Party Product; or (d) actions taken at a customer's written direction. This is an exception defining the scope of the commitment, not a withdrawal of it; mark stays yes.
points.text_zh: ZDR 承诺的适用边界（例外，非撤销）：若 Customer Content 的 logging、retention、storage、access、use 或 disclosure 源于 (a) 客户或其授权用户所作的配置、设置或部署选择；(b) 客户提供或选用的 model runtime code、packages、dependencies 等软件（含 Customer Model 或其供应链中的潜在漏洞）；(c) 客户自行开启 logging、retention、abuse monitoring 或任何 Third-Party Product；或 (d) 按客户书面指示采取的行动，则不构成 Baseten 违反 Security Practices（含 ZDR 承诺）。mark 仍为 yes。
points.quote: Baseten will not be in breach of these Security Practices (including the ZDR commitments) to the extent that any logging, retention, storage, access, use, or disclosure of Customer Content arises from (a) configurations, settings, or deployment choices made by a customer or its authorized users; (b) model runtime code, packages, dependencies, or other software provided or selected by a customer, including any vulnerability or compromise latent in a Customer Model or its supply chain; (c) a customer's election to enable logging, retention, abuse monitoring, or any Third-Party Product; or (d) actions taken at a customer's written direction.

points.text: ZDR configuration is changeable at the customer's request: customers may request changes to the applicable ZDR configuration for their workloads by written notice, and Baseten will promptly implement requested changes whenever technically supported for the applicable Service; where it cannot, it must promptly notify the customer with an explanation. This is what mode=default means here — a default the customer can have changed — and it does not mean Baseten may rewrite the default on its own.
points.text_zh: ZDR 配置可依客户书面请求变更：客户可书面请求变更其负载适用的 ZDR 配置，Baseten 在适用服务技术上支持时即迅速实现，不可实现时须迅速通知并说明原因。这解释了本档 mode=default 的成色——默认值可由客户请求改写——不等于厂商可自行变更默认值。
points.quote: Customers may request changes to the applicable ZDR configuration for their workloads by written notice, and Baseten will promptly implement requested changes whenever technically supported for the applicable Service.

retention.quote: Baseten's Dedicated Inference product adheres to a Zero Data Retention posture for Customer Model inputs and outputs.

points.text: Security Practices "Dedicated Inference": a Zero Data Retention posture for Customer Model inputs and outputs, with no persistent copy made
points.text_zh: Security Practices「Dedicated Inference」：对 Customer Model 输入输出持 ZDR、不做持久副本

points.text: "Dedicated Inference (non-input/output data)": for thirty (30) days after the end of the subscription term the customer may retrieve remaining Customer Content (such as Customer Models), which is deleted once that period ends
points.text_zh: 「Dedicated Inference (non-input/output data)」：订阅期结束后 30 天内可取回剩余 Customer Content（如 Customer Models），期满即删除

points.text: "Customer Model Weights": weights are loaded dynamically into GPU memory and are not persisted to storage by default; where weight caching is enabled, cached weights can be permanently deleted on request
points.text_zh: 「Customer Model Weights」：权重动态载入 GPU 内存、默认不持久化，开启 weight caching 后可要求永久删除

points.text: The KV cache lives only in GPU memory and is not written to disk (docs/observability/security).
points.text_zh: KV cache 只在 GPU 内存、不落盘（docs/observability/security）。

points.text: Async exception on this tier, from the "Asynchronous Inference" entry of the Security Practices (listed there as a product entry alongside Model APIs and Dedicated Inference): if the customer elects to enable asynchronous inference, model inputs get temporarily stored and queued for the duration of the request, can stay in queue for up to 72 hours before being processed and then deleted, and Model Outputs are not stored. It applies only where the customer turns asynchronous inference on; 72 hours is an upper bound, and the inputs are deleted once processed.
points.text_zh: 本档的异步例外，出自 Security Practices「Asynchronous Inference」条（该页把它与 Model APIs、Dedicated Inference 并列为产品条）：客户启用异步推理时，模型输入在请求期间被暂存排队，最多 72 小时后处理并删除，且不存 Model Outputs。仅在客户主动启用异步推理时适用；72 小时是上限，处理完即删除。
points.quote: These model input requests can stay in queue for up to 72 hours before being processed and then deleted.

points.text: A different object inside this dimension: Baseten's access and authentication-related security logs (access and actions taken by Baseten personnel, plus customer authentication events such as device type, IP addresses and abnormality detection) are stored for up to 4 years and cannot be deleted or modified, even by an administrator. That is an upper bound for that log class, not the retention rule for Customer Model inputs and outputs, which are covered by the ZDR posture above.
points.text_zh: 本维度内的另一类对象：Baseten 的访问与认证类安全日志（Baseten 人员的访问与操作，以及客户认证相关事件，如 device type、IP addresses、abnormality detection）最多留存 4 年，且不可删除或修改。这是该类日志的上限，不等于 Customer Model 输入输出的保留口径——输入输出适用上面的 ZDR 姿态。
points.quote: Security-relevant logs are stored for up to 4 years, protected from unauthorized access, and cannot be deleted or modified, even by an administrator.

processing_region.quote:
| Region slug | Location |
| --- | --- |
| `us` | United States |
| `eu` | European Union |

points.text: This is the only product whose region can be chosen: a regional deployment supports `us` / `eu`, and with no selection it is Global (any region with available compute)
points.text_zh: 本档是唯一可自选区域的产品：regional deployment 支持 `us`/`eu`，不选则 Global（可在任何有算力的区域）

points.text: An organization compliance policy can restrict placement further and cannot be overridden
points.text_zh: 组织合规策略可进一步限制且不可被覆盖

points.text: There are also regional environments configured on Baseten's side that confine the models and Chains of an entire environment to a specified region.
points.text_zh: 另有 Baseten 侧配置的 regional environments 把整个 environment 的模型与 Chain 限制在指定区域。

role.quote: The Parties acknowledge and agree that with regard to the Processing of Customer Personal Data: (a) Baseten acts as a Processor; (b) Customer acts as a Controller, or as a Processor on behalf of its own controllers; and (c) Baseten will engage Sub-Processors pursuant to Section 7.

points.text: Same as the top level. Baseten only provides the infrastructure layer that runs the customer's inference workloads (Security Practices "Infrastructure-Only Processing").
points.text_zh: 同顶层。Baseten 只提供基础设施层运行客户推理负载（Security Practices「Infrastructure-Only Processing」）。

training.quote: Baseten does not use Customer Content for model training, fine-tuning, or improvement of any algorithms.

points.text: The same contractual provisions as at top level (Terms §6.3 / DPA §9 / Security Practices "Infrastructure-Only Processing") apply to this tier.
points.text_zh: 同顶层合同（Terms §6.3 / DPA §9 / Security Practices「Infrastructure-Only Processing」）对本档同样适用。

zdr.summary: 是，但由部署形态决定而非承诺
zdr.summary_en: Yes, but by deployment, not a commitment
zdr.quote: **Payload retention**: Baseten doesn’t store synchronous inference inputs or outputs.

points.text: On this tier "no retention" is guaranteed by the architecture (payloads never leave the customer's environment), not by a commitment alone
points.text_zh: 本档的「不保留」由架构保证（payload 不出客户环境）而非仅靠承诺

points.text: The ZDR posture in the Security Practices, being "across all inference products", covers this tier too.
points.text_zh: Security Practices 的 ZDR 姿态对 all inference products 同样覆盖本档。

points.text: Scope limit on the ZDR commitment (the Security Practices clause is worded generally and covers this tier as well): Baseten is not in breach of these Security Practices (including the ZDR commitments) where logging, retention, storage, access, use or disclosure of Customer Content arises from (a) configurations, settings or deployment choices made by a customer or its authorized users; (b) model runtime code, packages, dependencies or other software provided or selected by a customer, including any vulnerability or compromise latent in a Customer Model or its supply chain; (c) a customer's election to enable logging, retention, abuse monitoring or any Third-Party Product; or (d) actions taken at a customer's written direction. This is an exception defining the scope of the commitment, not a withdrawal of it; mark stays yes.
points.text_zh: ZDR 承诺的适用边界（该条措辞是一般性的，同样覆盖本档；属例外而非撤销）：若 Customer Content 的 logging、retention、storage、access、use 或 disclosure 源于 (a) 客户或其授权用户所作的配置、设置或部署选择；(b) 客户提供或选用的 model runtime code、packages、dependencies 等软件（含 Customer Model 或其供应链中的潜在漏洞）；(c) 客户自行开启 logging、retention、abuse monitoring 或任何 Third-Party Product；或 (d) 按客户书面指示采取的行动，则不构成 Baseten 违反 Security Practices（含 ZDR 承诺）。mark 仍为 yes。
points.quote: Baseten will not be in breach of these Security Practices (including the ZDR commitments) to the extent that any logging, retention, storage, access, use, or disclosure of Customer Content arises from (a) configurations, settings, or deployment choices made by a customer or its authorized users; (b) model runtime code, packages, dependencies, or other software provided or selected by a customer, including any vulnerability or compromise latent in a Customer Model or its supply chain; (c) a customer's election to enable logging, retention, abuse monitoring, or any Third-Party Product; or (d) actions taken at a customer's written direction.

retention.quote: **Payload retention**: Baseten doesn’t store synchronous inference inputs or outputs.

points.text: docs/hosting-options/self-hosted「Payload retention」：Baseten doesn't store synchronous inference inputs or outputs

Async inputs queue inside the customer's own infrastructure until the request is executed. The 72-hour queue ceiling quoted for asynchronous inference comes from the "Asynchronous Inference" entry of the Security Practices; on this tier the queueing itself happens inside the customer's own infrastructure rather than in Baseten's, so that entry is recorded here only as the source of the ceiling, not as a second registration of the same exception. Note that some platform data still passes through Baseten on this tier: model code and container images travel through the control plane, metrics and billing data are sent back, and logs and metrics stay in the customer's cluster but are queried remotely by Baseten — the page gives no retention period for that platform data, so its duration is recorded as unspecified.
points.text_zh: 异步输入在客户自己的基础设施内排队直到请求执行。异步推理的 72 小时排队上限出自 Security Practices「Asynchronous Inference」条；本档的排队发生在客户自己的基础设施内而非 Baseten 侧，故这里只把该条记为上限的出处，不重复登记为同一例外。注意本档部分平台数据仍会经过 Baseten：model code 与 container image 经 control plane，metrics 与 billing 数据回传，logs 与 metrics 留在客户集群但 Baseten 远程查询——该页未给出这些平台数据的保留期限，故其期限记 unspecified。

points.text: A different object inside this dimension: Baseten's access and authentication-related security logs (access and actions taken by Baseten personnel, plus customer authentication events such as device type, IP addresses and abnormality detection) are stored for up to 4 years and cannot be deleted or modified, even by an administrator. That is an upper bound for that log class, not the retention rule for inference payloads on this tier, which are covered by the self-hosted payload retention point above.
points.text_zh: 本维度内的另一类对象：Baseten 的访问与认证类安全日志（Baseten 人员的访问与操作，以及客户认证相关事件，如 device type、IP addresses、abnormality detection）最多留存 4 年，且不可删除或修改。这是该类日志的上限，不等于本档推理 payload 的保留口径——payload 适用上面的自托管保留条款。
points.quote: Security-relevant logs are stored for up to 4 years, protected from unauthorized access, and cannot be deleted or modified, even by an administrator.

processing_region.quote: Inference payloads never leave your environment.

points.text: Inference payloads never leave your environment

The workload plane runs in the customer's VPC, deployed in a single provider region (AWS/GCP/OCI, with several workload planes possible across regions and clouds). Security Practices "Deployment Options" says the same: "No Customer Content leaves the customer's environment." The processing location is therefore chosen by the customer and not designated by Baseten.
points.text_zh: workload plane 在客户 VPC、按单一 provider region 部署（AWS/GCP/OCI，可跨区域跨云部署多个 workload plane）。Security Practices「Deployment Options」同旨：No Customer Content leaves the customer's environment。即处理地由客户选择，Baseten 不指定。

role.quote: The Parties acknowledge and agree that with regard to the Processing of Customer Personal Data: (a) Baseten acts as a Processor; (b) Customer acts as a Controller, or as a Processor on behalf of its own controllers; and (c) Baseten will engage Sub-Processors pursuant to Section 7.

points.text: Same as the top level: the DPA role for personal data remains Processor. On this tier Baseten touches inference payloads even less (the workload plane sits on the customer's side), but the control plane still processes some platform data, so the role determination is unchanged.
points.text_zh: 同顶层：DPA 对个人数据的角色仍为 Processor。本档中 Baseten 对推理 payload 实际接触更少（workload plane 在客户侧），但控制面仍处理部分平台数据，故角色判定不变。

training.quote: Baseten does not use Customer Content for model training, fine-tuning, or improvement of any algorithms.

points.text: "Training" on this tier means the customer training or fine-tuning their own model
points.text_zh: 本档「训练」是客户对自己模型做训练/微调

points.text: On Baseten's side, Terms §6.3 / DPA §9 still bar the use of Customer Content to train Baseten's own models. docs/loops/train-on-your-data and docs/training/your-own-data are how-to guides (classified not_policy) and cannot support or rebut this dimension.
points.text_zh: Baseten 侧仍受 Terms §6.3 / DPA §9 约束不得用 Customer Content 训练自己的模型。docs/loops/train-on-your-data 与 docs/training/your-own-data 是使用教程（判 not_policy），不能用来支撑或反驳本维度。

zdr.quote: For thirty (30) days after the end of a customer's subscription term, Baseten will provide the customer access to the Services to allow retrieval of Customer Content.

points.text: The scope of the ZDR posture in the Security Practices is worded as "across all inference products"; training data and checkpoints are storage-type data (retrievable until 30 days after the end of the subscription term) and fall outside zero retention of inference inputs and outputs. Request-level ZDR therefore does not apply to this tier — only the 30-day post-term retrieval window and the deletion commitment do.
points.text_zh: ZDR 姿态的适用范围是 all inference products；训练数据与 checkpoint 属存储型数据（订阅期结束后 30 天内可取回），不在推理输入输出的请求级零保留范围内。即本档不适用请求级 ZDR，只有终止后 30 天取回期与删除承诺。
points.quote: Baseten adheres to a Zero Data Retention posture across all inference products.

retention.summary: 按对象分列保留 30 天
retention.quote: For thirty (30) days after the end of a customer's subscription term, Baseten will provide the customer access to the Services to allow retrieval of Customer Content.

points.text: Security Practices "DATA RETENTION FOR OTHER PRODUCTS / Training": "For thirty (30) days after the end of a customer's subscription term, Baseten will provide the customer access to the Services to allow retrieval of Customer Content. After such thirty (30) day period, Baseten will promptly delete all remaining Customer Content in its possession." — the object is Customer Content (training data and checkpoints included)
points.text_zh: Security Practices「DATA RETENTION FOR OTHER PRODUCTS / Training」：For thirty (30) days after the end of a customer's subscription term, Baseten will provide the customer access to the Services to allow retrieval of Customer Content. After such thirty (30) day period, Baseten will promptly delete all remaining Customer Content in its possession. —— 对象是 Customer Content（含训练数据与 checkpoint）

points.text: Residual backup copies are separately covered by a "limited period" (not quantified).
points.text_zh: 备份残余另有「有限期间」（未量化）。

processing_region.quote: **Global** is the default when neither a deployment region nor a compliance policy limits placement. Baseten can place replicas in any region where the requested compute is available.

points.text: docs/deployment/regional-deployments states expressly that regional selection applies only to model deployments — "Chains and training jobs can't select a region" — so training jobs have no region selection and no default region is disclosed; recorded as undisclosed (and not to be read in reverse as a commitment to any region).
points.text_zh: docs/deployment/regional-deployments 明说 regional selection 只适用于 model deployments，「Chains and training jobs can't select a region」——训练作业没有区域选择能力，也未披露默认区域，故记未披露（不得反向解读为承诺在某一区域）。

role.quote: The Parties acknowledge and agree that with regard to the Processing of Customer Personal Data: (a) Baseten acts as a Processor; (b) Customer acts as a Controller, or as a Processor on behalf of its own controllers; and (c) Baseten will engage Sub-Processors pursuant to Section 7.

points.text: Same as the top level.
points.text_zh: 同顶层。

training.quote: Enterprise and Team customers under an MSA or DPA are excluded from model training and data sharing.

points.text: Enterprise and Team customers under an MSA or DPA are excluded from model training and data sharing.
points.text_zh: 官方安全页：受 MSA 或 DPA 管辖的 Enterprise 与 Team 客户被排除在模型训练与数据共享之外。
points.quote: Enterprise and Team customers under an MSA or DPA are excluded from model training and data sharing.

points.text: Privacy Policy §5.C: the model-development and dataset-licensing practices do not apply to accounts governed by a separate written agreement with StackBlitz that addresses these uses, or to organization-managed accounts except to the extent the organization's administrator has enabled such uses and any notice and choices required by applicable law have been provided.
points.text_zh: 隐私政策 §5.C：这些训练/数据集许可实践不适用于受单独书面协议（MSA/DPA）管辖的账户，也不适用于组织托管账户——除非组织管理员已开启这些用途，且厂商已提供适用法律要求的通知与选择。
points.quote: These model-development and dataset-licensing practices do not apply to Bolt Model Development Content in accounts governed by a separate written agreement with us that addresses these uses, or to organization-managed accounts except to the extent the organization’s administrator has enabled such uses and we have provided any notice and choices required by applicable law.

points.text: Terms §3.5(h)(ii): that section does not apply to organization-managed accounts, including Teams and Enterprise workspaces — an unconditional exclusion with no administrator exception. Both official versions are kept side by side: the Terms exclude these accounts outright, while the Privacy Policy leaves an administrator-enabled exception; the vendor does not explain the difference.
points.text_zh: ToS §3.5(h)(ii)：该节不适用于组织托管账户（含 Teams 与 Enterprise 工作区）——无条件排除，没有管理员例外。两条官方口径并列保留：ToS 无条件排除，隐私政策留了「管理员已开启」的口子，官方未解释差异。
points.quote: This Section 3.5 does not apply to: (i) Bolt Model Development Content in accounts governed by a separate written agreement with Stackblitz that addresses the uses described in this Section, in which case that agreement controls; (ii) organization-managed accounts, including Teams and Enterprise workspaces; or (iii) Restricted Region Accounts, as provided in Section 3.5(e).

retention.quote: Personal information and user content associated with an account are retained while the account remains active.

points.text: Object: personal information and user content. Context: default (while the account remains active). Duration type: no quantified period.
points.text_zh: 对象=个人信息与用户内容；语境=默认（账户活跃期）；期限类型=无量化期限——账户活跃期间保留。
points.quote: Personal information and user content associated with an account are retained while the account remains active.

points.text: Section 11 opening standard: retained for as long as necessary to provide the Services, support active accounts, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements — as-needed retention, neither a fixed period nor bounded by service termination.
points.text_zh: §11 首段总标准：为提供服务、支持活跃账户、履行法律义务、解决争议与执行协议所必需即保留——属按需保留，既不是固定期限，也不是以服务终止为界。
points.quote: We retain personal information and user content for as long as necessary to provide the Services, support active accounts, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements.

points.text: Context: voluntary account closure. The account and associated data enter an inactive or expired state, and StackBlitz will delete or anonymize such data within a reasonable period following closure, subject to backup retention, legal obligations and security requirements — no quantified period (the text contains no thirty-day figure).
points.text_zh: 语境=主动关户：账户及关联数据进入 inactive/expired 状态，厂商在关户后「合理期间」内删除或匿名化，并受备份保留、法律义务与安全要求限制——无量化期限（原文没有 30 天这个数）。
points.quote: When an account is voluntarily closed, the account and associated data enter an inactive or expired state. We will delete or anonymize such data within a reasonable period following account closure, subject to backup retention, legal obligations, and security requirements.

points.text: Context: termination or suspension other than for cause. A reasonable means to retrieve or export content is made available for thirty (30) days following the effective date, after which StackBlitz may delete it — this is an export availability window, not a deletion deadline.
points.text_zh: 语境=非过错终止或暂停：厂商在生效日起 30 天内提供检索/导出内容的合理途径，之后「may delete」——这是导出可用期，不是删除期限。
points.quote: Where we terminate or suspend an account other than for cause, we will make available a reasonable means to retrieve or export your content for thirty (30) days following the effective date of the termination or suspension, after which we may delete it.

points.text: Context: termination for abuse or policy violations. The account may be permanently disabled and associated data deleted, with no export window, subject to applicable legal requirements.
points.text_zh: 语境=违规终止（滥用服务或违反条款）：可永久停用账户并删除关联数据，无导出窗口，仍受适用法律要求约束。
points.quote: If an account is suspended or terminated due to abuse of the Services or violation of applicable terms or policies, we may permanently disable the account and delete associated data, subject to applicable legal requirements.

points.text: Context: after deletion or termination. Residual copies may persist in backups, logs, or archival systems for a limited period (unquantified), and are not used for active processing except as necessary for security, fraud prevention, or legal compliance.
points.text_zh: 语境=删除或终止之后：备份、日志、归档系统中的残留副本可能再保留有限期间（未量化），且不得用于主动处理（安全、反欺诈、法律合规除外）。
points.quote: Residual copies of personal information and user content may persist in backups, logs, or archival systems for a limited period following deletion or account termination. Such data will not be used for active processing except as necessary for security, fraud prevention, or legal compliance.

points.text: Object: relevant portions of files you explicitly attach to an AI prompt. Context: AI requests sent to third-party AI service providers. Duration type: limited but unquantified — those providers do not receive ongoing or independent access to your files.
points.text_zh: 对象=显式附加到 AI prompt 的文件的相关部分；语境=经第三方 AI 服务商的 AI 请求；期限类型=有限期间但未量化——这些服务商不获得对文件的持续或独立访问。
points.quote: When you explicitly attach files to an AI prompt, relevant portions of those files may be transmitted to third-party AI service providers solely to generate responses. These providers do not receive ongoing or independent access to your files and retain such inputs only for limited periods.

points.text: Scope: this conclusion covers the Privacy Policy only. The Policy itself states that enterprise customer data processing is governed by applicable DPAs rather than solely by this Privacy Policy (§16) and excludes data processed by customers within their own applications (§2), so retention for organization tiers may be set by the MSA/DPA; the DPA text and trust.bolt.new are not collected yet.
points.text_zh: 适用范围：本结论只覆盖隐私政策口径。隐私政策 §16 自认企业客户数据处理由适用 DPA 管辖、并非仅由本政策管辖（§2 另把客户自建/部署应用内的数据处理排除在政策之外），组织档位的保留期限可能由 MSA/DPA 另行约定；DPA 原文与 trust.bolt.new 尚未纳管。
points.quote: Enterprise customers should note that customer data processing is governed by applicable DPAs rather than solely by this Privacy Policy.

processing_region.quote: StackBlitz, Inc. is headquartered in the United States, and personal information may be transferred to, processed, and stored in countries outside of your jurisdiction, including the United States.

points.text: Deployment topology, not a region commitment: the security page states that BYOK deployment lets you run Bolt inside your own AWS or Azure tenant with full infrastructure isolation and no shared compute. It does not state which regions can be selected or where data is stored, and the statement comes from the marketing/security page only (no trust-centre or contract text collected yet).

points.quote: Yes. BYOK deployment lets you run Bolt inside your own AWS or Azure tenant with full infrastructure isolation and no shared compute, meeting HIPAA, FedRAMP, and SOC 2 requirements.

points.text: Scope limitation, not a role statement: §2 of the Policy excludes personal data processed by customers within applications they build or deploy, which is governed by customer agreements and DPAs.
points.text_zh: 适用范围限制（不构成角色表述）：政策 §2 把客户在其自建/部署的应用内处理的个人数据排除在政策之外，这部分由客户协议与 DPA 管辖。
points.quote: It does not apply to personal data processed by our customers within applications they build or deploy using the Services, which is governed by applicable customer agreements and data processing addenda (“DPA”), where applicable.

points.text: The Policy itself says enterprise customer data processing is governed by applicable DPAs rather than solely by this Privacy Policy; the DPA text is not collected yet, so this dimension stays unknown (pending sources: the DPA and trust.bolt.new).
points.text_zh: 隐私政策 §16 自认企业客户数据处理由适用 DPA 管辖、并非仅由本政策管辖；DPA 原文尚未纳管，故本档 role 维持 unknown（待纳管来源：DPA、trust.bolt.new）。
points.quote: Enterprise customers should note that customer data processing is governed by applicable DPAs rather than solely by this Privacy Policy.

training.quote: Unless you opt out and subject to the regional and consent rules below, we may use Bolt Model Development Content that is eligible under “Prospective Application” below to train, fine-tune, evaluate, benchmark, and improve artificial-intelligence models developed by or for StackBlitz.

points.text: By default, and unless you opt out, Bolt Model Development Content that is eligible under the prospective-application rules may be used to train, fine-tune, evaluate, benchmark and improve models and to prepare datasets licensed to third parties; opt-out is free of charge, implemented within fifteen (15) days, and does not unwind models already trained or datasets already delivered.
points.text_zh: 默认（除非退出）可将符合「Prospective Application」条件的 Bolt Model Development Content（AI Input、AI Output、代码、项目文件、错误/fix traces、tool invocations、edit histories）用于训练、微调、评测、基准测试并制作许可数据集；可免费退出，最长 15 天内实施，且不回溯已训练模型或已交付数据集。
points.quote: Unless you opt out and subject to the regional and consent rules below, we may use Bolt Model Development Content that is eligible under “Prospective Application” below to train, fine-tune, evaluate, benchmark, and improve artificial-intelligence models developed by or for StackBlitz.

points.text: Not applied before October 7, 2026 or before the Terms take effect for the account; only content created or generated on or after the later of those two dates is eligible, and earlier content is not eligible even if it remains stored in the account or project (earlier content re-submitted to Bolt AI Features on or after the applicable date becomes eligible). Forge Content is eligible from September 14, 2026 if covered by a Forge consent that has not been withdrawn.
points.text_zh: 对既有账户 2026-10-07（或条款对该账户生效日）起才适用；只有在该日及之后创建或生成的内容 eligible，更早的内容即使仍存在账户或项目里也不 eligible（在该日之后重新提交给 Bolt AI Features 的部分除外）。Forge Content 自 2026-09-14 起需有未撤回的 Forge 同意。
points.quote: We will not use Bolt Model Development Content for model development or dataset licensing before October 7, 2026 or before the Terms take effect for your account. Bolt Model Development Content is eligible for those purposes only if it is created or generated on or after the later of October 7, 2026 and the date the Terms take effect for your account, except that Forge Content created or generated on or after September 14, 2026 is eligible if it is covered by a Forge consent that you have not withdrawn.

points.text: Accounts determined to be located in the EEA, the United Kingdom, or Switzerland are excluded: no model development and no dataset licensing, and no reliance on legitimate interests or consent for those purposes; an account whose location cannot be determined is treated as located there.

points.quote: We do not use Bolt Model Development Content, including Forge Content, associated with an account we determine to be located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or Switzerland for AI model development or for preparing datasets for licensing, and we do not rely on legitimate interests or consent for those purposes for such accounts.

points.text: Bolt Forge is offered on the condition that Forge Content (AI Input, AI Output and related interaction data such as error-and-fix traces generated while Forge is enabled, plus the project files processed by Forge) may be used to train models and to prepare de-identified datasets licensed to third-party AI developers, including for compensation; enabling Forge requires an affirmative consent action.
points.text_zh: Bolt Forge 以内容使用为条件：启用 Forge 期间产生的 AI Input、AI Output 与交互数据（含 error-and-fix traces）连同经 Forge 处理的项目文件（Forge Content）可用于训练模型并制作去标识化数据集对外许可（含付费许可）；启用需以肯定动作明示同意。
points.quote: Forge is offered on the condition that we may use the AI Input, AI Output, and related interaction data (such as error-and-fix traces) generated while Forge is enabled, together with the project files processed by Forge (“Forge Content”), to train AI models and to prepare de-identified datasets that we license to third-party AI developers, including for compensation, for AI model development, training, and evaluation.

points.text: While Forge is enabled, the opt-out does not apply to Forge Content; stopping use of Forge ends collection of new Forge Content but does not by itself withdraw consent; after withdrawal the content is no longer selected for new model-training runs or newly prepared or licensed datasets, but processing already completed, models already trained and datasets already delivered are not unwound.
points.text_zh: Forge 启用期间 opt-out 不适用于 Forge Content；停止使用 Forge 只终止新内容的收集，不等于撤回同意；撤回后不再把 Forge Content 选入新的训练运行或新数据集，但不回溯已完成的处理、已训练模型与已交付数据集。
points.quote: While Forge is enabled, the opt-out described above does not apply to Forge Content. You can stop using Forge at any time: on a plan that includes other AI modes, by switching to another agent or mode; on a plan in which Forge is the only AI mode, by changing your plan (including to a free plan). Stopping use of Forge ends the collection of new Forge Content but does not by itself withdraw your consent, and we may continue to use Forge Content collected while Forge was enabled for the purposes described in this paragraph until you withdraw that consent. You can withdraw your consent at any time, free of charge, by contacting privacy@stackblitz.com or, once available, in your account settings; we implement a withdrawal in the same manner as an opt-out under “Opting Out and Withdrawing Consent” above, and after withdrawal we will not select your Forge Content for new model-training runs or newly prepared or licensed datasets. Neither stopping use of Forge nor withdrawing consent unwinds processing completed before that time, models already trained, or datasets already delivered to licensees, except as required by applicable law.

retention.quote: Personal information and user content associated with an account are retained while the account remains active.

points.text: Object: personal information and user content. Context: default (while the account remains active). Duration type: no quantified period.

points.quote: Personal information and user content associated with an account are retained while the account remains active.

points.text: Section 11 opening standard: retained for as long as necessary to provide the Services, support active accounts, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements — as-needed retention, neither a fixed period nor bounded by service termination.

points.quote: We retain personal information and user content for as long as necessary to provide the Services, support active accounts, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements.

points.text: Context: voluntary account closure. The account and associated data enter an inactive or expired state, and StackBlitz will delete or anonymize such data within a reasonable period following closure, subject to backup retention, legal obligations and security requirements — no quantified period (the text contains no thirty-day figure).

points.quote: When an account is voluntarily closed, the account and associated data enter an inactive or expired state. We will delete or anonymize such data within a reasonable period following account closure, subject to backup retention, legal obligations, and security requirements.

points.text: Context: termination or suspension other than for cause. A reasonable means to retrieve or export content is made available for thirty (30) days following the effective date, after which StackBlitz may delete it — this is an export availability window, not a deletion deadline.

points.quote: Where we terminate or suspend an account other than for cause, we will make available a reasonable means to retrieve or export your content for thirty (30) days following the effective date of the termination or suspension, after which we may delete it.

points.text: Context: termination for abuse or policy violations. The account may be permanently disabled and associated data deleted, with no export window, subject to applicable legal requirements.
points.text_zh: 语境=违规终止（滥用服务或违反条款）：可永久停用账户并删除关联数据，无导出窗口，仍受适用法律要求约束。
points.quote: If an account is suspended or terminated due to abuse of the Services or violation of applicable terms or policies, we may permanently disable the account and delete associated data, subject to applicable legal requirements.

points.text: Context: after deletion or termination. Residual copies may persist in backups, logs, or archival systems for a limited period (unquantified), and are not used for active processing except as necessary for security, fraud prevention, or legal compliance.
points.text_zh: 语境=删除或终止之后：备份、日志、归档系统中的残留副本可能再保留有限期间（未量化），且不得用于主动处理（安全、反欺诈、法律合规除外）。
points.quote: Residual copies of personal information and user content may persist in backups, logs, or archival systems for a limited period following deletion or account termination. Such data will not be used for active processing except as necessary for security, fraud prevention, or legal compliance.

points.text: Object: relevant portions of files you explicitly attach to an AI prompt. Context: AI requests sent to third-party AI service providers. Duration type: limited but unquantified — those providers do not receive ongoing or independent access to your files.
points.text_zh: 对象=显式附加到 AI prompt 的文件的相关部分；语境=经第三方 AI 服务商的 AI 请求；期限类型=有限期间但未量化——这些服务商不获得对文件的持续或独立访问。

points.text: Context: termination or suspension other than for cause. A reasonable means to retrieve or export content is made available for thirty (30) days following the effective date, after which StackBlitz may delete it — this is an export availability window, not a deletion deadline.
points.text_zh: 语境=非过错终止或暂停：厂商在生效日起 30 天内提供检索/导出内容的合理途径，之后「may delete」——这是导出可用期，不是删除期限。
points.quote: Where we terminate or suspend an account other than for cause, we will make available a reasonable means to retrieve or export your content for thirty (30) days following the effective date of the termination or suspension, after which we may delete it.

points.text: Context: termination for abuse or policy violations. The account may be permanently disabled and associated data deleted, with no export window, subject to applicable legal requirements.
points.text_zh: 语境=违规终止（滥用服务或违反条款）：可永久停用账户并删除关联数据，无导出窗口，仍受适用法律要求约束。
points.quote: If an account is suspended or terminated due to abuse of the Services or violation of applicable terms or policies, we may permanently disable the account and delete associated data, subject to applicable legal requirements.

points.text: Context: after deletion or termination. Residual copies may persist in backups, logs, or archival systems for a limited period (unquantified), and are not used for active processing except as necessary for security, fraud prevention, or legal compliance.
points.text_zh: 语境=删除或终止之后：备份、日志、归档系统中的残留副本可能再保留有限期间（未量化），且不得用于主动处理（安全、反欺诈、法律合规除外）。
points.quote: Residual copies of personal information and user content may persist in backups, logs, or archival systems for a limited period following deletion or account termination. Such data will not be used for active processing except as necessary for security, fraud prevention, or legal compliance.

points.text: Object: relevant portions of files you explicitly attach to an AI prompt. Context: AI requests sent to third-party AI service providers. Duration type: limited but unquantified — those providers do not receive ongoing or independent access to your files.
points.text_zh: 对象=显式附加到 AI prompt 的文件的相关部分；语境=经第三方 AI 服务商的 AI 请求；期限类型=有限期间但未量化——这些服务商不获得对文件的持续或独立访问。
points.quote: When you explicitly attach files to an AI prompt, relevant portions of those files may be transmitted to third-party AI service providers solely to generate responses. These providers do not receive ongoing or independent access to your files and retain such inputs only for limited periods.

points.text: Scope: this conclusion covers the Privacy Policy only. The Policy itself states that enterprise customer data processing is governed by applicable DPAs rather than solely by this Privacy Policy (§16) and excludes data processed by customers within their own applications (§2), so retention for organization tiers may be set by the MSA/DPA; the DPA text and trust.bolt.new are not collected yet.
points.text_zh: 适用范围：本结论只覆盖隐私政策口径。隐私政策 §16 自认企业客户数据处理由适用 DPA 管辖、并非仅由本政策管辖（§2 另把客户自建/部署应用内的数据处理排除在政策之外），组织档位的保留期限可能由 MSA/DPA 另行约定；DPA 原文与 trust.bolt.new 尚未纳管。
points.quote: Enterprise customers should note that customer data processing is governed by applicable DPAs rather than solely by this Privacy Policy.

processing_region.quote: StackBlitz, Inc. is headquartered in the United States, and personal information may be transferred to, processed, and stored in countries outside of your jurisdiction, including the United States.

points.text: Scope limitation, not a role statement: §2 of the Policy excludes personal data processed by customers within applications they build or deploy, which is governed by customer agreements and DPAs.
points.text_zh: 适用范围限制（不构成角色表述）：政策 §2 把客户在其自建/部署的应用内处理的个人数据排除在政策之外，这部分由客户协议与 DPA 管辖。
points.quote: It does not apply to personal data processed by our customers within applications they build or deploy using the Services, which is governed by applicable customer agreements and data processing addenda (“DPA”), where applicable.

points.text: The Policy itself says enterprise customer data processing is governed by applicable DPAs rather than solely by this Privacy Policy; the DPA text is not collected yet, so this dimension stays unknown (pending sources: the DPA and trust.bolt.new).
points.text_zh: 隐私政策 §16 自认企业客户数据处理由适用 DPA 管辖、并非仅由本政策管辖；DPA 原文尚未纳管，故本档 role 维持 unknown（待纳管来源：DPA、trust.bolt.new）。
points.quote: Enterprise customers should note that customer data processing is governed by applicable DPAs rather than solely by this Privacy Policy.

training.quote: the foregoing does not grant Cerebras the right to use Service Content for the purpose of training or fine-tuning models

points.text: Same as top-level training. The enterprise tier also has the purpose limitation in DPA §3.2.2 (no retaining, using, disclosing or otherwise processing Customer Personal Data for any purpose other than as necessary to provide the Services to Customer, as required by law, or on the customer's written instructions) and the use limitation in Inference Terms §3(c)
points.text_zh: 同顶层 training。企业档另有 DPA §3.2.2 的目的限制(只可为提供 Services、法律要求或客户书面指示处理),以及 Inference Terms §3(c) 的用途限定

points.text: But the enterprise contract text has no counterpart of the express ToS sentence "does not grant Cerebras the right to use Service Content for the purpose of training or fine-tuning models", so the conclusion is somewhat weaker.
points.text_zh: 但企业档合同文本里没有 ToS 那句明文「不授予训练/微调权利」,结论强度略低。

points.text: Neither the DPA nor the Inference Terms contains a ZDR or zero-retention clause, and neither gives an application process or a switch
points.text_zh: DPA 与 Inference Terms 全文都没有 ZDR / 零保留条款,也没有申请流程或开关

points.text: DPA §3.2.2 ("will not retain, use, disclose, or otherwise Process such Customer Personal Data for any purpose other than as necessary to provide Services") is a purpose limitation, not a statement on this dimension: it says nothing about whether zero retention is offered, so it is no longer bound to this entry.
points.text_zh: DPA §3.2.2（「不得为提供服务以外的目的保留、使用、披露或处理」）是目的限制条款，不构成对 zdr 维度的表述：它没有说是否提供零保留，故不再绑在本条。

points.text: The Trust Center document list contains no ZDR addendum. ZDR on the enterprise tier rests only on blog wording such as "can enforce zero-data-retention policies per customer requirements" (official_blog level, and in an on-prem-leaning context), which is not a contractual commitment.
points.text_zh: Trust Center 的文档列表里没有 ZDR 附件。企业档的 ZDR 只能靠「按客户要求可实施」这类博客表述(官方_blog 层级,且语境偏 on-prem),不构成合同承诺。

retention.quote: The personal data are retained so long as the parties continue to maintain a business relationship in connection with the Agreement.

points.text: The enterprise tier is governed by the DPA: Annex I, "The personal data are retained so long as the parties continue to maintain a business relationship in connection with the Agreement."
points.text_zh: 企业档以 DPA 为准:Annex I「The personal data are retained so long as the parties continue to maintain a business relationship in connection with the Agreement.」

points.text: §3.2.2 allows retention and use only as necessary to provide the Services, as required by law, or on the customer's instructions
points.text_zh: §3.2.2 只允许为提供服务、法律要求或客户指示而保留/使用

points.text: §3.2.9: on expiry or termination of the Agreement, data is returned or destroyed at the customer's choice (except where required by law)
points.text_zh: §3.2.9 协议到期或终止时按客户选择返还或销毁(法律要求除外)

points.text: §3.2.7(i) supports deletion at the customer's request. This differs from the "We do not retain inputs and outputs" wording of Privacy Policy §6 on the self-serve tier, so the two rows are recorded side by side.
points.text_zh: §3.2.7(i) 支持按客户请求删除。与个人档隐私政策 §6「不保留输入输出」口径不同,两行并列。

points.text: Object scope: Annex I lists "Any personal data contained in inputs in the training, inference and chatbot Services" among the categories of personal data transferred, alongside customer employee data (names, addresses, telephone numbers, email addresses, job titles) — which is why the object is recorded as "varies by object" rather than account or staff data alone.
points.text_zh: 对象范围：Annex I 把「Any personal data contained in inputs in the training, inference and chatbot Services」列入传输的个人数据类别,与客户员工数据(姓名、地址、电话、邮箱、职位)并列——故对象记为「按对象分列」,而不是只有账号或员工数据。
points.quote: Any personal data contained in inputs in the training, inference and chatbot Services

points.text: The contract layer states a second, different criterion for User Content: Inference Terms §3(c) — "We retain the User Content only to the extent necessary in connection with the Purpose", where the Purpose is to provide the Services and comply with applicable law. Recorded side by side with the DPA Annex I period (as long as the business relationship continues).
points.text_zh: 合同层对 User Content 另有一套口径：Inference Terms §3(c)「We retain the User Content only to the extent necessary in connection with the Purpose」,而 Purpose 是提供服务并遵守适用法律。与 DPA Annex I 的期限(业务关系存续期间)并列记录。
points.quote: We retain the User Content only to the extent necessary in connection with the Purpose

processing_region.quote: The Parties shall ensure that any transfer of Customer Personal Data hereunder complies with Data Protection Laws and, with respect to any such transfers from the European Economic Area, Switzerland or the United Kingdom to a Third Country the Parties agree that by executing this DPA they also execute Module 1, Module 2 and Module 3 of the Standard Contractual Clauses and the UK Addendum, which are incorporated by reference and form an integral part of this DPA.

points.text: Main evidence: DPA §7.1 commits only to a transfer mechanism — for transfers from the European Economic Area, Switzerland or the United Kingdom to a Third Country the Parties execute Module 1, Module 2 and Module 3 of the SCCs and the UK Addendum, with the governing jurisdiction and the forum being the Republic of Ireland (§7.2.1.4–§7.2.1.5) and the Irish DPC as the competent supervisory authority in Annex I. It commits to no processing location, no data residency and no selectable region. Recorded alongside Privacy Policy §9 (the United States and other countries) and the press release (100% United States).
points.text_zh: 主证据：DPA §7.1 只约定传输机制——EEA/瑞士/英国→第三国时双方执行 SCC Module 1/2/3 与 UK Addendum,管辖地与法院地为爱尔兰(§7.2.1.4–§7.2.1.5),Annex I 主管机关写 Irish DPC。没有承诺处理地、数据驻留或可选区域。与隐私政策 §9(美国 + 其他国家)、新闻稿(美国 100%)并列记录。

points.text: Auxiliary evidence only: the subprocessor-list anchor shows that the list is not set out in the DPA body but hosted on the Cerebras Trust Center; it says nothing about processing location, data residency or selectable regions.
points.text_zh: 辅助证据：子处理者清单锚点只说明清单不在 DPA 正文里、而是托管在 Cerebras Trust Center,不涉及处理地、数据驻留或可选区域。
points.quote: List of subprocessors shall be provided in the following webpage on the Cerebras Trust Center

role.quote: Cerebras acts as a Processor, or if applicable, Sub-processor to Customer

points.text: The enterprise row of top-level role: DPA §2.1 plus the importer role in Annex I = Processor / Sub-processor
points.text_zh: 同顶层 role 的企业档一行:DPA §2.1 + Annex I 的 importer 角色 = Processor / Sub-processor

points.text: Inference Terms §5(a) routes the handling of personal information to the DPA.
points.text_zh: Inference Terms §5(a) 把个人信息处理引向 DPA。

training.quote: the foregoing does not grant Cerebras the right to use Service Content for the purpose of training or fine-tuning models

points.text: The self-serve tier accepts the Website ToS, where "does not grant Cerebras the right to use Service Content for the purpose of training or fine-tuning models" applies directly. The commitment is contract-level (a clause in the accepted ToS), so the mode is recorded as "by contract" — the same sentence carries the same mode on the enterprise tier, and nothing in the public documents states a non-contractual default of not training.
points.text_zh: 自服务档接受的是 Website ToS,「does not grant Cerebras the right to use Service Content for the purpose of training or fine-tuning models」直接适用。该承诺属合同层(所接受 ToS 里的条款),故 mode 记 by_contract——同一句在企业档记的也是同一 mode,公开文本里没有「无需申请、默认即不训练」这类非合同层依据。

points.text: Usage Data (which excludes User Content and Outputs) may still be used for product improvement.
points.text_zh: Usage Data(不含 User Content)仍可用于产品改进。

zdr.quote: We do not retain inputs and outputs associated with our training, inference and chatbot Services.

points.text: Same as top-level zdr: nothing is retained at the content layer by default, but there is no ZDR programme that can be enabled
points.text_zh: 同顶层 zdr:内容层默认不保留,但没有可开通的 ZDR 方案

points.text: Logs and usage metadata are still retained and used.
points.text_zh: 日志与用量元数据仍会保留/使用。

points.text: Scope of the default: Privacy Policy §6 gives the no-retention rule for inputs and outputs, and the sentence immediately before it is the exception to it — "We may also retain and use this information as necessary to comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes, or enforce our agreements." Zero retention here is the default behaviour, not an unconditional guarantee.
points.text_zh: 默认口径的范围：隐私政策 §6 给出「不保留输入输出」,而紧接其前的一句正是它的例外——「We may also retain and use this information as necessary to comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes, or enforce our agreements.」这里的零保留是默认行为,不是无条件保证。
points.quote: We may also retain and use this information as necessary to comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes, or enforce our agreements.

retention.quote: We do not retain inputs and outputs associated with our training, inference and chatbot Services.

points.text: Points (1)(2)(3) of top-level retention: inputs and outputs are not retained, logs are deleted when they are no longer necessary to provide services, and the cache TTL is 5 minutes to 1 hour. The DPA does not apply to this tier.
points.text_zh: 同顶层 retention 的 (1)(2)(3):输入输出不保留、日志不再需要时删除、缓存 TTL 5 分钟~1 小时。DPA 不适用本档。

points.text: Context of the "we do not retain inputs and outputs" commitment: the sentence immediately before it in §6 is the exception to it — retention and use "as necessary to comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes, or enforce our agreements". So the basis is "not retained" by default, with a legal/dispute/enforcement carve-out; §10(a) adds a further caveat for EEA rights requests (record-keeping and compliance with applicable law). This is the only such exception sentence within §6.
points.text_zh: 「不保留输入输出」的语境：§6 中紧接其前的一句就是它的例外——为履行法律义务、解决争议或执行协议所必需时可保留并使用。故 basis 是「默认不留存」+ 法律/争议/执行三项豁免；§10(a) 就 EEA 权利请求另有「为存档目的及遵守适用法律所必需时仍可能保留」的保留。这是 §6 内唯一的例外句。
points.quote: We may also retain and use this information as necessary to comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes, or enforce our agreements.

processing_region.quote: your data may be stored and processed in the United States and other countries outside the United States

points.text: Same as top-level processing_region. The self-serve tier has no DPA SCC mechanism, and the only statement of processing location is §9, "your data may be stored and processed in the United States and other countries outside the United States".
points.text_zh: 同顶层 processing_region。个人档没有 DPA 的 SCC 机制,处理地只有 §9 的「美国 + 其他国家」表述。

role.quote: Cerebras will process your personal data as an independent controller in accordance with its Privacy Policy.

points.text: Inference Terms preamble: when the Services are used in a personal capacity the DPA does not apply, and "Cerebras will process your personal data as an independent controller in accordance with its Privacy Policy". That sentence is expressly conditional ("If you use the Services in a personal capacity …"), so it covers only the personal-capacity branch of this tier.
points.text_zh: Inference Terms 前言:个人身份使用时 DPA 不适用,Cerebras 以 independent controller 身份依隐私政策处理。该句带明确条件(「If you use the Services in a personal capacity …」),只覆盖本档的个人身份这一支。

points.text: Privacy Policy §10(a) is to the same effect (Cerebras is the "data controller" of the Personal Data handled under that Policy). Note that this anchor comes from the Inference Terms while self-serve sign-up may accept the Website ToS — the two texts state the role for this tier differently, so both branches are recorded rather than picking one.
points.text_zh: 隐私政策 §10(a) 同旨(政策下处理的个人数据,Cerebras 为「data controller」)。注意本锚点来自 Inference Terms,而自服务注册接受的可能是 Website ToS——两份文本对本档角色的表述不同,故两支并列记录,不选边。

points.text: The other branch: this tier has plan_level = "any", and for a Customer that is a business entity the role points to the DPA instead — Inference Terms §5(a) "will be handled in accordance with the Data Processing Agreement" — and DPA §2.1 makes Cerebras a Processor / Sub-processor. The controller value above therefore covers the personal-capacity branch only.
points.text_zh: 另一支：本档 plan_level = "any",客户为企业实体时角色指向 DPA——Inference Terms §5(a)「will be handled in accordance with the Data Processing Agreement」,而 DPA §2.1 定 Cerebras 为 Processor / Sub-processor。上面那个 controller 值只覆盖个人身份这一支。
points.quote: will be handled in accordance with the Data Processing Agreement

points.text: The Website ToS — the text self-serve sign-up accepts — is the ToS-layer role clue for this tier: "personally identifiable information that you transmit or post to the Site or the Service for the purpose of receiving services will be handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy and Data Processing Agreement, as applicable." The "as applicable" qualifier leaves both branches open, which is why the two roles are recorded side by side.
points.text_zh: 自服务注册接受的 Website ToS 是本档 ToS 层的角色线索:「personally identifiable information that you transmit or post to the Site or the Service for the purpose of receiving services will be handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy and Data Processing Agreement, as applicable.」其中「as applicable」把两支都留着,故两种角色并列记录。
points.quote: will be handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy and Data Processing Agreement, as applicable

points.text: On-prem / CS systems and customer-owned clusters are not covered by the Website ToS (which expressly excludes hardware and the software that ships with it)
points.text_zh: on-prem / CS 系统与客户自有集群不在 Website ToS 覆盖内(ToS 明文排除硬件及随硬件的软件)

points.text: What ships with the hardware is the Cerebras Software EULA (IP and confidentiality clauses only, no data processing clause) and the Terms of Sale. Cerebras publishes no training statement for this product line.
points.text_zh: 随硬件的是 Cerebras Software EULA(仅 IP 与保密条款,无数据处理条款)与 Terms of Sale。官方没有就这条产品线公开训练口径。

points.text: Only one sentence in the 2025-09-19 blog post, "can enforce zero-data-retention policies per customer requirements" (official_blog level, with no clause behind it)
points.text_zh: 只有 2025-09-19 博客一句「can enforce zero-data-retention policies per customer requirements」(官方_blog 层级,无条款支撑)

points.text: There is no contract-level ZDR clause and no product documentation for it.
points.text_zh: 没有合同级 ZDR 条款或产品文档。

retention.summary: 按对象分列未公布期限

points.text: Same as above: neither the EULA nor the Terms of Sale contains a retention clause
points.text_zh: 同上:EULA 与 Terms of Sale 都不含保留条款

points.text: The hardware line has no published retention commitment.
points.text_zh: 硬件线没有公开的保留承诺。

points.text: Deployed in the customer's own environment, with no processing-location clause disclosed
points.text_zh: 部署在客户自有环境,官方未披露任何处理地条款

points.text: The blog offers only descriptive wording such as "on-premises deployments as well as cloud regions in trusted geographies".
points.text_zh: 博客只有「on-premises deployments as well as cloud regions in trusted geographies」这种描述性表述。

points.text: The hardware line has no published DPA or role clause (the EULA is a software licence and contains no data processing clause)
points.text_zh: 硬件线没有公开的 DPA 或角色条款(EULA 是软件许可,不含数据处理条款)

points.text: The Cerebras Inference DPA covers only the cloud Services.
points.text_zh: Cerebras Inference DPA 只覆盖云端 Services。

training.quote: We do not use your private data to train our models or any other models on the platform unless you explicitly choose to share your inputs and annotations with the "Community."

points.text: 同顶层 training：除主动分享到 Community 外，不使用客户私有数据训练自家或平台上其他模型
points.text_zh: 同顶层 training：除主动分享到 Community 外，不使用客户私有数据训练自家或平台上其他模型

points.text: 聚合使用模式分析允许，明细日志需 opt-in。
points.text_zh: 聚合使用模式分析允许，明细日志需 opt-in。

zdr.quote: **API Control:** When making an API call, you can specify that the input data should not be stored. In this case, the data is used only to generate a prediction and is not retained.

points.text: Zero retention is available per request: when making an API call, you can specify that the input data should not be stored; in that case the data is used only to generate a prediction and is not retained.
points.text_zh: 零保留属请求级自助开通：API 调用时可指定不存储输入，此时数据仅用于生成预测、不留存。故记 mark=yes / mode=opt_in，而非「明确否定」。

points.text: 适用范围：仅在按请求显式关闭时生效，未关闭的调用仍会持久存储输入与预测；条款出自同一页「How to Opt-Out of Data Storage」一节。
points.text_zh: 适用范围：仅在按请求显式关闭时生效，未关闭的调用仍会持久存储输入与预测；条款出自同一页「How to Opt-Out of Data Storage」一节。

points.text: 背景：默认行为是安全存储输入（原文「we securely store the data you send to our platform」），保留由客户控制——这是 opt_in 方案的前提，不构成对零保留方案的否定。
points.text_zh: 背景：默认行为是安全存储输入（原文「we securely store the data you send to our platform」），保留由客户控制——这是 opt_in 方案的前提，不构成对零保留方案的否定。
points.quote: To enable this, we securely store the data you send to our platform.

retention.quote: When you send inputs (such as images, text, or video) to your application, the data and its resulting predictions are stored securely. This allows you to review, search, and manage your data directly within the Clarifai Portal.

points.text: 同顶层 retention：输入与预测默认持久存储在平台（S3），保留期由客户控制，无量化期限
points.text_zh: 同顶层 retention：输入与预测默认持久存储在平台（S3），保留期由客户控制，无量化期限

points.text: Customers can configure data retention policies to meet their needs via the API, setting a specific retention period (e.g., 30 days) after which their data is automatically purged.
points.text_zh: 客户可经 API 自行配置保留策略、设定具体保留期（例：30 天），到期后数据自动清除。
points.quote: **Full Control Over Retention:** You can configure data retention policies to meet your specific security and privacy needs. This can be done via the API, allowing you to set a specific retention period (e.g., 30 days) after which your data will be automatically purged.

points.text: basis=undisclosed 只描述「默认保留期限未公布」：默认存储行为见锚点 retention-secure-storage-by-default，厂商未给默认量化期限（期限由客户配置），不等于该维度没有披露——同一页已披露到期自动清除与请求级不写入持久存储两种机制。
