points.text: Multi-hop: Cline transmits the request to the upstream AI model provider on the user's behalf, and the notice says some AI model providers may use content for training unless the user has explicitly opted out where such an option is offered by that AI model provider. One hop is explicitly a no, so the whole chain is no.
points.text_zh: 多跳口径：本档请求由 Cline 代用户转给上游模型提供方，而隐私通知写明部分上游「may use content for training unless you have explicitly opted out where such an option is offered by that AI model provider」。任一跳明确为否则全链为否，故本档记 mark=no。对象=输入输出正文；语境=仅使用 Cline 提供的 API key 时（BYOK 时 Cline 不收集内容）；退出开关由上游决定、只在提供该选项的模型上存在，Cline 侧没有统一退出路径，因此不写 mode。
points.quote: Some AI model providers may use content for training unless you have explicitly opted out where such an option is offered by that AI model provider.

points.text: Secondary basis: Cline also uses the personal data it collects, which on this tier includes User Content, to administer, improve and personalize its own products and services. Service or product improvement counts as training under our judgment rules.
points.text_zh: 辅助依据：Cline 对自行收集的个人数据（本档包含 User Content）写明用于「Administer, improve, and personalize our products and services」。按判定口径「用来改进服务/提高质量算训练」，这也是训练维度的反向依据；主依据仍是上游跳那句。
points.quote: Administer, improve, and personalize our products and services, including by recognizing you and remembering your information when you return to our products and services;

points.text: Object = input and output content; context = only when using API keys provided by Cline (BYOK does not apply, Cline does not collect it); period type = undisclosed, as the notice sets no quantified period and no deletion point for request content. This anchor only shows that the tier does collect the content; it is not evidence of a period.
points.text_zh: 对象=输入输出正文；语境=仅使用 Cline 提供的 API key 时（BYOK 时 Cline 不收集，不适用）；期限类型=未披露——通知对正文既没有量化期限也没有删除承诺。本锚点只证明该档位确实收集正文，不含期限或删除时点，不能当作期限证据。
points.quote: However, if you use API keys provided by Cline rather than your own, we collect this information in order to facilitate your requests to third-party AI model providers on your behalf.

points.text: The only quantified period in the notice is the cookie consent preference of 12 months; its object is cookie preferences, not request content, so it is not evidence of a content retention period.
points.text_zh: 通知里唯一的量化期限是 cookie 同意偏好 12 个月，对象是 cookie 偏好而非输入输出正文，不构成正文保留期限的依据。
points.quote: Your consent preferences are stored for 12 months, after which you will be asked to renew your consent choices.

points.text: No role is designated in the public text: the notice states that it is not a contract and does not create any legal rights or obligations not otherwise provided by law, and controller or processor appears nowhere in the snapshot.
points.text_zh: 公开文本未指定角色：通知明写自身「is not a contract and does not create any legal rights or obligations not otherwise provided by law」，快照全文没有 controller / processor 的角色指定。
points.quote: This Privacy Notice is not a contract and does not create any legal rights or obligations not otherwise provided by law.

points.text: Controller posture is only an inference from the structure of the notice: Cline decides purposes for the personal data it collects, including administering, improving and personalizing its own products and services. That is not a designated role, and an enterprise DPA has to be obtained separately.
points.text_zh: 独立控制者姿态只是从通知结构推断：Cline 为自身目的（管理、改进与个性化自家产品与服务）决定所收集个人数据的处理方式，不是原文的角色指定；企业 DPA 需另行索取。
points.quote: Administer, improve, and personalize our products and services, including by recognizing you and remembering your information when you return to our products and services;

points.text: The no-training result comes from the deployment shape, not from a hosted commitment: your code never leaves your environment, Cline processes everything locally, with no uploads, no indexing and no training on your data.
points.text_zh: 不训练来自部署形态而非托管承诺：官方架构页写明「Your code never leaves your environment. Cline processes everything locally - no uploads, no indexing, no training on your data.」，即内容不出客户环境，Cline 拿不到内容做训练。
points.quote: Your code never leaves your environment. Cline processes everything locally - no uploads, no indexing, no training on your data.

points.text: The Security by Design card on the same page restates it: no model training, your code and prompts are not used for training.
points.text_zh: 同一页 Security by Design 卡片复述：「No model training：Your code and prompts aren't used for training」。
points.quote: Your code and prompts aren't used for training

points.text_zh: 上游跳：推理走客户自有的云合同与议定价格，内容是否被训练取决于客户所选 provider 的条款，Cline 对此不作承诺。
points.quote: Use your existing cloud contracts and negotiated rates.

points.text: Zero retention of content on this tier is architectural (code and context never leave the customer's environment), not a vendor ZDR commitment.
points.text_zh: 本档内容零保留是架构性的（代码与上下文不出客户环境），不是厂商的 ZDR 承诺。
points.quote: Your code never leaves your environment. Cline processes everything locally - no uploads, no indexing, no training on your data.

retention.quote: Your code never leaves your environment. Cline processes everything locally - no uploads, no indexing, no training on your data.

points.text: Object = code, prompts and context: they never leave the customer's environment, so no Cline-side retention period applies.
points.text_zh: 对象=代码、prompt 与上下文：不出客户环境，Cline 侧保留期不适用。
points.quote: Your code never leaves your environment. Cline processes everything locally - no uploads, no indexing, no training on your data.

points.text: Object = conversation history when the enterprise Prompt Storage feature is enabled: backed up to AWS S3 or Cloudflare R2, with ownership and period not stated in the snapshot, so no period can be given for this tier.

points.text_zh: 处理地=客户自建环境：官方页写的是客户端执行、直连客户自己的 provider，未给自家的区域清单，故记「可选地域」。
points.quote: Use your existing cloud contracts and negotiated rates.

points.text: Neither the enterprise page nor the privacy notice designates Cline as controller or processor for this tier; the notice states it is not a contract, and on this tier Cline is not in the content path at all, so the role has to be settled in the customer's own agreement with Cline.
points.text_zh: 企业页与隐私通知都没有指定本档的 controller / processor 角色；通知明示自身不是合同，而本档 Cline 不在内容链路上，角色只能在客户与 Cline 的合同里确认。
points.quote: This Privacy Notice is not a contract and does not create any legal rights or obligations not otherwise provided by law.

training.quote: Unless otherwise agreed, Cloudflare does not use any Customer Content to train generative AI tools.

points.text: Boundary clause — Feedback is licensed separately from Customer Data. Self-Serve §9: "You hereby grant Cloudflare a non-exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide, transferable, irrevocable, sublicensable, and perpetual license to use or incorporate into the Services any suggestions, enhancement requests, recommendations, corrections, or other feedback (“Feedback”) you provide to Cloudflare relating to the Services." Feedback is something the customer chooses to send and is not part of Customer Data (ESA §1.7: Customer Data = Customer Account Information + Customer Content + Customer Logs), so it does not change mark=yes. Nor may it be turned into a mark=no: the clause concerns the customer's own suggestions, not the use of Customer Content to train models.
points.text_zh: 边界条款——Feedback 与 Customer Data 分开授权。Self-Serve §9：「You hereby grant Cloudflare a non-exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide, transferable, irrevocable, sublicensable, and perpetual license to use or incorporate into the Services any suggestions, enhancement requests, recommendations, corrections, or other feedback (“Feedback”) you provide to Cloudflare relating to the Services.」Feedback 由客户主动提交、不属 Customer Data（ESA §1.7：Customer Data = Customer Account Information + Customer Content + Customer Logs），故不影响 mark=yes；也不得据此判 mark=no——该条讲的是客户自己的建议，不是把 Customer Content 用于训练模型。
points.quote: non-exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide, transferable, irrevocable, sublicensable, and perpetual license to use or incorporate into the Services any suggestions, enhancement requests, recommendations, corrections, or other feedback

points.text: Contract level (strongest): the "Cloudflare Workers AI; AI Gateway" subsection of the Developer Platform Service-Specific Terms says "Unless otherwise agreed, Cloudflare does not use any Customer Content to train generative AI tools." — a consent-gated statement (it can be agreed otherwise), not an absolute prohibition. The docs point the same way in different words: "would not do so unless we received your explicit consent" (explicit consent required, and covering (2) improve any Cloudflare or third-party services as well)
points.text_zh: 合同层（最强）：Developer Platform Service-Specific Terms 的「Cloudflare Workers AI; AI Gateway」小节写「Unless otherwise agreed, Cloudflare does not use any Customer Content to train generative AI tools.」——同意门控式表述（可另行约定），不是绝对禁止。docs 侧同旨但措辞不同：「would not do so unless we received your explicit consent」（需明示同意，且同时覆盖 (2) improve any Cloudflare or third-party services）

points.text: The Trust Hub puts it as "without customer consent". Clauses in tension are recorded alongside and not reconciled: (a) the same subsection's "Cloudflare does not reference or use any Customer Content except as needed to provide and improve the Services" — "improve the Services" is literally inconsistent with the docs' "not used to improve any Cloudflare or third-party services"
points.text_zh: Trust Hub 用「without customer consent」。反向张力条款并列记录（不调和）：(a) 同一小节的「Cloudflare does not reference or use any Customer Content except as needed to provide and improve the Services」——「improve the Services」与 docs 的「不用于改进 Cloudflare 或第三方服务」在字面上不一致

points.text: (b) Self-Serve §2.5.5 and ESA §5.4 allow Network Data (data derived from server, network and traffic data, not customer content) to be used for "developing and improving its Services", while ESA §5.3 states that no rights in Customer Data are transferred
points.text_zh: (b) Self-Serve §2.5.5 与 ESA §5.4 允许把 Network Data（由服务端/网络/流量数据衍生的数据，非客户内容）用于 developing and improving its Services，ESA §5.3 同时声明 Customer Data 的权利不发生转移

points.text: (c) DPA §3.3 commits, for Personal Data within CCPA scope, not to retain, use or disclose it for purposes other than those set out in the DPA and the Main Agreement. Circumstantial support: the responsible-ai page says "we do not use our customers' content to train any LLMs" and "Cloudflare neither trains its own LLMs nor provides its customers with access to GPUs for training their own models". Note also that the docs count "training data" as Customer Content, so training data uploaded by customers is protected by the same clause.
points.text_zh: (c) DPA §3.3 对 CCPA 范围内的 Personal Data 承诺不为 DPA 与主协议之外的目的 retain/use/disclose。旁证：responsible-ai 页「we do not use our customers' content to train any LLMs」「Cloudflare neither trains its own LLMs nor provides its customers with access to GPUs for training their own models」。另注：docs 把「训练数据（training data）」也列为 Customer Content，故客户上传的训练数据同样受该条保护。

points.text: The vendor discloses no zero-retention / ZDR option, switch or application method for Workers AI hosted inference — this is "undisclosed", not "a commitment to the contrary", and must not be read in reverse as not being offered. Scope checked: every page enumerated in the Workers AI documentation site's llms.txt (overview, data-usage, models, limits, pricing, glossary, event-subscriptions, changelog, errors, configuration/*, features/* including prompt-caching, batch-api, fine-tunes, function-calling, json-mode, markdown-conversion, prompting and reject-if-busy, and guides/*, 25 pages in all) was checked page by page, with no ZDR / zero data retention wording found
points.text_zh: 官方未披露 Workers AI 托管推理的零保留 / ZDR 选项、开关或申请方式——这是「未披露」，不是「承诺相反」，不得反向解读为不提供。已核范围：Workers AI 文档站 llms.txt 枚举的全部页面（overview、data-usage、models、limits、pricing、glossary、event-subscriptions、changelog、errors、configuration/*、features/*（含 prompt-caching、batch-api、fine-tunes、function-calling、json-mode、markdown-conversion、prompting、reject-if-busy）、guides/*，共 25 页）逐页核过，无 ZDR / zero data retention / 零保留字样

points.text: Of the 226 entries in the unified model catalog, all 90 carrying a "Zero data retention" tag are Third-party (external providers reached through AI Gateway), and not one of the 65 Cloudflare-hosted entries (the Workers AI catalog) carries the tag. Cross-entry dependency (important): AI Gateway does have a ZDR switch, but the documentation states plainly that it "only applies to Unified Billing requests that use Cloudflare-managed credentials" and that "ZDR is currently supported for: OpenAI / Anthropic" — so routing Workers AI requests through AI Gateway (unified billing) still does not obtain ZDR; that switch works only for OpenAI's and Anthropic's third-party models
points.text_zh: 统一模型目录 226 条里带「Zero data retention」标签的 90 条全部是 Third-party（经 AI Gateway 接入的外部 provider），65 条 Cloudflare-hosted（即 Workers AI 目录）无一带该标签。跨条目依赖（重要）：AI Gateway 确有 ZDR 开关，但文档明文「only applies to Unified Billing requests that use Cloudflare-managed credentials」且「ZDR is currently supported for: OpenAI / Anthropic」——即把 Workers AI 请求接到 AI Gateway（unified billing）也拿不到 ZDR，该开关只对 OpenAI/Anthropic 的第三方模型成立

points.text: Also "ZDR does not control AI Gateway logging": logging has to be switched off separately. Observations pointing the other way (not equivalent to a ZDR commitment): data-usage's "may be stored ... if you specifically use a storage service" and the prompt caching description of cached input tensors indicate that the default inference path does not write content to disk, but those are descriptions of conditions and uses.
points.text_zh: 另「ZDR does not control AI Gateway logging」，日志要单独关。反向观察（不等于 ZDR 承诺）：data-usage 的「may be stored ... if you specifically use a storage service」与 prompt caching 的输入张量缓存说明，说明默认推理路径不落盘正文，但那是条件/用途描述。

points.text: The catalog entry previously bound here is a third-party model's tag ("Alibaba's HappyHorse 1.0 … - Third-party - Zero data retention"), i.e. it describes another provider's posture, not Workers AI's, so it is not a statement on this dimension and is no longer bound to this entry. It stays as contrast material in the point above.
points.text_zh: 原先绑在本条的引文是统一目录里某个第三方模型的标签（「… - Third-party - Zero data retention」），说的是别的 provider 的立场，不构成对 Workers AI 本维度的表述，故不再绑在本条；它作为对照材料仍保留在上一条里。

points.text: Content-isolation fact recorded as circumstantial evidence, not as a ZDR statement and not as this dimension's basis (it says nothing about whether content is retained, for how long, or about a zero-retention option): "Cloudflare does not make your Customer Content available to any other Cloudflare customer." Non-disclosure of a ZDR option for Workers AI hosted inference therefore stands as recorded above, and this dimension stays undisclosed.
points.text_zh: 内容隔离层的事实，作为旁证记录，不构成 ZDR 表述、也不作为本维度的判定依据（它没有说明内容是否保留、保留多久，也没有说明零保留选项）：「Cloudflare does not make your Customer Content available to any other Cloudflare customer.」Workers AI 托管推理的 ZDR 选项仍属未披露，本维度维持未披露。
points.quote: Cloudflare does not make your Customer Content available to any other Cloudflare customer.

retention.quote: Until the earliest of (i) expiry/termination of the Main Agreement, or (ii) the date upon which processing is no longer necessary for the purposes of either party performing its obligations under the Main Agreement

points.text: Conclusion: there is no request-level (input/output) retention commitment and the vendor gives no uniform period, hence duration_kind=unspecified. Recorded item by item (with object and context): (1) docs: Customer Content "may be stored by Cloudflare if you specifically use a storage service (e.g., R2, KV, DO, Vectorize)" — the condition is that the customer uses a storage service, not a retention period on the inference path
points.text_zh: 结论：不存在请求级（输入/输出）保留期承诺，官方也未给出统一期限，故 duration_kind=unspecified。逐条并列（含对象与语境）：(1) docs：Customer Content「may be stored by Cloudflare if you specifically use a storage service (e.g., R2, KV, DO, Vectorize)」——条件是客户自己用存储服务，不是推理路径的保留期

points.text: (2) Prompt caching: on by default for some models, storing the input tensors computed in the prefill stage, with no duration or eviction rule disclosed (object = a derived cache of the input tensors)
points.text_zh: (2) Prompt caching：默认对部分模型开启，会存储 prefill 阶段计算的输入张量，未披露时长或清除规则（对象=输入张量的派生缓存）

points.text: (3) The retention-period field of DPA Annex 1: "Until the earliest of (i) expiry/termination of the Main Agreement, or (ii) the date upon which processing is no longer necessary..." (object = Personal Data, context = within the DPA's scope)
points.text_zh: (3) DPA Annex 1 的保留期栏：「Until the earliest of (i) expiry/termination of the Main Agreement, or (ii) the date upon which processing is no longer necessary...」（对象=Personal Data，语境=DPA 适用范围内）

points.text: DPA §3.1(i): deletion or return at the customer's choice after termination
points.text_zh: DPA §3.1(i) 终止后按客户选择删除或返还

points.text: (4) ESA §5.2: except for content "Cloudflare has agreed to store on behalf of Customer", Cloudflare "may delete Customer Data at any time after seventy-two (72) hours from the time such Customer Data is captured by Cloudflare" — that is a right to delete (floor-type wording) and "must be deleted after 72 hours" cannot be inferred from it
points.text_zh: (4) ESA §5.2：除「Cloudflare has agreed to store on behalf of Customer」的内容外，Cloudflare 可在 Customer Data 被捕获 72 小时后随时删除——这是删除权利（下限式表述），不能反推「72 小时后必删」

points.text: (5) ESA §11.5: for up to 72 hours after termination Cloudflare will still use reasonable efforts to make Customer Logs available
points.text_zh: (5) ESA §11.5：终止后最多 72 小时内仍尽力提供 Customer Logs

points.text: ESA §6.2: account information and audit logs may be retained as business and compliance needs require
points.text_zh: ESA §6.2：账户信息与审计日志可按业务与合规需要 retain

points.text: (6) EU Data Act Addendum (EU customers) §10.1: after termination the Customer's Data is kept for 30 calendar days for retrieval or erasure, and §10.2: Exportable Data is erased once that period ends
points.text_zh: (6) EU Data Act Addendum（欧盟客户）§10.1 终止后保留 Customer's Data 30 个日历日供取回或擦除、§10.2 期满擦除 Exportable Data

points.text: (7) Service-Specific Terms → Cloudflare Developer Platform §9 — object = content uploaded to the Developer Platform, context = after expiry or termination of the trial or subscription, type = upper bound on a retrieval window, with no retention obligation: "Subject to Section 8 above, you may be permitted to access the Customer Content you uploaded to the Developer Platform for up to thirty (30) days following the expiration or termination of your trial or subscription. You understand that Cloudflare has no obligation to retain the Customer Content you upload to the Developer Platform following the expiration or termination of your trial or subscription." Scope matters for procurement: the clause sits in the Developer Platform subsection whose product list (Cloudflare Workers; Cloudflare Pages; Workers KV; D1; Durable Objects; Vectorize; Hyperdrive; Cloudflare Queues; R2; Containers; and Workers for Platforms) does not include Workers AI, so it is a retrieval window for product content uploaded to the Developer Platform, not a retention or deletion period for Workers AI request content. It is a different clause from the other "30 days" in EU Data Act Addendum §10.1 (EU customers only, object = Customer's Data).
points.text_zh: (7) Service-Specific Terms → Cloudflare Developer Platform §9——对象=上传到 Developer Platform 的内容，语境=试用或订阅到期/终止后，期限类型=取回窗口上限，且厂商声明无保留义务：「Subject to Section 8 above, you may be permitted to access the Customer Content you uploaded to the Developer Platform for up to thirty (30) days following the expiration or termination of your trial or subscription. You understand that Cloudflare has no obligation to retain the Customer Content you upload to the Developer Platform following the expiration or termination of your trial or subscription.」适用范围对采购很重要：该条位于 Developer Platform 小节，其产品清单（Cloudflare Workers; Cloudflare Pages; Workers KV; D1; Durable Objects; Vectorize; Hyperdrive; Cloudflare Queues; R2; Containers; and Workers for Platforms）不含 Workers AI，故它是上传到 Developer Platform 的产品内容的取回窗口，不是 Workers AI 请求内容的保留或删除期限。它与 EU Data Act Addendum §10.1 的另一处「30 天」（仅欧盟客户，对象=Customer's Data）是两条不同适用范围的条款。
points.quote: you may be permitted to access the Customer Content you uploaded to the Developer Platform for up to thirty (30) days following the expiration or termination of your trial or subscription

points.text: The addendum limits Workers AI's Exportable Data to "LoRA adapters uploaded by Customers" plus the available audit logs (inference inputs and outputs are not included)
points.text_zh: 附录把 Workers AI 的 Exportable Data 限定为「LoRA adapters uploaded by Customers」+ 可用审计日志（未含推理输入输出）

points.text: Footnote [2]: "By default, Cloudflare stores any end user activity logs for seven days", together with the statement that it "does not store ... for every product" — the object is end-user activity logs, not request content
points.text_zh: 脚注 [2]「By default, Cloudflare stores any end user activity logs for seven days」，并声明「does not store ... for every product」——对象是终端用户活动日志，非请求正文

points.text: (8) Object = network traffic and related logs, nature = a right for Cloudflare to monitor and inspect, with no time limit, context = as necessary to perform the Services or to protect the security or integrity of the network (Self-Serve §2.5.5; the enterprise tier's ESA §5.4 says the same): "Cloudflare may monitor and inspect the traffic on the Cloudflare network, including any related logs, as necessary to perform the Services or protect the security or integrity of Cloudflare's network." This shows that log-type data exists and is reachable by Cloudflare, but it is an inspection right rather than a retention period, and it gives no period for input and output content (duration_kind stays unspecified).
points.text_zh: (8) 对象=网络流量与相关日志，性质=Cloudflare 的监控/检查权（无期限），语境=为提供服务或保护网络安全所必需（Self-Serve §2.5.5，企业档 ESA §5.4 同旨）：「Cloudflare may monitor and inspect the traffic on the Cloudflare network, including any related logs, as necessary to perform the Services or protect the security or integrity of Cloudflare's network.」它说明日志类数据存在且 Cloudflare 可及，但这是检查权、不是保留期限，也不给出输入输出正文的期限（duration_kind 维持 unspecified）。
points.quote: Cloudflare may monitor and inspect the traffic on the Cloudflare network, including any related logs, as necessary to perform the Services

points.text: (9) Privacy policy §11 gives only retention criteria (consumer_privacy, not authoritative for this tier). What can therefore be said about retention is: request content is not persisted by default (it is stored only where a storage product is used); log-type data has a 7-day default (not applying to every product); and there are two distinct 30-day retrieval windows — one for content uploaded to the Developer Platform (whose product list excludes Workers AI) and one for EU Data Act customers (Customer's Data). Clauses are split by object and context, and none of them gives a general number of days for input and output content.
points.text_zh: (9) 隐私政策 §11 只给保留标准（consumer_privacy，非本档权威）。因此 retention 的可用表述是：默认不持久存储请求正文（仅在使用存储类产品时才会存储）；日志类数据有 7 天默认（不适用于每个产品）；另有两个适用范围不同的 30 日取回窗口——上传到 Developer Platform 的内容（其产品清单不含 Workers AI）与欧盟 Data Act 客户的 Customer's Data。条款分对象、分语境，没有任何一条给出输入输出正文的通用保留天数。

points.text: The vendor discloses no processing location for Workers AI inference, and there is no switch for choosing an inference region. Four kinds of circumstantial evidence were checked and judged one by one, none of them sufficient to support a conclusion: (1) the documentation and product pages say only that it runs on "Cloudflare's global network", and the product page adds "No cold starts or region complexity"
points.text_zh: 官方未披露 Workers AI 推理的处理地，也没有按区域选择推理位置的开关。查过并逐条判定后仍不足以支撑结论的四类旁证：(1) 文档与产品页只说跑在「Cloudflare's global network」，产品页还写「No cold starts or region complexity」

points.text: (2) Privacy policy §7 "We primarily store your information in the United States and the European Economic Area" — consumer_privacy level, its object being information Cloudflare collects itself, and under the task rules it cannot serve as primary evidence for Workers AI
points.text_zh: (2) 隐私政策 §7「We primarily store your information in the United States and the European Economic Area」——consumer_privacy 层、对象是 Cloudflare 自行收集的个人信息，按任务要求不能当 Workers AI 的主证据

points.text: (3) DPA §6/§7 only lay down lawful cross-border transfer mechanisms (EU SCCs / UK Addendum / EU-U.S. DPF / Global CBPR-PRP) and designate no processing location, their implicit premise being that Personal Data may be transferred to the United States and other countries where Cloudflare operates
points.text_zh: (3) DPA §6/§7 只规定跨境转移的合法机制（EU SCCs / UK Addendum / EU-U.S. DPF / Global CBPR-PRP），不指定处理地，其隐含前提是 Personal Data 可能被转移到美国等 Cloudflare 有运营的国家

points.text: (4) The Data Localization Suite / Regional Services are paid enterprise add-ons that control where keys are stored, the boundary for traffic metadata and logs, and where HTTPS decryption is performed
points.text_zh: (4) Data Localization Suite / Regional Services 是企业付费附加项，控制密钥存储地、流量元数据/日志边界与 HTTPS 解密处理地

points.text: The Regional Services list of in-region services includes "Running Cloudflare Workers scripts" but does not list Workers AI inference (the list is worded "among others", so it cannot be concluded from this that DLS does not cover AI inference). Also: services in China are operated by JD Cloud (SST Other Terms), which has nothing to do with Workers AI. Recorded as not_found under the rules: the absence of public evidence is not the absence of a vendor commitment.
points.text_zh: Regional Services 的区域内服务清单列出「Running Cloudflare Workers scripts」，但未列 Workers AI 推理（清单措辞为 among others，不能据此断定 DLS 不覆盖 AI 推理）。另：中国区服务由 JD Cloud 运营（SST Other Terms），与 Workers AI 无关。结论按规则记 not_found：拿不到公开证据 ≠ 厂商没有处理地承诺。

points.text: The DLS clauses previously bound here ("Enterprise-only paid add-on" / "…enable customers to choose the location where Cloudflare inspects and stores data") state a purchasable location-control product but do not say that Workers AI inference is covered by it, so they are not statements about this tier's processing location and are no longer bound. They remain as circumstantial evidence in item (4) above.
points.text_zh: 原先绑在本条的两句 DLS 引文（「Enterprise-only paid add-on」／「…enable customers to choose the location where Cloudflare inspects and stores data」）只说明有一个可购买的定位控制产品，未说明覆盖 Workers AI 推理，不构成对本档处理地的表述，故不再绑在本条；它们作为旁证仍保留在上面第 (4) 条里。

points.text: Checked and judged insufficient to support a conclusion: EU Data Act Addendum §7.2 discloses only "The following URL identifies the locations of Cloudflare's infrastructure: cloudflare.com/network." — an infrastructure-location pointer (network map), not a disclosure of where a given service's data is processed; and the addendum itself applies only to customers who live or are headquartered in the EU with EU billing addresses, and only to agreements formed or orders placed on or after September 12, 2025.
points.text_zh: 查过并判定不足以支撑结论：EU Data Act Addendum §7.2 只披露「The following URL identifies the locations of Cloudflare's infrastructure: cloudflare.com/network.」——这是基础设施位置指引（网络地图），不是某服务数据在哪处理的披露；且该附录只适用于居住地或总部在欧盟、账单地址在欧盟的客户，也只适用于 2025 年 9 月 12 日及之后成立或下单的协议。
points.quote: The following URL identifies the locations of Cloudflare’s infrastructure: cloudflare.com/network.

role.quote: the Customer is the Controller (or a Processor processing Personal Data on behalf of a third-party Controller), and Cloudflare is a Processor (or sub-Processor, as applicable).

points.text: The contract makes Cloudflare the processor. DPA §2.3: "the Customer is the Controller (or a Processor processing Personal Data on behalf of a third-party Controller), and Cloudflare is a Processor (or sub-Processor, as applicable)"
points.text_zh: 合同层明确为受托处理方（processor）。DPA §2.3：「the Customer is the Controller (or a Processor processing Personal Data on behalf of a third-party Controller), and Cloudflare is a Processor (or sub-Processor, as applicable)」

points.text: The DPA opens by limiting itself to cases "where Cloudflare processes Personal Data as a Processor ... on behalf of Customer to provide the Services", and the definition of Services in §1.1(o) includes "any software, software development kits and application programming interfaces (APIs)", which covers Workers AI. Self-Serve §6.1 and ESA §5.3 say the same (the latter: "To the extent that Cloudflare processes Customer Data ... that includes Personal Data, Cloudflare will handle such Personal Data in compliance with the DPA"). The privacy policy reinforces it: Cloudflare designates itself data controller only for information it collects itself, and immediately afterwards designates itself data processor for "content provided by Customers and End Users through the Services that transits, or in some cases, is stored on, the Cloudflare network". Two layers of exception are recorded alongside: (a) the Service-Specific Terms classify "machine learning models made available by Cloudflare" as Third-Party Products, so the licence and use terms run between the customer and the model licensor, with Cloudflare neither controlling nor indemnifying
points.text_zh: DPA 开篇限定其适用于「where Cloudflare processes Personal Data as a Processor ... on behalf of Customer to provide the Services」，而 §1.1(o) 的 Services 定义含「any software, software development kits and application programming interfaces (APIs)」，覆盖 Workers AI。Self-Serve §6.1 与 ESA §5.3 同旨（后者：To the extent that Cloudflare processes Customer Data ... that includes Personal Data, Cloudflare will handle such Personal Data in compliance with the DPA）。隐私政策补强：Cloudflare 只对自行收集的信息自认 data controller，紧接着自认对「content provided by Customers and End Users through the Services that transits, or in some cases, is stored on, the Cloudflare network」为 data processor。同时并列记录两层例外：(a) Service-Specific Terms 把「machine learning models made available by Cloudflare」定性为 Third-Party Products，许可与使用条款发生在客户与模型许可方之间，Cloudflare 不控制、不赔偿

points.text: (b) The same page states plainly that for third-party products running on third-party infrastructure through AI Gateway "the Cloudflare Data Processing Addendum and Information Security Exhibit do not apply", and that this is treated as the customer instructing Cloudflare to send Customer Data to them — that third-party model hop is not covered by the DPA (it belongs to the cloudflare-ai-gateway entry). For the Workers AI hosted models (65 of them, including those marked Partner) no clause about handing data to the model's originator was found, so this tier is recorded as processor
points.text_zh: (b) 同一页明文：AI Gateway 上跑在第三方基础设施的第三方产品，「the Cloudflare Data Processing Addendum and Information Security Exhibit do not apply」，且视为客户指示 Cloudflare 向其发送 Customer Data——第三方模型那一跳不受 DPA 保护（属 cloudflare-ai-gateway 条目范围）。对 Workers AI 托管模型（65 个，含标 Partner 者）未发现「数据转交模型原厂」的条款，故本档判 processor

points.text: "Models are Third-Party Products" affects licensing and the allocation of liability; it does not change Cloudflare's position as data processor.
points.text_zh: 「models 是 Third-Party Products」影响的是许可与责任划分，不改变 Cloudflare 作为数据处理受托方的地位。

training.quote: Unless otherwise agreed, Cloudflare does not use any Customer Content to train generative AI tools.

points.text: Boundary clause — Feedback is licensed separately from Customer Data. ESA §6.3: "If Customer chooses to provide feedback, suggestions, or recommendations for improvement to the Services (“Feedback”), Cloudflare may use Feedback without restrictions and without obligations to Customer." Feedback is something the customer chooses to send and is not part of Customer Data (§1.7: Customer Data = Customer Account Information + Customer Content + Customer Logs), so it does not change mark=yes. Nor may it be turned into a mark=no: the clause concerns the customer's own suggestions, not the use of Customer Content to train models.
points.text_zh: 边界条款——Feedback 与 Customer Data 分开授权。ESA §6.3：「If Customer chooses to provide feedback, suggestions, or recommendations for improvement to the Services (“Feedback”), Cloudflare may use Feedback without restrictions and without obligations to Customer.」Feedback 由客户主动提交、不属 Customer Data（§1.7：Customer Data = Customer Account Information + Customer Content + Customer Logs），故不影响 mark=yes；也不得据此判 mark=no——该条讲的是客户自己的建议，不是把 Customer Content 用于训练模型。
points.quote: Cloudflare may use Feedback without restrictions and without obligations to Customer.

points.text: Contract level (strongest): the "Cloudflare Workers AI; AI Gateway" subsection of the Developer Platform Service-Specific Terms says "Unless otherwise agreed, Cloudflare does not use any Customer Content to train generative AI tools." — a consent-gated statement (it can be agreed otherwise), not an absolute prohibition. The docs point the same way in different words: "would not do so unless we received your explicit consent" (explicit consent required, and covering (2) improve any Cloudflare or third-party services as well)
points.text_zh: 合同层（最强）：Developer Platform Service-Specific Terms 的「Cloudflare Workers AI; AI Gateway」小节写「Unless otherwise agreed, Cloudflare does not use any Customer Content to train generative AI tools.」——同意门控式表述（可另行约定），不是绝对禁止。docs 侧同旨但措辞不同：「would not do so unless we received your explicit consent」（需明示同意，且同时覆盖 (2) improve any Cloudflare or third-party services）

points.text: The Trust Hub puts it as "without customer consent". Clauses in tension are recorded alongside and not reconciled: (a) the same subsection's "Cloudflare does not reference or use any Customer Content except as needed to provide and improve the Services" — "improve the Services" is literally inconsistent with the docs' "not used to improve any Cloudflare or third-party services"
points.text_zh: Trust Hub 用「without customer consent」。反向张力条款并列记录（不调和）：(a) 同一小节的「Cloudflare does not reference or use any Customer Content except as needed to provide and improve the Services」——「improve the Services」与 docs 的「不用于改进 Cloudflare 或第三方服务」在字面上不一致

points.text: (b) Self-Serve §2.5.5 and ESA §5.4 allow Network Data (data derived from server, network and traffic data, not customer content) to be used for "developing and improving its Services", while ESA §5.3 states that no rights in Customer Data are transferred
points.text_zh: (b) Self-Serve §2.5.5 与 ESA §5.4 允许把 Network Data（由服务端/网络/流量数据衍生的数据，非客户内容）用于 developing and improving its Services，ESA §5.3 同时声明 Customer Data 的权利不发生转移

points.text: (c) DPA §3.3 commits, for Personal Data within CCPA scope, not to retain, use or disclose it for purposes other than those set out in the DPA and the Main Agreement. Circumstantial support: the responsible-ai page says "we do not use our customers' content to train any LLMs" and "Cloudflare neither trains its own LLMs nor provides its customers with access to GPUs for training their own models". Note also that the docs count "training data" as Customer Content, so training data uploaded by customers is protected by the same clause.
points.text_zh: (c) DPA §3.3 对 CCPA 范围内的 Personal Data 承诺不为 DPA 与主协议之外的目的 retain/use/disclose。旁证：responsible-ai 页「we do not use our customers' content to train any LLMs」「Cloudflare neither trains its own LLMs nor provides its customers with access to GPUs for training their own models」。另注：docs 把「训练数据（training data）」也列为 Customer Content，故客户上传的训练数据同样受该条保护。

points.text: The vendor discloses no zero-retention / ZDR option, switch or application method for Workers AI hosted inference — this is "undisclosed", not "a commitment to the contrary", and must not be read in reverse as not being offered. Scope checked: every page enumerated in the Workers AI documentation site's llms.txt (overview, data-usage, models, limits, pricing, glossary, event-subscriptions, changelog, errors, configuration/*, features/* including prompt-caching, batch-api, fine-tunes, function-calling, json-mode, markdown-conversion, prompting and reject-if-busy, and guides/*, 25 pages in all) was checked page by page, with no ZDR / zero data retention wording found
points.text_zh: 官方未披露 Workers AI 托管推理的零保留 / ZDR 选项、开关或申请方式——这是「未披露」，不是「承诺相反」，不得反向解读为不提供。已核范围：Workers AI 文档站 llms.txt 枚举的全部页面（overview、data-usage、models、limits、pricing、glossary、event-subscriptions、changelog、errors、configuration/*、features/*（含 prompt-caching、batch-api、fine-tunes、function-calling、json-mode、markdown-conversion、prompting、reject-if-busy）、guides/*，共 25 页）逐页核过，无 ZDR / zero data retention / 零保留字样

points.text: Of the 226 entries in the unified model catalog, all 90 carrying a "Zero data retention" tag are Third-party (external providers reached through AI Gateway), and not one of the 65 Cloudflare-hosted entries (the Workers AI catalog) carries the tag. Cross-entry dependency (important): AI Gateway does have a ZDR switch, but the documentation states plainly that it "only applies to Unified Billing requests that use Cloudflare-managed credentials" and that "ZDR is currently supported for: OpenAI / Anthropic" — so routing Workers AI requests through AI Gateway (unified billing) still does not obtain ZDR; that switch works only for OpenAI's and Anthropic's third-party models
points.text_zh: 统一模型目录 226 条里带「Zero data retention」标签的 90 条全部是 Third-party（经 AI Gateway 接入的外部 provider），65 条 Cloudflare-hosted（即 Workers AI 目录）无一带该标签。跨条目依赖（重要）：AI Gateway 确有 ZDR 开关，但文档明文「only applies to Unified Billing requests that use Cloudflare-managed credentials」且「ZDR is currently supported for: OpenAI / Anthropic」——即把 Workers AI 请求接到 AI Gateway（unified billing）也拿不到 ZDR，该开关只对 OpenAI/Anthropic 的第三方模型成立

points.text: Also "ZDR does not control AI Gateway logging": logging has to be switched off separately. Observations pointing the other way (not equivalent to a ZDR commitment): data-usage's "may be stored ... if you specifically use a storage service" and the prompt caching description of cached input tensors indicate that the default inference path does not write content to disk, but those are descriptions of conditions and uses.
points.text_zh: 另「ZDR does not control AI Gateway logging」，日志要单独关。反向观察（不等于 ZDR 承诺）：data-usage 的「may be stored ... if you specifically use a storage service」与 prompt caching 的输入张量缓存说明，说明默认推理路径不落盘正文，但那是条件/用途描述。

points.text: The catalog entry previously bound here is a third-party model's tag ("Alibaba's HappyHorse 1.0 … - Third-party - Zero data retention"), i.e. it describes another provider's posture, not Workers AI's, so it is not a statement on this dimension and is no longer bound to this entry. It stays as contrast material in the point above.
points.text_zh: 原先绑在本条的引文是统一目录里某个第三方模型的标签（「… - Third-party - Zero data retention」），说的是别的 provider 的立场，不构成对 Workers AI 本维度的表述，故不再绑在本条；它作为对照材料仍保留在上一条里。

points.text: Content-isolation fact recorded as circumstantial evidence, not as a ZDR statement and not as this dimension's basis (it says nothing about whether content is retained, for how long, or about a zero-retention option): "Cloudflare does not make your Customer Content available to any other Cloudflare customer." Non-disclosure of a ZDR option for Workers AI hosted inference therefore stands as recorded above, and this dimension stays undisclosed.
points.text_zh: 内容隔离层的事实，作为旁证记录，不构成 ZDR 表述、也不作为本维度的判定依据（它没有说明内容是否保留、保留多久，也没有说明零保留选项）：「Cloudflare does not make your Customer Content available to any other Cloudflare customer.」Workers AI 托管推理的 ZDR 选项仍属未披露，本维度维持未披露。
points.quote: Cloudflare does not make your Customer Content available to any other Cloudflare customer.

retention.summary: 按对象分列未公布期限
retention.quote: may delete Customer Data at any time after seventy-two (72) hours from the time such Customer Data is captured by Cloudflare

points.text: The clauses that differ between the enterprise tier (ESA) and the self-serve tier are all in the ESA: §5.2 "Except for Customer Account Information and Customer Content that Cloudflare has agreed to store on behalf of Customer as set forth in the Documentation, Customer is solely responsible for keeping and maintaining its own copies of Customer Data. Cloudflare is not obligated to Customer to maintain any copies thereof, and may delete Customer Data at any time after seventy-two (72) hours from the time such Customer Data is captured by Cloudflare" — apart from content it has agreed to store on the customer's behalf, Cloudflare promises no retention of Customer Data and gains a right to delete after 72 hours (a right to delete, from which "must be deleted after 72 hours" cannot be inferred)
points.text_zh: 企业档（ESA）与自服务档的差异条款都在 ESA 里：§5.2「Except for Customer Account Information and Customer Content that Cloudflare has agreed to store on behalf of Customer as set forth in the Documentation, Customer is solely responsible for keeping and maintaining its own copies of Customer Data. Cloudflare is not obligated to Customer to maintain any copies thereof, and may delete Customer Data at any time after seventy-two (72) hours from the time such Customer Data is captured by Cloudflare」——除另行约定代存的内容外，Cloudflare 不承诺保留 Customer Data，且 72 小时后取得删除权（是删除权利，不能反推「72 小时后必删」）

points.text: §11.5: for up to 72 hours after termination Cloudflare will still use reasonable efforts to make Customer Logs available
points.text_zh: §11.5 终止后最多 72 小时内仍尽力提供 Customer Logs

points.text: Residual-copy exception at the confidentiality layer (§11.4): on top of the duty to return or destroy Confidential Information upon termination, "the Receiving Party may retain any Confidential Information that cannot feasibly be returned or destroyed, and a copy of any Confidential Information required for compliance with its internal record keeping requirements or automatic archival activities", with Section 8 continuing to apply to such retained Confidential Information until it is deleted or returned. Object = Confidential Information (a mutual confidentiality clause; §5.2 ties customer data to Cloudflare's confidentiality obligations under Section 8), context = after expiry or termination. It gives no period for input and output content, so basis stays undisclosed.
points.text_zh: 保密层的残余副本例外（§11.4）：在终止后返还或销毁保密信息的义务之外，「the Receiving Party may retain any Confidential Information that cannot feasibly be returned or destroyed, and a copy of any Confidential Information required for compliance with its internal record keeping requirements or automatic archival activities」，第 8 节对此类留存副本持续适用至其被删除或返还。对象=Confidential Information（双方互负的保密条款；§5.2 把客户数据连到第 8 节的保密义务），语境=到期或终止后。它不给出输入输出正文的期限，basis 维持 undisclosed。
points.quote: the Receiving Party may retain any Confidential Information that cannot feasibly be returned or destroyed, and a copy of any Confidential Information required for compliance with its internal record keeping requirements or automatic archival activities

points.text: §6.2: account information and audit logs may be retained as business and compliance needs require
points.text_zh: §6.2 账户信息与审计日志可按业务与合规需要 retain

points.text: Object = network traffic and related logs, nature = a right for Cloudflare to monitor and inspect, with no time limit, context = as necessary to perform the Services and to derive and compile Network Data (§5.4; the self-serve tier's Self-Serve §2.5.5 says the same): "Cloudflare may monitor and inspect the traffic on the Cloudflare network, including any related logs as necessary to perform the Services and to derive and compile Network Data." This shows that log-type data exists and is reachable by Cloudflare, but it is an inspection right rather than a retention period, and it gives no period for input and output content (duration_kind stays unspecified).
points.text_zh: 对象=网络流量与相关日志，性质=Cloudflare 的监控/检查权（无期限），语境=为提供服务以及派生与汇编 Network Data 所必需（§5.4，自助档 Self-Serve §2.5.5 同旨）：「Cloudflare may monitor and inspect the traffic on the Cloudflare network, including any related logs as necessary to perform the Services and to derive and compile Network Data.」它说明日志类数据存在且 Cloudflare 可及，但这是检查权、不是保留期限，也不给出输入输出正文的期限（duration_kind 维持 unspecified）。
points.quote: Cloudflare may monitor and inspect the traffic on the Cloudflare network, including any related logs as necessary to perform the Services and to derive and compile Network Data.

points.text: §5.3 provides that no rights in Customer Data are transferred, and that where it contains Personal Data the same DPA applies (so the DPA Annex 1 retention wording is identical on both tiers). EU customers are additionally covered by EU Data Act Addendum §10.1/§10.2: after termination the Customer's Data is kept for 30 calendar days for retrieval or erasure, after which Exportable Data is erased
points.text_zh: §5.3 明定 Customer Data 的权利不发生转移，且含 Personal Data 时适用同一份 DPA（故 DPA Annex 1 的保留期表述两档一致）。欧盟客户另受 EU Data Act Addendum §10.1/§10.2 约束：终止后保留 Customer's Data 30 个日历日供取回或擦除，随后擦除 Exportable Data

points.text: Service-Specific Terms → Cloudflare Developer Platform §9 — object = content uploaded to the Developer Platform, context = after expiry or termination of the trial or subscription, type = upper bound on a retrieval window, with no retention obligation: "Subject to Section 8 above, you may be permitted to access the Customer Content you uploaded to the Developer Platform for up to thirty (30) days following the expiration or termination of your trial or subscription. You understand that Cloudflare has no obligation to retain the Customer Content you upload to the Developer Platform following the expiration or termination of your trial or subscription." Scope matters for procurement: the clause sits in the Developer Platform subsection whose product list (Cloudflare Workers; Cloudflare Pages; Workers KV; D1; Durable Objects; Vectorize; Hyperdrive; Cloudflare Queues; R2; Containers; and Workers for Platforms) does not include Workers AI, so it is a retrieval window for product content uploaded to the Developer Platform, not a retention or deletion period for Workers AI request content. It is a different clause from the other "30 days" in EU Data Act Addendum §10.1 above (EU customers only, object = Customer's Data).
points.text_zh: Service-Specific Terms → Cloudflare Developer Platform §9——对象=上传到 Developer Platform 的内容，语境=试用或订阅到期/终止后，期限类型=取回窗口上限，且厂商声明无保留义务：「Subject to Section 8 above, you may be permitted to access the Customer Content you uploaded to the Developer Platform for up to thirty (30) days following the expiration or termination of your trial or subscription. You understand that Cloudflare has no obligation to retain the Customer Content you upload to the Developer Platform following the expiration or termination of your trial or subscription.」适用范围对采购很重要：该条位于 Developer Platform 小节，其产品清单（Cloudflare Workers; Cloudflare Pages; Workers KV; D1; Durable Objects; Vectorize; Hyperdrive; Cloudflare Queues; R2; Containers; and Workers for Platforms）不含 Workers AI，故它是上传到 Developer Platform 的产品内容的取回窗口，不是 Workers AI 请求内容的保留或删除期限。它与上文 EU Data Act Addendum §10.1 的另一处「30 天」（仅欧盟客户，对象=Customer's Data）是两条不同适用范围的条款。
points.quote: you may be permitted to access the Customer Content you uploaded to the Developer Platform for up to thirty (30) days following the expiration or termination of your trial or subscription

points.text: That addendum limits Workers AI's Exportable Data to "LoRA adapters uploaded by Customers" plus the available audit logs, and footnote [2] separately gives a 7-day default for end-user activity logs. The conclusion matches the self-serve tier: not one clause gives a general number of days for input and output content (duration_kind=unspecified).
points.text_zh: 该附录把 Workers AI 的 Exportable Data 限定为「LoRA adapters uploaded by Customers」+ 可用审计日志，脚注 [2] 另给默认 7 天的终端用户活动日志。结论与自服务档一致：没有任何一条给出输入输出正文的通用保留天数（duration_kind=unspecified）。

points.text: The vendor discloses no processing location for Workers AI inference, and there is no switch for choosing an inference region. Four kinds of circumstantial evidence were checked and judged one by one, none of them sufficient to support a conclusion: (1) the documentation and product pages say only that it runs on "Cloudflare's global network", and the product page adds "No cold starts or region complexity"
points.text_zh: 官方未披露 Workers AI 推理的处理地，也没有按区域选择推理位置的开关。查过并逐条判定后仍不足以支撑结论的四类旁证：(1) 文档与产品页只说跑在「Cloudflare's global network」，产品页还写「No cold starts or region complexity」

points.text: (2) Privacy policy §7 "We primarily store your information in the United States and the European Economic Area" — consumer_privacy level, its object being information Cloudflare collects itself, and under the task rules it cannot serve as primary evidence for Workers AI
points.text_zh: (2) 隐私政策 §7「We primarily store your information in the United States and the European Economic Area」——consumer_privacy 层、对象是 Cloudflare 自行收集的个人信息，按任务要求不能当 Workers AI 的主证据

points.text: (3) DPA §6/§7 only lay down lawful cross-border transfer mechanisms (EU SCCs / UK Addendum / EU-U.S. DPF / Global CBPR-PRP) and designate no processing location, their implicit premise being that Personal Data may be transferred to the United States and other countries where Cloudflare operates
points.text_zh: (3) DPA §6/§7 只规定跨境转移的合法机制（EU SCCs / UK Addendum / EU-U.S. DPF / Global CBPR-PRP），不指定处理地，其隐含前提是 Personal Data 可能被转移到美国等 Cloudflare 有运营的国家

points.text: (4) The Data Localization Suite / Regional Services are paid enterprise add-ons that control where keys are stored, the boundary for traffic metadata and logs, and where HTTPS decryption is performed
points.text_zh: (4) Data Localization Suite / Regional Services 是企业付费附加项，控制密钥存储地、流量元数据/日志边界与 HTTPS 解密处理地

points.text: The Regional Services list of in-region services includes "Running Cloudflare Workers scripts" but does not list Workers AI inference (the list is worded "among others", so it cannot be concluded from this that DLS does not cover AI inference). Also: services in China are operated by JD Cloud (SST Other Terms), which has nothing to do with Workers AI. Recorded as not_found under the rules: the absence of public evidence is not the absence of a vendor commitment.
points.text_zh: Regional Services 的区域内服务清单列出「Running Cloudflare Workers scripts」，但未列 Workers AI 推理（清单措辞为 among others，不能据此断定 DLS 不覆盖 AI 推理）。另：中国区服务由 JD Cloud 运营（SST Other Terms），与 Workers AI 无关。结论按规则记 not_found：拿不到公开证据 ≠ 厂商没有处理地承诺。

points.text: The DLS clauses previously bound here ("Enterprise-only paid add-on" / "…enable customers to choose the location where Cloudflare inspects and stores data") state a purchasable location-control product but do not say that Workers AI inference is covered by it, so they are not statements about this tier's processing location and are no longer bound. They remain as circumstantial evidence in item (4) above.
points.text_zh: 原先绑在本条的两句 DLS 引文（「Enterprise-only paid add-on」／「…enable customers to choose the location where Cloudflare inspects and stores data」）只说明有一个可购买的定位控制产品，未说明覆盖 Workers AI 推理，不构成对本档处理地的表述，故不再绑在本条；它们作为旁证仍保留在上面第 (4) 条里。

points.text: Checked and judged insufficient to support a conclusion: EU Data Act Addendum §7.2 discloses only "The following URL identifies the locations of Cloudflare's infrastructure: cloudflare.com/network." — an infrastructure-location pointer (network map), not a disclosure of where a given service's data is processed; and the addendum itself applies only to customers who live or are headquartered in the EU with EU billing addresses, and only to agreements formed or orders placed on or after September 12, 2025.
points.text_zh: 查过并判定不足以支撑结论：EU Data Act Addendum §7.2 只披露「The following URL identifies the locations of Cloudflare's infrastructure: cloudflare.com/network.」——这是基础设施位置指引（网络地图），不是某服务数据在哪处理的披露；且该附录只适用于居住地或总部在欧盟、账单地址在欧盟的客户，也只适用于 2025 年 9 月 12 日及之后成立或下单的协议。
points.quote: The following URL identifies the locations of Cloudflare’s infrastructure: cloudflare.com/network.

role.quote: the Customer is the Controller (or a Processor processing Personal Data on behalf of a third-party Controller), and Cloudflare is a Processor (or sub-Processor, as applicable).

points.text: The contract makes Cloudflare the processor. DPA §2.3: "the Customer is the Controller (or a Processor processing Personal Data on behalf of a third-party Controller), and Cloudflare is a Processor (or sub-Processor, as applicable)"
points.text_zh: 合同层明确为受托处理方（processor）。DPA §2.3：「the Customer is the Controller (or a Processor processing Personal Data on behalf of a third-party Controller), and Cloudflare is a Processor (or sub-Processor, as applicable)」

points.text: The DPA opens by limiting itself to cases "where Cloudflare processes Personal Data as a Processor ... on behalf of Customer to provide the Services", and the definition of Services in §1.1(o) includes "any software, software development kits and application programming interfaces (APIs)", which covers Workers AI. Self-Serve §6.1 and ESA §5.3 say the same (the latter: "To the extent that Cloudflare processes Customer Data ... that includes Personal Data, Cloudflare will handle such Personal Data in compliance with the DPA"). The privacy policy reinforces it: Cloudflare designates itself data controller only for information it collects itself, and immediately afterwards designates itself data processor for "content provided by Customers and End Users through the Services that transits, or in some cases, is stored on, the Cloudflare network". Two layers of exception are recorded alongside: (a) the Service-Specific Terms classify "machine learning models made available by Cloudflare" as Third-Party Products, so the licence and use terms run between the customer and the model licensor, with Cloudflare neither controlling nor indemnifying
points.text_zh: DPA 开篇限定其适用于「where Cloudflare processes Personal Data as a Processor ... on behalf of Customer to provide the Services」，而 §1.1(o) 的 Services 定义含「any software, software development kits and application programming interfaces (APIs)」，覆盖 Workers AI。Self-Serve §6.1 与 ESA §5.3 同旨（后者：To the extent that Cloudflare processes Customer Data ... that includes Personal Data, Cloudflare will handle such Personal Data in compliance with the DPA）。隐私政策补强：Cloudflare 只对自行收集的信息自认 data controller，紧接着自认对「content provided by Customers and End Users through the Services that transits, or in some cases, is stored on, the Cloudflare network」为 data processor。同时并列记录两层例外：(a) Service-Specific Terms 把「machine learning models made available by Cloudflare」定性为 Third-Party Products，许可与使用条款发生在客户与模型许可方之间，Cloudflare 不控制、不赔偿

points.text: (b) The same page states plainly that for third-party products running on third-party infrastructure through AI Gateway "the Cloudflare Data Processing Addendum and Information Security Exhibit do not apply", and that this is treated as the customer instructing Cloudflare to send Customer Data to them — that third-party model hop is not covered by the DPA (it belongs to the cloudflare-ai-gateway entry). For the Workers AI hosted models (65 of them, including those marked Partner) no clause about handing data to the model's originator was found, so this tier is recorded as processor
points.text_zh: (b) 同一页明文：AI Gateway 上跑在第三方基础设施的第三方产品，「the Cloudflare Data Processing Addendum and Information Security Exhibit do not apply」，且视为客户指示 Cloudflare 向其发送 Customer Data——第三方模型那一跳不受 DPA 保护（属 cloudflare-ai-gateway 条目范围）。对 Workers AI 托管模型（65 个，含标 Partner 者）未发现「数据转交模型原厂」的条款，故本档判 processor

points.text: "Models are Third-Party Products" affects licensing and the allocation of liability; it does not change Cloudflare's position as data processor.
points.text_zh: 「models 是 Third-Party Products」影响的是许可与责任划分，不改变 Cloudflare 作为数据处理受托方的地位。

training.quote: Unless otherwise agreed, Cloudflare does not use any Customer Content to train generative AI tools.

points.text: Cloudflare's AI Gateway-specific contract terms — the section "Cloudflare Workers AI; AI Gateway" of the Service-Specific Terms → Developer Platform — state verbatim "Unless otherwise agreed, Cloudflare does not use any Customer Content to train generative AI tools." This section names AI Gateway itself, so it is the most directly applicable no-training commitment, and it is tier-independent (the page supplements the applicable master agreement, self-serve or enterprise). The "Unless otherwise agreed" opening makes it a default that a contrary agreement can displace, not an absolute bar
points.text_zh: Cloudflare 专指 AI Gateway 的合同条款——《服务专用条款 → 开发者平台》的「Cloudflare Workers AI; AI Gateway」一节——逐字写『Unless otherwise agreed, Cloudflare does not use any Customer Content to train generative AI tools.』该节点名 AI Gateway 本身,是最直接适用的不训练承诺,且不分档(该页补充 applicable master agreement,自助档与企业档皆适用)。『Unless otherwise agreed』这个开头说明它是可被另行约定覆盖的默认值,不是绝对禁止
points.quote: Unless otherwise agreed, Cloudflare does not use any Customer Content to train generative AI tools.

points.text: The same AI Gateway section also writes "Cloudflare does not reference or use any Customer Content except as needed to provide and improve the Services", keeping a service-improvement opening. Under docs/judgment.md (using data to improve the service counts as training) this has to sit next to the no-training sentence, not replace it: items 1 and 9 of the same section are kept side by side and no side is picked
points.text_zh: 同一 AI Gateway 节还写『Cloudflare does not reference or use any Customer Content except as needed to provide and improve the Services』,保留了「服务改进」这个口子。按 docs/judgment.md 的口径(用来改进服务算训练),这条必须与不训练那句并列而非替代它:同节第 1 条与第 9 条并列保留,不选边
points.quote: Cloudflare does not reference or use any Customer Content except as needed to provide and improve the Services

points.text: Gateway hop (Cloudflare) conclusion: at contract level Cloudflare is granted no license to train models on customer content. The content license in Self-Serve Subscription Agreement §2.5.1 is limited verbatim to "to the extent necessary to provide the Services"
points.text_zh: 网关跳(Cloudflare)结论:合同层没有授予 Cloudflare 用客户内容训练模型的许可。《自助订阅协议》§2.5.1 的内容许可逐字限于『to the extent necessary to provide the Services』

points.text: §2.5.5 assigns to Cloudflare only the Network Data derived from server, network and traffic data, which it "shall have the right to use ... for purposes of providing, maintaining, developing, and improving its Services", and states expressly that "Cloudflare may monitor and inspect the traffic on the Cloudflare network, including any related logs, as necessary to perform the Services or protect the security or integrity of Cloudflare's network" — derived data and security monitoring are the two openings left
points.text_zh: §2.5.5 只把由服务器/网络/流量数据衍生出的 Network Data 归 Cloudflare,并可『use Network Data for purposes of providing, maintaining, developing, and improving its Services』,同时明文『Cloudflare may monitor and inspect the traffic on the Cloudflare network, including any related logs, as necessary to perform the Services or protect the security or integrity of Cloudflare's network』——衍生数据与安全监控是两个留出的口子

points.text: §2.5.3 separately authorizes Cloudflare to modify or scan customer content to enhance performance, security or the functionality of the Services. DPA §3.3 (CCPA scope) says "Cloudflare will not retain, use, or disclose that Personal Data for any purposes other than the purposes set out in the Main Agreement and this DPA", and the Network Data wording in Enterprise §5.4 matches the self-serve version. Cloudflare has a blunter sentence of its own — "we do not use our customers' content to train any LLMs" (Trust Hub Responsible AI page) — but that page consistently returns a tracking-pixel shell through the production fetch channel r.jina.ai and its body cannot be retrieved (see the render_error entry in sources), so it is not treated as an authoritative source this round, only as a lead. Upstream hop: AI Gateway is a forwarding gateway and the request is ultimately processed by the upstream provider
points.text_zh: §2.5.3 另授权 Cloudflare 修改/扫描客户内容以提升性能、安全或服务功能。DPA §3.3(CCPA 范围)写『Cloudflare will not retain, use, or disclose that Personal Data for any purposes other than the purposes set out in the Main Agreement and this DPA』,企业档 §5.4 的 Network Data 措辞与自助档同旨。Cloudflare 自己另有更直白的一句『we do not use our customers' content to train any LLMs』(Trust Hub Responsible AI 页),但该页在生产抓取通道 r.jina.ai 下固定返回跟踪像素壳、拿不到正文(见 sources 的 render_error 条),本轮不作为权威来源,只作线索。上游跳:AI Gateway 是转发网关,请求最终由上游 provider 处理

points.text: The documentation points the "Terms and License" of third-party models directly at each provider's own terms (every entry in the model catalog links to the upstream terms), and Self-Serve Subscription Agreement §3 likewise says a Third-Party Product is "governed by the terms of service ... of the third party provider" and that access is "solely between you and the applicable Third-Party Product provider". Cloudflare makes no commitment about whether upstreams train on requests; each has to be checked separately. Under the multi-hop rule, the end-to-end conclusion is governed by each upstream
points.text_zh: 文档把第三方模型的『Terms and License』直接指向 provider 自家条款(模型目录页每条都链到上游条款),《自助订阅协议》§3 亦写第三方产品『governed by the terms of service ... of the third party provider』『solely between you and the applicable Third-Party Product provider』。上游是否用请求训练,Cloudflare 不作任何承诺,须逐家核。按多跳规则,全链结论以上游各家为准

points.text: This round reaches a conclusion for the gateway hop only.
points.text_zh: 本轮只对网关跳给结论。

zdr.quote: This setting only applies to Unified Billing requests that use Cloudflare-managed credentials. It does not apply to BYOK or other AI Gateway requests.

points.text: BYOK / bring-your-own provider key tier: no ZDR option, and this is an express denial rather than a non-disclosure — the Unified Billing page states verbatim that the ZDR setting "only applies to Unified Billing requests that use Cloudflare-managed credentials. It does not apply to BYOK or other AI Gateway requests." All this tier can do is switch logging or caching off; there is no request-level zero-retention commitment. Two further notes: (1) the AI Gateway Header Glossary calls itself a "complete list of all supported headers" yet omits cf-aig-zdr, while the Unified Billing page documents that header — on re-check this was judged a completeness problem of the reference page (not updated for the new header), not a contrary statement about the same tier and dimension, so it is not a contradiction and that source has been dropped. (2) Even with ZDR enabled on the Unified Billing tier, the vendor states that "ZDR does not control AI Gateway logging".
points.text_zh: BYOK / 请求自带 provider key 档:没有 ZDR 选项,且这是明确否定而非未披露——Unified Billing 页逐字写 ZDR 设置『only applies to Unified Billing requests that use Cloudflare-managed credentials. It does not apply to BYOK or other AI Gateway requests.』该档能做的只有关日志/关缓存,没有任何请求级零保留承诺。另记两处:①AI Gateway Header Glossary 自称是『complete list of all supported headers』,清单里却没有 cf-aig-zdr,而 Unified Billing 页明确文档了该头——重查后判为参考页文档完备性问题(参考页未随新头更新),不是对同一档位、同一维度的相反表述,不构成 contradiction,该 source 已 drop。②即便在 Unified Billing 档开了 ZDR,官方也说『ZDR does not control AI Gateway logging』。

retention.quote: These logs persist, giving you the flexibility to store them for your preferred duration and do more with valuable request data.

points.text: Gateway hop conclusion: there is no time commitment at request level; content is persisted by default until the storage cap triggers deletion or logging is switched off. (1) Content kept by default: "Logs, which include metrics as well as request and response data, are enabled by default for each gateway", and the content includes the user prompt and the model response themselves
points.text_zh: 网关跳结论:请求级没有任何时限承诺,正文默认被持久保存,直到触顶删除或被主动关闭。①默认留正文:日志对每个 gateway 默认开启(『Logs, which include metrics as well as request and response data, are enabled by default for each gateway』),内容含 user prompt 与 model response 正文

points.text: Official wording: "These logs persist, giving you the flexibility to store them for your preferred duration" — only an entry-count cap is given (free 100,000 per account, paid 10,000,000 per gateway, 10 MB per entry), with no limit in days. (2) How to switch it off: disable logging as a whole in the settings
points.text_zh: 官方措辞『These logs persist, giving you the flexibility to store them for your preferred duration』——只给条数上限(免费 100,000 条/账号、付费 10,000,000 条/gateway、单条 10 MB),没有天数上限。②关闭方式:设置里整体关闭日志

points.text: Per request, cf-aig-collect-log: false skips the entire log entry
points.text_zh: 逐请求 cf-aig-collect-log: false 跳过整条日志

points.text: cf-aig-collect-log-payload: false skips only the payload and keeps the metadata ("Payload storage is skipped. Metadata-only log entries are still saved."). (3) Behaviour at the cap: Automatic Log Deletion can be switched on to delete the oldest logs automatically, or new logs stop being written. (4) Cache: off by default
points.text_zh: cf-aig-collect-log-payload: false 只跳过正文而保留 metadata(『Payload storage is skipped. Metadata-only log entries are still saved.』)。③触顶行为:可开 Automatic Log Deletion 自动删最旧,或停止写入新日志。④缓存:默认关闭

points.text: Once enabled, responses are cached by Cloudflare with a TTL of at least 60 seconds and at most 1 month. (5) Export: on paid tiers, Workers Logpush can push logs to the customer's own external storage. Contract-level comparison: Enterprise §5.2 says of Customer Data not stored on the customer's behalf as described in the documentation that Cloudflare "may delete Customer Data at any time after seventy-two (72) hours", but AI Gateway logs are content stored on the customer's behalf as documented, so that 72-hour floor does not apply — and "logs are deleted after 72 hours" cannot be inferred from it
points.text_zh: 开启后响应由 Cloudflare 缓存,TTL 最短 60 秒、最长 1 个月。⑤导出:付费档 Workers Logpush 可把日志推送到客户自己的外部存储。合同层对照:企业档 §5.2 对『未按文档约定代客户存储』的 Customer Data 写『may delete Customer Data at any time after seventy-two (72) hours』,但 AI Gateway 日志属于文档约定代客户存储的内容,不适用该 72 小时下限——不能反推『日志 72 小时后删除』

points.text: The retention period in the DPA Annex is written as "Until the earliest of (i) expiry/termination of the Main Agreement, or (ii) the date upon which processing is no longer necessary...", a contract-level retention criterion rather than a request-level period. Also: §2.5.5 gives Cloudflare the right to inspect network traffic and related logs, but no retention commitment for abuse-monitoring logs.
points.text_zh: DPA Annex 的保留期写法是『Until the earliest of (i) expiry/termination of the Main Agreement, or (ii) the date upon which processing is no longer necessary...』,是合同层保留准则,不是请求级期限。另:§2.5.5 给了 Cloudflare 检查网络流量与相关日志的权限,但没有给 abuse 监控日志的保留期承诺。

points.text: Object boundary of the DPA retention criteria: the Annex criterion above does not reach the upstream hop — the AI Gateway section of the Service-Specific Terms says the Cloudflare Data Processing Addendum and Information Security Exhibit "do not apply to your use of such Third-Party Products accessed via AI Gateway", so how long the upstream provider keeps the request is governed by that provider's own policy
points.text_zh: DPA 保留准则的对象边界:上面那条 Annex 保留期不延伸到上游跳——《服务专用条款》AI Gateway 节写明 Cloudflare DPA 与 Information Security Exhibit『do not apply to your use of such Third-Party Products accessed via AI Gateway』,上游 provider 保留请求多久由它自己的政策决定
points.quote: Certain AI Gateway features utilize Third-Party Products that operate on third-party infrastructure, as further described in the developer documents. By using such features, you (i) direct Cloudflare to send certain of your Customer Data to the relevant Third-Party Product provider in order to provide the Service and (ii) understand and agree that the Cloudflare Data Processing Addendum and Information Security Exhibit do not apply to your use of such Third-Party Products accessed via AI Gateway.

points.text: Enterprise-tier comparison (does not constrain the self-serve tiers; recorded alongside §5.2 as reference only): §11.5 "Access to Logs On Termination" — "For up to seventy-two (72) hours following expiration or termination of Customer's access to the Service, Cloudflare will use reasonable efforts to continue to make available to Customer the Customer Logs." This is a post-termination retrieval window on the Customer Logs, not a deletion deadline: §5.2's 72-hour point is a floor for data Cloudflare is not documented as storing, while §11.5 keeps documented Customer Logs available to the customer for up to 72 hours after termination
points.text_zh: 企业档对照(不对自助档构成约束,与 §5.2 一并只作对照):§11.5『Access to Logs On Termination』——『For up to seventy-two (72) hours following expiration or termination of Customer's access to the Service, Cloudflare will use reasonable efforts to continue to make available to Customer the Customer Logs.』这是终止后仍可取回 Customer Logs 的窗口,不是删除期限:§5.2 的 72 小时是「未按文档代存」数据的下限,§11.5 则让文档约定代存的 Customer Logs 在终止后最多 72 小时内仍对客户可取回
points.quote: For up to seventy-two (72) hours following expiration or termination of Customer’s access to the Service, Cloudflare will use reasonable efforts to continue to make available to Customer the Customer Logs.

processing_region.quote: | AI Gateway | ✘ | ✘ | 🚧 15 |

points.text: Gateway hop conclusion: by default there is no commitment at all about where data is processed or stored; only a paid enterprise add-on provides a limited regional boundary. (1) Default state: the CMB documentation says "by default no boundary is applied and logs may be stored in Cloudflare's core data centers globally"
points.text_zh: 网关跳结论:默认没有任何处理地/存储地承诺,只有企业付费附加项提供有限的区域边界。①默认态:CMB 文档写『by default no boundary is applied and logs may be stored in Cloudflare's core data centers globally』

points.text: DPA §6.1: "the parties anticipate that Cloudflare (and its sub-Processors) may process outside of the European Economic Area", and §7.1 acknowledges processing outside the Originating Country. points.text: Footnote 15, as rendered by the direct .md channel of the docs, reads "Jurisdictional Restrictions (storage) options for Logs are not supported today. All other features are available to all CMB regions." — i.e. AI Gateway can be placed under CMB, but CMB supports only the eu and us regions. (3) The contractual CMB commitment is "Cloudflare will not transfer outside the configured region(s) any End User Customer Logs arising from Covered Services", and DLS is sold only for Enterprise-plan zones at an extra 30% fee (Data Localization Suite section of the Service-Specific Terms). (4) Upstream hop: which provider processes the request in which region is governed by each provider's own policy; Cloudflare neither commits to nor discloses the target region of per-request routing. (5) Unverified / uncertain: whether AI Gateway is on CMB's "Covered Services" list is not itemized in the public documentation
points.text_zh: docs 的 .md 直连通道给出的脚注 15 原文为『Jurisdictional Restrictions (storage) options for Logs are not supported today. All other features are available to all CMB regions.』——即 AI Gateway 可配 CMB,但 CMB 只支持 eu / us 两区。③CMB 的合同承诺是『Cloudflare will not transfer outside the configured region(s) any End User Customer Logs arising from Covered Services』,且 DLS 只对企业版 zone 销售、额外收 30% 费用(《服务专用条款》Data Localization Suite 一节)。④上游跳:请求最终由哪家 provider 在哪个区域处理,由各家自己的政策决定,Cloudflare 不承诺、也不披露逐请求路由的目标区域。⑤未核/不确定:AI Gateway 是否被列入 CMB 的『Covered Services』清单,公开文档没有逐项列名

points.text: Footnote 15 is readable only through the direct channel (jina drops footnotes).
points.text_zh: 脚注 15 只在 direct 通道可读(jina 丢脚注)。

points.text: Exception to the boundary: CMB has an "Allow out-of-region access" setting — "When enabled, Customer Logs will still be stored in the configured regions but will be accessible to authorized users on your account, regardless of physical location." CMB therefore constrains where logs are stored, not who may read them. Object caveat: the same document defines CMB's Customer Logs as traffic metadata ("request URLs, timestamps, and firewall events"), and Cloudflare does not state whether AI Gateway prompt/response content falls inside that definition
