points.quote: An exception is made if "Allow out-of-region access" is enabled. When enabled, Customer Logs will still be stored in the configured regions but will be accessible to authorized users on your account, regardless of physical location.

role.quote: the Customer is the Controller (or a Processor processing Personal Data on behalf of a third-party Controller), and Cloudflare is a Processor (or sub-Processor, as applicable)

points.text: Gateway hop conclusion: Cloudflare designates itself processor. DPA §2.3: "the Customer is the Controller (or a Processor processing Personal Data on behalf of a third-party Controller), and Cloudflare is a Processor (or sub-Processor, as applicable)", and the Annex role table says the same
points.text_zh: 网关跳结论:Cloudflare 自认处理受托方(processor)。DPA §2.3『the Customer is the Controller (or a Processor processing Personal Data on behalf of a third-party Controller), and Cloudflare is a Processor (or sub-Processor, as applicable)』,Annex 角色表同旨

points.text: §3.1(i) provides that, following termination or expiry of the Main Agreement or completion of the Service, all personal data is deleted or returned at the customer's choice
points.text_zh: §3.1(i) 约定主协议终止/到期或服务完成后,按客户选择删除或返还全部个人数据

points.text: §4.3 has the customer give blanket written authorization for Cloudflare group members and data-center and support third parties to act as sub-processors, with the sub-processor list at cloudflare.com/gdpr/subprocessors/. Upstream hop: not a question about Cloudflare's role — Self-Serve Subscription Agreement §3 states plainly that a Third-Party Product is "governed by the terms of service ... of the third party provider" and is "solely between you and the applicable Third-Party Product provider", each upstream provider being responsible for its own processing. Difference between the two tiers: on the BYOK / own-key tier the customer has a direct contractual and credential relationship with the upstream and Cloudflare is only a proxy
points.text_zh: §4.3 客户对 Cloudflare 集团成员及数据中心/支持类第三方作为子处理者给出一揽子书面授权,子处理者清单在 cloudflare.com/gdpr/subprocessors/。上游跳:不是 Cloudflare 的角色问题——《自助订阅协议》§3 明写第三方产品『governed by the terms of service ... of the third party provider』『solely between you and the applicable Third-Party Product provider』,上游 provider 各自对其处理负责。两档差异:BYOK/自带 key 档,客户与上游有直接的合同与凭据关系,Cloudflare 只是代理

points.text: On the Unified Billing tier the credentials are held by Cloudflare and usage is billed against Cloudflare credit ("the request is served with Cloudflare-managed credentials and billed against your Cloudflare credit balance", with provider inference pricing "passed through with no markup"), so Cloudflare is an intermediary in the billing chain — but the documentation does not disclose on what terms Cloudflare contracts with the upstreams, which is this tier's biggest open question.
points.text_zh: Unified Billing 档凭据由 Cloudflare 托管、按 Cloudflare 额度计费(『the request is served with Cloudflare-managed credentials and billed against your Cloudflare credit balance』,provider 推理价『passed through with no markup』),即 Cloudflare 在结算上是中间方——但文档没有披露 Cloudflare 与上游之间以何种条款签约,这是本档最大的不确定点。

points.text: Scope limit written into the contract itself: the AI Gateway section of the Service-Specific Terms provides that where AI Gateway features use Third-Party Products running on third-party infrastructure, "you (i) direct Cloudflare to send certain of your Customer Data to the relevant Third-Party Product provider in order to provide the Service and (ii) understand and agree that the Cloudflare Data Processing Addendum and Information Security Exhibit do not apply to your use of such Third-Party Products accessed via AI Gateway." Cloudflare's processor role — and the DPA that expresses it — therefore covers the gateway hop only; the role of the upstream hop is set by the upstream provider's own terms
points.text_zh: 合同自身写明的范围限定:《服务专用条款》AI Gateway 节规定,对于跑在第三方基础设施上的第三方产品,『you (i) direct Cloudflare to send certain of your Customer Data to the relevant Third-Party Product provider in order to provide the Service and (ii) understand and agree that the Cloudflare Data Processing Addendum and Information Security Exhibit do not apply to your use of such Third-Party Products accessed via AI Gateway.』——Cloudflare 的 processor 角色(以及体现它的 DPA)只覆盖网关跳;上游跳的角色由上游 provider 自己的条款决定
points.quote: Certain AI Gateway features utilize Third-Party Products that operate on third-party infrastructure, as further described in the developer documents. By using such features, you (i) direct Cloudflare to send certain of your Customer Data to the relevant Third-Party Product provider in order to provide the Service and (ii) understand and agree that the Cloudflare Data Processing Addendum and Information Security Exhibit do not apply to your use of such Third-Party Products accessed via AI Gateway.

training.quote: Unless otherwise agreed, Cloudflare does not use any Customer Content to train generative AI tools.

points.text: The AI Gateway-specific contract terms — the section "Cloudflare Workers AI; AI Gateway" of the Service-Specific Terms → Developer Platform — state verbatim "Unless otherwise agreed, Cloudflare does not use any Customer Content to train generative AI tools." That section names AI Gateway itself and supplements whichever master agreement applies, so it covers this tier as well; the "Unless otherwise agreed" opening makes it a default a contrary agreement can displace, not an absolute bar
points.text_zh: 专指 AI Gateway 的合同条款——《服务专用条款 → 开发者平台》的「Cloudflare Workers AI; AI Gateway」一节——逐字写『Unless otherwise agreed, Cloudflare does not use any Customer Content to train generative AI tools.』该节点名 AI Gateway 本身、补充适用的主协议,因此本档同样适用;『Unless otherwise agreed』这个开头说明它是可被另行约定覆盖的默认值,不是绝对禁止
points.quote: Unless otherwise agreed, Cloudflare does not use any Customer Content to train generative AI tools.

points.text: The same AI Gateway section also writes "Cloudflare does not reference or use any Customer Content except as needed to provide and improve the Services", keeping a service-improvement opening. Under docs/judgment.md (using data to improve the service counts as training) this has to sit next to the no-training sentence rather than replace it; the two items of the same section are kept side by side and no side is picked
points.text_zh: 同一 AI Gateway 节还写『Cloudflare does not reference or use any Customer Content except as needed to provide and improve the Services』,保留了「服务改进」这个口子。按 docs/judgment.md 的口径(用来改进服务算训练),这条必须与不训练那句并列而非替代它:同节两条并列保留,不选边
points.quote: Cloudflare does not reference or use any Customer Content except as needed to provide and improve the Services

points.text: Same source as the api tier: the contractual content license is still limited to what is "necessary to provide the Services", and the same two openings (Network Data and security monitoring) apply
points.text_zh: 与 api 档同源:合同层内容许可仍限于『necessary to provide the Services』,Network Data 与安全监控两个口子同样适用

points.text: The documentation makes no separate training commitment for Unified Billing. The difference lies in credentials and billing — requests on this tier are sent with Cloudflare-managed credentials and billed against Cloudflare credit, but the public documentation does not disclose on what terms Cloudflare contracts with the upstream providers, so whether upstreams train on requests is equally unresolved on this tier.
points.text_zh: 文档没有对 Unified Billing 另作训练承诺。差别在凭据与结算——该档请求由 Cloudflare 托管凭据发出、按 Cloudflare 额度计费,但公开文档未披露 Cloudflare 与上游 provider 之间以何种条款签约,因此上游是否用请求训练在本档同样无解。

zdr.quote: Zero Data Retention (ZDR) routes Unified Billing traffic through provider endpoints that do not retain prompts or responses.

points.text: Unified Billing tier: there is a ZDR switch, but with three layers of qualification, and the commitment lands on the upstream endpoint side. (1) The wording is verbatim "Zero Data Retention (ZDR) routes Unified Billing traffic through provider endpoints that do not retain prompts or responses" — the party not retaining prompts or responses is the provider endpoints (upstream), while what Cloudflare provides is the routing and the setting ("maps to ZDR-capable upstream provider configurations"). (2) Scope: only Unified Billing requests that use Cloudflare-managed credentials; BYOK and other AI Gateway requests are out of scope
points.text_zh: Unified Billing 档:有 ZDR 开关,但有三层限定,且承诺落在上游端点一侧。①逐字表述是『Zero Data Retention (ZDR) routes Unified Billing traffic through provider endpoints that do not retain prompts or responses』——不保留 prompt/response 的主体是 provider endpoints(上游),Cloudflare 侧提供的是路由与设置(『maps to ZDR-capable upstream provider configurations』)。②适用范围:仅使用 Cloudflare 托管凭据的 Unified Billing 请求,BYOK 与其他 AI Gateway 请求不适用

points.text: The documentation at the time listed only two supported upstreams, OpenAI and Anthropic; enabling it for a provider that does not support ZDR means AI Gateway "falls back to the standard (non-ZDR) Unified Billing configuration". (3) "ZDR does not control AI Gateway logging." — with ZDR on, logging still has to be switched off separately, or the gateway side still keeps the prompt and response content. How to enable: the gateway-level zdr setting (off by default) or cf-aig-zdr: true per request. For the model-by-model view see the AI model catalog page (90 of 226 entries carry a Zero data retention marker, and the same page also has entries without it). This tier's ZDR must not be read as "Cloudflare commits to zero retention": it is a mapping onto upstream endpoint configurations and does not cover the gateway's own logs.
points.text_zh: 文档当时只列 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 两个上游支持,给不支持 ZDR 的 provider 开启会『falls back to the standard (non-ZDR) Unified Billing configuration』。③『ZDR does not control AI Gateway logging.』——开了 ZDR 仍要单独关日志,否则网关侧仍留 prompt/response 正文。开启方式:网关级 zdr 设置(默认未开启)或逐请求 cf-aig-zdr: true。逐模型对照见 AI 模型目录页(226 条中 90 条带 Zero data retention 标记,同页也有不带该标记的条目)。不能把本档的 ZDR 当成『Cloudflare 承诺零保留』:它是对上游端点配置的映射,且不覆盖网关自身日志。

retention.quote: These logs persist, giving you the flexibility to store them for your preferred duration and do more with valuable request data.

points.text: Same as the api tier: logging is a gateway-level behaviour, on by default, containing prompt and response content, persisted, and bounded by an entry-count cap. One official qualification must be recorded alongside on this tier: "ZDR does not control AI Gateway logging" — with ZDR on, logging still has to be switched off separately before nothing is written on the gateway side.
points.text_zh: 与 api 档相同:日志是 gateway 级行为,默认开、含 prompt/response 正文、持久保存、按条数上限。该档另有一处必须并列的官方限定:『ZDR does not control AI Gateway logging』——开了 ZDR 仍要单独关日志才算网关侧不落盘。

points.text: Object boundary of the DPA retention criteria on this tier: the Annex criterion ("Until the earliest of (i) expiry/termination of the Main Agreement, or (ii) the date upon which processing is no longer necessary...") covers the gateway hop only — the AI Gateway section of the Service-Specific Terms says the Cloudflare DPA and Information Security Exhibit "do not apply to your use of such Third-Party Products accessed via AI Gateway", so how long the upstream provider keeps the request is governed by that provider's own policy. Even a ZDR-mapped configuration is a mapping onto upstream endpoints, not a Cloudflare retention commitment
points.text_zh: 本档 DPA 保留准则的对象边界:Annex 的保留期(『Until the earliest of (i) expiry/termination of the Main Agreement, or (ii) the date upon which processing is no longer necessary...』)只覆盖网关跳——《服务专用条款》AI Gateway 节写明 Cloudflare DPA 与 Information Security Exhibit『do not apply to your use of such Third-Party Products accessed via AI Gateway』,上游 provider 保留请求多久由它自己的政策决定;即便开了映射到上游 ZDR 端点的配置,那也只是对上游端点配置的映射,不是 Cloudflare 的保留承诺

training.quote: We do not use Prompt and Project Data to train our or third-party AI models unless, before you use the applicable model or feature, we clearly state that the data may be used for AI training.

points.text: 只有明确标注“May use data for AI training”的模型/功能例外；使用该例外时训练结论反转。连接 Freebuff Cloud 仓库还允许有限 Codebase Evaluation，但该行为本身不授权训练。
points.text_zh: 只有明确标注“May use data for AI training”的模型/功能例外；使用该例外时训练结论反转。连接 Freebuff Cloud 仓库还允许有限 Codebase Evaluation，但该行为本身不授权训练。
points.quote: We do not use Prompt and Project Data to train our or third-party AI models unless, before you use the applicable model or feature, we clearly state that the data may be used for AI training.

retention.summary: 按对象分列未公布期限
retention.quote: We retain information for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this Privacy Policy, including providing, maintaining, developing, improving, evaluating, securing, and supporting Service; advertising; enforcing our Terms; complying with law; and resolving disputes.

points.text: 输入、代码、文件、agent traces 与项目数据可被收集；只给按目的合理必要的泛化期限。账号删除请求完成后，不再仅为 Codebase Evaluation 保留 raw source code/agent traces，但断开 GitHub 或 Delete project 本身不会删除已收集数据。
points.text_zh: 输入、代码、文件、agent traces 与项目数据可被收集；只给按目的合理必要的泛化期限。账号删除请求完成后，不再仅为 Codebase Evaluation 保留 raw source code/agent traces，但断开 GitHub 或 Delete project 本身不会删除已收集数据。
points.quote: We retain information for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this Privacy Policy, including providing, maintaining, developing, improving, evaluating, securing, and supporting Service; advertising; enforcing our Terms; complying with law; and resolving disputes.

points.text: Tree-sitter 在本地建立 code map，但官方未披露该本地索引/缓存的清理期限。
points.text_zh: Tree-sitter 在本地建立 code map，但官方未披露该本地索引/缓存的清理期限。
points.quote: 1.   Tree-sitter scans your repo and builds a code map

points.text: 产品默认会向 analytics/observability 服务商发送有界的使用、性能和诊断事件；官方政策及 CLI 文档未披露全局关闭开关或遥测保留期限。
points.text_zh: 产品默认会向 analytics/observability 服务商发送有界的使用、性能和诊断事件；官方政策及 CLI 文档未披露全局关闭开关或遥测保留期限。
points.quote: Our products also send bounded usage, performance, and diagnostic events to analytics and observability providers.

points.text: A deletion request does not remove everything: deleted information may remain in backups, and deidentified or aggregated data, derived interests, derived Codebase Evaluation results that contain no raw source code or agent traces, permitted training data, and content others keep through a sharing or publishing feature may all survive deletion.
points.text_zh: 删除请求不等于全删：已删除信息可能仍留在备份中，去标识或聚合数据、派生兴趣、不含原始源码与 agent traces 的派生 Codebase Evaluation 结果、已授权的训练数据，以及他人通过分享或发布功能保留的内容，都可能在删除后继续存在。
points.quote: Deleted information may remain in backups, and deidentified or aggregated data, derived interests, derived Codebase Evaluation results that do not contain raw source code or agent traces, permitted training data, and content others retain through a sharing or publishing feature may remain after deletion.

processing_region.quote: We are based in the United States, and we and our providers may process information in the United States and other countries.

points.text: Edits and commands run locally, but relevant prompts, code, files, and repository context are sent to Freebuff and to model providers, so the processing region — and the role of each hop — is additionally governed by those providers' own terms.
points.text_zh: 编辑与命令在本机执行，但相关提示词、代码、文件与仓库上下文会发往 Freebuff 及各模型商，处理地（以及各跳的角色）还受这些模型商各自条款约束。
points.quote: Edits and commands run locally. Relevant prompts, code, files, and repository context are sent to Freebuff and model providers.

points.text: The policy never uses controller or processor for Codebuff's own role; the only occurrences of processor refer to payment processors. No enterprise DPA or processor commitment is published, so the role has to be confirmed separately before procurement.
points.text_zh: 政策未用 controller/processor 术语描述自身角色，processor 仅指支付处理商；企业 DPA 或受托处理方身份未公开，采购前需另行确认。

points.text: The policy grounds processing in the company's own legal bases — performing the contract, complying with legal obligations, and pursuing its own legitimate interests such as securing and improving Service, preventing abuse, and supporting its business. That reads like processing for its own purposes, but the clause names no role, so it is recorded as context rather than as proof of controller status.
points.text_zh: 政策把处理建立在自身合法依据上（履行合同、遵守法定义务，以及保护与改进服务、防止滥用、支持自身业务等自有合法利益），口径接近为自身目的处理；但该句未指明角色，只作背景记录，不足以据此改判角色。
points.quote: Where applicable law requires a legal basis, we process personal information as necessary to perform our contract with you, comply with legal obligations, and pursue legitimate interests such as securing and improving Service, preventing abuse, and supporting our business.

points.text: Prompt and Project Data are also used to personalize advertising inside the Service, including by deriving general interest categories — again processing for the company's own purposes, and no retention period is published for those derived interest categories.
points.text_zh: 提示词与项目数据还被用于站内广告个性化，包括派生一般兴趣类别，同样是为自身目的处理，且政策未公布这些派生兴趣类别的保留期限。
points.quote: We may use Prompt and Project Data to personalize advertising shown within Service, including by deriving general interest categories.

training.quote: A label or notice such as May use data for AI training means that Prompt and Project Data submitted through that model or feature may be retained and used by Company or the applicable third-party provider for AI training, development, evaluation, testing, fine-tuning, quality improvement, safety research, and related model or product improvement.

zdr.quote: A label or notice such as May use data for AI training means that Prompt and Project Data submitted through that model or feature may be retained and used by Company or the applicable third-party provider for AI training, development, evaluation, testing, fine-tuning, quality improvement, safety research, and related model or product improvement.

retention.summary: 按对象分列未公布期限
retention.quote: A label or notice such as May use data for AI training means that Prompt and Project Data submitted through that model or feature may be retained and used by Company or the applicable third-party provider for AI training, development, evaluation, testing, fine-tuning, quality improvement, safety research, and related model or product improvement.

points.text: Data submitted through a model or feature labeled for AI training may be retained for the permitted development and improvement uses and may not be removable once it has been deidentified or incorporated into a model — an authorised retention with no deletion ceiling.
points.text_zh: 带 AI 训练标注的模型或功能所提交的数据可按已授权的开发与改进用途留存，且在去标识或并入模型后可能不可移除——属授权性留存，没有删除上限。
points.quote: Data submitted through a model or feature labeled for AI training may be retained for the permitted development and improvement uses above and may not be removable after it is deidentified or incorporated into a model.

processing_region.quote: We are based in the United States, and we and our providers may process information in the United States and other countries.

points.text: In jurisdictions where these advertising choices are not legally required, certain advertising processing may be necessary to use the free Service — advertising the provider runs for its own purposes rather than on a customer's instruction. The policy still names no role for Codebuff.
points.text_zh: 在未强制提供广告选择的辖区，部分广告处理是使用免费服务的必要条件，即厂商为自身广告目的而非按客户指示进行的处理；但政策仍未指明 Codebuff 的角色。
points.quote: In jurisdictions where these choices are not legally required, certain advertising processing may be necessary to use the free Service.

training.quote: You can opt out from your prompts and generations being used to train Cohere models in your dashboard settings at any time.

points.text: Policy layer (Enterprise Data Commitments, channel=enterprise_privacy_faq): prompts and generations are used to train Cohere models unless the customer turns the dashboard toggle off — "You can opt out from your prompts and generations being used to train Cohere models in your dashboard settings at any time." The toggle is described for this paying tier, and EDC states its own scope as the enterprise data of Cohere's commercial, paying customers, i.e. SaaS Platform customers who have a credit card on file in their account. Recorded as mark=no with mode=opt_out, not as undisclosed.
points.text_zh: 政策层（EDC，channel=enterprise_privacy_faq）：默认会用于训练，客户可在控制台随时关闭——「You can opt out from your prompts and generations being used to train Cohere models in your dashboard settings at any time.」该开关是给本付费档描述的；EDC 自述适用范围是商业付费客户的企业数据，即 SaaS Platform 上有信用卡在账的客户。故记 mark=no + mode=opt_out，不是「未披露」。
points.quote: You can opt out from your prompts and generations being used to train Cohere models in your dashboard settings at any time.

points.text: Time boundary of the switch: "Your change in settings will apply to data created after you make that change." Opting out therefore covers only data created afterwards; data already submitted and already drawn on is not affected by the change.
points.text_zh: 开关的时间边界：「Your change in settings will apply to data created after you make that change.」即退出只对之后产生的数据生效，此前已提交、已被使用的数据不因此停止被使用。
points.quote: Your change in settings will apply to data created after you make that change.

points.text: Contract layer (Cohere API SaaS Agreement §3(a)(iii), channel=contract, tier=contradiction): "CUSTOMER GRANTS TO COHERE A NONEXCLUSIVE, WORLDWIDE, ROYALTY-FREE, IRREVOCABLE, SUBLICENSABLE, AND FULLY PAID-UP RIGHT TO ACCESS, COLLECT, USE, PROCESS, STORE, DISCLOSE AND TRANSMIT CUSTOMER DATA TO: … (III) IMPROVE AND ENHANCE THE SERVICES AND COHERE’S OTHER OFFERINGS AND BENCHMARK THE FOREGOING, INCLUDING BY SHARING API DATA AND FINETUNING DATA WITH THIRD PARTIES WHO MAY USE THE FINETUNING DATA AND API DATA TO PROVIDE SERVICES TO COHERE AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES PERMITTED UNDER THEIR TERMS AND CONDITIONS." The licence is expressly irrevocable, covers Customer Data generally without any opt-in by the customer, and allows API Data / Finetuning Data to be handed to third parties under their own terms. The two layers of the same tier are kept side by side rather than averaged: the policy layer gives a dashboard opt-out, the contract layer grants an irrevocable licence; neither document says whether the dashboard switch limits that licence.
points.text_zh: 合同层（《Cohere API SaaS Agreement》§3(a)(iii)，channel=contract，tier=contradiction）：对 Customer Data 授予 NONEXCLUSIVE…IRREVOCABLE… 的许可，第 (III) 项明确用于 IMPROVE AND ENHANCE THE SERVICES AND COHERE’S OTHER OFFERINGS，并允许把 API Data / Finetuning Data 交第三方按第三方条款使用；许可明文不可撤销、覆盖全部 Customer Data、不需要客户 opt-in。同一档位的两种口径并列保留、不取平均：政策层给 dashboard opt-out，合同层给不可撤销许可；两份文件都没说 dashboard 开关是否构成对该许可的合同性限缩。
points.quote: IMPROVE AND ENHANCE THE SERVICES AND COHERE’S OTHER OFFERINGS AND BENCHMARK THE FOREGOING

points.text: Scope of this row: EDC itself sends data from users on a trial API key to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy, and that sub-tier is recorded as its own row (trial) because its training mechanism is different — there is no dashboard switch there. The opt-out described above is not offered on it.
points.text_zh: 本行范围：EDC 自己把「用试用 API key 访问 SaaS Platform」的用户数据划给 Terms of Use + 隐私政策；该子档的训练机制不同（没有 dashboard 开关），故单列 trial 一行。上面这个 opt-out 开关不适用于它。
points.quote: apply to data we receive from users using a trial API key to access our SaaS Platform.

zdr.quote: Zero data retention (ZDR) means we do not log any prompts or generations.

points.text: Besides the request-based scheme, the Trust Center describes a configuration that stores nothing at all: "we can, in certain circumstances, configure our offering to ensure that no customer data is stored on Cohere’s systems. When the Cohere offering is configured in this way, the customer data is considered “ephemeral”, as it transits through Cohere’s systems only briefly for the purposes of providing the services and is purged immediately after processing." The same answer records the trade-off — it limits some features and Cohere's ability to improve the user experience by reviewing customer data — and describes it as a configuration rather than a self-serve switch, so it corroborates the by_agreement record instead of replacing the ZDR definition as this row's main basis.
points.text_zh: 除按申请开通的方案外，Trust Center 还描述了另一种「完全不存储」的配置：「we can, in certain circumstances, configure our offering to ensure that no customer data is stored on Cohere’s systems… the customer data is considered “ephemeral”… and is purged immediately after processing.」同一条回答也承认代价（会限制部分功能，并削弱 Cohere 通过查阅客户数据来改进体验的能力），且它写的是「配置」而非自助开关——故作为 by_agreement 的佐证，不替换 ZDR 定义句作主锚点。
points.quote: however, we can, in certain circumstances, configure our offering to ensure that no customer data is stored on Cohere’s systems. When the Cohere offering is configured in this way, the customer data is considered “ephemeral”, as it transits through Cohere’s systems only briefly for the purposes of providing the services and is purged immediately after processing.

points.text: Two limits stated in the same FAQ answer: "we only allow ZDR for enterprise customers who can make additional commitments about their usage of the Cohere Services", and "ZDR does not affect usage data, which Cohere still receives." ZDR therefore does not extend to the trial sub-tier (see that row) and does not cover usage metadata.
points.text_zh: 同一条 FAQ 里的两处限定：「we only allow ZDR for enterprise customers who can make additional commitments about their usage of the Cohere Services」以及「ZDR does not affect usage data, which Cohere still receives.」即 ZDR 不覆盖试用子档（见 trial 行），也不覆盖 usage data 这类元数据。
points.quote: we only allow ZDR for enterprise customers who can make additional commitments about their usage of the Cohere Services

retention.quote: We automatically delete logged prompts and generations after 30 days, unless we need it to comply with a legal requirement or customer contract

points.text: Object, context and exceptions of the 30 days: object = logged prompts and generations (input/output content); context = the default on the SaaS Platform for this paying tier; "We automatically delete logged prompts and generations after 30 days, unless we need it to comply with a legal requirement or customer contract, or unless your usage is flagged as potentially violating our terms, including our Usage Policy (e.g. abuse or misuse of our services)." EDC adds that flagged prompts and associated logs may be retained and reviewed to enforce the policies, and that deleting an account does not delete prompts or generations — those follow the 30-day rule and its exceptions.
points.text_zh: 这 30 天的对象、语境与例外：对象=被记录的 prompts 与 generations（输入输出正文）；语境=本付费档在 SaaS Platform 上的默认值；原文「We automatically delete logged prompts and generations after 30 days, unless we need it to comply with a legal requirement or customer contract, or unless your usage is flagged as potentially violating our terms…」。EDC 另写：被标记的 prompts 与相关日志可被保留并复核以执行政策；删除账号也不会删除 prompts/generations，它们仍按 30 天规则及其例外处理。
points.quote: We automatically delete logged prompts and generations after 30 days, unless we need it to comply with a legal requirement or customer contract

points.text: Exception inside the same paragraph as the 30 days: "Data you allow us to use for training purposes may be retained separately in accordance with our agreement with you." Input/output the customer allows Cohere to use for training is therefore not covered by the 30 days — it is kept separately under the agreement instead.
points.text_zh: 与 30 天同段的例外：「Data you allow us to use for training purposes may be retained separately in accordance with our agreement with you.」即被允许用于训练的输入输出不受 30 天约束，按协议另行保留。
points.quote: Data you allow us to use for training purposes may be retained separately in accordance with our agreement with you.

points.text: Contract layer, a second and different "30 days": "Within 30 calendar days following termination, Cohere will, at Customer’s request, delete or otherwise render inaccessible any Customer Data that remains in the hardware or systems used by Cohere to provide the Cohere API SaaS Services, including any Custom Models." Context = after termination, and conditional on the customer asking; this is not the automatic deletion during the term, and the two figures must not be read as one.
points.text_zh: 合同层的另一个「30 天」：「Within 30 calendar days following termination, Cohere will, at Customer’s request, delete or otherwise render inaccessible any Customer Data that remains in the hardware or systems used by Cohere to provide the Cohere API SaaS Services, including any Custom Models.」语境=服务终止之后，且以客户提出请求为前提；这与服务期内的自动删除是两回事，不能合并成同一个数字。
points.quote: Within 30 calendar days following termination, Cohere will, at Customer’s request, delete or otherwise render inaccessible any Customer Data

points.text: The same clause excludes one class of data from that deletion duty: "Notwithstanding the foregoing, Cohere will have no obligation to delete or otherwise render inaccessible any API Data or Finetuning Data submitted by Customer to Cohere in accordance with Section 3(a)(iii)." In context this governs deletion after termination (it follows the 30-day window above); §3(a)(iii) covers Customer Data generally without the customer opting in, so for data submitted under it the contract layer makes no deletion commitment, while the policy layer keeps the 30-day automatic deletion as the default. The two layers are recorded side by side.
points.text_zh: 同一条把一类数据排除在删除义务之外：「Notwithstanding the foregoing, Cohere will have no obligation to delete or otherwise render inaccessible any API Data or Finetuning Data submitted by Customer to Cohere in accordance with Section 3(a)(iii).」按上下文它管的是终止后的删除（紧接上文那个 30 天窗口）；§3(a)(iii) 的许可覆盖全部 Customer Data 且不需要客户 opt-in，因此对该许可项下的数据，合同层不作删除承诺，而政策层仍保留 30 天自动删除作为默认值。两层并列记录。
points.quote: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Cohere will have no obligation to delete or otherwise render inaccessible any API Data or Finetuning Data submitted by Customer to Cohere in accordance with Section 3(a)(iii).

points.text: Scope: EDC applies to "enterprise data of our commercial, paying customers … customers who have a credit card on file in their account", and EDC sends trial API key data to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy, where no fixed period for inputs and outputs is published (see the trial row). The 30 days above is therefore this paying tier's default, not a platform-wide rule.
points.text_zh: 适用范围：EDC 适用于「enterprise data of our commercial, paying customers … customers who have a credit card on file in their account」，并把试用 API key 的数据划给 Terms of Use + 隐私政策（其中没有公布输入输出的固定期限，见 trial 行）。故上面的 30 天是本付费档的默认值，不是全平台规则。
points.quote: Our Enterprise Data Commitments apply to enterprise data of our commercial, paying customers.

processing_region.quote: Our hosting centers are on Google Cloud Platform servers located in US-Central.

role.quote: designed to give our customers contractual assurances regarding Cohere’s handling of customer data on their behalf

training.quote: IMPROVE AND ENHANCE THE COHERE SOLUTION AND OUR OTHER OFFERINfGS AND BENCHMARK THE FOREGOING

points.text: Contract layer for this sub-tier: EDC states that "Our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy apply to data we receive from users using a trial API key to access our SaaS Platform", and ToU §4(a) grants Cohere a right over Customer Data "TO: … (III) IMPROVE AND ENHANCE THE COHERE SOLUTION AND OUR OTHER OFFERINfGS AND BENCHMARK THE FOREGOING, INCLUDING BY SHARING API DATA AND FINETUNING DATA WITH THIRD PARTIES WHO MAY USE THE FINETUNING DATA AND API DATA TO PROVIDE SERVICES TO COHERE". Input and output is therefore used to improve the products — training under this ledger's rule — and the licence is expressly irrevocable.
points.text_zh: 本子档的合同层：EDC 写明「Our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy apply to data we receive from users using a trial API key to access our SaaS Platform」，而 ToU §4(a) 对 Customer Data 授予不可撤销的权利：「TO: … (III) IMPROVE AND ENHANCE THE COHERE SOLUTION AND OUR OTHER OFFERINfGS AND BENCHMARK THE FOREGOING, INCLUDING BY SHARING API DATA AND FINETUNING DATA WITH THIRD PARTIES…」（OFFERINfGS 是厂商原文笔误，照录）。输入输出因此会用于改进产品——按本台账判定口径即训练——且许可明文不可撤销。
points.quote: IMPROVE AND ENHANCE THE COHERE SOLUTION AND OUR OTHER OFFERINfGS AND BENCHMARK THE FOREGOING

points.text: Privacy Policy §2.3 covers this population directly (Trial Users and Researchers): "We may use this input and output data to conduct research and development. This includes analyzing usage trends and using inputs/outputs to improve the performance and safety of Cohere Products." The same section states that de-identification steps are taken before any research and development use, and that these environments are not intended for personal information.
points.text_zh: 隐私政策 §2.3 直接覆盖这批用户（Trial Users 与 Researchers）：「We may use this input and output data to conduct research and development. This includes analyzing usage trends and using inputs/outputs to improve the performance and safety of Cohere Products.」同节写明用于研发前会做去标识化，且这些环境不适用于处理个人信息。
points.quote: We may use this input and output data to conduct research and development. This includes analyzing usage trends and using inputs/outputs to improve the performance and safety of Cohere Products.

points.text: Mechanism: no dashboard switch on this sub-tier. EDC describes the opt-out toggle for enterprise/paying customers, and the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy that govern trial API key data provide no way to withdraw the licence — hence mark=no with no opt_out mode.
points.text_zh: 机制：本子档没有 dashboard 开关。EDC 的 opt-out 开关是给企业/付费客户描述的，而治理试用 API key 数据的 Terms of Use 与隐私政策没有提供撤回许可的途径——故记 mark=no 且不带 opt_out。
points.quote: apply to data we receive from users using a trial API key to access our SaaS Platform.

points.text: No zero-retention option is disclosed for this sub-tier: the Terms of Use and the Privacy Policy say nothing about zero retention, and the only ZDR mechanism Cohere publishes is limited — "we only allow ZDR for enterprise customers who can make additional commitments about their usage of the Cohere Services."
points.text_zh: 本子档没有公开任何零保留方案：Terms of Use 与隐私政策都没提到零保留，而 Cohere 公开的 ZDR 机制是有限定的——「we only allow ZDR for enterprise customers who can make additional commitments about their usage of the Cohere Services.」
points.quote: we only allow ZDR for enterprise customers who can make additional commitments about their usage of the Cohere Services

retention.quote: We retain personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, to meet business or legal requirements, and as otherwise permitted or required by applicable law, including litigation holds.

points.text: The 30-day figure published elsewhere is stated for Enterprise Users only: "Retention of inputs and outputs on the Platform is generally 30 days for Enterprise Users." The next sentence sends Trial Users and Researchers elsewhere — the Platform "is not intended to process personal information", with deletion on request if personal information is inadvertently included in an input.
points.text_zh: 别处公布的 30 天只针对 Enterprise Users：「Retention of inputs and outputs on the Platform is generally 30 days for Enterprise Users.」紧接着的一句把 Trial Users 与 Researchers 划到另一套：平台「is not intended to process personal information」，若输入中不慎包含个人信息，可发信要求删除。
points.quote: Retention of inputs and outputs on the Platform is generally 30 days for Enterprise Users.

points.text: This row covers two objects with different answers, which is why the object field is recorded as mixed rather than as inputs and outputs alone. What the governing documents do state is the Privacy Policy's as-needed rule, and that rule is stated for personal information: "We retain personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, to meet business or legal requirements…", the same section adding that "there is not typically a fixed retention period that will always apply to a particular category of personal information". Inputs and outputs are a different object and no period is published for them on this sub-tier: the 30-day figure is stated for Enterprise Users, and EDC's 30-day automatic deletion is scoped to paying customers — EDC applies to "enterprise data of our commercial, paying customers … customers who have a credit card on file in their account" and routes trial API key data to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
points.text_zh: 本行覆盖两种对象、答案不同，故 object 记 mixed 而非只记输入输出。治理本子档的文件里能落实的是隐私政策的按需保留规则，而该规则针对的是个人信息：「We retain personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, to meet business or legal requirements…」，同节还写「there is not typically a fixed retention period that will always apply to a particular category of personal information」。输入输出是另一种对象，本子档没有公布它的期限：30 天是针对 Enterprise Users 写的，EDC 的 30 天自动删除适用于付费客户——EDC 适用于「enterprise data of our commercial, paying customers … customers who have a credit card on file in their account」，并把试用 API key 的数据划给 Terms of Use + 隐私政策。
points.quote: Our Enterprise Data Commitments apply to enterprise data of our commercial, paying customers.

processing_region.quote: Our hosting centers are on Google Cloud Platform servers located in US-Central.

points.text: The hosting answer is platform-level rather than tier-specific: "Our hosting centers are on Google Cloud Platform servers located in US-Central. We do not use servers outside of the US…" It is the same answer that describes the ephemeral configuration, and no region choice is offered for this sub-tier.
points.text_zh: 托管地的回答是平台级而非分档的：「Our hosting centers are on Google Cloud Platform servers located in US-Central. We do not use servers outside of the US…」它与描述 ephemeral 配置的是同一条回答，本子档没有可选地域。
points.quote: Our hosting centers are on Google Cloud Platform servers located in US-Central.

points.text: Neither document that governs this sub-tier assigns Cohere a controller/processor role for trial API key data. The processor framing in the Privacy Policy is stated for End Users ("In this case we are usually the processor or service provider") — a different population from the Trial Users covered by §2.3, whose content Cohere may use for research and development. Recorded as unknown rather than guessed.
points.text_zh: 治理本子档的两份文件都没有为试用 API key 数据约定 Cohere 的控制者/受托处理方角色。隐私政策里的受托处理口径是针对 End Users 写的（「In this case we are usually the processor or service provider」），与 §2.3 覆盖的 Trial Users 不是同一批人——后者的内容 Cohere 可用于研发。故记 unknown，不猜。
points.quote: In this case we are usually the processor or service provider

training.quote:
Crusoe does not store Inputs and Outputs to disk, and only processes them as long as necessary to provide Customer with the Crusoe Intelligence Foundry or as otherwise provided in the Data Processing and Security Terms. This processing includes standard cache use patterns for inference, including temporarily caching Inputs and Outputs in memory, evicting cache entries to make room for new requests, and immediately wiping the cache when the model instance is deleted.**

**We do not use Inputs or Outputs to train Models or improve our Services without Customer’s explicit opt-in consent.**

points.text: Direct-access tier conclusion: not used for training by default, available only after the customer explicitly opts in. The authoritative clause is "Processing and Storage of Inputs and Outputs" in the Crusoe Intelligence Foundry Terms within Service Specific Terms v5.0: "Crusoe does not store Inputs and Outputs to disk…" plus "We do not use Inputs or Outputs to train Models or improve our Services without Customer's explicit opt-in consent."
points.text_zh: 直连档结论：默认不用于训练，仅在客户明确 opt-in 后可用。权威条款＝Service Specific Terms v5.0 内 Crusoe Intelligence Foundry Terms 的「Processing and Storage of Inputs and Outputs」：「Crusoe does not store Inputs and Outputs to disk…」＋「We do not use Inputs or Outputs to train Models or improve our Services without Customer's explicit opt-in consent.」

points.text: On the fine-tuning side there is also "We do not use Training Data to train Models or improve our Services without Customer's explicit opt-in consent." Platform-level comparison: Cloud Platform TOS v1.10 "Protection of Customer Data" — Crusoe will only access or use Customer Data to provide the Services and TSS or as instructed by the customer and "will not use it for any other Crusoe products, services, or advertising". The official product page also says "zero data sharing… never used to improve shared or third-party models" (official_blog grade, not used as primary evidence). Undisclosed: how opt-in is given and withdrawn, which model or corpus opted-in data enters, and how long opted-in data is kept.
points.text_zh: 微调侧另有「We do not use Training Data to train Models or improve our Services without Customer's explicit opt-in consent.」。平台层对照＝Cloud Platform TOS v1.10「Protection of Customer Data」：Crusoe 只会为提供服务/TSS 或依客户指示访问或使用 Customer Data，「will not use it for any other Crusoe products, services, or advertising」。官方产品页亦称「zero data sharing…never used to improve shared or third-party models」（official_blog 档，不作主证据）。未披露：opt-in 的申请与撤回方式、opt-in 后数据进入哪个模型或语料、opt-in 数据的保留期限。

zdr.quote:
Crusoe does not store Inputs and Outputs to disk, and only processes them as long as necessary to provide Customer with the Crusoe Intelligence Foundry or as otherwise provided in the Data Processing and Security Terms. This processing includes standard cache use patterns for inference, including temporarily caching Inputs and Outputs in memory, evicting cache entries to make room for new requests, and immediately wiping the cache when the model instance is deleted.**

**We do not use Inputs or Outputs to train Models or improve our Services without Customer’s explicit opt-in consent.**

points.text: Reading (the main divergence from the old record): the terms do commit that inputs and outputs are not written to disk, are cached in memory only, and are cleared when the instance is deleted — request-level non-persistence by default design
points.text_zh: 口径（与旧记录的主要分歧）：条款层确实承诺输入输出不落盘、仅内存缓存、实例删除即清空，这是默认设计上的请求级不持久化

points.text: But Crusoe has never made a commitment under the name ZDR / zero retention / zero data retention — those words appear nowhere in the Cloud TOS, AUP, DPST, Cloud Platform Privacy Notice, SST or Website terms, and there is no ZDR switch, application path or approval process. Clauses pointing the other way remain: the Cloud Platform TOS reserves the right to "investigate any potential violation of the AUP…may include reviewing Customer Applications or Customer Data", DPST v1.3 has a law-enforcement request exception, and SST v4.0 used to state expressly that Crusoe could delete or block Inputs/Outputs in abuse or infringement investigations (the current v5.0 has removed that paragraph, the right now resting on the investigation clause in the Cloud TOS and on the AUP). URLs checked this round, none of which contains ZDR wording: legal.crusoe.ai/, legal.crusoe.ai/open-router, legal.crusoe.ai/#data-processing, legal.crusoe.ai/#service-specific-terms, trust.crusoe.ai, trust.crusoe.ai/subprocessors, trust.crusoe.ai/controls, trust.crusoe.ai/faq, docs.crusoecloud.com/llms.txt, docs.crusoecloud.com/managed-ai/overview, docs.crusoecloud.com/serverless-inference/overview, docs.crusoecloud.com/identity-and-security, www.crusoe.ai/cloud/managed-inference, www.crusoe.ai/cloud/serverless-fine-tuning.
points.text_zh: 但 Crusoe 从未以 ZDR / 零保留 / zero data retention 的名义作出承诺——Cloud TOS、AUP、DPST、Cloud Platform Privacy Notice、SST、Website 条款里都没有这些字样，也没有 ZDR 开关、申请入口或审批流程。相反方向的条款仍在：Cloud Platform TOS 保留「investigate any potential violation of the AUP…may include reviewing Customer Applications or Customer Data」，DPST v1.3 有执法请求例外，SST v4.0 曾明写 Crusoe 有权在滥用/侵权调查中删除或屏蔽 Inputs/Outputs（现行 v5.0 已删除该段，该权利改由 Cloud TOS 的调查条款与 AUP 承接）。本轮查过、均未发现 ZDR 表述的 URL：legal.crusoe.ai/、legal.crusoe.ai/open-router、legal.crusoe.ai/#data-processing、legal.crusoe.ai/#service-specific-terms、trust.crusoe.ai、trust.crusoe.ai/subprocessors、trust.crusoe.ai/controls、trust.crusoe.ai/faq、docs.crusoecloud.com/llms.txt、docs.crusoecloud.com/managed-ai/overview、docs.crusoecloud.com/serverless-inference/overview、docs.crusoecloud.com/identity-and-security、www.crusoe.ai/cloud/managed-inference、www.crusoe.ai/cloud/serverless-fine-tuning。

retention.quote:
Crusoe does not store Inputs and Outputs to disk, and only processes them as long as necessary to provide Customer with the Crusoe Intelligence Foundry or as otherwise provided in the Data Processing and Security Terms. This processing includes standard cache use patterns for inference, including temporarily caching Inputs and Outputs in memory, evicting cache entries to make room for new requests, and immediately wiping the cache when the model instance is deleted.**

**We do not use Inputs or Outputs to train Models or improve our Services without Customer’s explicit opt-in consent.**

points.text: Recorded by object (direct-access tier): (1) Input and output content = not written to disk, cached only in memory under the standard inference caching pattern, evicted to make room for new requests, and the cache cleared when the model instance is deleted
points.text_zh: 按对象分记（直连档）：(1) 输入输出正文＝不落盘，仅在内存中按标准推理缓存模式临时缓存、为新请求腾位时淘汰、模型实例删除即清空缓存

points.text: There is no "deleted after N days" commitment of any kind; the period type is non-persistence. (2) KV cache = described by both the official product page and the documentation site as a cluster-level memory cache (cluster-wide KV cache / cluster-aware routing), i.e. in memory
points.text_zh: 没有任何「N 天后删除」的天数承诺，期限类型为非持久化。(2) KV 缓存＝官方产品页与文档站都描述为集群级内存缓存（cluster-wide KV cache / cluster-aware routing），属内存态

points.text: The terms describe only the eviction mechanism and give no lifetime for the cache. (3) Training Data and Checkpoints = processed only to run the fine-tuning job the customer requested, and the customer can delete them at any time under the DPST. (4) Termination = all Customer Data (including existing copies) remaining in Crusoe's systems at the end of the Term is deleted unless European Law requires storage. (5) Service Data (account, billing, technical and operational logs and so on) = Cloud Platform Privacy Notice v1.3 says retention periods are set separately by data type and use, and that data is deleted or anonymized once no longer needed, with no number of days
points.text_zh: 条款只说明淘汰机制，未给缓存存活时限。(3) Training Data 与 Checkpoints＝只为执行客户提交的微调任务而处理，客户可依 DPST 随时删除。(4) 服务终止＝Term 结束时 Crusoe 系统内的 Customer Data（含既有副本）全部删除，除非欧洲法要求保存。(5) Service Data（账号、计费、技术/运营日志等）＝Cloud Platform Privacy Notice v1.3 称按数据类型与用途分别设定保留期、不再需要即删除或匿名化，未给天数

points.text: That notice states expressly that it does not apply to Customer Data. (6) Exception = DPST v1.3 "Law Enforcement Requests" permits Inputs/Outputs/Training Data/Checkpoints/Customer Models to be provided in response to law enforcement requests (Crusoe must challenge any request that is not binding and valid, notify the customer, and request a waiver where notice is prohibited by law). There is no "retained for at least N months" floor anywhere in the texts, and no fixed ceiling.
points.text_zh: 该通知明文不适用于 Customer Data。(6) 例外＝DPST v1.3「Law Enforcement Requests」允许在执法请求下提供 Inputs/Outputs/Training Data/Checkpoints/Customer Models（须先质疑不具约束力的请求并通知客户，法律禁止通知时须申请豁免）。全文无「至少保留 N 个月」类下限表述，也无固定上限。
points.quote: If Crusoe receives a request from law enforcement for Inputs, Outputs, Training Data, Checkpoints, or Customer Models, Crusoe shall challenge any request that is not binding and valid, provide Customer with notice (unless prohibited by law, in which case we shall request a waiver of such prohibition), and provide only information responsive to a reasonable interpretation of the request.

points.text: Running deletion right during the Term (DPST v1.3 "Deletion by Customer during the Term"): Crusoe will enable the customer to delete Customer Data during the Term, and will comply with a Customer Instruction to delete Customer Data from its systems "as soon as reasonably practicable, unless European Law requires storage" — the period type is "as soon as practicable", not a number of days, with a European Law exception
points.text_zh: 运行期删除权（DPST v1.3「Deletion by Customer during the Term」）：Crusoe 须让客户在 Term 期间删除 Customer Data，并依客户指示从系统中删除，「as soon as reasonably practicable, unless European Law requires storage」——期限类型是「尽快」而非天数，并带欧洲法保存例外
points.quote: Crusoe will comply with a Customer Instruction to to delete Customer Data from Crusoe’s systems as soon as reasonably practicable, unless European Law requires storage.

points.text: Contract-level duration of the processing (DPST Appendix 1, "Duration of the Processing"): "The Term plus the period from the end of the Term until deletion of all Customer Data by Crusoe in accordance with the Terms." — it defines how long processing lasts (Term, then until deletion), and is not a retention ceiling; it does not contradict the input/output non-persistence recorded above
points.text_zh: 合同层的处理持续期（DPST 附录 1「Duration of the Processing」）：「The Term plus the period from the end of the Term until deletion of all Customer Data by Crusoe in accordance with the Terms.」——定义处理持续到何时（Term 内，然后直到删除完毕），不是保留上限，与上面记的输入输出非持久化并不冲突
points.quote: The Term plus the period from the end of the Term until deletion of all Customer Data by Crusoe in accordance with the Terms.

points.text: Exception and backup fact (Cloud Platform Privacy Notice v1.3): "Sometimes we need to retain certain information for an extended period of time for legitimate business or legal purposes" (tax or accounting, security, fraud and abuse prevention, continuity, legal or regulatory requirements), and when Crusoe deletes data it takes "measures to ensure that our Services protect information from accidental or malicious deletion through the use of backup systems" — so Service Data copies can persist in backups. This is the notice's own statement about Service Data, and it is an exception to the "deleted once no longer needed" wording above, not a number of days
points.text_zh: 例外与备份事实（Cloud Platform Privacy Notice v1.3）：「Sometimes we need to retain certain information for an extended period of time for legitimate business or legal purposes」（税务/会计、安全、反欺诈、业务连续性、法律或监管要求），且删除时用备份系统防止误删——即 Service Data 副本可能长期留在备份里。这是通知本身对 Service Data 的表述，是上面「不再需要即删除」的例外，不是天数
points.quote:
Sometimes we need to retain certain information for an extended period of time for legitimate business or legal purposes. For example, when Crusoe processes a payment for you, or when you make a payment to Crusoe, we’ll retain data about those transactions as required for tax or accounting purposes. Other legitimate business or legal purposes that may require us to retain data include security, fraud and abuse prevention, ensuring continuity of our Services, and complying with legal or regulatory requirements.

When we delete data, we follow detailed steps to make sure that the data is securely and completely removed from our active systems or retained only in anonymized form. We take measures to ensure that our Services protect information from accidental or malicious deletion through the use of backup systems.

points.text: Fine-tuning datasets and checkpoints are stored in the Files API (developer_data): "Datasets and checkpoints live in the Files API." The Serverless Fine-Tuning documentation gives no retention period for files stored there (it only says datasets and checkpoints share the same lifecycle primitives), so how long a dataset or checkpoint survives after the job is undisclosed
points.text_zh: 微调数据集与检查点存放在 Files API（developer_data）：「Datasets and checkpoints live in the Files API.」。Serverless Fine-Tuning 文档未给该处文件的保留期（只说数据集与检查点共用同一套生命周期原语），故数据集/检查点在任务结束后留存多久属未披露
points.quote: Datasets and checkpoints live in the Files API

processing_region.quote:
[Crusoe Intelligence Foundry Terms](https://legal.crusoe.ai/#intelligence-foundry-terms)
4.   [Third Party Terms](https://legal.crusoe.ai/#third-party-terms)
5.   [Pricing and Billing Terms](https://legal.crusoe.ai/#pricing-and-billing-terms)

General Service Terms

Data Location

The Services do not limit the locations from which Customer or Customer End Users may access Customer Data or to which they may move Customer Data.

points.text: Direct-access tier conclusion: no data residency commitment. Three clauses at terms level: (a) SST v5.0 "General Service Terms / Data Location" — the service does not restrict where the customer accesses Customer Data from, nor where Customer Data may be moved to
points.text_zh: 直连档结论：无数据驻留承诺。条款层三条：(a) SST v5.0「General Service Terms / Data Location」——服务不限制客户从哪里访问 Customer Data、也不限制把 Customer Data 移到哪里

points.text: (b) DPST v1.3 "Data Transfers / Data Storage and Processing Facilities" — "Customer Data may be processed in any country in which Crusoe or its Subprocessors maintain facilities"
points.text_zh: (b) DPST v1.3「Data Transfers / Data Storage and Processing Facilities」——Customer Data 可在 Crusoe 或其子处理者拥有设施的任何国家处理

points.text: (c) DPST Appendix 1 — a multi-tenant environment on Crusoe-owned servers, with Customer Data replicated between multiple data centers unless the customer instructs otherwise (for example through a data location selection)
points.text_zh: (c) DPST 附录 1——多租户环境、Crusoe 自有服务器，除客户另有指示（例如 data location selection）外会在多个数据中心之间复制 Customer Data

points.text: The "data location selection" mechanism is mentioned in the terms, but the public documentation gives no list of available locations, no scope, and no statement of whether it applies to Managed Inference. (d) Service Data side: Cloud Platform Privacy Notice v1.3 says Service Data may be processed on servers outside the user's own country (centralized or regionalized billing, support and security operations). Infrastructure facts (developer_data): the documentation site lists data centers in Iceland / Houston, TX / Virginia / Sparks, NV / Norway (Norway coming soon)
points.text_zh: 「按指令选择数据位置」的机制在条款里被提到，但公开文档未给出可选位置清单、适用范围或是否适用于 Managed Inference。(d) Service Data 侧：Cloud Platform Privacy Notice v1.3 称 Service Data 可能在用户所在国以外的服务器上处理（集中式或区域化的计费、支持、安全运营）。基础设施事实（developer_data）：文档站列出数据中心 Iceland / Houston, TX / Virginia / Sparks, NV / Norway（Norway 即将上线）

points.text: The Serverless Fine-Tuning documentation states plainly that "You don't pick a region, instance type, or GPU count."
points.text_zh: Serverless Fine-Tuning 文档明说客户不能选 region、instance type 或 GPU 数量。
points.quote: You don't pick a region, instance type, or GPU count.

points.text: Subprocessor locations (contract + enterprise_privacy_faq): DPST v1.3 says information about Subprocessors, including their functions and locations, is available at the Crusoe Cloud Subprocessors page, and the published Trust Center list (Google Cloud Platform / Mailgun / Stripe / Zendesk) marks every entry United States
points.text_zh: 子处理者位置（合同 + enterprise_privacy_faq）：DPST v1.3 称子处理者的职能与所在地见 Crusoe Cloud Subprocessors 页面；Trust Center 公布的清单（Google Cloud Platform / Mailgun / Stripe / Zendesk）每条均标注 United States
points.quote: Information about Subprocessors, including their functions and locations, is available at Crusoe Cloud Subprocessors

points.text: The first entry of that published list reads "Google Cloud Platform … Cloud service provider … United States" (enterprise_privacy_faq)
points.text_zh: 该清单首条在 Trust Center 上的实际内容为「Google Cloud Platform … Cloud service provider … United States」（enterprise_privacy_faq）
points.quote:
Google Cloud Platform

•

Cloud service provider

United States

points.text: Svix, added in 2026-02, "processes data primarily in the United States using AWS infrastructure". Overall: request content is processed by default in Crusoe's own facilities, but there is no contractual guarantee of processing or storage in any one country, and the actual location depends on the product chosen and on available capacity.
points.text_zh: 2026-02 新增的 Svix 主要在美国用 AWS 处理。综合：请求内容默认在 Crusoe 自有机房处理，但没有「仅在某国处理/存储」的合同保证，实际位置取决于所选产品与容量。

role.quote: Crusoe is a processor of that Customer Personal Data under European Data Protection Law

points.text: Direct-access tier conclusion: Crusoe designates itself processor. DPST v1.3 "Processor and Controller Responsibilities" verbatim: "If European Data Protection Law applies to the processing of Customer Personal Data: 1. Crusoe is a processor of that Customer Personal Data under European Data Protection Law; 2. Customer is a controller or processor, as applicable…"
points.text_zh: 直连档结论：Crusoe 自认 processor。DPST v1.3「Processor and Controller Responsibilities」逐字：「If European Data Protection Law applies to the processing of Customer Personal Data: 1. Crusoe is a processor of that Customer Personal Data under European Data Protection Law; 2. Customer is a controller or processor, as applicable…」

points.text: The same document defines a Subprocessor as "a third party authorized as another processor under these Terms". Accompanying clauses: SST v5.0 "Crusoe shall process Inputs, Outputs, Customer Models, Checkpoints and Training Data according to the Data Processing and Security Terms", and "Customer will have sole access to Customer Models deployed in the Managed Inference Service, and neither Crusoe nor any third party not authorized by Customer may access or use such Customer Models except as needed to provide the Managed Inference Service"
points.text_zh: 同文件把 Subprocessor 定义为「a third party authorized as another processor under these Terms」。配套条款：SST v5.0「Crusoe shall process Inputs, Outputs, Customer Models, Checkpoints and Training Data according to the Data Processing and Security Terms」、「Customer will have sole access to Customer Models deployed in the Managed Inference Service, and neither Crusoe nor any third party not authorized by Customer may access or use such Customer Models except as needed to provide the Managed Inference Service」

points.text: Cloud Platform TOS v1.10: "Crusoe will only access or use Customer Data to provide the Services and TSS to Customer or as otherwise instructed by Customer". Two reservations: (1) the processor statement is conditioned on "if European Data Protection Law applies"; outside European jurisdictions the DPST says only that each party complies with applicable law
points.text_zh: Cloud Platform TOS v1.10「Crusoe will only access or use Customer Data to provide the Services and TSS to Customer or as otherwise instructed by Customer」。两点保留：(1) processor 声明以「若欧洲数据保护法适用」为前提，非欧法域下 DPST 只写各方遵守适用法律

points.text: (2) That sentence appears 4 times on the legal page (the four embedded versions DPST v1.0–v1.3 are word for word identical), so it cannot be located uniquely, see notes.
points.text_zh: (2) 该句在 legal 页面内出现 4 次（DPST v1.0–v1.3 四份内嵌版本逐字相同），无法唯一定位，见 notes。

training.quote: Crusoe will only access or use Customer Data to provide the Services and TSS to Customer or as otherwise instructed by Customer and will not use it for any other Crusoe products, services, or advertising.

points.text: GPU / Infrastructure Cloud tier (the customer runs their own environment in VMs, disks and CMK): the platform-level contract commits that Crusoe will only access or use Customer Data to provide the Services and TSS or as instructed by the customer, and "will not use it for any other Crusoe products, services, or advertising". The key difference from the Managed Inference tier is that this tier has no "Customer Licenses to Crusoe" content-use grant (the license clause in SST v5.0 covers only Intelligence Foundry Inputs/Outputs/Customer Models/Training Data/Checkpoints). The DPST also assigns responsibility for protecting data inside customer-managed resources to the customer: "Customer is responsible for implementing and maintaining privacy protections and security measures for aspects of the Services that it controls (such as… resources provisioned by Customer using the Services, such as a virtual machine or storage)". So a customer training models inside their own VM is not governed by Crusoe's training clauses, and Crusoe acquires no content license from it.
points.text_zh: GPU/Infrastructure Cloud 档（客户在 VM、磁盘、CMK 里自管环境）：平台层合同承诺 Crusoe 只会为提供服务/TSS 或依客户指示访问或使用 Customer Data，「will not use it for any other Crusoe products, services, or advertising」。与 Managed Inference 档的关键区别：本档没有「Customer Licenses to Crusoe」那类内容使用授权（SST v5.0 的授权条款只覆盖 Intelligence Foundry 的 Inputs/Outputs/Customer Models/Training Data/Checkpoints）。DPST 同时把客户自管资源内的数据保护责任划给客户：「Customer is responsible for implementing and maintaining privacy protections and security measures for aspects of the Services that it controls (such as… resources provisioned by Customer using the Services, such as a virtual machine or storage)」。即：客户在 VM 内自行训练模型不受 Crusoe 训练条款约束，Crusoe 也不会因此取得内容授权。

points.text: There is no ZDR concept on this tier and no zero-retention clause at all: the "not written to disk" commitment applies only to Managed Inference Inputs/Outputs
points.text_zh: 该档不存在 ZDR 概念，也没有任何零保留条款：「不落盘」承诺只针对 Managed Inference 的 Inputs/Outputs

points.text: Retention and erasure in customer-managed resources are determined by the customer's own configuration (the DPST assigns security responsibility for the customer-controlled surface, such as VMs and storage, to the customer). All the URLs above were checked and contain no ZDR / zero-retention / not-written-to-disk wording. This is "the vendor has not disclosed ZDR for this tier", not "the vendor commits to the opposite".
points.text_zh: 客户自管资源的保留与清除由客户自己的配置决定（DPST 把 VM/存储等客户控制面的安全责任划给客户）。以上 URL 均查过、无 ZDR / 零保留 / 不落盘表述。这是「官方未披露该档 ZDR」，不是「厂商承诺相反」。

points.text: The Cloud Platform Privacy Notice scope clause previously bound here ("This Privacy Notice applies solely to Service Data and does not apply to Customer Data") says which data the notice covers, not whether zero retention is offered, so it is not a statement on this dimension and is no longer bound. The anchor definition stays in this file, now unreferenced by any verdict.
points.text_zh: 原先绑在本条的 Cloud Platform Privacy Notice 范围条款（「This Privacy Notice applies solely to Service Data and does not apply to Customer Data」）只说明该通知覆盖哪些数据，没有说是否提供零保留，不构成对本维度的表述，故不再绑在本条；该 anchor 定义仍保留在本文件中（现无维度引用它）。
