retention.quote: All Customer Data (including existing copies) remaining at the end of the Term will be deleted from Crusoe’s systems unless European Law requires storage.

points.text: Data on this tier is managed by the customer, and the only commitment verifiable on Crusoe's side is that Customer Data left in its systems at the end of the Term is deleted (including existing copies, unless European Law requires storage)
points.text_zh: 本档数据由客户自管，Crusoe 侧可复核的承诺只有：Term 结束时删除其系统内残留的 Customer Data（含既有副本，除非欧洲法要求保存）
points.quote: All Customer Data (including existing copies) remaining at the end of the Term will be deleted from Crusoe’s systems unless European Law requires storage.

points.text: Service Data has retention periods set according to its use and is deleted or anonymized once no longer needed (no number of days)
points.text_zh: Service Data 按用途设定保留期、不再需要即删除或匿名化（无天数）
points.quote: We retain Service Data for different periods of time depending on what it is, how we use it, and how you configure your settings.

points.text: Running deletion right during the Term (DPST v1.3 "Deletion by Customer during the Term"): Crusoe will enable the customer to delete Customer Data during the Term and will comply with a Customer Instruction to delete it "as soon as reasonably practicable, unless European Law requires storage" — the period type is "as soon as practicable", not a number of days
points.text_zh: 运行期删除权（DPST v1.3「Deletion by Customer during the Term」）：Crusoe 须让客户在 Term 期间删除 Customer Data，并依客户指示「as soon as reasonably practicable, unless European Law requires storage」——期限类型是「尽快」而非天数
points.quote: Crusoe will comply with a Customer Instruction to to delete Customer Data from Crusoe’s systems as soon as reasonably practicable, unless European Law requires storage.

points.text: Contract-level duration of the processing (DPST Appendix 1, "Duration of the Processing"): "The Term plus the period from the end of the Term until deletion of all Customer Data by Crusoe in accordance with the Terms." — the DPST covers every Crusoe Cloud Platform service, Infrastructure Cloud included, so this is the duration definition that goes with the until_termination reading above
points.text_zh: 合同层的处理持续期（DPST 附录 1「Duration of the Processing」）：「The Term plus the period from the end of the Term until deletion of all Customer Data by Crusoe in accordance with the Terms.」——DPST 覆盖 Crusoe Cloud Platform 全部服务（含 Infrastructure Cloud），这是与上面 until_termination 记法配套的处理持续期定义
points.quote: The Term plus the period from the end of the Term until deletion of all Customer Data by Crusoe in accordance with the Terms.

points.text: Exception and backup fact (Cloud Platform Privacy Notice v1.3): "Sometimes we need to retain certain information for an extended period of time for legitimate business or legal purposes" (tax or accounting, security, fraud and abuse prevention, continuity, legal or regulatory requirements), and when Crusoe deletes data it takes "measures to ensure that our Services protect information from accidental or malicious deletion through the use of backup systems". This is the notice's own statement and is separate from the storage-cluster soft-delete clearing time recorded below, which stays undisclosed
points.text_zh: 例外与备份事实（Cloud Platform Privacy Notice v1.3）：「Sometimes we need to retain certain information for an extended period of time for legitimate business or legal purposes」（税务/会计、安全、反欺诈、业务连续性、法律或监管要求），且删除时用备份系统防止误删。这是通知本身的表述，与下面存储集群软删除数据的清除时限是两件事，后者仍未披露
points.quote:
Sometimes we need to retain certain information for an extended period of time for legitimate business or legal purposes. For example, when Crusoe processes a payment for you, or when you make a payment to Crusoe, we’ll retain data about those transactions as required for tax or accounting purposes. Other legitimate business or legal purposes that may require us to retain data include security, fraud and abuse prevention, ensuring continuity of our Services, and complying with legal or regulatory requirements.

When we delete data, we follow detailed steps to make sure that the data is securely and completely removed from our active systems or retained only in anonymized form. We take measures to ensure that our Services protect information from accidental or malicious deletion through the use of backup systems.

points.text: DPST v1.3 also carries the law-enforcement exception.
points.text_zh: DPST v1.3 另有执法请求例外。
points.quote: If Crusoe receives a request from law enforcement for Inputs, Outputs, Training Data, Checkpoints, or Customer Models, Crusoe shall challenge any request that is not binding and valid, provide Customer with notice (unless prohibited by law, in which case we shall request a waiver of such prohibition), and provide only information responsive to a reasonable interpretation of the request.

points.text: Disk layer (developer_data). Ephemeral Disk content: "When a VM is destroyed, the content is cryptographically erased."
points.text_zh: 磁盘层（developer_data）。Ephemeral Disk 内容：「When a VM is destroyed, the content is cryptographically erased.」
points.quote: When a VM is destroyed, the content is cryptographically erased.

points.text: Erasure of an Ephemeral Disk is triggered by more than "the customer destroys the VM": "The disks are erased when the physical server reboots, or the VM is stopped and restarted, or if there are any other hardware or software failures" — an uncontrolled data-loss surface for anything kept on an Ephemeral Disk
points.text_zh: Ephemeral Disk 的擦除条件比「客户销毁 VM」更宽也更不可控：「The disks are erased when the physical server reboots, or the VM is stopped and restarted, or if there are any other hardware or software failures」——对放在 Ephemeral Disk 上的数据是不可控的丢失面
points.quote: The disks are erased when the physical server reboots, or the VM is stopped and restarted, or if there are any other hardware or software failures.

points.text: Conversely, an in-VM reboot does not erase the disk: "Note: if a VM is restarted from within the VM (e.g. using `sudo reboot now`) rather than by stopping and restarting the VM from the UI, CLI, or API, the disks will not be erased." — so "the instance was destroyed or restarted" and "the disk content is gone" are not equivalent in either direction
points.text_zh: 反过来，在 VM 内部 reboot 不会触发擦除：「Note: if a VM is restarted from within the VM (e.g. using `sudo reboot now`) rather than by stopping and restarting the VM from the UI, CLI, or API, the disks will not be erased.」——「实例被销毁/重启」与「盘上内容没了」两个方向都不等价
points.quote: Note: if a VM is restarted from within the VM (e.g. using `sudo reboot now`) rather than by stopping and restarting the VM from the UI, CLI, or API, the disks will not be erased.

points.text: Persistent Disk content is not erasable on deletion: "Persistent Disks are backed by volumes on a centralized storage cluster. Data is encrypted at rest, but the encryption key(s) are pooled among all users of that storage cluster. When a disk is deleted, data is soft-deleted, but cryptographic erasure is not currently available."
points.text_zh: Persistent Disk 删除不等于数据不可恢复：「Persistent Disks are backed by volumes on a centralized storage cluster. Data is encrypted at rest, but the encryption key(s) are pooled among all users of that storage cluster. When a disk is deleted, data is soft-deleted, but cryptographic erasure is not currently available.」
points.quote: Persistent Disks are backed by volumes on a centralized storage cluster. Data is encrypted at rest, but the encryption key(s) are pooled among all users of that storage cluster. When a disk is deleted, data is soft-deleted, but cryptographic erasure is not currently available.

points.text: Shared Disks behave the same way as Persistent Disks and are not encrypted in transit (developer_data): "Shared Disks are backed by volumes on a centralized storage cluster. Data is encrypted at rest, but the encryption key(s) are pooled among all users of that storage cluster. Data is not encrypted while in transit. When a disk is deleted, data is soft-deleted, but cryptographic erasure is not currently available."
points.text_zh: Shared Disk 与 Persistent Disk 行为相同，且传输中不加密（developer_data）：「Shared Disks are backed by volumes on a centralized storage cluster. Data is encrypted at rest, but the encryption key(s) are pooled among all users of that storage cluster. Data is not encrypted while in transit. When a disk is deleted, data is soft-deleted, but cryptographic erasure is not currently available.」
points.quote: Shared Disks are backed by volumes on a centralized storage cluster. Data is encrypted at rest, but the encryption key(s) are pooled among all users of that storage cluster. Data is not encrypted while in transit. When a disk is deleted, data is soft-deleted, but cryptographic erasure is not currently available.

points.text: Undisclosed: how long soft-deleted data actually stays in the storage cluster, backup system retention at the storage-cluster level, and retention rules for VM snapshots and images. Confidence is medium because the contract level offers only "deletion after termination" while retention during operation depends entirely on the customer's configuration.
points.text_zh: 未披露：软删除数据在存储集群中的实际清除时限、存储集群层面的备份保留期、VM 快照/镜像留存规则。置信度 medium 是因为合同层只有「终止后删除」，运行期保留完全取决于客户配置。

processing_region.quote: Crusoe stores data in a multi-tenant environment on Crusoe-owned servers. Subject to any Instructions to the contrary (e.g., in the form of a data location selection), Crusoe replicates Customer Data between multiple data centers.

points.text: This tier shares the same regional clauses as the Managed Inference tier (DPST v1.3 + SST v5.0 Data Location): no residency commitment. One extra layer of fact here: the published data center list on the documentation site (Iceland, Houston TX, Virginia, Sparks NV, Norway) and the locations resource in the CLI show that the customer can choose a location ID when ordering
points.text_zh: 与 Managed Inference 档共用同一套地域条款（DPST v1.3 + SST v5.0 Data Location）：无驻留承诺。本档多一层事实：文档站公开的数据中心位置清单（Iceland、Houston TX、Virginia、Sparks NV、Norway）与 CLI 的 locations 资源，说明客户可在下单时选 location ID
points.quote: | Iceland | `eu-iceland1-a` | 100% renewable grid

points.text: The DPST likewise mentions a customer instruction "in the form of a data location selection". But the public terms do not turn the selected location into a guarantee about where data is processed, so it is not recorded as a residency commitment.
points.text_zh: DPST 也提到「in the form of a data location selection」的客户指示。但公开条款未把「所选 location」写成数据处理地保证，故不作驻留承诺记录。

role.quote: Crusoe is a processor of that Customer Personal Data under European Data Protection Law

points.text: Same DPST v1.3 "Processor and Controller Responsibilities": Crusoe is the processor of Customer Personal Data and the customer is controller or processor. That statement covers every Crusoe Cloud Platform service (Infrastructure Cloud included) and does not distinguish tiers.
points.text_zh: 同 DPST v1.3「Processor and Controller Responsibilities」：Crusoe 对 Customer Personal Data 是 processor，客户是 controller 或 processor。该声明覆盖 Crusoe Cloud Platform 全部服务（含 Infrastructure Cloud），不区分档位。

training.quote:
Crusoe does not store Inputs and Outputs to disk, and only processes them as long as necessary to provide Customer with the Services or as otherwise provided in the [Data Processing and Security Terms](https://app.pactsafe.com/contracts/591916/edit#data-processing). This processing includes standard cache use patterns for inference, including temporarily caching Inputs and Outputs in memory, evicting cache entries to make room for new requests, and immediately wiping the cache when the model instance is deleted.

We do not use Inputs or Outputs to train Models or improve our Services without Customer’s explicit opt-in consent.

points.text: Resale tier (customer → OpenRouter → Crusoe Managed Inference), Crusoe-side conclusion: likewise not used for training by default. TOS for OpenRouter Customers v4.6 "Processing and Storage of Customer Data": "Crusoe does not store Inputs and Outputs to disk…" plus "We do not use Inputs or Outputs to train Models or improve our Services without Customer's explicit opt-in consent." — v4.5 → v4.6 was a rewrite of the whole section: v4.5's "Protection of Customer Data; No Training" became "Processing and Storage of Customer Data" in v4.6, and v4.6 dropped three v4.5 sentences ("Crusoe will only access or use Customer Data to provide the Services to Customer…will not use it for any other Crusoe products, services, or advertising"; "Specifically, Crusoe will only use Customer Data for inference - we will not use it for training Models, and we will not store it on disk…"; and the logging clause "Crusoe generally does not log Customer Data…"), while what v4.6 adds is the opt-in conditional sentence. This is a substantive clause change between versions; whether to record it under changes/ is left to human review and was not recorded automatically here. DPST v1.3, SST v5.0 and AUP v1.1 are incorporated into this agreement through the "URL Terms" definition in v4.6 (URL Terms = AUP + Data Processing and Security Terms + Service Specific Terms). Chain note: "Customer" on this tier is OpenRouter's customer, and Crusoe's commitment covers the Crusoe hop only
points.text_zh: 转售档（客户 → OpenRouter → Crusoe Managed Inference）Crusoe 侧结论：同样默认不用于训练。TOS for OpenRouter Customers v4.6「Processing and Storage of Customer Data」：「Crusoe does not store Inputs and Outputs to disk…」＋「We do not use Inputs or Outputs to train Models or improve our Services without Customer's explicit opt-in consent.」——v4.5→v4.6 是整节改写：v4.5 的「Protection of Customer Data; No Training」在 v4.6 变成「Processing and Storage of Customer Data」，v4.6 删掉了 v4.5 的三句（only access or use Customer Data…will not use it for any other Crusoe products；Specifically, Crusoe will only use Customer Data for inference - we will not use it for training Models, and we will not store it on disk…；日志披露句 Crusoe generally does not log Customer Data…），新增的才是这条带 opt-in 条件的不训练句。这是版本间的实质条款变化，是否记入 changes/ 留人工确认，本轮不自动记。DPST v1.3、SST v5.0、AUP v1.1 通过 v4.6 的「URL Terms」定义一并纳入本协议（v4.6 定义「URL Terms」= AUP + Data Processing and Security Terms + Service Specific Terms）。链路提示：本档的「Customer」是 OpenRouter 的客户，Crusoe 的承诺只覆盖 Crusoe 这一跳
points.quote:
Crusoe will only access or use Customer Data to provide the Services to Customer or as otherwise instructed by Customer and will not use it for any other Crusoe products, services, or advertising.

Specifically, Crusoe will only use Customer Data for inference - we will not use it for training Models, and we will not store it on disk or use it for any other purpose other than the inference process.

Crusoe generally does not log Customer Data, but does log metadata that might be useful for purposes of debugging and improving the performance of the Service. Crusoe may observe and log a small portion of Customer Data when necessary for debugging, security purposes, or as required by law.

points.text: Whether OpenRouter itself resells or retains inputs and outputs must be checked on the other hop (this round took openrouter.ai/privacy only as a lead).
points.text_zh: OpenRouter 自身是否转售/留存输入输出需按另一跳核（本轮只取 openrouter.ai/privacy 作线索）。

zdr.quote:
Crusoe does not store Inputs and Outputs to disk, and only processes them as long as necessary to provide Customer with the Services or as otherwise provided in the [Data Processing and Security Terms](https://app.pactsafe.com/contracts/591916/edit#data-processing). This processing includes standard cache use patterns for inference, including temporarily caching Inputs and Outputs in memory, evicting cache entries to make room for new requests, and immediately wiping the cache when the model instance is deleted.

We do not use Inputs or Outputs to train Models or improve our Services without Customer’s explicit opt-in consent.

points.text: On the resale tier the Crusoe side matches the direct tier: nothing written to disk by default, no commitment under the ZDR name, and no switch or application path
points.text_zh: 转售档 Crusoe 侧同直连档：默认不落盘、无 ZDR 名义承诺、无开关或申请入口

points.text: The law-enforcement exception applies here too (DPST v1.3 is incorporated through the URL Terms). Whether the other hop offers zero retention is outside this vendor's scope, and end-to-end zero retention must not be inferred from this.
points.text_zh: 执法请求例外同样适用（DPST v1.3 已并入 URL Terms）。链路另一跳是否提供零保留不在本家范围内，不得据此推断全链可零保留。

retention.quote:
Crusoe does not store Inputs and Outputs to disk, and only processes them as long as necessary to provide Customer with the Services or as otherwise provided in the [Data Processing and Security Terms](https://app.pactsafe.com/contracts/591916/edit#data-processing). This processing includes standard cache use patterns for inference, including temporarily caching Inputs and Outputs in memory, evicting cache entries to make room for new requests, and immediately wiping the cache when the model instance is deleted.

We do not use Inputs or Outputs to train Models or improve our Services without Customer’s explicit opt-in consent.

points.text: Crusoe side of the resale tier: the same sentence as the direct tier — inputs and outputs are not written to disk, cached in memory only, and cleared when the model instance is deleted
points.text_zh: 转售档 Crusoe 侧：与直连档同一句话——输入输出不落盘、仅内存缓存、模型实例删除即清空

points.text: No number of days. Customer Data is defined as "Input, Output, and any personal data about Customer that Crusoe may receive from OpenRouter". The post-termination deletion obligation, the Service Data retention periods and the law-enforcement exception all come from the DPST v1.3 / Cloud Platform Privacy Notice v1.3 embedded in the same page and match the direct tier. v4.6 also has a "Required Disclosure" clause permitting disclosure of Confidential Information (Customer Data being the customer's confidential information) to comply with Legal Process; that sentence appears 12 times on the page (12 TOS versions, word for word identical), so no anchor is given and it is noted here only.
points.text_zh: 无天数。Customer Data 定义＝「Input, Output, and any personal data about Customer that Crusoe may receive from OpenRouter」。服务终止后删除义务、Service Data 保留期、执法请求例外均来自同一页面内嵌的 DPST v1.3 / Cloud Platform Privacy Notice v1.3，与直连档一致。v4.6 另有一条「Required Disclosure」允许为遵守 Legal Process 披露 Confidential Information（Customer Data 属客户保密信息），该句在页面内出现 12 次（12 个 TOS 版本逐字相同），故未提锚点，仅在此说明。
points.quote: “**Customer Data**” means Input, Output, and any personal data about Customer that Crusoe may receive from OpenRouter, and excludes Service Data.

points.text: Running deletion right (DPST v1.3 "Deletion by Customer during the Term", incorporated through the URL Terms): Crusoe will enable the customer to delete Customer Data during the Term, and will comply with a Customer Instruction to delete Customer Data from its systems "as soon as reasonably practicable, unless European Law requires storage" — the period type is "as soon as practicable", not a number of days, with a European Law exception
points.text_zh: 运行期删除权（经 URL Terms 并入的 DPST v1.3「Deletion by Customer during the Term」）：Crusoe 须让客户在 Term 期间删除 Customer Data，并依客户指示从系统中删除，「as soon as reasonably practicable, unless European Law requires storage」——期限类型是「尽快」而非天数，并带欧洲法保存例外
points.quote: Crusoe will comply with a Customer Instruction to to delete Customer Data from Crusoe’s systems as soon as reasonably practicable, unless European Law requires storage.

points.text: Contract-level duration of the processing (DPST Appendix 1, "Duration of the Processing"): "The Term plus the period from the end of the Term until deletion of all Customer Data by Crusoe in accordance with the Terms." — a definition of how long processing lasts, not a retention ceiling
points.text_zh: 合同层的处理持续期（DPST 附录 1「Duration of the Processing」）：「The Term plus the period from the end of the Term until deletion of all Customer Data by Crusoe in accordance with the Terms.」——定义处理持续到何时，不是保留上限
points.quote: The Term plus the period from the end of the Term until deletion of all Customer Data by Crusoe in accordance with the Terms.

points.text: v4.5 logging clause, dropped in v4.6: v4.5 said "Crusoe generally does not log Customer Data, but does log metadata that might be useful for purposes of debugging and improving the performance of the Service. Crusoe may observe and log a small portion of Customer Data when necessary for debugging, security purposes, or as required by law." — a narrow exception touching a small portion of Customer Data for debugging, security or legal reasons. The current v4.6 text has no equivalent sentence, so whether request content is logged is now undisclosed rather than committed in either direction; dropping that clause is a substantive change between versions, and whether to record it under changes/ is left to human review (not recorded automatically here).
points.text_zh: v4.5 的日志条款、v4.6 已删除：v4.5 写「Crusoe generally does not log Customer Data, but does log metadata that might be useful for purposes of debugging and improving the performance of the Service. Crusoe may observe and log a small portion of Customer Data when necessary for debugging, security purposes, or as required by law.」——一个窄口径例外：为调试、安全或法律要求可能观察并记录一小部分 Customer Data。现行 v4.6 文本无对应句，故「是否记录请求内容」现在是未披露，而不是任何方向的承诺；删句属版本间实质变化，是否记入 changes/ 留人工确认（本轮不自动记）。
points.quote:
Crusoe will only access or use Customer Data to provide the Services to Customer or as otherwise instructed by Customer and will not use it for any other Crusoe products, services, or advertising.

Specifically, Crusoe will only use Customer Data for inference - we will not use it for training Models, and we will not store it on disk or use it for any other purpose other than the inference process.

Crusoe generally does not log Customer Data, but does log metadata that might be useful for purposes of debugging and improving the performance of the Service. Crusoe may observe and log a small portion of Customer Data when necessary for debugging, security purposes, or as required by law.

processing_region.quote: Subject to Crusoe’s data location commitments under the [Service Specific Terms](https://legal.crusoe.ai/#service-specific-terms) and to the remainder of [Data Transfers](https://legal.crusoe.ai/#data-processing-data-transfers), Customer Data may be processed in any country in which Crusoe or its Subprocessors maintain facilities.

points.text: The regional conclusion on the resale tier is the same as on the direct tier, because the applicable text is the same DPST v1.3 (incorporated through the URL Terms definition in TOS for OpenRouter Customers v4.6) plus SST v5.0 "Data Location". This tier has no residency or regional clause of its own
points.text_zh: 转售档的地域结论与直连档相同，因为适用的是同一份 DPST v1.3（经 TOS for OpenRouter Customers v4.6 的 URL Terms 定义并入）＋ SST v5.0「Data Location」。该档没有任何专门的驻留或地域条款

points.text: How OpenRouter routes to which Crusoe facility is not explained in the public documentation.
points.text_zh: OpenRouter 侧如何路由到 Crusoe 的哪个机房，公开文档未说明。

role.quote: Crusoe is a processor of that Customer Personal Data under European Data Protection Law

points.text: The role on the resale tier has two layers, not reconciled: (1) For OpenRouter's customer, Crusoe's DPST v1.3 still says "Crusoe is a processor of that Customer Personal Data" — but the direct counterparty to that agreement is "the entity or person agreeing to these terms" (OpenRouter's customer), while Customer Data is defined as what "Crusoe may receive from OpenRouter", so OpenRouter still stands between Crusoe and the end customer
points.text_zh: 转售档角色分两层，不调和：(1) 对 OpenRouter 的客户而言，Crusoe 的 DPST v1.3 仍写「Crusoe is a processor of that Customer Personal Data」——但这份协议的直接签约相对方是「the entity or person agreeing to these terms」（即 OpenRouter 的客户），而 Customer Data 被定义为「Crusoe may receive from OpenRouter」，即 Crusoe 与终端客户之间还隔着 OpenRouter
points.quote: “**Customer Data**” means Input, Output, and any personal data about Customer that Crusoe may receive from OpenRouter, and excludes Service Data.

points.text: The terms do not say whether Crusoe is processor or sub-processor relative to the end customer. (2) OpenRouter's own role in the chain (whether it passes requests to Crusoe as a controller) has to be checked separately and was not covered this round. That is why confidence is medium.
points.text_zh: 条款未说明 Crusoe 相对于终端客户是 processor 还是 sub-processor。(2) OpenRouter 自身在其链路中的角色（它是否以 controller 身份向 Crusoe 传递请求）需另核，本轮未纳入。置信度 medium 的原因即在此。

training.quote: Cloud Agents run in [Privacy Mode](https://cursor.com/privacy-overview). With Privacy Mode on, Cursor never trains on code accessed by Cloud Agents or on the prompts and responses their runs generate.

points.text: 官方这句话是有前提的：「With Privacy Mode on, Cursor never trains…」。之所以对 Teams 判默认不训练，是因为 Teams 的 Privacy Mode 默认对全体成员开启、管理员还能强制到成员关不掉——前提本身有文档兜底，不是 Cloud Agent 自带的属性。
points.text_zh: 官方这句话是有前提的：「With Privacy Mode on, Cursor never trains…」。之所以对 Teams 判默认不训练，是因为 Teams 的 Privacy Mode 默认对全体成员开启、管理员还能强制到成员关不掉——前提本身有文档兜底，不是 Cloud Agent 自带的属性。
points.quote: For teams, Privacy Mode is enabled by default for all team members. Admins can enforce it organization-wide via [cursor.com/dashboard](https://cursor.com/dashboard) so members cannot disable it.

zdr.quote: VM snapshots | Point-in-time copies of the VM disk (including cloned code) used to start and resume without recloning | Snapshot and cache layer outside the active VM, encrypted | Rolling 90 days of inactivity; each start or resume extends it, then automatic deletion

points.text: 模型提供商多数走 ZDR，但托管 Agent 本身必须把完整仓库放入 Cursor 云 VM，并在 Cursor 后端保存对话状态、元数据与 artifacts，因此端到端不是零保留。
points.text_zh: 模型提供商多数走 ZDR，但托管 Agent 本身必须把完整仓库放入 Cursor 云 VM，并在 Cursor 后端保存对话状态、元数据与 artifacts，因此端到端不是零保留。

retention.summary: 按对象分列保留 90 天

points.text: The Privacy Policy that governs individual plans states the general rule — Inputs and Suggestions are not used to train our models — together with three exceptions: security review flags, explicit reports (Feedback), and explicit agreement. points.quote: We do not use Inputs or Suggestions to train our models, or permit third parties to use them for training, unless: (1) they are flagged for security review (in which case we may analyze them to improve our ability to detect and enforce our Terms of Service), (2) you explicitly report them to us (for example, as Feedback), or (3) you’ve explicitly agreed to their use for such training purposes.

points.text: The contract layer is the highest authority for this tier, and its only clause authorizing Anysphere to process data to enhance the Service covers Usage Data — technical logs, data, and learnings about your use of the Service — and states that it excludes Content. It therefore neither rebuts nor reinforces the Content-training verdict; a buyer asking whether technical logs and learnings feed model improvement has to read this clause, not the training column.

points.text: 代码库索引其实有两条并存的数据流，官方从未澄清二者关系：docs 的 Instant Grep 在本机建索引、不上传代码；官方 blog 描述的服务端语义索引则会在新代码库上 uploads every file，把变更文件切成 syntactic chunks 转成 embeddings 存入服务端索引，并可在同团队内复用他人的索引。该服务端索引的保留期限官方未公布。因此「不留存」这个结论只覆盖模型请求路径，不覆盖代码库索引——采购若在意整库上传，必须单独谈这一条。

points.text: The consumer contract's only clause touching deletion of Content makes it discretionary: upon termination Anysphere may at our option delete any Content or other data associated with your account. That is a permission, not a deletion commitment, and it sets no period — it does not extend or undercut the no-retention basis recorded for model requests, it only shows that post-termination data handling carries no guarantee.

points.text: The Privacy Policy that governs individual plans states the general rule — Inputs and Suggestions are not used to train our models — together with three exceptions: security review flags, explicit reports (Feedback), and explicit agreement. Turning Privacy Mode off is the act that falls under exception (3), so this tier is recorded as training-permitted on the vendor's own text, not by reading against it.
points.text_zh: 个人档适用的 Privacy Policy §2 给的是「原则不训练 + 三项例外」：安全审查标记、用户主动上报（如 Feedback）、用户明确同意。关闭 Privacy Mode 正是落入例外 (3) 的那个动作——本档记「会训练」不是对厂商文本的反读，政策原文本身就留了这条口子。
points.quote: We do not use Inputs or Suggestions to train our models, or permit third parties to use them for training, unless: (1) they are flagged for security review (in which case we may analyze them to improve our ability to detect and enforce our Terms of Service), (2) you explicitly report them to us (for example, as Feedback), or (3) you’ve explicitly agreed to their use for such training purposes.

points.text: The contract layer is the highest authority for this tier, and its only clause authorizing Anysphere to process data to enhance the Service covers Usage Data — technical logs, data, and learnings about your use of the Service — and states that it excludes Content. It therefore neither rebuts nor reinforces the Content-training verdict; a buyer asking whether technical logs and learnings feed model improvement has to read this clause, not the training column.
points.text_zh: 合同层是本档最高权威。ToS §5.4 是其中唯一授权 Anysphere 为「enhance the Service」处理数据的条款，对象是 Usage Data（技术日志、data、learnings），且该条自己写明 excludes Content——所以它既不推翻也不加码 Content 的训练结论（本维度问的是输入输出是否进模型）。采购若要问「技术日志和 learnings 会不会进模型改进」，看的是这一条，不是 training 列。
points.quote: Anysphere may: (i) collect, analyze, and otherwise process Usage Data internally for its business purposes, including for security and analytics, to enhance the Service, and for other development and corrective purposes; and (ii) disclose Usage Data to third parties only in an aggregated and/or de-identified form and in a manner that does not identify you. “Usage Data” means technical logs, data, and learnings about Customer’s use of and interactions with the Service, but excludes Content.

retention.quote: Provider will not retain, store, or log any Customer Data submitted to or generated by the Services beyond the period strictly necessary to process and return the applicable request, after which such Customer Data is deleted from Provider's systems in the ordinary course of operations ("**Zero Data Retention**")

points.text: Context: default online inference. The Section 7(b) Zero Data Retention commitment says Customer Data is not retained, stored, or logged beyond the period strictly necessary to process and return the request, after which it is deleted from Provider's systems; the docs page says the same for inference APIs.
points.text_zh: 语境=默认在线推理。主证据用合同 §7(b) 的 Zero Data Retention 句：Customer Data 不留存超过「处理并返回该请求所严格必需的期间」，之后从系统删除；docs /account/data-privacy 同旨（输入不落盘、只在推理期留内存、完成即从内存删除，输出同理）。期限类型=不保留／处理完即删除。
points.quote: we do not store the data you submit to our APIs on disk. We only hold it in memory during the inference process. Once inference is complete, the data is deleted from memory

points.text: Exception 1 — outputs of image generation models are stored for a short period of time to allow easy access; no length is quantified.
points.text_zh: 例外①图片生成输出：「Outputs of image generation models are stored for a short period of time to allow easy access」——短期存储，具体期限未量化。
points.quote: Outputs of image generation models are stored for a short period of time to allow easy access (e.g., for the model demo page)

points.text: Exception 2 — bulk inference (several requests in one call): data may be stored for a longer period, potentially on disk in encrypted form, and is deleted from disk and memory after a short retention period once results are returned.
points.text_zh: 例外②批量推理：可能「store data for a longer period, potentially on disk in encrypted form」，结果返回后「deleted from disk and memory after a short retention period」——加密落盘 + 短期，期限未量化。
points.quote: we may need to store data for a longer period, potentially on disk in encrypted form. Once inference is complete and results are returned to you, the data is deleted from disk and memory after a short retention period

points.text: Exception 3 — logs: DeepInfra generally does not log the content of requests and logs only metadata, but reserves the right to log a small portion of requests for debugging or security.
points.text_zh: 例外③日志：默认只记元数据（request ID、cost、sampling parameters），但「reserve the right to log a small portion of requests when necessary for debugging or security purposes」——对象是访问日志、不是输入输出正文，上限未量化。
points.quote: We generally do not log the content of your requests. We log metadata useful for debugging: request ID, cost, sampling parameters. We reserve the right to log a small portion of requests when necessary for debugging or security purposes

points.text: Exception 4 — Google / Anthropic models: the output is stored by the receiving company under its own policy, and DeepInfra quantifies no period.

points.quote: If you opt to use a Google model, Google will store the output as outlined in their [Privacy Notice](https://cloud.google.com/terms/cloud-privacy-notice)

points.text: Exception 5 — Google models: Google logs prompts and responses for a limited period solely to detect violations of its Prohibited Use Policy, so the input side is recorded upstream as well.

points.text: Requests of this subset have to be transferred to the upstream endpoints to be fulfilled, and the docs page discloses that the upstream hop retains: Google stores the output of Google models and Anthropic the output of Anthropic models, and Google additionally logs prompts and responses for a limited period. Under the ledger's multi-hop rule — one hop that clearly does not retain zero makes the whole chain non-ZDR — this subset has no end-to-end zero retention.
points.text_zh: 本档请求必须转到上游端点才能完成，而 docs /account/data-privacy 明示上游一跳会留存：Google 模型下「Google will store the output as outlined in their Privacy Notice」，Anthropic 模型下同理；且 Google 还会为检测其禁用政策违规记录 prompts 与 responses 一段时间。按多跳口径「任一跳明确为否，则全链为否」记 mark=no。

points.text: The contract points the other way and is kept alongside: Section 5(a) says the Section 7(b) Zero Data Retention commitment controls over the Privacy Policy and any other Provider policy, webpage, or documentation and applies to all Customer Data, and the Section 7(b) exception list does not name Google or Anthropic. retention.quote: All container data is permanently lost when terminated. Save your work before stopping.

points.text: 结论：本档没有请求级的量化保留期，官方只给出一条容器级的事实。(a) GPU 实例租用这一半：docs /gpu-instances/overview「All container data is permanently lost when terminated. Save your work before stopping.」——对象是客户自己写进容器的数据（经 SSH 上传的权重、数据集、训练产物、容器内日志），语境是默认，期限类型是事件触发：容器存续期间数据一直留在 DeepInfra 的机器上，销毁时永久丢失，何时销毁由客户决定，官方不另设期限。(b) 私有模型部署这一半：docs /private-models/overview 全页只有一句隔离性表述「data stays on dedicated infrastructure, not shared with other users」，讲的是不与其他租户共享，不是期限

points.text: Operational access path (circumstantial): the Terms of Use §3.4 gives DeepSeek the right to review user behaviour and information in order to meet statutory duties, expressly including reviewing inputs and outputs, building risk-filtering mechanisms and building a database of illegal-content characteristics. Request content is therefore visible to and processed by the vendor on the service side and may enter an illegal-content feature database — this points the same way as "no zero retention". It is support only and sets no retention period.
points.text_zh: 运营性访问路径（佐证）：用户协议 §3.4 为履行法定义务赋予深度求索对用户使用本服务的行为及信息进行审查的权利，明文包括对输入和输出进行审查、建立风险过滤机制、建立违法内容特征库。请求内容因此在服务侧对厂商可见、会被厂商侧处理，并可能进入违法内容特征库，与「不支持零保留」同向。仅作佐证，不构成任何保留期限。

points.text: Legal-obligation exception, not a retention period: the Open Platform Terms of Service §7.2 states that records relating to suspected breaches of law or suspected criminal conduct will be kept and reported to the competent authorities, and the Terms of Use §2.5(1) keeps DeepSeek's right, after an account is cancelled, to retain the user's registration data and previous behaviour records as required by laws and regulations. Both are exception contexts only: the object is account data and behaviour records, not input/output content, and no period is given, so object=input_output / basis=undisclosed stand and no retention period for request content can be inferred from them.
points.text_zh: 法定义务例外，不是保留期限：开放平台服务协议 §7.2 写明对涉嫌违反法律法规、涉嫌违法犯罪的行为将保存有关记录，并依法向有关主管部门报告、配合有关主管部门调查；用户协议 §2.5(1) 保留深度求索在用户注销账号后按照法律法规的要求保留该用户的注册数据及以前的行为记录的权利。两条都只构成例外语境：对象是账号数据与行为记录、不是输入输出正文，且期限未定，故本档 object=input_output / basis=undisclosed 不变，也不能据此推出请求内容的保留期。

points.text: Processing location is undisclosed, and no region code is asserted for this tier. The two contracts that cover it contain no processing-location or cross-border clause: the Open Platform Terms of Service §9.1 only states that the agreement is governed by the law of mainland China (choice of law and jurisdiction, not a processing location), and the Terms of Use contain no processing-location or cross-border-transfer clause at all. The "stored within China" sentence cited elsewhere comes from the DeepSeek Privacy Policy, which is not registered as a source in this file and has no snapshot in this repository, so it cannot be re-checked — and its object is personal information, not the processing location of API business content.

points.text: The role is layered, and kind=processor describes the end-user-data chain position only. For end-user data the developer is the processor and DeepSeek the entrusted party: §3.5 puts the duty on the developer to inform end users and to obtain consent for collecting/processing personal information and for entrusting DeepSeek to process it. For the developer's own personal information DeepSeek collects and processes it itself under the DeepSeek Privacy Policy (§5.5), i.e. on the controller side, and §5.5 also places end users' personal information outside that policy and puts the disclosure duty on the developer. kind=processor is therefore not an all-scenario "processor" role: §4.3 shows inputs and outputs may be used for DeepSeek's own model training and service optimisation.
points.text_zh: 角色是分层的，kind=processor 只描述终端用户数据这一链位。终端用户数据：开发者是处理者、DeepSeek 是受托方——§3.5 把告知终端用户、就收集处理个人信息以及委托深度求索处理个人信息取得同意的义务放在开发者一侧。开发者自身的个人信息：由深度求索依《DeepSeek 隐私政策》自行收集、处理（§5.5），即独立控制方一侧；§5.5 同时把终端用户的个人信息排除在该隐私政策说明范围外，并把披露义务放在开发者一侧。故 kind=processor 不等于全场景受托：§4.3 显示输入输出可能被用于深度求索自身的模型训练与服务优化。
points.quote: 我们会按照《DeepSeek隐私政策》收集、处理您作为个人信息主体在使用开放平台服务时产生和提供的个人信息。您的终端用户访问您基于开放平台开发的下游系统、应用或功能时，其被收集的个人信息的处理规则不在该隐私政策的说明范围内，您作为该场景下个人信息处理活动的处理者应当向终端用户披露相关个人信息保护规则

training.quote: If you are an Enterprise customer, we will never train on your data without your express prior written consent.

points.text: Contract-level support for the same conclusion: 『Licensor’s subprocessors are subject to equivalent restrictions through contractual obligations or technical configurations that prevent Customer Data from being used for model training purposes.』 (DPA §4) This binds the upstream model providers listed in Appendix C — OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft/Azure, Google/Vertex and the others — i.e. the next hop of the chain, not Cognition alone.
points.text_zh: 同一结论的合同层依据：『Licensor’s subprocessors are subject to equivalent restrictions through contractual obligations or technical configurations that prevent Customer Data from being used for model training purposes.』（DPA §4）——该条约束 Appendix C 列出的上游模型商（OpenAI、Anthropic、Microsoft/Azure、Google/Vertex 等），即多跳链路的下一跳，而不只是 Cognition 自己。
points.quote: Licensor’s subprocessors are subject to equivalent restrictions through contractual obligations or technical configurations that prevent Customer Data from being used for model training purposes.

points.text: Contract-level purpose limitation: 『For clarity, as Data Processor, Licensor will not sell or share Customer Data, nor will Licensor use, disclose, retain, or otherwise process Customer Data (i) for a purpose other than the specific purpose of providing the Services; (ii) outside of the direct business relationship between Licensor and Customer and the written instructions received from Customer; and (iii) in a manner inconsistent with applicable Data Protection Laws.』 (DPA §3) This also bounds retention, not just training.
points.text_zh: 合同层的用途限制：『For clarity, as Data Processor, Licensor will not sell or share Customer Data, nor will Licensor use, disclose, retain, or otherwise process Customer Data (i) for a purpose other than the specific purpose of providing the Services; (ii) outside of the direct business relationship between Licensor and Customer and the written instructions received from Customer; and (iii) in a manner inconsistent with applicable Data Protection Laws.』（DPA §3）——既禁止为提供服务之外的目的使用，也禁止超目的保留。
points.quote: For clarity, as Data Processor, Licensor will not sell or share Customer Data, nor will Licensor use, disclose, retain, or otherwise process Customer Data (i) for a purpose other than the specific purpose of providing the Services; (ii) outside of the direct business relationship between Licensor and Customer and the written instructions received from Customer; and (iii) in a manner inconsistent with applicable Data Protection Laws.

points.text: The no-training commitment does not isolate the project: 『Devin can still learn to fit into your unique workflow via the Knowledge feature. When you share Knowledge, Devin can become more reliable at working on your specific projects over time.』 The official text does not say whether shared Knowledge counts as training.
points.text_zh: 不训练不等于完全隔离：『Devin can still learn to fit into your unique workflow via the Knowledge feature. When you share Knowledge, Devin can become more reliable at working on your specific projects over time.』——Devin 仍可基于客户共享的 Knowledge 持续适配其项目；官方未进一步界定共享的 Knowledge 内容是否属于训练范围。
points.quote: Devin can still learn to fit into your unique workflow via the Knowledge feature. When you share Knowledge, Devin can become more reliable at working on your specific projects over time.

zdr.quote: By default, we may use your data for model training purposes to improve and enhance the Services. If you’re on a paid plan, you can opt out at any time on the Data Controls settings page. After you opt out, your data will not be used for training and Zero Data Retention will be enabled with our model providers.

points.text: Enterprise is a paid plan, so the paid-plan sentence covers it: 『If you're on a paid plan, you can opt out at any time on the Data Controls settings page. After you opt out, your data will not be used for training and Zero Data Retention will be enabled with our model providers.』 Two qualifications: the object of that ZDR is the upstream model providers (the next hop), while retention on the Cognition side is the retention dimension's subject; and the page describes the Data Controls opt-out without writing a separate enterprise-only ZDR mechanism — its enterprise-specific sentence is the no-training-without-written-consent commitment, which is a contract path and does not by itself define ZDR. The page adds that on the Teams plan only an administrator can exercise the opt-out; the enterprise tier is not separately described.

retention.quote: Upon termination of this DPA, Licensor will direct each Subprocessor to delete Customer Data within thirty (30) days of the termination, unless prohibited by law.

points.text: Contract level (highest authority) fixes the post-termination deletion window: 『Upon termination of this DPA, Licensor will direct each Subprocessor to delete Customer Data within thirty (30) days of the termination, unless prohibited by law.』 (DPA §11) That is an upper bound on deletion after termination.
points.text_zh: 合同层（权威性最高）给出终止后的删除期限：『Upon termination of this DPA, Licensor will direct each Subprocessor to delete Customer Data within thirty (30) days of the termination, unless prohibited by law.』（DPA §11）——终止后 30 天内指示各 subprocessor 删除 Customer Data，属终止后删除的上限。

points.text: Carve-out in the next sentence of §11: 『To the extent Licensor is required to retain any Customer Data to comply with applicable legal or regulatory obligations, including record retention requirements, Licensor will isolate and protect such data for further processing and delete it as soon as such obligations are satisfied.』
points.text_zh: §11 紧接的例外：依法必须留存的 Customer Data（含记录留存要求）会被隔离保护、仅供该目的处理，并在义务满足后尽快删除。
points.quote: To the extent Licensor is required to retain any Customer Data to comply with applicable legal or regulatory obligations, including record retention requirements, Licensor will isolate and protect such data for further processing and delete it as soon as such obligations are satisfied.

points.text: Security-page FAQ (auxiliary, lower authority than the DPA): 『Cognition only retains data processed through Devin for the duration of the relationship with a given Customer, unless otherwise specified by the Customers.』
points.text_zh: 安全页 FAQ（辅助说明，权威性低于 DPA）：『Cognition only retains data processed through Devin for the duration of the relationship with a given Customer, unless otherwise specified by the Customers.』

points.text: Exception sitting in the same FAQ answer: 『Any Feedback Data and User Interaction Data are retained as long as needed and as determined by Cognition.』 For those two objects there is no fixed period and no relationship-end bound — the duration is Cognition's call.

points.text: Exception in the same DPA: the processor role covers Customer Data only. 『Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this DPA, the parties acknowledge and agree that Licensor may process Account Data as a Data Controller solely to (a) manage and administer its relationship with Customer, including business user access management and account provisioning; (b) detect, prevent, or investigate security incidents, fraud, and other abuse or misuse of the Services; and (c) comply with applicable legal or regulatory obligations.』 (DPA §2.b) Account Data is therefore handled as an independent controller.

points.quote: We clone the repository in order to create the index, but once we finish creating embeddings for the codebase we delete all the code and code snippets assuming that the Store Snippets setting is unchecked. We don’t persist anything other than the embeddings themselves, from which you cannot derive the original code.

points.text: The same AI data privacy page covers the agent scenario (including "We do not store agent input or output when using third-party model providers."), and the no-training statement applies equally

points.text: There is no separate contract-layer no-training clause on the knowledge base or agent side.
points.text_zh: 知识库/agent 侧无单独的合同层不训练条款。

points.text: Contract-layer boundary (TOS §4.3), the same as the API tier: "We may use Usage Data and other information about how you use and interact with the Services to provide, maintain, and improve our Services." Under docs/judgment.md this is a service-improvement opening, but the same sentence carves Usage Data out of Services Content, so mark=yes stands. Whether "other information about how you use and interact with the Services" reaches agent prompts or knowledge base content is not defined in the text
points.text_zh: 合同层边界(TOS §4.3),同 API 档:「We may use Usage Data and other information about how you use and interact with the Services to provide, maintain, and improve our Services.」按 docs/judgment.md 这是服务改进口子,但同句已把 Usage Data 排除在 Services Content 之外,故 mark=yes 维持。该句是否涵盖 agent prompt 或知识库内容,原文未界定
points.quote: We may use Usage Data and other information about how you use and interact with the Services to provide, maintain, and improve our Services.

points.text: Third-party model hop: "Data sent to other third-party model providers is handled according to the applicable provider's policies." The no-training mark covers DigitalOcean-hosted models; on the third-party path the outcome is decided by the upstream provider and DigitalOcean commits to nothing itself
points.text_zh: 第三方模型跳:「Data sent to other third-party model providers is handled according to the applicable provider's policies.」不训练的 mark 只覆盖 DO 托管模型;走第三方模型时结果由上游 provider 的政策决定,DO 自己不作承诺
points.quote: Data sent to other third-party model providers is handled according to the applicable provider’s policies.

points.text: DigitalOcean expressly excludes only the Files API from ZDR eligibility and takes no position on whether ZDR applies to the knowledge base or to agent session storage. The knowledge base is cross-request persistent storage (the same shape as the Files API), but the vendor makes no corresponding statement, so this is recorded with low confidence and marked undisclosed rather than concluded on the vendor's behalf.
points.text_zh: DO 只明确排除 Files API 的 ZDR 资格,对知识库/agent 会话存储是否适用 ZDR 未表态。知识库属跨请求持久化存储(与 Files API 同类形态),但厂商未作对应声明,故记低置信并标注未披露,不代替厂商下结论。

points.text: The clause previously bound here ("We do not store agent input or output when using third-party model providers.") covers only third-party-model-provider agent traffic, while this product's knowledge base is cross-request persistent storage that the vendor leaves unaddressed (and whose shape matches the Files API it does exclude from ZDR), so the clause is not a statement covering this tier and is no longer bound. The clause itself is still cited in this product's training points, whose verdict carries a different anchor.
points.text_zh: 原先绑在本条的引文（「We do not store agent input or output when using third-party model providers.」）只覆盖走第三方模型 provider 的 agent 流量，而本产品的知识库属跨请求持久化存储、厂商未表态（其形态与厂商已排除 ZDR 资格的 Files API 同类），不构成覆盖本档的表述，故不再绑在本条；该引文在本档 training 条目的 point 里仍被引用（那条的 anchor 是另一个）。

points.text: Multi-hop boundary, recorded without an anchor because it does not answer this dimension's question: on the third-party-model path the applicable upstream provider's policies govern ("Data sent to other third-party model providers is handled according to the applicable provider's policies.", bound in this product's training dimension), and DigitalOcean may share usage information that does not include Services Content with that provider. None of it says whether ZDR applies to the knowledge base or to agent session storage, which is what this verdict leaves undisclosed
points.text_zh: 多跳边界,本条不绑锚点,因为这些话没有回答本维度的问题:走第三方模型时适用上游 provider 的政策(「Data sent to other third-party model providers is handled according to the applicable provider's policies.」,已绑在本档 training 维度),且 DO 可把不含 Services Content 的使用信息交给该 provider。这些都没有说明 ZDR 是否适用于知识库或 agent 会话存储 —— 那正是本判定留作未披露的问题

points.text: Scope note on the shared inference path (clause bound in this file's api-tier retention points, not here): the cache exception is not uniformly bounded — for open-source models prompt caches are "held for an unbounded period of time" and cannot be switched off. Recorded as scope information only; it is not a statement about the knowledge base or agent session storage
points.text_zh: 共用推理路径上的范围说明(该句锚点绑在本文件的 api 档 retention,不在本条):缓存例外并非统一有界 —— 开源模型的 prompt 缓存「held for an unbounded period of time」且无法关闭。此处只作范围说明,不是关于知识库或 agent 会话存储的表述

points.text: Knowledge base: data sources are immediately indexed into vector embeddings and stored persistently in the customer's own Managed OpenSearch database until an explicit destroy, when all of it is "irreversibly and permanently deleted"

points.text: Only the 15 most recent indexing job logs are kept
points.text_zh: 索引任务日志只留最近 15 条

points.text: Agent conversation context is read by the agent from browser storage (data privacy page). The retention period for agent run logs and traces is not disclosed — nothing is inferred in reverse.
points.text_zh: agent 对话上下文由 agent 从浏览器存储读取(数据隐私页)。agent 运行日志与 traces 的保留期限未披露 —— 不反推。

points.text: Regional availability table: Agent Platform is limited to TOR1 (Toronto), ATL1 (Atlanta) and RIC1 (Richmond)
points.text_zh: 区域可用性表:Agent Platform 仅 TOR1(多伦多)、ATL1(亚特兰大)、RIC1(里士满)

points.text: Dedicated Inference/BYOM additionally includes NYC2.
points.text_zh: Dedicated Inference/BYOM 另含 NYC2。

role.quote: | Customer stores end-user data on DigitalOcean Services. | DigitalOcean is a Processor. Customer is a Controller or processor to a controller. |

points.text: Same as the API tier: when the customer stores end-user data, DigitalOcean is a Processor (DPA Schedule 1).
points.text_zh: 同 API 档:客户存 end-user 数据时 DO 为 Processor(DPA Schedule 1)。

training.quote: DigitalOcean does not use this data to train, retrain, or fine-tune any model, and does not share it with any third parties for training or fine-tuning.

points.text: DigitalOcean-hosted models: "DigitalOcean does not use this data to train, retrain, or fine-tune any model, and does not share it with any third parties for training or fine-tuning." and "Customer data submitted to the model is never sent back to the original model creator, so the creator cannot use it for training." At the contract layer there is only a narrow no-training commitment (Service Terms §7.2.2 covers Evaluation Datasets and Evaluation Outputs only), with no clause covering all inference content — recorded as such.
points.text_zh: DO 自托管模型:「DigitalOcean does not use this data to train, retrain, or fine-tune any model, and does not share it with any third parties for training or fine-tuning.」且「Customer data submitted to the model is never sent back to the original model creator」。合同层只有窄口径不训练承诺(Service Terms §7.2.2 仅覆盖 Evaluation Datasets/Outputs),无覆盖全部推理内容的合同条款 —— 已如实标注。

points.text: Contract-layer boundary (TOS §4.3): "We may use Usage Data and other information about how you use and interact with the Services to provide, maintain, and improve our Services." Under docs/judgment.md (using data to improve the service counts as training) this is the contract layer's service-improvement opening, and the same sentence carves Usage Data (resource identifiers, metadata, access controls, rules, usage policies, permissions, system logs, metrics, configurations and similar items) out of Services Content, so it does not overturn mark=yes. Whether "other information about how you use and interact with the Services" reaches prompt bodies is not defined in the text — recorded as stated, not narrowed on the vendor's behalf
points.text_zh: 合同层边界(TOS §4.3):「We may use Usage Data and other information about how you use and interact with the Services to provide, maintain, and improve our Services.」按 docs/judgment.md 的口径(用于改进服务算训练),这是合同层的服务改进口子;同句已把 Usage Data(资源标识、元数据、访问控制、规则、使用政策、权限、系统日志、指标、配置等)排除在 Services Content 之外,故不推翻 mark=yes。「其他关于你如何使用/交互服务的信息」是否涵盖 prompt 正文,原文未界定 —— 如实记录,不替厂商收窄
points.quote: We may use Usage Data and other information about how you use and interact with the Services to provide, maintain, and improve our Services.

points.text: The same shape appears once more on the Evaluations side: Service Terms §7.2.3 lets DigitalOcean process anonymized, aggregated telemetry "to maintain and improve the performance and reliability of the Service", expressly excluding Evaluation Datasets and Evaluation Outputs
points.text_zh: 同类表述在 Evaluations 侧还有一处:Service Terms §7.2.3 允许为「to maintain and improve the performance and reliability of the Service」处理匿名聚合遥测,并明文排除 Evaluation Datasets 与 Evaluation Outputs
points.quote: To maintain and improve the performance and reliability of the Service, we may process anonymized, aggregated telemetry data (e.g., latency, throughput).

points.text: Third-party model hop: "Data sent to other third-party model providers is handled according to the applicable provider's policies." The no-training mark covers DigitalOcean-hosted models; on the third-party path DigitalOcean makes no commitment of its own and the outcome is decided by the upstream provider (see this product's zdr points for the upstream regimes)
points.text_zh: 第三方模型跳:「Data sent to other third-party model providers is handled according to the applicable provider's policies.」不训练的 mark 只覆盖 DO 托管模型;走第三方模型时 DO 不作承诺,结果由上游 provider 的政策决定(上游各自的口径见本档 zdr 的 point)
points.quote: Data sent to other third-party model providers is handled according to the applicable provider’s policies.

zdr.quote: We do not store inputs or outputs on DigitalOcean infrastructure for any models.

points.text: DigitalOcean has no ZDR program, application path or contractual commitment. The source text uses the term ZDR only in an exclusion context (the Files API "does not qualify for Zero Data Retention (ZDR) frameworks"). What is verifiable is architectural: "We do not store inputs or outputs on DigitalOcean infrastructure for any models." plus, for third-party models, "We do not store agent input or output when using third-party model providers.", overlaid with the cache, Batch, Files and Claude Fable exceptions (the cache exception is not uniformly bounded: the automatic cache for open-source models has no stated ceiling). It is therefore recorded as "inputs and outputs are not stored on the DigitalOcean side by default", which is not a ZDR service that can be applied for
points.text_zh: DO 没有 ZDR 计划/申请入口/合同承诺。原文只在排除语境使用 ZDR 术语(Files API「does not qualify for Zero Data Retention (ZDR) frameworks」)。可核实的表述是架构性的「We do not store inputs or outputs on DigitalOcean infrastructure for any models.」+ 第三方模型「We do not store agent input or output when using third-party model providers.」,再叠加缓存/Batch/Files/Claude Fable 例外(缓存例外并非统一有界:开源模型的自动缓存无公布上限)。因此记为「DO 侧默认不存输入输出」,不等于可申请的 ZDR 服务

points.text: Exception — Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Fable 5: "access requires a mandatory 30-day data retention of prompts and completions for trust and safety reviews", and DigitalOcean routes such traffic upstream to a compliant workspace automatically. It is a model-level precondition of access that the customer cannot switch off, carried by the upstream compliant workspace, so the "nothing stored on the DigitalOcean side by default" position does not hold for these models
points.text_zh: 例外——Claude Fable 5.1 / Fable 5:「access requires a mandatory 30-day data retention of prompts and completions for trust and safety reviews」,且 DO 自动把这类流量路由到上游合规 workspace。这是模型级的访问前置条件、客户无法关闭,由上游合规 workspace 承担,故「DO 侧默认不存输入输出」对这些模型不成立
points.quote: access requires a mandatory 30-day data retention of prompts and completions for trust and safety reviews

points.text: Multi-hop data flow: "In addition, we may share information, that does not include your Services Content, about your use of a Third-Party AI Model on the Gradient AI Platform Service with the provider of that Third-Party AI Model", and for Evaluations "DigitalOcean may share usage metadata (excluding your Services Content) with the relevant model provider for billing or abuse-detection purposes". This is a flow of usage information, not of content, and it does not change the role analysis, which rests on DPA Schedule 1
points.text_zh: 多跳信息流:「In addition, we may share information, that does not include your Services Content, about your use of a Third-Party AI Model on the Gradient AI Platform Service with the provider of that Third-Party AI Model」;Evaluations 侧同旨「DigitalOcean may share usage metadata (excluding your Services Content) with the relevant model provider for billing or abuse-detection purposes」。这是使用信息的流向而非内容,不改变角色定性(角色以 DPA Schedule 1 为准)
points.quote: we may share information, that does not include your Services Content, about your use of a Third-Party AI Model on the Gradient AI Platform Service with the provider of that Third-Party AI Model

points.text: Third-party model hop: "Data sent to other third-party model providers is handled according to the applicable provider's policies." For that hop DigitalOcean commits to nothing itself — training and retention are decided by the upstream provider, and the upstream regimes are named on the same page (OpenAI and Anthropic, see the next two points)
points.text_zh: 第三方模型跳:「Data sent to other third-party model providers is handled according to the applicable provider's policies.」这一跳 DO 自己不作任何承诺 —— 训练与保留由上游 provider 决定,同页也点名了上游各自的口径(OpenAI 与 Anthropic,见下面两条)
points.quote: Data sent to other third-party model providers is handled according to the applicable provider’s policies.

points.text: Upstream hop, OpenAI models: "OpenAI’s zero data retention policy" applies — it excludes customer content from abuse monitoring logs and treats the store parameter for /v1/responses and /v1/chat/completions as false, while certain endpoints may still store limited application state
points.text_zh: 上游一跳,OpenAI 模型:适用「OpenAI’s zero data retention policy」—— 客户内容被排除在滥用监控日志之外,store 参数按 false 处理,但某些端点仍可能保留有限的应用状态
points.quote: OpenAI’s zero data retention policy

points.text: Upstream hop, Anthropic models: "Anthropic applies a Zero Retention Policy" and deletes prompts and outputs after generation, except where required by law or to address malicious use; Anthropic may run risk classification models on prompts and outputs
points.text_zh: 上游一跳,Anthropic 模型:「Anthropic applies a Zero Retention Policy」,生成后即删除 prompts 与 outputs,法律要求或处理恶意使用时除外;Anthropic 可能对 prompts/outputs 跑风险分类模型
points.quote: Anthropic applies a Zero Retention Policy

points.text: The earlier record of zdr=available/default is downgraded accordingly.
points.text_zh: 旧记录 zdr=available/default 的口径据此下调。

retention.summary: 按对象分列保留 30 天
retention.quote: | Output and error result files | 29-30 days from job completion |

points.text: The tier-level "30 days" is composite, not one uniform rule: it is the Batch output/error file window (29-30 days from job completion), the mandatory 30-day retention that comes with Claude Fable 5/5.1, and the upper limit for deleting Personal Data after account de-activation (DPA §7.6). The default position is still that inputs and outputs are not stored on DigitalOcean infrastructure, so "30 days" must not be read as "everything is kept for 30 days"
points.text_zh: 档位级的「30 天」是拼出来的,不是单一规则:Batch 输出/错误文件窗口(批次完成起算 29-30 天)、Claude Fable 5/5.1 附带的强制 30 天、账户停用后删除 Personal Data 的 30 天上限(DPA §7.6)。默认口径仍是 DO 自有基础设施不存输入输出,故「30 天」不得读成「所有内容都留 30 天」

points.text: Object × period: (1) default — "We do not store inputs or outputs on DigitalOcean infrastructure for any models." (an architectural statement)
points.text_zh: 对象×期限:①默认——DO 自有基础设施不存输入输出(架构性表述)

points.text: (2) prefix / KV cache — for OpenAI models prompt_cache_retention is in_memory or 24h, for Anthropic models ttl is 5m (default) or 1h, and caches are isolated per customer account. The cache object is not uniformly bounded: on the same page "Prompt caches are held for an unbounded period of time." sits under Open-Source Models (public), where caching is automatic for models such as DeepSeek V3.2 and needs no cache_control or prompt_cache_retention, and the only opt-out is X-Model-Affinity: none — "You can’t opt out for older OpenAI models or DigitalOcean-hosted models."
points.text_zh: ②前缀/KV 缓存——OpenAI 模型 24h 或内存内,Anthropic 模型 5m(默认)/1h,缓存按账户隔离。缓存对象并非统一有界:同页「Prompt caches are held for an unbounded period of time.」位于开源模型(public)段,该处 DeepSeek V3.2 一类模型自动缓存、无需 cache_control/prompt_cache_retention,唯一退出方式是 X-Model-Affinity: none,而「You can’t opt out for older OpenAI models or DigitalOcean-hosted models.」
points.quote: Prompt caches are held for an unbounded period of time.

points.text: (2b) opt-out limits — automatic caching can be switched off only with the X-Model-Affinity: none header, and that opt-out "works for Anthropic models and OpenAI models GPT-5.6 and newer"; older OpenAI models and DigitalOcean-hosted models cannot opt out
points.text_zh: (2b) 退出限制——自动缓存只能用 X-Model-Affinity: none 关闭,且该退出「works for Anthropic models and OpenAI models GPT-5.6 and newer」;较旧的 OpenAI 模型与 DO 托管模型无法退出
points.quote: You can’t opt out for older OpenAI models or DigitalOcean-hosted models.

points.text: (3) Batch — output and error result files 29-30 days from job completion (the how-to says up to 30 days), prompts and request content "Not stored for training or any purpose beyond the current batch job", policy-violating content kept as evidence for up to 1 year. The 29-30 days is the window for this sub-object and starts at job completion, not a tier-wide period
points.text_zh: ③Batch——输出与错误文件 29-30 天(how-to 写 up to 30 days,起算点是批次任务完成),prompts/请求内容仅为当前批次任务不存储,违规内容证据最多 1 年。29-30 天是这个子对象的窗口,不是档位级期限
points.quote: | Output and error result files | 29-30 days from job completion |

points.text: (4) Files API (/v1/files) — retained statefully across requests until an explicit, authenticated DELETE request is executed
points.text_zh: ④Files API(/v1/files)——跨请求持久保存至显式 DELETE
points.quote: They are retained statefully on the upstream infrastructure until an explicit, authenticated `DELETE` request is executed via the API.

points.text: (5) Claude Fable 5/5.1 — access requires a mandatory 30-day data retention of prompts and completions; it is a model-level condition of access rather than a storage option the customer picks, and DigitalOcean routes it upstream to a compliant workspace, so it is not a DigitalOcean-side retention rule
points.text_zh: ⑤Claude Fable 5/5.1——访问需强制 30 天保留 prompts/completions;这是模型级访问前置条件而非客户可选的存储设置,且由 DO 自动路由到上游合规 workspace,不属 DO 侧留存口径
points.quote: access requires a mandatory 30-day data retention of prompts and completions for trust and safety reviews

points.text: (6) contract layer — Service Terms §4.5.2 permits retaining relevant content and associated metadata as reasonably necessary to investigate violations
points.text_zh: ⑥合同层——Service Terms §4.5.2 允许为违规调查保留相关内容与元数据
points.quote: We may retain relevant content and associated metadata to the extent reasonably necessary for such purposes, subject to its confidentiality and security obligations.

points.text: (7) contract layer, Processor role — DPA Schedule 3 §2: "DigitalOcean retains Personal Data it collects or receives from Customer as a Processor for the duration of the Agreement and consistent with its obligations in this DPA." Object is Personal Data, context is the contract default, and the period type is the life of the agreement; it sits alongside the 30-day post-de-activation ceiling in §7.6 rather than replacing it
points.text_zh: ⑦合同层(Processor 角色)——DPA Schedule 3 §2:「DigitalOcean retains Personal Data it collects or receives from Customer as a Processor for the duration of the Agreement and consistent with its obligations in this DPA.」对象是 Personal Data,语境为合同默认,期限类型是协议存续期间;与 §7.6 的「停用后 30 天」上限并列,不互相取代
points.quote: DigitalOcean retains Personal Data it collects or receives from Customer as a Processor for the duration of the Agreement and consistent with its obligations in this DPA.

points.text: (8) DPA §7.6 — "DigitalOcean will delete all Personal Data no later than 30 days following the date of de-activation". That 30 days is an upper limit, not a guaranteed deletion
points.text_zh: ⑧DPA §7.6——「DigitalOcean will delete all Personal Data no later than 30 days following the date of de-activation」。这 30 天是上限,不是保证删除
points.quote: DigitalOcean will delete all Personal Data no later than 30 days following the date of de-activation

points.text: (9) DPA §7.6, exceptions — "Notwithstanding the foregoing, DigitalOcean may retain Personal Data as required by applicable law, or retain Personal Data it has archived on back-up systems subject to automated retention and disposal configured with such system", which it must securely isolate from any further active processing. The 30 days in (8) therefore does not cover data kept for legal requirements or archived on back-up systems
points.text_zh: ⑨DPA §7.6 例外——「Notwithstanding the foregoing, DigitalOcean may retain Personal Data as required by applicable law, or retain Personal Data it has archived on back-up systems subject to automated retention and disposal configured with such system」,且须安全隔离、不再被主动处理。故 (8) 的 30 天不覆盖法律要求保留的数据与备份系统上归档的数据
points.quote: Notwithstanding the foregoing, DigitalOcean may retain Personal Data as required by applicable law, or retain Personal Data it has archived on back-up systems subject to automated retention and disposal configured with such system

processing_region.quote: The processing location is the customer’s selected region (when available as an option), the service provider’s location listed below and/or the location of the customer’s end users in accordance with use of the service

points.text: The rule: "The processing location is the customer’s selected region (when available as an option), the service provider’s location listed below and/or the location of the customer’s end users". The AI-related subprocessor row reads "LLM Models ... AI services ... Various, based on supplier". Serverless Inference does not appear in the regional availability table and its specific processing location is not disclosed
points.text_zh: 规则:「The processing location is the customer's selected region (when available as an option), the service provider's location listed below and/or the location of the customer's end users」。AI 相关子处理者写「LLM Models … AI services … Various, based on supplier」。Serverless Inference 不在区域可用性表内,其具体处理地未披露

points.text: Dedicated Inference/BYOM is limited to NYC2/TOR1/ATL1/RIC1. SCC governing law: the member state where the EU customer is located, or the Netherlands (DPA Schedule 2/3).
points.text_zh: Dedicated Inference/BYOM 仅 NYC2/TOR1/ATL1/RIC1。SCC 管辖:欧盟客户所在成员国/荷兰(DPA Schedule 2/3)。

points.text: Customer-selected region is not a lock: "When purchasing Services, you may specify the geographic region and jurisdiction in which your Services Content will be stored", but "Unless otherwise agreed in writing between you and DigitalOcean, you agree that DigitalOcean may transfer and store your Services Content in other geographic regions or jurisdictions at its sole discretion." So codes=[selected] means selectable, not that the processing location is fixed by the customer
points.text_zh: 客户自选地域不等于锁定:「When purchasing Services, you may specify the geographic region and jurisdiction in which your Services Content will be stored」,但「Unless otherwise agreed in writing between you and DigitalOcean, you agree that DigitalOcean may transfer and store your Services Content in other geographic regions or jurisdictions at its sole discretion.」。故 codes=[selected] 只表示「可选」,不等于处理地由客户锁定
points.quote: Unless otherwise agreed in writing between you and DigitalOcean, you agree that DigitalOcean may transfer and store your Services Content in other geographic regions or jurisdictions at its sole discretion.

role.quote: | Customer stores end-user data on DigitalOcean Services. | DigitalOcean is a Processor. Customer is a Controller or processor to a controller. |

points.text: DPA §7.1: "DigitalOcean will have the obligations set forth in this Section 7 if it Processes Personal Data in its capacity as Customer’s Processor or Service Provider", and they do not apply when it acts as a Controller, Business or Third party
points.text_zh: DPA §7.1:仅当 DO 以 Customer's Processor/Service Provider 身份处理 Personal Data 时才承担 §7 义务,作为 Controller/Business/Third party 时不适用

points.text: Schedule 1 lists the scenarios one by one: "Customer stores end-user data on DigitalOcean Services. → DigitalOcean is a Processor. Customer is a Controller or processor to a controller." §7.2.1 processes Personal Data only in accordance with the customer's instructions. Note: DigitalOcean is itself a Controller for account, billing and telemetry data (the first three rows of Schedule 1), so the role cannot be recorded as processor across the board.
points.text_zh: Schedule 1 逐场景列明「Customer stores end-user data on DigitalOcean Services. → DigitalOcean is a Processor. Customer is a Controller or processor to a controller.」§7.2.1 仅按客户指示处理。注意:DO 对账户/账单/遥测数据自身是 Controller(Schedule 1 前三行),不能一律记成 processor。

points.text: GPU Droplets, Bare Metal and 1-Click Models are customer-managed infrastructure, and no model training takes place on the DigitalOcean side
points.text_zh: GPU Droplets/Bare Metal/1-Click Models 是客户自管基础设施,不存在 DO 侧模型训练行为

points.text: DigitalOcean writes no dedicated AI training clause for this tier — that is undisclosed, and must not be read in reverse as a commitment.
points.text_zh: DO 未就该档作专门的 AI 训练条款 —— 属未披露,不得反向解读为承诺。

points.text: The TOS §4.1 clause previously bound here ("we will store, host, or otherwise process … information that you provide") defines what DigitalOcean may do with Services Content, not what it does with model training, so it is not a statement on this dimension and is no longer bound.
points.text_zh: 原先绑在本条的 TOS §4.1 引文（「we will store, host, or otherwise process … information that you provide」）界定的是 DO 对 Services Content 的处置范围，不涉及模型训练，不构成对本维度的表述，故不再绑在本条。

points.text: DigitalOcean's ZDR wording appears only in the Inference product documentation (in the Files API exclusion context). On the customer-managed GPU tier there is no retention on the DigitalOcean side, but the vendor does not use the ZDR term and gives no ZDR commitment — this is undisclosed, not a vendor commitment to the contrary.
points.text_zh: DO 的 ZDR 相关表述仅出现在 Inference 产品文档(Files API 排除语境)。客户自管 GPU 档不存在 DO 侧留存,但厂商未使用 ZDR 术语、未提供 ZDR 承诺 —— 官方未披露,不是厂商承诺相反。

points.text: The clause previously bound here ("They also come with two different kinds of storage: a boot disk for persistent data and a scratch disk for non-persistent data.") describes the disks attached to a customer-managed GPU Droplet, not a zero-retention option from DigitalOcean, so it is not a statement on this dimension and is no longer bound.
points.text_zh: 原先绑在本条的引文（「They also come with two different kinds of storage: a boot disk for persistent data and a scratch disk for non-persistent data.」）说的是客户自管 GPU Droplet 自带的磁盘类型，不是 DO 提供的零保留选项，不构成对本维度的表述，故不再绑在本条。

retention.summary: 按对象分列未公布期限
retention.quote: They also come with two different kinds of storage: a boot disk for persistent data and a scratch disk for non-persistent data.

points.text: Content retention is controlled by the customer: a GPU Droplet comes with a boot disk for persistent data and a scratch disk for non-persistent data
points.text_zh: 内容保留由客户控制:GPU Droplet 自带 boot disk(持久)与 scratch disk(非持久)

points.text: At the contract layer DigitalOcean "does not promise to retain any preservations or backups of your Services Content" (TOS §4.6), and Personal Data is deleted no later than 30 days following de-activation (DPA §7.6).
points.text_zh: 合同层 DO 不承诺保留任何备份或留存(TOS §4.6),账户停用后 30 天内删除 Personal Data(DPA §7.6)。

points.text: The 30 days after de-activation is an upper limit with two exceptions in the same paragraph of DPA §7.6: retention required by applicable law, and Personal Data archived on back-up systems under automated retention and disposal, which must be securely isolated from further active processing. It is not a guarantee that everything is deleted
points.text_zh: 停用后 30 天是上限,DPA §7.6 同段另有两条例外:法律要求的保留,以及备份系统上按自动保留/销毁策略归档的 Personal Data(须安全隔离、不再被主动处理)。不能读成「一定全部删除」
points.quote: Notwithstanding the foregoing, DigitalOcean may retain Personal Data as required by applicable law, or retain Personal Data it has archived on back-up systems subject to automated retention and disposal configured with such system

processing_region.quote: DigitalOcean GPU Droplets, Spot GPU Droplets, and Bare Metal GPUs are available by GPU model and datacenter as listed below.

points.text: GPU Droplets and Bare Metal GPUs are offered by datacenter and the customer selects the datacenter (for example ATL1/AMS3/NYC2/TOR1/RIC1/MEM1)
points.text_zh: GPU Droplets/Bare Metal GPU 按机房提供,客户自选机房(如 ATL1/AMS3/NYC2/TOR1/RIC1/MEM1 等)

points.text: See the platform regional table for the datacenter list.
points.text_zh: 机房清单见平台区域表。

points.text: Datacenter choice is not a lock at the contract layer: "Unless otherwise agreed in writing between you and DigitalOcean, you agree that DigitalOcean may transfer and store your Services Content in other geographic regions or jurisdictions at its sole discretion." (TOS §4.7). codes=[selected] therefore means selectable, not customer-fixed
points.text_zh: 合同层上机房选择不等于锁定:「Unless otherwise agreed in writing between you and DigitalOcean, you agree that DigitalOcean may transfer and store your Services Content in other geographic regions or jurisdictions at its sole discretion.」(TOS §4.7)。故 codes=[selected] 只表示「可选」,不等于由客户固定
points.quote: Unless otherwise agreed in writing between you and DigitalOcean, you agree that DigitalOcean may transfer and store your Services Content in other geographic regions or jurisdictions at its sole discretion.

role.quote: | Customer stores end-user data on DigitalOcean Services. | DigitalOcean is a Processor. Customer is a Controller or processor to a controller. |

points.text: 公开文本承诺的是对话记录不上传、只留在你的设备上。要注意它承诺的边界：这一档的模型跑在法至自己的 IDC 与 UCloud 上，推理请求必然进入法至的基础设施，而「推理请求本身不落盘」这句公开文本没有单独写。判 ✓ 依据的是「不上传对话记录」这条明文，不是更强的那个意思。
points.text_zh: 公开文本承诺的是对话记录不上传、只留在你的设备上。要注意它承诺的边界：这一档的模型跑在法至自己的 IDC 与 UCloud 上，推理请求必然进入法至的基础设施，而「推理请求本身不落盘」这句公开文本没有单独写。判 ✓ 依据的是「不上传对话记录」这条明文，不是更强的那个意思。

retention.quote: 对话记录仅保存在您的本地设备，不上传至法至服务器。

points.text: 「不留存」说的是对话记录不上传法至服务器这一条。账号、订单、日志这类个人信息另按第五节「最短必要期限」保留，并受《网络安全法》网络日志不少于 6 个月的法定要求约束；这与推理内容是两件事。
points.text_zh: 「不留存」说的是对话记录不上传法至服务器这一条。账号、订单、日志这类个人信息另按第五节「最短必要期限」保留，并受《网络安全法》网络日志不少于 6 个月的法定要求约束；这与推理内容是两件事。
points.quote: 我们仅在为实现服务目的所必需的最短必要期限内保留您的个人信息。

points.text: 期限类型：§五.2 的两类例外同样适用于本档——遵从法律法规的信息留存要求（例如《网络安全法》规定网络日志不少于 6 个月，这是下限，不能反推「到期即删全部内容」）；以及出于财务、审计、争议解决等目的需要合理延长的期限（仅限所列目的）。
points.text_zh: 期限类型：§五.2 的两类例外同样适用于本档——遵从法律法规的信息留存要求（例如《网络安全法》规定网络日志不少于 6 个月，这是下限，不能反推「到期即删全部内容」）；以及出于财务、审计、争议解决等目的需要合理延长的期限（仅限所列目的）。

points.quote: 当您删除相关信息后，因安全技术限制，我们可能无法立即从备份系统中删除相应信息。我们将安全地存储该信息并限制对其的进一步处理，直到备份可以清除或实现匿名化。
