zdr.quote: SSO, SAML/SCIM provisioning, and ZDR

points.text: Business lists ZDR as a plan capability, alongside identity and audit controls — "SSO, SAML/SCIM provisioning, and ZDR" in the Business card and the Data controls row "| Data controls | — | ZDR, audit logging and activity trails | ZDR, audit logging, data residency |". It is a capability of a custom-priced plan sold through sales (the same card reads "Business · Custom pricing" / "Contact Sales"), not a self-serve switch, hence by_agreement rather than a default.
points.text_zh: Business 把 ZDR 列为套餐能力，与身份和审计控制并列——Business 卡片条目「SSO, SAML/SCIM provisioning, and ZDR」，对照表 Data controls 行「| Data controls | — | ZDR, audit logging and activity trails | ZDR, audit logging, data residency |」。它属于按需报价、经销售开通的套餐能力（同一卡片写「Business · Custom pricing」「Contact Sales」），不是自助开关，故记 by_agreement 而非默认。
points.quote: | Data controls | — | ZDR, audit logging and activity trails | ZDR, audit logging, data residency |

points.text: What the ZDR is attached to, and on what conditions: "By default, Droid can target enterprise-grade endpoints for providers like Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini, using contracts that support zero data retention and enterprise privacy controls. In these configurations, Factory routes traffic directly to the provider's official APIs; we do not proxy this traffic through third-party services or store prompts and responses in Factory cloud." In high-security settings the docs add: "Prefer the direct enterprise endpoints described above to get first-party zero-retention guarantees." The guarantee therefore covers the direct enterprise-endpoint configuration; it does not cover gateways or self-hosted models (see the next point).
points.text_zh: 这条 ZDR 挂在什么上、什么条件下：文档「By default, Droid can target enterprise-grade endpoints for providers like Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini, using contracts that support zero data retention and enterprise privacy controls. In these configurations, Factory routes traffic directly to the provider's official APIs; we do not proxy this traffic through third-party services or store prompts and responses in Factory cloud.」高安全场景另写「Prefer the direct enterprise endpoints described above to get first-party zero-retention guarantees.」即承诺覆盖直连企业级端点的配置，不覆盖网关或自建模型（见下一条）。
points.quote: In these configurations, Factory routes traffic directly to the provider's official APIs; we do not proxy this traffic through third-party services or store prompts and responses in Factory cloud.

points.text: Scope limit — own endpoints are excluded: "If you instead configure your own endpoints - LLM gateways, self-hosted models, or generic HTTP APIs - the privacy guarantees are entirely determined by those systems and your agreements with them; Factory does not add additional protections on top." On those paths retention, training and ZDR are decided by the upstream hop.
points.text_zh: 适用范围限定——自建端点被排除：「If you instead configure your own endpoints - LLM gateways, self-hosted models, or generic HTTP APIs - the privacy guarantees are entirely determined by those systems and your agreements with them; Factory does not add additional protections on top.」走这些路径时保留、训练与 ZDR 都由上游那一跳决定。
points.quote: If you instead configure your own endpoints - LLM gateways, self-hosted models, or generic HTTP APIs - the privacy guarantees are entirely determined by those systems and your agreements with them; Factory does not add additional protections on top.

points.text: Object: account-related personal data in Factory's archives — default, upper bound: "We will delete your personal data from our archives no later than 10 years from the last time you used Factory or as agreed with you in a separate contract"; a separate contract may set another term. points.quote: | Data controls | — | ZDR, audit logging and activity trails | ZDR, audit logging, data residency |

points.text: No role is stated for this tier. organizations.md describes the Business plan, its controls and its contract-based pricing but names no controller/processor role; privacy-and-data-flows describes deployment and data flow, not a role; the consumer privacy policy is a notice to individuals and its preamble defines the scope of the notice, not the role. No DPA or contract text is registered as a source in this file, so the role has to be confirmed from the signed agreement before procurement.

points.quote: | Data controls | — | ZDR, audit logging and activity trails | ZDR, audit logging, data residency |

points.text: Enterprise is the tier that can change the region, per the developer_data source: "Choose Enterprise when you need unlimited seats, dedicated compute, partitioned inference, on-premise deployment, sub-organizations, data residency, or priority support commitments." points.quote: Choose Enterprise when you need unlimited seats, dedicated compute, partitioned inference, on-premise deployment, sub-organizations, data residency, or priority support commitments.

points.text: Deployment patterns that move or remove the region: hybrid — "LLM and OTEL traffic terminate in your network"; fully airgapped — "no traffic leaves the environment" and "In fully airgapped environments, Factory never receives any runtime data; you are responsible for all retention and residency decisions."
points.text_zh: 会改变或移除处理地的部署形态：混合部署——「LLM and OTEL traffic terminate in your network」；全隔离部署——「no traffic leaves the environment」以及「In fully airgapped environments, Factory never receives any runtime data; you are responsible for all retention and residency decisions.」

points.text: Hybrid deployments keep the LLM and telemetry traffic inside the customer's network: "LLM and OTEL traffic terminate in your network"; Factory cloud may only see minimal metadata if the customer enables it.
points.text_zh: 混合部署下 LLM 与遥测流量终止在客户网络内：「LLM and OTEL traffic terminate in your network」；只有客户主动开启时 Factory 云才可能看到最少的元数据。
points.quote: LLM and OTEL traffic terminate in your network

points.text: No role is stated for this tier. organizations.md describes the Enterprise plan and its controls but names no controller/processor role; privacy-and-data-flows covers deployment and data flow, not a role; the consumer privacy policy is a notice to individuals and its preamble defines the scope of the notice, not the role. No DPA or contract text is registered as a source in this file, so the role has to be confirmed from the signed agreement before procurement.
points.text_zh: 本档没有角色表述。organizations.md 讲的是 Enterprise 档的套餐与控制能力，没有给 controller/processor 角色；privacy-and-data-flows 讲部署与数据流，不涉及角色；消费级隐私政策是面向个人的通知，其前言界定的是通知适用范围而非角色。本文件没有登记任何 DPA 或合同文本来源，采购前需从签署的协议确认角色。
points.quote: | Data controls | — | ZDR, audit logging and activity trails | ZDR, audit logging, data residency |

zdr.quote: We have adopted a “Zero Data Retention” policy, which means that we will not, unless otherwise required by Applicable Law (or to provide the Service or support to you): (i) log your Content for human review; or (ii) retain your Content, beyond the time it takes to generate Output and deliver that Output to you.

points.text: 同顶层 zdr：默认开启、无需申请
points.text_zh: 同顶层 zdr：默认开启、无需申请

points.text_zh: 例外为 Response API、prompt caching、training/fine-tuning/agent 功能

points.text: Documentation layer narrows the no-logging statement to open models: "Fireworks does not log or store prompt or generation data for any open models, without explicit user opt-in."
points.text_zh: 文档层把「不记录」的范围限定在 open models：「Fireworks does not log or store prompt or generation data for any open models, without explicit user opt-in.」
points.quote: Fireworks does not log or store prompt or generation data for any open models, without explicit user opt-in.

points.text: Two limits sit inside the very ToS §3.6 sentence this verdict is anchored to: the promise does not apply where "otherwise required by Applicable Law (or to provide the Service or support to you)", and "you agree that we have the right to use safety screening tools on the Content as we deem appropriate" — the one opening in the no-logging promise that lets the vendor keep processing Content.
points.text_zh: 结论所绑的 ToS §3.6 同一句里自带两处限定：依适用法律要求（或为向你提供服务/支持所必需）时不适用，以及「you agree that we have the right to use safety screening tools on the Content as we deem appropriate」（厂商保留对 Content 使用安全审查工具的权利）——这是「不记录、不留存」承诺里唯一允许继续处理 Content 的口子。
points.quote: Notwithstanding the foregoing, you agree that we have the right to use safety screening tools on the Content as we deem appropriate.

points.text: Contract layer adds a precondition (DPA §4.5): the no-retention obligation applies when the customer uses the Services in accordance with Company's Zero Data Retention configuration and usage documentation, and keeping that configuration consistent with the then-current documentation is the customer's responsibility. DPA §2 makes the DPA supersede the Agreement in case of contradictions, so this limit is not a channel-priority argument.
points.text_zh: 合同层另有 DPA §4.5 的前提：不保留义务只在客户按 Company 的 ZDR 配置与使用文档使用服务时成立，维持配置与最新文档一致的责任在客户。DPA §2 规定冲突时 DPA 优先于 Agreement——这条限定来自同层优先，不是 channel 排序。
points.quote: Company shall not retain Customer's prompt inputs or model outputs beyond the lifecycle of the applicable request.

retention.quote: We have adopted a “Zero Data Retention” policy, which means that we will not, unless otherwise required by Applicable Law (or to provide the Service or support to you): (i) log your Content for human review; or (ii) retain your Content, beyond the time it takes to generate Output and deliver that Output to you.

points.text: 同顶层 retention。本档内部还要再分：默认推理请求正文不落盘
points.text_zh: 同顶层 retention。本档内部还要再分：默认推理请求正文不落盘
points.quote: In either case, prompt and generation data are not logged into any persistent storage.

points.text: Mechanism, verbatim: "prompt and generation data exist only in volatile memory for the duration of the request"; with prompt caching active, some prompt data and its associated KV caches can sit in volatile memory for several minutes.
points.text_zh: 机制（逐字）：「prompt and generation data exist only in volatile memory for the duration of the request」；prompt caching 激活时，部分 prompt 数据与相关 KV 缓存可在内存中保留数分钟。
points.quote: prompt and generation data exist only in volatile memory for the duration of the request

points.text: prompt cache 内存保留数分钟~数小时
points.text_zh: prompt cache 内存保留数分钟~数小时
points.quote: Cached prompts usually stay in the cache for at least several minutes. Depending on the model, load level, and deployment configuration, it can be up to several hours.

points.text: Response API store=True 默认 30 天
points.text_zh: Response API store=True 默认 30 天

points.text: Stored conversation data is deleted automatically after 30 days, and can be deleted immediately through the DELETE API endpoint with the response_id.
points.text_zh: 已存储的会话数据 30 天后自动删除，也可用 DELETE API + response_id 立即删除。
points.quote: All stored conversation data is automatically deleted after 30 days.

points.text: Batch API 上传的数据集保留期未披露。
points.text_zh: Batch API 上传的数据集保留期未披露。

points.text_zh: 功能级例外：用户显式 opt-in 后可记录 prompt 与 generation 数据（如 FireOptimizer）——该页里唯一一条记录 prompt 正文的路径，且以用户选择为前提。

points.text: Object note: metadata (e.g. number of tokens in a request) is logged as required to deliver the service — a logs-object disclosure this row's object=input_output does not cover.
points.text_zh: 对象说明：元数据（如请求的 token 数）按提供服务所需记录——属 logs 对象，本行 object=input_output 不覆盖它。

points.text: The ToS §3.6 sentence this verdict is anchored to carries two limits: the promise does not apply where "otherwise required by Applicable Law (or to provide the Service or support to you)", and the vendor keeps the right to use safety screening tools on the Content.
points.text_zh: 结论所绑的 ToS §3.6 同一句自带两处限定：依适用法律要求（或为提供服务/支持所必需）时不适用，以及厂商保留对 Content 使用安全审查工具的权利。
points.quote: Notwithstanding the foregoing, you agree that we have the right to use safety screening tools on the Content as we deem appropriate.

points.text: Contract layer (DPA §4.5) conditions the no-retention obligation on the customer using the Services in accordance with Company's Zero Data Retention configuration and usage documentation, with the customer responsible for keeping that configuration current.
points.text_zh: 合同层（DPA §4.5）：不保留义务以「客户按 Company 的 ZDR 配置与使用文档使用服务」为前提，维持配置一致的责任在客户。
points.quote: Company shall not retain Customer's prompt inputs or model outputs beyond the lifecycle of the applicable request.

points.text: Contract-layer termination deletion: under DPA §11.2(b) Company deletes all copies of Covered Data processed by Company or any Authorised Sub-processor on expiry of the Retention Period, where §11.2(a) defines the Retention Period as the thirty (30) days from expiry of the Agreement — a deletion commitment at termination time, not the retention period of request content.
points.text_zh: 合同层终止后删除：DPA §11.2(b) 规定在 Retention Period 届满时删除 Company 或任何授权子处理者处理的所有 Covered Data 副本（Administration Data 与 Usage Data 例外）；Retention Period 由 §11.2(a) 定义为协议终止后 30 天——这是终止时点的删除承诺，不是请求正文的保留期。
points.quote: on expiry of the Retention Period, delete all copies of Covered Data Processed by Company or any Authorised Sub-processors

points.text: DPA Schedule 2 puts the same commitment in one line: "All Personal Data is deleted from the Services following service termination."
points.text_zh: DPA Schedule 2 一句话写明同一条承诺：「All Personal Data is deleted from the Services following service termination.」
points.quote: All Personal Data is deleted from the Services following service termination.

points.text_zh: 合同层支撑 codes 里的 global：DPA Schedule 4 的授权子处理者不限于美国——Oracle Cloud Infrastructure「United States, Japan, United Kingdom, Germany」，同一张表里 AWS 为「United States, Japan」、Crusoe 为「United States, Iceland」、Cloudflare 为「Closest data center to End User (global)」。
points.quote: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure  United States, Japan, United Kingdom, Germany

points.text: One row of that schedule is explicitly global: Cloudflare is listed at the "Closest data center to End User (global)", i.e. processing follows the end user's location rather than a fixed country.
points.text_zh: 该表里有一行的处理地是明文的 global：Cloudflare 记为「Closest data center to End User (global)」，即按终端用户位置就近处理，而非固定国家。
points.quote: Cloudflare  Closest data center to End User (global)

points.text: Schedule 2 of the same DPA adds that "All Company processing occurs in physical data centers that are managed by AWS, GCP, Oracle Cloud" — the contract layer describes multi-country infrastructure, not a single-country default.
points.text_zh: 同一 DPA 的 Schedule 2 另写「All Company processing occurs in physical data centers that are managed by AWS, GCP, Oracle Cloud.」——合同层描述的是多国基础设施，不是单国默认。
points.quote: All Company processing occurs in physical data centers that are managed by AWS, GCP, Oracle Cloud.

points.text: ToS §10.1 is the contract-layer US wording — "your personal information may be transferred to, and/or processed in, the United States". points.text: Tier-specific: dedicated deployments share a single prompt cache by default, and "Cached prompts usually stay in the cache for at least several minutes. Depending on the model, load level, and deployment configuration, it can be up to several hours." The period is a range, not a fixed term, so no days value is given. The same page admits "a minor risk of a timing attack" and offers x-prompt-cache-isolation-key for full isolation. Confidence medium: that page describes cache behaviour, it makes no dedicated-specific retention promise.
points.text_zh: 本档特有面：dedicated 默认共享单一 prompt cache，缓存内容在内存中「at least several minutes…up to several hours」——是区间而非固定期限，故本行不给 days。同页承认这带来「a minor risk of a timing attack」，需用 x-prompt-cache-isolation-key 才能完全隔离。置信度 medium：该页只描述缓存行为，未针对 dedicated 单独声明保留承诺。
points.quote: Cached prompts usually stay in the cache for at least several minutes. Depending on the model, load level, and deployment configuration, it can be up to several hours.

points.text: The ToS §3.6 sentence behind this tier's ZDR promise carries two limits: it does not apply where "otherwise required by Applicable Law (or to provide the Service or support to you)", and the vendor keeps the right to use safety screening tools on the Content.

points.quote: Notwithstanding the foregoing, you agree that we have the right to use safety screening tools on the Content as we deem appropriate.

points.text: Fireworks' own Zero Data Retention wording (ToS §3.6 and the Zero Data Retention page) is written for the inference path Fireworks itself serves. The FireRouter docs cover routing, billing and authentication only, and neither page states a zero-retention position for the pass-through hop, whose executor is a third-party provider.
points.text_zh: Fireworks 自己的零保留表述（ToS §3.6 与《Zero Data Retention》页）针对的是 Fireworks 自己提供推理的那条路径。FireRouter 文档只写路由、计费与鉴权，两处都没有就 pass-through 这一跳（执行方是第三方 provider）给出零保留方案。

points.text: Contrary reading, kept side by side: DPA §4.5 says Company shall not retain prompt inputs or model outputs beyond the lifecycle of the applicable request, and DPA Schedule 4 lists Anthropic as an authorised sub-processor — read at contract level, the pass-through hop may already be covered. The verdict stays at no because Fireworks' ZDR documentation does not extend the commitment to the third-party hop, and the upstream hop's own retention policy is not part of this provider's scope.
points.text_zh: 相反口径并列保留：DPA §4.5 承诺 Company 不保留 prompt inputs / model outputs 超过请求生命周期，Schedule 4 又把 Anthropic 列为授权子处理者——按合同层读，pass-through 这一跳可能已被 DPA 覆盖。结论仍记否：Fireworks 的 ZDR 文档没有把承诺延伸到第三方跳，上游跳（Anthropic）自己的保留政策不在本台账本家范围内。
points.quote: Company shall not retain Customer's prompt inputs or model outputs beyond the lifecycle of the applicable request.

points.text: The only retention-adjacent disclosure FireRouter makes is about credentials: "Provider keys sent on individual requests are not persisted by FireRouter." (a per-request provider key is not stored; when workspace BYOK is provisioned by Fireworks the credential lives in the customer workspace and is supplied server-side). It says nothing about the retention period of request/response content on the pass-through path, which is why this row is recorded as undisclosed instead of being anchored to that sentence.

points.quote: Provider keys sent on individual requests are not persisted by FireRouter.

points.text: The other side of the same section: Exhibit 1 §1.6 says FriendliAI owns Friendli Model Optimizations and Customer Model Optimization and "reserves the right to use them for any purpose, unless expressly restricted in this Section 1.6", and the very next sentence narrows that to use "only ... on behalf of Customer and/or any other FriendliAI customer to which Customer grants rights". Definition §1(i) adds that the process of creating a Customer Model Optimization may incorporate the use of Customer Data, so §1.1(d)'s exclusion of Inputs and Outputs does not by itself cover what is derived from them.
points.text_zh: 同节的另一面：Exhibit 1 §1.6 称 FriendliAI 拥有 Friendli Model Optimizations 与 Customer Model Optimization，且「reserves the right to use them for any purpose, unless expressly restricted in this Section 1.6」，紧接着一句又收窄为「only … on behalf of Customer and/or any other FriendliAI customer to which Customer grants rights」。定义 §1(i) 还写明创建 Customer Model Optimization 的过程可能使用 Customer Data，故 §1.1(d) 对 Inputs/Outputs 的排除并不自动覆盖由它们派生的产物。

points.text: Parallel period for the overlapping object, and the reason the line above is not a contradiction: Privacy §8 keeps log data (IP information, browser type, visited domain, visited page, mobile device and application ID, search term, etc.), links, cookie data, Service usage history and bad usage records until five (5) days after withdrawal from regular and/or social membership — an upper bound on Site and service access/usage logs, whereas ToS §10(e) simply sets no period for Usage Data.
points.text_zh: 同一类对象的并列期限，也是上面一句不构成矛盾的原因：隐私政策 §8 把 log data（IP、浏览器类型、访问域名/页面、设备与应用 ID、搜索词等）、links、cookie、Service usage history、bad usage record 保留至会员退出后 5 天——这是 Site 与服务的访问/使用日志上限，而 ToS §10(e) 只是未给 Usage Data 写期限。
points.quote: **Information such as log data (including IP information, browser type, visited domain, visited page, mobile device and application ID, search term, etc.), links, cookie data, Service usage history, bad usage record, etc.**: retained until five (5) days after withdrawal from regular and/or social membership.

points.text: Korean-resident annex touching the same object: the Annex 1 overseas consignment table consigns "Any personal data processed" with the period "Until member’s membership withdrawal; or until the consignment agreement is terminated", and every consignee’s destination country is U.S. Its purpose column limits those consignees to data management, usage analysis, payment and authentication, so this is a Korea-only annex rather than a general retention rule for request content.
points.text_zh: 涉及同一对象的韩国居民附录：Annex 1 境外受托处理表委托的对象是「Any personal data processed」，保留期写「Until member’s membership withdrawal; or until the consignment agreement is terminated」，受托方目的地全部为 U.S.。其用途列限定为数据管理、使用分析、支付与认证，故这是韩国居民专属附录，不是请求正文的通用保留规则。

points.text: Privacy Policy §11 is the only clause naming a place: information received from and provided to the Site is held on servers located in the U.S. The same paragraph then says that by using the Site you consent to the transfer to, and processing, usage, sharing and storage of your information "in the United States and in other countries", which is why the code is recorded as US + global rather than US alone.
points.text_zh: 隐私政策 §11 是唯一点名地点的条款：从 Site 收到与向 Site 提供的信息保存在美国服务器。同段紧接着写使用 Site 即同意信息在美国「and in other countries」被传输、处理、共享与存储，故码记 US + global，而非单一 US。

points.text: The heading of that section is "Visitors to the Site Outside of the United States", so it is a Site-level statement rather than a statement about the inference compute: not one sentence states directly which country the inference compute sits in.

points.text_zh: 同顶层 role：客户数据的 Processor/Sub-Processor + 自有业务数据的 independent Controller。

points.text: The vendor’s own consumer policy says the opposite in its own words: Privacy Policy §19 states that "FriendliAI is the data controller of Personal Information processed in relation to the Service" (§16 makes the same claim for EEA data subjects). Both statements are official and are kept side by side, not averaged. The scopes differ: DPA §2 governs Personal Data in customer content processed on the customer’s behalf, while the policy speaks to Personal Information FriendliAI processes for its own relationship with users.
points.text_zh: 厂商自家消费者政策里有相反的表述：隐私政策 §19 称「FriendliAI is the data controller of Personal Information processed in relation to the Service」（§16 对 EEA 数据主体作同样表述）。两句都是官方的，按规则并列保留、不取平均。适用范围不同：DPA §2 管的是客户内容中代表客户处理的 Personal Data，政策说的是 FriendliAI 就自身与用户关系处理的 Personal Information。
points.quote: FriendliAI is the data controller of Personal Information processed in relation to the Service.

training.quote: use the Friendli Container Service in an environment that does not utilize the Customer’s internal network or VPN or within a cloud environment to which Customer does not have exclusive access

points.text: Exhibit 1 §2, not §1, governs this tier: §1 states that its terms "are only applicable to Customers that receive access to Friendli Endpoints Services", which §1(t) defines as Serverless (Model API) + Dedicated. §2.1 authorizes use of the Friendli Container Service "only for Customer’s internal use", and §2.2 forbids running it outside the customer’s internal network or VPN, so the inference content stays in the customer’s own environment and is not submitted to FriendliAI — the training licences in §1.1 do not reach it.
points.text_zh: 本档适用 Exhibit 1 §2 而非 §1：§1 自述其条款「are only applicable to Customers that receive access to Friendli Endpoints Services」，而 §1(t) 把该定义限定为 Serverless（Model API）+ Dedicated。§2.1 授权 Friendli Container Service「only for Customer’s internal use」，§2.2 禁止在客户内网/VPN 之外运行，故推理内容留在客户自有环境、不提交给 FriendliAI，§1.1 的训练许可管不到它。

points.text: That is an architectural result of the deployment model, not a training commitment — hence mode = by_deployment rather than a default rule.
points.text_zh: 这是部署形态的架构结果，不是训练承诺——故 mode = by_deployment，而不是默认规则。

points.text: But Exhibit 1 §2.3 requires the customer to supply "input values" and "specific input examples" for support and bug fixes; those are provided voluntarily by the customer, and the terms take no position on whether such samples may be used for training — that channel is undisclosed, not clean.

points.text: The free tier inherits the same Privacy Policy: §2 defines the Services without splitting free from paid, so §11 (information held on servers located in the U.S., plus consent to processing "in the United States and in other countries") applies to it too. The vendor makes no separate processing-region statement for the free service, and the §11 heading is Site-level rather than a statement about the inference compute — the same basis the api tier uses, recorded the same way.
points.text_zh: 免费档继承同一份隐私政策：§2 的 Services 定义未把免费与付费分开，故 §11（信息保存在美国服务器，以及同意在美国「and in other countries」处理）同样适用。官方未就免费服务单独声明处理区域，且 §11 的小节标题属 Site 层、不是推理算力的声明——与 api 档同一依据、同一记法。

role.quote: FriendliAI will act as Processor or Sub-Processor to Customer, who can act either as Controller or Processor (on behalf of Customer’s customers or end users) of Personal Data.

points.text: The DPA applies to all Services

points.text: But the free tier is authorized under §1.1(c) for improving the vendor's own products, which is substantively closer to controller self-use; the public documents make no separate role statement about it.
points.text_zh: 但免费档被 §1.1(c) 授权用于自家产品改进，实质上更接近控制者自用，公开文件未就此另作角色声明。

points.text: And the vendor’s consumer policy claims the controller role for itself: Privacy Policy §19 says "FriendliAI is the data controller of Personal Information processed in relation to the Service" (§16 likewise for EEA data subjects). Both statements are official and are kept side by side, not averaged; DPA §2 speaks to customer content processed on the customer’s behalf, the policy to Personal Information processed for FriendliAI’s own relationship with users.
points.text_zh: 厂商的消费者政策还自称控制者：隐私政策 §19 写「FriendliAI is the data controller of Personal Information processed in relation to the Service」（§16 对 EEA 数据主体同样表述）。两句都是官方的，按规则并列保留、不取平均；DPA §2 说的是代表客户处理的客户内容，政策说的是厂商就自身与用户关系处理的 Personal Information。

training.quote: The Company may monitor your use of the Services to assess compliance with this Agreement and the quality of operations of the Services and to make improvements to the Services

points.text: Terms, Services section: 『The Company may monitor your use of the Services to assess compliance with this Agreement and the quality of operations of the Services and to make improvements to the Services.』 Under docs/judgment.md (using data to improve the service counts as training) this is a training-relevant authorisation, and neither international document excludes model training.
points.text_zh: 服务条款 Services 节：「The Company may monitor your use of the Services to assess compliance with this Agreement and the quality of operations of the Services and to make improvements to the Services.」——按 docs/judgment.md「用来改进服务/提高质量算训练」属训练相关授权，而国际站两份文本都没有把模型训练排除在外，故本档记 training=no（条款授权、无开关）。
points.quote: The Company may monitor your use of the Services to assess compliance with this Agreement and the quality of operations of the Services and to make improvements to the Services

points.text: Privacy policy, Service Enhancement: 『To improve user experience and maintain security, we may gather network logs, usage frequency, crash reports, usage scenarios, and performance metrics. This data helps us optimize the Platform and enhance service quality.』
points.text_zh: 隐私政策 Service Enhancement 条：「To improve user experience and maintain security, we may gather network logs, usage frequency, crash reports, usage scenarios, and performance metrics. This data helps us optimize the Platform and enhance service quality.」——服务改进/优化用途的明文表述。
points.quote: To improve user experience and maintain security, we may gather network logs, usage frequency, crash reports, usage scenarios, and performance metrics. This data helps us optimize the Platform and enhance service quality

points.text: The only sentence about training itself concerns third-party sources rather than user Prompts/Inputs: privacy policy 『We may collect publicly available data from internet sources to train our models and deliver our services.』 The terms also describe the service scope as programmatic APIs and web interfaces to host, use, fine tune and train large AI models. There is no commitment anywhere that user Prompts/Inputs are not used for training.
points.text_zh: 唯一直接提到训练的句子针对的是互联网公开数据而非用户 Prompts/Inputs：隐私政策「We may collect publicly available data from internet sources to train our models and deliver our services.」；服务条款把服务范围写成 host/use/fine tune/train 大模型。国际站对 Prompts/Inputs 不用于训练没有任何承诺。
points.quote: We may collect publicly available data from internet sources to train our models and deliver our services

points.text: Scope of this round's check: both international documents (terms and privacy policy) were read line by line, which is why this verdict is no longer recorded as unknown — the monitoring and service-enhancement clauses are statements about this dimension, and under the ledger rule a verdict that quotes the record cannot also say no wording was found.
points.text_zh: 本轮核查范围：国际站两份文本（服务条款与隐私政策）已逐条核过，故本档不再记 unknown——monitoring 与 Service Enhancement 两条都是针对本维度的表述，按台账规则「绑了引文就不能判 unknown」。

points.text: 国际站两份文本均无 ZDR/零保留表述。
points.text_zh: 国际站两份文本均无 ZDR/零保留表述。

points.text: The international privacy policy has no retention-period section, and the collection clause previously bound here only answers what is collected — 『we may collect your text inputs, prompts, uploaded files, feedback』, chat history — so it is not a statement about how long anything is kept and is no longer bound to this verdict.
points.text_zh: 国际站隐私政策没有保留期限章节；原先绑在本条的收集条只回答「收集哪些内容」（text inputs、prompts、uploaded files、feedback、chat history），不涉及留存多久，故不再绑在本条。

points.text: The only deletion wording is in the rights list: 『Delete the personal information we maintain about you, unless such information is necessary for compliance with our legal or regulatory obligations.』 — a deletion right with a compliance exception, and no number of days; the terms contain no retention clause either.
points.text_zh: 唯一的删除表述在权利清单里：「Delete the personal information we maintain about you, unless such information is necessary for compliance with our legal or regulatory obligations.」——只给删除权（附合规例外），没有任何天数；服务条款也没有保留条款。
points.quote: Delete the personal information we maintain about you, unless such information is necessary for compliance with our legal or regulatory obligations

points.text: Terms, Confidentiality Restrictions: 『The parties will have no confidentiality obligations to each other unless otherwise agreed in writing.』 Prompts/Inputs are not placed under any confidentiality duty on the international site, so no retention limit can be derived from confidentiality either. (The China site is a different entity and a different text, so this clause does not carry over.)
points.text_zh: 服务条款 Confidentiality Restrictions：「The parties will have no confidentiality obligations to each other unless otherwise agreed in writing.」——国际站不把 Prompts/Inputs 置于保密义务之下，因此也不能从保密义务推出保留期限。（国内站是另一实体、另一文本，本条不适用。）
points.quote: The parties will have no confidentiality obligations to each other unless otherwise agreed in writing

points.text: 国际站隐私政策未声明存储地域
points.text_zh: 国际站隐私政策未声明存储地域

points.text: 官网首页自称「SOC 2 and HIPAA compliant」「Deploy in enterprise VPC」，但未给出数据驻留条款。
points.text_zh: 官网首页自称「SOC 2 and HIPAA compliant」「Deploy in enterprise VPC」，但未给出数据驻留条款。

points.text: Both international documents were read line by line this round and neither designates Moark as a processor or a controller — there is no controller/processor wording and no DPA. The two clauses that bear on the data relationship are the IP clause and the confidentiality clause below; neither is a role designation, so the role stays unknown.
points.text_zh: 本轮逐条核过国际站两份文本，都没有把 Moark 定性为受托处理者或独立控制者——没有 controller/processor 用语，也没有 DPA。与数据关系相关的只有下面两条（IP 条与无保密义务条），两条都不构成角色定性，故仍记 kind=unknown。

points.text: IP clause: 『The Company exclusively owns all right, title and interest in and to the Website, the Services, the Professional Services deliverables, and all related data. You exclusively own all right, title and interest in your data.』 It divides ownership between the parties' data but names no processing role.
points.text_zh: IP 条：「The Company exclusively owns all right, title and interest in and to the Website, the Services, the Professional Services deliverables, and all related data. You exclusively own all right, title and interest in your data.」——只划分双方数据的权属（all related data 归公司、用户数据归用户），没有角色定性。
points.quote: The Company exclusively owns all right, title and interest in and to the Website, the Services, the Professional Services deliverables, and all related data. You exclusively own all right, title and interest in your data.

points.text: Confidentiality Restrictions: 『The parties will have no confidentiality obligations to each other unless otherwise agreed in writing.』 A processor relationship normally carries confidentiality duties; this text disclaims them, which is the key fact for this dimension on the international site. It does not apply to the China site (different entity, different text).
points.text_zh: Confidentiality Restrictions：「The parties will have no confidentiality obligations to each other unless otherwise agreed in writing.」——受托处理关系通常伴随保密义务，本条反向声明双方互不承担保密义务，是国际站本维度的关键事实。它不适用于国内站（不同实体、不同文本）。
points.quote: The parties will have no confidentiality obligations to each other unless otherwise agreed in writing

points.text: The counterparty is 『Moark Inc., a Delaware corporation』, which owns and operates the website and services.
points.text_zh: 对手方主体为「Moark Inc., a Delaware corporation」（Delaware 公司），运营该网站与服务。

training.quote: 在此明确，未经您的允许，我们不会使用您的内容作为人工智能模型训练的输入

points.text: The training-specific exclusion is terms §7.2 『在此明确，未经您的允许，我们不会使用您的内容作为人工智能模型训练的输入』, the same clause that carries the serverless-api tier. §7.1 『我们不会以本服务条款未允许的其他任何方式使用您的模型、数据集、应用等内容』 is a general limitation on the scope of use and contains no reference to training, so it is kept as a supporting point rather than as the basis of this verdict.
points.text_zh: 把「模型训练」单独排除的是 §7.2「在此明确，未经您的允许，我们不会使用您的内容作为人工智能模型训练的输入」，与按量 API 档同一句。§7.1「我们不会以本服务条款未允许的其他任何方式使用您的模型、数据集、应用等内容」是概括性的使用范围限制、不含「训练」字样，故只作旁证 point 保留，不再充当本档结论的锚点。
points.quote: 我们不会以本服务条款未允许的其他任何方式使用您的模型、数据集、应用等内容

points.text: §7.2 的例外句同样以「未经您的允许」为前提。本档另有大量把合规义务压给用户的条款（§4.1/§4.2 模型备案、§5.9 违法信息不得作训练语料、§6.10 应用采集使用者输入作训练语料须事前约定并给关闭选项）。
points.text_zh: §7.2 的例外句同样以「未经您的允许」为前提。本档另有大量把合规义务压给用户的条款（§4.1/§4.2 模型备案、§5.9 违法信息不得作训练语料、§6.10 应用采集使用者输入作训练语料须事前约定并给关闭选项）。

points.text: Opposite-direction clauses in the same terms, kept side by side and not reconciled: §8.3 『根据我们的隐私政策，我们可能会汇总、匿名化或以其他方式从与您使用我们网站和服务相关的数据中进行学习，并用其改进这些服务，您对此知晓并同意』 and §8.2 (a perpetual, irrevocable licence over 『反馈』 to commercialise it, improve the services and develop new products). Under docs/judgment.md (using data to improve the service counts as training) both are training-relevant, and §7.2 does not carve them out.
points.text_zh: 同一份条款里方向相反的两条，并列保留、不裁决：§8.3「根据我们的隐私政策，我们可能会汇总、匿名化或以其他方式从与您使用我们网站和服务相关的数据中进行学习，并用其改进这些服务，您对此知晓并同意」，以及 §8.2（对「反馈」的永久、不可撤销许可，可用于商业化利用反馈、改进服务、开发新产品）。按 docs/judgment.md「用来改进服务/提高质量算训练」，两条都属训练相关表述，且 §7.2 没有把它们排除在外。
points.quote: 我们可能会汇总、匿名化或以其他方式从与您使用我们网站和服务相关的数据中进行学习，并用其改进这些服务，您对此知晓并同意

points.text: Privacy policy §2 lists the purposes the collected information is used for; item 4 is 『评估、改善我们的服务』 and item 5 is 『出于业务运营或科学目的对服务或与之相关的任何主题进行分析或研究』. The list never mentions model training, but it does authorise service-improvement and research uses.
points.text_zh: 隐私政策 §2 的用途清单：第 4 项「评估、改善我们的服务」、第 5 项「出于业务运营或科学目的对服务或与之相关的任何主题进行分析或研究」。清单没有出现「模型训练」，但明确授权了服务改进与研究用途。
points.quote: 评估、改善我们的服务

points.text: Ledger treatment: training=yes rests on §7.2 alone (the only training-specific exclusion in the documents); the §8.3/§8.2/privacy-§2 authorisations above point the other way and are recorded beside it, not adjudicated (docs/judgment.md: a vendor's own conflicting statements are kept side by side).
points.text_zh: 本台账的处理：training=yes 只由 §7.2 支撑（全文唯一针对训练的排除）；上面 §8.3/§8.2/隐私政策 §2 三条方向相反，并列记录、不裁决（docs/judgment.md：厂商自己说法冲突时两条事实并列保留）。

points.text: §四.1: 『为识别设备身份，我们可能收集硬件序列号、MAC 地址、系统版本号』, and with your authorisation crash records 『以改进性能』 — device identifiers collected for the vendor's own device-identification purpose, which is what this tier's controller reading rests on. points.text: The only clause that puts model training itself outside is terms §7.2: 『在此明确，未经您的允许，我们不会使用您的内容作为人工智能模型训练的输入』. It is a conditional negative — the gate is 『未经您的允许』 — and the clause does not say how that permission is obtained, whether it can be withdrawn, or whether a switch exists.
points.text_zh: 全文只有 §7.2 这一句把「模型训练」本身单独排除：「在此明确，未经您的允许，我们不会使用您的内容作为人工智能模型训练的输入」。它是以「未经您的允许」为前提的条件式否定，条款没写「允许」如何取得、能否撤回、有无开关。
points.quote: 在此明确，未经您的允许，我们不会使用您的内容作为人工智能模型训练的输入

points.text: Opposite-direction clause in the same terms, kept side by side and not reconciled: §8.3 『根据我们的隐私政策，我们可能会汇总、匿名化或以其他方式从与您使用我们网站和服务相关的数据中进行学习，并用其改进这些服务，您对此知晓并同意』. The object is data related to your use of the website and services, the use is learning plus service improvement; under docs/judgment.md (using data to improve the service counts as training) this is a training-relevant authorisation, and §7.2 does not carve it out.
points.text_zh: 同一份条款里方向相反的一条，并列保留、不裁决：§8.3「根据我们的隐私政策，我们可能会汇总、匿名化或以其他方式从与您使用我们网站和服务相关的数据中进行学习，并用其改进这些服务，您对此知晓并同意」。对象是「与您使用我们网站和服务相关的数据」，用途是「学习 + 改进服务」——按 docs/judgment.md「用来改进服务/提高质量算训练」，这属训练相关表述，且 §7.2 没有把它排除在外。
points.quote: 我们可能会汇总、匿名化或以其他方式从与您使用我们网站和服务相关的数据中进行学习，并用其改进这些服务，您对此知晓并同意

points.text: §8.2 gives the platform a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, non-exclusive licence over any 『反馈』 you provide about the website or service — to commercialise the feedback, improve the services, and develop and/or commercialise new products. Feedback is information the user supplies about use, operation, performance or features, and the clause does not exclude feedback that contains user input.
points.text_zh: §8.2 对「反馈」给出永久、不可撤销、全球性、免费的许可：可用于商业化利用反馈、改进我们的服务、开发和/或商业化新产品。对象是用户就网站/服务的使用、操作、性能或功能提供的反馈，条款没有把含用户输入内容的反馈排除在外。
points.quote: 您特此授予我们永久的、不可撤销的、全球性的、免费的、非排他性的权利和许可，以商业化利用这些反馈、改进我们的服务、以及开发和/或商业化我们的新产品

points.text: The 90-day clauses previously bound here are about another object and are no longer bound to this verdict: terms §3.10 『您应当在 90 天的保留期（或者我们和您特别约定的期限）内完成内容清理或迁移』 and §16.3 govern content the user stores — the repositories a user must clean up or migrate when the service term ends or the account is closed — not the retention of API request bodies. They stay bound to the model-hosting tier, where user-stored content is the object. Readers must not read the 90 days as an API input/output retention period.
points.text_zh: 原先绑在本条的 90 天条款对象不对，故不再绑在本条：§3.10「您应当在 90 天的保留期（或者我们和您特别约定的期限）内完成内容清理或迁移」与 §16.3 约束的是用户自己存储的内容（服务期满或注销账号时的清理窗口），不是 API 请求正文的保留期。它们仍绑在 model-hosting 档（那一档的对象才是用户存储的内容）。不能把这 90 天读成 API 输入输出的保留期。

points.text: Privacy policy §4.2 『一般而言，我们仅在为实现目的所必需的最短时间内保留您的数据信息，但下列情况除外』 (exceptions: laws and regulations, court rulings, government enforcement) is the only retention wording in the documents, and its object is the personal information the policy collects — §1.1/§1.2 list nicknames, phone numbers, emails, usernames, passwords, images, log/device/location data, contacts and cookie data, and never list API inference inputs or outputs. It gives no number of days and does not cover this verdict's object.
points.text_zh: 隐私政策 §4.2「一般而言，我们仅在为实现目的所必需的最短时间内保留您的数据信息，但下列情况除外」（例外：法律法规、法院判决、政府执法）是全文仅有的保留期表述，对象是政策所收集的个人信息——§1.1/§1.2 列举的是昵称、手机号、邮箱、用户名、密码、图片、日志/设备/位置信息、通讯录与 Cookie，没有把 API 推理输入输出列为收集对象。它不含天数，也不覆盖本结论的对象。
points.quote: 一般而言，我们仅在为实现目的所必需的最短时间内保留您的数据信息，但下列情况除外

points.text: Privacy policy §4.4 『我们会在提供服务、遵守任何适用的法律要求、维护安全和防止事件以及总体上追求我们的合法利益所需的时间内保留您的信息』 is an as-needed wording with no number of days, and its object is likewise 『您的信息』 (personal information), not API request bodies.

points.text_zh: 对 CN 结论的限定，出自隐私政策 §4.3：「通过服务收集的个人信息可能会在公司或其附属公司、子公司存储和处理」，§4.3.1/§4.3.2 进一步包括附属机构（含控制权变更、合并、收购或出售时并入集团的企业）与第三方服务提供商，且未对这些关联方限定地域——即境内存储承诺覆盖的是公司及其服务器，不排除集团内其他主体在别处存储或处理。同政策 §8 的第三方名单只有统计/短信/支付类（百度统计、神策数据、SendCloud、云片、支付宝/微信支付），未列任何模型或算力供应商。

points.text: Neither the terms nor the privacy policy designates the platform as a processor or a controller: the only role-like wording in the privacy policy is 『个人信息保护团队和个人信息保护负责人』, which is a PIPL compliance role, not a controller/processor designation. The clauses that come closest all describe processing for the platform's own purposes: §8.8 『您使用我们的服务而产生的由我们记录的信息和数据，例如日志信息、计量和费用信息、服务咨询信息，我们拥有相应的权益』 with 『您不得也不会主张对于这些信息和数据的权利』; §7.4 『我们可能会根据我们的隐私政策中规定的条款访问或共享您的私人信息』; §11.2 (it may disclose your identity information to a rights holder when handling an infringement complaint). Recorded as controller on that basis — this is an interpretation drawn from the platform's own data rights and the absence of any processor commitment, not a designation in the text (confidence medium).
points.text_zh: 服务条款与隐私政策都没有把平台定性为受托处理者或独立控制者：隐私政策里唯一近似角色的表述是「个人信息保护团队和个人信息保护负责人」（PIPL 合规角色，不是控制者/处理者定性）。最接近的几条都描述「为平台自身目的处理」：§8.8「您使用我们的服务而产生的由我们记录的信息和数据，例如日志信息、计量和费用信息、服务咨询信息，我们拥有相应的权益」并写「您不得也不会主张对于这些信息和数据的权利」；§7.4「我们可能会根据我们的隐私政策中规定的条款访问或共享您的私人信息」；§11.2（处置侵权投诉时有权向权利人披露您的身份信息）。据此记 controller——这是从平台自身数据权益与「无任何受托承诺」推出的解释性结论，不是原文定性（置信度 medium）。
points.quote: 您使用我们的服务而产生的由我们记录的信息和数据，例如日志信息、计量和费用信息、服务咨询信息，我们拥有相应的权益

points.text: §7.4 only promises that reasonable and appropriate measures will be taken to keep private repositories confidential, while keeping the right to access or share private information under the privacy policy — an access right, not a processor undertaking.
points.text_zh: §7.4 私有存储库条款只承诺「采取合理和适当的措施来保护您的内容保密」，同时保留按隐私政策访问或共享私人信息的权利——是访问权，不是受托处理承诺。
points.quote: 我们可能会根据我们的隐私政策中规定的条款访问或共享您的私人信息

points.text: Subcontracting: terms §17.3 『我们可以自行决定分包我们在本服务条款下的全部或部分义务，而无需通知您』, with the platform taking the same responsibility for a subcontractor's acts and omissions as for its own performance. There is no published sub-processor list and no notice duty. This is context for the role reading only — it does not on its own establish a processor designation.
points.text_zh: 分包：§17.3「我们可以自行决定分包我们在本服务条款下的全部或部分义务，而无需通知您」，且平台对分包商的作为和不作为承担与自身履行相同的责任。无公开子处理者清单，也无通知义务。此条只作角色口径的旁证，不据此单独推出 processor 定性。
points.quote: 我们可以自行决定分包我们在本服务条款下的全部或部分义务，而无需通知您

points.text: 同顶层 role：自述中立平台，保留内容访问/删除权与日志权益，无 processor 定性、无公开 DPA。原绑在本条的 §17.8 只是文件冲突时的效力优先顺序，不含任何数据处理角色定性，故不再绑在本条。
points.text_zh: 同顶层 role：自述中立平台，保留内容访问/删除权与日志权益，无 processor 定性、无公开 DPA。原绑在本条的 §17.8 只是文件冲突时的效力优先顺序，不含任何数据处理角色定性，故不再绑在本条。

points.text_zh: 例外：启用 Claude Fable 5 / Fable 5.1 时 Anthropic 默认保留 prompts 与 outputs(安全分类器)。企业可申请限时豁免走 ZDR 端点，豁免到 2026 年底(Anthropic 推进 EFS 期间)，需资格审批且管理员逐个显式启用；2026 年底后继续使用需 Enterprise Frontier Safeguards。故 default 不等于所有配置无条件零保留。

points.text: Contract boundary: the DPA that carries the processor commitments 「applies to all Online Services except … Previews, unless expressly designated by GitHub as being governed by this DPA」; previews may employ different privacy and security measures, are offered under Preview Terms, and customers 「should not use Previews to process Personal Data or other data that is subject to legal or regulatory compliance requirements」.
points.text_zh: 合同层边界：本档的 ZDR/处理承诺都挂在 DPA 上，而 DPA §2.A.ii 把 Previews 排除在覆盖之外(除 GitHub 明确指定受 DPA 管辖)；preview 的隐私与安全措施可能不同、按 Preview Terms 提供，客户不应在其中处理受法律或监管合规要求约束的数据；GenAI Terms §7 进一步把 preview 功能改由 GitHub Pre-Release License Terms 管辖。

points.quote: **Other GitHub Copilot access and use:** - Inputs and Outputs: Retained for up to 28 days by default.

training.quote: You also grant GitHub and its Affiliates a license to collect and use your Inputs and Outputs to develop, train and improve artificial intelligence and machine learning models and technologies including those that power AI Features, unless (a) you opt out through your account settings, or (b) your use of the Service is governed by a GitHub Customer Agreement or volume licensing agreement.

points.text: 默认 permitted。§J.3 给 GitHub 及关联方「collect and use your Inputs and Outputs to develop, train and improve artificial intelligence and machine learning models」，退出条件为「(a) you opt out through your account settings, or (b) your use of the Service is governed by a GitHub Customer Agreement or volume licensing agreement」
points.text_zh: 默认 permitted。§J.3 给 GitHub 及关联方「collect and use your Inputs and Outputs to develop, train and improve artificial intelligence and machine learning models」，退出条件为「(a) you opt out through your account settings, or (b) your use of the Service is governed by a GitHub Customer Agreement or volume licensing agreement」

points.text: 退出只向将来生效。开关实体在 manage-policies 页：「Allow GitHub to use my data for AI model training」设为 Disabled，生效日 2026-04-24(model-hosting 页与 Trust Center FAQ 同旨，前者还写明个人档数据可用于「prompts (inputs), suggestions (outputs), and code snippets」)。未覆盖范围：§J.3 末段说明退出权不适用于 D.4-D.8 的一般内容许可，公开仓库内容不在其中
points.text_zh: 退出只向将来生效。开关实体在 manage-policies 页：「Allow GitHub to use my data for AI model training」设为 Disabled，生效日 2026-04-24(model-hosting 页与 Trust Center FAQ 同旨，前者还写明个人档数据可用于「prompts (inputs), suggestions (outputs), and code snippets」)。未覆盖范围：§J.3 末段说明退出权不适用于 D.4-D.8 的一般内容许可，公开仓库内容不在其中

points.text: 私有仓库内容一旦作为 AI Feature 的 Input 提交，E.2 允许用于开发、训练与改进服务。上游一跳另有约束：§J.3「This license does not, however, permit GitHub or its Affiliates to share your Inputs or Outputs with third-party AI model providers for their own independent model training purposes.」
points.text_zh: 私有仓库内容一旦作为 AI Feature 的 Input 提交，E.2 允许用于开发、训练与改进服务。上游一跳另有约束：§J.3「This license does not, however, permit GitHub or its Affiliates to share your Inputs or Outputs with third-party AI model providers for their own independent model training purposes.」

points.text: Official limit on the scope of that licence: 「We do not train on the contents from any paid organization’s repos, regardless of whether a user is working in that repo with a Copilot Free, Pro, Pro+ or Max subscription.」 If a user’s GitHub ID is a member of, or an outside collaborator with, a paid organization, GitHub excludes their interaction data from model training. This is the case procurement cares about most — an employee opening an employer’s repository while on a personal subscription — and it is an official qualification of what Section J.3 authorises. It does not change this tier’s mark=no.
points.text_zh: §J.3 授权范围的官方限定：付费组织仓库的内容不参与训练，即使用户是以 Copilot Free/Pro/Pro+/Max 个人订阅在该仓库里工作；若用户 GitHub ID 是付费组织的成员或 outside collaborator，其交互数据被排除在模型训练之外。这条恰好覆盖采购最关心的场景(员工用个人订阅打开公司仓库)，不改变本档 mark=no 的值。
points.quote: We do not train on the contents from any paid organization’s repos, regardless of whether a user is working in that repo with a Copilot Free, Pro, Pro+ or Max subscription.

points.text: Platform-level layer, recorded alongside: 「Personal Data may be shared with GitHub affiliates, including Microsoft, to facilitate … product development and improvement (including training and improving artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies) …」. The same statement lists code, inputs and AI outputs as Personal Data, and its 「Product Development and Improvement」 purpose likewise covers 「… and training models」. How this platform-level sharing sits with the account-setting opt-out in Section J.3 is not clarified by GitHub; both statements are kept side by side.
points.text_zh: 平台级声明另有一层口径：个人数据(该声明把 code、inputs、AI outputs 明列为 Personal Data)可共享给含 Microsoft 的关联方，用于含训练 AI/ML 技术的产品开发与改进；同旨还有 §Product Development and Improvement 的「…and training models」。它与 ToS §J.3 的账户设置退出开关如何叠加，GitHub 未说明，两条并列保留。
points.quote: Personal Data may be shared with GitHub affiliates, including Microsoft, to facilitate customer service, marketing and advertising, order fulfillment, billing, technical support, legal and compliance obligations, product development and improvement (including training and improving artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies), and for other purposes described in their respective privacy statements.

points.text: 同顶层 zdr：ZDR 由 GitHub 与上游托管方的协议决定(OpenAI / Anthropic GA 功能 / xAI / Kimi 托管方)，不是个人账户可开关的选项
points.text_zh: 同顶层 zdr：ZDR 由 GitHub 与上游托管方的协议决定(OpenAI / Anthropic GA 功能 / xAI / Kimi 托管方)，不是个人账户可开关的选项

points.text: 官方未按档位区分这些协议的适用性，也未说明个人档可申请 ZDR。例外：启用 Claude Fable 5 / Fable 5.1 时 Anthropic 默认保留数据，限时 ZDR 豁免只面向通过审批并配置的企业。
points.text_zh: 官方未按档位区分这些协议的适用性，也未说明个人档可申请 ZDR。例外：启用 Claude Fable 5 / Fable 5.1 时 Anthropic 默认保留数据，限时 ZDR 豁免只面向通过审批并配置的企业。

retention.quote: We’ll retain your Personal Data as long as your account is active and as needed to fulfill contractual obligations, comply with legal requirements, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements.

points.text: The only quantified retention figure available on the individual tier has a different object: on github.com, 「Copilot Chat stores up to 100 of your most recent conversations. Messages within each conversation are kept for 28 days before being permanently deleted.」 That object is Copilot Chat conversation history / messages, not the request body (inputs and outputs) of an inference call, so it cannot be carried over as a request-level retention commitment.
points.text_zh: 个人档唯一可量化的保留口径对象不是请求正文：github.com 上 Copilot Chat 最多保留 100 个最近对话，单条对话内消息保留 28 天后永久删除(上限)。对象是「对话历史/Chat 消息」，不是推理请求正文(输入输出)，不能当作请求级保留承诺。
points.quote: Copilot Chat stores up to 100 of your most recent conversations. Messages within each conversation are kept for 28 days before being permanently deleted.

points.text: For request bodies (inputs and outputs) the individual tier discloses no period at all: the platform-level statement only says 「We’ll retain your Personal Data as long as your account is active and as needed to fulfill contractual obligations, comply with legal requirements, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements.」 (unquantified), and the Terms of Service only add that repository content is deleted 「within 90 days of cancellation or termination (though some information may remain in encrypted backups)」.
points.text_zh: 请求正文(输入输出)的保留期在个人档没有任何官方量化承诺：平台级口径是《GitHub General Privacy Statement》「We’ll retain your Personal Data as long as your account is active…」(未量化)；ToS 只补了注销后 90 天内删除仓库内容(仍可能留在加密备份)。
points.quote: We’ll retain your Personal Data as long as your account is active and as needed to fulfill contractual obligations, comply with legal requirements, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements.

points.text: Exception, unquantified: 「As part of its enforcement and security operations, and acting as an independent data controller under the GitHub Data Protection Agreement, GitHub may enable targeted logging of input and output data associated with confirmed policy-violating accounts for a limited period.」 Object = inputs and outputs; context = confirmed policy-violating accounts; period = not quantified.
points.text_zh: 例外：GitHub 在执法与安全运营中，以 DPA 下的独立控制者身份，可对已确认违规账号的输入输出开启定向记录。对象=输入输出，语境=已确认违规账号，期限未量化。
points.quote: As part of its enforcement and security operations, and acting as an independent data controller under the GitHub Data Protection Agreement, GitHub may enable targeted logging of input and output data associated with confirmed policy-violating accounts for a limited period.

points.text: 对照：同一家商业档有明确量化(IDE 路径默认不留存 / 其他访问路径最多 28 天，且该量化写在 Trust Center FAQ 的「The default settings for Copilot Business and Enterprise Customers are as follows」之下)，个人档没有对应条款，不能把商业档的 28 天外推到个人档。
points.text_zh: 对照：同一家商业档有明确量化(IDE 路径默认不留存 / 其他访问路径最多 28 天，且该量化写在 Trust Center FAQ 的「The default settings for Copilot Business and Enterprise Customers are as follows」之下)，个人档没有对应条款，不能把商业档的 28 天外推到个人档。
points.quote: **Other GitHub Copilot access and use:** - Inputs and Outputs: Retained for up to 28 days by default.

processing_region.quote: GitHub stores and processes Personal Data in a variety of locations, including your local region, the United States, and other countries where GitHub, its affiliates, subsidiaries, or subprocessors have operations.

points.text: 个人账户无区域选择权，处理地是「本地区域 + 美国 + 其他运营地」，EU/UK/CH 出境靠 SCCs。数据驻留(Data Residency)是 GitHub Enterprise Cloud 的能力，个人档不适用。
points.text_zh: 个人账户无区域选择权，处理地是「本地区域 + 美国 + 其他运营地」，EU/UK/CH 出境靠 SCCs。数据驻留(Data Residency)是 GitHub Enterprise Cloud 的能力，个人档不适用。

role.quote: It applies to the Personal Data that GitHub, Inc. or GitHub B.V., processes as the “Data Controller” when you interact with websites, applications, and services that display this Statement

points.text: Individual accounts: 「It applies to the Personal Data that GitHub, Inc. or GitHub B.V., processes as the “Data Controller” when you interact with websites, applications, and services that display this Statement」 — the opening scope clause of the statement is the basis for the controller role here.
points.text_zh: 个人账户：GitHub 以 Data Controller 身份处理个人数据，依据是声明开篇的适用范围句(「…processes as the “Data Controller” when you interact with websites, applications, and services that display this Statement」)。
points.quote: It applies to the Personal Data that GitHub, Inc. or GitHub B.V., processes as the “Data Controller” when you interact with websites, applications, and services that display this Statement

points.text: Role flip when the account is organization-provided: 「When a school or employer supplies your GitHub account, they assume the role of Data Controller for most Personal Data used in our Services」 and 「the organization becomes the Data Controller … GitHub functions as a Data Processor, adhering to the Data Controller’s instructions」. In that scenario GitHub acts as controller 「solely for specific processing activities」 defined in the DPA with the organization.
points.text_zh: 组织提供账号时角色翻转：学校或雇主承担 Data Controller，组织成为控制者、GitHub 以 Data Processor 身份按控制者指示处理并受 DPA 约束；此时 GitHub 仅在 DPA 明确约定的特定处理活动上自认控制者(§End User Notice: Organization-Provided GitHub Accounts)。
points.quote: In such circumstances, GitHub functions as a Data Processor, adhering to the Data Controller's instructions regarding your Personal Data's processing.

points.text: Separate independent-controller track: 「acting as an independent data controller under the GitHub Data Protection Agreement, GitHub may enable targeted logging of input and output data associated with confirmed policy-violating accounts for a limited period.」
points.text_zh: 另一条独立控制者口径：GitHub 在执法与安全运营中，以 DPA 下的独立控制者身份，可对已确认违规账号的输入输出开启定向记录(期限未量化)。

points.quote: GitLab has a zero data retention policy with Fireworks AI.

points.text: Conclusion: not zero retention across the whole chain (partial). The public material contains one express ZDR statement only, covering a single hop: "For GitLab Duo requests, GitLab has a zero data retention policy with Fireworks AI. Fireworks AI discards model input and output data immediately after the output is provided and does not store input and output data for abuse monitoring." The exceptions that immediately follow it: (1) "The exception to this policy is when prompt caching is turned on for GitLab Duo Code Suggestions and GitLab Duo Agentic Chat. For OpenAI models, you cannot turn off prompt caching."
points.text_zh: 结论：不是全链零保留（partial）。公开材料只有一条 ZDR 明文，且只覆盖一个跳：「For GitLab Duo requests, GitLab has a zero data retention policy with Fireworks AI. Fireworks AI discards model input and output data immediately after the output is provided and does not store input and output data for abuse monitoring.」该句紧接的例外：①「The exception to this policy is when prompt caching is turned on for GitLab Duo Code Suggestions and GitLab Duo Agentic Chat. For OpenAI models, you cannot turn off prompt caching.」

points.text: (2) "Certain Anthropic and OpenAI models, including when hosted on Amazon Bedrock and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, are subject to limited vendor-side data retention." — these models expressly do have vendor-side retention, so that hop is not zero retention. On the GitLab side there are two further retentions decoupled from ZDR: "On GitLab.com, GitLab retains chat and workflow history for anti-abuse purposes." and "Logging information related to AI features is separate from any zero data retention policy with GitLab AI model sub-processors." Under the multi-hop rule "a clear no on any hop makes the whole chain a no": the Fireworks tier can be called zero retention, while the Anthropic/OpenAI tier (including when hosted on Bedrock or the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform) is not
points.text_zh: ②「Certain Anthropic and OpenAI models, including when hosted on Amazon Bedrock and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, are subject to limited vendor-side data retention.」——这些模型在 vendor 侧明确有保留，即该跳不是零保留。GitLab 侧另有两条与 ZDR 脱钩的保留：「On GitLab.com, GitLab retains chat and workflow history for anti-abuse purposes.」与「Logging information related to AI features is separate from any zero data retention policy with GitLab AI model sub-processors.」按多跳规则「任一跳明确为否，则全链为否」：Fireworks 档可称零保留，Anthropic/OpenAI（含 Bedrock / Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 托管）档不是零保留

points.text: And the public material offers no unified ZDR switch or application path (on the contrary, retaining inputs and outputs is what requires the customer's written consent through a support ticket). Uncertainty: GitLab does not disclose how to tell, per model or per feature, whether the current configuration falls within ZDR coverage, and provides no verifiable ZDR attestation document.
points.text_zh: 且公开材料没有统一的 ZDR 开关或申请入口（保留输入输出反而是「客户经 support ticket 书面同意」才发生）。不确定性：GitLab 未披露如何按模型/功能判断当前配置是否处于 ZDR 覆盖范围，也未提供可核验的 ZDR 声明文件。

points.text: (1) is of the upper-bound type (zero by default) but carries the four exceptions (2)(3)(4)(5), so it cannot be read in reverse as "no input or output is retained at all". It is opt-in and must be enabled at both group and project level before any vulnerability data is sent to LLMs, so code context containing secrets does reach an LLM once it is on.

role.quote: Customer’s obligations as a Controller under the DPA will apply.

points.text: Conclusion: on the enterprise/paid tiers GitLab positions itself as processor (the customer is controller)

points.text: On the free/self-serve tiers GitLab appears as controller (processor_for_enterprise_customer_controller_for_self_serve). Contract layer: (1) GitLab Duo AI Terms §2.3, "To the extent Customer's use of AI Functionality powered by GitLab Models involves the processing of Personal Data, Customer's obligations as a Controller under the DPA will apply. Any sub-processors used to provide AI Functionality powered by GitLab Models will be listed at https://about.gitlab.com/privacy/subprocessors/ and all notifications of updates to that list will be done in accordance with Section 14 of the DPA." — it places the DPA's controller obligations on the customer, which puts GitLab in the processor position

points.text: §2.1 also states that "these Terms, along with the Agreement and the DPA, govern Customer's access to and use of AI Functionality and GitLab Models". (2) Subscription Agreement §14.2, "If this Agreement is entered into on behalf of an Enterprise, the terms of the data processing addendum at ... (“DPA”) are hereby incorporated by reference and shall apply to the extent Customer Content includes Personal Data"
points.text_zh: §2.1 同时明确「these Terms, along with the Agreement and the DPA, govern Customer's access to and use of AI Functionality and GitLab Models」。②《Subscription Agreement》§14.2「If this Agreement is entered into on behalf of an Enterprise, the terms of the data processing addendum at ... (“DPA”) are hereby incorporated by reference and shall apply to the extent Customer Content includes Personal Data」

points.text: §14.4 also carries a PIPL cross-border clause requiring the customer, as "personal information processor", to give notice and obtain separate consent itself. (3) The subprocessor page opens with "When acting as a processor for Customer, Gitlab may engage the following entities to carry out specific processing activities". (4) The Privacy Statement, "For Enterprise Users or accounts that are members of a paid namespace, the enterprise that provisioned your account or invited you to its paid namespace is the Controller of your data. GitLab is a Processor in this scenario" — the same paragraph also confirms that in free/self-serve scenarios GitLab is itself the controller (the privacy statement is written throughout in a controller's voice: we collect / we use). (5) Bring-your-own models (Customer Models) and third-party products are excluded from GitLab's commitments and liability by AI Terms §1.3/§1.9/§2.2, and the role relationship on that hop is set between the customer and its own model vendor. Uncertainty: the body of the DPA (the handbook page only links to an external document, and the PDF text was not obtained this round) could not be checked clause by clause

points.quote: GitLab has a zero data retention policy with Fireworks AI.

points.text: Conclusion: not zero retention across the whole chain (partial). The public material contains one express ZDR statement only, covering a single hop: "For GitLab Duo requests, GitLab has a zero data retention policy with Fireworks AI. Fireworks AI discards model input and output data immediately after the output is provided and does not store input and output data for abuse monitoring." The exceptions that immediately follow it: (1) "The exception to this policy is when prompt caching is turned on for GitLab Duo Code Suggestions and GitLab Duo Agentic Chat. For OpenAI models, you cannot turn off prompt caching."
points.text_zh: 结论：不是全链零保留（partial）。公开材料只有一条 ZDR 明文，且只覆盖一个跳：「For GitLab Duo requests, GitLab has a zero data retention policy with Fireworks AI. Fireworks AI discards model input and output data immediately after the output is provided and does not store input and output data for abuse monitoring.」该句紧接的例外：①「The exception to this policy is when prompt caching is turned on for GitLab Duo Code Suggestions and GitLab Duo Agentic Chat. For OpenAI models, you cannot turn off prompt caching.」

points.text: (2) "Certain Anthropic and OpenAI models, including when hosted on Amazon Bedrock and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, are subject to limited vendor-side data retention." — these models expressly do have vendor-side retention, so that hop is not zero retention. On the GitLab side there are two further retentions decoupled from ZDR: "On GitLab.com, GitLab retains chat and workflow history for anti-abuse purposes." and "Logging information related to AI features is separate from any zero data retention policy with GitLab AI model sub-processors." Under the multi-hop rule "a clear no on any hop makes the whole chain a no": the Fireworks tier can be called zero retention, while the Anthropic/OpenAI tier (including when hosted on Bedrock or the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform) is not
points.text_zh: ②「Certain Anthropic and OpenAI models, including when hosted on Amazon Bedrock and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, are subject to limited vendor-side data retention.」——这些模型在 vendor 侧明确有保留，即该跳不是零保留。GitLab 侧另有两条与 ZDR 脱钩的保留：「On GitLab.com, GitLab retains chat and workflow history for anti-abuse purposes.」与「Logging information related to AI features is separate from any zero data retention policy with GitLab AI model sub-processors.」按多跳规则「任一跳明确为否，则全链为否」：Fireworks 档可称零保留，Anthropic/OpenAI（含 Bedrock / Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 托管）档不是零保留

points.text: And the public material offers no unified ZDR switch or application path (on the contrary, retaining inputs and outputs is what requires the customer's written consent through a support ticket). Uncertainty: GitLab does not disclose how to tell, per model or per feature, whether the current configuration falls within ZDR coverage, and provides no verifiable ZDR attestation document.
points.text_zh: 且公开材料没有统一的 ZDR 开关或申请入口（保留输入输出反而是「客户经 support ticket 书面同意」才发生）。不确定性：GitLab 未披露如何按模型/功能判断当前配置是否处于 ZDR 覆盖范围，也未提供可核验的 ZDR 声明文件。

role.quote: Customer’s obligations as a Controller under the DPA will apply.

points.text: Conclusion: on the enterprise/paid tiers GitLab positions itself as processor (the customer is controller)
points.text_zh: 结论：企业/付费档 GitLab 自认 processor（客户为 controller）

points.text: On the free/self-serve tiers GitLab appears as controller (processor_for_enterprise_customer_controller_for_self_serve). Contract layer: (1) GitLab Duo AI Terms §2.3, "To the extent Customer's use of AI Functionality powered by GitLab Models involves the processing of Personal Data, Customer's obligations as a Controller under the DPA will apply. Any sub-processors used to provide AI Functionality powered by GitLab Models will be listed at https://about.gitlab.com/privacy/subprocessors/ and all notifications of updates to that list will be done in accordance with Section 14 of the DPA." — it places the DPA's controller obligations on the customer, which puts GitLab in the processor position
points.text_zh: 免费/自助档 GitLab 以 controller 身份出现（processor_for_enterprise_customer_controller_for_self_serve）。合同层：①《GitLab Duo AI Terms》§2.3「To the extent Customer's use of AI Functionality powered by GitLab Models involves the processing of Personal Data, Customer's obligations as a Controller under the DPA will apply. Any sub-processors used to provide AI Functionality powered by GitLab Models will be listed at https://about.gitlab.com/privacy/subprocessors/ and all notifications of updates to that list will be done in accordance with Section 14 of the DPA.」——把 DPA 的 controller 义务加在客户身上，即 GitLab 站 processor 位

points.text: §2.1 also states that "these Terms, along with the Agreement and the DPA, govern Customer's access to and use of AI Functionality and GitLab Models". (2) Subscription Agreement §14.2, "If this Agreement is entered into on behalf of an Enterprise, the terms of the data processing addendum at ... (“DPA”) are hereby incorporated by reference and shall apply to the extent Customer Content includes Personal Data"
points.text_zh: §2.1 同时明确「these Terms, along with the Agreement and the DPA, govern Customer's access to and use of AI Functionality and GitLab Models」。②《Subscription Agreement》§14.2「If this Agreement is entered into on behalf of an Enterprise, the terms of the data processing addendum at ... (“DPA”) are hereby incorporated by reference and shall apply to the extent Customer Content includes Personal Data」

points.text: §14.4 also carries a PIPL cross-border clause requiring the customer, as "personal information processor", to give notice and obtain separate consent itself. (3) The subprocessor page opens with "When acting as a processor for Customer, Gitlab may engage the following entities to carry out specific processing activities". (4) The Privacy Statement, "For Enterprise Users or accounts that are members of a paid namespace, the enterprise that provisioned your account or invited you to its paid namespace is the Controller of your data. GitLab is a Processor in this scenario" — the same paragraph also confirms that in free/self-serve scenarios GitLab is itself the controller (the privacy statement is written throughout in a controller's voice: we collect / we use). (5) Bring-your-own models (Customer Models) and third-party products are excluded from GitLab's commitments and liability by AI Terms §1.3/§1.9/§2.2, and the role relationship on that hop is set between the customer and its own model vendor. Uncertainty: the body of the DPA (the handbook page only links to an external document, and the PDF text was not obtained this round) could not be checked clause by clause
points.text_zh: §14.4 另有 PIPL 出境条款，要求客户作为「personal information processor」自行完成告知与单独同意。③子处理商页开头「When acting as a processor for Customer, Gitlab may engage the following entities to carry out specific processing activities」。④《Privacy Statement》「For Enterprise Users or accounts that are members of a paid namespace, the enterprise that provisioned your account or invited you to its paid namespace is the Controller of your data.
