points.text: Not a training permission. The in-memory caching paragraph says cached data "is used only for improving service performance"; under this ledger's rule that "service improvement" wording counts as training, that sentence is examined here and does not overturn mark = yes. The contract layer (Service Specific Terms §18) expressly bars Google from using Customer Data to train or fine-tune AI/ML models, and the sentence describes a latency-reduction performance cache — in-memory only, not at-rest, 24-hour TTL — so it ranks below the contract.
points.text_zh: 不构成训练授权。内存缓存段写缓存数据「is used only for improving service performance」；按本台账「用来改进服务算训练」的口径，这句须在训练维度被审视，但它不推翻 mark = yes：合同层（Service Specific Terms §18）已明确禁止用 Customer Data 训练或微调 AI/ML 模型，而该句描述的是降低延迟的性能缓存（仅内存、不落盘、24 小时 TTL），权威性低于合同。
points.quote: This data is stored only in-memory (not at-rest), is isolated at the project level, and has a 24-hour TTL.

zdr.quote: To achieve zero data retention, customers must take specific actions within each of these areas

points.text: Path to ZDR: "If you are in scope for prompt logging for abuse monitoring and want zero data retention, you can request an exception for abuse monitoring." On this tier ZDR is not a self-serve switch — the customer must take specific actions in each of the areas listed on this page and request the abuse-monitoring exception from Google.
points.text_zh: 达成 ZDR 的路径：原文「If you are in scope for prompt logging for abuse monitoring and want zero data retention, you can request an exception for abuse monitoring.」本档的 ZDR 不是自助开关——客户须在该页所列的每个领域逐项采取动作，并向 Google 申请滥用监控豁免。
points.quote: If you are in scope for prompt logging for abuse monitoring and want zero data retention, you can request an exception for abuse monitoring.

points.text: Who that agreement path applies to: only customers whose use of Google Cloud is governed by the Google Cloud Platform Terms of Service are subject to prompt logging for abuse monitoring, and "customers with a Google Cloud Master Agreement are exempt from prompt logging for this abuse monitoring by default". The exception is granted only if the opt-out form is approved, after which "Google won't store any prompts associated with the approved Google Cloud account".
points.text_zh: 这条申请路径对谁成立：只有使用受 Google Cloud Platform Terms of Service 约束的客户才在滥用监控范围内，「customers with a Google Cloud Master Agreement are exempt from prompt logging for this abuse monitoring by default」；豁免须填表并经批准，批准后「Google won't store any prompts associated with the approved Google Cloud account」。
points.quote: Only customers whose use of Google Cloud is governed by the Google Cloud Platform Terms of Service.

points.text: Availability is not universal: "Zero data retention may not be possible when using some Advanced AI features." Customers are told to contact their account team for clarification.
points.text_zh: 可用性并非普遍成立：原文「Zero data retention may not be possible when using some Advanced AI features.」官方要求联系客户团队确认。
points.quote: Zero data retention may not be possible when using some Advanced AI features.

points.text: Which models the exception can hit: the models and features designated as "Advanced AI" include Claude Mythos (all versions), Claude Fable (all versions), and Claude Opus >=4.7 and Sonnet >=5 when `advanced_ai_enabled` is set to `true` for use within Anthropic's Cyber Verification Program. All other usage of those Claude models is out of scope of the Advanced AI Safety Addendum.
points.text_zh: 例外可能落在哪些模型上：被指定为「Advanced AI」的模型与特性包括 Claude Mythos（全部版本）、Claude Fable（全部版本），以及为 Anthropic Cyber Verification Program 开启 `advanced_ai_enabled` 时的 Claude Opus >=4.7 与 Sonnet >=5；这些 Claude 模型的其余用法不在 Advanced AI Safety Addendum 范围内。
points.quote:
Models and features designated as "Advanced AI", including:

Claude Mythos (all versions)

Claude Fable (all versions)

Claude Opus >=4.7 and Sonnet >=5 when `advanced_ai_enabled` is set to `true` for use within Anthropic's Cyber Verification Program (CVP).

retention.quote: Absent Customer’s prior permission or instruction, Google will not store outside Customer’s Account (i) Customer Data prompted to a Generative AI Service for longer than is reasonably necessary to create the Generated Output, or (ii) the Generated Output.

points.text: Default (contract layer, highest authority): object = prompts and Generated Output; context = default, outside Customer's Account; period type = as needed — "Absent Customer's prior permission or instruction, Google will not store outside Customer's Account (i) Customer Data prompted to a Generative AI Service for longer than is reasonably necessary to create the Generated Output, or (ii) the Generated Output." The "Absent Customer's prior permission or instruction" clause makes it a default, not an absolute: traffic governed by the Google Cloud Platform Terms of Service is still logged for abuse monitoring (see the 90-day point below), and the Service Specific Terms repeat the same logging permission for Partners and Non-TOS Customers.
points.text_zh: 默认口径（合同层，权威最高）：对象=prompt 与 Generated Output；语境=默认、客户账户之外；期限类型=按需——原文「Absent Customer's prior permission or instruction, Google will not store outside Customer's Account (i) Customer Data prompted to a Generative AI Service for longer than is reasonably necessary to create the Generated Output, or (ii) the Generated Output.」前置条件「Absent Customer's prior permission or instruction」说明它是默认而非绝对：受 GCP ToS 约束的流量仍会被滥用监控记录（见下面 90 天一条），SST 对 Partner 与 Non-TOS 客户也重述了同一项记录授权。
points.quote: Absent Customer’s prior permission or instruction, Google will not store outside Customer’s Account (i) Customer Data prompted to a Generative AI Service for longer than is reasonably necessary to create the Generated Output, or (ii) the Generated Output.

points.text: Deletion on customer instruction (contract layer): object = Customer Data content; context = during the Term, after the customer deletes data that cannot be recovered by the customer; period type = upper bound — "Google will comply with this Instruction as soon as reasonably practicable and within a maximum period of 180 days", with the proviso "unless European Law requires storage" (or applicable law requires storage, under any other Applicable Privacy Law). The 180 days is the compliance ceiling for completing deletion, not a statement that content is kept for 180 days.
points.text_zh: 客户指令删除（合同层）：对象=Customer Data 正文；语境=Term 内、客户删除后无法自行恢复的数据；期限类型=上限——原文「Google will comply with this Instruction as soon as reasonably practicable and within a maximum period of 180 days」，并附但书「unless European Law requires storage」（其他适用隐私法下则为 applicable law requires storage）。180 天是完成删除动作的合规上限，不等于内容会被保留 180 天。
points.quote: If Customer uses the Services to delete any Customer Data during the Term and that Customer Data cannot be recovered by Customer, this use will constitute an Instruction to Google to delete the relevant Customer Data from Google’s systems. Google will comply with this Instruction as soon as reasonably practicable and within a maximum period of 180 days

points.text: When the Term ends (contract layer): object = all remaining Customer Data including existing copies; context = service termination; period type = upper bound — "After a recovery period of up to 30 days from that date, Google will comply with this Instruction as soon as reasonably practicable and within a maximum period of 180 days", again unless European Law or other applicable law requires storage. Per Section 6.3 (Deferred Deletion Instruction), where the same Customer Data is also processed under an Agreement with a continuing Term, the deletion instruction takes effect only when that continuing Term expires.
points.text_zh: 服务终止时（合同层）：对象=全部剩余 Customer Data（含既有副本）；语境=Term 结束；期限类型=上限——原文「After a recovery period of up to 30 days from that date, Google will comply with this Instruction as soon as reasonably practicable and within a maximum period of 180 days」，同样以欧洲法或其他适用法要求存储为例外。按 §6.3（Deferred Deletion Instruction），若同一 Customer Data 还受另一份仍在存续期的协议处理，删除指令要到该存续期届满才生效。
points.quote: After a recovery period of up to 30 days from that date, Google will comply with this Instruction as soon as reasonably practicable and within a maximum period of 180 days

points.text: Abuse-monitoring prompt logs (developer doc): object = logged customer prompts (logs, not encrypted with Customer-managed encryption keys); context = only customers whose use of Google Cloud is governed by the Google Cloud Platform Terms of Service, and only when automated safety classifiers flag suspicious activity needing investigation; period type = upper bound — "This data is stored securely for up to 90 days in the same region or multi-region selected by the customer for their project". Customers may request an opt-out.
points.text_zh: 滥用监控 prompt 日志（开发者文档）：对象=被记录的客户 prompt（日志，不用 CMEK 加密）；语境=仅限使用受 Google Cloud Platform Terms of Service 约束的客户，且仅当自动安全分类器标记出需要调查的可疑活动时；期限类型=上限——原文「This data is stored securely for up to 90 days in the same region or multi-region selected by the customer for their project」。客户可申请豁免。
points.quote: This data is stored securely for up to 90 days in the same region or multi-region selected by the customer for their project

points.text: Advanced AI models (developer doc): object = prompts and responses (logs); context = models and features designated as "Advanced AI"; period type = upper bound of 30 days — "All prompts and responses will be logged and securely stored for up to 30 days for the sole purpose of monitoring for abuse", and it may not be possible to opt out of this logging.
points.text_zh: Advanced AI 模型（开发者文档）：对象=prompt 与 response（日志）；语境=被指定为「Advanced AI」的模型与特性；期限类型=上限 30 天——原文「All prompts and responses will be logged and securely stored for up to 30 days for the sole purpose of monitoring for abuse」，且部分特性可能无法退出该记录。
points.quote: All prompts and responses will be logged and securely stored for up to 30 days for the sole purpose of monitoring for abuse.

points.text: In-memory data caching (developer doc): object = Customer Data (inputs, outputs, and derived data); context = on by default for Google's published Gemini models; period type = 24-hour TTL, and "This data is stored only in-memory (not at-rest), is isolated at the project level". The feature can be disabled at the project level and "does not violate zero data retention".
points.text_zh: 内存缓存（开发者文档）：对象=Customer Data（输入、输出与派生数据）；语境=Google 已发布 Gemini 模型的默认行为；期限类型=24 小时 TTL，且「This data is stored only in-memory (not at-rest), is isolated at the project level」。该特性可按项目关闭，且「does not violate zero data retention」。
points.quote: This data is stored only in-memory (not at-rest), is isolated at the project level, and has a 24-hour TTL.

points.text: Request-response logging (developer doc): "This feature is disabled by default. It can be enabled using a configuration setting on a per-model, per-project basis." Once enabled it writes certain requests and responses to a designated BigQuery table, so it is an opt-in retention path.
points.text_zh: 请求-响应日志（开发者文档）：原文「This feature is disabled by default. It can be enabled using a configuration setting on a per-model, per-project basis.」开启后会把指定模型的某些请求与响应写入指定的 BigQuery 表，属需主动开启的留存路径。
points.quote: This feature is disabled by default. It can be enabled using a configuration setting on a per-model, per-project basis.

points.text: Interactions API default (developer doc): object = user data such as prompts, responses, and conversation state; context = default — "If you do not specify a value for `store`, it defaults to `true` for all models", which applies to all managed models on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, including GA and pre-GA models. Retention is avoided only by explicitly setting `store = false`.
points.text_zh: Interactions API 的默认值（开发者文档）：对象=prompt、response、会话状态等用户数据；语境=默认——原文「If you do not specify a value for `store`, it defaults to `true` for all models」，适用于 Agent Platform 上所有托管模型（含 GA 与 pre-GA）。只有显式设置 `store = false` 才不产生留存。
points.quote: When using the Interactions API with `store = true`, Google stores user data (such as prompts, responses, and conversation state) to enable multi-turn conversations and later retrieval. If you do not specify a value for `store`, it defaults to `true` for all models.

points.text: Grounding with Google Search (developer doc + contract): object = logs containing queries derived from End User prompts and contextual information that Customer may provide, not associated with any Customer or its End Users; context = using this feature, storage cannot be turned off — "There is no way to disable the storage of this information if you use Grounding with Google Search"; period type = upper bound of three (3) days. The recommended route for customers who require zero data retention is Web Grounding for Enterprise, which deletes subsection 20(k)(ii) (storage for debugging).
points.text_zh: Google Search 接地（开发者文档 + 合同）：对象=由终端用户 prompt 派生的查询与客户可能提供的上下文信息，不与任何客户或终端用户关联；语境=使用该特性时无法关闭存储——原文「There is no way to disable the storage of this information if you use Grounding with Google Search」；期限类型=上限 3 天。需要 ZDR 的客户被建议改用 Web Grounding for Enterprise（SST §20.l 删除了 20(k)(ii) 的调试存储）。
points.quote: that are not associated with any Customer or its End Users for up to three (3) days

points.text: Grounding with Google Maps (developer doc + contract): object = prompts and contextual information that customers may provide, and generated output; context = using this feature, storage cannot be turned off; period type = thirty (30) days, for the purposes of creating grounded results and usable only for reliability engineering.
points.text_zh: Google Maps 接地（开发者文档 + 合同）：对象=客户可能提供的 prompt 与上下文信息，以及生成输出；语境=使用该特性时无法关闭存储；期限类型=30 天，用途限于生成接地结果，且只能用于可靠性工程。
points.quote: and generated output for thirty (30) days for the purposes of creating grounded results

points.text: Session resumption for Gemini Live API (developer doc): object = cached data including text, video, and audio prompt data and model outputs; context = disabled by default and must be enabled by the user on each call; period type = up to 24 hours, and the way to achieve zero data retention is not to enable it.
points.text_zh: Gemini Live API 会话续接（开发者文档）：对象=缓存数据，含文本、视频、音频 prompt 数据与模型输出；语境=默认关闭，须由用户每次调用时显式开启；期限类型=最长 24 小时，达成 ZDR 的方式是不开启该特性。
points.quote: for up to 24 hours. To achieve zero data retention, do not enable this feature.

points.text: CodeMender session data (developer doc, agent products): object = session state including target source code snippets, diffs, configuration, and analysis checkpoints; context = while a find-and-fix scan is in progress; period type = up to seven (7) days from session creation (encrypted), with source code cleared within seconds of a terminal state and the remaining session record deleted at the seven-day TTL; customers can delete a session earlier.
points.text_zh: CodeMender 会话数据（开发者文档，agent 产品）：对象=会话状态，含目标源码片段、diff、配置与分析检查点；语境=find-and-fix 扫描进行期间；期限类型=自会话创建起最长 7 天（加密存储），会话进入终态后源码在数秒内清除、剩余会话记录在 7 天 TTL 时自动删除；客户可提前删除会话。
points.quote: is stored encrypted for up to seven (7) days from session creation

processing_region.quote: Google will store Customer Data for that Service at rest only within the selected Region or Multi-Region.

points.text: Default when no region is selected, or when the service is not on the data-residency list (DPA §10.1, contract layer): "Customer Data may be processed in any country where Google or its Subprocessors maintain facilities", subject to Google's data location commitments under the Service Specific Terms and the data transfer commitments under Appendix 3. codes = ["selected"] therefore holds only where the service is listed at the data-residency page (Service Specific Terms §1.b) and the customer actually configures a Region or Multi-Region (or the AI/ML Multi-Region under §16); otherwise this default applies.
points.text_zh: 未选地域、或所用服务不在 data-residency 列表内时的默认口径（DPA §10.1，合同层）：原文「Customer Data may be processed in any country where Google or its Subprocessors maintain facilities」，并受 Service Specific Terms 的数据位置承诺与附录 3 的数据传输承诺约束。因此 codes = ["selected"] 只在服务列入 data-residency 页（SST §1.b）、且客户实际配置了 Region/Multi-Region（AI/ML 场景见 §16）时成立；否则回落本句的默认。
points.quote: Customer Data may be processed in any country where Google or its Subprocessors maintain facilities.

role.quote: Google is a processor and Customer is a controller or processor, as applicable, of Customer Personal Data.

training.quote: Google will not use Customer Data to train or fine-tune any AI/ML models without Customer's prior permission or instruction.

zdr.quote: To achieve zero data retention, customers must take specific actions within each of these areas:

points.text: ZDR here is a checklist to work through, not a default. To reach zero data retention the customer must leave request-response logging off, pass store = false explicitly on the Interactions API (store defaults to true for all models), request an abuse-monitoring exception where prompt logging applies, and not use the Sandbox API. The page does not state whether the Interactions API is open to partner models such as Claude, so that item is recorded as part of the checklist rather than as a Claude-specific rule.
points.text_zh: 这里的 ZDR 是一份要逐项执行的清单，不是默认状态：不开启 request-response logging、Interactions API 显式 store=false（不指定时对所有模型默认 true）、适用滥用监控时申请豁免、不使用 Sandbox API。该页未说明 Interactions API 是否对 Claude 这类 partner model 开放，故此项按清单的一部分记录，不当作 Claude 专属规则。
points.quote: If you do not specify a value for `store`, it defaults to `true` for all models. To achieve zero data retention, explicitly set `store = false` in your API requests.

points.text: Request-response logging is a per-model, per-project switch that is disabled by default; reaching ZDR means leaving it off.
points.text_zh: request-response logging 是按型号、按项目的开关，默认关闭；要达成 ZDR 就不能打开它。
points.quote: Enabling this logging causes certain requests and responses to the specified model to be written to a designated BigQuery table. To achieve zero data retention, do not enable this feature.

points.text: Prompt logging for abuse monitoring only binds customers whose use of Google Cloud is governed by the Google Cloud Platform Terms of Service; those customers can request an exception in order to reach zero data retention.
points.text_zh: 滥用监控的 prompt 记录只约束受 Google Cloud Platform Terms of Service 管辖的客户；这些客户可提交申请获得豁免，以达成零数据保留。
points.quote: If you are in scope for prompt logging for abuse monitoring and want zero data retention, you can request an exception for abuse monitoring.

points.text: Sandbox snapshots persist for the duration of the Sandbox TTL, so the page tells customers not to use the Sandbox API if they need zero retention.
points.text_zh: Sandbox 快照会随 Sandbox TTL 留存，该页因此写明要达成零保留就不要使用 Sandbox API。
points.quote: To achieve zero-data-retention, don't use the Sandbox API.

points.text: Two official limits sit on top of that checklist: zero data retention may not be possible when using some Advanced AI features, and it may not be possible to opt out of prompt-response logging for some of them.
points.text_zh: 清单之上还有两条官方限定：使用某些 Advanced AI 特性时可能无法达成零保留；某些 Advanced AI 特性下 prompt-response 记录可能无法退出。
points.quote: Zero data retention may not be possible when using some Advanced AI features.

points.text: The same limit stated from the abuse-monitoring side: it may not be possible to opt-out of prompt-response logging when using some Advanced AI features, and customers are told to ask their account team.
points.text_zh: 滥用监控页从另一侧写了同一条限定：某些 Advanced AI 特性下可能无法退出 prompt-response 记录，需向客户团队确认。
points.quote: Zero data retention may not be possible when using some Advanced AI features.

points.text: This row's yes does not extend to the Covered Models subset (Claude Fable 5 / Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5 / Mythos 5.1), which is a separate row of this product line: for those models Anthropic's retention and safety review supersedes modified retention commitments such as ZDR.
points.text_zh: 本行的 yes 不覆盖 Covered Models 子集（Claude Fable 5 / Fable 5.1、Claude Mythos 5 / Mythos 5.1）——它们在本产品线单列一行：对它们，Anthropic 的保留与安全审查优先于 ZDR 等修改后的保留承诺。
points.quote: Customer agrees that Anthropic may retain and perform safety reviews on Inputs, Outputs, and other data regarding Customer’s use of the Covered Models

retention.quote: This data is stored securely for up to 90 days in the same region or multi-region selected by the customer for their project

points.text: The 90 days is an upper bound on prompt logs, not a fixed retention period: prompts are logged only when automated safety classifiers flag suspicious activity that needs investigation, and the object logged is the prompt, not the response.
points.text_zh: 90 天是 prompt 日志的上限，不是固定期限：只有自动安全分类器判定可疑、需要进一步调查时才会记录 prompt，记录对象是 prompt 本身，不是 response。
points.quote: If automated safety classifiers detect suspicious activity that requires further investigation into whether a customer has violated our policies, then Google may log customer prompts solely for the purpose of examining whether a violation of the AUP or Prohibited Use Policy has occurred.

points.text: Scope of that logging: only customers whose use of Google Cloud is governed by the Google Cloud Platform Terms of Service; customers with a Google Cloud Master Agreement are exempt from it by default.
points.text_zh: 该记录的适用范围：只有受 Google Cloud Platform Terms of Service 管辖的客户适用；有 Google Cloud Master Agreement 的客户默认豁免。
points.quote: This means that customers with a Google Cloud Master Agreement are exempt from prompt logging for this abuse monitoring by default.

points.text: Other customers can request an exception, and if it is approved Google will not store any prompts associated with the approved account.
points.text_zh: 其他客户可提交表单申请豁免；获批后 Google 不再为获批账户存储任何 prompt。
points.quote: If approved, Google won't store any prompts associated with the approved Google Cloud account.

points.text: Second clock, for models inside the Advanced AI scope: Claude Mythos and Claude Fable (all versions, listed on this product line's Covered Models row) plus Claude Opus >= 4.7 and Sonnet >= 5 when advanced_ai_enabled = true for use within Anthropic's Cyber Verification Program. All other usage of these models is out of scope of the Advanced AI Safety Addendum.
points.text_zh: 第二条时钟（Advanced AI 范围内的模型）：Claude Mythos 与 Claude Fable 的全部版本（见本产品线的 Covered Models 行），以及 advanced_ai_enabled=true 时用于 Anthropic CVP 的 Claude Opus >= 4.7 / Sonnet >= 5。这些模型的其他用法不在 Advanced AI Safety Addendum 范围内。
points.quote: Claude Mythos (all versions)

points.text: Inside that scope prompts and responses are logged and stored for up to 30 days for abuse monitoring only — a different clock from the 90-day prompt-log path.
points.text_zh: 落在该范围内的调用，prompt 与 response 一律记录、最多留存 30 天（仅用于滥用监控）——与 90 天的 prompt 日志是两条不同的时钟。
points.quote: All prompts and responses will be logged and securely stored for up to 30 days for the sole purpose of monitoring for abuse.

points.text: Contract layer, and the highest-authority rule for this row: absent the customer's prior permission or instruction, Google will not store outside the customer's Account (i) Customer Data prompted to a Generative AI Service for longer than is reasonably necessary to create the Generated Output, or (ii) the Generated Output — a necessity standard rather than a number.
points.text_zh: 合同层，也是本行最高权威的口径：未经客户事先许可或指示，Google 不会把提示给 Generative AI Service 的 Customer Data 或 Generated Output 存到客户 Account 之外超过生成输出所必需的时间——这是「必要时间」标准，不是具体天数。
points.quote: Google will not store outside Customer’s Account (i) Customer Data prompted to a Generative AI Service for longer than is reasonably necessary to create the Generated Output, or (ii) the Generated Output

points.text: Deletion-completion timeline, not a retention period: when the customer deletes Customer Data through the Services, Google complies as soon as reasonably practicable and within a maximum period of 180 days.
points.text_zh: 删除完成时限（不是保留期限）：客户通过服务删除 Customer Data 后，Google 在合理可行范围内尽快完成，最长 180 天。
points.quote: Google will comply with this Instruction as soon as reasonably practicable and within a maximum period of 180 days

points.text: Deletion-completion timeline, not a retention period: at the end of the Term, after a recovery period of up to 30 days, Google deletes the remaining Customer Data within a maximum period of 180 days.
points.text_zh: 删除完成时限（不是保留期限）：服务期结束时，经过最长 30 天的恢复期后，Google 在最长 180 天内删除剩余 Customer Data。
points.quote: After a recovery period of up to 30 days from that date, Google will comply with this Instruction as soon as reasonably practicable and within a maximum period of 180 days

processing_region.quote: The geographic location of this processing is determined by your choice of endpoint

points.text: The column asks where data is processed, and the platform page separates that from storage: data at rest stays in the customer-selected location independent of the endpoint called.
points.text_zh: 列名问的是「数据在哪里处理」，平台页把这件事与存储分开：at-rest 数据留在客户选定位置，与所调端点无关。
points.quote: Data stored at rest in the customer selected location remains at rest in that

points.text: Processing location is set by the choice of endpoint — jurisdictional multi-region, locational, or global.
points.text_zh: 处理地由所选的端点决定——jurisdictional multi-region、locational 或 global。
points.quote: The geographic location of this processing is determined by your choice of endpoint

points.text: Global endpoints route and process data anywhere globally, without restricting it to a specific geographic region, and provide no regional isolation or data residency guarantees.
points.text_zh: global 端点在全球任意位置路由和处理数据，不限制在特定地理区域，也不提供区域隔离或数据驻留保证。
points.quote: Global endpoints route and process data anywhere globally, without restricting it to a specific geographic region.

points.text: Contract layer (CDPA §10.1): subject to Google's data location commitments under the Service Specific Terms and its data transfer commitments, Customer Data may be processed in any country where Google or its Subprocessors maintain facilities.
points.text_zh: 合同层（CDPA §10.1）：在 Google 于 Service Specific Terms 下的数据位置承诺与数据传输承诺约束下，Customer Data 可能在 Google 或其 Subprocessor 设有设施的任何国家处理。
points.quote: Customer Data may be processed in any country where Google or its Subprocessors maintain facilities.

points.text: SST §16 lets the customer configure both at-rest storage and machine learning processing of Customer Data into a specific Multi-Region, and Google will perform both only in that Multi-Region.
points.text_zh: SST §16 允许客户把 Customer Data 的 at-rest 存储与 ML processing 一并配置到某个 Multi-Region，Google 只在那个 Multi-Region 内执行这两件事。
points.quote: to (a) store Customer Data at rest and (b) perform machine learning processing of Customer Data by the Service, in each case in a specific Multi-Region, and Google will perform (a) and (b) only in that Multi-Region.

points.text: Which regions are actually available is decided per model, not per provider: the data-residency page carries a partner-model table that lists regional support model by model, and each model page gives its own ML processing regions.
points.text_zh: 具体哪些区域可用按型号而非按厂商决定：驻留文档里有 partner model 表，逐型号列出区域支持；每个型号页另给出该型号的 ML processing 区域。
points.quote: Google Cloud partner model support

role.quote: Google is a processor and Customer is a controller or processor, as applicable, of Customer Personal Data.

points.text: The Anthropic layer is scoped by Anthropic's own terms: use of Anthropic models on Agent Platform is governed by Anthropic's Commercial Terms of Service or other applicable agreement with Anthropic, with Advanced AI use governed by Section F of Anthropic's Service Specific Terms.
points.text_zh: Anthropic 那一层由 Anthropic 自己的条款划定：Agent Platform 上 Anthropic 模型的用量受 Anthropic 商业服务条款（或与 Anthropic 的其他适用协议）管辖，Advanced AI 的用量受 Anthropic Service Specific Terms §F 管辖。
points.quote: Use of Anthropic models on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform is governed by Anthropic's

training.quote: Google will not use Customer Data to train or fine-tune any AI/ML models without Customer's prior permission or instruction.

points.text: The Anthropic hop adds its own contract on top of Google's training restriction: Anthropic may not train models on Customer Content from Services.
points.text_zh: 多出的一跳在 Google 的训练限制之上另有自己的合同：Anthropic 不得用 Services 的 Customer Content 训练模型。
points.quote: Anthropic may not train models on Customer Content from Services.

zdr.quote: Customer agrees that Anthropic may retain and perform safety reviews on Inputs, Outputs, and other data regarding Customer’s use of the Covered Models

points.text: Anthropic's Covered Models policy says it plainly: zero data retention is not available in workspaces, Claude Enterprise organizations, or third-party platforms where Covered Models can be accessed — Google Cloud Agent Platform is one of those platforms.
points.text_zh: Anthropic 的 Covered Models 政策写明：在可访问 Covered Models 的工作区、Claude Enterprise 组织或第三方平台上不提供零数据保留——Google Cloud Agent Platform 正是这类平台。
points.quote: Accordingly, zero data retention is not available in workspaces, Claude Enterprise organizations, or third-party platforms (e.g., Azure Subscriptions) where Covered Models can be accessed.

points.text: Counter-statement kept side by side rather than reconciled: eligible customers are offered the option to use ZDR with Fable 5 and Fable 5.1 for their own internal business applications, for a limited time, as a transition to Enterprise Frontier Safeguards. The contract layer still supersedes modified retention commitments such as ZDR.
points.text_zh: 并列保留、不调和的反向表述：符合条件的客户可限时获得对 Fable 5 / Fable 5.1 使用 ZDR 的选项（仅限自有内部业务应用，作为向 Enterprise Frontier Safeguards 的过渡）。合同层仍然明确优先于 ZDR 等修改后的保留承诺。
points.quote: To make the transition smooth, eligible customers will receive the option to use ZDR with Fable 5 and Fable 5.1 for their own internal business applications. This arrangement is available for a limited time, and intended to be a transition to EFS.

retention.quote: 30-day minimum retention by default.

points.text: Anthropic's 30 days is a floor, not a ceiling: prompts and model completions are retained for at least 30 days and then automatically deleted, unless they are subject to a safety investigation or Anthropic is legally required to maintain them.
points.text_zh: Anthropic 的 30 天是下限而非上限：prompt 与模型输出至少保留 30 天后再自动删除，除非处于安全调查中或法律要求继续保留。
points.quote: Prompts and model completions are retained for at least 30 days and then automatically deleted, unless they are subject to a safety investigation or we are legally required to maintain them.

points.text: Google's side gives the same 30 days as an upper bound and adds an enablement duty: for Anthropic Claude Fable 5 on Google Cloud and Mythos 5, prompts and responses are retained for up to 30 days, and using those models requires enabling sharing of that data with Anthropic. The two figures describe different things and are kept side by side.
points.text_zh: Google 一侧给出的是同一段 30 天的上限，并附加一项开启义务：Claude Fable 5 on Google Cloud 与 Mythos 5 的 prompt 与 response 最多保留 30 天，且使用这些模型必须开启与 Anthropic 的数据共享。两个数字说的不是同一件事，并列保留。
points.quote: For Anthropic Claude Fable 5 on Google Cloud and Mythos 5, prompts and responses are retained for up to 30 days.

points.text: The Fable 5 model page repeats the Google-side figure: all prompts and responses are stored for up to 30 days for the sole purpose of monitoring for potential abuse of relevant terms of service.
points.text_zh: Fable 5 型号页重复了 Google 一侧的口径：所有 prompt 与 response 最多存储 30 天，且仅用于监控是否滥用相关服务条款。
points.quote: All prompts and responses are stored for up to 30 days for the sole purpose of monitoring for potential abuse of relevant terms of service

points.text: These policies follow the model and apply wherever Covered Models are offered, including third-party cloud platforms.
points.text_zh: 这些政策随模型走，适用于所有提供 Covered Models 的地方，包括第三方云平台。
points.quote: These policies follow the model. They apply wherever Covered Models are offered, including third-party cloud platforms.

points.text: Anthropic's API documentation states the same requirement for third-party platforms: the 30-day data retention requirement applies wherever Covered Models are offered.
points.text_zh: Anthropic 的 API 文档对第三方平台给出同一条要求：该 30 天保留要求适用于所有提供 Covered Models 的地方。
points.quote: The 30-day data retention requirement applies wherever Covered Models are offered.

points.text: Where that retained data sits on this platform: on Google Cloud's Agent Platform retained data stays within the cloud provider's environment.
points.text_zh: 这些留存数据在云平台上的位置：在 Google Cloud Agent Platform 上，留存数据留在云厂商环境内。
points.quote: On Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud's Agent Platform, retained data stays within your cloud provider's environment

processing_region.quote: The geographic location of this processing is determined by your choice of endpoint

points.text: Processing location is set by the choice of endpoint, and global endpoints route and process data anywhere globally with no residency guarantee.
points.text_zh: 处理地由所选的端点决定；global 端点在全球任意位置路由和处理数据，不提供驻留保证。
points.quote: Global endpoints route and process data anywhere globally, without restricting it to a specific geographic region.

points.text: The Fable 5 model page lists Global / global endpoint among the model's available regions, so a global endpoint is a documented option for this row — that is why the codes here include global.
points.text_zh: Fable 5 型号页把 Global / global endpoint 列在该型号的可用区域里，因此经 global 端点调用是本行有据可依的选项——本行 codes 因此含 global。

ML processing

points.quote: Customer Data may be processed in any country where Google or its Subprocessors maintain facilities.

points.text: SST §16 lets the customer configure both at-rest storage and machine learning processing of Customer Data into a specific Multi-Region, and Google will perform both only in that Multi-Region.
points.text_zh: SST §16 允许客户把 Customer Data 的 at-rest 存储与 ML processing 一并配置到某个 Multi-Region，Google 只在那个 Multi-Region 内执行这两件事。
points.quote: to (a) store Customer Data at rest and (b) perform machine learning processing of Customer Data by the Service, in each case in a specific Multi-Region, and Google will perform (a) and (b) only in that Multi-Region.

role.quote: Google is a processor and Customer is a controller or processor, as applicable, of Customer Personal Data.

points.text: Default on Cloud Platforms: the technology Anthropic provides to enable access to the Hosted Services does not give Anthropic access to any Customer instance within the Cloud Platforms, including the Inputs or Outputs they contain — subject to Section F.2 below.
points.text_zh: 云平台上的默认安排：Anthropic 为提供 Hosted Services 访问而提供的技术，不让 Anthropic 接触云平台上任何客户实例的内容（含其中的 Inputs/Outputs）——但受 §F.2 约束。
points.quote: the technology provided by Anthropic to enable access to the Hosted Services does not give Anthropic access to any Customer instance within the applicable Cloud Platforms, including the Inputs or Outputs they contain.

points.text: Covered Models change that: the Fable 5 model page requires prompt-response sharing with Anthropic for each model location, as required by Section F of Anthropic's Service Specific Terms.
points.text_zh: Covered Models 改变了这一点：Fable 5 型号页要求为每个 model location 开启与 Anthropic 的 prompt-response 共享（Anthropic Service Specific Terms §F 的要求）。
points.quote: enable prompt-response sharing with Anthropic for each model location

points.text: But the role itself does not change: for data regarding the customer's use of Covered Models via a Cloud Platform, Anthropic processes such data on the customer's behalf in accordance with the Anthropic Data Processing Agreement.
points.text_zh: 但角色本身不变：经云平台使用 Covered Models 所产生的数据，Anthropic 依 Anthropic DPA 以客户受托方身份处理。
points.quote: Anthropic will process such data on Customer's behalf in accordance with the Anthropic Data Processing Agreement (or other applicable data processing agreement between the parties) consistent with the terms governing the processing of Customer Data.

points.text: Regional carve-out (§17.15, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia): "Groq’s rights to Inputs and Outputs in Section 4.2 (Inputs and Outputs) are amended as follows: “Groq does not access, use, store, or retain Inputs or Outputs unless necessary to provide the Cloud Services or comply with applicable law.”" The amendment applies by billing address and rewrites the Inputs and Outputs paragraph as a whole, so for those Customers neither the no-training sentence nor the zero data retention setting sentence of §4.2 exists — training=yes and zdr=yes have no contractual basis for them. §8.2 (Customer's Training Data) is not touched by the amendment.
points.text_zh: 地区例外（§17.15，沙特）：billing address 在沙特的客户适用改写版 §4.2——该条把 §4.2 的「Inputs and Outputs」整段替换为只讲 access/use/store/retain 的版本，原「不用于训练」句与 ZDR 开关句都不在新文本里，故对这批客户，本档 training=yes 与 zdr=yes 的合同层依据不成立。改写只针对 Inputs and Outputs 段，§8.2 的 Customer Training Data 限制不受影响（仍只可用于向该客户提供服务）。
points.quote: Groq’s rights to Inputs and Outputs in Section 4.2 (Inputs and Outputs) are amended as follows: “Groq does not access, use, store, or retain Inputs or Outputs unless necessary to provide the Cloud Services or comply with applicable law.”

points.text: Supporting contract-layer evidence (DPA §2.3): Groq will Process Personal Data only to provide, maintain and support the Cloud Services and fulfil its obligations to Customer, on Customer's documented instructions, or as required by Data Protection Laws, and will not "sell" or "share" Personal Data or otherwise Process it for any purpose other than the specific purposes described in the DPA or outside the direct business relationship with Customer. Under §17.11 the DPA outranks the Agreement itself. It is a purpose limitation, not an express training ban, so §4.2 remains the primary anchor for this dimension.
points.text_zh: 合同层辅助证据（DPA §2.3）：处理只限三类目的——为提供/维护/支持 Cloud Services 并履行对客户的义务、按客户书面指示、或法律要求；并禁止 sell/share，禁止为 DPA 所述目的之外或直接业务关系之外的目的处理 Personal Data。按 §17.11 的效力顺序，DPA 高于协议本体。它是目的限制条款而非明文的训练禁令，故本维度的主锚点仍是 §4.2 不训练句。
points.quote: Groq will Process Personal Data only: (a) to provide, maintain, and support the Cloud Services and fulfill its obligations to Customer under the Agreement; (b) on Customer's behalf in compliance with Customer's documented instructions; and (c) as required by Data Protection Laws (however, Groq will inform Customer of the legal requirement before processing for that purpose unless the applicable law prohibits such notice). Groq will not "sell" or "share" (as such terms are defined in Data Protection Laws) Personal Data, or otherwise Process Personal Data for any purpose: (x) other than for the specific purposes described in this DPA, or (y) outside of the direct business relationship with Customer.

zdr.quote: All customers may enable Zero Data Retention (ZDR) in [Data Controls settings](https://console.groq.com/settings/data-controls). When ZDR is enabled, Groq will not retain customer data for system reliability and abuse monitoring.

points.text: 见顶层 zdr。开关在 console.groq.com/settings/data-controls，组织管理员可全局或按功能开启
points.text_zh: 见顶层 zdr。开关在 console.groq.com/settings/data-controls，组织管理员可全局或按功能开启

points.text: 开启后 Batch / Fine-tuning 等依赖保留的功能被禁用
points.text_zh: 开启后 Batch / Fine-tuning 等依赖保留的功能被禁用

points.text: 合同 §4.2 用「Eligible Customers」表述，与文档「All customers」冲突，两条并列。
points.text_zh: 合同 §4.2 用「Eligible Customers」表述，与文档「All customers」冲突，两条并列。

points.text: Regional carve-out: for Customers whose billing address is in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, §17.15 replaces the Inputs and Outputs paragraph of §4.2 with a version that no longer contains the zero data retention setting sentence, so the contractual route to ZDR does not exist for those Customers.
points.text_zh: 地区例外：billing address 在沙特的客户，§17.15 把 §4.2 的 Inputs and Outputs 段整段改写为不含 ZDR 开关句的版本，故这批客户没有合同层的 ZDR 依据（文档层的 console 开关表述未按地区区分）。
points.quote: Groq’s rights to Inputs and Outputs in Section 4.2 (Inputs and Outputs) are amended as follows: “Groq does not access, use, store, or retain Inputs or Outputs unless necessary to provide the Cloud Services or comply with applicable law.”

retention.summary: 按对象分列保留 30 天
retention.quote: Groq does not access, use, store, or retain Inputs or Outputs except as necessary to provide the Cloud Services, in accordance with the Customer's permission or instruction, comply with applicable law, ensure the reliable operation of the Cloud Services, or confirm Customer’s compliance with the [AUP](https://console.groq.com/docs/legal/ai-policy).

points.text: 见顶层 retention。本档对象：推理输入输出正文（默认不保留）／可靠性滥用日志（≤30 天，可 opt-out）／Batch 文件（30 天）／微调数据（至客户删除）／Prompt Cache（易失内存，2 小时未使用过期）／反馈中的对话片段（≤3 年）／终止后删除（30 天，DPA 路径最长 180 天）。
points.text_zh: 见顶层 retention。本档对象：推理输入输出正文（默认不保留）／可靠性滥用日志（≤30 天，可 opt-out）／Batch 文件（30 天）／微调数据（至客户删除）／Prompt Cache（易失内存，2 小时未使用过期）／反馈中的对话片段（≤3 年）／终止后删除（30 天，DPA 路径最长 180 天）。

points.text: Contract layer (primary anchor, §4.2): Groq does not access, use, store or retain Inputs or Outputs except as necessary to provide the Cloud Services, in accordance with the Customer's permission or instruction, to comply with applicable law, to ensure the reliable operation of the Cloud Services, or to confirm the Customer's compliance with the AUP. Mapping to what the developer-data page documents: "ensure the reliable operation" + "confirm compliance with the AUP" are the basis for the reliability and abuse-monitoring logs; "as necessary to provide the Cloud Services" is the basis for Batch and fine-tuning retention.
points.text_zh: 合同层（主锚点，§4.2）：除四类情形外不 access/use/store/retain Inputs 与 Outputs——为提供 Cloud Services 所必需、依客户许可或指示、遵守适用法律、确保 Cloud Services 可靠运行、核实客户是否遵守 AUP。对应到开发者文档里的具体场景：「确保可靠运行」与「核实 AUP 合规」是可靠性/滥用监控日志的依据，「为提供服务所必需」是 Batch 与微调保留的依据。
points.quote: Groq does not access, use, store, or retain Inputs or Outputs except as necessary to provide the Cloud Services, in accordance with the Customer's permission or instruction, comply with applicable law, ensure the reliable operation of the Cloud Services, or confirm Customer’s compliance with the [AUP](https://console.groq.com/docs/legal/ai-policy).

points.text: Product-behaviour layer, default: "By default, Groq does not retain customer data for inference requests."
points.text_zh: 产品行为层·默认：《Your Data in GroqCloud》明写默认不保留推理请求的客户数据（页面对象是 GroqCloud）。
points.quote: **By default, Groq does not retain customer data for inference requests.**

points.text: Product-behaviour layer, exception period: system-reliability and abuse-monitoring logs "are retained for up to 30 days, unless legally required to retain longer" — an upper bound on that log class, not a promise that all content is deleted after 30 days.
points.text_zh: 产品行为层·例外期限：可靠性/滥用监控日志「up to 30 days」，是这一类日志的上限，不是「30 天后全部内容删除」的承诺。
points.quote: These logs are retained for up to **30 days**, unless legally required to retain longer.

points.text: Termination deletion (§11.5): on termination Groq deletes Customer Data, Customer Training Data and any Customer supplied AI Model Service within 30 days, unless otherwise described in the Agreement or the Order Form or required by law.
points.text_zh: 终止后删除（§11.5）：协议终止后 30 天内删除 Customer Data、Customer Training Data 与客户自带的 AI Model Service（协议/Order Form 另有约定或法律要求保留的除外）。
points.quote: Groq will delete any Customer Data, Customer Training Data, and Customer supplied AI Model Service, as applicable, in its systems within 30 days, unless otherwise described in this Agreement or the Order Form or if Groq is required to retain any such information under applicable law.

points.text: Deletion on request (DPA §10): the Customer may request deletion of Personal Data, to be done as soon as reasonably practicable and within a maximum of 180 days.
points.text_zh: 客户请求删除（DPA §10）：客户可请求删除 Personal Data，最长 180 天内完成（含备份例外），比 §11.5 的 30 天更长。
points.quote: Customer may request Groq to promptly delete all Personal Data in its possession or control as soon as reasonably practicable and within a maximum period of 180 days

points.text: Two framings kept side by side: DPA ANNEX I describes a purpose-bound period ("The data will be retained for the time period needed to accomplish the purposes of Processing, unless otherwise required by applicable law."), while the Agreement and the developer-data page give fixed caps (30 days for logs and termination deletion, 180 days for the DPA request path). Neither overrides the other here.
points.text_zh: 两种口径并列保留：DPA ANNEX I 是目的绑定式期限（「为完成处理目的所需的时间」，法律另有要求除外），协议与开发者文档给的是固定上限（日志与终止后删除 30 天、DPA 请求路径最长 180 天）。按 docs/judgment.md，冲突的两条官方说法都写出，不选边。
points.quote: The data will be retained for the time period needed to accomplish the purposes of Processing, unless otherwise required by applicable law.

points.text: Supporting contract-layer evidence (DPA §2.3): Processing is limited to the purposes described in the DPA and the direct business relationship with Customer, and Groq will not "sell" or "share" Personal Data. This is a purpose limitation that supports retention=yes; it does not by itself state a retention period.
points.text_zh: 合同层辅助证据（DPA §2.3）：处理限于 DPA 所述目的与直接业务关系之内，且不 sell/share Personal Data。它支持「不得为服务之外目的保留」这一支，但本身不给出期限，故只作辅助证据。
points.quote: Groq will Process Personal Data only: (a) to provide, maintain, and support the Cloud Services and fulfill its obligations to Customer under the Agreement; (b) on Customer's behalf in compliance with Customer's documented instructions; and (c) as required by Data Protection Laws (however, Groq will inform Customer of the legal requirement before processing for that purpose unless the applicable law prohibits such notice). Groq will not "sell" or "share" (as such terms are defined in Data Protection Laws) Personal Data, or otherwise Process Personal Data for any purpose: (x) other than for the specific purposes described in this DPA, or (y) outside of the direct business relationship with Customer.

points.text: Supporting contract-layer evidence (DPA §2.3): Processing is limited to providing, maintaining and supporting the Cloud Services and fulfilling obligations to Customer, to Customer's documented instructions, or to what Data Protection Laws require; Groq will not "sell" or "share" Personal Data or Process it for purposes outside the DPA or outside the direct business relationship with Customer. Under §17.11 the DPA outranks the Agreement, so this binds enterprise Customers too; it is a purpose limitation rather than an express training ban, and §4.2 stays the primary anchor.
points.text_zh: 合同层辅助证据（DPA §2.3）：处理限于为提供/维护/支持 Cloud Services 并履行对客户的义务、按客户书面指示、或法律要求三类目的，且不 sell/share、不为 DPA 所述目的或直接业务关系之外的目的处理 Personal Data。按 §17.11 的效力顺序，DPA 高于协议本体，故对企业客户同样有效；它是目的限制条款而非明文训练禁令，主锚点仍是 §4.2。

points.text: Platform-level privacy policy reads as a controller: it states that "Hugging Face remains under an obligation to notify the Users about the legal basis on which their Personal Information is processed." with Consent / Agreement / Legitimate Interests as the grounds, and §1.A reserves the right to access user information without consent for its own legitimate interests.

points.text: 结论：本档没有请求级保留期，唯一量化的数字是注销之后的删除上限。对象与语境分三层：(1) **账号信息与自有仓库内容**——《用户协议》§Your Account「Upon cancellation of your Account, we will use commercially reasonable efforts to delete your information and Content of your own Repositories, whether public or private, within 90 days.」：对象含私有仓库内容，语境是注销之后，期限类型是上限，且以「commercially reasonable efforts」为限，不是硬承诺。(2) **例外**——同节紧接「We also reserve the right to retain your information for legal or regulatory compliance, pursuant to standard archiving, recovery, and back-up processes and practices」：法务合规与备份留存不受 90 天约束。(3) **订阅存续期间**——《隐私政策》§4.B「We retain your Information for as long as necessary to deliver the Services, to comply with any applicable legal requirements, to maintain security and prevent incidents and, in general, to pursue our legitimate interests.」：未量化的「目的必需」口径

points.text: Boundary of the deletion duty (the sentence right after the 90-day one): "We will not delete the Content that you contributed to other Users' Repositories, or copies made by us or other Users." — the 90-day cap covers only the information and Content of your own Repositories; content you contributed to other users' repositories, and copies already made by us or other users, are not deleted. points.text: Conclusion: not_disclosed — the public terms contain neither an authorization that data "may be used for training" nor a commitment that it is "not used for training"; neither direction can be found. Evidence base: across all 33 documents fetched this round (9 legal texts + the FAQ aggregate and single pages + product and operations documentation + the Chinese and English website policies), the word "training" appears exactly once, in User Service Agreement §1.3.6(3)②: "where we, as the platform operator and technology provider, discover or receive a report of unlawful content, we will promptly take disposal measures such as stopping generation, stopping transmission and removal, carry out rectification through measures such as model optimization training, and report to the competent authorities" — this is the unlawful-content rectification context required by the Interim Measures for the Administration of Generative AI Services, not an authorization to use customer data for training. Pointing the other way (also not a commitment): the "special note" opening the platform privacy policy states that the platform "does not directly collect or process any business data or personnel data that you or the enterprise customer you represent provides or generates in the course of use. We only: on the mandate of the enterprise customer you belong to or represent, process and store your ... business data", and §2 again characterizes it as "processing the relevant data on an entrusted basis"
points.text_zh: 结论：not_disclosed——公开条款既没有「可用于训练」的授权，也没有「不用于训练」的承诺，两向都查不到。证据面：本轮抓下的全部 33 份文档（legal 9 篇 + FAQ 聚合与单页 + 产品与运维文档 + 官网中英文政策）中，「训练」二字只在《用户服务协议》§1.3.6(3)② 出现一次：「我们作为平台运营方/技术提供方发现或收到举报存在违法内容的，将及时采取停止生成、停止传输、消除等处置措施，采取模型优化训练等措施进行整改，并向有关主管部门报告」——这是《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》要求的违法内容整改语境，不是把客户数据用于训练客户模型的授权。相反面向（同样不构成承诺）：平台隐私政策开篇「特别说明」自认平台「并不直接收集或处理您或您代表的企业客户在使用过程中所提供或产生的任何业务数据或人员数据。我们仅：受您所属/所代表的企业客户委托，对您……业务数据……进行处理及存储」，§二 再次以「受托处理相关数据」定性

points.text: Under the Personal Information Protection Law, entrusted processing means processing on the mandating party's instructions without using the data beyond that scope, which structurally works against the platform using customer content for training, but not a word of the terms says so — that is inference, not disclosure. Also note: User Service Agreement §6.5 authorizes only "the use of your name, trademarks and logos in sales, marketing and other publicity and promotional materials and activities", and does not touch content. Uncertainties: (1) the "preset models" on the Agentic MaaS platform include third-party closed-source models (User Service Agreement §1.3.1 lists the filing entities for Wuqiong AI Assistant / Onetake / GenStudio, which deploy open-source models such as GLM-5, Moonshot, Kling-V3-omni, seedance-2.0 and deepseek), and Privacy Policy §2.2 also says "if you and your enterprise have a need to use third-party closed-source models, you may raise it with us and we will coordinate on your behalf" — if a request is forwarded to the original vendor of a third-party closed-source model, whether that vendor uses the input for training is not covered anywhere in this provider's documents
points.text_zh: 受托处理在《个人信息保护法》下意味着按委托方指示处理、不得超范围使用，这在结构上不利于平台拿客户内容去训练，但条款本身没有一个字这么说，属推断而非披露。另可注意：《用户服务协议》§6.5 只授权「在销售、营销等宣传、推广材料和活动中使用您的名称、商标、标识」，未触及内容。不确定性：①Agentic MaaS 平台上「预置模型」含第三方闭源模型（用户协议 §1.3.1 列出无穹 AI 助手/Onetake/GenStudio 分别部署了 GLM-5、Moonshot、Kling-V3-omni、seedance-2.0、deepseek 等开源模型的备案主体），隐私政策 §2.2 也说「如您及所属企业有第三方闭源模型使用需求，亦可向我们提出，我们将为您协调」——若请求被转给第三方闭源模型原厂，那些原厂是否用输入训练，本家的文档完全没有覆盖

points.text: (2) throughput content is sent to Alibaba Cloud and NetEase Yidun for content safety review (Privacy Policy §2.2 and §5.1.5); their retention and use rules are in their own policies, and this provider makes no binding statement about them

points.text: (3) the earlier record saying "the privacy policy has no training-related clause" is correct, but it also wrote the conclusion as "maintain not_stated"; this round uses not_disclosed uniformly for the same meaning.
points.text_zh: ③旧记录说「隐私政策无训练相关条款」是对的，但它同时把结论写成「维持 not_stated」，本轮统一用 not_disclosed 表达同一含义。

points.text: (4) The one clause inside the searched set that does put customer-submitted material to "improving the service" use, and therefore has to be handled explicitly under docs/judgment.md ("used to improve the service / raise quality" counts as training), is platform Privacy Policy §2.5 (extended business function — troubleshooting service). The sentence, quoted verbatim from the snapshot: "我们将记录、分析这些信息以便及时响应您的请求，并用于改进服务。" Object boundary: what §2.5 collects is the troubleshooting record the customer submits — "您提交的故障描述、问题证明截图" — i.e. support material about a fault, not the input/output content of API requests. Because the object is support material rather than request content, this clause neither supplies a training commitment nor overturns the not_disclosed verdict for this tier; it is recorded so that the tier is not read as if the platform puts nothing at all to service-improvement use. It is quoted in this point rather than bound as an anchor, because a bound quote on a mark=unknown dimension would assert a conclusion this tier does not carry (docs/judgment.md).
points.text_zh: ④查阅范围内确有一条把客户提交的材料用于「改进服务」的表述，按 docs/judgment.md「用来改进服务/提高质量」算训练的口径必须显式处理：平台隐私政策 §2.5（扩展业务功能-故障排查服务）。原句逐字引自快照：「我们将记录、分析这些信息以便及时响应您的请求，并用于改进服务。」对象边界：§2.5 收集的是客户提交的故障记录——「您提交的故障描述、问题证明截图」，即围绕故障的支持材料，不是 API 请求的输入/输出正文。正因对象是排障材料而非请求正文，这条既不是本档的训练承诺，也不推翻本档的 not_disclosed；写在这里是为了不把本档读成「平台完全不把任何东西用于服务改进」。它只在本条 point 正文里引述、不设锚点——在 mark=unknown 的维度上绑引文等于断言本档并不承载的结论（docs/judgment.md）。

points.text: (5) The second "improvement" wording sits in the same document's §3 (use of Cookies and similar technologies), also quoted verbatim from the snapshot: "通过Cookie和同类技术可以帮助您省去重复填写账号信息、输入搜索内容的步骤和流程，还可以帮助我们改进服务效率、提升登录和响应速度。" Object = Cookie and similar-technology data (account information, search records, login state), again not API input/output content; same treatment and same reason for not binding an anchor as §2.5 above. The same document adds that information collected through Cookies or similar technologies is not used for any purpose other than those described in the policy.
points.text_zh: ⑤第二处「改进」表述在同一份文档的 §三（对 Cookie 和同类技术的使用），同样逐字引自快照：「通过Cookie和同类技术可以帮助您省去重复填写账号信息、输入搜索内容的步骤和流程，还可以帮助我们改进服务效率、提升登录和响应速度。」对象=Cookie 与同类技术数据（账号信息、搜索记录、登录状态），同样不是 API 输入/输出正文；处理方式与不设锚点的理由同上面 §2.5。同一份文档另写明通过 Cookie 或同类技术收集的信息不用于本政策所述目的之外的任何其他用途。

points.text: (6) Anchor bookkeeping for this dimension: three anchors in this file have "training" among their topics, and none of them is bound to this dimension — infini-tos-training-only-remediation (topics: training) is bound to no dimension at all; infini-tos-scope-modules (topics: retention, role, training) is bound to the compute tier's retention evidence, where the §1.3 scope limit does real work; infini-privacy-special-notice-not-collector (topics: role, training) is bound to api/role and compute/role. The §1.3.6(3)② wording is quoted in the point text above instead of being anchored; a bound quote on a mark=unknown dimension would assert a conclusion this tier does not carry (docs/judgment.md).
points.text_zh: ⑥本维度的锚点记账：本文件里 topics 含 training 的锚点共三个，都不绑在本维度——infini-tos-training-only-remediation（topics: training）未绑任何维度；infini-tos-scope-modules（topics: retention, role, training）绑在算力档的 retention 依据上，那里 §1.3 的范围限制才起作用；infini-privacy-special-notice-not-collector（topics: role, training）绑在 api/role 与 compute/role 上。§1.3.6(3)② 那句只在上面 point 正文里引述、不设锚点；在 mark=unknown 的维度上绑引文等于断言本档并不承载的结论（docs/judgment.md）。

zdr.quote: 对于您及您所属客户输入/输出内容，本平台已进行了全量加密并隔离存储

points.text: Conclusion: no ZDR / zero-retention / no-persistence commitment, switch, application path or enterprise data processing addendum can be found, recorded as not_found (no public evidence obtained is not the same as the vendor not offering it). This round fetched all 9 documents in the docs-site legal directory, the support FAQs (including the conversation history single page), the AgentWorks security and memory docs, the Chinese and English website privacy policies and the whole compute cloud website; full-text searches for "zero retention / zero data retention / not retained / not kept / immediate deletion / delete immediately / DPA / data processing agreement / subprocessor" returned no hit
points.text_zh: 结论：查不到任何 ZDR / 零保留 / 不落盘 的承诺、开关、申请方式或企业级数据处理附录，记 not_found（拿不到公开证据 ≠ 厂商不提供）。本轮把文档站 legal 目录 9 篇 + 支持类 FAQ（含会话历史单页）+ AgentWorks 安全与记忆文档 + 官网中英文隐私政策 + 智算云平台官网全部抓了一遍，全文检索「零保留 / 零数据保留 / 不保留 / 不留存 / 即刻删除 / 立即删除 / DPA / 数据处理协议 / 子处理者」均无命中

points.text: The docs site also has no DPA and no trust/security white paper page (the legal directory holds only 9 documents, none a DPA; /legal/legal-notice.html is a 404). The earlier record treated the FAQ sentence "we do not store the conversation history between users and large language models" as ZDR evidence "stronger than a standard no-retention statement"; this round disagrees, for three reasons: (1) the Q&A containing that sentence is "Can I retrieve the chat history of a conversation?", which asks about the user's ability to retrieve history, and the sentence commits only to not storing "conversation history" — it says nothing about request-level non-retention, nothing about deletion once processing completes, and gives no period or application path
points.text_zh: 文档站也不存在 DPA 或 trust/security 白皮书页（legal 目录只有 9 篇，没有 DPA；/legal/legal-notice.html 是 404）。旧记录把 FAQ 那句「我们均不会存储用户与大语言模型的会话历史记录」当成「强于标准不保留表述」的 ZDR 证据，本轮不同意，理由三条：①该句所在问答是「我可以检索会话的聊天历史记录吗？」，问的是用户侧的历史检索能力，句子本身只承诺不存储「会话历史记录」，没有说请求级不保留、没有说处理完成后即删、没有给任何期限或可申请口径

points.text: (2) it is not about the same object as platform Privacy Policy §2.2 — the privacy policy states that "for the input and output content of you and the customer you belong to, this platform applies full encryption and isolated storage", i.e. input and output content is stored (encryption + tenant isolation + decryption only on application by request ID during debugging), while this sentence commits only to not retaining "user-retrievable conversation history"; the two do not conflict (on re-checking on 2026-09-21 that source was reclassified from conflict to core, for the reasons in its scope_note)
points.text_zh: ②它与平台隐私政策 §2.2 讲的不是同一个对象——隐私政策写明「对于您及您所属客户输入/输出内容，本平台已进行了全量加密并隔离存储」，即输入输出正文是被存储的（加密 + 租户隔离 + 仅 debug 时按请求 ID 申请授权解密），而本句只承诺不保留「用户可检索的会话历史」，两者不构成冲突（该源 2026-09-21 重查后由 conflict 改判 core，理由见其 scope_note）

points.text: (3) it appears in the developer documentation FAQ rather than in a legal document, and none of the three legal texts — the platform privacy policy, the user agreement and the website privacy policy — carries a corresponding statement. Three observations in the other direction (which do not amount to the vendor not offering ZDR): (a) the platform privacy policy opens by stating that it "does not directly collect or process" customer business data and processes only "on the mandate of the enterprise customer", and the entrusted role is contractually incompatible with "using content for its own purposes", but that is not a zero-retention commitment
points.text_zh: ③它出现在开发者文档 FAQ 而非法律文件，且隐私政策、用户协议、官网隐私政策三份法律文本中都没有对应表述。反向观察三点（不等于厂商不提供 ZDR）：(a) 平台隐私政策开篇自认「并不直接收集或处理」客户业务数据、仅「受企业客户委托」处理，受托角色在条款上与「把内容用于自身目的」相斥，但这不是零保留承诺

points.text: (b) throughput content is returned after content safety review by Alibaba Cloud and NetEase Yidun, and retention at that third-party leg is not disclosed

points.text: (c) the AgentWorks documentation states that the retention and deletion policies for Traces and logs must be "confirmed with the platform provider and the owner of the external system", i.e. the platform side does not disclose them.
