points.text: Object and context have to be written separately, because this provider has two sentences pointing in different directions about the same object. (1) Object = input/output content (API and the experience center): platform Privacy Policy §2.2, "for the input and output content of you and the customer you belong to, this platform applies full encryption and isolated storage; only when you or the customer you belong to requests that we carry out program debugging will we look up the corresponding log by request ID and apply to you and your customer for authorization to decrypt the throughput content" — that is, input and output content is stored, and the controls are encryption plus isolation plus an application requirement for decryption, not "not retained". Set against it is the developer FAQ (the aggregate page and the single page /support/faq/027-chat-history.html are word for word identical): "whether in the experience center or in the API service, we do not store the conversation history between users and large language models." The reconciling reading: the FAQ addresses only the product concept "conversation history" (multi-turn conversation history the user can retrieve), while Privacy Policy §2.2 addresses "input/output content" as an object of data processing
points.text_zh: 对象与语境必须分开写，因为本家同一对象有两句方向不同的话。①对象=输入/输出正文（API 与体验中心）：平台隐私政策 §2.2「对于您及您所属客户输入/输出内容，本平台已进行了全量加密并隔离存储，仅在您及您所属客户请求我们开展程序调试（debug）时，我们将根据相关请求ID查看对应日志并向您及您所属客户申请对吞吐内容进行授权解密」——即输入输出正文是被存储的，控制手段是加密 + 隔离 + 解密需申请，不是「不保留」。与之并列的是开发者 FAQ（聚合页与单页 /support/faq/027-chat-history.html 逐字相同）：「无论是体验中心还是 API 服务，我们均不会存储用户与大语言模型的会话历史记录。」两句的调和读法：FAQ 只针对「会话历史记录」这一产品概念（用户侧可检索的多轮对话历史），隐私政策 §2.2 针对「输入/输出内容」这一数据处理对象

points.text: But on their face the two sentences do pull against each other, and no sentence in the legal documents marks the boundary between them, so confidence is recorded as medium rather than high. (2) Object = personal information (account, real-name, refund, logs): §4.2.1, "we will retain your personal information only for the period necessary for the purpose of providing this platform and related services", listing three criteria (the time needed for the business purpose / a longer period the user consents to / legal and contractual requirements), with no day count
points.text_zh: 但两句字面上确实互相拉扯，而法律文件里没有任何一句说明二者的边界，故置信度记 medium 而非 high。②对象=个人信息（账号、实名、退费、日志）：§四.2.1「我们将仅在为提供本平台及相关服务之目的所必需的期间内保留您的个人信息」，并列出三条确定标准（业务目的所需时间/用户同意的更长期限/法律与合同要求），未给天数

points.text: §4.2.2: deleted or anonymized once the period expires (except where laws and regulations provide otherwise). Suspended-service users are an express exception: §1.1, "we will continue to keep the mobile number, account and password such suspended-service users submitted when creating the account, in order to provide them with account login, until the suspended-service user deregisters the account or our statutory storage period expires". (3) Object = access and operation logs: §1.3(3) discloses the network log fields as "customer APIKey, request time, request processing result (success/failure, whether finished)", with no period
points.text_zh: §四.2.2 超期删除或匿名化（法律法规另有规定除外）。停服用户是明确的例外：§1.1「该等停服用户创建账户时提交的手机号码、账号、密码，我们将会继续保存，以为其提供账号登录服务，直至停服用户注销其账号，或我们法定的存储时间届满」。③对象=访问/操作日志：§1.3(3) 披露网络日志字段为「客户APIKey、请求时间、请求处理结果（成功/失败、是否结束）」，无期限

points.text: User Service Agreement §1.3.5(2), in the context of implicit labelling of generated synthetic content, says "as the service provider we will retain the relevant log information in accordance with laws, administrative regulations and relevant national provisions" — a statutory floor, which cannot be read in reverse as "deleted when it expires"
points.text_zh: 《用户服务协议》§1.3.5(2) 在生成合成内容隐式标识语境下写「我们作为服务提供方将依照法律、行政法规和国家有关规定保存相关日志信息」——这是法定下限口径，不能反推「到期即删」

points.text: The feature documentation gives the only observable floor: the "query operation audit events" page states that event queries "only support operation records from 2024-10-31 onwards", i.e. operation audit events have been retained continuously since at least 2024-10-31 (about 23 months); note that this is a query-range limit, not a deletion commitment, and that the 30-day single-query window is a query limit, not a retention period. (4) Object = agent memory and Trace: the AgentWorks memory doc states that "retention period, automatic deduplication, recall threshold and end-user self-service deletion need to be managed through the organization's data processes or external systems", and the security doc states that "URL expiry only means the URL can no longer be used for access; it does not mean every copy has been deleted", adding "please confirm the retention and deletion policies for Traces, logs and other copies with the platform provider and the owner of the external system" — i.e. the platform discloses no period for these two objects. (5) Object = portrait material uploaded to Onetake: the "ONEtake Platform Important Notice" confirms it will be "collected, edited, previewed, stored and processed", with no period. (6) Object = data the customer uploads to the platform: User Agreement §2.4.2 only "purges" it on deregistration for violations
points.text_zh: 功能文档给了唯一可观测的下限：「查询操作审计事件」页面写明事件查询「仅支持 2024-10-31 至今的操作记录」，即操作审计事件至少自 2024-10-31 起持续留存（约 23 个月），注意那是查询范围限制，不是删除承诺，且 30 天的单次查询窗口是查询限制不是保留期。④对象=智能体记忆与 Trace：AgentWorks 记忆文档写明「保留期限、自动去重、召回阈值和最终用户自助删除需要通过组织的数据流程或外部系统管理」，安全文档写明「URL 过期只表示不能再通过该 URL 访问，不代表所有副本已经删除」，并「请向平台提供方和外部系统负责人确认 Trace、日志及其他副本的保留和删除策略」——即平台不披露这两个对象的期限。⑤对象=Onetake 上传的人像素材：《ONEtake 平台重要提示》确认会被「收集、编辑、预览、存储并处理」，无期限。⑥对象=客户主动上传到平台的数据：用户协议 §2.4.2 只在违规注销时「清空」

points.text: §3.5 places security and backup responsibility wholly on the customer. (7) A general exception to deletion: §7.1, "because you use this platform's services on an enterprise's mandate or as an employee of an enterprise customer, business data in the corresponding account, such as business operations and service usage records, cannot be deleted or anonymized except on the instruction or request of your enterprise" — the end user cannot delete business data themselves. (8) Third-party leg: throughput content is reviewed by Alibaba Cloud and NetEase Yidun (§2.2 and §5.1.5 state that NetEase Yidun receives "the user's request content" and "the service's response content"), and this provider does not constrain their retention. Period type: all of the "needed for the purpose / statutory floor" kind, with no cap and no typical range
points.text_zh: §3.5 把安全与备份责任整体压给客户。⑦删除的普遍例外：§七.1「因您是受企业委托/作为企业客户员工使用本平台服务，除受您所在企业指示或要求，对应账号中与业务开展、服务使用记录等业务数据无法进行删除或匿名化处理」——最终用户本人无法删除业务数据。⑧第三方环节：吞吐内容经阿里云与网易易盾审核（§2.2、§5.1.5 列明网易易盾共享「用户的请求内容」与「服务的响应内容」），其保留期本家未约束。期限类型：全部为「目的所需/法定下限」型，无任何上限或典型区间

points.text: This provider discloses no request-level deletion period.
points.text_zh: 本家未披露任何请求级删除期限。

points.text: (9) Service termination: platform Privacy Policy §7.5 — "如我们停止运营，我们将停止收集您的个人信息，并将停止运营的通知以公告等商业上可行的形式通知您，并对我们所持有的您的个人信息进行删除或匿名化处理。" Object = the personal information we hold; context = the platform stops operating. It is a deletion / anonymisation commitment, not a period for input/output content.
points.text_zh: ⑨服务终止：平台隐私政策 §七.5「如我们停止运营，我们将停止收集您的个人信息，并将停止运营的通知以公告等商业上可行的形式通知您，并对我们所持有的您的个人信息进行删除或匿名化处理。」对象=我们持有的个人信息，语境=平台停止运营。这是一条删除/匿名化承诺，不是输入输出正文的期限。
points.quote: 如我们停止运营，我们将停止收集您的个人信息，并将停止运营的通知以公告等商业上可行的形式通知您，并对我们所持有的您的个人信息进行删除或匿名化处理。

points.text: (10) Exception context — violation handling: User Service Agreement §1.3.4 — "我们作为平台运营方/技术提供方有权依法依约采取警示、限制功能、暂停或终止向您提供服务等处置措施，保存有关记录，并向有关主管部门报告。" No period is given. §1.3.6(3)③ repeats the same undertaking in synonymous wording ("将依法依约"), and §7.1 adds the same "保存有关记录" for investigations. This is wider than, and sits alongside, the §1.3.5(2) statutory log floor, so this tier must not be read as having only that one implicit-labelling retention clause.
points.text_zh: ⑩例外语境——违规处置：用户服务协议 §1.3.4「我们作为平台运营方/技术提供方有权依法依约采取警示、限制功能、暂停或终止向您提供服务等处置措施，保存有关记录，并向有关主管部门报告。」未定期限。§1.3.6(3)③ 是同义句（「将依法依约」），§7.1 另就调查写明同样的「保存有关记录」。它比 §1.3.5(2) 的法定日志下限更宽，与之并列，故不能把本档读成只有隐式标识那一处法定留存。
points.quote: 我们作为平台运营方/技术提供方有权依法依约采取警示、限制功能、暂停或终止向您提供服务等处置措施，保存有关记录，并向有关主管部门报告

points.text: (11) Account-level deregistration trigger: User Service Agreement §2.4.3 — "如您连续12个月未通过您的账号登录本平台，且您的账号下不存在任何可用服务，我们有权自主决定注销您的账号。" This is an inactivity trigger at account level; §2.4.1(3) says only that "该账号记录、功能等将无法恢复或提供", i.e. it promises no deletion of data, so this is not a content retention period and does not narrow the periods above.
points.text_zh: ⑪账号层面的注销触发条件：用户服务协议 §2.4.3「如您连续12个月未通过您的账号登录本平台，且您的账号下不存在任何可用服务，我们有权自主决定注销您的账号。」这是账号层面的不活跃注销触发；§2.4.1(3) 只说「该账号记录、功能等将无法恢复或提供」，未承诺删除数据，故不是内容保留期限，也不缩短上面各条的期限。
points.quote: 如您连续12个月未通过您的账号登录本平台，且您的账号下不存在任何可用服务，我们有权自主决定注销您的账号

processing_region.quote: 除非另有约定或法律另有规定，我们在中华人民共和国境内收集和产生的个人信息将储存在中华人民共和国境内

points.text: Conclusion: stored within China (CN). Platform Privacy Policy §4.1, "unless otherwise agreed or otherwise provided by law, personal information we collect and generate within the territory of the People's Republic of China will be stored within the territory of the People's Republic of China. For personal information collected and generated outside the territory of the People's Republic of China, we will store it in accordance with laws, regulations, international rules or international practice recognized as effective by the People's Republic of China" — note the second half: personal information collected or generated abroad is stored under internationally recognized rules, which leaves an unclear opening
points.text_zh: 结论：境内（CN）存储。平台隐私政策 §四.1「除非另有约定或法律另有规定，我们在中华人民共和国境内收集和产生的个人信息将储存在中华人民共和国境内。对在中华人民共和国境外收集和产生的个人信息，我们将按照中华人民共和国认可效力的法律、法规、国际规则或国际惯例予以存储」——注意后半句：境外收集/产生的个人信息按中国认可的国际规则存储，等于留了一个不明确的出口

points.text: The first half also carries the exception "unless otherwise agreed or otherwise provided by law". The website tier says the same and more strongly: website enquiry-form Privacy Policy §7.1, "in accordance with laws and regulations, we will store the personal information collected about you only within the territory of the People's Republic of China" (the English version has the same sentence: will be stored within the territory of the People’s Republic of China), and the privacy policy summary matches. So the Chinese and English sites, and the platform and website tiers alike, are consistent on storage location: within China. Inconsistent or uncovered points, recorded faithfully alongside: (a) User Agreement §3.6 permits "arranging for Infini-AI affiliates or other third parties to provide all or part of the services to you, and where necessary granting them the access to service information they require" — without limiting where those affiliates or third parties are located
points.text_zh: 前半句也带「除非另有约定或法律另有规定」的例外。官网档同向且更强：官网问卷隐私政策 §七.1「我们依照法律法规的规定，仅会将收集到的有关您的个人信息存储于中华人民共和国境内」（英文版同句：will be stored within the territory of the People’s Republic of China），隐私政策摘要亦同。因此中英文两站、平台与官网两档在存储地点上口径一致，均为境内。不一致/未覆盖的点如实并列：(a) 用户协议 §3.6 允许「安排无问芯穹关联公司、其他第三方为您提供全部或部分服务，必要时为其开通必需的服务信息访问权限」——未限定这些关联公司/第三方的所在地

points.text: (b) platform Privacy Policy §2.2 and §5.1.5 show that throughput content is sent to Alibaba Cloud and NetEase Yidun for content safety review; both are domestic entities (Alibaba Cloud Computing Co., Ltd. and Hangzhou NetEase Zhiqi Technology Co., Ltd.), which is compatible with the in-China storage commitment, but whether they in turn sub-entrust is not disclosed
points.text_zh: (b) 平台隐私政策 §2.2 与 §5.1.5 显示吞吐内容会送阿里云与网易易盾做内容安全审核，两家均为境内主体（阿里云计算有限公司、杭州网易智企科技有限公司），与境内存储承诺相容，但其自身是否再转委托未披露

points.text: (c) the AgentWorks documentation notes that private deployment is a separate delivery scope, in which case the processing location is determined by the delivery environment and the public documentation does not cover it. No "data export" commitment and no statement of a completed cross-border transfer assessment was found, nor any overseas compute or overseas inference node.
points.text_zh: (c) AgentWorks 文档提到私有部署属单独交付范围，私有部署时的处理地由交付环境决定，公开文档未覆盖。未发现任何「数据出境」承诺或已通过出境评估的表述，也未发现境外算力/境外推理节点。

role.quote: 我们并不直接收集或处理您或您代表的企业客户在使用过程中所提供或产生的任何业务数据或人员数据

points.text: Conclusion: for customer business data (including API request and response content) the provider identifies itself as an entrusted processor
points.text_zh: 结论：对客户业务数据（含 API 请求与响应内容）自认为受托处理方（processor）

points.text: For personal information it collects itself, such as account and real-name information, it is the handler
points.text_zh: 对账号/实名等自身收集的个人信息是处理者

points.text: On the website tier it identifies itself as a joint handler. The three tiers differ and are recorded one by one. (1) Platform tier (model services / platform services): the "special note" opening the privacy policy — "the infini-ai platform is a platform through which we provide services to enterprise users; we do not directly collect or process any business data or personnel data that you or the enterprise customer you represent provides or generates in the course of use. We only: on the mandate of the enterprise customer you belong to or represent, process and store the business data that you or that enterprise customer actively provides or that the operation of the service generates (including but not limited to the account management information you fill in and service log data)"
points.text_zh: 官网档则自认为共同处理者。三档不同，逐档记录。①平台档（模型服务/平台服务）：隐私政策开篇「特别说明」——「infini-ai平台是由我们向企业用户提供服务的平台，我们并不直接收集或处理您或您代表的企业客户在使用过程中所提供或产生的任何业务数据或人员数据。我们仅：受您所属/所代表的企业客户委托，对您或您所属/代表的企业客户在使用过程中所主动提供或服务运营产生的业务数据（包括但不限于您主动填写的账号管理信息、服务日志数据）进行处理及存储」

points.text: §2 characterizes it again: "this part describes only the technical support services we provide to you on the mandate of your enterprise and the entrusted processing of the relevant data in that course." This is an express admission of entrusted processing. §5.1.2 also states that "for scenarios where the processing of personal information is entrusted out, we will sign the relevant processing agreements with the entrusted partner as required by law and supervise its use of personal information" — showing that the provider itself also contracts downstream as an entrusting party. (2) The counterweight on the platform tier: User Agreement §1.3.2/§1.3.3 repeatedly calls itself "platform operator / technology provider", §3.5 places the security, backup and lawfulness of user data wholly on the enterprise customer, and the §8 disclaimers assign availability risk to force majeure and third parties
points.text_zh: §二 再次定性「本部分仅介绍，我们受您所属企业委托为您提供的技术支持服务情况及该等过程中受托处理相关数据的情况」。这是明确的受托处理自认。§5.1.2 还写明「对于委托处理个人信息的场景，我们会与受托合作方根据法律规定签署相关处理协议，并对其个人信息使用活动进行监督」——说明本家自己也作为委托方向下游受托方签约。②平台档的对照面：用户协议 §1.3.2/§1.3.3 反复自称「平台运营方/技术提供方」，§3.5 把用户数据的安全、备份、合法性责任整体压给企业客户，§8 免责条款把可用性风险归给不可抗力与第三方

points.text: Privacy Policy §7.1 states that an end user "cannot delete or anonymize" the business data under their account, and §7.2 states that "except on the instruction or request of your enterprise, we cannot provide you personally with account deregistration" — both typical behaviours of an entrusted party (answerable only to the mandating party), consistent with the processor characterization. (3) Website tier: the introduction to the website enquiry-form privacy policy says "Shanghai Infinigence Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. and Beijing Infinigence Technology Co., Ltd. ... jointly operate the website as joint handlers of the data (links: infinigence-ai.com, infini-ai.com)" — joint handlers (joint controllers); and the website tier expressly states "at present, this platform does not share your (or your organization's) information with any third party, nor does it integrate software development kits (SDKs) provided by third parties ...", in contrast with the platform tier, which lists four third-party SDKs. (4) Contracting entities: both the user agreement and the platform privacy policy name "Shanghai Infinigence Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. and Beijing Infinigence Technology Co., Ltd." as joint operators / joint handlers, and no public document explains how responsibility is divided between them. Uncertainties: (1) there is a naming conflict within the docs site — the "Third-Party Information Sharing List and Third-Party SDK Catalogue" links "Shanghai Infinigence Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. Website Privacy Policy" to the platform-tier privacy.html, while the "Privacy Policy Summary" uses the same name for the website-tier document
points.text_zh: 隐私政策 §七.1 明确最终用户对其账号下业务数据「无法进行删除或匿名化处理」、§七.2 明确「除受您所在企业指示或要求，我们无法为您个人提供账号注销的服务」——这些都是受托方行为的典型特征（只对委托方负责），与 processor 定性一致。③官网档：官网问卷隐私政策引言写「上海无问芯穹智能科技股份有限公司、北京无问芯穹科技有限公司……作为数据的共同处理者共同运营的官网（链接：infinigence-ai.com、infini-ai.com）」——共同处理者（joint controller），且官网档明确「目前，本平台并不存在与第三方共享您（或您的组织）信息的情况，亦不存在会接入由第三方提供的软件开发包(SDK)……的情况」，与平台档列出四个第三方 SDK 形成对比。④签约主体：用户协议与平台隐私政策均写「上海无问芯穹智能科技股份有限公司、北京无问芯穹科技有限公司」两家共同运营/共同处理，公开文件中未见两家之间责任划分的说明。不确定性：①文档站内存在名称冲突——《第三方共享信息清单和第三方 SDK 目录》把「《上海无问芯穹智能科技股份有限公司官网隐私政策》」链到平台档 privacy.html，而《隐私政策摘要》用同一名称指官网档文档

points.text: User Agreement §1.2 cites the "Infini-AI Website Privacy Policy" for collecting sales contact information (pointing to the website tier). The naming conflict itself does not affect the processor determination (which rests on the platform-tier text), but it shows that this provider's cross-references are not rigorous. (2) The AgentWorks documentation uses wording such as "platform provider" and "target deployment" and notes that private deployment is a separate delivery scope; if the actual delivery form is a private deployment, the role determination must follow the delivery contract, which the public documentation cannot cover. (3) This provider publishes no DPA or data processing addendum (there is none among the 9 documents in the legal directory) and no subprocessor list in text (the third-party sharing list page is dynamically rendered and its body is empty).
points.text_zh: 用户协议 §1.2 引用《无问芯穹官网隐私政策》收销售联系信息（指向官网档）。名称冲突本身不影响 processor 的认定（认定依据是平台档正文），但说明本家文档的引用关系不严谨。②AgentWorks 文档中出现「平台提供方」「目标部署」等措辞，且提到私有部署属单独交付范围，若实际交付形态是私有化部署，角色认定需以交付合同为准，公开文档不能覆盖。③本家没有任何公开 DPA/数据处理附录（legal 目录 9 篇中无 DPA），也没有子处理者清单的正文（第三方共享清单页面动态渲染，正文为空）。

infini-ai/compute.entity: 上海无问芯穹智能科技股份有限公司 / 北京无问芯穹科技有限公司

points.text: The compute tier has no separately named terms document. User Agreement §1.3 confines "this platform" to two modules, Agentic MaaS (GenStudio/AgentWorks/ComfyStack) and Onetake, while compute instances and per-GPU-hour billing appear only in the FAQ and the billing documentation
points.text_zh: 算力档没有单独命名的条款文件。用户协议 §1.3 把「本平台」限定为 Agentic MaaS（GenStudio/AgentWorks/ComfyStack）+ Onetake 两个模块，算力实例/按卡时计费只在 FAQ 与计费文档里出现

points.text: The console login page states that the user agrees to the "Infini-AI Terms of Service, Privacy Policy and Product Service Agreement", but this round found no public text of the "Product Service Agreement" on the website, on the docs site, in the legal directory or among the 276 pages listed in llms.txt. The training position for the compute tier is therefore recorded as undisclosed, and the not_disclosed conclusion of the model service tier is not borrowed to cover it (the evidence differs).
points.text_zh: 控制台登录页声明用户同意「Infini-AI 服务条款、隐私政策 和 产品服务协议」，但本轮在官网、文档站、legal 目录与 llms.txt 的 276 页清单中都没有找到公开的《产品服务协议》正文。因此算力档的训练口径按「未披露」记，不借用模型服务档的 not_disclosed 结论去覆盖它（两者证据不同）。

points.text: Same as top-level zdr: there is no zero-retention commitment or application path anywhere on the site
points.text_zh: 同顶层 zdr：全站无零保留承诺或申请方式

points.text: The compute tier does not even have a published service agreement text of its own.
points.text_zh: 算力档连独立的服务协议正文都未公开。

retention.summary: 按对象分列未公布期限

points.text: No public document contains any retention clause for compute instances (containers, images, mounted volumes, job logs). The only usable adjacent evidence is that operation audit events "only support operation records from 2024-10-31 onwards" (which applies equally to operation events such as creating, starting and stopping compute instances), and User Agreement §2.4.2, which on deregistration for violations "purges the data you have uploaded to and stored in this platform and the services" — neither is a retention commitment for compute instance data. Recorded as not_found; §4.2 of the model service tier is not used as a substitute. User Agreement §1.3 is why the platform-tier retention clauses cannot simply be carried over: it defines "本平台" as the Agentic MaaS modules (GenStudio / AgentWorks / ComfyStack) plus the Onetake module, so those clauses do not reach compute instances.
points.text_zh: 公开文件中没有任何针对算力实例（容器、镜像、挂载卷、任务日志）的保留期限条款。唯一可用的相邻证据是操作审计事件「仅支持 2024-10-31 至今的操作记录」（对算力实例的创建/启停等操作事件同样适用），以及用户协议 §2.4.2 违规注销时「清空您所上传和存储在本平台及服务中的数据」——都不是算力实例数据的保留承诺。按 not_found 记，不拿模型服务档的 §四.2 去顶替。平台档的保留条款之所以不能直接搬过来，依据是用户协议 §1.3：它把「本平台」界定为 Agentic MaaS 服务模块（GenStudio / AgentWorks / ComfyStack）加 Onetake 功能模块，这些条款够不到算力实例。
points.quote: 本平台业务包含以下部分：（1）Agentic MaaS服务模块，具体含有大模型服务平台、智能体服务平台及ComfyUI工作流平台

points.text: Recorded as undisclosed for this tier — the region code is unknown, not CN. The in-China storage commitment in platform Privacy Policy §4.1 ("除非另有约定或法律另有规定，我们在中华人民共和国境内收集和产生的个人信息将储存在中华人民共和国境内") has "本平台" as its scope, and §1.3/§2 define this platform as Agentic MaaS plus Onetake, without naming compute instances. The FAQ separately carries Q&As such as "the compute cloud platform uses a strict multi-tenant architecture that ensures data isolation between tenants" and "where are the compute resources", but neither is a storage-location commitment. The compute tier is very likely processed within China as the platform tier is (the same tenancy system, the same privacy policy framework), but the public terms do not name compute instances, so the earlier CN code is withdrawn and the §4.1 sentence is kept here as adjacent evidence only, not as this tier's region. If the enterprise customer signs a separate compute service contract (the "Product Service Agreement" mentioned on the console login page), the region follows that contract; its text is not published and has no snapshot.
points.text_zh: 本档按未披露记，不再断言任何地域码。平台隐私政策 §四.1 的境内存储承诺（「除非另有约定或法律另有规定，我们在中华人民共和国境内收集和产生的个人信息将储存在中华人民共和国境内」）范围是「本平台」，而 §1.3/§二 把本平台界定为 Agentic MaaS + Onetake，算力实例未被点名。FAQ 另有「智算云平台采用严格的多租户架构，确保租户间的数据隔离」与「算力资源在哪里」类问答，但都不构成存储地域承诺。算力档很可能与平台档同为境内处理（同一套租户体系、同一份隐私政策框架），但公开条款没有点名算力实例，故撤掉原先的 CN 码，§四.1 那句只作为相邻证据保留，不作为本档的处理地结论。若企业客户另签算力服务合同（控制台登录页提及的《产品服务协议》），处理地以该合同为准；其正文未公开、无快照。
points.quote: 除非另有约定或法律另有规定，我们在中华人民共和国境内收集和产生的个人信息将储存在中华人民共和国境内

points.text: Recorded as undisclosed / governed by the delivery contract: the compute tier has no role clause of its own. The platform privacy policy's admission of entrusted processing ("我们并不直接收集或处理您或您代表的企业客户在使用过程中所提供或产生的任何业务数据或人员数据。我们仅：受您所属/所代表的企业客户委托，对您或您所属/代表的企业客户在使用过程中所主动提供或服务运营产生的业务数据……进行处理及存储") is textually scoped to "本平台", which User Agreement §1.3 defines as Agentic MaaS plus Onetake; compute instances are not named. Customer data inside a compute instance is a kind of "business data", but without a clause naming this tier the platform-tier processor determination is not carried over as this tier's kind. If the enterprise customer signs a separate compute service contract (the "Product Service Agreement" mentioned on the console login page), the role follows that contract; its text is not published and has no snapshot.
points.text_zh: 本档按未披露记／以交付合同为准：算力档没有独立的角色条款。平台隐私政策的受托处理自认（「我们并不直接收集或处理您或您代表的企业客户在使用过程中所提供或产生的任何业务数据或人员数据。我们仅：受您所属/所代表的企业客户委托，对您或您所属/代表的企业客户在使用过程中所主动提供或服务运营产生的业务数据……进行处理及存储」）在文本上的范围是「本平台」，而用户协议 §1.3 把本平台界定为 Agentic MaaS + Onetake，算力实例未被点名。算力实例中的客户数据虽属「业务数据」的一种，但在没有点名本档的条款时，不把平台档的 processor 认定搬来当本档的 kind。若企业客户另签算力服务合同（控制台登录页提及的《产品服务协议》），角色以该合同为准；其正文未公开、无快照。
points.quote: 我们并不直接收集或处理您或您代表的企业客户在使用过程中所提供或产生的任何业务数据或人员数据

infini-ai/website.entity: 上海无问芯穹智能科技股份有限公司 / 北京无问芯穹科技有限公司

points.text: None of the three website-tier documents (the Chinese and English enquiry-form privacy policies, the privacy policy summary and the personal information collection list) contains any wording about training. The website collects only enquiry-form information, used solely to "contact you, address your question in a targeted way and reach further cooperation".
points.text_zh: 官网档三份文档（问卷隐私政策中文/英文、隐私政策摘要、个人信息收集清单）全文均无「训练」或 training 相关表述。官网收集的只有咨询表单信息，用途限于「与您取得联系并针对性解决您的问题、达成进一步合作」。

points.text: One wording in this tier's own document puts Cookie data to "improving service quality" use and has to be processed explicitly under docs/judgment.md ("used to improve the service / raise quality" counts as training): website enquiry-form Privacy Policy §2.1 — "我们使用该信息判断注册用户是否已经登录，提升服务质量及优化用户体验。我们不会将 Cookie 用于前述目的之外的任何用途。" The same sentence stands in both the current website version (infinigence-ai.com/privacy-policy.html §二.1, 2026-08-04) and the earlier docs-site copy (2026-07-21 §二.1). Object = Cookie / similar-technology data, neither the enquiry-form information this tier collects nor API input/output content, so it does not move the undisclosed verdict for this tier; it is recorded so that the tier is not read as if no improvement wording exists in it at all. It is quoted in this point rather than bound as an anchor, because a bound quote on a mark=unknown dimension would assert a conclusion this tier does not carry (docs/judgment.md). The platform-tier documents carry their own two improvement wordings (platform Privacy Policy §2.5 troubleshooting records and §3 Cookies), recorded under the api tier; this tier's own document has no troubleshooting-service clause, and the Cookie sentence above is the only improvement wording in it.
points.text_zh: 本档自己的文档里有一处把 Cookie 数据用于「提升服务质量」的表述，按 docs/judgment.md（「用来改进服务/提高质量」算训练）必须显式处理：官网问卷隐私政策 §二.1「我们使用该信息判断注册用户是否已经登录，提升服务质量及优化用户体验。我们不会将 Cookie 用于前述目的之外的任何用途。」该句在官网现行版（infinigence-ai.com/privacy-policy.html §二.1，2026-08-04）与文档站更早的副本（2026-07-21 §二.1）里都在。对象=Cookie 与同类技术数据，既不是本档收集的咨询表单信息，也不是 API 输入/输出正文，故不改变本档的未披露结论；写在这里是为了不把本档读成不存在任何「改进」类表述。它只在本条 point 正文里引述、不设锚点——在 mark=unknown 的维度上绑引文等于断言本档并不承载的结论（docs/judgment.md）。平台档另有两处「改进」表述（平台隐私政策 §2.5 故障记录与 §三 Cookie），记在 api 档下；官网档自己的文档里没有故障排查服务一节，全文「改进/提升」类表述只有上面这句 Cookie 条款。

points.text: The website tier has no ZDR-related wording
points.text_zh: 官网档无 ZDR 相关表述

points.text: The website itself carries no inference requests, so the ZDR concept does not apply to the website tier.
points.text_zh: 官网本身也不承载推理请求，ZDR 概念在官网档不适用。

retention.quote: 我们在为您提供满足产品/服务目的所必需且最短的期间内保留您的个人信息

points.text: Website tier conclusion: the shortest necessary period, not quantified, with enquiry-form information given as an example, kept "for a certain period during business exchange and cooperation"
points.text_zh: 官网档结论：最短必需期限，未量化，举例说明咨询表单信息「在业务交流合作的一定时间段内」持续保存

points.text: Deleted or anonymized once that period is exceeded. The English version has the same sentence (shortest period necessary to fulfill the stated service purposes). There is also one limit on deletion: a deletion request excludes "data that laws and regulations require to be retained", and after deletion the data may not be purged from backups immediately, being stored in isolation until the backup can be purged or anonymized. Note that these periods hold only for website form information and cannot be extrapolated to API request content.
points.text_zh: 超期删除或匿名化。英文版同句（shortest period necessary to fulfill the stated service purposes）。另有一条删除限制：删除请求「法律法规要求必须保留的数据除外」，且删除后可能无法立即从备份中清除，会隔离存储至备份可清除或匿名化。注意这些期限只对官网表单信息成立，不能外推到 API 请求内容。

points.text: Period type — the other half of §7.3 is a statutory floor: "此外，我们会对您的相关信息保存至相关法律所规定的必要期限。" It is a lower bound set by law, not a cap, so it cannot be read as "deleted once the period expires" or as an upper bound; it stands alongside the shortest-necessary period and the deletion / anonymisation after that period. It is quoted from the current website version of the document (infinigence-ai.com/privacy-policy.html, published/effective/last updated 2026-08-04, §七.3), the version this tier's anchors are bound to; the earlier docs-site copy of the same policy (2026-07-21, §七.3) carries the same sentence and can be cross-checked.
points.text_zh: 期限类型——§七.3 还有另外一半，是法定下限：「此外，我们会对您的相关信息保存至相关法律所规定的必要期限。」这是法律规定的下限而非上限，不能反推为「到期即删」，也不能当作上限；它与「最短必需期间」及超期删除/匿名化并列。该句引自官网档现行发布版（infinigence-ai.com/privacy-policy.html，发布/生效/最近更新日期均为 2026-08-04，§七.3），也就是本档各维度锚点所绑定的那一版；同一政策更早的文档站副本（2026-07-21，§七.3）同句，可互校。
points.quote: 此外，我们会对您的相关信息保存至相关法律所规定的必要期限。

processing_region.quote: 我们依照法律法规的规定，仅会将收集到的有关您的个人信息存储于中华人民共和国境内。

points.text: Website tier conclusion: stored within China only. In Chinese, "in accordance with laws and regulations, we will store the personal information collected about you only within the territory of the People's Republic of China"; the English international site has the same sentence, as does the privacy policy summary. Cross-border transfer requires separate notice and consent. Note that the international site (infinigence-ai.com) and its English version carry the same commitment, showing that the international site does not place data outside China.
points.text_zh: 官网档结论：仅境内存储。中文「我们依照法律法规的规定，仅会将收集到的有关您的个人信息存储于中华人民共和国境内」，英文国际站同句，隐私政策摘要同。跨境需单独告知并取得授权同意。注意国际站（infinigence-ai.com）与其英文版也是同一承诺，说明国际站没有把数据放到境外。

role.quote: 作为数据的共同处理者共同运营的官网

points.text: Website tier conclusion: joint handlers (joint controllers) — the introduction, "Shanghai Infinigence Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. and Beijing Infinigence Technology Co., Ltd. ... jointly operate the website as joint handlers of the data"; the same sentence stands in both the current website version (2026-08-04) and the earlier docs-site copy (2026-07-21), so it can be re-checked stably.
points.text_zh: 官网档结论：共同处理者（joint controller）——引言「上海无问芯穹智能科技股份有限公司、北京无问芯穹科技有限公司……作为数据的共同处理者共同运营的官网」；该句在官网现行版（2026-08-04）与文档站更早的副本（2026-07-21）里都在，可稳定复核。

points.text: And "at present, this platform does not share your (or your organization's) information with any third party, nor does it integrate software development kits (SDKs) provided by third parties ...". Against the platform tier (an entrusted processor for customer business data, integrating SDKs such as Alibaba Cloud and NetEase Yidun), these are two roles and two sets of facts. This sentence is kept as parallel evidence for the website-vs-platform contrast; it answers the third-party sharing and SDK question, not the controller / processor question, so the role verdict above is anchored to the joint-handler sentence instead.
points.text_zh: 且「目前，本平台并不存在与第三方共享您（或您的组织）信息的情况，亦不存在会接入由第三方提供的软件开发包(SDK)……的情况」。与平台档（对客户业务数据为受托处理方、并接入阿里云与网易易盾等 SDK）是两种角色、两套事实。本句作为「官网档 vs 平台档」对比的并列证据保留：它回答的是第三方共享与 SDK 接入，不是受托/控制方的问题，故上面的 role 结论锚定在共同处理者那句上。
points.quote: 目前，本平台并不存在与第三方共享您（或您的组织）信息的情况，亦不存在会接入由第三方提供的软件开发包(SDK)以实现相关功能的情况。

training.quote: We undertake that We will not use Your Inputs, Data, Outputs, and Suggestions to train any language models that generate code, text, or another type of data from which Your Inputs, Data, Outputs, or Suggestions could be extracted, unless You expressly agree to it.

points.text: Detailed-data collection (the full communication between you and the LLM, both text and code fragments) is opt-in and off by default. That clause governs collection, not the training restriction — the no-training commitment itself comes from Terms of Service §5(c).
points.text_zh: AI Assistant 那份「把你和模型的完整对话（含代码片段）交上去」的详细数据采集是 opt-in，默认不开；但它管的是采集，不是训练口径——不训练这条来自服务条款 §5(c) 的承诺本身。
points.quote: In addition, JetBrains IDE builds with the AI Assistant plugin perform an opt-in collection of detailed data about AI feature usage, including the full communication between you and the LLM (both text and code fragments).

points.text: Exception carved out in the Product Data Collection and Usage Notice §1(f): detailed code-related data — "the full text of inputs sent by the IDE to the large language model and its responses, including source code snippets" — "can be used for product improvement and training AI models". It is not collected from commercial users unless explicit, informed consent was obtained in advance, and organizations need an explicit company-level permission.
points.text_zh: 《产品数据采集与使用通知》§1(f) 是训练口径的例外：详细代码数据（对象是发给大模型的输入全文与回复，含源码片段）可用于产品改进与训练 AI 模型；商用用户除非事先取得明确知情同意否则不采集，组织还需公司级明确许可。
points.quote: Detailed code-related data can be used for product improvement and training AI models. We do not collect Detailed code-related data from our commercial users unless explicit, informed consent has been obtained in advance. We have a safeguard in place that disallows data sharing for organizations unless there's an explicit permission on a company level. We apply a 1-year data retention period for this data.

points.text: Multi-hop: ToS §5(e) lets JetBrains share inputs and data with third-party language model service providers ("AI Subcontractors"), and the training restriction is passed downstream only as a commitment that they "not use Your Inputs, Data, Outputs, and Suggestions for the training of their AI models at least to the same extent" as JetBrains commits. The list of AI Subcontractors sits on a separate service-providers page that is not yet a registered source. A new AI Subcontractor is published at least 30 days in advance, and the customer may object or terminate.
points.text_zh: 多跳：服务条款 §5(e) 允许 JetBrains 把输入与数据交给第三方大模型服务商（AI Subcontractors），不训练约束只以「at least to the same extent」（至少与 JetBrains 同等程度）传导给上游；上游名单在另一份 service-providers 页，尚未纳入来源。新增 AI Subcontractor 提前至少 30 天公告，客户可提出异议或终止。
points.quote: You give Us permission to process Your Inputs and Data that We select and to share them with these AI Subcontractors for the purpose of providing JetBrains AI. We will ensure that all AI Subcontractors commit not to use Your Inputs, Data, Outputs, and Suggestions for the training of their AI models at least to the same extent as We commit not to do so under these Terms.

points.text: Boundary of the §5(c) commitment: ToS §4(d) gives JetBrains an irrevocable, perpetual, royalty-free and sublicensable licence over feedback, and feedback is not among the Inputs/Data/Outputs/Suggestions that §5(c) protects. Content sent to JetBrains AI as an Input still falls inside the commitment (§2 definition of "Input").
points.text_zh: §5(c) 承诺的边界：服务条款 §4(d) 的 Feedback 授权不可撤销、永久、免版税且可再许可，Feedback 不在 §5(c) 覆盖的 Inputs/Data/Outputs/Suggestions 之列；但通过 AI Assistant 提交的内容按 §2「Input」定义仍落在承诺范围内。
points.quote: You give Us the right to use, change (‘modify’), commercialize, and incorporate into JetBrains AI any of Your ideas, suggestions, recommendations, proposals, or other feedback relating to JetBrains AI. You cannot withdraw this permission after it is given (it is ‘irrevocable’) and it is perpetual.

points.text: Scope limit: "these data sharing preferences, once configured, apply to all installed JetBrains products".
points.text_zh: 适用范围限定：数据共享偏好 once configured, apply to all installed JetBrains products（一次配置即作用于所有已安装的 JetBrains 产品）。
points.quote: Note that these data sharing preferences, once configured, apply to all installed JetBrains products.

points.text: Default-state wording on the help page: the IDE setting that controls detailed data collection (Settings | Appearance & Behavior | System Settings | Data Sharing | Send detailed code-related data) "is disabled by default".

points.quote: At times, JetBrains may process or transfer some of your Personal Data (such as your name and email address) to our affiliate companies or subprocessors outside the EU.

points.quote: Detailed data is not currently collected in China.

points.quote: We may also process some of Your Personal Data in connection with these Terms in our capacity as a data controller in accordance with our Privacy Policy

points.text: Detailed-data collection (the full communication between you and the LLM, both text and code fragments) is opt-in and off by default. That clause governs collection, not the training restriction — the no-training commitment itself comes from Terms of Service §5(c).

points.quote: In addition, JetBrains IDE builds with the AI Assistant plugin perform an opt-in collection of detailed data about AI feature usage, including the full communication between you and the LLM (both text and code fragments).

points.text: Exception carved out in the Product Data Collection and Usage Notice §1(f): detailed code-related data — "the full text of inputs sent by the IDE to the large language model and its responses, including source code snippets" — "can be used for product improvement and training AI models". It is not collected from commercial users unless explicit, informed consent was obtained in advance, and organizations need an explicit company-level permission.

points.text: Shape of the enterprise opt-in (§3 table, Company / Organizational license): the company opts in "by signing a contract with JetBrains", and "when enabled at the company level, this setting applies to all end users and cannot be adjusted individually". Joining requires the waitlist.

points.text: Multi-hop: ToS §5(e) lets JetBrains share inputs and data with third-party language model service providers ("AI Subcontractors"), and the training restriction is passed downstream only as a commitment that they "not use Your Inputs, Data, Outputs, and Suggestions for the training of their AI models at least to the same extent" as JetBrains commits. The list of AI Subcontractors sits on a separate service-providers page that is not yet a registered source. A new AI Subcontractor is published at least 30 days in advance, and the customer may object or terminate.

points.text: Boundary of the §5(c) commitment: ToS §4(d) gives JetBrains an irrevocable, perpetual, royalty-free and sublicensable licence over feedback, and feedback is not among the Inputs/Data/Outputs/Suggestions that §5(c) protects. points.text: Boundary of the §5(c) commitment: ToS §4(d) gives JetBrains an irrevocable, perpetual, royalty-free and sublicensable licence over feedback, and feedback is not among the Inputs/Data/Outputs/Suggestions that §5(c) protects. Content sent to JetBrains AI as an Input still falls inside the commitment (§2 definition of "Input").
points.text_zh: §5(c) 承诺的边界：服务条款 §4(d) 的 Feedback 授权不可撤销、永久、免版税且可再许可，Feedback 不在 §5(c) 覆盖的 Inputs/Data/Outputs/Suggestions 之列；但通过 AI Assistant 提交的内容按 §2「Input」定义仍落在承诺范围内。
points.quote: You give Us the right to use, change (‘modify’), commercialize, and incorporate into JetBrains AI any of Your ideas, suggestions, recommendations, proposals, or other feedback relating to JetBrains AI. You cannot withdraw this permission after it is given (it is ‘irrevocable’) and it is perpetual.

points.text: Scope limit: "these data sharing preferences, once configured, apply to all installed JetBrains products".
points.text_zh: 适用范围限定：数据共享偏好 once configured, apply to all installed JetBrains products（一次配置即作用于所有已安装的 JetBrains 产品）。
points.quote: Note that these data sharing preferences, once configured, apply to all installed JetBrains products.

points.text: Default-state wording on the help page: the IDE setting that controls detailed data collection (Settings | Appearance & Behavior | System Settings | Data Sharing | Send detailed code-related data) "is disabled by default".
points.text_zh: 帮助页的默认状态表述：控制详细数据采集的 IDE 设置项（Settings | Appearance & Behavior | System Settings | Data Sharing | Send detailed code-related data）is disabled by default（默认关闭）。
points.quote: The option that controls detailed data collection can be found in the IDE Settings under Settings | Appearance & Behavior | System Settings | Data Sharing | Send detailed code-related data and is disabled by default.

points.text: Conflicting statement in the same notice, kept side by side: §3's table row "Individual developer / Non-commercial license" says JetBrains "may collect analytics as specified above by default based on our legitimate interest" and that the user "may opt out in the product settings". This free tier is the most likely candidate for that row, but the notice does not split the AI subscription tiers.
points.text_zh: 同一份通知里的另一说，并列保留：§3 表格 Individual developer / Non-commercial license 一行写 may collect analytics as specified above by default based on our legitimate interest、可在设置里退出。free 档最可能落到这一行，但通知没有按 AI 订阅档拆分。
points.quote: We may collect analytics as specified above by default based on our legitimate interest. You may opt out in the product settings.

retention.summary: 按对象分列保留 1 年
retention.quote: Detailed code-related data can be used for product improvement and training AI models. We do not collect Detailed code-related data from our commercial users unless explicit, informed consent has been obtained in advance. We have a safeguard in place that disallows data sharing for organizations unless there's an explicit permission on a company level. We apply a 1-year data retention period for this data.

points.text: Local IDE request log: "Logs are stored during the current AI Assistant session."
points.text_zh: IDE 本地请求日志：Logs are stored during the current AI Assistant session（仅保留当前会话）。
points.quote: Logs are stored during the current AI Assistant session.

points.text: Vendor-side period for opt-in detailed code-related data: "We apply a 1-year data retention period for this data". The object is the full text of inputs sent by the IDE to the large language model and its responses, including source code snippets; the context is the opt-in detailed-code-data collection. The text does not say whether one year is a ceiling.
points.text_zh: 厂商侧期限（opt-in 详细代码数据）：We apply a 1-year data retention period for this data。对象是发给大模型的输入全文与回复（含源码片段），语境是 opt-in 的详细代码数据采集；原文未说明 1 年是否为上限。
points.quote: Detailed code-related data can be used for product improvement and training AI models. We do not collect Detailed code-related data from our commercial users unless explicit, informed consent has been obtained in advance. We have a safeguard in place that disallows data sharing for organizations unless there's an explicit permission on a company level. We apply a 1-year data retention period for this data.

points.text: Security exception, a different object and context (ToS §5(b)(ii)): "Your Inputs, Data, Outputs, and Suggestions may be monitored by Us or our subcontractors ... and may be stored and used for a limited period" — no specific period, and subcontractors may access the content.
points.text_zh: 安全目的例外，对象与语境都不同（服务条款 §5(b)(ii)）：输入输出可被 JetBrains 或其分包商监控，并 may be stored and used for a limited period（期限未披露），分包商可访问内容。
points.quote: Your Inputs, Data, Outputs, and Suggestions may be monitored by Us or our subcontractors to prevent violation of applicable acceptable use policies and may be stored and used for a limited period.

points.text: Third rule for Personal Data generally (Privacy Notice §7): "When the reason for data storage expires, and we are no longer required to keep it, we remove your Personal Data from our servers or anonymize it for further usage" — no fixed period.
points.text_zh: Personal Data 一般情形的第三套口径（隐私通知 §7）：存储理由消失且不再被要求保留时，从服务器删除或匿名化——无固定期限。
points.quote: When the reason for data storage expires, and we are no longer required to keep it, we remove your Personal Data from our servers or anonymize it for further usage.

processing_region.quote: The collected data remains stored within the European Economic Area (EEA).

points.text: The Product Data Collection and Usage Notice §4 states "The collected data remains stored within the European Economic Area (EEA)." §1(f) defines that collected data as including the full text of inputs sent by the IDE to the large language model and its responses.
points.text_zh: 《产品数据采集与使用通知》§4 明写 The collected data remains stored within the European Economic Area (EEA)；§1(f) 把被采集数据定义为包含发给大模型的输入全文与回复。
points.quote: The collected data remains stored within the European Economic Area (EEA).

points.text: Privacy Notice §8 qualifies this for AI: "The default location for any Personal Data of our customers is the EU, unless specified otherwise. ... For JetBrains AI, the default location of Personal Data storage may differ; see this link."
points.text_zh: 隐私通知 §8 对 AI 另有限定：默认位置是 EU，但 For JetBrains AI, the default location of Personal Data storage may differ（AI 的默认存储地可能不同）。
points.quote: The default location for any Personal Data of our customers is the EU, unless specified otherwise. For Software as a Service products, we may provide the option for our customers to choose between hosting their instance in the EU or in other regions. For JetBrains AI, the default location of Personal Data storage may differ; see this link.

points.text: Same section: "At times, JetBrains may process or transfer some of your Personal Data (such as your name and email address) to our affiliate companies or subprocessors outside the EU", based on a relevant adequacy decision of the European Commission, especially standard data protection clauses.
points.text_zh: 同节：JetBrains 有时会把部分 Personal Data（如姓名与邮箱）传输给欧盟外的关联公司或次级处理者，依据欧盟委员会的充分性决定/标准数据保护条款。
points.quote: At times, JetBrains may process or transfer some of your Personal Data (such as your name and email address) to our affiliate companies or subprocessors outside the EU.

points.text: Scope limit in the same notice: "Detailed data is not currently collected in China."
points.text_zh: 同通知的适用范围限定：Detailed data is not currently collected in China（详细数据当前在中国不采集）。
points.quote: Detailed data is not currently collected in China.

role.quote: Any information directly or indirectly identifying an individual or other data protected under an applicable law as personal data (“Personal Data”), that We will process on Your behalf in connection with these Terms, will be processed in accordance with the Data Processing Addendum

points.text: Contract layer (highest authority) ToS §16(b): Personal Data "that We will process on Your behalf in connection with these Terms, will be processed in accordance with the Data Processing Addendum ... which is a part of (‘incorporated into’) these Terms".
points.text_zh: 合同层（权威最高）服务条款 §16(b)：JetBrains 代表客户处理的 Personal Data 依 Data Processing Addendum 处理，且 DPA 经条款明文并入（incorporated into）。
points.quote: Any information directly or indirectly identifying an individual or other data protected under an applicable law as personal data (“Personal Data”), that We will process on Your behalf in connection with these Terms, will be processed in accordance with the Data Processing Addendum

points.text: The same section keeps a controller capacity for some data: "We may also process some of Your Personal Data in connection with these Terms in our capacity as a data controller in accordance with our Privacy Policy".
points.text_zh: 同节保留独立控制者身份：部分 Personal Data 以 data controller 身份依隐私政策处理。
points.quote: We may also process some of Your Personal Data in connection with these Terms in our capacity as a data controller in accordance with our Privacy Policy

points.text: Privacy Notice: "JetBrains and its associated companies act as joint data controllers", and the notice applies only where JetBrains acts as a controller — processor situations are governed by the DPA.
points.text_zh: 隐私通知：JetBrains 及其关联公司是 joint data controllers；该通知只覆盖 controller 情形，processor 情形见 DPA。
points.quote: JetBrains and its associated companies act as joint data controllers, who are jointly responsible for compliance with data protection legislation.

training.quote: to improve and personalize your experience with us and the Services and to tailor communications to you

points.text: No clause in this policy commits Kilo Code not to train on API inputs or outputs. The training-relevant statements run the other way: personal information is used "to improve and personalize your experience with us and the Services and to tailor communications to you" (Legitimate interests), and automatically collected device and visit telemetry "to improve the Services and experience for visitors". Under the project's rule that service-improvement purposes count as training, this tier is marked no, and no opt-out switch is offered.
points.text_zh: 全篇没有「不用于训练」的承诺。与训练相关的表述方向相反：合法利益一节把个人信息用于「to improve and personalize your experience with us and the Services and to tailor communications to you」；自动采集的设备与访问遥测用于「to improve the Services and experience for visitors」（后一句的对象是遥测数据，作为训练依据弱于前一句）。按「用来改进服务/提高质量算训练」的口径记 no，且没有可关闭的开关。
points.quote: to improve and personalize your experience with us and the Services and to tailor communications to you

points.text: The closest counter-statement is a purpose limitation, not a no-training commitment: "Prompts and conversation content are sent to the AI provider you select per request, routed through OpenRouter. This information is used only to generate the response." It sits in the Mobile App (Kilo App for iOS and Android) data-flow section, so its scope is the App's data flow rather than the hosted Gateway as a whole; it never names model training, and the same policy lists improvement and personalization as purposes, so it does not settle this dimension.
points.text_zh: 最接近的反方向表述是一句用途限制，不是不训练承诺：「Prompts and conversation content are sent to the AI provider you select per request, routed through OpenRouter. This information is used only to generate the response.」。该句出自「Mobile App (Kilo App for iOS and Android)」数据流一节，适用范围是 App 的数据流而非整个托管 Gateway；它没有点名模型训练，同一份政策又把改进与个性化列为用途，故不足以在本维度定论。
points.quote: Prompts and conversation content are sent to the AI provider you select per request, routed through OpenRouter.

points.text: Chain scope: prompts and conversation content go through OpenRouter to the AI provider selected per request, while "Account ID and request metadata are sent to Kilo Gateway, our backend, for authentication, request routing, and billing reconciliation." That sentence describes what the Gateway backend receives and why; it does not exclude prompt or conversation content from Kilo's own systems, and it comes from the Kilo App data-flow section. The chain is Kilo → OpenRouter → the selected model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, Mistral, Meta and others listed at https://openrouter.ai/models).
points.text_zh: 链路范围：提示与对话内容经 OpenRouter 送往每次请求所选定的 AI 厂商，而「Account ID and request metadata are sent to Kilo Gateway, our backend, for authentication, request routing, and billing reconciliation.」描述的是 Gateway 后端收到哪些数据、用于什么（认证、路由、计费对账），并非排他性限定，也不排除提示与对话内容进入 Kilo 自有系统；该句出自 Kilo App 数据流一节。链路为 Kilo → OpenRouter → 所选模型厂商（Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、xAI、Mistral、Meta 等）。
points.quote: Account ID and request metadata are sent to Kilo Gateway, our backend, for authentication, request routing, and billing reconciliation.

points.text: Kilo limits its own service providers and partners by contract: "Our service providers and partners are required by contract to safeguard any personal information they receive from us and are prohibited from using the personal information for any purpose other than to perform the services as instructed by Kilo Code." It sits in the Service Providers and partners section, so it applies to the Services generally rather than to the Kilo App alone, and it covers OpenRouter plus the downstream AI providers listed above it. It is a contract between Kilo and its providers, so it cannot substitute for the upstream model vendors' own terms on this dimension.
points.text_zh: Kilo 以合同约束自己的服务商与合作伙伴：「Our service providers and partners are required by contract to safeguard any personal information they receive from us and are prohibited from using the personal information for any purpose other than to perform the services as instructed by Kilo Code.」。该句位于「Service Providers and partners」一节，适用全部 Services（不是 Mobile App 专属），覆盖 OpenRouter 与其下列出的下游 AI 厂商。它约束的是 Kilo 与服务商之间的合同，不能替代上游模型厂商自有条款在本维度上的表态。
points.quote: Our service providers and partners are required by contract to safeguard any personal information they receive from us and are prohibited from using the personal information for any purpose other than to perform the services as instructed by Kilo Code.

points.text: "OpenRouter and the downstream providers are bound by data protection terms equivalent to those described in this policy." This policy contains no no-training commitment, so "equivalent to those described in this policy" cannot be read as an upstream no-training promise. Per the multi-hop rule — any hop without a commitment makes the chain fail — the upstream hop does not lift this tier above no.
points.text_zh: 「OpenRouter and the downstream providers are bound by data protection terms equivalent to those described in this policy.」本政策通篇没有不训练承诺，故「等效于本政策」在当前文本下不构成上游的不训练承诺。按多跳口径「任一跳无承诺则全链为否」，上游那一跳不能把本档抬到 no 之上。
points.quote: OpenRouter and the downstream providers are bound by data protection terms equivalent to those described in this policy.

points.text: No zero-retention option is stated for the hosted Gateway. The nearest statements are purpose and retention descriptions rather than a ZDR scheme: "This information is used only to generate the response." (Kilo App flow), "Account ID and request metadata are sent to Kilo Gateway, our backend, for authentication, request routing, and billing reconciliation.", and "OpenRouter and the downstream providers are bound by data protection terms equivalent to those described in this policy." — equivalent to this policy, which offers no zero-retention option, so the upstream hop carries no ZDR promise either. Search scope is recorded in searched: only https://kilo.ai/privacy has a snapshot; https://kilo.ai/terms and https://kilo.ai/security-and-compliance are not registered sources and were removed from searched until the fetch bot brings them back.
points.text_zh: 本档没有任何零保留方案。最接近的几句都是用途与留存描述，不是 ZDR 方案：「This information is used only to generate the response.」（Kilo App 数据流）、「Account ID and request metadata are sent to Kilo Gateway, our backend, for authentication, request routing, and billing reconciliation.」、「OpenRouter and the downstream providers are bound by data protection terms equivalent to those described in this policy.」——而本政策没有零保留选项，故「等效于本政策」也不构成上游的零保留承诺。查阅范围见 searched：只有 https://kilo.ai/privacy 有快照；https://kilo.ai/terms 与 https://kilo.ai/security-and-compliance 未登记为来源、无可复核快照，已从 searched 移除，待抓取 bot 补回后再写。

retention.summary: 按对象分列留至服务终止
retention.quote: Kilo Code will retain your information for as long as your account is active or as needed to perform our contractual obligations, provide you services through the Services, to comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, preserve legal rights, or enforce our agreements.

points.text: Object and deletion path: "Once deletion is confirmed, your Kilo account, prompts, conversation history, and account metadata are removed from Kilo's systems. Data already shared with third-party AI providers to generate responses is governed by those providers' retention policies, including those linked from the OpenRouter model list and the providers' own privacy documentation." So the objects covered by Kilo's own deletion are prompts, conversation history and account metadata; the context is the default account lifecycle; deletion happens on request plus confirmation rather than automatically after a fixed period. On the multi-hop chain Kilo cannot delete what has already been forwarded — that retention is governed by each upstream provider's policy.
points.text_zh: 对象与删除路径：「Once deletion is confirmed, your Kilo account, prompts, conversation history, and account metadata are removed from Kilo's systems. Data already shared with third-party AI providers to generate responses is governed by those providers' retention policies, including those linked from the OpenRouter model list and the providers' own privacy documentation.」。Kilo 自身删除的对象是提示、对话历史与账户元数据；语境是默认的账户存续期；删除靠用户申请并确认，不是固定期限后自动删除。多跳链路上，已转发给第三方 AI 厂商的数据由各上游政策决定保留，Kilo 无法代为删除。
points.quote: Once deletion is confirmed, your Kilo account, prompts, conversation history, and account metadata are removed from Kilo's systems. Data already shared with third-party AI providers to generate responses is governed by those providers' retention policies, including those linked from the OpenRouter model list and the providers' own privacy documentation.

points.text: Exception to deletion: "Please note that due to the open source nature of our products, services, and community, we may retain limited personal information indefinitely in order to ensure transactional integrity and nonrepudiation." The next sentence gives the example of a GitHub issue or comment, which is not automatically deleted even after the account is removed. So basis = until_termination is the main rule, not an absolute one — limited personal information in open-source community contributions may be kept indefinitely.
points.text_zh: 删除的例外：「Please note that due to the open source nature of our products, services, and community, we may retain limited personal information indefinitely in order to ensure transactional integrity and nonrepudiation.」。紧随的例句是 GitHub issue / comment——即使账户被删除，社区帖子也不会自动删除。故 basis = until_termination 是主规则而非绝对规则：开源社区贡献中的有限个人信息可能无限期保留（对象=开源社区贡献中的有限个人信息，期限类型=可能无限期，语境=例外）。
points.quote: Please note that due to the open source nature of our products, services, and community, we may retain limited personal information indefinitely in order to ensure transactional integrity and nonrepudiation.

processing_region.quote: The Services are hosted in the United States and the personal information we collect will be stored and processed on our servers in the United States.

role.quote: The relevant data controller for any personal information processed in connection with the Services is Kilo Code Inc.

points.text: 托管链路为 Kilo → OpenRouter → 用户所选模型厂商，任一上游的训练/保留政策都需另行组合。
points.text_zh: 托管链路为 Kilo → OpenRouter → 用户所选模型厂商，任一上游的训练/保留政策都需另行组合。

points.text: Tier boundary: "If you are a customer of Kilo Code, this Privacy Policy does not apply to personal information or other data and information that we process on your behalf (if any) as your service provider (collectively, “Customer Data”)." This product is the individual tier, so kind = controller holds; where Kilo processes Customer Data as a service provider this policy does not apply, and a separate product entry with the applicable agreement would be required.
points.text_zh: 档位边界：「If you are a customer of Kilo Code, this Privacy Policy does not apply to personal information or other data and information that we process on your behalf (if any) as your service provider (collectively, “Customer Data”).」。本档是个人档，故 kind = controller 成立；涉及 Kilo 以 service provider 身份处理的客户数据（Customer Data）时本政策不适用，需另建档位条目并另找协议依据。
points.quote: If you are a customer of Kilo Code, this Privacy Policy does not apply to personal information or other data and information that we process on your behalf (if any) as your service provider (collectively, “Customer Data”).

lines.entity: 北京月之暗面科技股份有限公司
北京月之暗面科技股份有限公司

training.quote: We may use Content to provide, maintain, develop, support, and improve the Services

points.text: Contract side: ToS §4 lets Moonshot AI use Content — the same section defines Content as input plus output — to provide, maintain, develop, support, and improve the Services, and to comply with law, enforce its terms and keep the Services safe and secure. Under the ledger's rule that "used to improve the service" counts as training, this self-use permission is the basis for mark=no (training permitted by the terms).
points.text_zh: 合同侧:ToS §4 允许厂商用 Content(同节把 Content 定义为输入+输出)提供、维护、开发、支持与改进服务,并为守法、执行条款与保障服务安全而使用。按台账口径「用于改进服务算训练」,这条自用许可即 mark=no(条款允许训练)的依据。
points.quote: We may use Content to provide, maintain, develop, support, and improve the Services

points.text: Same section, the default made explicit: a customer who requires restrictions on the use of Customer Content for training or improving Moonshot AI models must contact Moonshot AI to discuss available enterprise arrangements or separate written agreements, and unless otherwise expressly agreed in writing Customer Content may be used for the foregoing purposes. That is a restriction to be negotiated with the vendor, not a self-serve opt-out switch — hence no mode is recorded on this verdict.
points.text_zh: 同节写明默认不设限:需限制「用 Customer Content 训练或改进 Moonshot AI 模型」的客户,须联系厂商商谈可行的企业安排或另立书面协议;除非另有书面明确约定,Customer Content 可用于前述用途。这是需与厂商商定的限制,不是自助退出开关——故本判定不记 mode。
points.quote: Customer who requires restrictions on the use of Customer Content for training or improving Moonshot AI models may contact Moonshot AI to discuss available enterprise arrangements or separate written agreements.

points.text: Privacy policy side (developer_data): §2 "To Improve and Develop Our Services" says the analysis of how you use the services "includes training and refining our underlying technology, such as machine learning models and algorithms" — the most explicit training basis on this product line.
points.text_zh: 隐私政策侧(developer_data):§2「To Improve and Develop Our Services」写明对使用方式的分析「包括训练与改进我们的底层技术,如机器学习模型与算法」——本产品线最直白的训练依据。
points.quote: We analyze how you use the services to identify areas for improvement, develop new features, and enhance the overall user experience. This includes training and refining our underlying technology, such as machine learning models and algorithms.

points.text: Opposite direction, tier-qualified — kept side by side, no picking a side: the ZDR page states that by default the Kimi Open Platform does not use enterprise customer data to train models, i.e. the no-training statement is limited to enterprise customers, while this row covers the whole api tier (plan_level=any, pay-as-you-go plus enterprise options). It does not override the contract's §4 default.
points.text_zh: 相反方向、带档位限定——并列保留,不选边:ZDR 页称开放平台默认不使用企业客户数据训练模型,即该不训练表述只限企业客户,而本行覆盖整个 api 档(plan_level=any,按量自助 + 企业方案)。它不覆盖合同 §4 的默认口径。
points.quote: By default, the Kimi Open Platform does not use enterprise customer data to train models.

points.text: Opposite direction, unqualified (contradiction source): the help-center FAQ in the same kimi-api category says user data submitted through the API, including input content and model output, is not used to train or improve Kimi's models. A developer_data FAQ ranks below the contract and does not override §4; both facts stay visible pending written clarification from the vendor.
points.text_zh: 相反方向、无档位限定(冲突来源):同一帮助中心 kimi-api 分类的 FAQ 称通过 API 提交的用户数据(含输入内容与模型输出)不用于训练或改进 Kimi 的模型。developer_data 的 FAQ 权威性低于合同,不覆盖 §4;两条事实并列可见,待厂商书面澄清。
points.quote: not used to train or improve Kimi

zdr.quote: ZDR is available on request to enterprise customers.

points.text: Object and context: ZDR covers request content (prompts and model responses) only. When ZDR is enabled, request content is processed only while the response is being generated and is deleted as soon as the response is returned; the only stated exception is where retention is required by applicable laws and regulations.
points.text_zh: 对象与语境:ZDR 只覆盖请求内容(提示与模型响应)。开通后请求内容仅在生成响应期间被处理、响应返回即删除;唯一明示例外是适用法律法规要求保留。
points.quote: When ZDR is enabled, your request content is processed only while the response is being generated and is deleted as soon as the response is returned.

points.text: ZDR is not "nobody touches the content": it changes only how content is retained, not the platform's usage policies; automated safeguards, including content safety reviews, continue to apply to all traffic, and abusive behavior may lead to action under the usage policies, including terminating ZDR service.
points.text_zh: ZDR ≠「无人接触内容」:它只改变内容的保留方式、不改变平台的使用政策;内容安全审核等自动保障对全部流量照常生效,发现滥用行为可依使用政策处理,包括终止 ZDR 服务。
points.quote: ZDR changes only how content is retained; it does not change the platform’s usage policies. Automated safeguards, including content safety reviews, continue to apply to all traffic. If we identify abusive behavior, we may take action under our usage policies, including terminating ZDR service.

points.text: Scope exclusion (1 of 3): ZDR cannot be guaranteed for images or videos submitted through direct file uploads.
points.text_zh: 范围除外(三类之一):通过文件直传提交的图片或视频不能保证 ZDR。
points.quote: ZDR cannot be guaranteed for images or videos submitted through direct file uploads.

points.text: Scope exclusion (2 of 3): operational data, such as security logs and billing records, is outside the scope of zero data retention.
points.text_zh: 范围除外(三类之二):安全日志与计费记录等运营数据不在零数据保留范围内。
points.quote: Operational data, such as security logs and billing records, is outside the scope of zero data retention.

points.text: Scope exclusion (3 of 3): third-party models, connectors, and plugins are not covered by this policy.
points.text_zh: 范围除外(三类之三):第三方模型、连接器与插件不在本政策覆盖范围内。
points.quote: Third-party models, connectors, and plugins are not covered by this policy.

retention.quote: We store your information as long as necessary to provide the services, fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy and other legitimate business purposes

points.text: Period type: no quantified number of days. The OpenPlatform Privacy Policy §6 stores information as long as necessary to provide the services, fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy and other legitimate business purposes, and retention periods vary with information type, sensitivity, and legal requirements.
points.text_zh: 期限类型:无量化天数。开放平台隐私政策 §6 称信息留存至「提供服务、实现本政策所述目的及其他合法商业目的所必需」的时间,保留期依信息类型、敏感度与法律要求而不同。
points.quote: We store your information as long as necessary to provide the services, fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy and other legitimate business purposes

points.text: Object and context: account, input, and payment information are retained while the account is active (default, for the life of the account); violation-related information is retained until the violation is resolved; in some cases the retention time depends on the customer's settings.
points.text_zh: 对象与语境:账户、输入与支付信息在账户存续期间保留(默认、随账户存续);违规相关信息保留至违规解决;部分情形下保留时长取决于客户设置。
points.quote: For example, account, input, and payment information are retained while your account is active.

points.text: Contract side, vendor-initiated termination: after your service is terminated, Moonshot AI will delete your content and data in accordance with the requirements of applicable laws and regulations — a deletion commitment with a legal carve-out, not "everything is wiped the moment the service ends".
points.text_zh: 合同侧·厂商侧终止:服务终止后,厂商按适用法律法规的要求删除你的内容与数据——这是带法律例外的删除承诺,不等于「服务一终止就全部清除」。
points.quote: After your service is terminated, we will delete your content and data in accordance with the requirements of applicable laws and regulations.

points.text: Contract side, customer-initiated cancellation: the customer may terminate the services at any time by deleting the account; once the account is canceled, account information, data, APIs, and any remaining balance are permanently deleted and are not restored even if the same entity registers again.
points.text_zh: 合同侧·客户主动注销:客户可随时通过删除账户终止服务;账户一旦注销,账户信息、数据、API 与剩余余额将被永久删除,同一主体重新注册也不会恢复。
points.quote: Customer may terminate the Services at any time by deleting your account.

points.text: Contradiction side, kept side by side: the help-center FAQ says API data is used solely to fulfill the current API request and is not persistently stored for training purposes. The qualifier "for training purposes" is the FAQ's own limit — it does not deny the account-life retention recorded above.
points.text_zh: 冲突侧,并列保留:帮助中心 FAQ 称 API 数据仅用于完成当次 API 请求、不为训练目的持久存储。限定语「for training purposes」是 FAQ 自带的范围——它不否认上文记录的账户存续期保留。
points.quote: is not persistently stored for training purposes

processing_region.quote: We store the information we collect in secure servers located in Singapore.

points.text: Object and context: the information the platform collects is stored by default on secure servers located in Singapore.
points.text_zh: 对象与语境:平台收集的信息默认存储在新加坡的安全服务器上。
points.quote: We store the information we collect in secure servers located in Singapore.

points.text: Not an exclusive-region commitment: in the same section the policy says your personal information may be transferred to and stored on servers located outside your country of residence, and that cross-border transfers are made with appropriate safeguards consistent with applicable data protection laws. Singapore should therefore be read as the default storage location, not as a guarantee that processing stays there.
points.text_zh: 不是排他性处理地承诺:同一节写明个人信息可能被转移到居住国以外的服务器存储,跨境转移时会依适用数据保护法采取适当保障措施。因此「新加坡」应读作默认存储地,而非「处理只在新加坡」的保证。
points.quote: Your personal information may be transferred to and stored on servers located outside your country of residence.

role.quote: Unless otherwise expressly agreed in writing, Customer Content may be used for the foregoing purposes.

points.text: Controller direction: ToS §4 gives Moonshot AI a self-use permission — unless otherwise expressly agreed in writing, Customer Content may be used for the foregoing purposes (providing, maintaining, developing, supporting, and improving the Services) — i.e. the vendor uses the content for its own purposes rather than on the customer's instructions.
points.text_zh: 控制者方向:ToS §4 给出厂商自用许可——除非另有书面明确约定,Customer Content 可用于前述用途(提供、维护、开发、支持与改进服务)——即厂商为自己的目的使用内容,而非依客户指示处理。
points.quote: Unless otherwise expressly agreed in writing, Customer Content may be used for the foregoing purposes.

points.text: Counter-direction clause in the same contract, recorded side by side: §6 deems Customer Content Customer's Confidential Information and binds the recipient not to disclose it. That obligation constrains the disclosure direction and does not withdraw §4's self-use permission, so the verdict is not flipped. Difference from moonshotai-cn.toml, which records the same tier as kind=unknown: that document contains both entrusted-processor clauses and a self-use optimization license (an intra-document conflict); this contract records no entrusted-processor clause, so no such conflict arises here.
points.text_zh: 同一合同中的反方向条款,并列记录:§6 把 Customer Content 定为客户机密信息,并约束接收方不得披露。该义务约束的是披露方向,并未收回 §4 的自用许可,故不改判定。与 moonshotai-cn.toml 同档位记 kind=unknown 的差异:那份文档同时有受托处理条款与自用优化许可(同文冲突);本合同没有受托处理条款,不存在同类冲突。
points.quote: Customer Content shall be deemed Customer’s Confidential Information.

training.quote: 为了提升您使用本服务的体验，您授予我们一项免费的使用权，以在法律允许的范围内将您输入输出之内容及反馈用于模型服务优化

points.text: Open Platform pay-as-you-go API tier (including enterprise-verified accounts and enterprise plans). The contract keeps a license for "model service optimization": User Service Agreement Section V.3 (incorporated by the opening paragraph of the Model Use Agreement) grants use of inputs, outputs and feedback for model service optimization, and provides an opt-out route from training
points.text_zh: 开放平台按量 API 档（含企业认证/企业方案）。合同保留「模型服务优化」用途许可：userservice 五、3（经 modeluse 首段并入）授权将输入输出及反馈用于模型服务优化，并给训练 opt-out 途径

points.text: Model Use Agreement Section VI.3 grants the same license but with no opt-out. The official FAQ (api-data-security) and the ZDR page state that API / enterprise customer data is not used for training, which is the opposite of the contractual grant; under contract > developer_data the contract prevails. Re-checked (2026-09-21): after ruling out the scope, tier and site readings one by one, judged a genuine contradiction (recency could not be ruled out because the page carries no date, but there is no evidence of a superseding version); marked contradiction, see the contradiction_note on api-data-security.
points.text_zh: modeluse 六、3 同款授权但无 opt-out。官方 FAQ（api-data-security）与 ZDR 页声明 API/企业客户数据不用于训练，与合同授权相反，按 contract > developer_data 取合同。重查(2026-09-21)：逐条排除范围/档位/站点三种解释后判为真矛盾（时效因该页无日期未能排除，但无版本取代证据），标 contradiction，见 api-data-security 的 contradiction_note。

zdr.quote: 开通后，你的请求内容只在生成响应的过程中存在于系统中，响应返回后即行清除，不做留存（法律法规要求除外）。

points.text: On request to enterprise customers (contact sales to request an assessment), not self-serve. The ZDR page scopes the programme to enterprise customers ("provided to enterprise customers", "opened to enterprise customers on demand"), while this row is plan_level=any and per Section I.2 of the Model Use Agreement also covers individual-verified accounts — individual accounts fall outside the ZDR scope.
points.text_zh: 企业客户按需开放、需联系销售申请评估，不是自助开通。ZDR 页把适用对象限定为「为企业客户提供」「按需开放给企业客户」，而本行 plan_level=any、按 modeluse 一、2 也覆盖个人认证账号——个人认证账号不在 ZDR 开放范围内。
points.quote: ZDR 按需开放给企业客户。如果你的业务涉及敏感数据，或所在行业对数据留存有监管要求，可联系销售申请评估。

points.text: Once enabled, request content is cleared as soon as the response is returned. Excluded: images and videos submitted by direct file upload, Kimi Hosted Agents data, operational data such as security logs and billing records, and third-party models, connectors and plugins.
points.text_zh: 开通后请求内容响应返回即清除。排除：直接文件上传的图像/视频、Kimi Hosted Agents 数据、安全日志与账单等运营数据、第三方模型/连接器/插件。
points.quote: 通过直接文件上传方式提交的图像或视频，使用 Kimi Hosted Agents 托管智能体的数据，零数据留存无法保证。安全日志、账单记录等运营数据不属于零留存范围；第三方模型、连接器、插件等不受本协议约束。

retention.summary: 按对象分列未公布期限
retention.quote: 我们仅依据相关法律法规要求或基于本服务的需要存储客户数据，我们没有义务存储您的数据或信息，亦不对您的数据存储工作或结果承担任何责任。

points.text: No fixed period on the standard tier; the only commitment is to store customer data "as required by applicable laws and regulations or as needed for this service", with no obligation to store (Section V.5)
points.text_zh: 普通档无固定期限，仅承诺「依据相关法律法规要求或基于本服务的需要」存储、且无存储义务（五、5）
points.quote: 我们仅依据相关法律法规要求或基于本服务的需要存储客户数据，我们没有义务存储您的数据或信息，亦不对您的数据存储工作或结果承担任何责任。

points.text: Account deletion has two halves in the same document. Deletion side: once the account is deleted the account, data, API access and remaining balance are all cleared, and re-registering under the same entity does not restore them (Section IX.1). Statutory floor: registration data and activity records must still be retained as required by the Cybersecurity Law and other laws (Section IX.4) — a floor, which cannot be read backwards as "everything is deleted at that point".
points.text_zh: 注销在同一份文档里有两半。删除侧：一旦注销，账号、数据、API 和充值余额都会被清空，同一主体重新注册也无法恢复（九、1）。法定下限：注销后仍需按网络安全法等法律法规保留注册数据及行为记录（九、4）——是下限，不能反推「此时全部内容即删除」。
points.quote: 一旦注销，您的账号、数据、API和充值余额都会被清空，即使您再次通过同一主体进行注册，请您审慎选择。

points.text: Personal information is kept for "the time necessary to achieve the purpose of the service" (userprivacy 5.2). On the approved ZDR tier, content is cleared as soon as the response is returned.
points.text_zh: 个人信息为「实现服务目的所必需的时间」（userprivacy 5.2）。ZDR 获批档响应返回即清除。
points.quote: 我们仅在**为实现服务目的所必需的时间内**保留您的个人信息

points.text: Exception inside the deletion flow: where deleting or anonymising personal information is technically infeasible, processing stops except for storage and necessary security protection measures — the data is kept, not deleted (userprivacy 7.3). It sits alongside the statutory floor in Section IX.4; both qualify the reading "deletion means the data is gone".
points.text_zh: 删除流程内的例外：如果删除、匿名化处理个人信息从技术上难以实现，我们会停止除存储和采取必要的安全保护措施之外的处理——数据被继续存储，而非删除（userprivacy 7.3）。它与九、4 的法定下限并列，同属「注销≠立即消失」的限定。
points.quote: 如果删除、匿名化处理个人信息从技术上难以实现，我们会停止除存储和采取必要的安全保护措施之外的处理。

points.text: Object = raw request data on the content-moderation path, per the tier's own official FAQ: content review does not store or leak the user's raw data. The FAQ is the same source that contradicts the core contract on training (tier=contradiction), so this is recorded as supplementary evidence for the moderation path only, not as the main basis for this verdict.
points.text_zh: 对象=内容安全审查链路上的请求原始数据，出自本档官方 FAQ：内容审查不会存储或泄露你的原始数据。该 FAQ 正是与 core 合同就 training 冲突的同一来源（tier=contradiction），故仅作审查链路的补充证据，不作本维度主证据。
points.quote: 内容审查不会存储或泄露你的原始数据。

points.text: Object = files uploaded through the file API, on user instruction: a file can be deleted at any time through the DELETE endpoint or the console, after which it can no longer be referenced and the related data is cleared from the servers. Also from the tier's official FAQ (tier=contradiction), recorded as a supplementary lead rather than the main basis.
points.text_zh: 对象=通过文件接口上传的文件，语境=用户主动删除：可通过 DELETE 接口或控制台随时删除，删除后文件无法再被引用、相关数据会从服务器中清除。同出本档官方 FAQ（tier=contradiction），作补充线索而非主证据。
points.quote: 删除后文件将无法再被引用，相关数据会从服务器中清除。

processing_region.quote: 我们将您的个人信息存储于中华人民共和国境内。除非取得您的单独同意，并且符合国家相关法律法规的规定，我们不会向境外提供您的任何个人信息。

points.text: Personal information is stored within mainland China; cross-border provision requires separate consent and must comply with the law (5.1)
points.text_zh: 个人信息存储于中国境内，跨境提供需单独同意且合法（5.1）

points.text: The disclosure covers storage location only. No public disclosure of the inference / processing region, the data centres used or any selectable region option; the row is coded CN on the storage clause, not on a processing-region commitment.
points.text_zh: 该披露只覆盖存储地点：推理/处理地域、所用机房与可选区域均无公开披露。本行记 CN 的依据是存储地条款，不是处理地承诺。

role.quote: 作为中立的技术服务提供者，我们只会严格执行您的指示处理客户数据，除非法律法规另有规定、依据本协议及产品规则或基于您的要求为您提供技术协助进行故障排除或解决技术问题，我们不会对客户数据进行任何非授权的使用或披露。

points.text: Main clause (Model Use Agreement V.3): Moonshot AI is a neutral technical service provider that only processes customer data on the customer's instructions, and will not make any unauthorised use or disclosure of it.
points.text_zh: 主条款（modeluse 五、3）：月之暗面是中立的技术服务提供者，只严格执行客户指示处理客户数据，不会对客户数据做任何非授权的使用或披露。
points.quote: 作为中立的技术服务提供者，我们只会严格执行您的指示处理客户数据，除非法律法规另有规定、依据本协议及产品规则或基于您的要求为您提供技术协助进行故障排除或解决技术问题，我们不会对客户数据进行任何非授权的使用或披露。

points.text: Purpose limitation (V.6): Moonshot AI and its authorised partners process customer business data only on documented instructions and "not for their own purposes", or to meet legal requirements / regulator instructions — an entrusted-processor positioning.
points.text_zh: 目的限制（五、6）：月之暗面及其委托授权合作伙伴仅按有文件记录的指示、且「不为其自身目的处理相关数据」处理客户业务数据，或为落实法律法规与主管部门指示——受托处理者定位。
points.quote: 我们或我们委托授权合作伙伴将仅按照如下方式处理您的客户业务数据：（1）按照本协议及您可能不时做出的任何进一步有文件记录的指示且不为其自身目的处理相关数据；（2）为落实现行法律法规要求或按照主管部门指示处理客户业务数据。

points.text: Boundary (V.1): responsibility for end users' personal information collected through the customer's own product lies with the customer, and the end-user product's own privacy policy applies rather than this service's — consistent with the customer being the party that determines the purposes of processing.
points.text_zh: 边界（五、1）：客户利用本服务收集的终端用户个人信息由客户负全部责任，适用客户自己的隐私政策而非本服务的——与「由客户决定处理目的」一致。
points.quote: 您利用本服务所开发的终端的用户个人信息保护应当直接适用您的而非本服务的隐私政策。

points.text: Counter-evidence kept in parallel: the IP section (VI.3) grants Moonshot AI a free licence to use inputs, outputs and feedback for model service optimisation; the identical clause in the User Service Agreement (V.3) carries a training opt-out. These are content-use licences rather than statements of role, so they do not overturn the processor positioning, but they pull the other way and are recorded here.
points.text_zh: 并列保留的反向条款：知识产权节（六、3）授权月之暗面将输入输出及反馈用于模型服务优化；userservice 五、3 同款并续接训练 opt-out。两句都是内容使用许可而非角色声明，不推翻受托处理者定位，但方向相反，故一并记录。
points.quote: 为了提升您使用本服务的体验，您授予我们一项免费的使用权，以在法律允许的范围内将您输入输出之内容及反馈用于模型服务优化。
