points.quote: 您应保证已经获得了个人信息主体的同意，并有权将其个人信息传输给我们进行数据处理

points.text: Scope of the tier: Paid Services Agreement §5.2 — some entitlements of the Token Plan subscription may be used in products operated by the company, its affiliates or its partners (such as MiniMax Code); partner-operated products need not follow the same data rules, so this is recorded as a scope clue only.
points.text_zh: 档位适用范围：付费协议 5.2——Token Plan 订阅的部分权益可在公司及其关联公司、公司合作伙伴运营的产品（如MiniMax Code）中使用；合作伙伴运营的产品未必沿用同一套数据规则，故只作范围线索。
points.quote: 您通过Token Plan订阅的相关权益，部分权益可在公司及其关联公司、公司合作伙伴运营的产品（如MiniMax Code）中使用。

training.quote: unless Customer is or has opted-out of training

points.text: Commercial ToS §4.2 is a direct contract-level clause, kept side by side with DPA §2.3 below because the two point in opposite directions: "Mistral AI will not use Customer Data or Outputs to train its artificial intelligence models", except (a) where the customer opted in to training on a Mistral AI Product set to opt-out by default, or has not opted out of training on a Product set to opt-in by default, (b) where Customer or an End User provides Feedback, (c) as otherwise provided in an Order Form, or (d) where Customer uses Labs or Preview Models
points.text_zh: Commercial ToS §4.2 是合同层的直接条款,与下面的 DPA §2.3 并列保留(两条方向相反):Mistral AI 不会用 Customer Data / Outputs 训练其模型,例外为 (a) 产品被设为 opt-out by default 时用户主动 opt-in,或产品被设为 opt-in by default 时用户未 opt-out、(b) Feedback、(c) Order Form 另行约定、(d) Labs / Preview 模型
points.quote: Mistral AI will not use Customer Data or Outputs to train its artificial intelligence models except (a) when you (i) opted-in to training on a Mistral AI Product set to opt-out by default or (ii) have not opted-out of training on a Mistral AI Product set to opt-in by default, (b) when Customer or an End User provides Feedback to Mistral AI, (c) as otherwise may be provided in an Order Form or (d) when Customer uses Labs or Preview Models.

points.text: §4.1 expressly puts model training outside the license granted by the customer ("excludes model training")
points.text_zh: §4.1 把 model training 明确排除在客户授予的许可之外
points.quote: which includes debugging, assessing, reviewing, and correcting the performance of the Mistral AI Products but excludes model training

points.text: §4.3 states separately for Labs / Preview Models that "Mistral AI may use Customer Data and Outputs generated from Labs or Preview Models to train its artificial intelligence models" (use means training, and it is unaffected by the opt-out and ZDR available on other products). Observation of our own, not vendor text and not a policy change: the older docs page "Privacy and data controls" (which said "API: data sent through the API isn't used for model training.") now returns 404 and has been removed from the docs sitemap. That page is not among this provider's registered sources and no snapshot of it exists in this repo, so it carries no weight in this verdict.
points.text_zh: §4.3 对 Labs / Preview 模型另有明示:用了就训练,且不受其他产品的 opt-out 与 ZDR 影响。以下是我们自己的观察,不是厂商文本、也不算政策变化:旧 docs 页『Privacy and data controls』(原文 API : data sent through the API isn't used for model training.)现返回 404、已从 docs sitemap 移除;该页不在本 provider 登记的来源内,仓库里也没有它的快照,故在本行判定中不占权重。

points.text: DPA §2.3 (contract layer, incorporated into the Agreement by §11.2) is the clause that carries mark=no: Mistral AI is authorized to process Personal Data as Controller for the purpose of "Training its artificial intelligence models in accordance with its Privacy Policy, unless Customer is or has opted-out of training", i.e. an opt-out regime — training by default unless the customer opts out. The same clause adds that Feedback given through the in-app thumbs up / thumbs down features is used as Controller, together with the associated Input and Output, to train models, conduct research or improve the products. Where the two layers meet: §4.2 exception (a)(ii) (customer has not opted out of training on a Product set to opt-in by default) and this clause describe the same switch.
points.text_zh: DPA §2.3(合同层,经 §11.2 并入协议)是支撑 mark=no 的条款:Mistral AI 被授权以 Controller 身份处理 Personal Data,目的包括『Training its artificial intelligence models in accordance with its Privacy Policy, unless Customer is or has opted-out of training』,即 opt-out 制——默认训练,除非客户退出。同条还写明:通过应用内 thumbs up / thumbs down 提交的 Feedback,连同相关 Input 与 Output,由 Mistral 以 Controller 身份用于训练模型、做研究或改进产品。两层交汇点:§4.2 例外 (a)(ii)(产品默认 opt-in 时客户未 opt-out)与这条讲的是同一个开关。
points.quote: unless Customer is or has opted-out of training

points.text: The conflict is kept explicit instead of averaged: §4.2 says Mistral AI will not train on Customer Data or Outputs by default, while DPA §2.3 authorizes processing for training purposes as Controller under an opt-out regime, and DPA §11.2 provides that "In the event of any conflict between the terms of the DPA and the remainder of the Agreement, the terms of the DPA shall prevail to the extent of such conflict.", so §4.2's "no training by default" cannot stand on its own. Clauses that pull the other way are recorded too: DPA §3.1 (process only in accordance with the documented lawful instructions of Customer) and DPA §12.2 (CCPA: no processing for a commercial purpose other than as necessary to provide the products) both limit the Processor role and sit alongside, not against, the Controller-purpose authorization in §2.3.
points.text_zh: 冲突显式并列、不取平均:§4.2 说默认不用 Customer Data / Outputs 训练,DPA §2.3 却授权以 Controller 身份为训练目的处理(opt-out 制),而 DPA §11.2 规定 DPA 与协议其余部分冲突时以 DPA 为准,所以 §4.2 的『默认不训练』不能单独成立。反向条款也一并记下:DPA §3.1(仅按客户书面合法指示处理)与 DPA §12.2(CCPA:除提供产品所必需外,不得为商业目的处理)都限制 Processor 角色,与 §2.3 的 Controller 用途授权并列而非对撞。
points.quote: In the event of any conflict between the terms of the DPA and the remainder of the Agreement, the terms of the DPA shall prevail to the extent of such conflict.

points.text: Feedback is a wider exception than the one-liner in §4.2(b): Commercial ToS §2.4 provides that "By providing Feedback, Customer acknowledges and agrees that Mistral AI may use, copy, disclose, license, distribute, and exploit such Feedback, along with the Customer Data and Output associated with such Feedback, in any manner without any obligation, royalty, or restriction based on intellectual property rights or otherwise.", and §6.1 confirms such Feedback is not Customer Confidential Information. The same Feedback, with its associated Input and Output, is what DPA §2.3 has Mistral process as Controller for training, so this path is not covered by the training opt-out.
points.text_zh: Feedback 是比 §4.2(b) 一句话更宽的例外:Commercial ToS §2.4 规定,客户提供 Feedback 即同意 Mistral AI 可无限制使用、复制、披露、许可、分发和利用该 Feedback 及其关联的 Customer Data 与 Output,不承担任何义务、版税或其他知识产权限制;§6.1 进一步确认该等 Feedback 不属客户保密信息。同一批 Feedback(含关联 Input / Output)正是 DPA §2.3 下 Mistral 以 Controller 身份用于训练的数据,因此这条路径不受训练 opt-out 覆盖。
points.quote: By providing Feedback, Customer acknowledges and agrees that Mistral AI may use, copy, disclose, license, distribute, and exploit such Feedback, along with the Customer Data and Output associated with such Feedback, in any manner without any obligation, royalty, or restriction based on intellectual property rights or otherwise.

points.text: A training opt-out switch exists at account level: Privacy Policy §8 states "We’ve introduced a user control which allows you to object to the use of your input and output data for model training directly from your account.", and the §3 table lists "Your Input and Output, subject to your opt-out." Scope caveat: that Privacy Policy is written from the Controller side and its own Scope says it "does not apply if you use our Mistral AI Products to process personal data in the context of your business activities", so it is auxiliary support for the existence of the control only; the main basis for mode=opt_out remains ToS §4.2 exception (a) and the opt-out regime of DPA §2.3.
points.text_zh: 账户级存在训练 opt-out 开关:隐私政策 §8 写『We’ve introduced a user control which allows you to object to the use of your input and output data for model training directly from your account.』,§3 表格列出『Your Input and Output, subject to your opt-out.』。适用范围提示:该隐私政策是 Controller 视角,其 Scope 自述不适用于『以企业身份处理个人数据』的场景,所以只能作『存在该开关』的辅助佐证;mode=opt_out 的主依据仍是 ToS §4.2 例外 (a) 与 DPA §2.3 的 opt-out 制。
points.quote: We’ve introduced a user control which allows you to object to the use of your input and output data for model training directly from your account.

points.text: Help Center articles on data usage are a lead rather than evidence: they are not among this provider's registered sources and no snapshot of them exists in this repo. They say of Studio Pay-as-you-go only that "Customers retain full control over this processing and have the right to opt out at any time.", no longer stating that there is no training by default, while the Free mode paragraph on the same page says plainly "we may use your data (input and output) to train". This row's evidence chain is the contract layer above (ToS §4.1 / §4.2 / §4.3, DPA §2.3, §11.2), not these pages.
points.text_zh: Help Center 的数据使用说明只能算线索、不算证据:它们不在本 provider 登记的来源内,仓库里也没有快照。对 Studio Pay-as-you-go 只写『Customers retain full control over this processing and have the right to opt out at any time.』,不再声明默认不训练;同页 Free mode 段则明写『we may use your data (input and output) to train』。本行的证据链是上面的合同层(ToS §4.1 / §4.2 / §4.3、DPA §2.3、§11.2),不是这些页面。

points.text: Structured conclusion: the contract layer conflicts with itself (§4.2 says no training by default; DPA §2.3 authorizes processing for training purposes as Controller under an opt-out regime, and DPA §11.2 gives the DPA precedence), and the current Help Center no longer states a no-training default. Under the conservative assumption (✓ requires an explicit no-training commitment) the tier is recorded as mark=no (used for training) with mode=opt_out. Both clauses are kept side by side; no averaging. The opt-out lands in §4.2 exception (a)(ii) and in the opt-out regime of DPA §2.3.
points.text_zh: 结构化结论：合同层自相冲突（§4.2 默认不训练 vs DPA §2.3 授权以 Controller 身份为训练目的处理、opt-out 制，且 §11.2 冲突时 DPA 优先），现行 Help Center 又不再声明默认不训练。按保守假设（✓ 要求明确的不训练承诺）记 mark=no（会训练）+ mode=opt_out；两条官方文本并列保留，不取平均。退出机制落在 §4.2 例外 (a)(ii) 与 DPA §2.3 的 opt-out 制。

zdr.quote: ZDR is available on paid plans for supported stateless API calls.

points.text: Official developer documentation, ZDR page (current this round, 2026-09-21): "ZDR is available on paid plans for supported stateless API calls", and once enabled Mistral "does not store or log inputs and outputs for supported API requests" beyond what is needed to generate the output. It covers stateless endpoints such as /v1/chat/completions, /v1/fim/completions, /v1/embeddings, moderations, classifications, ocr and audio, and does not apply to stateful APIs or products (Agents, Batch, Conversations, Libraries, /v1/files, Vibe Work, Chat) or to Labs models. Application-based: a justification must be submitted to support, "We review each request and may approve or deny it.", and once approved it appears in Admin privacy settings
points.text_zh: 官方开发者文档 ZDR 页(本轮 2026-09-21 现行):ZDR 在付费计划上对受支持的无状态 API 调用可用,启用后 Mistral 不会为受支持的 API 请求存储或记录输入输出(超出生成输出所需)。覆盖 /v1/chat/completions、/v1/fim/completions、/v1/embeddings、moderations、classifications、ocr、audio 等无状态端点,不覆盖 stateful API 与产品(Agents、Batch、Conversations、Libraries、/v1/files、Vibe Work、Chat)与 Labs 模型。申请制:需向支持提交正当理由,逐案审核,可批准或拒绝,批准后出现在 Admin privacy settings

points.text: ZDR and training opt-out are two separate controls. Help Center 347612 (updated 2026-08-12) is stricter in wording: pay-as-you-go only (Free mode must first enable pay-as-you-go), stateless APIs only. At contract level, DPA §2.3 excludes abuse monitoring as a processing purpose "when zero data retention has been activated", so ZDR is recognized in the DPA.
points.text_zh: ZDR 与训练 opt-out 是两个独立控制。Help Center 347612(2026-08-12 更新)措辞更严:仅 pay-as-you-go(Free mode 需先开通按量付费)、仅无状态 API。合同层另有 DPA §2.3:滥用监测这一处理目的在『zero data retention has been activated』时被排除,即 ZDR 在 DPA 里被承认。

retention.quote: Except for specific APIs, we keep your Input and Output for the period necessary to generate the Output and then for thirty (30) rolling days to monitor abuse (unless zero data retention is activated).

points.text: Privacy Policy §5: "Except for specific APIs, we keep your Input and Output for the period necessary to generate the Output and then for thirty (30) rolling days to monitor abuse (unless zero data retention is activated)." Exception: with the Agents API, Input and Output are kept until the account is terminated
points.text_zh: Privacy Policy §5:除特定 API 外,Input / Output 在生成输出所需时间之后滚动保留 30 天用于滥用监测,除非启用 ZDR。例外:Agents API 的 Input / Output 保留至销户

points.text: With the Fine-Tuning API, fine-tuning data is kept until it is deleted or the account is terminated. DPA §10.1 separately provides that Personal Data will no longer be accessible upon expiry of a thirty (30) day period following termination (a termination-cleanup rule). The ZDR page and Help Center 347612 give the contrasting state once ZDR is enabled (no longer retained). Help Center 347628 adds statutory retention periods for account-level data (identity data 5 years, account data 1 year, technical data 1 rolling year, invoices 10 years), but that is account/billing data, not API inputs and outputs.
points.text_zh: Fine-Tuning API 的微调数据保留至主动删除或销户。DPA §10.1 另定终止后 30 天内 Personal Data 不再可访问(终止清理口径)。ZDR 页与 Help Center 347612 给出启用 ZDR 后的对照态(不再留存)。Help Center 347628 补充账户类数据的法定保留期(身份数据 5 年、账户数据 1 年、技术数据 1 滚动年、发票 10 年),但那是账号/账单数据而非 API 输入输出。

points.text: Contract layer for Personal Data processed as a Processor — DPA Exhibit 1 (Description of the Processing, incorporated into the Agreement by §11.2; contract outranks consumer_privacy in the global priority order) states the retention period as "the duration of the Agreement": "The period for which the personal data will be retained, or, if that is not possible, the criteria used to determine that period: the duration of the Agreement." The object differs from this row's headline figure: Exhibit 1 covers Personal Data (per DPA §1(f), Customer Data that is personal data and which Mistral AI processes as a Processor), not API input and output bodies. The two are kept side by side, not averaged: cleanup after termination is governed by DPA §10.1 (no longer accessible 30 days after termination), while API Input and Output bodies are governed by Privacy Policy §5 (30 rolling days).
points.text_zh: 以 Processor 身份处理的 Personal Data 的合同层口径——DPA Exhibit 1(Description of the Processing,经 §11.2 并入协议;按全局优先级 contract 高于 consumer_privacy)把保留期写作『the duration of the Agreement』:『The period for which the personal data will be retained, or, if that is not possible, the criteria used to determine that period: the duration of the Agreement.』对象与本行头条数字不同:Exhibit 1 讲的是 Personal Data(按 DPA §1(f) 定义,即客户数据中属个人数据、且 Mistral 以 Processor 身份处理的部分),不是 API 输入输出正文。两条口径并列保留、不取平均:终止后的清理由 DPA §10.1 管(终止后 30 天不再可访问),API 输入输出正文由隐私政策 §5 管(滚动 30 天)。
points.quote: The period for which the personal data will be retained, or, if that is not possible, the criteria used to determine that period: the duration of the Agreement.

processing_region.quote: Mistral does not commit to a specific inference location for requests sent to this endpoint.

points.text: Official developer documentation, Regional inference page (independently re-checked this round): the default global endpoint is api.mistral.ai, and Mistral states expressly that "Mistral does not commit to a specific inference location for requests sent to this endpoint"
points.text_zh: 官方开发者文档 Regional inference 页(本轮独立复核):默认 global 端点 api.mistral.ai,官方明确『Mistral does not commit to a specific inference location for requests sent to this endpoint』

points.text: Regional endpoints api.eu.mistral.ai (multiple data centers in EU and EFTA countries, 1.1x price) and api.us.mistral.ai (multiple data centers in the United States)
points.text_zh: 区域端点 api.eu.mistral.ai(EU 与 EFTA 多数据中心,加价 1.1×)与 api.us.mistral.ai(美国多数据中心)

points.text: Regionalization covers inference only; control-plane data (account configuration, API keys, billing, access management, usage analytics and other operational metadata) may still be handled by Mistral systems outside the selected geography
points.text_zh: 区域化只覆盖推理,控制面数据(账号配置、API key、账单、访问管理、用量分析等运营元数据)仍可能在所选地理之外处理

points.text: Regionalization and ZDR are two separate controls. Help Center 347629 (updated 2026-08-12) adds that data is hosted in the EU by default and in the United States where the US API endpoint is used explicitly, and that some features may temporarily transfer data outside the EU (destinations listed in the Trust Center subprocessors). DPA §8.1 is the contractual authorization for cross-border transfers (adequacy-decision countries / appropriate safeguards / SCCs). Note the difference between the two statements: the Help Center speaks of hosting (storage) being in the EU by default, while the docs speak of the global endpoint not committing to an inference location.
points.text_zh: 区域化与 ZDR 是两个独立控制。Help Center 347629(2026-08-12 更新)补充:默认数据托管在欧盟,显式使用 US API 端点则托管在美国,部分功能可能临时把数据传出欧盟(去向见 Trust Center subprocessors)。DPA §8.1 为跨境传输的合同授权(充分性认定国家 / 适当保障 / SCC)。注意两处口径差异:Help Center 说的是『托管(存储)默认在欧盟』,docs 说的是『global 端点不承诺推理处理地』。

points.text: Boundary of the regional-processing commitment (same page, Limitations section): "Regional endpoints have feature limitations. If a workload depends on an unsupported feature, the regional processing guarantees for that workload do not apply." The page adds that regional endpoints "only serve models hosted in that region", that function calling is the only supported regional tool, and that stateful features including Agents, Batch and the Files API are not available on regional endpoints. So the guarantee covers inference only, and only for models and features available in the target region — it is not a blanket promise that everything sent to an EU or US endpoint is processed there.
points.text_zh: 区域处理承诺的边界(同页 Limitations 段):『Regional endpoints have feature limitations. If a workload depends on an unsupported feature, the regional processing guarantees for that workload do not apply.』同页还写:区域端点只服务托管在该区域的模型;工具调用目前只支持 function calling;Agents、Batch、Files API 等 stateful 功能在区域端点不可用。因此该保证只覆盖推理,且只对目标区域已托管、受支持的模型与功能生效——不能理解成『发往 EU / US 端点的一切都在该地处理』。
points.quote: Regional endpoints have feature limitations. If a workload depends on an unsupported feature, the regional processing guarantees for that workload do not apply.

role.quote: Customer is the Controller of the Personal Data. Mistral AI Processes the Personal Data on behalf of Customer as a Processor.

points.text: DPA §2.1: "Customer is the Controller of the Personal Data. Mistral AI Processes the Personal Data on behalf of Customer as a Processor." (the DPA is incorporated into the Agreement by §11.2 and applies to commercial customers using the Products on Mistral AI Infrastructure). The role splits by data category: Commercial ToS §12.2 states that account-level Personal Data is collected and processed by Mistral AI as Data Controller (under its privacy policy), while §12.3 repeats the Processor role in the Mistral Infrastructure case and points to this DPA
points.text_zh: DPA §2.1:客户是 Personal Data 的 Controller,Mistral AI 以 Processor 身份代表客户处理(DPA 经 §11.2 并入协议,适用于在 Mistral AI Infrastructure 上使用产品的商业客户)。角色按数据类别分裂:Commercial ToS §12.2 明确账户类 Personal Data 由 Mistral AI 以 Data Controller 身份收集处理(依其隐私政策),§12.3 重申 Mistral Infrastructure 场景下的Processor 身份并指向本 DPA

points.text: DPA §2.3 lists the limited purposes for which Mistral may process as Controller (training, abuse monitoring, aggregated usage statistics). The general privacy policy's own Scope states that it "does not apply if you use our Mistral AI Products to process personal data in the context of your business activities" (in that case the customer is controller and Mistral the processor), consistent with this conclusion.
points.text_zh: DPA §2.3 列出 Mistral 以 Controller 身份可做的有限处理目的(训练、滥用监测、用量聚合统计)。通用隐私政策自身 Scope 明确不适用于『以企业身份处理个人数据』的场景(该场景客户是 controller、Mistral 是 processor),与本结论一致。

points.text: The instruction side of the Processor role, DPA §3.1: Mistral AI shall "Process the Personal Data only in accordance with the documented lawful instructions of Customer, including as set forth in this DPA or the Agreement". It sits alongside, not against, the Controller-purpose authorization in §2.3: the customer's documented instructions govern processing carried out on its behalf, while §2.3 lists the limited purposes for which Mistral may process the same Personal Data on its own account.
points.text_zh: Processor 身份的指示侧义务,DPA §3.1:Mistral AI 应『仅按客户书面合法指示处理 Personal Data,包括本 DPA 或协议中的指示』。它与 §2.3 的 Controller 用途授权并列而非对撞:客户指示管的是代客户执行的处理,§2.3 列的是 Mistral 为自身目的可做的有限处理。
points.quote: Process the Personal Data only in accordance with the documented lawful instructions of Customer, including as set forth in this DPA or the Agreement

points.text: A second self-limitation on the Processor side, DPA §12.2 (CCPA subsection, which per §12.1 applies only where the corresponding law applies to the processing): Mistral AI "shall not: (i) Process the Personal Data for a commercial purpose other than as necessary to provide the Mistral AI Products to Customer; (ii) “sell” or “share” (each as defined by the CCPA) any Personal Data; (iii) Process the Personal Data outside of the direct business relationship between Processor and Customer". It limits the purposes of Processor-role processing and sits alongside the Controller-purpose authorization in §2.3 — it neither overrides §2.3 nor is covered by it. Note that Commercial ToS §12.2 is a different clause in a different document and cannot stand in for this one.
points.text_zh: Processor 身份的第二层自我限制,DPA §12.2(CCPA 小节,按 §12.1 仅在对应法律适用时生效):Mistral AI『不得 (i) 除提供 Mistral AI Products 所必需外为商业目的处理 Personal Data;(ii) 出售或共享(按 CCPA 定义)任何 Personal Data;(iii) 在 Processor 与客户直接商业关系之外处理 Personal Data』。它限制的是 Processor 角色的处理目的,与 §2.3 的 Controller 用途授权并列——既不推翻 §2.3,也不被 §2.3 掩盖。注意 Commercial ToS §12.2 是另一份文件的另一条,不能顶替这一条。
points.quote: Mistral AI shall not: (i) Process the Personal Data for a commercial purpose other than as necessary to provide the Mistral AI Products to Customer; (ii) “sell” or “share” (each as defined by the CCPA) any Personal Data; (iii) Process the Personal Data outside of the direct business relationship between Processor and Customer

training.quote: Modal will not, except with Customer's prior written consent: (i) train any AI model using Customer Data, or (ii) export Customer Data into, or cause Customer Data to be ingested by, large language models.

points.text: Same as top-level training.
points.text_zh: 同顶层 training。

points.text: Same as endpoints-shared: zero retention on the payload path.
points.text_zh: 同 endpoints-shared：payload 路径零保留。

points.text: Request and response payloads are not stored ("Dedicated Endpoints, Shared Endpoints, and Servers do not store request and response payloads"), so the payload path carries no period at all.
points.text_zh: 请求与响应 payload 不存储（「Dedicated Endpoints, Shared Endpoints, and Servers do not store request and response payloads」），payload 路径本身没有任何期限。
points.quote: Dedicated Endpoints, Shared Endpoints, and Servers do not [store request and response payloads

points.text: The log periods are the unquantified item here: the security page row gives numbers only for the lower plans ("1 day on Starter, 30 days on Team") and says "configurable on Enterprise", while audit logs are "Per Enterprise contract". This tier is plan_level=enterprise, so the 30-day figure is the Team plan's number and the enterprise log and audit-log periods are set by contract with no public number. Metadata is stored for the lifetime of the account; customer-supplied weights and custom images live in Images and Volumes, which is durable storage (retained until the customer deletes them).
points.text_zh: 日志期限是本档的未量化项：security 页该行只给低档数字（「1 day on Starter, 30 days on Team」）并写「configurable on Enterprise」，审计日志为「Per Enterprise contract」。本档 plan_level=enterprise，故 30 天是 Team 档数字，企业档日志与审计日志期限由合同约定、公开文档无数字。元数据随账户存续；客户自带权重与自定义镜像存放在 Images/Volumes，属持久存储（客户删除前保留）。
points.quote: | App and container logs | [Functions](https://modal.com/docs/guide), [Sandboxes](https://modal.com/docs/guide/sandboxes) | Plan-dependent: 1 day on Starter, 30 days on Team, configurable on Enterprise

points.text: The contract layer sets no ceiling on retention: DPA Schedule 2 states "Modal retains data as long as the Modal has a need for its use, or to meet regulatory or contractual requirements. Once data is no longer needed, it is securely disposed of or archived." The object-level periods published on the security page are documentation-layer disclosures, not a contractual maximum.
points.text_zh: 合同层不设保留上限：DPA Schedule 2 写明「Modal retains data as long as the Modal has a need for its use, or to meet regulatory or contractual requirements. Once data is no longer needed, it is securely disposed of or archived.」。security 页公布的对象级期限是文档层披露，不是合同层上限。
points.quote: Modal retains data as long as the Modal has a need for its use, or to meet regulatory or contractual requirements. Once data is no longer needed, it is securely disposed of or archived.

points.text: Contract-layer carve-out that also touches training: §1.11 opens with "Notwithstanding anything to the contrary" and lets Modal "collect and use Service Metrics for its own business purposes during the term of this Agreement and thereafter". Service Metrics are defined as data used in an aggregate and/or permanently anonymized manner that does not identify an individual or Customer, with safeguards prohibiting re-identification, and they are not Customer Data — so the no-training and deletion promises are not absolute at the contract layer, but this carve-out does not reach Customer Data.
points.text_zh: 同时涉及 training 的合同层例外：§1.11 以「Notwithstanding anything to the contrary」开头，允许 Modal「collect and use Service Metrics for its own business purposes during the term of this Agreement and thereafter」。Service Metrics 定义为以聚合和/或永久匿名方式使用、不识别个人或客户、并有禁止再识别保障的数据，且不含 Customer Data——故合同层的不训练与删除承诺并非绝对，但该例外不及于 Customer Data。
points.quote: Customer acknowledges and agrees that Modal may collect and use Service Metrics for its own business purposes during the term of this Agreement and thereafter. "**Service Metrics**" means data and information related to Customer's or its Users' use of the Services that is used by Modal in an aggregate and/or permanently anonymized manner such that it does not identify an individual or Customer, and for which Modal has implemented technical safeguards and business processes to prohibit reidentification of such data

points.text: Kept alongside the processor characterisation: DPA Appendix 1 also incorporates SCC Module 1, "Transfer controller to controller ... apply where Modal Processes Personal Data as a Controller". That is a specific situation defined by the SCC annex (Modal and its Affiliates in non-adequacy approved third countries, Customer established in the EEA) and does not displace the processor characterisation for the service processing above.

training.quote: Modal will not, except with Customer's prior written consent: (i) train any AI model using Customer Data, or (ii) export Customer Data into, or cause Customer Data to be ingested by, large language models.

points.text: Same as top-level training. §5.5.1 states that the Input and Output of AI Tools are Customer Data, so this tier's prompts and completions fall within the protection of §5.5.4, "will not train any AI model using Customer Data"

points.text: §5.5.3 further states that subcontractors processing Customer Data in order to provide AI Tools are on the subprocessor list. No clause was found that allows Modal to use inference requests to train models.
points.text_zh: §5.5.3 另说明为提供 AI Tools 而处理 Customer Data 的分包商在 subprocessor 名单上。未发现任何条款允许 Modal 用推理请求训练模型。

points.text: Tier boundary not verified: this product is plan_level=any and therefore includes the free Starter tier, while §1.2 states that "No-Fee Use may be subject to certain additional restrictions, limitations and differing terms all as specified in the corresponding No-Fee Use Limitations." "**Service Metrics**" means data and information related to Customer's or its Users' use of the Services that is used by Modal in an aggregate and/or permanently anonymized manner such that it does not identify an individual or Customer, and for which Modal has implemented technical safeguards and business processes to prohibit reidentification of such data

processing_region.quote: * _Shared Endpoints route through `us-west`, and containers are distributed across Modal’s global compute pool._

points.text: The data-residency page: for Shared Endpoints, neither the container region nor the routing region is selectable

points.text: Footnote: "Shared Endpoints route through us-west, and containers are distributed across Modal’s global compute pool" — routing is fixed to us-west, but the containers that process the workload are spread over Modal's global compute pool, so processing is not confined to the United States. Logs and durable storage (Images, Volumes, Dicts, Queues, Secrets) do stay in the United States.

points.text: The shared-endpoints page is to the same effect. So neither the container region nor the routing region is selectable on this tier, and customers with hard data residency requirements must switch to Dedicated Endpoints.
points.text_zh: shared-endpoints 页同旨。即本档容器区域与路由区域均不可选，对数据驻留有硬要求的客户须改用 Dedicated Endpoints。

role.quote: Modal shall act as a Service Provider to Customer and shall collect, access, maintain, use, process, and transfer Customer Personal Data solely for the purpose of performing Modal's obligations under this Agreement for or on behalf of Customer and for no commercial purpose other than the performance of such obligations.

points.text: Same as top-level role. The operator of this tier is Modal itself (Modal hosts the compute pool and Modal bills), with no "third-party technical support provider" style resale layer
points.text_zh: 同顶层 role。本档的运营主体是 Modal 自己（Modal 托管算力池、Modal 计费），不存在「第三方技术支持商」式的转售层

points.text: Whether requests are forwarded to the original model vendor is disclosed neither in the documentation nor in the subprocessor list (which holds only cloud hosting providers and logging/monitoring/data-warehouse vendors). This is the unverified item for role on this tier.

points.text: Kept alongside the processor characterisation: DPA Appendix 1 also incorporates SCC Module 1, "Transfer controller to controller ... apply where Modal Processes Personal Data as a Controller". That is a specific situation defined by the SCC annex (Modal and its Affiliates in non-adequacy approved third countries, Customer established in the EEA) and does not displace the processor characterisation for the service processing above.

training.quote: Modal will not, except with Customer's prior written consent: (i) train any AI model using Customer Data, or (ii) export Customer Data into, or cause Customer Data to be ingested by, large language models.

points.text: Same as top-level training. The difference on the enterprise tier is that the §5.5.4 exception, "Customer's prior written consent", can be extended through a Service Order or a separate written authorization — that is, an arrangement of the form "may be used for training with written consent" is more likely to arise on the enterprise tier, but the public terms disclose no authorization that is on by default.

points.text: The other objects are documented object by object and are not undisclosed: request and response payloads for Server and Auto Endpoints are "Not stored — proxied directly to your container"; app, function and container metadata is "Stored for the lifetime of your account"; Volumes and Images are "Persistent until you delete them"; memory snapshots 7 days after creation; filesystem and directory snapshots 30 days after creation (configurable); Dict entries 7 days after last read or write; Queue partitions have a configurable per-partition TTL (default 24 hours).

points.text: The Data privacy section of the security page separately commits that Modal will never access or use your source code, the inputs and outputs of your Modal Functions, or any data you store in Images or Volumes. That absolute wording is qualified at the contract layer by §5.3, which requires safeguards preventing access, use, modification or disclosure of Customer Data by Modal personnel "except: (a) to provide the Service and to prevent or address service or technical problems, or (b) as Customer expressly permits in writing" — so "never access or use" is not an unlimited commitment. A customer running their own training job on this tier is the customer's own act and does not change this conclusion.

points.text: China-site conclusion: no explicit "not used for training" commitment exists, and one clause counts the other way — Privacy Policy §2.6.1 states that the support-channel records it collects are used "to improve the service", which this ledger's rule ("used to improve the service / improve quality" counts as training) records as mark=no with mode=not_disclosed. There is still no admission that "the platform uses API inputs/outputs to train or optimize models", and the absence of such an admission must not be read as the presence of a commitment. Checked: the full text of both China-site agreements (User Agreement 2025-08-27, Privacy Policy 2024-06-05) plus every policy-type document on the docs site (content compliance review, AI ethics initiative, the three API-Inference pages, the Magicube credit system, FlexTrain, deployment introduction). The word "training" appears in only three places on the China site, none of them about the platform training on user data: (1) User Agreement §4.1(8) "in order to improve your experience, this community may provide you with a certain amount of free computing resources, which you may use for model training and other related development activities" — this is **the user training their own model on the platform's free compute** (with a requirement to credit "this model was trained with technical support from the ModelScope community"), the opposite direction from "the platform trains on your data"
points.text_zh: 中国站结论：没有「不用于训练」的明确承诺，且有一条反向口径——隐私政策 §2.6.1 把客服渠道收集的记录写明「用于改进服务」，按本台账口径（「用来改进服务/提高质量」算训练）记 mark=no、mode=not_disclosed。仍然没有「平台使用 API 输入/输出训练或优化模型」的自认——不得把「没有承诺」当成「有自认」来解读。原绑的 §3.2.1 授权清单只界定用户内容许可的范围（列举托管、存储、传输、公开展示等，未含模型训练），它既未授权也未排除平台训练，不构成对本维度的表述，已撤锚；查阅范围见 searched。核过中国站两份协议全文（用户协议 2025-08-27、隐私政策 2024-06-05）+ docs 站全部政策类文档（内容合规审查、AI 伦理倡议书、API-Inference 三页、魔粒体系、FlexTrain、部署简介）。「训练」一词在中国站的分布只有三类，全部与平台使用用户数据训练无关：(1) 用户协议 §4.1(8)「为提升您的使用体验，本社区可能为您提供一定额度的免费计算资源，您可将其用于模型训练等相关开发活动」——这是**用户用平台免费算力训练自己的模型**（并要求标注「本模型训练获得魔搭社区技术支持」），方向与「平台拿你的数据训练」相反

points.text: (2) Privacy Policy §2.4.2 "to try out online model debugging, training and deployment, you may choose to bind an Alibaba Cloud account" — a user-side feature entry point
points.text_zh: (2) 隐私政策 §2.4.2「为体验模型在线调试、训练及部署能力，您可选择绑定阿里云账号」——是用户侧功能入口

points.text: (3) User Agreement §4.2.1(2), the compliance obligation of Studio creators for "management of training data and generated content" — the obligation falls on the creator. Two further clauses bearing on this dimension: Privacy Policy §2.3.2, which limits the purpose of collecting "the text, voice, images and video you input, reply with or generate" to "providing you with those services" and adds that the platform "has the right to display your nickname, avatar and published content"
points.text_zh: (3) 用户协议 §4.2.1(2) 创空间创建者的「训练数据与生成内容管理」合规义务——义务落在创建者身上。另两条与本维度相关的条款：隐私政策 §2.3.2 把「您输入、回复、生成的文字、语音、图片、视频」收集目的限定为「为向您提供该等服务」并「有权展示您的昵称、头像和发布内容」

points.text: Privacy Policy §2.6.1 is the only China-site clause that carries a data object and says the information is used "to improve the service": "When you request support or help from us through the customer-service channels we provide, you need to provide us with a description of the problem, and we will also need to collect your enquiry records, fault-report records and the troubleshooting process for your fault (such as **conversation or call recordings**); we will record and analyse this information so as to respond to your help request more promptly, and to improve the service." Under this ledger's rule that "used to improve the service / improve quality" counts as training, this is the basis for mark=no (mode=not_disclosed): the clause does not name model training, but it does not exclude it either, so a "not used for training" reading cannot be maintained. Scope limit to keep in view: the object is support-channel records (enquiry records, fault reports, troubleshooting process, conversation or call recordings) — **not API inference inputs/outputs** — so it does not show that inference request content is used for training; it is also narrower than the international site's Privacy Policy §6, which authorises product improvement over Personal Data generally.
points.text_zh: 隐私政策 §2.6.1 是中国站唯一一条带数据对象的「用于改进服务」表述：「当您通过我们提供的客服渠道请求我们支持或帮助时，您需要向我们提供问题描述，同时我们会需要收集您的咨询记录、报障记录和针对用户故障的排障过程（如**对话或通话记录**），我们将通过记录、分析这些信息以便更及时响应您的帮助请求，以及用于改进服务。」按本台账口径（「用来改进服务/提高质量」算训练），这是 mark=no（mode=not_disclosed）的依据：该条没有点名模型训练，但也没有把模型训练排除在外，故不能维持「不用于训练」的读法。需保留的限定：对象是客服渠道记录（咨询记录、报障记录、排障过程、对话或通话记录），**不是 API 推理输入/输出**，因此它不证明推理请求内容被用于训练；它也比国际站隐私政策 §6（对 Personal Data 的概括性产品改进授权）更窄。
points.quote: 同时我们会需要收集您的咨询记录、报障记录和针对用户故障的排障过程（如**对话或通话记录**），我们将通过记录、分析这些信息以便更及时响应您的帮助请求，以及用于改进服务

points.text: The license list in User Agreement §3.2.1 is to host, store, transmit, publicly display, publicly perform, communicate to the public, reproduce, create derivative works and distribute, and **does not include model training or model optimization**. Two clauses pulling the other way must be recorded alongside: User Agreement §3.2.1(2) says plainly that "we may access or share your private user content in accordance with what is set out in our privacy policy", and §4.1(2) reserves the right to review user content (including Demo inputs, see the content compliance review document) by technical or human means. Uncertainties: (a) the privacy policy gives no affirmative "not used for training without explicit authorization" commitment of the kind PPIO gives, and no switch for any training purpose
points.text_zh: 用户协议 §3.2.1 的授权清单是托管、存储、传输、公开展示、公开表演、向公众传播、复制、创建衍生作品、分发，**不含模型训练/模型优化**。另有两条反向张力的条款须并列：用户协议 §3.2.1(2) 明说「我们可能会根据我们的隐私政策中规定的内容访问或分享您的私有用户内容」，§4.1(2) 保留对用户内容（含 Demo 输入，见内容合规审查文档）的技术或人工审核权。不确定性：(a) 隐私政策没有像 PPIO 那样给出「未经明确授权不用于训练」的正面承诺，也没有给出任何训练用途的选项开关

points.text: (b) On the API-Inference path, the public documentation says only that "compute is provided by Alibaba Cloud", and whether Alibaba Cloud retains or trains on inputs and outputs is not disclosed in this vendor's documents
points.text_zh: (b) API-Inference 的推理链路上，公开文档只写「由阿里云提供算力支持」，阿里云侧对输入输出是否留存/训练未在本家文档披露

points.text_zh: (c) 本结论只覆盖中国站

points.text_zh: 国际站另有独立结论。

points.text: Removed anchor: §3.2.1(2) "we will use reasonable and appropriate measures to keep your content confidential ... however, we may access or share your private user content as provided in our privacy policy" is a confidentiality clause with a carve-out, not a statement about zero retention; it neither promises nor denies ZDR, so it is not a statement on this dimension. Search scope is recorded in searched.
points.text_zh: 已撤锚：§3.2.1(2)「我们将使用合理和适当的措施来保密您的内容……然而，我们可能会根据我们的隐私政策中规定的内容访问或分享您的私有用户内容」是保密义务条款加例外口子，不是关于零保留的表述——既不承诺也不否认 ZDR，故不构成对本维度的表述。查阅范围见 searched。

points.text: China-site conclusion: no zero data retention (ZDR) commitment, switch or application path exists in any public document. Scope checked: User Agreement, Privacy Policy, content compliance review, AI ethics initiative, API-Inference usage limits / introduction / API-Provider, the Magicube credit system, FlexTrain, deployment introduction, the two stable protocol entry points (SPAs whose body r.jina.ai cannot fetch and whose direct HTML has no embedded body), and the official document version API. The keywords "zero data retention / zero retention / not stored / not written to disk / not retained / deleted once the request is processed" return zero hits in the full text of both agreements (and zero hits in the two English international-site documents). Three observations that are incompatible with, or at least do not support, ZDR (not equivalent to "the vendor refuses ZDR"): (1) User Agreement §3.2.1 grants an "irrevocable" license to host, store and distribute content, and §3.2.1(2) states expressly that private user content may be accessed
points.text_zh: 中国站结论：全部公开文档中不存在零数据保留（ZDR）承诺、开关或申请入口。核过的范围：用户协议、隐私政策、内容合规审查、AI 伦理倡议书、API-Inference 使用限制/介绍/API-Provider、魔粒体系、FlexTrain、部署简介、两个 protocol 稳定入口（SPA，r.jina.ai 抓不到正文，直连 HTML 亦无内嵌正文）、官方文档版本 API。关键词「零数据保留 / 零保留 / 不存储 / 不落盘 / 不留存 / 请求处理完成后删除 / zero retention」在两份协议全文零命中（国际站英文两份亦零命中）。三条与 ZDR 相斥或至少不支持的观察（不等价于「厂商拒绝 ZDR」）：(1) 用户协议 §3.2.1 给出「不可撤销」的内容托管/存储/分发授权，§3.2.1(2) 明确可能访问私有用户内容

points.text: (2) Privacy Policy §6.2 sets a "period necessary for the purpose", not per-request immediate deletion
points.text_zh: (2) 隐私政策 §6.2 是「目的所需期限」而非请求级即时删除

points.text: (3) The content compliance review document states that the platform reviews "the input of model Demos" by technical or human means — review means the input can be accessed on the platform's side. Recorded as not_found under the ledger's rules: the absence of public evidence is not the same as the vendor not offering ZDR
points.text_zh: (3) 内容合规审查文档说明平台会对「模型Demo的输入」做技术或人工审核——审核意味着输入在平台侧可被接触。按台账规则记 not_found：拿不到公开证据 ≠ 厂商不提供 ZDR

points.text: This vendor has no enterprise privacy FAQ, no public DPA and no trust/security compliance page to check (no document of that kind exists in the full enumeration of the docs site index).

retention.quote: 我们只会在达成本政策所述目的所需的期限内保留您的用户信息，除非受到法律的允许

points.text: China-site conclusion: no quantified retention period, only the principle of "the period necessary for the purpose + deletion or anonymization once exceeded", with an express acknowledgement of delayed deletion from backups. Objects and context, itemized: **Object** — Privacy Policy §2.3.1 brings "the text, voice, images and video you input, reply with or generate" within user content, and the appendix further lists "conversation content" as part of "log information" ("including time, user ID, conversation ID, conversation content, as well as IP address, browser type, telecom carrier, language, and date and time of access"), so on the China site inference interaction content and access logs are covered by the same "user information / personal information" regime and the documents do not regulate them separately. **Period** — §6.2 "we retain your user information only for the period necessary to achieve the purposes stated in this policy, unless permitted by law. Once that retention period is exceeded, we will delete or anonymize your personal information" (ceiling-type, unquantified, a statement of principle rather than a verifiable number of days). **Exceptions and triggers** — (1) §4.3.3 delayed deletion from backups: "because of applicable law and security-technology limits, we may not be able to delete the corresponding information from backup systems immediately ... until the backup can be cleared or anonymized"
points.text_zh: 中国站结论：没有量化保留期限，只有「目的所需期限 + 超期删除或匿名化」的原则，且明确承认备份延迟删除。对象与语境逐条列清：**对象**——隐私政策 §2.3.1 把「您输入、回复、生成的文字、语音、图片、视频」纳入用户内容，附录又把「对话内容」列为「日志信息」的组成部分（「包括时间、用户ID、对话ID、对话内容，以及IP地址、浏览器类型、电信运营商、使用语言、访问日期和时间」），即推理交互内容与访问日志在中国站是被同一套「用户信息/个人信息」口径覆盖的，文档没有把二者分开规定。**期限**——§6.2「我们只会在达成本政策所述目的所需的期限内保留您的用户信息，除非受到法律的允许。超出上述用户信息保存期限后，我们会对您的个人信息进行删除或匿名化处理」（上限型、未量化；属原则性表述，不是可核对的天数）。**例外与触发点**——(1) §4.3.3 备份延迟删除：「因为适用的法律和安全技术限制，我们可能无法立即从备份系统中删除相应的信息……直到备份可以清除或实现匿名化」

points.text: (2) §4.5.2 deletion after account cancellation, "except where laws, regulations or industry supervisory rules provide otherwise"
points.text_zh: (2) §4.5.2 注销后删除「但法律法规或行业监管规则另有规定的除外」

points.text: (3) §6.5 deletion or anonymization of personal information held when operations cease
points.text_zh: (3) §6.5 停止运营时对持有个人信息删除或匿名化

points.text: (4) User Agreement §9.2.1 "once the feature is withdrawn, your right to use this community terminates immediately and any information you have stored in this community may be unrecoverable" — no retention is promised when a free feature is withdrawn
points.text_zh: (4) 用户协议 §9.2.1「一旦功能取消，您使用本社区的权利立即终止，您在本社区中储存的任何信息可能无法恢复」——免费功能取消不承诺保留

points.text: (5) User Agreement §3.4.1(3) legal-preservation permission: where the user fails to comply with statutory obligations (the context is the labelling duty for generated synthetic content), "we have the right to preserve the relevant records in accordance with the law and report to the Cyberspace Administration and the relevant competent authorities". It fixes no period, and the object is the records related to the breach — it is a permission to keep, not a retention period and not a floor, so no number of days may be derived from it.
points.text_zh: (5) 用户协议 §3.4.1(3) 法定保存许可：用户未遵守相关法定义务时（语境是生成合成内容的标识义务）「我们有权依法保存有关记录，并向网信部门和有关主管部门报告」。它没有期限，对象是违规相关的记录——是保存许可，不是保留期限、也不是下限，不能据此推任何天数。

points.text_zh: 也没有国内站常见的「相关网络日志不少于六个月」下限表述——魔搭中国站两份协议全文都没有出现该表述，因此不能按其他国内厂商的口径套用。不确定性：免费档 API-Inference 的调用日志实际保留多久，官方未披露。

processing_region.quote: 原则上，我们在中华人民共和国境内开展业务过程中产生或收集的个人信息，将存储在中华人民共和国境内

points.text: China-site conclusion: personal information generated by the community service is, in principle, stored within China. Privacy Policy §6.6: "In principle, personal information generated or collected in the course of our business within the People's Republic of China is stored within the People's Republic of China; unless it is necessary to provide you with a service, in which case we will transfer your personal information abroad only after obtaining your separate consent and taking the other measures required by laws and regulations"
points.text_zh: 中国站结论：社区服务产生的个人信息原则上境内存储。隐私政策 §6.6「原则上，我们在中华人民共和国境内开展业务过程中产生或收集的个人信息，将存储在中华人民共和国境内；除非为向您提供某项服务所必需，我们会在获得您单独同意，并采取其他法律法规要求的措施下，方会向境外传输您的个人信息」

points.text: User Agreement §10.2 adds that "this community is intended for users in mainland China, and we do not warrant that the service is suitable or available for access or use outside mainland China". Three pieces of circumstantial support on the compute and account side (same direction, but product-implementation descriptions rather than regional commitments): the API-Inference usage limits document says "the free inference API is backed by compute provided by Alibaba Cloud" and requires "binding an Alibaba Cloud account" with real-name verification

role.quote: 我们可能委托授权合作伙伴（如技术服务方、授权合作伙伴等）处理您的个人信息，以便授权合作伙伴代表我们为您提供某些服务或履行职能

points.text: China-site conclusion: for the community service the platform designates itself a personal information handler (the independent-controller side), while also calling itself a "neutral platform" at the agreement level; both statements are recorded side by side and not reconciled. Supporting the handler side: the privacy policy opens by positioning "Shanghai ModelScope Technology Co., Ltd. as the operator of the ModelScope community"; §2.3.2 determines the purpose of collecting user content itself ("in order to provide you with those services ... and we have the right to display your nickname, avatar and published content"); §3.1 is an entrusting-party clause for engaging others ("we may entrust authorized partners (such as technical service providers and authorized partners) to process your personal information ... we will only entrust them to process your information for the lawful, legitimate, necessary, specific and explicit purposes stated in this policy" — ModelScope is the entrusting party, the partner the entrusted party); and §3.2 makes "your explicit consent" the rule for external sharing. Supporting the neutral-platform side: User Agreement §4.1(6) "as a neutral open-source community service provider"
points.text_zh: 中国站结论：平台对社区服务自认个人信息处理者（独立控制者一侧），同时在协议层面自称「中立平台」，两处表述并列记录、不调和。支持处理者一侧：隐私政策开篇以「上海魔搭科技有限公司作为魔搭社区的运营方」自我定位，§2.3.2 自行决定收集用户内容的目的（「为向您提供该等服务……并有权展示您的昵称、头像和发布内容」），§3.1 是委托他人处理时的委托方条款（「我们可能委托授权合作伙伴（如技术服务方、授权合作伙伴等）处理您的个人信息……我们仅会出于本政策声明的合法、正当、必要、特定、明确的目的委托其处理您的信息」——即魔搭是委托方，合作方是受托方），§3.2 对外共享以「获得您明确同意」为原则。支持中立平台一侧：用户协议 §4.1(6)「我们作为中立性开源社区服务提供方」

points.text: §4.2.1(3) / §4.2.2(3) describe the platform in the Studio scenario as "merely a technical platform providing free code hosting and limited trial compute resources", and place deep-synthesis and generative-AI compliance obligations on the Studio creator (§4.2.1(2)). Tension the other way: §3.2.1(2) admits that "we may access or share your private user content in accordance with what is set out in our privacy policy", and §4.1(2) reserves the right to review and delete user content and Demo inputs. **Key gap**: who acts as entrusted processor on the API-Inference path is not disclosed anywhere in the public documents — there are only technical statements such as "bind an Alibaba Cloud account" and "compute provided by Alibaba Cloud", and the China site has no list of third parties information is shared with (PPIO, by contrast, has a dedicated list page), so whether Alibaba Cloud is an entrusted party or an independent handler on the inference path cannot be answered from this vendor's documents. That is also why confidence for this dimension is only medium. The role conclusion differs between the China site and the international site: international terms §9 states expressly that "any processing of personal data submitted through ModelScope.AI is for your purposes and on your behalf only" (processor wording), see the intl row under products.
points.text_zh: §4.2.1(3)/§4.2.2(3) 在创空间场景自称「仅作为免费提供代码托管、有限的体验试用计算资源等技术平台」，并明确深度合成/生成式 AI 的合规义务由创空间创建者承担（§4.2.1(2)）。反向张力：§3.2.1(2) 承认「我们可能会根据我们的隐私政策中规定的内容访问或分享您的私有用户内容」，§4.1(2) 保留对用户内容与 Demo 输入的审核删除权。**关键缺口**：API-Inference 推理链路上谁是受托处理方，公开文档完全没有披露——只有「绑定阿里云账号」「由阿里云提供算力支持」这类技术表述，且中国站没有第三方信息共享清单（对比 PPIO 有专门的清单页），因此「阿里云在推理链路上是受托方还是独立控制者」在本家文档中无解。这也是本维度置信度只给 medium 的原因。中国站与国际站的 role 结论不同：国际站 terms §9 明文「any processing of personal data submitted through ModelScope.AI is for your purposes and on your behalf only」（受托方口径），见 products 的 intl 行。

training.quote: using and storing User Content that is not personal data to develop and improve our machine-learning and artificial-intelligence technologies

points.text: International-site conclusion: the contract itself carries the platform's own-use authorisation, so the "nothing found" reading no longer holds. Terms §3.5: "we may process any User Content to improve our services and/or develop new products and services (including without limitation for our internal business purposes and/or for other customers). You hereby expressly authorise and consent to us: (i) using and storing User Content that is not personal data to develop and improve our machine-learning and artificial-intelligence technologies; and (ii) processing and storing such User Content outside of the jurisdiction where you are using ModelScope.AI". Two limits must be kept when reading it: the wording is "develop and improve … machine-learning and artificial-intelligence technologies", not "train models", and the express authorisation in (i) is confined to User Content **that is not personal data**. It is nevertheless contract-level, which outranks the privacy policy in this ledger's order of authority, so it is the primary evidence for this row. The user content license in international Terms §3.2 is worded "to access, use, host, modify, communicate, reproduce, adapt, make derivative works of, publish, perform, and/or distribute any User Content" — "use" is broad, but training or model training never appears anywhere as a platform purpose
points.text_zh: 国际站结论：合同层自带平台自我使用的授权，「全文没有」的读法不再成立。Terms §3.5「we may process any User Content to improve our services and/or develop new products and services (including without limitation for our internal business purposes and/or for other customers). You hereby expressly authorise and consent to us: (i) using and storing User Content that is not personal data to develop and improve our machine-learning and artificial-intelligence technologies; and (ii) processing and storing such User Content outside of the jurisdiction where you are using ModelScope.AI」。读这条要保留两个限定：措辞是「develop and improve … machine-learning and artificial-intelligence technologies」而非「train models」；(i) 的明示授权只限**非个人数据**的 User Content。但它属合同层，在本台账的权威顺序里高于隐私政策，故为本行主证据。国际站 Terms §3.2 的用户内容许可措辞是「to access, use, host, modify, communicate, reproduce, adapt, make derivative works of, publish, perform, and/or distribute any User Content」——「use」很宽泛但全文没有出现 training 或 model training 作为平台用途
points.quote: we may process any User Content to improve our services and/or develop new products and services (including without limitation for our internal business purposes and/or for other customers)

points.text: §3.11's "free computing resources for model training" matches China-site §4.1(8): users training their own models. The privacy-policy counterpart is the legitimate-interest basis in §6, "for improving our products, services, processes or business, understanding customer preferences and personalising experiences and recommendations" — a general product-improvement authorization that does not name training and rests on legitimate interests rather than the user's express grant. §6 also carries an IPR clause stating that "trained/upgraded models, output, analytics results … shall be solely and absolutely owned by us", which is an ownership clause and not an admission of using inputs for training. Uncertainty: the international site has no separate API terms, and whether model inference request content is used for training is not answered in the public texts.
points.text_zh: §3.11 的「free computing resources for model training」与中国站 §4.1(8) 同旨，是用户自己训练模型。隐私政策一侧的对应条款是 §6 基于合法利益的「for improving our products, services, processes or business, understanding customer preferences and personalising experiences and recommendations」——这是「改进产品」的概括授权，未点名训练，且属合法利益基础而非用户明示授权。另有 §6 IPR 条款声明「trained/upgraded models, output, analytics results … shall be solely and absolutely owned by us」，是成果归属条款，不构成「使用输入训练」的自认。不确定性：国际站没有面向 API 的单独条款，模型推理请求内容是否被训练在公开文本中无答案。结构化结论：本档按口径「厂商写『用于提高质量/改进服务』而不提训练即按会训练算」记 mark=no——该句是平台自我使用用户数据的概括授权，未把模型训练排除在外。
points.quote: for improving our products, services, processes or business, understanding customer preferences and personalising experiences and recommendations

points.text: Terms §3.5 also covers usage-side telemetry: "we may collect performance and usage metrics and data regarding your access and/or use of ModelScope.AI, including model versions, inferences, upload times, as well as processing, diagnostic and other data, and we may use such metrics and data to improve the quality and other aspects of ModelScope.AI and its underlying technologies". Object limit: these are metrics and data about your access and/or use of ModelScope.AI (model versions, inference records, upload times, processing and diagnostic data) — **not the body of your requests**. It is same-direction support for mark=no (the platform uses data generated by your use to improve itself and its underlying technologies), and it must not be read as direct evidence that request content is retained or used for training.
points.text_zh: Terms §3.5 另覆盖使用侧遥测：「we may collect performance and usage metrics and data regarding your access and/or use of ModelScope.AI, including model versions, inferences, upload times, as well as processing, diagnostic and other data, and we may use such metrics and data to improve the quality and other aspects of ModelScope.AI and its underlying technologies」。对象限定：这是关于你访问/使用情况的度量与数据（模型版本、inferences 记录、上传时间、处理与诊断数据），**不是请求正文**。它同向支持 mark=no（平台用你的使用所产生的数据改进自身及其底层技术），但不能读成「请求正文被留存或被用于训练」的直接证据。
points.quote: we may collect performance and usage metrics and data regarding your access and/or use of ModelScope.AI, including model versions, inferences, upload times, as well as processing, diagnostic and other data, and we may use such metrics and data to improve the quality and other aspects of ModelScope.AI and its underlying technologies

points.text: International-site conclusion: neither the Terms nor the Privacy Policy contains a zero data retention / zero retention / not-stored-after-the-request commitment, switch or application method (the keywords zero, retention and retain return zero hits in the Terms, and in the Privacy Policy appear only in an unrelated reservation-of-rights context). The international site has no public DPA and no trust/compliance page. Recorded as not_found under the rules, and not read in reverse as "the vendor refuses ZDR".
points.text_zh: 国际站结论：Terms 与 Privacy Policy 全文均无 zero data retention / 零保留 / 请求完成后不存储 的承诺、开关或申请方式（关键词 zero、retention、retain 在 Terms 中零命中，Privacy Policy 中仅出现于无关的权利保留语境）。国际站没有公开的 DPA、没有 trust/compliance 页。按规则记 not_found，不反向解读为「厂商拒绝 ZDR」。

retention.quote: Your use of ModelScope.AI may result in data provided to or stored by us being removed or rendered inaccessible from time to time, even if not marked for deletion or destruction by you

points.text: International-site conclusion: no retention period is laid down at all; the only relevant provision is a disclaimer-style "data may be removed". Terms §8: "Whether or not we make available backup services or tools from time to time (this being at our sole and absolute discretion), it is your sole responsibility to take appropriate measures to backup copies of data that you require. Your use of ModelScope.AI may result in data provided to or stored by us being removed or rendered inaccessible from time to time, even if not marked for deletion or destruction by you" — backup and data continuity are placed entirely on the user
points.text_zh: 国际站结论：没有任何保留期限规定，唯一相关的是一条免责式的「数据可能被移除」。Terms §8「Whether or not we make available backup services or tools from time to time (this being at our sole and absolute discretion), it is your sole responsibility to take appropriate measures to backup copies of data that you require. Your use of ModelScope.AI may result in data provided to or stored by us being removed or rendered inaccessible from time to time, even if not marked for deletion or destruction by you」——把备份与数据存续责任完全推给用户

points.text: §7 reserves the right to remove "any content stored on any systems associated with ModelScope.AI" at any time. The Privacy Policy has no retention clause at all (only the §7 cookies wording "we shall retain all rights, title and interest in … analytics data", a reservation of rights unrelated to retention periods). Recorded as duration_kind=unspecified: neither a ceiling nor a floor. Uncertainty: whether international-site inference request logs are kept, and for how long, is not disclosed.
points.text_zh: §7 保留随时移除「any content stored on any systems associated with ModelScope.AI」的权利。Privacy Policy 全文没有 retention/retain 条款（只有 §7 cookies 的「we shall retain all rights, title and interest in … analytics data」这种权利保留表述，与保留期限无关）。结论按 duration_kind=unspecified 记录：既无上限也无下限。不确定性：国际站的推理请求日志是否留存、留存多久，公开文档未披露。

points.text: Terms §3.5 also grants an express storage right, but its object is limited and it fixes no period: the user "expressly authorise[s] and consent[s] to us: (i) using and storing User Content that is not personal data to develop and improve our machine-learning and artificial-intelligence technologies; and (ii) processing and storing such User Content outside of the jurisdiction where you are using ModelScope.AI". Two limits to keep: the object is User Content **that is not personal data** (so it is not an authorisation to store personal data), and it is a permission to store rather than a retention period — no number of days can be derived from it.
points.text_zh: Terms §3.5 另给出一项明示的存储授权，但对象有限、也不含期限：用户「expressly authorise[s] and consent[s] to us: (i) using and storing User Content that is not personal data to develop and improve our machine-learning and artificial-intelligence technologies; and (ii) processing and storing such User Content outside of the jurisdiction where you are using ModelScope.AI」。两点限定要保留：对象是**非个人数据**的 User Content（不构成对个人数据存储的授权），且它是存储许可而非保留期限——不能由此推出任何天数。
points.quote: using and storing User Content that is not personal data to develop and improve our machine-learning and artificial-intelligence technologies

processing_region.quote: processing and storing such User Content outside of the jurisdiction where you are using ModelScope.AI

points.text: International-site conclusion: no specific region is named. The privacy policy has no storage-location clause at all, and the contract touches on the location of processing only negatively — Terms §3.5 has the user "expressly authorise and consent to us: … (ii) processing and storing such User Content outside of the jurisdiction where you are using ModelScope.AI", i.e. all that is disclosed is that processing and storage may take place outside the jurisdiction where the user is using ModelScope.AI; no country or region is committed to. The only usable circumstantial evidence is the operating entity and the governing law: the Privacy Policy opens with "Alibaba Cloud (Singapore) Private Limited and its related corporations", the DPO's mailing address is at Times Square, Causeway Bay, Hong Kong, and §11 provides that it "shall be governed by the laws of the Republic of Singapore"
points.text_zh: 国际站结论：没有指名任何具体地域。隐私政策没有存储地域条款，合同层只从反面涉及处理地——Terms §3.5 要求用户「expressly authorise and consent to us: … (ii) processing and storing such User Content outside of the jurisdiction where you are using ModelScope.AI」，即厂商只披露处理与存储可能发生在用户所在司法辖区之外，未承诺任何国家或地域。可用的旁证只有运营主体与法律适用：Privacy Policy 开篇主体为「Alibaba Cloud (Singapore) Private Limited and its related corporations」，DPO 通信地址在香港铜锣湾时代广场，§11「shall be governed by the laws of the Republic of Singapore」

points.text: §4 says expressly that personal data may be provided to "our related corporations; analytics, search engine providers or other third party service providers …", "whether they are located overseas or in Singapore" — the document only states that disclosure abroad is possible and promises no particular region for the data. Where the entity sits is not where the data is processed, so this is recorded faithfully as not_found rather than filled in as Singapore.
points.text_zh: §4 明说个人信息可能提供给「our related corporations; analytics, search engine providers or other third party service providers …」，「whether they are located overseas or in Singapore」——即文档只承诺「可能向境外披露」，不承诺数据留在某一地域。主体所在地 ≠ 数据处理地，故本条如实记 not_found 而不是填新加坡。已撤锚：原绑的 §4 只说明个人信息「可能提供给位于境外或新加坡的接收方」，是披露/接收方所在地条款，不构成对处理地的表述。

points.text: Removed anchor: Privacy Policy §4 states only that personal data may be provided to recipients "whether they are located overseas or in Singapore" — a disclosure/recipient-location clause, not a statement about where processing takes place.
points.text_zh: 已撤锚：隐私政策 §4 只说明个人信息可能提供给「位于境外或新加坡」的接收方，属披露与接收方所在地条款，不构成对处理地的表述。

role.quote: any processing of personal data submitted through ModelScope.AI is for your purposes and on your behalf only

points.text: International-site conclusion: the contract expressly designates the platform a processor. Terms §9: "You agree that any processing of personal data submitted through ModelScope.AI is for your purposes and on your behalf only, and you remain responsible for complying with all applicable data protection requirements in relation to such personal data", and it further requires the user to warrant that all consents for uploading personal data have been obtained and the required notices given to the individuals concerned. §9 also provides that the user's consents "supplement and do not supersede" the existing privacy policy consents, so the two texts run in parallel. Alongside this, the Privacy Policy still describes collection and use with Alibaba Cloud itself as the subject (§3 purposes, §6 legitimate interests), producing a two-layer structure: processing positioned as on your behalf at the terms-of-service level, with controller-style wording retained at the privacy-policy level. In addition, §6 declares that the IPR in trained/upgraded models and output belongs to the platform, which is in tension with a purely processor position (an ownership clause). The China-site role conclusion differs (see the top-level role).
points.text_zh: 国际站结论：合同层明文自认受托处理方（processor）。Terms §9「You agree that any processing of personal data submitted through ModelScope.AI is for your purposes and on your behalf only, and you remain responsible for complying with all applicable data protection requirements in relation to such personal data」，并进一步要求用户保证已取得上传个人数据的全部同意、并已向相关个人提供告知。§9 另规定用户的同意「supplement and do not supersede」既有的隐私政策同意，即两套文本并行。与此并存的是 Privacy Policy 仍以 Alibaba Cloud 自身为主体描述收集使用（§3 目的、§6 合法利益），二者构成「服务条款层面把处理定位为 on your behalf，隐私政策层面仍保留自身控制者表述」的双层结构。另 §6 声明训练/升级模型与 output 的 IPR 归平台所有，与「完全受托」的定位存在张力（成果归属条款）。中国站的 role 结论与此不同（见顶层 role）。

points.text: Supplemental Terms §2.3 puts Dedicated Endpoints inside the Token Factory Service ("The Token Factory Service provides Customer with Dedicated Endpoints to deploy supported Models with dedicated capacity"), and §5.1(b) authorizes Nebius to process Input and Output in order to "train smaller Models used for Speculative Decoding". points.text: Verdict rationale: this tier rests on the same evidence as the Token Factory pay-as-you-go tier and Nebius has published no dedicated-endpoint-specific position, so it is kept aligned with that tier (mark=no, mode=opt_out) instead of reading the DPA sentence as controlling for dedicated endpoints only. Contract §10.2, "By Default, Novita AI will not use your Content to train our own models or to improve the Services.", plus FAQ item 1, "No. By default, we do not use any data submitted through our API — including prompts, inputs, outputs, or conversation histories — to train or improve our models."
