points.text_zh: 见顶层 training。合同 §10.2「By Default, Novita AI will not use your Content to train our own models or to improve the Services.」+ FAQ 第 1 条「No... to train or improve our models」。未披露任何允许训练的可选档

points.text: Upstream hop: FAQ item 12 lists "Model provider: Provides model inference for integrated models. Data processed: API inputs and outputs per your requests." as a sub-processor category, and that answer gives no entity name for it (the other categories there carry examples such as AWS and Stripe); TOS §6 likewise refers only to a generic "Model Provider". Whether that hop trains on or retains API inputs and outputs is not disclosed, so the chain is recorded by its weakest hop.
points.text_zh: 上游一跳：FAQ 第 12 条把「Model provider: Provides model inference for integrated models. Data processed: API inputs and outputs per your requests.」列为子处理者类别，该条回答未给它任何主体名（同类目里其他项带 AWS、Stripe 这类例子）；TOS §6 也只以「Model Provider」泛指。该跳是否用 API 输入输出训练或保留未披露，整链按最弱一跳记录。
points.quote: Model provider: Provides model inference for integrated models. Data processed: API inputs and outputs per your requests.

points.text: Policy layer (Privacy Policy, object = Personal Information): "The Personal Information will not be used for model training" sits in the same paragraph as the purpose "To improve our Services and conduct research", and the business-purposes list adds "Research and Development: To conduct research and analysis to improve our Services and develop new products and features." Under the house rule that improving the service counts as training, both halves are kept side by side; the object is account and website personal information, not API inputs and outputs (those are governed by TOS §10.2).
points.text_zh: 政策层（隐私政策，对象=Personal Information）：「The Personal Information will not be used for model training」与同段的用途「To improve our Services and conduct research」并存，Business Purposes 还列有「Research and Development: To conduct research and analysis to improve our Services and develop new products and features.」。按「改进服务算训练」的口径，两半并列保留；其对象是账户与网站类个人信息，不是 API 输入输出（后者适用 TOS §10.2）。
points.quote: The Personal Information will not be used for model training

zdr.quote: We have adopted a "Zero Data Retention" policy, which means that we will not, unless otherwise required by applicable law (or as necessary to provide the Services or technical support to you): (i) log your Content for human review; or (ii) retain your Content beyond the time it takes to generate Output and deliver that Output to you.

points.text: See top-level zdr. The definition in TOS §10.2 plus FAQ item 3, "Zero Data Retention is the default for all endpoints, including serverless API calls." — no application required
points.text_zh: 见顶层 zdr。TOS §10.2 定义 + FAQ 第 3 条「Zero Data Retention is the default for all endpoints, including serverless API calls.」，无需申请

points.text: The exceptions and the open-ended "as necessary to provide the Services or technical support" clause are left undefined.
points.text_zh: 例外与「as necessary to provide the Services or technical support」开口条款未界定。

points.text: Contract layer keeps a second, coexisting clause (§25 USER DATA): "We will maintain certain data that you transmit to the Site for the purpose of managing the performance of the Marketplace Offerings… Although we perform regular routine backups of data…" Routine backups are the classic exception to zero retention; the vendor does not quantify how long backup residue is kept, and §25 neither narrows nor widens §10.2 — the two clauses stand side by side.
points.text_zh: 合同层另有一条并存条款（§25 USER DATA）：「We will maintain certain data that you transmit to the Site for the purpose of managing the performance of the Marketplace Offerings… Although we perform regular routine backups of data…」例行备份是零保留最经典的例外；官方未量化备份残余的期限，§25 也不缩小或扩大 §10.2 的范围——两条并列。
points.quote: We will maintain certain data that you transmit to the Site for the purpose of managing the performance of the Marketplace Offerings, as well as data relating to your use of the Marketplace Offerings.

points.text: Upstream hop: the sub-processor category "Model provider" processes "API inputs and outputs per your requests" (FAQ item 12) and that answer names no entity for it; its own retention policy is not disclosed, so the zero-retention chain cannot be closed at that hop.
points.text_zh: 上游一跳：子处理者类别「Model provider」处理「API inputs and outputs per your requests」（FAQ 第 12 条），该条回答未给出主体名，其自身的保留政策未披露，零保留链在该跳无法闭合。
points.quote: Model provider: Provides model inference for integrated models. Data processed: API inputs and outputs per your requests.

retention.summary: 按对象分列保留 180 天
retention.quote: We collect the following categories of data: • API inputs & outputs: Processed transiently for inference only. Not retained beyond the time required to generate and deliver Output, except where required by applicable law. Zero Data Retention is the default for all endpoints, including serverless API calls. • Technical metadata (request timestamps, error codes, usage metrics): Retained for 6 months for the purposes of billing, debugging, and security auditing. • Account & authentication data: Retained for the duration of the account plus any statutory retention periods, for the purposes of service delivery and legal compliance. Our no-retention commitment applies to the substantive content of your API inputs and outputs across all endpoints, including serverless API calls. Technical metadata for operational purposes (e.g., request timestamps, error codes, usage metrics) is handled as described in our Privacy Policy and applicable Data Processing Agreement. You may request deletion of your account data by contacting support@novita.ai.

points.text: The object has to be split rather than summarised by one number: API input and output content is "Processed transiently for inference only. Not retained beyond the time required to generate and deliver Output, except where required by applicable law"; the 180 days recorded for this row is the upper bound for technical metadata only — "Technical metadata (request timestamps, error codes, usage metrics): Retained for 6 months for the purposes of billing, debugging, and security auditing." Account & authentication data is kept for the duration of the account plus any statutory retention periods (FAQ item 3).
points.text_zh: 对象要分开写，不能用一个数字概括：API 输入输出正文「Processed transiently for inference only. Not retained beyond the time required to generate and deliver Output, except where required by applicable law」；本行记录的 180 天只是技术元数据的上限——「Technical metadata (request timestamps, error codes, usage metrics): Retained for 6 months for the purposes of billing, debugging, and security auditing.」。账户与鉴权数据为账户存续期加法定期间（FAQ 第 3 条）。
points.quote: We collect the following categories of data: • API inputs & outputs: Processed transiently for inference only. Not retained beyond the time required to generate and deliver Output, except where required by applicable law. Zero Data Retention is the default for all endpoints, including serverless API calls. • Technical metadata (request timestamps, error codes, usage metrics): Retained for 6 months for the purposes of billing, debugging, and security auditing. • Account & authentication data: Retained for the duration of the account plus any statutory retention periods, for the purposes of service delivery and legal compliance. Our no-retention commitment applies to the substantive content of your API inputs and outputs across all endpoints, including serverless API calls. Technical metadata for operational purposes (e.g., request timestamps, error codes, usage metrics) is handled as described in our Privacy Policy and applicable Data Processing Agreement. You may request deletion of your account data by contacting support@novita.ai.

points.text: Contract layer, §10.2 Zero Data Retention: Content is not retained beyond the time it takes to generate and deliver Output, with exceptions for applicable law, what is necessary to provide the Services or technical support, and automated safety screening. The clause carries no day count of its own — the 180 days above comes from the FAQ's metadata line, a different object.
points.text_zh: 合同层 §10.2 Zero Data Retention：正文不为生成与交付 Output 所需之外保留，例外为法律要求、为提供服务或技术支持所必需、自动安全筛查。该条本身不含任何天数——上面的 180 天出自 FAQ 的元数据那句，是另一个对象。
points.quote: We have adopted a "Zero Data Retention" policy, which means that we will not, unless otherwise required by applicable law (or as necessary to provide the Services or technical support to you): (i) log your Content for human review; or (ii) retain your Content beyond the time it takes to generate Output and deliver that Output to you.

points.text: §25 USER DATA coexists with §10.2: "We will maintain certain data that you transmit to the Site… Although we perform regular routine backups of data…" Backup residue is the classic zero-retention exception and the vendor does not quantify its period; read it as a residual copy, not as long-term retention of request content.
points.text_zh: §25 USER DATA 与 §10.2 并存：「We will maintain certain data that you transmit to the Site… Although we perform regular routine backups of data…」备份残余是零保留的经典例外，官方未量化其期限；按残余副本理解，不读成对请求正文的长期留存。
points.quote: We will maintain certain data that you transmit to the Site for the purpose of managing the performance of the Marketplace Offerings, as well as data relating to your use of the Marketplace Offerings.

points.text: A different kind of period, object = Personal Information: aggregated or de-identified information may be used indefinitely — "We may also anonymize or de-identify your Personal Information (so that it can no longer be associated with you) for research or statistical purposes, as described above, in which case we may use this information indefinitely without further notice to you." It does not fall on API inputs and outputs.
points.text_zh: 另一类期限，对象=个人信息：去标识化/聚合信息可无限期使用——「We may also anonymize or de-identify your Personal Information (so that it can no longer be associated with you) for research or statistical purposes, as described above, in which case we may use this information indefinitely without further notice to you.」该口径不落在 API 输入输出正文上。
points.quote: We may also anonymize or de-identify your Personal Information (so that it can no longer be associated with you) for research or statistical purposes, as described above, in which case we may use this information indefinitely without further notice to you.

points.text: Privacy-layer fixed periods by category: account information = account lifetime plus 7 years, transaction history = 7 years, communication information = 3 years from last communication, technical information = 2 years (Privacy Policy, "Specific Retention Periods"). These cover personal information, not request content — do not read 2 or 7 years as the retention period of prompts and outputs.
points.text_zh: 隐私层的分类固定期限：账户信息=账户存续期加 7 年、交易记录 7 年、通讯信息自最后一次通讯起 3 年、技术信息 2 年（隐私政策「Specific Retention Periods」）。覆盖的是个人信息，不是请求正文——不要把 2 年或 7 年读成 prompt 与输出的保留期。
points.quote:
Account Information: Retained for as long as your account is active plus 7 years for legal and tax purposes
*   Transaction History: Retained for 7 years for accounting and tax compliance
*   Communication Information: Retained for 3 years from last communication
*   Technical Information: Retained for 2 years for security and analytics purposes

points.text: Privacy-layer general rule: "We retain your Personal Information for only as long as we need in order to provide our Service to you, or for other legitimate business purposes…" The policy does not say how long it takes to determine those factors.
points.text_zh: 隐私层通则：「We retain your Personal Information for only as long as we need in order to provide our Service to you, or for other legitimate business purposes…」政策未写明这些因素的判定周期。
points.quote: We retain your Personal Information for only as long as we need in order to provide our Service to you, or for other legitimate business purposes such as resolving disputes, safety and security reasons, or complying with our legal obligations.

points.text: None of the sources registered for this file mentions Prompt Cache, so no retention period for it is recorded here — that is absence of evidence on our side, not a vendor statement that cache is retained.
points.text_zh: 本文件登记的来源均未提到 Prompt Cache，故这里不记录其保留期——这是「我们没有证据」，不是厂商声明会留存缓存。

processing_region.quote: We may transfer Personal Information to countries outside your country or region, including the United States.

points.text: The Privacy Policy's cross-border sentence — "We may transfer Personal Information to countries outside your country or region, including the United States." — takes Personal Information that Novita collects itself as its object, and the same policy states up front that it "does not apply to content that we process on behalf of customers while providing services"; the verb is transfer, so the sentence does not establish where API request content is processed.
points.text_zh: PP 的跨境句——「We may transfer Personal Information to countries outside your country or region, including the United States.」——对象是 Novita 自己收集的个人信息，且同一份政策开头就写明它「does not apply to content that we process on behalf of customers while providing services」；动词是 transfer，因此不能推出 API 请求内容的处理地。
points.quote: We may transfer Personal Information to countries outside your country or region, including the United States.

points.text: FAQ item 6 says the service is "Hosted on AWS data centers" (no region given)
points.text_zh: FAQ 第 6 条称托管在 AWS 数据中心（未给区域）

points.text: FAQ item 8 gives the cross-border mechanism as SCC Module 2 plus the UK IDTA. There is no data residency commitment and no region selection option.
points.text_zh: FAQ 第 8 条跨境机制为 SCC Module 2 + UK IDTA。无数据驻留承诺或区域选择项。

points.text: No source registered for this file states a processing location for API request content, so this row is recorded as undisclosed with the searched range listed, rather than read out of the cross-border transfer sentence — the same treatment as the other two tiers.
points.text_zh: 本文件登记的来源都没有给出 API 请求内容的处理地，故本行记 undisclosed 并列出查阅范围，不从跨境传输句反推——与另两档口径一致。

role.quote: This Privacy Policy does not apply to content that we process on behalf of customers while providing services. Our use of that data is governed by our customer agreements covering access to and use of those offerings.

points.text: See top-level role. Customer content that "we process on behalf of customers" is governed by the customer agreements
points.text_zh: 见顶层 role。客户内容「we process on behalf of customers」由客户协议约束
points.quote: This Privacy Policy does not apply to content that we process on behalf of customers while providing services. Our use of that data is governed by our customer agreements covering access to and use of those offerings.

points.text: The enterprise tier offers a GDPR Article 28 DPA and SCC Module 2. But FAQ item 12 lists "Model provider" as a sub-processor category that processes API inputs and outputs, without naming the entity; the upstream entity and its data policy are not disclosed.
points.text_zh: 企业档提供 GDPR Art.28 DPA 与 SCC Module 2。但 FAQ 第 12 条把「Model provider」列为处理 API 输入输出的子处理者类别，未给出主体名；上游主体及其数据政策未披露。
points.quote: Model provider: Provides model inference for integrated models. Data processed: API inputs and outputs per your requests.

points.text: The same policy also carries a controller-side stance for the Personal Information Novita collects itself: "We may share personal information with third parties for purposes such as analytics and advertising, which may be considered a "sale" under CCPA." Its object is account and website information, not content processed on behalf of customers, so it does not overturn the processor reading above — the two are kept side by side with their own scopes.
points.text_zh: 同一份政策对 Novita 自身收集的个人信息还有一条控制者侧口径：「We may share personal information with third parties for purposes such as analytics and advertising, which may be considered a "sale" under CCPA.」其对象是账户与网站信息，不是代表客户处理的内容，故不推翻上面的 processor 判定——两条各自带适用范围并列。
points.quote: We do not sell your personal information for monetary consideration. However, under the CCPA, "sale" is broadly defined to include making personal information available to third parties for monetary or other valuable consideration. We may share personal information with third parties for purposes such as analytics and advertising, which may be considered a "sale" under CCPA.

training.quote: No. By default, we do not use any data submitted through our API — including prompts, inputs, outputs, or conversation histories — to train or improve our models. For EU/EEA users, this practice aligns with GDPR Article 5(1)(e) (storage limitation principle). Upon request, we can provide written confirmation that no User Content is retained post-processing or used for model training purposes.

points.text: But the enterprise custom terms themselves are not public, so whether they contain exceptions cannot be checked.
points.text_zh: 但企业自定义条款本身不公开，无法核对是否含例外。

Under the house rule that improving the service counts as training, both halves are kept side by side; the object is account and website personal information, not API inputs and outputs (those are governed by TOS §10.2).
points.text_zh: 政策层（隐私政策，对象=Personal Information）：「The Personal Information will not be used for model training」与同段的用途「To improve our Services and conduct research」并存，Business Purposes 还列有「Research and Development: To conduct research and analysis to improve our Services and develop new products and features.」。按「改进服务算训练」的口径，两半并列保留；其对象是账户与网站类个人信息，不是 API 输入输出（后者适用 TOS §10.2）。
points.quote: The Personal Information will not be used for model training

zdr.quote: We collect the following categories of data: • API inputs & outputs: Processed transiently for inference only. Not retained beyond the time required to generate and deliver Output, except where required by applicable law. Zero Data Retention is the default for all endpoints, including serverless API calls. • Technical metadata (request timestamps, error codes, usage metrics): Retained for 6 months for the purposes of billing, debugging, and security auditing. • Account & authentication data: Retained for the duration of the account plus any statutory retention periods, for the purposes of service delivery and legal compliance. Our no-retention commitment applies to the substantive content of your API inputs and outputs across all endpoints, including serverless API calls. Technical metadata for operational purposes (e.g., request timestamps, error codes, usage metrics) is handled as described in our Privacy Policy and applicable Data Processing Agreement. You may request deletion of your account data by contacting support@novita.ai.

points.text: Zero retention is the default; the enterprise tier additionally has a DPA/SCC and written confirmation (FAQ item 1) as contractual reinforcement, but the DPA template is not public.
points.text_zh: 默认即为零保留；企业档另有 DPA/SCC 与书面确认（FAQ 第 1 条）可作合同加固，但 DPA 模板不公开。

retention.summary: 按对象分列保留 180 天
retention.quote: We collect the following categories of data: • API inputs & outputs: Processed transiently for inference only. Not retained beyond the time required to generate and deliver Output, except where required by applicable law. Zero Data Retention is the default for all endpoints, including serverless API calls. • Technical metadata (request timestamps, error codes, usage metrics): Retained for 6 months for the purposes of billing, debugging, and security auditing. • Account & authentication data: Retained for the duration of the account plus any statutory retention periods, for the purposes of service delivery and legal compliance. Our no-retention commitment applies to the substantive content of your API inputs and outputs across all endpoints, including serverless API calls. Technical metadata for operational purposes (e.g., request timestamps, error codes, usage metrics) is handled as described in our Privacy Policy and applicable Data Processing Agreement. You may request deletion of your account data by contacting support@novita.ai.

points.text: The object has to be split rather than summarised by one number: API input and output content is "Processed transiently for inference only. Not retained beyond the time required to generate and deliver Output, except where required by applicable law"; the 180 days recorded for this row is the upper bound for technical metadata only — "Technical metadata (request timestamps, error codes, usage metrics): Retained for 6 months for the purposes of billing, debugging, and security auditing." Account & authentication data is kept for the duration of the account plus any statutory retention periods (FAQ item 3).
points.text_zh: 对象要分开写，不能用一个数字概括：API 输入输出正文「Processed transiently for inference only. Not retained beyond the time required to generate and deliver Output, except where required by applicable law」；本行记录的 180 天只是技术元数据的上限——「Technical metadata (request timestamps, error codes, usage metrics): Retained for 6 months for the purposes of billing, debugging, and security auditing.」。账户与鉴权数据为账户存续期加法定期间（FAQ 第 3 条）。
points.quote: We collect the following categories of data: • API inputs & outputs: Processed transiently for inference only. Not retained beyond the time required to generate and deliver Output, except where required by applicable law. Zero Data Retention is the default for all endpoints, including serverless API calls. • Technical metadata (request timestamps, error codes, usage metrics): Retained for 6 months for the purposes of billing, debugging, and security auditing. • Account & authentication data: Retained for the duration of the account plus any statutory retention periods, for the purposes of service delivery and legal compliance. Our no-retention commitment applies to the substantive content of your API inputs and outputs across all endpoints, including serverless API calls. Technical metadata for operational purposes (e.g., request timestamps, error codes, usage metrics) is handled as described in our Privacy Policy and applicable Data Processing Agreement. You may request deletion of your account data by contacting support@novita.ai.

points.text: FAQ item 3 says technical metadata is handled "as described in our Privacy Policy and applicable Data Processing Agreement", so the periods above are the default tier's; the specific periods for the enterprise tier are set by the DPA, which the public documentation does not carry.
points.text_zh: FAQ 第 3 条称技术元数据的处理「as described in our Privacy Policy and applicable Data Processing Agreement」，即上面这些期限是默认档口径；企业档的具体期限按 DPA 约定，公开文档未载。

points.text: A different kind of period, object = Personal Information: aggregated or de-identified information may be used indefinitely — "We may also anonymize or de-identify your Personal Information (so that it can no longer be associated with you) for research or statistical purposes, as described above, in which case we may use this information indefinitely without further notice to you." It does not fall on API inputs and outputs.
points.text_zh: 另一类期限，对象=个人信息：去标识化/聚合信息可无限期使用——「We may also anonymize or de-identify your Personal Information (so that it can no longer be associated with you) for research or statistical purposes, as described above, in which case we may use this information indefinitely without further notice to you.」该口径不落在 API 输入输出正文上。
points.quote: We may also anonymize or de-identify your Personal Information (so that it can no longer be associated with you) for research or statistical purposes, as described above, in which case we may use this information indefinitely without further notice to you.

points.text: Privacy-layer fixed periods by category: account information = account lifetime plus 7 years, transaction history = 7 years, communication information = 3 years from last communication, technical information = 2 years (Privacy Policy, "Specific Retention Periods"). These cover personal information, not request content — do not read 2 or 7 years as the retention period of prompts and outputs.
points.text_zh: 隐私层的分类固定期限：账户信息=账户存续期加 7 年、交易记录 7 年、通讯信息自最后一次通讯起 3 年、技术信息 2 年（隐私政策「Specific Retention Periods」）。覆盖的是个人信息，不是请求正文——不要把 2 年或 7 年读成 prompt 与输出的保留期。
points.quote:
Account Information: Retained for as long as your account is active plus 7 years for legal and tax purposes
*   Transaction History: Retained for 7 years for accounting and tax compliance
*   Communication Information: Retained for 3 years from last communication
*   Technical Information: Retained for 2 years for security and analytics purposes

points.text: Privacy-layer general rule: "We retain your Personal Information for only as long as we need in order to provide our Service to you, or for other legitimate business purposes…" The policy does not say how long it takes to determine those factors.
points.text_zh: 隐私层通则：「We retain your Personal Information for only as long as we need in order to provide our Service to you, or for other legitimate business purposes…」政策未写明这些因素的判定周期。
points.quote: We retain your Personal Information for only as long as we need in order to provide our Service to you, or for other legitimate business purposes such as resolving disputes, safety and security reasons, or complying with our legal obligations.

processing_region.quote: Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) — European Commission Decision 2021/914 (Module 2: Controller-to-Processor), as appropriate to your deployment model

points.text: FAQ item 8 offers SCC Module 2 and the UK IDTA/Addendum, showing that the cross-border path can be put into contract
points.text_zh: FAQ 第 8 条提供 SCC Module 2 与 UK IDTA/Addendum，说明跨境路径可合同化

points.text: No specific region is disclosed and there is no residency option.
points.text_zh: 未披露具体区域，也无驻留选项。

role.quote: Yes. We offer a DPA for enterprise customers. Our DPA covers the required elements under GDPR Article 28, including: • Subject matter, duration, nature, and purpose of processing • Types of personal data and categories of data subjects • Controller's obligations and processor's obligations • Sub-processor authorization requirements • Data subject rights mechanisms • Audit and inspection rights

points.text: FAQ item 9, "We offer a DPA for enterprise customers. Our DPA covers the required elements under GDPR Article 28, including: ... Controller's obligations and processor's obligations ...", together with item 8's SCC Module 2 (Controller-to-Processor) — at the agreement layer the enterprise tier is expressly a processor.
points.text_zh: FAQ 第 9 条「We offer a DPA for enterprise customers. Our DPA covers the required elements under GDPR Article 28, including: ... Controller's obligations and processor's obligations ...」，第 8 条 SCC Module 2 Controller-to-Processor——企业档在协议层明确为 processor。

points.text: TOS §10.2's no-training clause takes Content as its object, and §10 defines Content as the Input a user provides to the Services and the Output generated from it — files on an instance disk, volume or image are not inside that definition, so the clause does not cover this product line's data. It is therefore no longer bound to this entry, and the row is recorded as unknown rather than reading a clause that misses the object as a commitment.
points.text_zh: TOS §10.2 的不训练条款以 Content 为对象，而 §10 把 Content 定义为用户提供给 Services 的 Input 与由此产生的 Output——实例磁盘/卷/镜像内的文件不在该定义内，该条不覆盖本产品线的数据。故不再绑在本条上；本行记 unknown，不把对象不匹配的条款读成承诺。

points.text: Privacy-policy layer: "The Personal Information will not be used for model training" is stated for Personal Information (and the same paragraph also lists "To improve our Services and conduct research" as a purpose), while that policy expressly excludes content processed on behalf of customers. Neither half covers instance data, so neither is bound to this entry.
points.text_zh: 隐私政策层：「The Personal Information will not be used for model training」针对的是 Personal Information（同一段还把「To improve our Services and conduct research」列为用途），而该政策明文排除代表客户处理的内容。两半都不覆盖实例数据，故都不绑在本条上。

points.text: The object of the zero-retention commitment in the Trust Center FAQ and TOS §10.2 is "API inputs and outputs" / "Content", and the stated scope is API endpoints
points.text_zh: Trust Center FAQ 与 TOS §10.2 的零保留承诺对象是「API inputs and outputs / Content」，明示范围是 API endpoint

points.text: There is no zero-retention or no-persistence statement for GPU instance disks, network volumes, images or Serverless GPU endpoint content. Recorded as not_found per the rules: the vendor discloses nothing for this product line, and **this must not be read in reverse as the vendor retaining data**.
points.text_zh: GPU 实例磁盘、网络卷、镜像、Serverless GPU 端点内容均无零保留或不落盘的表述。按规则记 not_found：官方未就该产品线披露，**不得反向解读为厂商会留存**。

retention.summary: 按对象分列保留 7 天
retention.quote: Data from stopped instances is retained for **7 days**, during which storage fees of **\$0.005/GB/day** apply. After 7 days, data is automatically and permanently deleted with no recovery option.

points.text: The object is instance-local data: "Data from stopped instances is retained for 7 days", with storage fees of $0.005/GB/day during that period, after which "data is automatically and permanently deleted with no recovery option"
points.text_zh: 对象是实例本地数据：停止的实例数据保留 7 天（期间按 $0.005/GB/day 计存储费），7 天后自动永久删除、不可恢复

points.text: Network volume data is independent of the instance lifecycle (it survives instance deletion); container disk data is kept only when an image is saved, and volume disk data is not kept with the image. The vendor gives no deletion period for network volumes — that is customer-managed storage.
points.text_zh: 网络卷数据独立于实例生命周期（实例删除后仍在），容器盘数据仅在保存镜像时保留、卷盘不随镜像保留。厂商未对网络卷给出删除期限——那是客户自管存储。

processing_region.quote: Infrastructure: Hosted on AWS data centers with enterprise-grade physical and network security

points.text: Only broad wording such as "Hosted on AWS data centers" (and in the source it sits inside a security Q&A); no region selection and no residency commitment; low confidence.
points.text_zh: 只有「Hosted on AWS data centers」这类笼统表述（且原文置于安全问答中），无区域选择、无驻留承诺；低置信度。

points.text: The Privacy Policy sentence the other tiers rely on is a scope exclusion, not a role clause: "This Privacy Policy does not apply to content that we process on behalf of customers while providing services. Our use of that data is governed by our customer agreements covering access to and use of those offerings." It names no product line and assigns no controller/processor role for GPU Cloud data.
points.text_zh: 另两档所依据的 PP 句子是适用范围排除句，不是角色条款：「This Privacy Policy does not apply to content that we process on behalf of customers while providing services. Our use of that data is governed by our customer agreements covering access to and use of those offerings.」它未点名任何产品线，也没有为 GPU 云数据约定控制者/受托处理方角色。
points.quote: This Privacy Policy does not apply to content that we process on behalf of customers while providing services. Our use of that data is governed by our customer agreements covering access to and use of those offerings.

points.text: The TOS has no role clause for this product line either: its only service-provider wording ("We are a service provider and make no representations as to the safety, effectiveness, adequacy, accuracy…") sits in the disclaimer context of §3, and §10.2 governs Content only. Recorded as unknown rather than inferred by analogy.
points.text_zh: TOS 里也没有本产品线的角色条款：唯一类似「service provider」的表述（「We are a service provider and make no representations as to the safety, effectiveness, adequacy, accuracy…」）位于 §3 的免责语境，§10.2 只管 Content。记 unknown，不用类推。

training.quote: By Default, Novita AI will not use your Content to train our own models or to improve the Services.

points.text: There is no tier-specific clause; the default no-training commitment of TOS §10.2 and FAQ item 1 carries over. Confidence is medium rather than high: no sentence in the public documentation binds that commitment expressly to the Coding Plan tier, so applicability is derived from "the TOS covers all Marketplace Offerings".
points.text_zh: 无档位专用条款，沿用 TOS §10.2 与 FAQ 第 1 条的默认不训练承诺。置信度 medium 而非 high：公开文档没有一句话把该承诺明示绑定到 Coding Plan 这一档，属按「TOS 覆盖全部 Marketplace Offerings」推出的适用关系。

points.text: Multi-hop caveat: the Trust Center FAQ's sub-processor list names a category "Model provider: Provides model inference for integrated models. Data processed: API inputs and outputs per your requests." API inputs and outputs therefore pass through at least one further hop. Whether that hop trains on them is not disclosed in any public document, and it must not be inferred from the category name; the whole-chain verdict therefore rests on this platform's own commitment.
points.text_zh: 多跳提示：Trust Center FAQ 的子处理者清单里有一类「Model provider: Provides model inference for integrated models. Data processed: API inputs and outputs per your requests.」——API 输入输出至少要再经一跳。该跳是否用于训练，公开文档均未披露，也不得从类别名称反推；故整链结论以本平台自身的承诺为准。
points.quote: Model provider: Provides model inference for integrated models. Data processed: API inputs and outputs per your requests.

zdr.quote: We collect the following categories of data: • API inputs & outputs: Processed transiently for inference only. Not retained beyond the time required to generate and deliver Output, except where required by applicable law. Zero Data Retention is the default for all endpoints, including serverless API calls. • Technical metadata (request timestamps, error codes, usage metrics): Retained for 6 months for the purposes of billing, debugging, and security auditing. • Account & authentication data: Retained for the duration of the account plus any statutory retention periods, for the purposes of service delivery and legal compliance. Our no-retention commitment applies to the substantive content of your API inputs and outputs across all endpoints, including serverless API calls. Technical metadata for operational purposes (e.g., request timestamps, error codes, usage metrics) is handled as described in our Privacy Policy and applicable Data Processing Agreement. You may request deletion of your account data by contacting support@novita.ai.

points.text: FAQ item 3 describes ZDR as the "default for all endpoints, including serverless API calls"
points.text_zh: FAQ 第 3 条把 ZDR 说成「default for all endpoints, including serverless API calls」

points.text: The Coding Plan runs on the same API, but the documentation does not name this tier, hence medium.
points.text_zh: Coding Plan 走同一套 API，但文档未点名该档，故 medium。

points.text: The promise is bounded by the clause that states it: TOS §10.2 excludes the two behaviours "unless otherwise required by applicable law (or as necessary to provide the Services or technical support to you)", and the sentence immediately after adds that automated safety screening "does not constitute retention of your Content for any other purpose". Both are qualifications of the ZDR commitment, not withdrawals of it: mark stays yes and mode stays default.
points.text_zh: 该承诺被它自己那句限定：TOS §10.2 的两项排除以「unless otherwise required by applicable law (or as necessary to provide the Services or technical support to you)」为前提，紧随其后的一句又写明自动化安全筛查「does not constitute retention of your Content for any other purpose」。两处都是 ZDR 承诺的限定条件、不是撤销：mark 仍为 yes、mode 仍为 default。
points.quote: you agree that we have the right to apply automated safety screening tools to your Content as we deem appropriate, and that such screening does not constitute retention of your Content for any other purpose.

points.text: Multi-hop caveat (see training): the sub-processor category "Model provider" processes API inputs and outputs per request, and that hop's retention policy is not disclosed. Zero retention is therefore established for this platform, not for the whole chain.
points.text_zh: 多跳提示（见 training）：子处理者类别「Model provider」按请求处理 API 输入输出，该跳的保留政策未披露。故零保留只对本平台成立，不等于全链零保留。
points.quote: Model provider: Provides model inference for integrated models. Data processed: API inputs and outputs per your requests.

retention.quote: We collect the following categories of data: • API inputs & outputs: Processed transiently for inference only. Not retained beyond the time required to generate and deliver Output, except where required by applicable law. Zero Data Retention is the default for all endpoints, including serverless API calls. • Technical metadata (request timestamps, error codes, usage metrics): Retained for 6 months for the purposes of billing, debugging, and security auditing. • Account & authentication data: Retained for the duration of the account plus any statutory retention periods, for the purposes of service delivery and legal compliance. Our no-retention commitment applies to the substantive content of your API inputs and outputs across all endpoints, including serverless API calls. Technical metadata for operational purposes (e.g., request timestamps, error codes, usage metrics) is handled as described in our Privacy Policy and applicable Data Processing Agreement. You may request deletion of your account data by contacting support@novita.ai.

points.text: Object = API input and output content, context = default, type = upper bound with no fixed number of days, stated at the contract layer: no retention "beyond the time it takes to generate Output and deliver that Output to you" (TOS §10.2). The TOS quantifies no retention period for Content: the only six-month figure it contains is the liability look-back window in §23 (SIX (6) MONTH PERIOD), which is not a retention period. Hence this row carries basis=none and no days value.
points.text_zh: 对象＝API 输入输出正文，语境＝默认，期限类型＝上限且无固定天数，合同层表述为：不保留「beyond the time it takes to generate Output and deliver that Output to you」（TOS §10.2）。TOS 没有量化任何针对 Content 的保留期限：全文唯一的六个月数字是 §23 责任限额的回溯窗口（SIX (6) MONTH PERIOD），它不是保留期限。故本行取 basis=none、不写 days。
points.quote: We have adopted a "Zero Data Retention" policy, which means that we will not, unless otherwise required by applicable law (or as necessary to provide the Services or technical support to you): (i) log your Content for human review; or (ii) retain your Content beyond the time it takes to generate Output and deliver that Output to you.

points.text: The quantified, object-by-object statement lives in FAQ item 3, which is also the anchor of the zdr verdict: "Not retained beyond the time required to generate and deliver Output, except where required by applicable law" for API inputs and outputs, 6 months for technical metadata, and the duration of the account plus any statutory retention periods for account and authentication data. It is the same upper bound as the contract clause above, just split by object and with the metadata period quantified.
points.text_zh: 量化且分对象的表述在 FAQ 第 3 条，该锚点同时承载 zdr 结论：API 输入输出「Not retained beyond the time required to generate and deliver Output, except where required by applicable law」、技术元数据 6 个月、账户与鉴权数据为账户存续期加法定期间。与上文合同层条款是同一个上限，只是按对象拆开、并把元数据期限量化了。

points.text: Object = technical metadata (request timestamps, error codes, usage metrics), context = default, type = fixed period of 6 months, for billing, debugging and security auditing (FAQ item 3).
points.text_zh: 对象＝技术元数据（请求时间戳、错误码、用量指标），语境＝默认，期限类型＝固定 6 个月，用于计费、调试与安全审计（FAQ 第 3 条）。

points.text: Conflicting periods for an overlapping object, both kept on record without picking a side: the Privacy Policy's Specific Retention Periods give Technical Information 2 years for security and analytics, while FAQ item 3 gives technical metadata 6 months; the overlap is usage and request metadata. FAQ item 3's closing sentence defers to the Privacy Policy and the applicable DPA — "Technical metadata for operational purposes (e.g., request timestamps, error codes, usage metrics) is handled as described in our Privacy Policy and applicable Data Processing Agreement" — so the vendor's own framing is FAQ as overview, Privacy Policy as detail.
points.text_zh: 同一对象上的两个冲突期限，并列保留、不选边：PP 的 Specific Retention Periods 给 Technical Information 2 年（security and analytics），FAQ 第 3 条给技术元数据 6 个月，重叠部分是用量与请求元数据。FAQ 第 3 条末句自认以 PP 与 DPA 为准——「Technical metadata for operational purposes (e.g., request timestamps, error codes, usage metrics) is handled as described in our Privacy Policy and applicable Data Processing Agreement」——即厂商口径是 FAQ 概览、PP 细则。
points.quote:
Account Information: Retained for as long as your account is active plus 7 years for legal and tax purposes
*   Transaction History: Retained for 7 years for accounting and tax compliance
*   Communication Information: Retained for 3 years from last communication
*   Technical Information: Retained for 2 years for security and analytics purposes

points.text: Object = account-side data, where the Privacy Policy gives per-category periods rather than one number: account information for as long as the account is active plus 7 years for legal and tax purposes (a duration-of-account lower bound plus a fixed period), transaction history 7 years for accounting and tax compliance, communication information 3 years from last communication, technical information 2 years for security and analytics. The Privacy Policy itself does not apply to content processed on behalf of customers.
points.text_zh: 对象＝账户侧数据，PP 给的是分类期限而非一个数字：账户信息为账户存续期加 7 年（存续期下限＋固定年数）、交易记录 7 年（会计与税务合规）、通讯信息自最后一次沟通起 3 年、技术信息 2 年。PP 自身不适用于代客户处理的内容。
points.quote:
Account Information: Retained for as long as your account is active plus 7 years for legal and tax purposes
*   Transaction History: Retained for 7 years for accounting and tax compliance
*   Communication Information: Retained for 3 years from last communication
*   Technical Information: Retained for 2 years for security and analytics purposes

points.text: A separate retention path disclosed at the contract layer, object = data you transmit to the Site for managing the performance of the Marketplace Offerings plus data relating to your use of them: "We will maintain certain data that you transmit to the Site for the purpose of managing the performance of the Marketplace Offerings, as well as data relating to your use of the Marketplace Offerings. Although we perform regular routine backups of data, you are solely responsible for all data that you transmit..." (TOS §25). This is an account/operations-side path and the clause does not state that it applies to API input and output content, so it is recorded as another retention path and does not change the no-retention conclusion for content.
points.text_zh: 合同层披露的另一条留存路径，对象＝你传输到 Site 的、用于管理 Marketplace Offerings 运行的数据以及与你使用相关的数据：「We will maintain certain data that you transmit to the Site for the purpose of managing the performance of the Marketplace Offerings, as well as data relating to your use of the Marketplace Offerings. Although we perform regular routine backups of data, you are solely responsible for all data that you transmit...」（TOS §25）。属账户/运营侧路径，条款未声明适用于 API 输入输出正文；故作为「其他留存路径」列出，不改变正文不留存的结论。
points.quote: We will maintain certain data that you transmit to the Site for the purpose of managing the performance of the Marketplace Offerings, as well as data relating to your use of the Marketplace Offerings.

points.text: Exception qualifying the no-retention promise, sitting in the same clause: automated safety screening applied to Content "does not constitute retention of your Content for any other purpose" (TOS §10.2).
points.text_zh: 同一句里的限定条件：对 Content 施加的自动化安全筛查「does not constitute retention of your Content for any other purpose」（TOS §10.2）。
points.quote: you agree that we have the right to apply automated safety screening tools to your Content as we deem appropriate, and that such screening does not constitute retention of your Content for any other purpose.

points.text: The only sentence touching geography is the Privacy Policy's cross-border disclosure, and it states no processing location: "We may transfer Personal Information to countries outside your country or region, including the United States." It names a transfer destination (and not only the United States), so codes=["US"] cannot be derived from it; the same policy also says it "does not apply to content that we process on behalf of customers", which excludes API input and output content.
points.text_zh: 唯一涉及地域的一句是 PP 的跨境传输披露，它并未声明处理地：「We may transfer Personal Information to countries outside your country or region, including the United States.」说的是传输去向（且不只美国），推不出 codes=["US"]；同一份政策还自述「does not apply to content that we process on behalf of customers」，即 API 输入输出正文不在其适用范围内。
points.quote: We may transfer Personal Information to countries outside your country or region, including the United States.

points.text: The only infrastructure statement in the three documents is FAQ item 6's "Infrastructure: Hosted on AWS data centers", which gives no region. The TOS carries no region or processing-location wording at all (§22 mentions only "our secure servers"). Recorded as undisclosed: the vendor has not stated where processing happens, and that is not the same as a statement that processing happens in the United States.

points.text: The §2.3 default is genuinely no storage at the end of each session, but §2.4 carves out two exceptions — certain API Services such as Fine Tuning (User Content 30 days from first upload, its Generated Content 90 days from first availability) and security/anti-fraud logging and storage of User Content and Generated Content with no published period — so the tier is not end-to-end zero retention.

points.text: Default of this tier (§2.3): "Except as stated below in Section 2.4 or unless expressly disclosed to you for an API Service, NVIDIA will not store or use User Content or Generated Content at the end of each API Service session." Object = User Content and Generated Content (input and output content); context = the trial tier's default; the bound is the end of the session, not a retention window. The same sentence names its own two openings: Section 2.4 below, and anything expressly disclosed to you for an API Service.
points.text_zh: 本档默认（§2.3）：「Except as stated below in Section 2.4 or unless expressly disclosed to you for an API Service, NVIDIA will not store or use User Content or Generated Content at the end of each API Service session.」对象=User Content 与 Generated Content（输入输出正文）；语境=试用档默认；边界是会话结束，不是某个保留窗口。该句自带两个开口：下文 §2.4，以及为某个 API Service 向你明示披露的另行约定。
points.quote: Except as stated below in Section 2.4 or unless expressly disclosed to you for an API Service, NVIDIA will not store or use User Content or Generated Content at the end of each API Service session.

points.text: First exception, with its own scope (§2.4): "For certain API Services, such as the Fine Tuning API Service or as expressly disclosed in the NVIDIA API Catalog, unless you purchase a Subscription from the appropriate Service Provider, NVIDIA will store User Content for thirty (30) days from first upload of User Content, and the Generated Content of the Fine Tuning Service for ninety (90) days from when it is first made available to you". Object and period are split: User Content 30 days from first upload, the Fine Tuning Service's Generated Content 90 days from first availability. Context = certain API Services such as Fine Tuning, or as expressly disclosed in the API Catalog — this is not the trial tier's blanket default, so the 30 days must not be read as a single rule covering every call.
points.text_zh: 第一条例外及其自身范围（§2.4）：「For certain API Services, such as the Fine Tuning API Service or as expressly disclosed in the NVIDIA API Catalog, unless you purchase a Subscription from the appropriate Service Provider, NVIDIA will store User Content for thirty (30) days from first upload of User Content, and the Generated Content of the Fine Tuning Service for ninety (90) days from when it is first made available to you」。对象与期限是分开的：User Content 自首次上传起 30 天；Fine Tuning Service 的 Generated Content 自首次提供起 90 天。语境=某些 API Service（如微调），或按 API Catalog 明示披露者——这不是试用档的笼统默认值，不能把 30 天读成覆盖所有调用的单一规则。
points.quote: unless you purchase a Subscription from the appropriate Service Provider, NVIDIA will store User Content for thirty (30) days from first upload of User Content, and the Generated Content of the Fine Tuning Service for ninety (90) days from when it is first made available to you, except that NVIDIA may log and store User Content and Generated Content to monitor for security or to prevent fraud or abuse

points.text: Second exception, in the same sentence as the 30/90 days and with no published period: "except that NVIDIA may log and store User Content and Generated Content to monitor for security or to prevent fraud or abuse as stated in Section 3.3." Object = User Content and Generated Content themselves, not only access logs; context = security and fraud/abuse monitoring; no time limit is published, so this is an open-ended exception rather than a bounded deletion promise.
points.text_zh: 第二条例外，与 30/90 天同句，且没有公布期限：「except that NVIDIA may log and store User Content and Generated Content to monitor for security or to prevent fraud or abuse as stated in Section 3.3.」对象=User Content 与 Generated Content 正文本身，不只是访问日志；语境=安全与反欺诈/反滥用监控；期限未公布，是一条无上限的例外，不能当作有界的删除承诺。
points.quote: except that NVIDIA may log and store User Content and Generated Content to monitor for security or to prevent fraud or abuse

points.text: Third object, with no period at all: "Your use of the API Services will be logged for security, fraud or abuse monitoring and shared with third party service providers for this purpose." Object = use/access logs of the API Services, which is a different object from input and output content; context = security, fraud or abuse monitoring; the clause states the logging and the sharing but no retention period, so logs are the one object in this row whose period is undisclosed.
points.text_zh: 第三类对象，完全没有期限：「Your use of the API Services will be logged for security, fraud or abuse monitoring and shared with third party service providers for this purpose.」对象=API Service 的使用/访问日志，与输入输出正文是不同的对象；语境=安全、欺诈或滥用监控；该句写明会记录并与第三方服务商共享，但没有给任何保留期限——日志是本行唯一期限未公布的对象。
points.quote: Your use of the API Services will be logged for security, fraud or abuse monitoring and shared with third party service providers for this purpose.

points.text: Scope of this row: the API Catalog trial tier only. §1.4: "The terms and conditions of your Subscription will govern your production use of the API Service." Production use is governed by separately purchased Subscription terms with no public source and no snapshot in this ledger; §2.4's 30/90 days is itself conditioned on "unless you purchase a Subscription from the appropriate Service Provider", so it must not be read as the production tier's retention rule.
points.text_zh: 本行范围：仅 API Catalog 试用档。§1.4：「The terms and conditions of your Subscription will govern your production use of the API Service.」生产使用由另行购买的 Subscription 条款管辖，该条款无公开来源、本台账也没有快照；§2.4 的 30/90 天本身就以「unless you purchase a Subscription from the appropriate Service Provider」为前提，不得当作生产档的保留规则。

points.text: Why this stays undisclosed: the only clause bearing on whether NVIDIA servers are suitable for processing data is a disclaimer, not a location disclosure — §4.3: "NVIDIA does not represent, and specifically disclaims, that NVIDIA servers are appropriate for processing of any data including personal data". §4.5's "NVIDIA servers" is a prohibition on misuse, not a processing-location statement. No data residency, region or country is named anywhere in the trial terms, so the disclaimer is recorded here as the reason for undisclosed rather than as evidence of a location.
points.text_zh: 为什么仍然是未披露：协议里唯一涉及「NVIDIA 服务器是否适合处理数据」的条款是免责声明，不是处理地披露——§4.3：「NVIDIA does not represent, and specifically disclaims, that NVIDIA servers are appropriate for processing of any data including personal data」。§4.5 提到的 NVIDIA servers 是禁止滥用的行为限制，不是处理地说明。试用条款全篇没有点名任何数据驻留地、区域或国家，故此处把该免责声明记为「未披露」的理由，而不是处理地的证据。
points.quote: NVIDIA does not represent, and specifically disclaims, that NVIDIA servers are appropriate for processing of any data including personal data

role.quote: You agree that NVIDIA may, but is not obligated to, block, monitor, scan or review communications or User Content or Generated Content transmitted through the API Service

points.text: Basis for reading NVIDIA as a controller, and what it rests on: §3.3 has NVIDIA collecting "User Content and Generated Content to improve NVIDIA products and services, including AI models" — it decides to use the content for its own products and models rather than only on the user's instructions. The Agreement itself never uses the words controller or processor (the only "Service Provider" in it, §1.4, defines a reseller of Subscriptions), so this determination rests on the own-purpose clause plus §2.7, not on a role stated in the text.
points.text_zh: 把 NVIDIA 读作独立控制者的依据与其性质：§3.3 让 NVIDIA 收集「User Content and Generated Content to improve NVIDIA products and services, including AI models」——即为自身产品与模型决定使用目的，而不只是按用户指示处理。协议全文没有出现 controller / processor 字样（唯一出现的 Service Provider 是 §1.4 里订阅转售方的定义），因此该定性建立在「为自身目的处理」这一条款与 §2.7 之上，不是协议明写的角色。
points.quote: NVIDIA will collect the following data, without identifying specific users, to operate and improve the API Services and other products and services: (i) session metrics (e.g., the amount of processing power consumed, type of request made); (ii) error logs and execution logs relating to your session (e.g., whether your request was executed successfully); (iii) your feedback and ranking of specific API Services; and (iv) User Content and Generated Content to improve NVIDIA products and services, including AI models.

points.text: Counterweight inside the very clause that grants the licence (§2.2): the licence runs "during your API Service session solely to provide you with the API Service and as otherwise described in this Agreement or expressly disclosed to you for an API Service" — limited to the session and to serving the user, which reads closer to a service-provider side than to an independent controller. The same tail is also the opening condition on the retention promises in §2.3 and §2.4.
points.text_zh: 同一条授予许可的条款里的反向面（§2.2）：许可被限定为「during your API Service session solely to provide you with the API Service and as otherwise described in this Agreement or expressly disclosed to you for an API Service」——只限会话期间、且仅为向你提供 API Service，方向更接近服务提供方一侧。同一句尾也是 §2.3、§2.4 保留承诺的开口条件。
points.quote: you grant NVIDIA, its affiliates and their service providers a worldwide license with respect to User Content and Generated Content, to use, host, store, reproduce, modify, create derivative works (such as those resulting from translations, adaptations or other changes), display and transmit such User Content and Generated Content during your API Service session solely to provide you with the API Service and as otherwise described in this Agreement or expressly disclosed to you for an API Service.

points.text: Second counterweight (§2.5): "You acknowledge that NVIDIA does not manage or control User Content or Generated Content that you provide, make available or create through the NVIDIA API Catalog." With §2.1 (the user is solely responsible for all User Content and Generated Content) this pushes responsibility onto the user and cuts against reading NVIDIA as the party deciding how the content is handled.
points.text_zh: 第二处反向面（§2.5）：「You acknowledge that NVIDIA does not manage or control User Content or Generated Content that you provide, make available or create through the NVIDIA API Catalog.」与 §2.1（用户对全部 User Content 与 Generated Content 负全责）一起把责任推向用户一侧，与「由 NVIDIA 决定内容如何处理」的读法相反。
points.quote: You acknowledge that NVIDIA does not manage or control User Content or Generated Content that you provide, make available or create through the NVIDIA API Catalog.

points.text: Applicability limit carried by the section that also disclaims server suitability (§4.3): "Unless expressly permitted by an API Service, you will not upload any personal information relating to an identifiable individual, financial, health or governmental information, or any other information which may be subject to data privacy or data security laws, rules, or regulations." The trial tier is not offered for personal or regulated data unless a service expressly permits it — a limit on what may be submitted, not a role designation.
points.text_zh: 适用范围限制（§4.3，与「服务器适格性」免责同节）：「Unless expressly permitted by an API Service, you will not upload any personal information relating to an identifiable individual, financial, health or governmental information, or any other information which may be subject to data privacy or data security laws, rules, or regulations.」除某项服务明示许可外，试用档不接受个人信息或受监管数据——这是对可提交内容的限制，不是角色定性。

training.quote: This training data is not used to improve the general use cases for OCI Generative AI.

points.text: Scope of the anchor: the clause "This training data is not used to improve the general use cases for OCI Generative AI." is about customer-submitted fine-tuning training data — the same paragraph says "This training data is solely used for building a custom model for this customer". It is not a statement about inference inputs. The inference path on this tier is covered by the data-handling page only as "No, OCI Generative AI doesn't retain customer inputs" and "Both input and output are not stored inside OCI Generative AI" — a retention statement, not a training statement.
points.text_zh: 锚点适用范围：原句『This training data is not used to improve the general use cases for OCI Generative AI.』的对象是客户提交的**微调训练数据**（同段写 This training data is solely used for building a custom model for this customer），不是推理输入。本档推理路径在 data-handling 页只有『No, OCI Generative AI doesn't retain customer inputs』『Both input and output are not stored inside OCI Generative AI』——那是保留表述，不是训练表述。

That URL is not registered in [[source]] and has no snapshot in this repo, so per AGENTS ("a quote only counts if it appears in a snapshot") it cannot carry this tier's verdict. Until the fetch bot brings it back, the yes on this tier rests on the fine-tuning clause and covers fine-tuning training data only.

points.text: Reverse evidence in the same provider, recorded alongside rather than resolved: the consumer Privacy Policy §4 says "We may process personal information in order to analyze, develop, improve and optimize the use, function and performance of our sites and products and services, including for quality assurance and training purposes, as well as for marketing and sales campaigns." Its object is website/account-side personal information — §2 excludes personal information Oracle processes to provide Cloud, Technical Support or Consulting services to customers — so it does not reach API content. It is the only place in this provider's library where the words "training purposes" appear, and it must not be read as covering API inputs.
points.text_zh: 同一家的反面表述（并列保留，不选边）：消费侧《Oracle Privacy Policy》§4『We may process personal information in order to analyze, develop, improve and optimize the use, function and performance of our sites and products and services, including for quality assurance and training purposes, as well as for marketing and sales campaigns.』——对象是网站/账户侧个人信息，该政策 §2 明确把 Oracle 为提供 Cloud/技术支持/咨询等服务而处理的个人信息排除在外，故不覆盖 API 内容。这是本 provider 在库材料里唯一逐字出现 training purposes 的表述，不能读成覆盖 API 输入。
points.quote: We may process personal information in order to analyze, develop, improve and optimize the use, function and performance of our sites and products and services, including for quality assurance and training purposes, as well as for marketing and sales campaigns.

points.text: Contract layer: there is no verbatim "not used for training" clause (CSA §11.2 keeps data from the Services in aggregated form for research and development). What the contract layer does contain is a purpose limitation in DPA §2.2 — Oracle Processes Personal Information solely for the purpose of providing the Services — whose object is Personal Information and therefore does not cover non-personal customer content.
points.text_zh: 合同层：没有逐字的『不用于训练』条款（CSA §11.2 保留以聚合形式使用服务数据用于研发）；但合同层有一条目的限制——DPA §2.2『Oracle will Process Personal Information during the term of the Services Agreement solely for the purpose of providing the Services in accordance with the Services Agreement and this Data Processing Agreement.』。对象是 Personal Information，不含非个人信息的客户内容。
points.quote: Oracle will Process Personal Information during the term of the Services Agreement solely for the purpose of providing the Services in accordance with the Services Agreement and this Data Processing Agreement.

points.text: Uncovered contract-layer document, recorded as a gap and not used as evidence: HDP §7 says "The Oracle Artificial Intelligence Terms available online at http://oracle.com/contracts apply to Artificial Intelligence Functionality (as defined in such terms) in Your ordered Cloud Services." Those AI Terms are not in [[source]] and have no snapshot in this repo, so whether they carry their own training or retention clauses cannot be judged from this ledger today.

points.text: The hosting sentence is qualified by its source: "xAI Grok models are hosted on the xAI platform with data processed on zero data retention endpoints, offering an extra layer of protection." appears only in the 2026-01-13 classified-cloud post, whose subject is the general availability of OCI Generative AI in Oracle's US Top Secret classified cloud regions (see this provider's source note). training.quote: **We do not use your inputs or outputs to train AI models.**

points.text: Privacy Policy §4 lists "Improve and develop new features" among the purposes for which personal information collected via the Service is used, but the subject of that list is the §3 personal information — account information, payment information (processed by Stripe) and support communications, plus automatically collected metadata that expressly excludes prompt or response content ("Diagnostic metadata for troubleshooting (does not include prompt or response content)"). Scope: this §4 line is not a statement about training on prompt or response content.

zdr.quote: When Ollama partners with providers, we require no logging, no training, and zero data retention policies in place.

points.text: The zero data retention commitment is a requirement Ollama places on the upstream hop rather than a first-party retention term: Privacy Policy §5 lists "model inference providers" among the third parties who help operate the Service ("Third parties who help us operate (e.g., Stripe for payments, cloud infrastructure providers, model inference providers)."), and the pricing FAQ names that hop ("Ollama collaborates with NVIDIA Cloud Providers (NCPs) to host open models."), immediately followed by "When Ollama partners with providers, we require no logging, no training, and zero data retention policies in place." Chain: Ollama → model inference provider (NVIDIA Cloud Providers); the commitment is what Ollama requires of that hop.
points.text_zh: 零保留是对上游那一跳的要求，而不是第一方保留条款：隐私政策 §5 把「model inference providers」列为协助运营服务的第三方类别（「Third parties who help us operate (e.g., Stripe for payments, cloud infrastructure providers, model inference providers).」），定价页 FAQ 指明该跳为 NVIDIA Cloud Providers（「Ollama collaborates with NVIDIA Cloud Providers (NCPs) to host open models.」），紧接的一句是「When Ollama partners with providers, we require no logging, no training, and zero data retention policies in place.」。链路：Ollama → 模型推理提供方（NVIDIA Cloud Providers）；承诺的形式是 Ollama 对该跳提出的要求。
points.quote: Third parties who help us operate (e.g., Stripe for payments, cloud infrastructure providers, model inference providers).

retention.quote: When using cloud-hosted models, we process this content transiently to provide the Service and this content is not stored beyond the time required to fulfill the request.

points.text: Object = prompt/response content, first-party statement: "When using cloud-hosted models, we process this content transiently to provide the Service and this content is not stored beyond the time required to fulfill the request." The §6 categories are per object and are not the same period: account information retained while the account is active and deleted upon request, subject to legal obligations; billing records retained as required by tax, accounting and other legal obligations; metadata and analytics retained as needed for service operations, security and improvement. Support communications are a separate category — see the point below.

points.quote: When using cloud-hosted models, we process this content transiently to provide the Service and this content is not stored beyond the time required to fulfill the request.

points.text: Exception path for input/output content, verbatim: "Support communications: retained until resolved and then archived or deleted." Input or output content reaches that category only when the user voluntarily includes it in a support request (Privacy Policy §2: "If you voluntarily include such content in support requests, it will be handled solely to resolve your issue and not used for training."); on that path the request-scoped limit ("not stored beyond the time required to fulfill the request") does not apply — the period is the support case lifecycle.

points.quote: Support communications: retained until resolved and then archived or deleted.

points.text: Separate object, undisclosed period: cached input is priced ("Usage is measured in tokens at each model's rates. The model pricing table lists the input, cached input, and output price per million tokens for every cloud model.", with a "Cached input" column in the table). KV/prompt cache is its own object alongside prompt/response content, and Ollama publishes no lifetime, eviction rule or scope for it — undisclosed.

points.text_zh: 启用 ZDR 也成立的保留例外:提交到 /v1/responses、/v1/chat/completions、/v1/images 的图片/文件输入会做 CSAM 扫描,分类器命中时图片会被保留以供人工复核,「即使已启用 Zero Data Retention、Modified Abuse Monitoring 或 Private Retention with PSP」。这是按输入的例外,与端点级的「部分端点不适用」分开
points.quote: the image will be retained for manual review, even if Zero Data Retention, Modified Abuse Monitoring, or Private Retention with PSP is enabled

points.text: OpenAI keeps the right to withdraw the controls, but not unconditionally: "we reserve the right to make models ineligible for Zero Data Retention or Modified Abuse Monitoring for specific customers, as notified in advance to the impacted customers in writing". In that case (Private Retention with PSP, formerly Eyes Off) customer content is retained in encrypted abuse monitoring logs in OpenAI-managed infrastructure, but excluded from human review unless applicable law requires it
points.text_zh: OpenAI 保留停用控制项的权利,但不是无条件的:「we reserve the right to make models ineligible for Zero Data Retention or Modified Abuse Monitoring for specific customers, as notified in advance to the impacted customers in writing」。此情形下(Private Retention with PSP,原 Eyes Off)客户内容留在 OpenAI 自管的加密滥用监测日志中,除法律要求外不进入人工复核
points.quote: we reserve the right to make models ineligible for Zero Data Retention or Modified Abuse Monitoring for specific customers, as notified in advance to the impacted customers in writing

points.text: The Safety Retention variant of the same right applies when it is "reasonably necessary to investigate or prevent severe risk activity", also with advance written notice; OpenAI may then retain and human review customer content on those models that its classifiers detect as potentially violating the Usage Policies or the agreement, while otherwise retention is not affected
points.text_zh: 同一权利的 Safety Retention 变体在「reasonably necessary to investigate or prevent severe risk activity」时适用,同样须事先书面通知;此时 OpenAI 可保留并人工复核其分类器判定可能违反使用政策或协议的内容,其余情况下保留不受影响

points.text: Response bodies carry a lower bound of their own: for /v1/responses the API keeps 30 days of Application State by default, or when `store` is set to `true`, and in those cases "response data will be stored for at least 30 days". points.text: No ZDR commitment exists for the consumer tier, and the official texts confine ZDR to the API enterprise side: the ZDR blog post opens with "Zero Data Retention gives eligible API customers a clear promise", your-data defines ZDR/MAM as API organization- and project-level controls subject to prior approval by OpenAI, and neither the consumer help center nor the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy contains any zero-retention statement addressed to individual subscriptions. This is "the vendor provides no commitment for this tier", not "no evidence could be obtained"

points.text: No fixed cap: regular and archived chats remain saved to the account until the user deletes them (or until a workspace retention policy applies)

points.text: The consumer tier carries no regional residency commitment; data is processed and stored across multiple jurisdictions and expressly includes the US: "Content is stored on OpenAI systems and our trusted service providers’ systems in the US and around the world"

points.text: The Privacy Policy says the same (servers located in various jurisdictions, including US facilities and the locations of affiliates, partners and service providers), and cross-border transfers are made only under lawful transfer mechanisms. training.quote: We use Content to provide our Services, comply with applicable law, enforce our terms and policies, and keep our Services safe. In addition, if you are using the Services through an unpaid account, we may use Content to further develop and improve our Services.

points.text: No no-training commitment covers the share pages. The only clause touching how Content is used is the contract layer: "In addition, if you are using the Services through an unpaid account, we may use Content to further develop and improve our Services." It is conditional on the account being unpaid and comes with no opt-out, so the conservative reading (mark=no) applies rather than a blanket permission.

points.quote: We use Content to provide our Services, comply with applicable law, enforce our terms and policies, and keep our Services safe. In addition, if you are using the Services through an unpaid account, we may use Content to further develop and improve our Services.

zdr.quote: Shared conversations remain accessible until you explicitly unshare them.

points.text: Shared conversations are kept, not zero-retained: "Shared conversations remain accessible until you explicitly unshare them." The only removal path is the user's /unshare, which "will remove the share link and delete the data related to the conversation" — no zero-retention option is offered for this path.

points.text: Object and context: once the optional /share feature is on (manual by default, or auto-share), the whole conversation is synced to the pages hosted at opencode.ai — "If a user enables the /share feature, the conversation and the data associated with it are sent to the service we use to host these share pages at opencode.ai." The retention rule covers full conversation history, all messages and responses, and session metadata.
points.text_zh: 对象与语境：开启可选的 /share（默认手动，也可设为 auto-share）后，整段会话被同步到 opencode.ai 托管的分享页——「If a user enables the /share feature, the conversation and the data associated with it are sent to the service we use to host these share pages at opencode.ai.」。保留的对象是完整会话历史、全部消息与回复、会话元数据。
points.quote: If a user enables the `/share` feature, the conversation and the data associated with it are sent to the service we use to host these share pages at opencode.ai.

points.text: Period type: there is no fixed term — retention lasts until the user revokes the share, and the revocation deletes the data: "This will remove the share link and delete the data related to the conversation." until_termination here means until the user unshares, not until the service ends.
points.text_zh: 期限类型：没有固定期限——保留持续到用户撤销分享，撤销时会删除数据（「This will remove the share link and delete the data related to the conversation.」）。此处的 until_termination 指「到用户 unshare 为止」，不是「到服务终止」。
points.quote: This will remove the share link and delete the data related to the conversation.

No official text defines whether a beta-free team workspace is an "unpaid account", so this row is not re-judged on that clause — it is recorded as an open question.
points.text_zh: 合同层适用性待澄清：Terms of Use 授权对 unpaid account 用 Content 改进服务，而 Zen 文档写「Workspaces are currently free for teams as a part of the beta」。beta 期免费的团队工作区是否算 unpaid account，官方文本没有界定，因此本行不据此改写结论，只记为待澄清项。
