training.quote: 我们可能会对收集的信息进行去标识化地研究、统计分析和预测，用于改善本平台的内容和布局，改进我们的服务（包括使用匿名数据进行机器学习或模型算法训练），则此类处理后数据的使用无需另行向您通知并征得您的同意。

points.text: The gateway pages do not themselves disclose a training use. What they say is that gateway request records may include prompts, tool calls and streamed output and may be used for "troubleshooting, auditing or follow-up analysis", and that "before call records are used for fine-tuning or retraining, complete authorization confirmation under the enterprise's data management process" — the object of that authorization step is the enterprise's own data-management process, not a statement of the vendor's training use; the vendor makes no "not used for training by default" commitment and gives the customer no switch.
points.text_zh: 网关页本身没有披露训练用途：它只说请求记录可含 Prompt、工具调用及流式输出，用于排障、审计或后续分析，以及「将调用记录用于微调或再训练前，按企业的数据管理流程完成授权确认」——这一步的宾语是企业自己的数据管理流程，不是厂商训练用途的披露；官方也没有承诺「默认不用于训练」，没有给客户开关。
points.quote: 网关的请求记录可包含 Prompt、工具调用及流式输出，用于排障、审计或后续分析。使用日志时需要明确部署中的收集范围、存储位置、访问权限与保留规则；这些规则由实际配置和企业数据要求共同决定。

points.text: The determination therefore rests on the Privacy Policy that also covers this platform service (community tier §1(5)3): information collected, once de-identified or anonymized, may be used for machine learning or model algorithm training without further notice or consent, so value is permitted and this tier points the same way as the community tier. Confidence only reaches medium: that wording sits in a Kubernetes/Helm self-deployment context and the SaaS-side values are not disclosed item by item, and the upstream is a third-party commercial API whose own training use of request bodies is outside the coverage of OpenCSG's documents (a multi-hop chain, where a no on any hop makes the whole chain no).
points.text_zh: 故本档判定依据的是同样覆盖本平台服务的《传神社区隐私政策》§一（五）3：去标识化/匿名化后的收集信息可用于机器学习或模型算法训练，无需另行通知与同意，value 取 permitted，方向与社区档一致。置信度只能到 medium：该口径写在面向 Kubernetes/Helm 自部署的语境里、SaaS 侧取值官方未逐项披露，且上游是第三方商业 API，上游对请求正文的训练用途不在 OpenCSG 文件覆盖范围内（多跳链路，任一跳为否即全链为否）。
points.quote: 我们可能会对收集的信息进行去标识化地研究、统计分析和预测，用于改善本平台的内容和布局，改进我们的服务（包括使用匿名数据进行机器学习或模型算法训练），则此类处理后数据的使用无需另行向您通知并征得您的同意。

points.text: A processing step disclosed on the same page: AI Gateway can run content checks on model inputs and outputs — enterprise editions can configure a sensitive-word check chain, an optional LLM content-safety guard and plugin-based security scanning services — so request and response content may be inspected and may pass through a moderation model service; where the deployment supports it, explicitly configured trusted requests skip detection. The configuration items (aigateway.moderation.*) are written for self-deployment and the SaaS-side values are not disclosed, so this is the platform's stated capability rather than an SaaS parameter. It does not change the mark.
points.text_zh: 同页披露的处理环节：AI Gateway 可对模型输入与输出执行内容检测——企业版可配置敏感词检测链、可选的 LLM 内容安全守卫与插件接入的安全扫描服务——即请求与响应正文可能被检测、并可能经过审核模型服务；部署支持时，明确配置的可信请求可跳过检测。配置项（aigateway.moderation.*）面向自部署、SaaS 侧取值未披露，故这只是平台口径而非 SaaS 参数。不改变 mark。
points.quote: AI Gateway 可以对模型输入与输出执行内容检测

points.text: The gateway tier offers no zero-retention option, switch or application path
points.text_zh: 网关档没有任何零保留选项、开关或申请方式

points.text: None of the 590 URLs on the docs site is a ZDR or DPA page. Multi-hop note: the upstream is a third-party commercial API, and whether ZDR can be applied for separately on each hop is not disclosed; this ledger does not infer from that that the hops can be combined into an enabled ZDR.
points.text_zh: 文档站 590 条 URL 无 ZDR/DPA 页。多跳提示：上游为第三方商业 API，各跳能否单独申请 ZDR 官方未披露，本台账不据此推定可组合开通。

retention.summary: 按对象分列未公布期限
retention.quote: 网关请求记录可包括输入 Prompt、工具调用和输出内容，适用于审计、效果分析以及经授权的数据分析。日志获取方式、字段与保留范围由部署配置决定

points.text: The clearest official statement for this tier is that there is no uniform period: for gateway request records (input prompts, tool calls, output content), "how logs are obtained, which fields they contain and the retention scope are determined by the deployment configuration"
points.text_zh: 本档最明确的官方口径就是「没有统一期限」：网关请求记录（输入 Prompt、工具调用、输出内容）的「日志获取方式、字段与保留范围由部署配置决定」
points.quote: 网关请求记录可包括输入 Prompt、工具调用和输出内容，适用于审计、效果分析以及经授权的数据分析。日志获取方式、字段与保留范围由部署配置决定

points.text: Request records are also meant to be exported and handled by people: the troubleshooting page asks that real credentials be removed before submitting logs and that the call content be handled under enterprise rules — the records are taken out of the platform and looked at, which is exactly why credentials must be stripped first.
points.text_zh: 请求记录还会被导出并由人工处理：排障页要求「提交日志前移除真实凭据，并按企业规则处理调用正文」——记录本就是要拿出来看的，所以先要求剥离真实凭据。
points.quote: 提交日志前移除真实凭据，并按企业规则处理调用正文

points.text: On caching, the docs speak of "viewing how the upstream reuses the cache of the input context", and billing includes input cache hits (cached_price_per_million), but cache retention and purge rules are not disclosed anywhere in these pages. Note also: this wording sits in the configuration context of Kubernetes/Helm self-deployment, and the corresponding values on the SaaS side are not disclosed item by item — it cannot be taken as the SaaS retention parameter, nor read in reverse as "the SaaS side retains nothing".
points.text_zh: 缓存方面「查看上游对输入上下文的缓存复用情况」，且计费含输入缓存命中（cached_price_per_million），但缓存条目的保留时长与清除规则全文未披露。另注意：该口径写在面向 Kubernetes/Helm 自部署的配置语境里，SaaS 侧对应取值官方未逐项披露——不能把它当成 SaaS 的保留期参数，也不能反推「SaaS 不保留」。
points.quote: 查看上游对输入上下文的缓存复用情况

processing_region.quote: 请求内容会发送到路由选中的上游模型服务。需要将数据保留在企业内部时，请同时检查主用和备用上游，选择符合企业数据要求的服务。

points.text: Gateway tier conclusion: request content is sent to the upstream model service selected by routing (including the fallback upstream), the processing location is determined by the upstream and the routing configuration, and the platform does not disclose its list of upstreams
points.text_zh: 网关档结论：请求正文发往路由选中的上游（含备用上游），处理地由上游与路由配置决定，平台未披露上游清单

points.text: The platform does commit to storing "the user information it collects" within China (Privacy Policy §3(1)), but that commitment does not cover the upstream's processing of request bodies. The public model list corroborates that the upstreams include third-party commercial APIs (llm_type=external_llm).
points.text_zh: 平台自身对「收集的用户信息」有境内存储承诺（隐私政策 §三（一）），但该承诺不覆盖上游对请求正文的处理。公开模型列表可佐证上游含第三方商业 API（llm_type=external_llm）。

role.quote: 本协议仅针对您在本产品之数据、模型上传与下载，应用空间体验以及参与竞赛等活动，不包括第三方向您提供的服务。

points.text: The role determination rests on the contract layer, not on the request-routing sentence: User Agreement §1.1 places third-party services outside the agreement's own scope (it covers only data/model upload and download, app-space experience and competitions in this product, and "does not include services provided to you by third parties"), and the platform makes no commitment to act as the customer's entrusted processor. The public text contains no controller/processor terminology, so this is a position read off the agreement's boundaries rather than a designated role.
points.text_zh: 角色判定落在合同层，不在「请求正文发往上游」那句上：用户协议 §一1 把第三方服务排除在协议范围外（仅针对数据、模型上传下载、应用空间体验与竞赛等活动，「不包括第三方向您提供的服务」），平台未承诺作为客户的受托处理者。公开原文没有出现控制者/受托方用语，故这是从协议边界推出的立场，不是原文指定的角色。
points.quote: 本协议仅针对您在本产品之数据、模型上传与下载，应用空间体验以及参与竞赛等活动，不包括第三方向您提供的服务。

points.text: User Agreement §6.3: disputes arising from third-party software or technology used by this product are to be settled by the third party, and "we bear no relevant liability" — the platform does not take on the upstream's responsibility.
points.text_zh: 用户协议 §六3：本产品所使用的第三方软件或技术所引发的任何纠纷应由相关第三方负责解决，「我方不承担相关责任」——平台不与上游同责。
points.quote: 就本产品所使用的第三方软件或技术所引发的任何纠纷，应由相关第三方负责解决，我方不承担相关责任

points.text: Gateway tier: the platform is a gateway and forwarder and does not disclose the upstream entities. (Background only — docs/model_access is not registered as a source in this file and has no snapshot — is that for commercial APIs the administrator configures the upstream endpoint and the provider credentials, i.e. the upstream relationship is configured on the customer side.)
points.text_zh: 网关档：平台是网关/转发方，未披露各上游主体。（仅为背景——docs/model_access 在本文件里未登记为来源、没有快照——说明商业 API 由管理员配置上游 Endpoint 与供应商凭据，即上游关系由客户侧配置。）

points.text: Privacy Policy §1(5)3: collected information, once de-identified or anonymized, may be used for machine learning or model algorithm training, and such use requires no separate notification to you or consent from you — the clause itself rules your choice out, and the same resource bundle describes no in-product training opt-out, so no mode is recorded (mark=no with no mode reads as "permitted by the terms").
points.text_zh: 隐私政策 §一（五）3：去标识化/匿名化后的收集信息可用于机器学习或模型算法训练，且此类使用无需另行通知并征得您的同意——条款本身把用户选择排除在外，整份资源包里也没有任何产品内训练退出开关，故不记 mode（mark=no 无 mode 读作「条款允许训练」）。
points.quote: 我们可能会对收集的信息进行去标识化地研究、统计分析和预测，用于改善本平台的内容和布局，改进我们的服务（包括使用匿名数据进行机器学习或模型算法训练），则此类处理后数据的使用无需另行向您通知并征得您的同意。

points.text: The parallel clauses on this tier are the User Agreement's right to review your input data and synthesized results by technical or manual means — manual review means input content may be seen by people — and the perpetual, irrevocable licence over "contributed content" (whose object is uploaded models and datasets, not API request bodies).
points.text_zh: 同档并列条款为用户协议对输入与合成结果的技术或人工审核权（人工审核意味着输入内容可能被人接触），以及对「贡献内容」的永久不可撤销许可（对象是上传的模型/数据集，不是 API 正文）。
points.quote: 我们会依法采取技术或者人工方式对您的输入数据和合成结果进行审核

points.text: Same as top-level zdr: neither the policy document nor the site-wide resource bundle contains any zero-retention or no-storage statement, and there is no DPA entry point (/dpa, /trust, /security and /compliance all 302 → /errors/not-found → 404).
points.text_zh: 同顶层 zdr：整份政策载体与全站资源包无零保留/不存储表述，无 DPA 入口（/dpa /trust /security /compliance 均 302→/errors/not-found→404）。

retention.quote: 我们只会在达成本政策所述目的所需的期限内保留您的用户信息，除非受到法律的允许。超出上述用户信息保存期限后，我们会对您的个人信息进行删除或匿名化处理。

points.text: Object = user information, default context: kept only for the period needed to achieve the purposes stated in this policy (an unquantified ceiling, purpose-bound), and beyond that period deleted or anonymized.
points.text_zh: 对象=用户信息，默认语境：只在达成本政策所述目的所需的期限内保留（未量化的上限，目的绑定），超出后删除或匿名化。
points.quote: 我们只会在达成本政策所述目的所需的期限内保留您的用户信息，除非受到法律的允许。超出上述用户信息保存期限后，我们会对您的个人信息进行删除或匿名化处理。

points.text: Object = information you provided or generated while using the service, context = after you delete your user information or close the account: the platform stops serving you, but that information still has to be kept for the time required by regulators — a floor, and a direct denial of "deleted on termination".
points.text_zh: 对象=您在使用服务期间提供或产生的信息，语境=主动删除/注销之后：平台停止为您提供服务，但这些信息仍需按监管要求的时间保存——这是下限，直接否定「终止即删除」。
points.quote: 在您主动删除用户信息之后，我们将停止为您提供服务，但您在使用服务期间提供或产生的信息我们仍需按照监管要求的时间进行保存。

points.text: Object = user information, context = the platform ceases operation: reasonable measures to protect it, including stopping further collection and deleting or anonymizing the personal information held.
points.text_zh: 对象=用户信息，语境=平台停止运营：采取合理措施保护，包括停止继续收集、对所持有的个人信息进行删除或匿名化处理。
points.quote: 如出现本平台停止运营的情形，我们会采取合理措施保护您用户信息安全

points.text: Object = information you have "stored in this product", context = the feature is cancelled: your rights in the product end immediately and that information may not be recoverable — this is not a retention period but the absence of any guarantee after termination.
points.text_zh: 对象=您在本产品中「储存的信息」，语境=功能取消：权益即刻终止，信息可能无法找回——这不是保留期限，是终止后不保证。
points.quote: 一经取消功能，您使用本产品的权益即刻终止，您在本产品中所储存的信息可能无法找回

points.text: Object = records of unlawful content, context = reporting as required by law: such records are preserved and reported to the cyberspace authorities and competent departments.
points.text_zh: 对象=违法内容相关记录，语境=依法报告：我们会依法保存有关记录，并向网信部门和有关主管部门报告。
points.quote: 我们会依法保存有关记录，并向网信部门和有关主管部门报告

points.text: Deletion is on request, not automatic: in the situations listed in the policy you may ask us to delete your user information. A deletion request is a user-initiated right — it is not expiry on a schedule, and it is not a training opt-out switch either.
points.text_zh: 删除是「可申请」而非自动到期：在政策列举的情形中您可以提出删除用户信息的请求。删除请求权是用户主动行使的权利——不等于到期自动删除，也不构成训练退出开关。
points.quote: 在以下情形中，您可以向我们提出删除用户信息的请求：

processing_region.quote: 我们将收集到的您的用户信息存放在中华人民共和国境内

points.text: See top-level processing_region: user information collected by the platform is in principle stored within the territory of the People's Republic of China, and any cross-border transfer requires separate consent and notification.
points.text_zh: 见顶层 processing_region：平台收集的用户信息原则上境内存储，出境需单独同意并告知。

role.quote: 在您使用本平台的产品和服务的过程中，我们会如何收集、使用、共享、存储和保护您的个人信息以及您可以如何管理您的个人信息

points.text: The platform speaks of itself as the party that collects, uses, shares, stores and protects your personal information, i.e. it stands on the controller side. This quote is only the policy's opening statement of purpose and scope, though: the public text never uses controller / processor / entrusted-party terminology, so the role is read off the structure of the policy rather than designated in it.
points.text_zh: 平台以「我们/本平台」为收集、使用、共享、存储和保护您个人信息的主体，即站在控制者一侧。但该句只是隐私政策开篇的目的与范围陈述：公开原文通篇没有出现控制者/受托方这类角色指定用语，角色是从政策结构推出的，不是原文指定的。
points.quote: 在您使用本平台的产品和服务的过程中，我们会如何收集、使用、共享、存储和保护您的个人信息以及您可以如何管理您的个人信息

points.text: Privacy Policy §2(1)3: the platform may entrust trusted partners to provide services and may share certain user information with them, and those partners have no right to use the shared information for any other purpose — the entrustment runs platform → partner, not customer → platform.
points.text_zh: 隐私政策 §二（一）3：平台可能委托受信赖的合作伙伴来提供服务并与伙伴共享某些用户信息，且合作伙伴无权将共享信息用于任何其他用途——委托方向是「平台委托、伙伴受托」，不是「平台是客户的受托方」。
points.quote: 我们可能委托受信赖的合作伙伴来提供服务，因此我们可能会与合作伙伴共享您的某些用户信息

points.text: User Agreement §5.2: for content generated by deep-processing with the product's models, "ownership and related rights belong to us and the lawful rights holders", and the platform calls itself the technology provider and lawful rights holder — a rights-holder stance, which is incompatible with acting merely as a processor.
points.text_zh: 用户协议 §五2：对用户利用本产品模型深度加工生成的内容，「其所有权和相关权益均由我们和法定权利人所有」，平台自认技术提供者和法定权利人——这是权利人立场，与「仅为受托处理者」不相容。
points.quote: 其所有权和相关权益均由我们和法定权利人所有

points.text: User Agreement §1.1 draws the agreement's own boundary: it covers only data/model upload and download, app-space experience and competitions in this product, and does not include services provided to you by third parties.
points.text_zh: 用户协议 §一1 自设协议边界：仅针对本产品之数据、模型上传与下载、应用空间体验以及参与竞赛等活动，不包括第三方向您提供的服务。
points.quote: 本协议仅针对您在本产品之数据、模型上传与下载，应用空间体验以及参与竞赛等活动，不包括第三方向您提供的服务。

points.text: No commitment to act as the customer's entrusted processor, and no DPA to sign.
points.text_zh: 无受托处理者承诺，无 DPA 可签。

training.quote: **Some Model Providers may use your Inputs and Outputs for model training or improvement.**

points.text: Whole-chain verdict. OpenRouter itself commits not to train, but the upstream hop decides the chain and that hop is a no: the privacy policy says "Some Model Providers may use your Inputs and Outputs for model training or improvement.", and terms §6.1 says the same at contract level ("Some Models may store or train on your Inputs for improving their own large language models and may allow you to opt-out of model training, as described in their Model Terms."). Under "a clear no on any hop makes the whole chain a no", this tier is treated as possibly used for training.
points.text_zh: 全链判定。OpenRouter 自身承诺不训练，但定全链的是上游那一跳，而那一跳为「否」：隐私政策明说「Some Model Providers may use your Inputs and Outputs for model training or improvement.」，terms §6.1 是同一件事的合同表述（「Some Models may store or train on your Inputs for improving their own large language models…」）。按「任一跳明确为否，则全链为否」，本档按可能用于训练处理。

points.text: OpenRouter's own hop only: "OpenRouter does not use your Inputs or Outputs for model training." That is the provider's own commitment and cannot settle the chain.
points.text_zh: 只覆盖 OpenRouter 自身这一跳：「OpenRouter does not use your Inputs or Outputs for model training.」这是厂商自身的承诺，定不了全链。
points.quote: **OpenRouter does not use your Inputs or Outputs for model training.**

points.text: Endpoints whose policy cannot be confirmed count as training: "If OpenRouter is not able to establish or ascertain a clear policy for a provider or endpoint, we take a conservative stance and assume that the endpoint both retains and trains on data and mark it as such."
points.text_zh: 政策无法确认的端点按会训练计：「If OpenRouter is not able to establish or ascertain a clear policy for a provider or endpoint, we take a conservative stance and assume that the endpoint both retains and trains on data and mark it as such.」
points.quote: we take a conservative stance and assume that the endpoint both retains and trains on data and mark it as such

points.text: Account settings and the request-level `data_collection` / `provider.zdr` parameters can restrict routing, but OpenRouter does not guarantee upstream compliance.
points.text_zh: 账户设置与请求级 `data_collection`/`provider.zdr` 可限制路由，但 OpenRouter 不保证上游合规。

zdr.quote: OpenRouter has privacy settings that, when enabled, only allow you to route to endpoints that have a Zero Data Retention policy. You can enforce ZDR globally, per model group, per guardrail, or per request.

points.text: Self-service enforcement, four ways: "You can enforce ZDR globally, per model group, per guardrail, or per request." — account privacy settings, per-model-group scopes, guardrails, and the request-level `provider.zdr: true` (the request parameter ORs with the account and guardrail settings).
points.text_zh: 自助强制，四种方式：「You can enforce ZDR globally, per model group, per guardrail, or per request.」即账户隐私设置、模型组范围、guardrail、请求级 `provider.zdr: true`（请求参数与账户/guardrail 设置取「或」）。

points.text: Supporting only: the DPA defines what ZDR means ("means OpenRouter does not persistently store API Payloads after completion of the applicable API request and response, except for transient processing in memory, short-lived buffering or caching strictly necessary to transmit, secure, or complete the request, and records required by law."). The definition itself does not say the option can be turned on; that comes from the enforcement clause above.
points.text_zh: 仅作辅证：DPA 给出 ZDR 的定义（「means OpenRouter does not persistently store API Payloads after completion of the applicable API request and response, except for transient processing in memory, short-lived buffering or caching strictly necessary to transmit, secure, or complete the request, and records required by law.」）。定义本身不含「可开通」之意，后者以上面的强制条款为准。
points.quote: means OpenRouter does not persistently store API Payloads after completion of the applicable API request and response, except for transient processing in memory, short-lived buffering or caching strictly necessary to transmit, secure, or complete the request, and records required by law.

points.text: Boundary of this tier's ZDR: with ZDR-only routing OpenRouter "will not route Customer API requests to AI Model Providers that are not designated as ZDR-eligible in OpenRouter's provider registry", but the list only "reflects the AI Model Provider's published or represented policy of "no retention and no training" on zero-data-retention API payloads; it does not constitute OpenRouter's guarantee of AI Model Provider compliance" — the upstream hop is still judged on its own.
points.text_zh: 本档 ZDR 的边界：启用 ZDR-only 路由时 OpenRouter「will not route Customer API requests to AI Model Providers that are not designated as ZDR-eligible in OpenRouter's provider registry」，但该名单只反映上游自称的政策，且「it does not constitute OpenRouter's guarantee of AI Model Provider compliance」——上游那一跳仍逐跳判定。
points.quote: it does not constitute OpenRouter's guarantee of AI Model Provider compliance

points.text: Unverified endpoints: "If OpenRouter is not able to establish or ascertain a clear policy for a provider or endpoint, we take a conservative stance and assume that the endpoint both retains and trains on data and mark it as such." So what ZDR buys depends on the endpoint being on the ZDR list.
points.text_zh: 未核实端点：「If OpenRouter is not able to establish or ascertain a clear policy for a provider or endpoint, we take a conservative stance and assume that the endpoint both retains and trains on data and mark it as such.」故 ZDR 的实际效果取决于端点是否在 ZDR 名单内。
points.quote: we take a conservative stance and assume that the endpoint both retains and trains on data and mark it as such

points.text: "ZDR enforcement only applies to provider routing for inference requests." — it does not cover plugins or web search.
points.text_zh: 只覆盖推理路由，不含 plugins 与 web search。

retention.summary: 按对象分列未公布期限
retention.quote: OpenRouter does not store your prompts or responses, _unless_ you opt in to one or both of the following

points.text: Object and context — inputs and outputs: by default "OpenRouter does not store your prompts or responses, _unless_ you opt in to one or both of the following" (private input & output logging, or letting OpenRouter use your inputs/outputs for a 1% discount). Periods for content stored after opting in vary by feature and are only pointed at feature documentation (terms §6.3(c): "Retention periods for User Content stored under this Section 6.3 vary by feature and are described in the applicable feature documentation"), so no period is published either by default or after opt-in.
points.text_zh: 对象与语境——输入输出：默认「OpenRouter does not store your prompts or responses, _unless_ you opt in to one or both of the following」（私有日志，或以 1% 折扣换取 OpenRouter 使用输入输出）。opt-in 后所存内容的期限按功能而定、只指向功能文档（terms §6.3(c)：「Retention periods for User Content stored under this Section 6.3 vary by feature and are described in the applicable feature documentation」），故默认与 opt-in 两种情形都没有公布期限。

points.text: What opting in means: terms §6.2 provides that you "grant OpenRouter a worldwide, perpetual, irrevocable, non-exclusive, royalty-free, fully paid right and license (with the right to sublicense) to host, store, transfer, display, perform, reproduce, modify for the purpose of formatting for display, adapt, translate, and prepare derivative works of, and distribute your User Content, in whole or in part, in any media formats and through any media channels now known or hereafter developed, for purposes of providing the Services to you and for our own commercial and business purposes."
points.text_zh: opt-in 的含义：terms §6.2 规定你「grant OpenRouter a worldwide, perpetual, irrevocable, non-exclusive, royalty-free, fully paid right and license (with the right to sublicense) to host, store, transfer, display, perform, reproduce, modify for the purpose of formatting for display, adapt, translate, and prepare derivative works of, and distribute your User Content, in whole or in part, in any media formats and through any media channels now known or hereafter developed, for purposes of providing the Services to you and for our own commercial and business purposes.」
points.quote: you grant OpenRouter a worldwide, perpetual, irrevocable, non-exclusive, royalty-free, fully paid right and license (with the right to sublicense) to host, store, transfer, display, perform, reproduce, modify for the purpose of formatting for display, adapt, translate, and prepare derivative works of, and distribute your User Content, in whole or in part, in any media formats and through any media channels now known or hereafter developed, for purposes of providing the Services to you and for our own commercial and business purposes.

points.text: That licence expressly includes example (3): "license or sell your User Content in anonymized form, where your User Content is not associated with you or your account." So any period given for logged content is a floor, not a deletion promise.
points.text_zh: 该许可明确含示例 (3)：「license or sell your User Content in anonymized form, where your User Content is not associated with you or your account.」故已记录内容的任何期限都只是下限，不是删除承诺。
points.quote: license or sell your User Content in anonymized form, where your User Content is not associated with you or your account.

points.text: Context — bulk/large-volume requests: terms §6.3(b) says certain features "such as batch or other large-volume request processing, require OpenRouter to temporarily store your User Content in order to process, route, and fulfill your request, including where the volume or size of a request cannot be processed in memory."
points.text_zh: 语境——批量/大体积请求：terms §6.3(b) 规定某些功能「such as batch or other large-volume request processing, require OpenRouter to temporarily store your User Content in order to process, route, and fulfill your request, including where the volume or size of a request cannot be processed in memory.」
points.quote: require OpenRouter to temporarily store your User Content in order to process, route, and fulfill your request, including where the volume or size of a request cannot be processed in memory.

points.text: Other object — Files API uploads: "Uploaded Files are retained by us until you delete them or close your account, subject to the exceptions described below."
points.text_zh: 另一类对象——Files API 上传文件：「Uploaded Files are retained by us until you delete them or close your account, subject to the exceptions described below.」
points.quote: Uploaded Files are retained by us until you delete them or close your account, subject to the exceptions described below.

points.text: Other object — image/audio/video inputs: "We do not persist image, audio or video files beyond the duration necessary to route the request, except as required for abuse detection, security, billing, or legal compliance."
points.text_zh: 另一类对象——图片/音频/视频输入：「We do not persist image, audio or video files beyond the duration necessary to route the request, except as required for abuse detection, security, billing, or legal compliance.」
points.quote: We do not persist image, audio or video files beyond the duration necessary to route the request, except as required for abuse detection, security, billing, or legal compliance.

points.text: Logs/metadata: "OpenRouter does store metadata (e.g. number of prompt and completion tokens, latency, etc) for each request." with no period given.
points.text_zh: 日志/元数据：「OpenRouter does store metadata (e.g. number of prompt and completion tokens, latency, etc) for each request.」无期限。
points.quote: OpenRouter does store metadata (e.g. number of prompt and completion tokens, latency, etc) for each request.

points.text: DPA customers can request deletion: "OpenRouter deletes Customer Data from the datastores and backups within 30 business days of request".
points.text_zh: DPA 客户可要求删除：「OpenRouter deletes Customer Data from the datastores and backups within 30 business days of request」。
points.quote: OpenRouter deletes Customer Data from the datastores and backups within 30 business days of request

processing_region.quote: Google Cloud Platform hosting in US regions; data at rest is region-restricted

points.text: See top-level processing_region. The default is "Google Cloud Platform hosting in US regions; data at rest is region-restricted"
points.text_zh: 见顶层 processing_region。默认 GCP US regions

points.text: In-region routing (EU/US) is a paid Business/Enterprise feature, and EU-only processing has its own DPA Exhibit A.
points.text_zh: in-region（EU/US）是 Business/Enterprise 付费功能，EU-only 另有 DPA Exhibit A。

role.quote: Customer is the Controller, and OpenRouter is the Processor

points.text: See top-level role. For customer personal data, "Customer is the Controller, and OpenRouter is the Processor"
points.text_zh: 见顶层 role。对客户个人数据 OpenRouter 是 Processor

points.text: For site and account data it uses the data in its own right as a controller (marketing, analytics).
points.text_zh: 对站点/账户数据它自己以控制者身份使用（营销、分析）。

training.quote: **Some Model Providers may use your Inputs and Outputs for model training or improvement.**

points.text: Whole-chain verdict, same as the API tier: OpenRouter itself commits not to train, but the upstream hop is a no — the privacy policy says "Some Model Providers may use your Inputs and Outputs for model training or improvement.", and BYOK does not change that: "Training (`data_collection`) restrictions still follow the policy that OpenRouter tracks for the endpoint."
points.text_zh: 全链判定，同 API 档：OpenRouter 自身承诺不训练，但上游那一跳为「否」——隐私政策明说「Some Model Providers may use your Inputs and Outputs for model training or improvement.」，而 BYOK 不改变这一点：「Training (`data_collection`) restrictions still follow the policy that OpenRouter tracks for the endpoint.」

points.text: Training restrictions on a BYOK request are still the endpoint's, and BYOK changes neither the routing pool nor the data policy: "Your data policies apply to BYOK endpoints. A BYOK key changes the credential for the upstream request. It does not change which endpoints you can route to."
points.text_zh: BYOK 请求的训练限制仍按端点政策，且 BYOK 既不改变可路由端点也不改变 data policy：「Your data policies apply to BYOK endpoints. A BYOK key changes the credential for the upstream request. It does not change which endpoints you can route to.」
points.quote: Training (`data_collection`) restrictions still follow the policy that OpenRouter tracks for the endpoint.

points.text: Endpoints whose policy cannot be confirmed count as training: "If OpenRouter is not able to establish or ascertain a clear policy for a provider or endpoint, we take a conservative stance and assume that the endpoint both retains and trains on data and mark it as such."
points.text_zh: 政策无法确认的端点按会训练计：「If OpenRouter is not able to establish or ascertain a clear policy for a provider or endpoint, we take a conservative stance and assume that the endpoint both retains and trains on data and mark it as such.」
points.quote: we take a conservative stance and assume that the endpoint both retains and trains on data and mark it as such

points.text: The upstream hop is governed by your own agreement with that provider (which OpenRouter cannot see).
points.text_zh: 上游那一跳以你自己与厂商的协议为准（OpenRouter 看不到该协议）。

zdr.quote: Some providers give your own account zero data retention. The shared endpoint that OpenRouter tracks for that provider can still retain prompts. OpenRouter cannot see your provider agreement.

points.text: By default a BYOK key does not exempt you from ZDR restrictions: an endpoint that retains prompts stays blocked ("When you do, an endpoint that retains prompts stays blocked. Your own key does not change that."). The exception is a key whose "Provider agreement → Zero data retention" is declared as "My account has ZDR", which is let through; the declaration **does not cover video generation**, and OpenRouter says plainly that "OpenRouter cannot see your provider agreement", i.e. it is the customer's own attestation, not verification by OpenRouter.
points.text_zh: 默认情况下 BYOK 键不豁免 ZDR 限制：端点会保留 prompt 时仍被拦（「When you do, an endpoint that retains prompts stays blocked. Your own key does not change that.」）。例外是 key 上「Provider agreement → Zero data retention」声明为「My account has ZDR」时放行，声明**不覆盖视频生成**，且 OpenRouter 明说「OpenRouter cannot see your provider agreement」，即这只是客户自述、不是 OpenRouter 的核验。

points.text: Even with a declaration in place, endpoints whose policy cannot be confirmed count as retaining: "If OpenRouter is not able to establish or ascertain a clear policy for a provider or endpoint, we take a conservative stance and assume that the endpoint both retains and trains on data and mark it as such."
points.text_zh: 即便有声明，政策无法确认的端点仍按保留计：「If OpenRouter is not able to establish or ascertain a clear policy for a provider or endpoint, we take a conservative stance and assume that the endpoint both retains and trains on data and mark it as such.」
points.quote: we take a conservative stance and assume that the endpoint both retains and trains on data and mark it as such

points.text_zh: OpenRouter 这一跳同默认档：「OpenRouter does not store your prompts or responses, _unless_ you opt in to one or both of the following」；opt-in 后的期限按功能而定、只指向功能文档（terms §6.3(c)）。

points.text_zh: opt-in 的含义：terms §6.2 授予 OpenRouter「worldwide, perpetual, irrevocable, non-exclusive, royalty-free, fully paid right and license (with the right to sublicense) to host, store, transfer, display, perform, reproduce, modify for the purpose of formatting for display, adapt, translate, and prepare derivative works of, and distribute your User Content, in whole or in part, in any media formats and through any media channels now known or hereafter developed, for purposes of providing the Services to you and for our own commercial and business purposes.」
points.quote: you grant OpenRouter a worldwide, perpetual, irrevocable, non-exclusive, royalty-free, fully paid right and license (with the right to sublicense) to host, store, transfer, display, perform, reproduce, modify for the purpose of formatting for display, adapt, translate, and prepare derivative works of, and distribute your User Content, in whole or in part, in any media formats and through any media channels now known or hereafter developed, for purposes of providing the Services to you and for our own commercial and business purposes.

points.quote: require OpenRouter to temporarily store your User Content in order to process, route, and fulfill your request, including where the volume or size of a request cannot be processed in memory.

points.text_zh: 另一类对象——图片/音频/视频输入：「We do not persist image, audio or video files beyond the duration necessary to route the request, except as required for abuse detection, security, billing, or legal compliance.」
points.quote: We do not persist image, audio or video files beyond the duration necessary to route the request, except as required for abuse detection, security, billing, or legal compliance.

points.text: The upstream hop is determined by the customer's own agreement, which OpenRouter does not disclose on their behalf.
points.text_zh: 上游那一跳由客户自有协议决定，OpenRouter 不代为披露。

processing_region.quote: On a regional domain, OpenRouter routes only to endpoints it has onboarded for that region (see In-Region Routing). OpenRouter cannot see where your own OpenAI account processes requests, so you tell OpenRouter.

points.text: Region rests on a declaration: "On a regional domain, OpenRouter routes only to endpoints it has onboarded for that region (see In-Region Routing). OpenRouter cannot see where your own OpenAI account processes requests, so you tell OpenRouter." The Data region setting on a key offers Global / European Union / United States, and the declaration is the customer's attestation — "OpenRouter does not verify it".
points.text_zh: 区域靠声明：「On a regional domain, OpenRouter routes only to endpoints it has onboarded for that region (see In-Region Routing). OpenRouter cannot see where your own OpenAI account processes requests, so you tell OpenRouter.」key 上的 Data region 有 Global / European Union / United States 三档，声明是客户自述——「OpenRouter does not verify it」。

points.text: A region declaration does not change the key's retention policy ("A region declaration does not change your key's retention policy.").
points.text_zh: 区域声明不改变 key 的保留政策（「A region declaration does not change your key's retention policy.」）。

points.text_zh: 就 OpenRouter 自己处理的那部分数据仍是 Processor

points.text: But on the BYOK tier there is a further direct relationship between the customer and the upstream vendor (the customer holds the key), and the upstream's use of content is determined by that agreement.
points.text_zh: 但 BYOK 档下客户与上游厂商之间另有一层直接关系（客户自持密钥），上游对内容的使用由该协议决定。

training.quote: **Some Model Providers may use your Inputs and Outputs for model training or improvement.**

points.text: Whole-chain verdict, same as the API tier: the upstream hop is a no — the privacy policy says "Some Model Providers may use your Inputs and Outputs for model training or improvement.", and the FAQ states "The same data privacy applies to the chatroom as the API.", so that section covers the Chatroom too.
points.text_zh: 全链判定，同 API 档：上游那一跳为「否」——隐私政策明说「Some Model Providers may use your Inputs and Outputs for model training or improvement.」，FAQ 又写明「The same data privacy applies to the chatroom as the API.」，故该节同样覆盖 Chatroom。

points.text: The Chatroom shares the API's data privacy: "The same data privacy applies to the chatroom as the API."
points.text_zh: Chatroom 与 API 是同一套数据隐私口径：「The same data privacy applies to the chatroom as the API.」
points.quote: The same data privacy applies to the chatroom as the API.

points.text: OpenRouter itself does not train on inputs or outputs ("OpenRouter does not use your Inputs or Outputs for model training."), but that covers its own hop only.
points.text_zh: OpenRouter 自身不训练输入输出（「OpenRouter does not use your Inputs or Outputs for model training.」），但只覆盖自身这一跳。
points.quote: **OpenRouter does not use your Inputs or Outputs for model training.**

points.text: Upstreams still follow their own policies, and the "Model Provider Data Practices" section of the privacy policy applies to the Chatroom as well.

training.quote: **Note:** All prompts and completions for this model are logged by the provider and may be used to improve the model.

points.text: The upstream hop on the free tier is a no: for each free/anonymous model listed at the time, the model catalogue page discloses "All prompts and completions for this model are logged by the provider and may be used to improve the model." (a few entries read "logged by the model creator for feedback and training"). OpenRouter itself still commits not to train (the same privacy policy clause applies to the free tier), but under "a clear no on any hop makes the whole chain a no", the free tier's whole chain should be treated as **possibly used for training**. Control: account settings have a separate training toggle for free models (provider-logging: "There are separate settings for paid and free models."). Uncertainty: that list is dynamic and OpenRouter writes no separate clause for the free tier in its policy documents — this point rests on the per-model disclosures on the model catalogue page, not on policy text.
points.text_zh: 免费档的上游那一跳为「否」：模型目录页对当时列出的免费/匿名模型逐条披露「All prompts and completions for this model are logged by the provider and may be used to improve the model.」（个别条目为「logged by the model creator for feedback and training」）。OpenRouter 自身仍承诺不训练（隐私政策同一条适用于免费档），但按「任一跳明确为否，则全链为否」，免费档全链应视为**可能用于训练**。控制手段：账户设置里 free 档有独立的训练开关（provider-logging「There are separate settings for paid and free models.」）。不确定性：该清单是动态的，且 OpenRouter 未在政策文档中单独为免费档写条款——本条依据是模型目录页的逐模型披露，不是政策文本。

zdr.quote: **Note:** All prompts and completions for this model are logged by the provider and may be used to improve the model.

points.text: Whole-chain verdict. OpenRouter's own hop has a ZDR policy, but on the free tier the weak hop is upstream: the model catalogue page discloses for the free/anonymous models listed at the time that "**Note:** All prompts and completions for this model are logged by the provider and may be used to improve the model." Enforcing ZDR then removes those endpoints, so "free tier + ZDR" holds only for the free endpoints that are on the ZDR list — which cannot be confirmed in advance from the public pages (the list is a dynamic table).
points.text_zh: 全链判定。OpenRouter 自身这一跳有 ZDR 政策，但免费档的弱跳在上游：模型目录页对当时列出的免费/匿名模型披露「All prompts and completions for this model are logged by the provider and may be used to improve the model.」。强制 ZDR 会把这些端点排除，故「免费档 + ZDR」只在免费端点位于 ZDR 名单内时成立，公开页面无法预先确认（清单是动态表格）。

points.text: AI Tools 档（AI Training / AI Notebooks / AI Deploy）的合同附录 7 完全没有「数据是否用于训练」的条款——与 AI Endpoints 附录 10 §5 的逐字不重用条款形成对比。可用的最接近依据是通用层：EU DPA §1.1「as a Processor acting under Client's instruction, to process the Controller's Personal Data to the extent necessary to provide the Services」+「OVHcloud shall process Personal Data only under the Client's instruction」+ GTS §6.2.2「does not exercise prior control over the Content and has no knowledge of it」——即 OVHcloud 只能按客户指示、为提供服务所必需而处理，不得另作训练用途。这是受托处理者的目的限制推导，不是厂商逐字的「不训练」承诺，故 confidence=medium，且必须注明本档缺 AI Tools 专用训练条款。另注意术语陷阱：AI Training 的产品语义是「客户自己训练模型」，与「厂商拿客户数据训练自己的模型」是两件事，不要混读。

points.text: Structured conclusion: the cited contract clause states an affirmative retention period for this tier's data ("It is permanently deleted thirty (30) days after the Client deletes a Notebook, unless the Client decides otherwise."), and the service is designed around persistent storage, with no ZDR option or application path anywhere in Annex 7. The tier is therefore recorded as mark=no (terms state retention) rather than as undisclosed.

role.quote: as a Processor acting under Client’s instruction, to process the Controller’s Personal Data to the extent necessary to provide the Services.

points.text: 与 API 档同源：EU/IE DPA 的 Processor 定性 + GTS 实体 OVH Hosting Limited + Annex Sub-processors。AI Tools 附录 7 本身同样不写角色条款（不同于附录 4/8 的逐字 sub-processor 表述），故 role 依据仍是通用 DPA。本档的差别在介入面：客户数据（训练数据、Notebook 内容、容器镜像）位于客户自管实例，OVHcloud 主要做资源编排与运维——附录 7 §2.2 逐字「The Resources are dedicated to the Client. They are hosted, managed and maintained in operational condition by OVHcloud for the entire duration of the use of the Service.」边界说明（与 API 档同源）：DPA 目的条款之后逐字接「excluding the personal data processing activities performed by OVHcloud as a controller. The conditions into which OVHcloud processes, as a Controller, Personal Data relating to the Client (including the Client's agents), are defined in the OVHcloud Data Usage Policy.」——role=processor 只覆盖「作为服务一部分」的客户内容处理，OVHcloud 以 controller 身份处理客户（含其代理人）个人数据的条件由 OVHcloud Data Usage Policy 管辖；该政策尚未纳入本文件 [[source]]，机器不可复核，只作发现线索。

zdr.quote: It is permanently deleted thirty (30) days after the Customer deletes a Notebook, unless the Customer decides otherwise.

points.text: Structured conclusion: the cited US Service-Specific Terms §9.3.3 states an affirmative retention period for this tier's data ("It is permanently deleted thirty (30) days after the Customer deletes a Notebook, unless the Customer decides otherwise."), and the AI Tools Service is designed around persistent storage, with no ZDR option or application path anywhere in §9 or in the US DPA. The tier is therefore recorded as mark=no (terms state retention), in line with the EU tier, rather than as undisclosed — an anchor is bound to this verdict, and a found clause cannot be reported as not_found.
points.text_zh: 结构化结论：US 条款 §9.3.3 对本档数据正面写明保留期（「It is permanently deleted thirty (30) days after the Customer deletes a Notebook, unless the Customer decides otherwise.」），且该服务按设计包含持久存储，§9 与 US DPA 全文都没有 ZDR 选项或申请入口。据此记 mark=no（条款明示会留存），与 EU 档口径一致；本维度已绑引文，不再记 unknown（引文找到了就不能判未披露）。

training.quote: OVHcloud has no knowledge of Inputs and Outputs, and OVHcloud does not reuse them in any way.

points.text: API 档结论：不用于训练——但合同层与营销层的措辞强度不同，必须并列。①合同层（最高优先级文件，附录 10 §5）逐字：「OVHcloud has no knowledge of Inputs and Outputs, and OVHcloud does not reuse them in any way. OVHcloud does not carry out any backups of Inputs or Outputs.」条款说的是「no knowledge / does not reuse」，不是逐字「不训练」。②逐字「不训练」只在官方产品页（official_blog 层）：「Your data will never be used to train or improve our AI models; one of our many security guarantees.」③文档层：getting-started「we do not store user data」、capabilities「Data is not stored or shared during or after model use」。三点限定：(a) Batch API 是 §5 明文例外（「This does not apply for the AI Endpoint Batch API Service.」），条款未说明该临时存储能否被用于训练或改进模型

points.text: API 档结论：默认即零保留，无需申请或开通，但两个口径必须写清。①合同层：附录 10 §2「does not include backup or storage, even if it is temporary」+ §5「no knowledge…does not reuse…does not carry out any backups」，零保留是本产品的结构性属性（服务不含存储），不是可选开关、也不需要补充协议——与需要单独申请 ZDR 计划的厂商在制度上不同。②例外：Batch API 明文不在零保留范围内（§2 括注、§5 末句「This does not apply for the AI Endpoint Batch API Service.」），其输出/错误文件在平台保留 15 天。③旁证：产品页「Zero data retention: We keep only the data required for billing purposes.」（全库唯一逐字出现 Zero data retention 之处，属营销层）

points.text: 按对象分开读，条款层不给天数：①输入输出正文（同步推理）——附录 10 §2「The AI Endpoints Service does not include backup or storage, even if it is temporary」+ §5「does not carry out any backups of Inputs or Outputs」，即合同上服务不含任何（哪怕临时的）存储与备份，故不存在可量化保留期；结构化字段据此记 basis=none（输入输出不留存），不写天数——本档唯一被量化的期限（15 天）属于下条的 Batch 例外，不能读成「输入输出保留 15 天」

role.quote: OVHcloud is entitled, as a Processor and as part of the Services defined in the Agreement, to carry out the processing of Personal Data on behalf of, and on instructions from the Client

points.text: API 档结论：OVHcloud 在协议上自认 processor（受托处理方）——但依据来自通用 DPA 与 GTS，不来自 AI Endpoints 自己的产品条款。附录 10 内没有任何 data processing / 角色条款，这一点可与同一份 SC 的其他附录对照：附录 4（DBaaS）与附录 8（Managed Rancher）逐字写「OVHcloud carries out processing of personal data as a sub-processor on the instructions of the Client」，附录 6（Quantum）反而写「In order to provide the Service, OVHcloud does not process personal data as a processor or access the Client Content」，附录 10 两者皆无，只有 §5「The Client is responsible for Inputs and Outputs.」与「OVHcloud has no knowledge of Inputs and Outputs」。依据链：①EU/IE 版 DPA（Version dated on 17.10.2025）抬头「entered into between OVH Hosting Ltd. … and the Client」，目的条款「OVHcloud is entitled, as a Processor and as part of the Services defined in the Agreement, to carry out the processing of Personal Data on behalf of, and on instructions from the Client」，§1.1「as a Processor acting under Client's instruction」。边界说明（DPA 目的条款紧接的 carve-out，已并入 eudpa-processor-purpose 的 suffix 一并覆盖）：目的条款之后逐字接「excluding the personal data processing activities performed by OVHcloud as a controller. The conditions into which OVHcloud processes, as a Controller, Personal Data relating to the Client (including the Client's agents), are defined in the OVHcloud Data Usage Policy.」——即 role=processor 只覆盖「作为服务一部分」的请求内容处理；OVHcloud 以 controller 身份处理客户（含其代理人）个人数据（账号/用量一类）的条件由 OVHcloud Data Usage Policy 管辖。该政策尚未纳入本文件 [[source]]，机器不可复核，只能记为发现线索，待 bot 抓回快照后再引；它也不推翻本档的 processor 定性。

training.quote: Perplexity shall not use (or authorize third parties to use) Customer Content to train, retrain, fine-tune or otherwise improve any generative artificial intelligence models.

points.text: See the top-level training entry: §2.3.3 bars Perplexity and third parties alike from using Customer Content for training
points.text_zh: 见顶层 training：§2.3.3 同时禁止 Perplexity 与第三方用 Customer Content 训练

points.text: DPA §5 points the same way. Usage Data (§3.3) is outside that restriction.
points.text_zh: DPA §5 同向。Usage Data（§3.3）不在此限。
points.quote: For the avoidance of doubt, Personal Data will not be used for training of Perplexity’s large language models.

points.text: Multi-hop chain: the Services may utilize Third-Party Models provided by Third-Party Providers, and their terms are folded into the contract by §2.6; if Customer disagrees with any Third-Party Terms, its sole recourse is to cease all use of the relevant model. The trust-center subprocessor list names the model-provider hops (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Cloud, xAI, Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Azure).
points.text_zh: 多跳链路：服务可能调用第三方提供方（Third-Party Providers）的第三方模型，§2.6 把其条款并入合同；客户不同意 Third-Party Terms 的唯一救济是停用对应模型。trust center 子处理者清单列出的模型提供方跳为 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google Cloud、xAI、Amazon Bedrock、Microsoft Azure。
points.quote: The Services may utilize large language models and other models (“Third-Party Models”) developed and/or provided in whole or in part by third parties (“Third-Party Providers”)

points.text: Obligations are flowed down rather than erased: DPA §6c–e treats Model Providers as subcontractors, requires written agreements no less onerous than the DPA, and keeps Perplexity liable to Customer for their performance. This describes the chain only — it must not be read as proof that any hop can access content, nor that each hop's ZDR can be enabled in the same configuration.
points.text_zh: 义务是流下而非消失：DPA §6c–e 把 Model Provider 作为分包方，要求其书面义务不低于 DPA，并保留 Perplexity 对其履约的责任。此处只描述链路——不得据此推断某一跳能否访问内容，也不得推断各跳 ZDR 可在同一配置下同时开通。
points.quote: If Perplexity appoints a new subcontractor or intends to make any changes concerning the addition or replacement of any subcontractor that provides large language models or other generative artificial intelligence models (a “Model Provider”)

zdr.quote: Perplexity maintains a strict **Zero Data Retention Policy** for the Chat Completions API. We do not retain data sent through the Chat Completions API, and we do not use customer data to train our models or for any purpose beyond processing the immediate request.

points.text: Structured conclusion: zero retention by default, and the cited sentence is limited to the Chat Completions API. The same page adds that the only data collected through that API is billable metadata ("This billing metadata does not include any content from your prompts, responses, or other user data.").
points.text_zh: 结构化结论：默认零保留，且所引句子限定 Chat Completions API。同页说明该 API 只收集计费元数据（「This billing metadata does not include any content from your prompts, responses, or other user data.」）。
points.quote: This billing metadata does not include any content from your prompts, responses, or other user data.

points.text: The platform-level FAQ says the same without naming an endpoint ("By default, the API has zero day retention of user prompt data, which is never used for AI training."). Both wordings are kept side by side; the vendor does not clarify the scope difference.
points.text_zh: 平台级 FAQ 同向但未点名端点（「By default, the API has zero day retention of user prompt data, which is never used for AI training.」）。两种措辞并列保留，范围差异厂商未澄清。
points.quote: By default, the API has zero day retention of user prompt data, which is never used for AI training.

points.text: Scope note: this row records the Sonar / Chat Completions pay-as-you-go endpoints, so this zdr verdict is not a statement about the Agent API. The Agent API is a separate product line in this ledger (Perplexity Agent), where its server-side conversation state and the ZDR-by-agreement wording are recorded; the source note in this file also says that page cannot support an Agent API zdr verdict.
points.text_zh: 范围说明：本行记 Sonar / Chat Completions 按量端点，故本行 zdr 结论不涉及 Agent API。Agent API 在台账里是独立产品线（Perplexity Agent），服务端会话状态与「ZDR 需协议」的措辞记在那里；本文件的来源注亦声明该页不能支撑 Agent API 的 zdr 结论。

retention.quote: We do not retain any query data sent through the API and do not train on any of your data.

points.text: Structured conclusion: the FAQ states that the API does not retain query data ("We do not retain any query data sent through the API and do not train on any of your data."), so Input/Output is recorded as not retained. The FAQ does not name an endpoint; the privacy-security page limits the same commitment to the Chat Completions API.
points.text_zh: 结构化结论：FAQ 明说 API 不保留 query data（「We do not retain any query data sent through the API and do not train on any of your data.」），故输入输出记不留存。FAQ 未点名端点，privacy-security 页把同一承诺限定在 Chat Completions API。

points.text: Personal Data contained in Input is a different object and is not covered by that sentence: DPA Annex 1 stores it until the earlier of (a) the date it is deleted by Customer through the Services' interface and (b) the date that is thirty days after Perplexity is no longer providing the Services to Customer — a termination-anchored rule, not a retention period for non-personal Input/Output.
points.text_zh: Input 中的个人信息是另一个对象，不在该句覆盖范围内：DPA Annex 1 保留至「客户通过服务界面删除」与「Perplexity 停止提供服务后 30 天」两者较早者——以终止为锚点，不是非个人输入输出的保留期限。
points.quote: Any personal information contained within Input will be stored until the earlier of (a) the date it is deleted by Customer through the Services’ interface and (b) the date that is thirty days after Perplexity is no longer providing the Services to Customer.

points.text: DPA §10 adds the post-termination deadline: all Personal Data is deleted (or, at Customer's option, returned) within thirty days of the end of the provision of the Services. It is not a retention period, and it covers Personal Data only.
points.text_zh: DPA §10 补充终止后期限：服务结束后 30 天内删除（或按客户选择返还）全部 Personal Data。这不是保留期限，且只覆盖个人信息。
points.quote: Perplexity shall delete (or, at Customer’s option, return) all Personal Data within thirty days of the end of the provision of the Services to Customer, unless retention of the Personal Data is required by law

points.text: At contract level no retention period is given for non-personal Input/Output; the only post-termination rule in the API ToS is §10.5 — destroy or return Confidential Information, with copies in automated back-up systems deleted under the receiving party's standard deletion procedures.
points.text_zh: 合同层未给非个人输入输出的保留期限；API ToS 里唯一的终止后规则是 §10.5——销毁或返还保密信息，自动备份中的副本按接收方标准删除流程删除。
points.quote: except copies in the Receiving Party’s automated back-up systems, which shall remain subject to Section 5 while maintained and which shall be deleted in accordance with the Receiving Party’s standard deletion procedures.

processing_region.quote: Our compute is hosted via Amazon Web Services in North America.

points.text: See the top-level processing_region entry: no processing-location clause at contract level; it rests on the documentation site and the trust center.
points.text_zh: 见顶层 processing_region：合同层无处理地条款，靠文档站与 trust center。

role.quote: The Parties acknowledge that in relation to any Personal Data received from Customer in providing the Services, for purposes of Privacy Laws, Customer is the Controller or Processor or Business and Perplexity is the Service Provider or Processor.

points.text: See the top-level role entry: DPA §2 processor
points.text_zh: 见顶层 role：DPA §2 processor

points.text: Usage Data and Search Data are the exceptions.
points.text_zh: Usage Data 与 Search Data 属例外。

points.text: The vendor discloses no training posture specific to the Embeddings API
points.text_zh: 官方未披露 Embeddings API 专属的训练姿态

points.text: The DPA expressly carves it out of the main posture. This must not be read in reverse as a vendor commitment to the contrary.
points.text_zh: DPA 明确把它划出主姿态。不得反向解读为厂商承诺相反。已撤锚：DPA 序言「Certain Services (including but not limited to the Embeddings API …) may operate under data postures that differ from this DPA」只声明本档不适用 DPA 主姿态，没有对训练表态，故不构成本维度的表述。查阅范围见 searched。

points.text: The zero-retention commitment in Privacy & Security names only the Chat Completions API, and the FAQ says only "the API"; neither names Embeddings
points.text_zh: Privacy & Security 的零保留承诺只写 Chat Completions API，FAQ 只写「the API」，均未点名 Embeddings

points.text: The DPA preamble instead carves Embeddings out of the main posture. ZDR for this tier is therefore recorded as undisclosed.
points.text_zh: DPA 序言反而把 Embeddings 划出主姿态。故本档 ZDR 记未披露。已撤锚：该句只声明本档不适用 DPA 主姿态，没有对本档是否提供零保留表态。查阅范围见 searched。

retention.quote: Certain Services (including but not limited to the Embeddings API and Perplexity Search) may operate under data postures that differ from this DPA

points.text: DPA preamble: "Certain Services (including but not limited to the Embeddings API and Perplexity Search) may operate under data postures that differ from this DPA... the applicable product-specific terms shall govern and control over this DPA." — so the DPA's retention clauses may not apply to this tier, and no product-specific terms are public. This is "undisclosed" rather than a denial.
points.text_zh: DPA 序言：「Certain Services (including but not limited to the Embeddings API and Perplexity Search) may operate under data postures that differ from this DPA... the applicable product-specific terms shall govern and control over this DPA.」即 DPA 的保留条款对本档可能不适用，而专属条款未见公开。这是「未披露」而非否定。

points.text: No processing-location clause specific to Embeddings
points.text_zh: 无 Embeddings 专属处理地条款

points.text: The subprocessor list is not broken down by product.
points.text_zh: 子处理者清单未按产品拆分。已撤锚：DPA 序言的产品划出句只声明本档不适用 DPA 主姿态，没有对处理地表态。查阅范围见 searched。

points.text: Once the DPA preamble carves this tier out of the main posture, nothing further is said about role allocation.
points.text_zh: DPA 序言把本档划出主姿态后，角色归属未再说明。已撤锚：该句只声明本档不适用 DPA 主姿态，没有对 controller / processor 归属表态。查阅范围见 searched。

training.quote: Perplexity may retain, copy, distribute and otherwise use Search Data for its lawful business purposes, including the improvement and development of products and services.

points.text: Structured conclusion: §2.2 authorizes Perplexity to use Search Data for its lawful business purposes "including the improvement and development of products and services", and the Addendum gives no no-training commitment. Under the rule that service-improvement wording which does not exclude model training counts as training, this tier is recorded as mark=no.
points.text_zh: 结构化结论：§2.2 授权 Perplexity 为「lawful business purposes, including the improvement and development of products and services」使用 Search Data，且 Addendum 未给不训练承诺。按口径「写『用于服务改进』而不排除模型训练即按会训练算」，本档记 mark=no。

points.text: The Addendum gives no no-training commitment
points.text_zh: Addendum 未给不训练承诺

points.text: §2.2 instead authorizes Perplexity to retain, copy and distribute Search Data "for its lawful business purposes, including the improvement and development of products and services". Whether the no-training commitment in API ToS §2.3.3 still applies to Search Data is not stated — §1.2.2 names only obligations such as "update, upgrade and/or zero data retention obligations" as excluded, and does not name §2.3.3. This uncertainty has to be flagged in the ledger and must not be resolved on the vendor's behalf.
points.text_zh: §2.2 反而授权 Perplexity 为「lawful business purposes, including the improvement and development of products and services」保留、复制、分发 Search Data。API ToS §2.3.3 的不训练承诺是否仍适用于 Search Data，文档未明说——§1.2.2 只点名排除了「update, upgrade and/or zero data retention obligations」这类义务，未点名 §2.3.3。此不确定性必须在台账上标明，不得替厂商推定。

points.text: Third-party model hops do not arise on this tier as currently configured: Schedule 1 states that the /search endpoint "does not generate Output through the use of artificial intelligence, including large language models". Whether API ToS §2.6 (Third-Party Models) otherwise applies to the Search Services is not stated, and §1.2.2 is not read in either direction here.
points.text_zh: 按当前配置，本档不涉及第三方模型跳：Schedule 1 明说 /search 端点「does not generate Output through the use of artificial intelligence, including large language models」。API ToS §2.6（Third-Party Models）是否另行适用于 Search Services，文档未说明，§1.2.2 在此不作任何方向的推定。
points.quote: This API does not generate Output through the use of artificial intelligence, including large language models.

zdr.quote: except for obligations expressly set out in this Addendum, any Perplexity obligations in the Agreement applicable to its other products and services (e.g., update, upgrade and/or zero data retention obligations) do not apply to the Search Services.

points.text: §1.2.2：「any Perplexity obligations in the Agreement applicable to its other products and services (e.g., update, upgrade and/or zero data retention obligations) do not apply to the Search Services」
§4.1 likewise states that the security and service-level commitments for other products (the Sonar APIs included) do not apply to the Search Services. This is an express denial, not a non-disclosure.
points.text_zh: §4.1 亦声明其他产品（含 Sonar APIs）的安全/服务水平承诺不适用于 Search Services。这是明确否定，不是未披露。

retention.quote: Perplexity may retain, copy, distribute and otherwise use Search Data for its lawful business purposes, including the improvement and development of products and services.

points.text: §2.2 authorizes retention, copying and distribution of Search Data (Search Data = Input + Output, §1.1.1), with no period given
points.text_zh: §2.2 授权保留/复制/分发 Search Data（Search Data = Input + Output，§1.1.1），未给期限

points.text: §1.2.2 states expressly that the zero-retention obligations for other products do not apply. §2.3 prohibits the customer from submitting personal information (unless authorized in writing), so the question of personal information retention largely does not arise on this tier.
points.text_zh: §1.2.2 明确其他产品的零保留义务不适用。§2.3 禁止客户提交个人信息（除非书面授权），因此本档的个人信息保留问题主要不适用。

points.text: Neither the Search Addendum nor the API ToS has a processing-location clause
points.text_zh: Search Addendum 与 API ToS 均无处理地条款

points.text: Removed anchor: the cited subprocessor-list row ("Amazon Web Services / Cloud infrastructure and security / Cloud provider / US") records where the subprocessor company sits, not where data is processed. The snapshot has no column header saying the US column is a processing location, so it cannot support a region code. The consumer tier is judged on the same reasoning, keeping the two tiers consistent. Search scope is recorded in searched.
points.text_zh: 已撤锚：原引子处理者清单条目（「Amazon Web Services / Cloud infrastructure and security / Cloud provider / US」）记的是该子处理者公司所在地，不是数据处理地；快照里没有表头说明 US 列是处理地，故不能支撑区域码。消费者档按同一理由判定，两档口径一致。查阅范围见 searched。

role.quote: The Parties acknowledge that in relation to any Personal Data received from Customer in providing the Services, for purposes of Privacy Laws, Customer is the Controller or Processor or Business and Perplexity is the Service Provider or Processor.

points.text: The role clause is inherited rather than restated in the Addendum: §1.2.1 keeps the Agreement in force for the Search Services, API ToS §6.1 incorporates the DPA, and DPA §2 makes Perplexity the Service Provider or Processor.
points.text_zh: 角色条款是继承来的，Addendum 未重述：§1.2.1 让 Agreement 对 Search Services 继续适用，API ToS §6.1 并入 DPA，DPA §2 自认 Service Provider or Processor。

points.text: The clause previously cited here is a customer obligation, not a statement of Perplexity's role: "Customer shall not submit Personal Data (as defined in the DPA) to the Search Services unless explicitly authorized by Perplexity in writing".
points.text_zh: 此处原先引用的条款是对客户的义务，不是对 Perplexity 角色的表述：「Customer shall not submit Personal Data (as defined in the DPA) to the Search Services unless explicitly authorized by Perplexity in writing」。
points.quote: Customer shall not submit Personal Data (as defined in the DPA) to the Search Services unless explicitly authorized by Perplexity in writing

points.text: But §2.2 states expressly that "Search Data is not Customer's Confidential Information" and authorizes Perplexity to retain, copy, distribute and otherwise use Search Data for its lawful business purposes, the opposite of API ToS §5.1, which makes Customer Content the customer's confidential information. The processor relationship is weaker on this tier than on the Sonar tier; both statements are kept side by side.
points.text_zh: 但 §2.2 明文「Search Data is not Customer's Confidential Information」，并授权 Perplexity 为 lawful business purposes 保留、复制、分发、使用 Search Data，与 API ToS §5.1 把 Customer Content 定为客户保密信息相反。本档受托关系比 Sonar 档弱；两句并列保留。

training.quote: Improve or create services and products, including our AI models.

points.text: Structured conclusion: the purposes list in the consumer privacy notice includes "Improve or create services and products, including our AI models." Service-improvement wording that does not exclude model training counts as training, and this sentence names AI models outright, so the tier is recorded as mark=no.
points.text_zh: 结构化结论：消费者隐私声明的处理目的清单含「Improve or create services and products, including our AI models.」。按「写『用于服务改进』而不排除模型训练即按会训练算」，且该句直接点名 AI 模型，本档记 mark=no。

points.text: The other purposes listed alongside it ("develop services", "conduct internal research", "improve our websites") likewise do not exclude model training.
points.text_zh: 与之并列的其他目的（「develop services」「conduct internal research」「improve our websites」）同样未排除模型训练。

points.text: Feature-level exception, not the tier's commitment: "We do not use the content of emails to create, train, improve, or fine-tune AI models." covers Email Assistant data only. In-product switches such as AI Data Retention (help center, not fetched this round) are retention settings, not training statements.
points.text_zh: 功能级例外，不构成本档承诺：「We do not use the content of emails to create, train, improve, or fine-tune AI models.」只覆盖 Email Assistant 的数据。AI Data Retention 之类的产品内开关（帮助中心，本轮未取）属保留设置，不是训练表态。

zdr.quote: We keep your personal data for only as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes in this Notice unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.

points.text: Structured conclusion: the cited clause states affirmatively that personal data is kept for as long as necessary ("We keep your personal data for only as long as necessary…"), and the consumer tier offers no zero-retention mechanism. The tier is therefore recorded as mark=no (terms state retention).
points.text_zh: 结构化结论：原引句正面写明个人数据会被保留（「We keep your personal data for only as long as necessary…」），消费档也没有任何零保留机制。据此记 mark=no（条款明示会留存）。

points.text: No zero-retention commitment on the consumer tier. Only feature-level mechanisms exist, and no official policy document explains their effect: the in-product AI Data Retention switch (help center, not fetched this round) and Incognito — "Incognito increases your privacy by not saving your search activity across use sessions."
points.text_zh: 消费者档无零保留承诺。只有功能级机制，且未见官方政策文档说明其效果：产品内的 AI Data Retention 开关（帮助中心，本轮未取）与 Incognito——「Incognito increases your privacy by not saving your search activity across use sessions.」。

retention.quote: We keep your personal data for only as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes in this Notice unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.

points.text: "We keep your personal data for only as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes in this Notice unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law." — a purpose-necessity period, not quantified
points.text_zh: 「We keep your personal data for only as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes in this Notice unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law.」——目的必要期限，未量化

points.text: The deletion-rights clause separately states that "in many cases we must keep your personal data to comply with legal obligations...".
points.text_zh: 另有删除权条款说明「in many cases we must keep your personal data to comply with legal obligations...」。

processing_region.quote: By submitting your personal data to us you agree to the transfer, storage, and processing of your data in a country other than your country of residence including, but not limited to, the United States.

points.text: Removed anchor: the cited subprocessor-list row ("Amazon Web Services / Cloud infrastructure and security / Cloud provider / US") records where the subprocessor company sits, not where data is processed. Entity location is not processing location, so it is not a statement on this dimension. Search scope is recorded in searched.
points.text_zh: 已撤锚：原引子处理者清单条目（「Amazon Web Services / Cloud infrastructure and security / Cloud provider / US」）记的是该子处理者公司所在地，不是数据处理地。主体所在地 ≠ 数据处理地，故不构成本维度的表述。查阅范围见 searched。

points.text: The notice discloses cross-border transfer only: "By submitting your personal data to us you agree to the transfer, storage, and processing of your data in a country other than your country of residence including, but not limited to, the United States." It commits to no residency location, and the enumeration is open-ended, so no single region code can be assigned.
points.text_zh: 声明只披露跨境传输：「By submitting your personal data to us you agree to the transfer, storage, and processing of your data in a country other than your country of residence including, but not limited to, the United States.」未承诺驻留地，且列举是开放的，故不能给出单一区域码。

points.text: Only the DPF (EU-U.S. / UK Extension) and the all-US subprocessor list are available as indirect clues.
points.text_zh: 只有 DPF（EU-U.S./UK Extension）与子处理者清单全 US 可作间接线索。

role.quote: This notice does not apply to data collected through Perplexity’s [Enterprise](https://www.perplexity.ai/enterprise/home) and [API](https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/resources/privacy-security) offerings where we act as a service provider or processor with regard to the data collected through those systems.

points.text: The privacy notice merely excludes the Enterprise and API tiers, describing Perplexity as service provider or processor for those two, from which it follows that the consumer tier is processed by Perplexity as an independent controller in its own right
points.text_zh: 隐私声明只把 Enterprise 与 API 档排除在外并自认那两档为 service provider/processor，反推消费者档是自有的独立控制者处理

points.text: The notice is written throughout in "we collect" terms, with no processor wording.
points.text_zh: 声明全篇以「we collect」口径书写，未见受托表述。

training.quote: Perplexity shall not use (or authorize third parties to use) Customer Content to train, retrain, fine-tune or otherwise improve any generative artificial intelligence models.

points.text: Enterprise ToS §1.3.3 is word for word the same as API ToS §2.3.3: "Perplexity shall not use (or authorize third parties to use) Customer Content to train, retrain, fine-tune or otherwise improve any generative artificial intelligence models."
points.text_zh: Enterprise ToS §1.3.3 与 API ToS §2.3.3 同文：「Perplexity shall not use (or authorize third parties to use) Customer Content to train, retrain, fine-tune or otherwise improve any generative artificial intelligence models.」

points.text: Exception that the §1.3.3 commitment does not cover: Usage Data is defined outside Customer Content and personal information, and §2.3 authorizes Perplexity to use it for any lawful purpose (e.g., to assess the relative popularity of the Services' features or to improve categorization algorithms). The same layer is recorded on the API tier.
points.text_zh: §1.3.3 承诺覆盖不到的例外：Usage Data 的定义排除 Customer Content 与个人信息，§2.3 授权 Perplexity 为 any lawful purpose（例如评估各功能的受欢迎程度、改进分类算法）使用它。API 档记有同一层。
points.quote: Perplexity may use Usage Data for any lawful purpose (e.g., to assess the relative popularity of the Services’ features or to improve categorization algorithms) without remuneration to Customer.

points.text: Removed anchor: the cited clause ("If your account has a Zero Data Retention (ZDR) agreement with Perplexity, check with your account team…") is a conditional reference in the Agent API docs. It confirms ZDR agreements exist but does not state that this tier has one, so it is not a statement on this verdict's dimension. Search scope is recorded in searched.
points.text_zh: 已撤锚：原引句「If your account has a Zero Data Retention (ZDR) agreement with Perplexity, check with your account team…」是 Agent API 文档里的条件式提示，只说明存在 ZDR 协议这种安排，并未说明本档是否覆盖，故不构成本判定的表述。查阅范围见 searched。

points.text: Neither the Enterprise ToS nor the DPA contains a zero-retention commitment
points.text_zh: Enterprise ToS 与 DPA 均无零保留承诺

points.text: ZDR is mentioned in the API documentation in the form of an "agreement", and whether it covers the Enterprise tier is not published.
points.text_zh: ZDR 在 API 文档里以「agreement」形式被提及，是否覆盖 Enterprise 档未公开。

retention.summary: 输入输出留至服务终止
retention.quote: Any personal information contained within Input will be stored until the earlier of (a) the date it is deleted by Customer through the Services’ interface and (b) the date that is thirty days after Perplexity is no longer providing the Services to Customer.

points.text: Structured conclusion: Enterprise ToS §5.1 incorporates the DPA, and no retention period is given for Input/Output during the term. The only rule that states both object and context is DPA Annex 1: personal information contained in Input is stored until the earlier of (a) the date it is deleted by Customer through the Services' interface and (b) the date that is thirty days after Perplexity is no longer providing the Services to Customer — hence basis=until_termination.
points.text_zh: 结构化结论：Enterprise ToS §5.1 并入 DPA，服务期内未给输入输出的保留期限。唯一写明对象与语境的规则是 DPA Annex 1：Input 中的个人信息保留至「客户通过服务界面删除」与「Perplexity 停止提供服务后 30 天」两者较早者——故记 until_termination。

points.text: DPA §10 is a post-termination deletion deadline, not a retention period: Perplexity deletes (or, at Customer's option, returns) all Personal Data within thirty days of the end of the provision of the Services. It covers Personal Data only, so non-personal Input/Output has no contract-level period.
points.text_zh: DPA §10 是终止后的删除期限，不是保留期限：服务结束后 30 天内删除（或按客户选择返还）全部 Personal Data；且只覆盖个人信息，非个人的输入输出在合同层没有期限条款。
points.quote: Perplexity shall delete (or, at Customer’s option, return) all Personal Data within thirty days of the end of the provision of the Services to Customer, unless retention of the Personal Data is required by law

points.text: The enterprise contract's own post-termination clause: each party destroys or returns the other party's Confidential Information and all copies thereof, except copies in automated back-up systems, which remain subject to §4 while maintained and are deleted in accordance with the receiving party's standard deletion procedures. Customer Content is the customer's Confidential Information under §4.1.
points.text_zh: 企业合同自身的终止后条款：各方销毁或返还对方保密信息及其所有副本，自动备份中的副本除外——该副本在保存期间仍受 §4 约束，并按接收方的标准删除流程删除。§4.1 下 Customer Content 属客户保密信息。
points.quote: Upon the termination of this Agreement, each party shall destroy or return to the other party all Confidential Information of the other party and all copies thereof, except copies in the Receiving Party’s automated back-up systems, which shall remain subject to Section 4 while maintained and which shall be deleted in accordance with the Receiving Party’s standard deletion procedures.

points.text: There are also enterprise settings such as "Configuring Data Retention" inside the product (that page was not fetched this round).
points.text_zh: 产品内另有「Configuring Data Retention」类企业设置（本轮未取该页）。

points.text: No region code can be assigned: DPA §11 is the only transfer clause and it commits only to a transfer compliance mechanism (EU SCCs / UK Addendum, data importer obligations), naming no country or region. The only places "US" appears in the DPA are the definition of US Privacy Laws (including CCPA), which is a legal definition rather than a processing location.
points.text_zh: 无法给出区域码：DPA §11 是唯一的传输条款，只承诺传输合规机制（EU SCCs / UK Addendum、data importer 义务），未出现任何国家或区域。DPA 里出现「US」的地方只有 US Privacy Laws（含 CCPA）的法定定义，不是处理地。
points.quote: To the extent Perplexity processes Personal Data subject to EU/UK Privacy Laws in a Third Country, and it is acting as a data importer, Perplexity shall comply with the data importer

points.text: The subprocessor list marks every vendor US, but that column is the vendor company's location, not the processing location — the consumer tier is judged on the same reasoning, keeping the two tiers consistent.
points.text_zh: 子处理者清单全标 US，但那是厂商公司所在地，不是处理地——消费者档按同一理由判定，两档口径一致。

points.text: The enterprise security page likewise has no regional clause.
points.text_zh: 企业安全页亦无地域条款。

role.quote: The DPA governs Perplexity’s processing of personal data as a processor on Customer’s behalf in connection with the provision of the Services.

points.text: §5.1「The DPA governs Perplexity's processing of personal data as a processor on Customer's behalf」

But that clause and §5.4 make clear that for personal data processed for the Marketing Services "Perplexity acts as an independent controller, and the DPA does not apply". So processor as the main position and independent controller for marketing data, recorded side by side.
points.text_zh: 但同条与 §5.4 明确：为客户人员信息做营销（Marketing Services）时「Perplexity acts as an independent controller, and the DPA does not apply」。即受托为主、营销数据为独立控制者，两层并列。

training.quote: Perplexity shall not use (or authorize third parties to use) Customer Content to train, retrain, fine-tune or otherwise improve any generative artificial intelligence models

points.text: Same as top-level training: API ToS §2.3.3 covers Customer Content and includes "or authorize third parties to use"
points.text_zh: 同顶层 training：API ToS §2.3.3 覆盖 Customer Content 且含「or authorize third parties to use」

points.text: DPA §5 covers Personal Data, but its (a)–(c) prohibitions are prefixed with "To the extent required by Privacy Laws"; the training prohibition at the end of the same paragraph opens with "For the avoidance of doubt", so whether that prefix governs it is open to interpretation. This dimension therefore rests on the unconditional API ToS §2.3.3. The conduct of the upstream providers themselves falls outside Perplexity's commitment (§2.6).
points.text_zh: DPA §5 覆盖 Personal Data，但其 (a)–(c) 禁令以「To the extent required by Privacy Laws」为前提；同段末句的训练禁令以「For the avoidance of doubt」起头，是否受该前提约束存在解释空间，故本维度以无条件的 API ToS §2.3.3 为主依据。上游提供方自身行为不在 Perplexity 承诺范围内(§2.6)。
points.quote: To the extent required by Privacy Laws, Perplexity shall not (a) Sell or Share Personal Data, (b) retain, use, or disclose the Personal Data outside of the direct business relationship between Perplexity and Customer

points.text: Boundary of the commitment (API ToS §3.3): "Usage Data" means metadata, analytics, performance metrics and other operational data that "does not include Customer Content or personal information or is anonymized and/or aggregated", and Perplexity "may use Usage Data for any lawful purpose (e.g., to assess the relative popularity of the Services’ features or to improve categorization algorithms) without remuneration to Customer". Improving the service counts as training under this ledger's rule, but §3.3 sits expressly outside Customer Content, so it does not overturn §2.3.3 — it only marks the edge of the no-training commitment.
points.text_zh: 承诺的边界(API ToS §3.3)：「Usage Data」指元数据、分析、性能指标等运营数据，且「does not include Customer Content or personal information or is anonymized and/or aggregated」；Perplexity「may use Usage Data for any lawful purpose (e.g., to assess the relative popularity of the Services’ features or to improve categorization algorithms) without remuneration to Customer」。按本台账口径「用来改进服务算训练」，但 §3.3 明文排除 Customer Content，故不推翻 §2.3.3，只标明不训练承诺的边界。
points.quote: Perplexity may use Usage Data for any lawful purpose (e.g., to assess the relative popularity of the Services’ features or to improve categorization algorithms) without remuneration to Customer
