retention.summary: 按对象分列留至服务终止
retention.quote: Perplexity shall delete (or, at Customer’s option, return) all Personal Data within thirty days of the end of the provision of the Services to Customer

points.text: Object: personal information contained in Input. DPA Annex 1 stores it "until the earlier of (a) the date it is deleted by Customer through the Services’ interface and (b) the date that is thirty days after Perplexity is no longer providing the Services to Customer" — a post-termination deletion obligation, not a fixed 30-day retention period; during the term it sets no ceiling at all.
points.text_zh: 对象：Input 中的个人信息。DPA Annex 1 规定其留存至「客户经界面删除」与「不再向客户提供服务后 30 天」两者较早者——这是终止后的删除义务，不是固定 30 天保留期；服务存续期间它不给任何上限。
points.quote: Any personal information contained within Input will be stored until the earlier of (a) the date it is deleted by Customer through the Services’ interface and (b) the date that is thirty days after Perplexity is no longer providing the Services to Customer

points.text: Second limb (DPA §10): Perplexity deletes (or returns) all Personal Data "within thirty days of the end of the provision of the Services to Customer, unless retention of the Personal Data is required by law", and deletes it once that legal retention obligation expires. The thirty days is therefore an upper bound that starts at the end of the service and carries a statutory-retention exception — days = 30 records that deletion window, not a retention period.
points.text_zh: 第二层依据(DPA §10)：Perplexity 在「服务结束后 30 天内」删除(或返还)全部 Personal Data，除非法律要求留存，并在该法定留存义务届满后删除。故 30 天是自服务结束时起算的上限，且带法定保留例外——days = 30 记的是这个删除窗口，不是保留期。
points.quote: Perplexity shall delete (or, at Customer’s option, return) all Personal Data within thirty days of the end of the provision of the Services to Customer

points.text: Duration at the contract layer (DPA Annex 1, "Frequency and duration of the processing"): processing runs "for the duration of the term of the Agreement and any post-termination retention period as set out in the Agreement" — the contract speaks only to Personal Data's processing duration and gives no specific period for Input or Output content beyond that.
points.text_zh: 合同层的处理持续期(DPA Annex 1「Frequency and duration of the processing」)：处理持续到「the duration of the term of the Agreement and any post-termination retention period as set out in the Agreement」——合同层只界定 Personal Data 的处理持续期，对输入输出正文没有给出具体期限。
points.quote: On a continuous basis, for the duration of the term of the Agreement and any post-termination retention period as set out in the Agreement

points.text: May still survive termination: API ToS §10.5 requires each party to destroy or return all Confidential Information on termination, and §5.1 makes Customer Content Customer's Confidential Information, so that duty covers Input and Output — but "copies in the Receiving Party’s automated back-up systems" are carved out and deleted only "in accordance with the Receiving Party’s standard deletion procedures", with no period stated. That sits alongside the DPA §10 thirty-day deletion duty.
points.text_zh: 终止后仍可能留存：API ToS §10.5 要求双方在终止时销毁或返还全部机密信息，§5.1 又把 Customer Content 定性为客户的机密信息，故该义务覆盖输入输出正文；但「copies in the Receiving Party’s automated back-up systems」被明文排除，只按「标准删除流程」删除、未给期限。该条与 DPA §10 的 30 天删除义务并列。
points.quote: except copies in the Receiving Party’s automated back-up systems, which shall remain subject to Section 5 while maintained and which shall be deleted in accordance with the Receiving Party’s standard deletion procedures

points.text: Output has no retention clause at the contract layer (the DPA governs Personal Data, and Annex 1's storage rule is written for Input), which is why this row reads "varies by object"; the platform-level "no retention / zero day retention" wording in the FAQ and the privacy-security page is recorded alongside it without picking a side.
points.text_zh: Output 在合同层没有保留期限条款(DPA 只约束 Personal Data，Annex 1 的存储规则是为 Input 写的)，本行故记「按对象分列」；FAQ/privacy-security 的平台级「不保留/零日保留」与之并列保留，不选边。

points.text: The core conflict for retention on this tier: the Agent API persists response and conversation state server-side by default, and setting store: false only hides a response from retrieval — it does not disable persistence

points.text: **The retention period, automatic expiry and deletion method are all undisclosed**. At the contract layer (DPA Annex 1) there is only one rule, covering Personal Data, "until the earlier of (a) the date it is deleted by Customer through the Services' interface and (b) the date that is thirty days after Perplexity is no longer providing the Services to Customer", and it does not address conversation state itself

By default, the API has zero day retention of user prompt data..." — the first half takes "our compute" as its object, which is a platform-level statement not split by endpoint, so it covers the Chat Completions tier as well. By default, the API has zero day retention of user prompt data...」——前半句以「our compute」为对象，是平台级表述，不按端点分档，故同样覆盖 Chat Completions 档。官方未提供任何区域选择或数据驻留选项，也没有披露具体 AWS 区域（只说 North America）。本行是边界标注行：region 与 role 两维两档一致，并不意味着其他维度一致——zdr/retention 两维 Chat Completions 与 Agent API 恰好相反，这正是本行单列的原因。不确定性：该句出自 FAQ（developer_data 层），合同层（API ToS 与 DPA）没有数据所在地条款，DPA 的跨境传输机制未在公开文本中给出。

points.text_zh: 与顶层及 api 档同源、同结论：DPA §2「Customer is the Controller or Processor or Business and Perplexity is the Service Provider or Processor」

points.text: API ToS §6.1 incorporates the DPA into the contract by reference, and the scope in ToS §1 expressly covers "the Sonar by Perplexity and/or Agentic Research application programming interface (“API”) services" — Sonar's chat completions endpoint is among them, so the processor positioning applies to this tier as well. Why confidence is recorded as medium: DPA §1 carries its own exclusion, "Certain Services (including but not limited to the Embeddings API and Perplexity Search) may operate under data postures that differ from this DPA"; the ones named are the Embeddings API and Perplexity Search, and Chat Completions is not among them, but the list is open-ended (including but not limited to) and no complete list of excepted services is given. One hop upstream: ToS §2.6 acknowledges that the Services may use third-party models and DPA §6(c) requires subcontractors to carry obligations no less onerous than Perplexity's own, but the public text does not name one by one which model providers take part in the Chat Completions tier.
points.text_zh: API ToS §6.1 以引用方式把 DPA 并入合同，而 ToS §1 的适用范围明写覆盖「the Sonar by Perplexity and/or Agentic Research application programming interface ("API") services」——Sonar 的 chat completions 端点正在其中，故本档同样适用 processor 定位。置信度记 medium 的理由：DPA §1 自带排除条款「Certain Services (including but not limited to the Embeddings API and Perplexity Search) may operate under data postures that differ from this DPA」，被点名的是 Embeddings API 与 Perplexity Search，Chat Completions 不在其列，但该清单是开放式的（including but not limited to），官方未给出完整的例外服务清单。上游一跳：ToS §2.6 承认 Services 可能使用第三方模型，DPA §6(c) 要求子处理方承担不低于自身的义务，但公开文本未逐一点名哪些模型提供方参与 Chat Completions 档。

points.text_zh: API 档**没有任何专门针对 API 输入的训练承诺**，只能套平台级条款，且平台级条款本身冲突：(a) 适用的是 Poe Privacy Policy——上游模型厂商「may receive details about your interactions with bots and apps on Poe … to provide and generally improve their services」

training.quote: Third-party developer bots and apps can use your chats to train their AI models

points.text: Basis for mark=no on this tier (the half shield): the Privacy Center FAQ “Are my chats used to train the AI models?” answers “In most cases, no. Only third-party developer bots and apps are permitted to use your chats to train their models.”, and the half shield entry reads “Third-party developer bots and apps can use your chats to train their AI models – even then, they don’t have access to the personal data associated with your Poe account unless you interact with other users in a group chat.” The shield is also permission-dependent: “A bot or app can change from full shield to half shield if you grant it new permissions.” This tier therefore contains an explicit training-on hop and is recorded ✗ on the “not used for training?” column.
points.text_zh: 本档 mark=no 的正面依据（half shield）：Privacy Center 的 FAQ「Are my chats used to train the AI models?」答「In most cases, no. Only third-party developer bots and apps are permitted to use your chats to train their models.」，half shield 条目逐字写「Third-party developer bots and apps can use your chats to train their AI models – even then, they don’t have access to the personal data associated with your Poe account unless you interact with other users in a group chat.」；shield 还随权限变化——「A bot or app can change from full shield to half shield if you grant it new permissions.」。本档存在明确会训练的一跳，故按列名问题（「不用于训练?」）记 ✗。

points.text: Conflicting statement, kept side by side rather than resolved: the Poe Privacy Policy says third-party AI model providers and third-party developers “may receive details about your interactions with bots and apps on Poe (including the contents of your chats and photos or documents you upload) to provide and generally improve their services”, a purpose not limited to producing the requested response — and under docs/judgment.md “generally improve their services” counts as training. Separately, Poe ToS §4.5 grants Poe itself a perpetual, transferable licence over Your Content, with a purpose listed as “Understanding your use of Poe to generally improve the Poe services”.
points.text_zh: 与 Privacy Policy 的冲突（并列保留、不选边）：Poe Privacy Policy 说上游模型厂商与第三方开发者「may receive details about your interactions with bots and apps on Poe (including the contents of your chats and photos or documents you upload) to provide and generally improve their services」——用途未限制在「产出本次回复」，而「generally improve their services」按 docs/judgment.md 记作训练。另注：Poe ToS §4.5 给 Poe 自身一项永久、可转让的内容使用许可，用途含「Understanding your use of Poe to generally improve the Poe services」。
points.quote: Our third party AI model providers and third party developers may receive details about your interactions with bots and apps on Poe (including the contents of your chats and photos or documents you upload) to provide and generally improve their services

points.text: Exception, not a tier-level commitment: the full shield entry reads “Your interactions with the bot or app will not be used by AI model providers for training purposes.”, and the FAQ bullet adds that “Official Poe bots and user-created prompt bots using Open AI, Anthropic, Google, and Meta’s AI models do not train on your chats and cannot access your chats for anything other than to produce the requested LLM response”. This covers only a subset of this tier, so it is recorded as the scope of the promise and cannot turn the tier into ✓.
points.text_zh: 例外说明（不构成整档承诺）：full shield 条目写「Your interactions with the bot or app will not be used by AI model providers for training purposes.」，FAQ 该条 bullet 另写「Official Poe bots and user-created prompt bots using Open AI, Anthropic, Google, and Meta’s AI models do not train on your chats and cannot access your chats for anything other than to produce the requested LLM response」——该承诺只覆盖本档的一个子集，因此只作适用范围记录，不能据此把整档记 ✓。

zdr.quote: Temporary chat messages are permanently deleted within 24 hours of creation. Files you upload to a temporary chat are retained for up to 15 days for safety review before being permanently deleted. In limited cases, we may keep content longer to meet our legal and safety obligations.

points.text: 消费档没有零保留方案或开关。读懂的依据：①官方最私密的 temporary chat 仍保留请求正文——消息 24 小时内永久删除、上传文件最多 15 天做安全审核，且「In limited cases, we may keep content longer to meet our legal and safety obligations.」
points.text_zh: 消费档没有零保留方案或开关。读懂的依据：①官方最私密的 temporary chat 仍保留请求正文——消息 24 小时内永久删除、上传文件最多 15 天做安全审核，且「In limited cases, we may keep content longer to meet our legal and safety obligations.」

points.text: 标的正是该功能的请求内容，保留主体是 Poe 自己（安全审核是平台自身目的）。②普通对话保存在 Poe 系统内、以用户删除为触发条件（Privacy Center「Your chats and personal data associated with your account are deleted from Poe's systems」），Memory 还会用你发出的消息生成长期摘要，故 Poe 侧无自动到期删除、无期限承诺。③ToS §4.1 把「你发的问题/prompt」和「你收到的回复」都定义为 Your Content，§4.5 就此给出永久、可转让、终止后仍可继续使用的使用许可，§5 明确「Any Data collected prior to termination may continue to be used」——合同层没有「用完即删」的承诺。④上游那一跳由各 provider 自定保留期（Poe 自己举例 OpenAI / Anthropic 30 天），Poe 只剥离账号身份、不承诺不转发。privacy shield 的 full shield 只承诺「不用于训练」，是 training 维度的承诺，不构成保留承诺。

points.text: The only quantified account-level window in this chain, and it belongs to the account process rather than to the chats: the Quora Privacy Policy (incorporated by reference into the Poe Privacy Policy) states “It may take Quora up to 14 days to process your account deletion request, and if you log back into your account during that time, your account may be reactivated.” The object is the processing window for an account-deletion request (an upper bound of 14 days, on the account personal-information layer) and re-logging in during that window can revive the account. It says nothing about how long chat contents are kept, so it must not be read as “contents are deleted after 14 days”, and this tier’s retention for inputs & outputs stays undisclosed.
points.text_zh: 链路里唯一量化的账号级窗口，且属账号流程而非对话内容：被 Poe Privacy Policy 以引用方式并入的 Quora Privacy Policy 写「It may take Quora up to 14 days to process your account deletion request, and if you log back into your account during that time, your account may be reactivated.」——对象是账号删除请求的处理窗口（上限 14 天，账号个人信息层），期间重新登录还可能使账号复活。它没有说对话正文留多久，不得外推成「内容 14 天后删除」，本档对输入输出的 basis 仍为 undisclosed。

points.text: Reverse-side restriction — a developer obligation, not extra evidence that Poe does not train: API Terms §4b adds “Further, if you use the Bot Query API you will (i) not use the Bot Query API or any data received through it to train or develop foundation models or other large language models, and (ii) use the Bot Query API and any data received through it solely in connection with Your Bot on Poe.” The bound party is the developer, and the object is the Bot Query API and any data received through it — a different object from §4c’s “content provided by Your Bot”. It is therefore recorded as a use restriction on the receiving hop, and does not amount to a Poe-side no-training commitment covering user chats or bot content; the anchor and the verdict above are unchanged.
points.text_zh: 反向限制（义务主体是开发者，不构成 Poe 侧不训练的额外证据）：API Terms §4b 另写「Further, if you use the Bot Query API you will (i) not use the Bot Query API or any data received through it to train or develop foundation models or other large language models, and (ii) use the Bot Query API and any data received through it solely in connection with Your Bot on Poe.」——被约束的是使用 Bot Query API 的开发者，标的为「Bot Query API 及其收到的任何数据」，与 §4c 的「content provided by Your Bot」是两个不同标的；因此它只作为本档链路里接收跳的使用限制记录，不能当作 Poe 对用户对话输入或 bot 内容的训练承诺，上方 verdict 与锚点不变。

zdr.quote: Developers that create bots and apps on Poe using APIs may view and store your chats on their servers to train their models.

points.text: 开发者档链路里，用户对话会被交给 bot 开发者并可由其保存：Poe Privacy Policy 逐字写「Developers that create bots and apps on Poe using APIs may view and store your chats on their servers to train their models.」——标的 = 用户对话正文，动作 = store，主体 = 开发者（本档的接收跳）。API Terms 没有保留期或零保留条款：§4c 的限制句标的写作「any content provided by Your Bot」（creator FAQ 第 2 问复述为「the responses from your bot」），即**开发者 bot 的输出**，不是用户请求正文——它是不训练 / 不无合同约束转第三方的使用限制，不是保留承诺

points.text: §5(b) 只有一条按请求触发的删除义务（条款原文与落位见 retention 维度），反推默认可以持有；§8 终止条款也未要求删除。故本档不构成零保留。锚点取自 Privacy Policy 的开发者句（该句写在消费档语境），此处按「同一数据流的接收跳」引用，未外推具体天数。
points.text_zh: §5(b) 只有一条按请求触发的删除义务（条款原文与落位见 retention 维度），反推默认可以持有；§8 终止条款也未要求删除。故本档不构成零保留。锚点取自 Privacy Policy 的开发者句（该句写在消费档语境），此处按「同一数据流的接收跳」引用，未外推具体天数。

points.text: This tier is not a total silence on retention, but it still has no period commitment: API Terms §5(b) puts a trigger-based deletion duty on the developer — “promptly delete the personal data when requested by a user (or by us on behalf of a user or their authorized agent) or as required by law”. The duty carries no deadline and no default retention period, so it does not support a fixed_period reading and the basis stays undisclosed; the same clause is also the basis of the zdr conclusion for this tier (see the zdr dimension).
points.text_zh: 本档不是「全文无涉保留」，而是只有按请求删除的义务、没有期限承诺：API Terms §5(b) 对开发者设了一条触发式删除义务——「promptly delete the personal data when requested by a user (or by us on behalf of a user or their authorized agent) or as required by law」。该义务不含量化期限，也不构成默认保留期，故 basis 仍为 undisclosed（不得据此把本档读成「有删除期限承诺」）；同一条款也是本档 zdr 结论的依据，条款原文与落位见 zdr 维度。

points.text: See top-level training. At the contract layer the default licence covers use "in the course of optimizing models and services" (§4.5), and coexists with the "we will not access or use your data without your consent" clauses in User Agreement §6.4 and PPIO Privacy Policy §2.4.5(2); the reading is that entering into the agreement constitutes that consent; no opt-out switch is documented; the licence is granted to "us and our affiliates" and does not cover the third-party technical support provider referred to in §8.6.
points.text_zh: 见顶层 training。合同层默认授权用于「优化模型和服务」（§4.5），与《用户协议》§6.4、《PPIO 隐私政策》§2.4.5(2) 的「未经（明确）同意不使用/不训练」条款并存，读法为签署协议即构成该同意；无退出开关说明；授权对象为「我们及关联公司」，不含 §8.6 所称的第三方技术支持商。

zdr.quote: 当请求与历史 Prompt 完全一致时，系统会直接返回缓存结果

points.text: Same as top-level zdr: zero retention is not supported (no); see the top level for the reasoning chain. All three grounds take the form "this line says X, therefore Y": (1) the Prompt Cache doc says X, "when a request is completely identical to a historical prompt, the system returns the cached result directly" — the object is request content (the historical prompt), therefore Y, the platform retains request content on the inference side, and "transparent to the application" shows this is not a customer-facing switch; the whole page gives no TTL, no purge rule and no way to turn it off
points.text_zh: 同顶层 zdr：不支持零保留（no），判断链见顶层。三条依据都是「这条说的是 X，所以 Y」：①Prompt Cache 文档说的是 X「当请求与历史 Prompt 完全一致时，系统会直接返回缓存结果」——对象是请求内容（历史 Prompt），所以 Y 平台在推理侧保留了请求内容，且「对应用透明」说明它不是客户开关，全篇无 TTL/清除规则/关闭方式

points.text: (2) Model Privacy Policy §5.3.3 says X, "we may not be able to delete the corresponding information from our backup systems immediately" — an admission that backups exist and that deletion is delayed, therefore Y, the "no recoverable copy" requirement of zero retention does not hold
points.text_zh: ②《模型隐私政策》§5.3.3 说的是 X「可能无法立即从备份系统中删除相应的信息」——自认存在备份且删除有延迟，所以 Y 零保留要求的「无副本可恢复」不成立

points.text: (3) the Batch Inference doc says X, "the file will be retained for 15 days" and "the result output file will be deleted 30 days after batch inference finishes" — therefore Y, on the batch tier request content is retained 15 days and output 30 days. For the contrary sentence see docs/model/FAQs ("a stateless interface ... does not save the full conversation content of each request"; that source has been judged drop and its anchor cleared): it says the console does not provide full conversation records (the qualifier is "full" and the context is "how to view API call records"), not "the platform retains no request content", which is not enough to overturn (1) and does not contradict (1) on the same proposition. The retention policy of the upstream technical support provider (User Agreement §8.6) is not disclosed; this conclusion covers only the PPIO hop.
points.text_zh: ③《批量推理》文档说的是 X「该文件将保留 15 天」「结果输出文件将在批量推理结束后 30 天删除」——所以 Y 批量档请求内容保留 15 天、输出 30 天。反向句见 docs/model/FAQs（「无状态接口…不会保存每次请求的完整对话内容」，该源已判 drop、锚点清空）：它说的是控制台不提供完整对话记录（限定词「完整」、语境为「如何查看 API 调用记录」），不是「平台不保留任何请求内容」，不足以推翻①，也不与①构成同一命题的矛盾。上游技术支持商（《用户协议》§8.6）的保留策略未披露，本结论只覆盖 PPIO 这一跳。

points.text: (4) Model Service Agreement §3.6.4 says X, "we have the right to review generated content technically or by humans" (User Agreement §3.5.4 is to the same effect) — therefore Y, the platform reserves the right for personnel to touch the output side of request content. Both sit inside the trial-function sections (Model Service Agreement §3.6 大模型 API 服务试用功能特别规范, User Agreement §3.5 大模型API服务试用功能), so the scope is the trial scenario, and it is a reserved right to review rather than a statement that staff necessarily access content.
points.text_zh: (4)《模型服务协议》§3.6.4 说的是 X「我们有权对生成内容进行技术或人工审核」（《用户协议》§3.5.4 同旨）——所以 Y 平台保留人员接触请求内容输出侧的权利。两条都位于试用功能专节（《模型服务协议》§3.6 大模型 API 服务试用功能特别规范、《用户协议》§3.5 大模型API服务试用功能），适用范围限于试用场景；且它是「有权审核」的保留权利，不等于人员必然访问内容。
points.quote: 我们有权对生成内容进行技术或人工审核

points.text: On the upstream hop: Model Privacy Policy §1.2 expressly excludes services provided by other third parties from that policy (their information handling is governed by the third party's own privacy policy or similar document), so the retention and training policy of the third-party technical support provider (User Agreement §8.6) is not covered by any PPIO document. That is why it is recorded as not disclosed — a statement about the reach of PPIO's documents, not a direction of commitment.
points.text_zh: 关于上游跳：《PPIO 模型隐私政策》§1.2 明文把其他第三方提供的服务排除在本政策之外（其信息处理适用该等第三方的隐私权政策或类似文件），故第三方技术支持商（《用户协议》§8.6）的保留与训练策略不在 PPIO 任何文档的覆盖范围内。这是记为「未披露」的原因——说的是 PPIO 文档的覆盖范围，不是承诺的方向。

points.text: Why this is not a yes (not used for training): §5.5 is only a general restriction on arbitrary use of user data — "except as necessary to provide the service or with your authorisation, Qiniu will not make arbitrary use of your user data". It neither authorises nor rules out model training, and judging yes requires a statement that explicitly shuts model training out, not the mere absence of a mention. Search scope in searched.
points.text_zh: 本维度不能记 yes 的理由:§5.5『除为了提供服务所必须或经您的授权外，七牛云不会对您的用户数据进行任意使用』是对用户数据使用的概括限制,既未授权也未排除模型训练——判 yes(不用于训练)需要明确把模型训练挡在外面的表述,而不是没提到。查阅范围见 searched

points.text: Why this is mark=no: §5.7 is a disclosed service-improvement authorisation over data Qiniu may collect — Qiniu may collect your data or produce certain technical and operational data (system logs, billing data, customer-service conversations, lead information) and "has the right to decide on its own to use such operational data to optimise and improve Qiniu Cloud services", with no opt-out, and neither intl document excludes model training. Under the house rule that using data to improve services counts as training, this points the training way; its object is operational data (including customer-service conversations), not necessarily the API request body, which is why the tier is recorded as terms-permit rather than an explicit statement that API inputs are trained on. The CN agreement §4.4 is worded almost identically, but the CN site additionally has the apidocs FAQ commitment and §4.5, which the intl site lacks — that is why the two tiers point in different directions.
points.text_zh: 本档记 mark=no 的依据:§5.7『七牛云有权自行决定利用该等运营数据优化和改善七牛云服务』是一条例外式的『改善服务』型授权——对象是运营数据(系统日志、账单数据、客服对话、留资信息),无退出开关,而国际站两份文本都没有排除模型训练。按『用来改进服务算训练』的口径,这是训练向授权;对象是运营数据(含客服对话),不必然是 API 请求正文,故记『条款允许』而不是『明示拿 API 输入训练』。国内站 §4.4 措辞与本条近乎平行,但国内站另有 apidocs FAQ 的明确承诺与 §4.5 的『不会擅自使用用户数据』,国际站两者都没有——这是两档结论方向不同的原因

points.text: The closest the intl agreement comes to limiting what Qiniu does with content is §10.5, in the disclaimers and liability-limitation chapter: in the course of the service Qiniu only carries out lawfully, validly and necessarily authorised distribution, transmission, caching and parameter processing of your data (including user data), and does not process the content of your data itself on its own initiative. It is a description of processing forms under a liability disclaimer — it neither authorises nor rules out model training, so it must not be read as a positive basis for "not used for training". It is also the source for caching as a processing form. The CN-site agreement has a near-identical clause (§9.2.3).
points.text_zh: 国际站文本里最接近『不会拿内容做别的事』的是 §10.5(位于『免责条款与责任限制』章):『七牛云服务过程中仅对您的数据（包括用户数据）进行经合法、有效、必要授权的分发、传输、缓存、参数处理等工作，而不会私自对您的数据内容本身进行加工。』它既不授权也不排除训练,属责任限制语境下的处理形态描述,不是数据保护承诺,不能读成『不用于训练』的正面依据;zdr 侧『缓存』这一处理形态也出自此处。国内站协议 §9.2.3 有几乎同义的表述

points.text: The intl agreement's own clause on data flow to third parties is §5.8: user data and personal data may be disclosed in whole or in part (1) with your consent, (2) where required by applicable law or a lawful request from a regulator or judicial body, or (3) to a third party in order to provide the service you requested. The CN-site agreement has the parallel clause §4.7.4. This describes the direction of the data flow (including to upstream providers where the service requires it); it is not by itself a self-declaration of processor or controller status.
points.text_zh: 数据流向的直接条款:国际站协议 §5.8『您确认并同意，您的数据（用户数据和个人数据）可能在下述情况下部分或全部被七牛云披露:(1) 经您授权同意后披露；(2) 根据可适用法律或者应监管机构或司法机构的合法要求披露；或者 (3) 为提供您所要求的服务而向第三方披露。』国内站对应条款为 §4.7.4。本条说明数据会流向第三方(含为提供服务所需的上游),本身不构成受托/控制角色的自述
points.quote: 您确认并同意，您的数据（用户数据和个人数据）可能在下述情况下部分或全部被七牛云披露：(1) 经您授权同意后披露；(2) 根据可适用法律或者应监管机构或司法机构的合法要求披露；或者 (3) 为提供您所要求的服务而向第三方披露。

training.quote: 您通过七牛云 AI 服务提交的数据 **不会被用于训练模型**！

points.text: Tier basis: this tier publishes no data clause of its own (the subscription product description developer.qiniu.com/aitokenapi/13330 contains no data terms, classified not_policy), so it relies on the same set of sources that cover 七牛云 AI 服务 as a service — user agreement §4.4/§4.5, privacy policy §2.2.2 and the developer FAQ.
points.text_zh: 档位依据:该档未公布独立数据条款(产品说明 developer.qiniu.com/aitokenapi/13330 全文无数据条款,分类为 not_policy),故沿用按「七牛云 AI 服务」服务口径覆盖订阅档的同一批来源:用户协议 §4.4/§4.5、隐私政策 §2.2.2、apidocs FAQ。

points.text: Contract layer, with its limits stated: §4.5 "除依据适用法律法规或为了提供服务所需，未经您授权同意，七牛云不会擅自使用用户数据。" This is a general restriction on the use of user data — the clause never mentions 训练, and it carries two exceptions of its own (as required by applicable law, and as needed to provide the service). The same structure on the international site (§5.5) has already been withdrawn as evidence for this dimension (providers/qiniu-ai.toml), so it is recorded here as contract-layer context only; the explicit basis for mark=yes is the FAQ sentence bound as this dimension's anchor.
points.text_zh: 合同层,连同它的限度一并记录:用户协议 §4.5『除依据适用法律法规或为了提供服务所需，未经您授权同意，七牛云不会擅自使用用户数据』。这是对用户数据使用的概括性限制,全文不含「训练」二字,且自带两处例外(依适用法律法规、为提供服务所需)。本仓库对国际站同形条款(§5.5)已按此撤锚(见 providers/qiniu-ai.toml),故此处只作合同层语境记录——本档 mark=yes 的明确依据是绑作本维度锚点的 FAQ 明示句。
points.quote: 除依据适用法律法规或为了提供服务所需，未经您授权同意，七牛云不会擅自使用用户数据。

points.text: The explicit commitment and its tier scope: the developer FAQ writes "您通过七牛云 AI 服务提交的数据 **不会被用于训练模型**！" under the heading 明确承诺. It is developer_data rather than a contract clause, and the sentence names 七牛云 AI 服务 as the service whose submitted data is covered (not one billing mode), which is why it is applied to this tier; no subscription-specific no-training statement exists. Being developer_data it cannot override the user agreement, so the contract layer above is kept side by side instead of replaced.
points.text_zh: 明示承诺与档位范围:apidocs FAQ 在「明确承诺」下写『您通过七牛云 AI 服务提交的数据 **不会被用于训练模型**！』。它是 developer_data 而非合同条款,句子按「七牛云 AI 服务」这个服务(不是某一种计费方式)说提交的数据,故适用于本档;订阅档没有专属的不训练声明。因属 developer_data,不能对抗用户协议,故与上面的合同层并列保留,不互相替换。

points.text: Opposite direction in the same contract, kept side by side without picking a side: §4.4 "您确认并同意，七牛云可能会收集或产生某些技术和运营数据，例如系统日志、账单数据、客服信息等（下称“运营数据”），七牛云有权自行决定利用该等运营数据优化和改善七牛云服务。" Under docs/judgment.md, using data to improve the service counts as training, so this direction has to be shown. Its object is 运营数据 (system logs, billing data, support information) and does not include request content, so it does not overturn mark=yes for inputs and outputs — and it must not be read as "your prompts are used to improve the service".
points.text_zh: 同一份合同里的相反方向,并列保留、不选边:§4.4『您确认并同意，七牛云可能会收集或产生某些技术和运营数据，例如系统日志、账单数据、客服信息等（下称“运营数据”），七牛云有权自行决定利用该等运营数据优化和改善七牛云服务。』按 docs/judgment.md「用来改进服务算训练」,这个方向必须呈现。其对象是「运营数据」(系统日志、账单数据、客服信息等),不含请求内容,故不推翻输入输出侧的 mark=yes——也不能被读成「您的请求内容会被用于改善服务」。
points.quote: 七牛云有权自行决定利用该等运营数据优化和改善七牛云服务。

points.text: Second opposite direction, in the privacy policy: §2.2.2 "为了改善我们的产品、服务并开发给您更好的服务，我们将会使用您的个人信息。" with its own limit in the following clause, "一般情况下，我们为此目的仅使用采用匿名化处理后的综合信息和统计性信息，并不会识别到您个人". Recorded as an authorization direction (service improvement counts as training) plus its anonymized/statistical limit; the object is account and usage-type personal information, whose boundary against request content has to be checked separately.
points.text_zh: 第二处相反方向,在隐私政策:§2.2.2『为了改善我们的产品、服务并开发给您更好的服务，我们将会使用您的个人信息。』紧随其后的限定是『一般情况下，我们为此目的仅使用采用匿名化处理后的综合信息和统计性信息，并不会识别到您个人』。按「授权方向 + 匿名化/统计性限定」两层记;对象主要是账号与使用类个人信息,它与请求正文的边界须另行核实。
points.quote: 为了改善我们的产品、服务并开发给您更好的服务，我们将会使用您的个人信息。

points.text: Upstream boundary: §9.3.1 states that the model's computation, inference and content generation are provided directly by the third-party model suppliers, who have "完整的独立控制权", and this tier resells international models (Claude, GPT-OSS and others in the FAQ model list). This conclusion therefore covers the Qiniu layer only; whether an upstream supplier trains on the request must be checked against that supplier's own policy.
points.text_zh: 上游边界:§9.3.1 写明模型的计算、推理与内容生成能力由各模型供应商直接提供、供应商对其服务拥有「完整的独立控制权」;本档转售 Claude、GPT-OSS 等国际模型(见 FAQ 模型表)。故本结论只覆盖七牛自身层,上游模型供应商是否拿请求训练须按其各自政策另行核实。
points.quote: 七牛云的主要义务在于提供稳定的技术接入、计费与服务平台，而模型的计算、推理与内容生成能力由各模型供应商直接提供

zdr.quote: 七牛云不会存储您的对话内容和敏感信息

points.text: Tier scope: no ZDR statement of its own for this tier (the subscription product description has no data clause). The commitment used is the FAQ sentence bound above, written for 七牛云 AI 服务 as a service; the source note in this file records that same FAQ as covering the domestic pay-as-you-go API tier, so the cross-tier reading rests on that service-level wording plus the absence of any subscription-specific data clause — and it is developer_data, which cannot override the user agreement.
points.text_zh: 档位范围:无订阅档专属 ZDR 声明(订阅档产品说明全文无数据条款)。所用承诺是上面绑定的 FAQ 那句,按「七牛云 AI 服务」这个服务口径写;本文件对该 FAQ 的 source note 自述覆盖国内站按量 API 档,故跨档推定依据的是服务口径措辞 + 订阅档无专属数据条款,且它是 developer_data,不能对抗用户协议。

points.text: Authority layer, and what the contract actually says: the contract clause directly about retention for AI services is §4.8, and it is exclusionary only — AI-type services are outside the general 30-day retention, and where no AI data policy has been published the data is deleted on service termination. It makes no no-storage commitment: "deleted on termination" and "not stored" are two different things, so mark=yes rests on the FAQ sentence, not on §4.8. The AI service data policy that §4.8 refers to has not been found published in the sources registered for this tier.
points.text_zh: 权威层级与合同实际写了什么:与 AI 类服务保留直接相关的合同条款是 §4.8,它只作排除式约定——AI 类服务不适用通用 30 天保留期,政策未公布时服务终止即删除,并没有承诺不存储。「终止即删」与「不存储」是两件事,故本维度 mark=yes 的依据是 FAQ 那句,不是 §4.8。§4.8 所引用的「AI 服务数据政策」在本档已登记的来源中未见公布。
points.quote: 但如您使用的是AI类服务，数据保留期限以七牛云官网届时公布的AI服务数据政策为准；政策未公布的，不适用本条约定的30天保留期，服务终止即删除。

points.text: Log layer, in the same FAQ block: immediately after the no-storage sentence comes "所有 API 调用都有详细日志，可追溯查询". Conversation content not being stored and call logs being kept coexist; per the request-log export doc the log fields are metadata (id, model_id, masked api_key, start/end time, server_type, code, errors, usage, cost) and contain no prompt/response body.
points.text_zh: 日志层,在同一 FAQ 段落里:紧接「不存储对话内容」之后写『所有 API 调用都有详细日志，可追溯查询』。对话内容不存与调用日志留存可以并存;据请求日志导出接口文档,日志字段为元数据(id、model_id、脱敏 api_key、起止时间、server_type、code、errors、用量、费用),不含 prompt/response 正文。
points.quote: 所有 API 调用都有详细日志，可追溯查询

points.text: Upstream boundary: this commitment comes from the developer FAQ (developer_data) and covers the Qiniu layer only. §9.3.1 puts the model's computation, inference and content generation with the third-party suppliers, who have "完整的独立控制权"; retention on that hop must be checked against each supplier's own policy. mark=yes/mode=default is therefore not a zero-retention statement for the whole chain, including the resold Claude/GPT/Gemini models.
points.text_zh: 上游边界:本承诺出自开发者 FAQ(developer_data),只覆盖七牛自身层。§9.3.1 把模型的计算、推理与内容生成交给第三方模型供应商、供应商拥有「完整的独立控制权」;这一跳的留存须按各原厂政策另行核实。故 mark=yes/mode=default 不构成对整条链路(含转售的 Claude/GPT/Gemini 等模型)的零保留承诺。
points.quote: 七牛云的主要义务在于提供稳定的技术接入、计费与服务平台，而模型的计算、推理与内容生成能力由各模型供应商直接提供

retention.summary: 按对象分列留至服务终止
retention.quote: 但如您使用的是AI类服务，数据保留期限以七牛云官网届时公布的AI服务数据政策为准；政策未公布的，不适用本条约定的30天保留期，服务终止即删除。

points.text: Contract layer, object = AI service data: §4.8 excludes AI-type services from the general 30-day retention and provides that where no AI data policy has been published, the data is deleted on service termination. What the contract commits to is deletion at termination, not zero retention — data is kept during the service term and removed when the service ends. The AI service data policy that §4.8 refers to has not been found published in the sources registered for this tier, so retention inside the service term is governed by that policy. The clause does not distinguish billing mode, so the subscription tier is under the same rule.
points.text_zh: 合同层,对象=AI 类服务数据:§4.8 把 AI 类服务排除在通用 30 天保留期之外,并约定政策未公布时「服务终止即删除」。合同承诺的是终止时删除,不是零留存——数据在服务期内留存、服务终止时删除。§4.8 所引用的「AI 服务数据政策」在本档已登记的来源中未见公布,服务期内的留存期限以该政策为准。该条不区分计费方式,订阅档同受此约束。

points.text: Object = request logs (metadata): the request-log export doc states "日志保留周期约为 30 天（以实际配置为准），请及时下载所需数据。" and lists the log fields as id, model_id, masked api_key, start/end time, server_type, code, errors, state, usage and cost — metadata only, no prompt/response body. This is the log layer, a different object both from the conversation content and from account personal information.
points.text_zh: 对象=请求日志(元数据):请求日志导出接口文档写『日志保留周期约为 30 天（以实际配置为准），请及时下载所需数据。』,并列出日志字段为 id、model_id、脱敏 api_key、起止时间、server_type、code、errors、state、用量与费用——只有元数据,不含 prompt/response 正文。这是日志层,与对话内容、账号个人信息都不是同一个对象。
points.quote: 日志保留周期约为 30 天（以实际配置为准），请及时下载所需数据。

points.text: The same FAQ paragraph discloses the log layer next to the no-storage sentence: "所有 API 调用都有详细日志，可追溯查询" — conversation content not stored, call metadata logged. Recorded so that the log layer is not misread as content retention.
points.text_zh: 同一 FAQ 段落在「不存储对话内容」旁披露了日志层:『所有 API 调用都有详细日志，可追溯查询』——对话内容不存,调用元数据有日志。记下来,免得把日志层误读成内容留存。
points.quote: 所有 API 调用都有详细日志，可追溯查询

points.text: Object = account and transaction personal information (a third, different object): privacy policy §5.4 keeps it for the minimum period required by law, and for identity and transaction information under the online-transaction/identity record-keeping duty states "您提供的个人信息将至少保存3年". This is a floor, not a deletion deadline, and it says nothing about how long inputs and outputs are kept.
points.text_zh: 对象=账号与交易类个人信息(第三个、不同的对象):隐私政策 §5.4 按法律要求的最短期限保存,其中为履行网络在线交易/互联网服务对身份及交易信息的保存义务写『您提供的个人信息将至少保存3年』。这是下限而非删除期限,也不能用来推断输入输出正文的保留期。
points.quote: 您提供的个人信息将至少保存3年

The commitment not to transfer overseas is therefore not absolute; the exception does not change codes=["CN"], it limits how that code is read.
points.text_zh: CN 锚点同段自带的例外:紧随「不会向境外传输」之后写『如七牛云因涉及跨境业务，需向境外机构传输境内收集的相关个人信息的，我们会按照法律法规和相关监管部门的规定执行』。故「不会向境外传输」并非绝对;该例外不改变 codes=["CN"],但限定了它的读法。
points.quote: 如七牛云因涉及跨境业务，需向境外机构传输境内收集的相关个人信息的，我们会按照法律法规和相关监管部门的规定执行

points.text: Upstream boundary: this tier resells international models (Claude, GPT-OSS and others in the FAQ model list) and §9.3.1 provides that the model's computation, inference and content generation are supplied directly by the third-party suppliers, who have "完整的独立控制权". The per-model location of the actual inference capacity is not disclosed, so this row covers the Qiniu layer and the account/log data only — it is not a conclusion that all inference happens inside China.
points.text_zh: 上游边界:本档转售国际模型(FAQ 模型表含 Claude、GPT-OSS 等),§9.3.1 写明模型的计算、推理与内容生成由各模型供应商直接提供、供应商拥有「完整的独立控制权」。逐模型的实际算力所在地没有披露,故本条只覆盖七牛自身层与账号/日志数据,不构成「全部推理在中国境内完成」的结论。
points.quote: 七牛云的主要义务在于提供稳定的技术接入、计费与服务平台，而模型的计算、推理与内容生成能力由各模型供应商直接提供

role.quote: 我们将按照您的指令、委托处理您的客户数据。

points.text: 同源:受托处理客户数据 + 网关层由模型供应商直接提供推理(用户协议 §9.3.1)
points.text_zh: 同源:受托处理客户数据 + 网关层由模型供应商直接提供推理(用户协议 §9.3.1)

points.text: Two roles, recorded separately: for customer data and end-user personal information Qiniu is the processor ("我们将按照您的指令、委托处理您的客户数据。"), while for account registration and business-contact personal information it collects and uses that information for its own purposes — privacy policy §2 opens with "我们仅会出于本政策所述的以下目的，收集和使用您的个人信息：", i.e. it is the controller for that data. The kind field records the customer-data side (processor).
points.text_zh: 双角色,分开记:对客户数据/最终用户个人信息,七牛是受托处理者(『我们将按照您的指令、委托处理您的客户数据。』);对账号注册与业务联系类个人信息,它是以自身目的收集使用——隐私政策 §2 开篇即『我们仅会出于本政策所述的以下目的，收集和使用您的个人信息：』,这部分它是控制者。kind 字段按客户数据这一面记 processor。
points.quote: 我们仅会出于本政策所述的以下目的，收集和使用您的个人信息：

points.text: 订阅档产品说明未改变角色约定
points.text_zh: 订阅档产品说明未改变角色约定

training.quote: Depending on your plan, you may opt out of such use at any time by disabling the “Share & Improve” setting, which will prevent your User Content from being used for the purposes described above.

points.text: Enterprise tier — object of the improvement use: "We take steps to remove personal data from your User Content, as permitted by applicable law, before it is used to research, develop, and improve our Services." The vendor describes de-identifying User Content first and conditions the use on applicable law; that is its own description of a measure, not a verified fact, and it also defines the object of the five-year row.
points.text_zh: Enterprise 档——「改进服务」用途的对象：「We take steps to remove personal data from your User Content, as permitted by applicable law, before it is used to research, develop, and improve our Services.」厂商称先移除 User Content 中的个人数据、并以法律允许为条件；这是厂商自述措施而非已核实事实，该句同时定义了五年上限那一行的对象。
points.quote: We take steps to remove personal data from your User Content, as permitted by applicable law, before it is used to research, develop, and improve our Services.

points.text: Enterprise tier — the opt-out does not reach back: "Any data already processed for the above purposes prior to disabling this setting may continue to be retained and used in accordance with this section." Disabling Share & Improve stops later use only, and the setting itself is plan-dependent ("Depending on your plan, you may opt out …").
points.text_zh: Enterprise 档——退出不追溯：「Any data already processed for the above purposes prior to disabling this setting may continue to be retained and used in accordance with this section.」关闭 Share & Improve 只阻止后续使用；该开关本身按档位而定（原文「Depending on your plan, you may opt out …」）。
points.quote: Any data already processed for the above purposes prior to disabling this setting may continue to be retained and used in accordance with this section.

points.text: Enterprise tier — chain, not a single hop: Outputs are generated with third-party LLMs — "large language models (such as Alibaba’s Qwen, MoonShoot’s Kimi) to support your coding experience and help generate Outputs" — so each upstream hop's own policy applies to its copy and, under the weakest-hop rule, an upstream that trains on inputs would make the chain a no. Same paragraph, mitigating: "All such Service Providers are contractually required to maintain data protection standards equal to or exceeding those required by applicable laws and regulations …". Upstream policies are not registered as sources yet.
points.text_zh: Enterprise 档——链路，不是单跳：Outputs 由第三方 LLM 参与生成（原文「large language models (such as Alibaba’s Qwen, MoonShoot’s Kimi) to support your coding experience and help generate Outputs」），上游各跳按自身政策处理其副本；按「任一跳明确为否则全链为否」，上游若训练输入即全链为否。同段减轻表述：「All such Service Providers are contractually required to maintain data protection standards equal to or exceeding those required by applicable laws and regulations …」。上游政策尚未登记为来源。
points.quote: We may share your personal data with service providers we engage from time to time to provide various services, including cloud infrastructure to host our Services, large language models (such as Alibaba’s Qwen, MoonShoot’s Kimi) to support your coding experience and help generate Outputs, as well as codebase data storage and web search providers that help us provide and deliver the Service. All such Service Providers are contractually required to maintain data protection standards equal to or exceeding those required by applicable laws and regulations, in order to facilitate the delivery of our Services.

points.text: Enterprise tier — scope condition, BYOK: "When you enable the “Bring Your Own Key” (BYOK) feature, your information may be transmitted to third-party service providers designated by you, and such transmission constitutes your own independent action rather than a sharing practice by our Service, and the processing of such data shall be governed by the privacy policies of the respective third-party service providers." The default path is not covered by this exception.
points.text_zh: Enterprise 档——适用范围条件（BYOK）：原文「When you enable the “Bring Your Own Key” (BYOK) feature, your information may be transmitted to third-party service providers designated by you, and such transmission constitutes your own independent action rather than a sharing practice by our Service, and the processing of such data shall be governed by the privacy policies of the respective third-party service providers.」默认路径不适用该例外。
points.quote: When you enable the “Bring Your Own Key” (BYOK) feature, your information may be transmitted to third-party service providers designated by you, and such transmission constitutes your own independent action rather than a sharing practice by our Service, and the processing of such data shall be governed by the privacy policies of the respective third-party service providers.

points.text: Enterprise tier — scope note on the chain, not evidence of a zero-retention option (no ZDR wording exists in the policy): Outputs may be produced with third-party LLMs ("such as Alibaba’s Qwen, MoonShoot’s Kimi"), each hop carrying its own stance; the vendor only commits that such providers are "contractually required to maintain data protection standards equal to or exceeding those required by applicable laws and regulations". No upstream option is evidenced here, and no upstream policy is registered as a source yet.
points.text_zh: Enterprise 档——链路适用范围说明，不构成零保留方案的证据（政策中没有任何 ZDR 措辞）：Outputs 可能由第三方 LLM 生成（原文「such as Alibaba’s Qwen, MoonShoot’s Kimi」），各跳各有口径；厂商只承诺这些服务商「contractually required to maintain data protection standards equal to or exceeding those required by applicable laws and regulations」。本文件没有上游零保留方案的证据，上游政策亦未登记为来源。
points.quote: We may share your personal data with service providers we engage from time to time to provide various services, including cloud infrastructure to host our Services, large language models (such as Alibaba’s Qwen, MoonShoot’s Kimi) to support your coding experience and help generate Outputs, as well as codebase data storage and web search providers that help us provide and deliver the Service. All such Service Providers are contractually required to maintain data protection standards equal to or exceeding those required by applicable laws and regulations, in order to facilitate the delivery of our Services.

points.text: Enterprise tier — scope condition, BYOK: a scope note, not a ZDR statement. With BYOK on, "the processing of such data shall be governed by the privacy policies of the respective third-party service providers", so a zero-retention question on that path belongs to the upstream. The default path is unaffected.
points.text_zh: Enterprise 档——适用范围条件（BYOK）：范围说明，不是零保留表态。启用 BYOK 后「the processing of such data shall be governed by the privacy policies of the respective third-party service providers」，该路径的零保留问题归上游；默认路径不受影响。
points.quote: When you enable the “Bring Your Own Key” (BYOK) feature, your information may be transmitted to third-party service providers designated by you, and such transmission constitutes your own independent action rather than a sharing practice by our Service, and the processing of such data shall be governed by the privacy policies of the respective third-party service providers.

retention.quote: We retain information for as long as necessary to provide the Service and for the other purposes set out in this Privacy Policy. We also retain information when necessary to comply with our contractual and legal obligations, when we have a legitimate business interest to do so (such as improving and developing the Service, and enhancing its safety, security, and stability), and for the exercise or defense of legal claims.

points.text: Enterprise tier — the only quantified period, and what it covers: the purpose-table row "To research, develop and improve our Services | - User Content in a de-identified format. | Up to five years from the date of collection" — object = de-identified User Content; context = the research/development/improvement purpose; type = an upper bound, not a fixed deletion date for inputs and outputs.
points.text_zh: Enterprise 档——唯一量化的期限及其覆盖面：用途表那一行「To research, develop and improve our Services | - User Content in a de-identified format. | Up to five years from the date of collection」——对象=去标识化后的 User Content；语境=研发与改进用途；期限类型=上限，不是输入输出正文的固定删除期。
points.quote: To research, develop and improve our Services | - User Content in a de-identified format. | Up to five years from the date of collection

points.text: Enterprise tier — periods differ by object and purpose: "The retention periods will be different depending on the type of information and the purposes for which we use the information. For example, we retain your Account Information for as long as you have an account." The same paragraph adds that a Terms violation lets the vendor remove access immediately while retaining the information to investigate.
points.text_zh: Enterprise 档——期限按对象与目的而异：「The retention periods will be different depending on the type of information and the purposes for which we use the information. For example, we retain your Account Information for as long as you have an account.」同段另写：违反服务条款时可立即停止访问，但按调查需要继续保留信息。
points.quote: The retention periods will be different depending on the type of information and the purposes for which we use the information. For example, we retain your Account Information for as long as you have an account.

points.text: Enterprise tier — tier-specific retention context: "If you are a member of an Organization under an Enterprise or Team Plan, we may share your personal data with your Organization, Administrators of your Organization, and/or other users (if applicable) in your Organization." Member data reaches the Organization and its Administrators, so retention here is not the individual's alone to control. What the public consumer policy says is this tier's default; an enterprise subscription or a DPA would govern if it says otherwise, and no contract-layer source is registered in this file — so these figures are the public-policy default, not the contractual one.
points.text_zh: Enterprise 档——本档特有的保留语境：「If you are a member of an Organization under an Enterprise or Team Plan, we may share your personal data with your Organization, Administrators of your Organization, and/or other users (if applicable) in your Organization.」成员数据会到达组织及其管理员，本档留存不由个人单独控制。公开消费级政策所述是本档默认值；企业订阅条款或 DPA 另有约定者从其约定，而本文件没有登记合同层来源——故这些数字是公开政策下的默认值，不是合同值。
points.quote: If you are a member of an Organization under an Enterprise or Team Plan, we may share your personal data with your Organization, Administrators of your Organization, and/or other users (if applicable) in your Organization.

points.text: Enterprise tier — conditional deletion/de-identification commitment: "When we have no further legitimate need or legal reason to retain your personal data, we will either delete it in a secure manner or deidentify it such that can no longer be associated with you." Conditional on no need or legal reason remaining — not scheduled deletion, and not a basis of "none".
points.text_zh: Enterprise 档——条件式的删除/去标识化承诺：「When we have no further legitimate need or legal reason to retain your personal data, we will either delete it in a secure manner or deidentify it such that can no longer be associated with you.」前提是已无正当需要或法律理由——不是按期删除，也不能读成「不留存」。
points.quote: When we have no further legitimate need or legal reason to retain your personal data, we will either delete it in a secure manner or deidentify it such that can no longer be associated with you.

points.text: Enterprise tier — exception context for deletion requests: "We may be unable to comply with your request if we are required to retain your information due to legal or regulatory obligations, such as when the information is necessary to complete a transaction, when fulfilling the request would compromise the privacy of others, or when it would be impractical to do so." A limit on the right, not a period.
points.text_zh: Enterprise 档——删除请求的例外语境：「We may be unable to comply with your request if we are required to retain your information due to legal or regulatory obligations, such as when the information is necessary to complete a transaction, when fulfilling the request would compromise the privacy of others, or when it would be impractical to do so.」这是权利行使的限制，不是期限。
points.quote: We may be unable to comply with your request if we are required to retain your information due to legal or regulatory obligations, such as when the information is necessary to complete a transaction, when fulfilling the request would compromise the privacy of others, or when it would be impractical to do so.

points.text: Enterprise tier — data already processed for improvement keeps its own life: "Any data already processed for the above purposes prior to disabling this setting may continue to be retained and used in accordance with this section." Switching off Share & Improve does not shorten retention of what was processed before.
points.text_zh: Enterprise 档——此前已用于改进的数据另有存续口径：「Any data already processed for the above purposes prior to disabling this setting may continue to be retained and used in accordance with this section.」关闭 Share & Improve 不会缩短此前已处理数据的保留。
points.quote: Any data already processed for the above purposes prior to disabling this setting may continue to be retained and used in accordance with this section.

points.text: Enterprise tier — chain: the same question has an upstream hop. Outputs are generated with third-party LLMs ("such as Alibaba’s Qwen, MoonShoot’s Kimi") and the only commitment about them is that they are "contractually required to maintain data protection standards equal to or exceeding those required by applicable laws and regulations"; their own policies govern their copies and are not registered as sources here.
points.text_zh: Enterprise 档——链路：同一问题还有上游一跳。Outputs 由第三方 LLM 参与生成（原文「such as Alibaba’s Qwen, MoonShoot’s Kimi」），厂商对它们的唯一承诺是「contractually required to maintain data protection standards equal to or exceeding those required by applicable laws and regulations」；上游按自身政策留存其副本，这些政策尚未登记为来源。
points.quote: We may share your personal data with service providers we engage from time to time to provide various services, including cloud infrastructure to host our Services, large language models (such as Alibaba’s Qwen, MoonShoot’s Kimi) to support your coding experience and help generate Outputs, as well as codebase data storage and web search providers that help us provide and deliver the Service. All such Service Providers are contractually required to maintain data protection standards equal to or exceeding those required by applicable laws and regulations, in order to facilitate the delivery of our Services.

points.text: Enterprise tier — scope condition, BYOK: with BYOK on, "the processing of such data shall be governed by the privacy policies of the respective third-party service providers" — retention on that path is the designated provider's, not Qoder's. The default path is not covered by this exception.
points.text_zh: Enterprise 档——适用范围条件（BYOK）：启用 BYOK 后「the processing of such data shall be governed by the privacy policies of the respective third-party service providers」——该路径的留存由用户指定的服务商决定，不是 Qoder 的承诺。默认路径不适用该例外。
points.quote: When you enable the “Bring Your Own Key” (BYOK) feature, your information may be transmitted to third-party service providers designated by you, and such transmission constitutes your own independent action rather than a sharing practice by our Service, and the processing of such data shall be governed by the privacy policies of the respective third-party service providers.

processing_region.summary: 美国 / 新加坡 / 日本
processing_region.quote: We process and store the information we collect in secure servers located in the United States, Singapore and Japan.

points.text: Enterprise tier — the three countries are the main server locations, not every entity that may process: "Certain entities within our corporate group ("Corporate Group") receive and process personal data to support the provision of the Services. These entities process Information Provided By You, Automatically Collected Information, and Information From Other Sources for us, as necessary to provide functions such as storage, operation and maintenance of Service, security, research and development, analytics, online payments, customer and technical support." Group entities and the §4 third parties may process outside US/SG/JP.
points.text_zh: Enterprise 档——三国是主要服务器所在地，不等于全部可能处理数据的实体：原文「Certain entities within our corporate group (“Corporate Group”) receive and process personal data to support the provision of the Services. These entities process Information Provided By You, Automatically Collected Information, and Information From Other Sources for us, as necessary to provide functions such as storage, operation and maintenance of Service, security, research and development, analytics, online payments, customer and technical support.」集团内实体与 §4 的第三方都可能在美国/新加坡/日本之外处理。
points.quote: Certain entities within our corporate group ("Corporate Group") receive and process personal data to support the provision of the Services. These entities process Information Provided By You, Automatically Collected Information, and Information From Other Sources for us, as necessary to provide functions such as storage, operation and maintenance of Service, security, research and development, analytics, online payments, customer and technical support.

points.text: Enterprise tier — the policy itself says processing entities may sit elsewhere: "Your personal data will be stored in Singapore. Your personal data may however be transferred to or accessed by our officers, employees, support staff, agents, Third Party Service Providers (and their sub-processors, if any), and our affiliate companies (and their designated Service Providers and the latter’s sub-processors, if any), which may be located in several other jurisdictions." (Philippines Addendum.)
points.text_zh: Enterprise 档——政策自己写明处理实体可能位于别处：「Your personal data will be stored in Singapore. Your personal data may however be transferred to or accessed by our officers, employees, support staff, agents, Third Party Service Providers (and their sub-processors, if any), and our affiliate companies (and their designated Service Providers and the latter’s sub-processors, if any), which may be located in several other jurisdictions.」（菲律宾附则。）
points.quote: Your personal data will be stored in Singapore. Your personal data may however be transferred to or accessed by our officers, employees, support staff, agents, Third Party Service Providers (and their sub-processors, if any), and our affiliate companies (and their designated Service Providers and the latter’s sub-processors, if any), which may be located in several other jurisdictions.

role.quote: We use, process, and/or disclose your personal data for the following purposes:

points.text: Enterprise tier — reading, not a vendor self-designation: the policy never calls Qoder a controller or a processor; its stance is that of a party setting its own purposes — "We use, process, and/or disclose your personal data for the following purposes:" — and the operating entity is BRIGHT ZENITH PRIVATE LIMITED (Singapore). The only controller/sub-processor wording sits elsewhere (a cookie-table row naming Google as the data controller for Google Analytics, and the sub-processor chain described for service providers). No DPA or subscription terms are registered in this file, so the value below is our reading of the privacy policy alone.
points.text_zh: Enterprise 档——这是解读而非厂商自述：政策没有把 Qoder 称作 controller 或 processor；其口径是由自己设定处理目的——「We use, process, and/or disclose your personal data for the following purposes:」——签约主体为 BRIGHT ZENITH PRIVATE LIMITED（新加坡）。仅有的 controller/sub-processor 字样在别处（cookie 表把 Google 列为 Google Analytics 的数据控制者；服务商链条提到其子处理者）。本文件未登记 DPA 或订阅条款，故下列取值只是我们对隐私政策的解读。
points.quote: We use, process, and/or disclose your personal data for the following purposes:

points.text: Enterprise tier — tier-specific, and why this tier's role is the least settled: "If you are a member of an Organization under an Enterprise or Team Plan, we may share your personal data with your Organization, Administrators of your Organization, and/or other users (if applicable) in your Organization." The Organization side can reach member data, so who is controller for what would normally come from subscription terms or a DPA — none is registered in this file, and the value below is the consumer-policy reading.
points.text_zh: Enterprise 档——本档特有，也是本档角色最不确定的原因：「If you are a member of an Organization under an Enterprise or Team Plan, we may share your personal data with your Organization, Administrators of your Organization, and/or other users (if applicable) in your Organization.」组织侧可以拿到成员数据，因此「谁是控制者」通常由订阅条款或 DPA 约定——本文件都没有登记，下列取值只是消费级政策下的解读。
points.quote: If you are a member of an Organization under an Enterprise or Team Plan, we may share your personal data with your Organization, Administrators of your Organization, and/or other users (if applicable) in your Organization.

points.text: Enterprise tier — several processing entities behind one facing entity: "Certain entities within our corporate group ("Corporate Group") receive and process personal data to support the provision of the Services. These entities process Information Provided By You, Automatically Collected Information, and Information From Other Sources for us …" — they act "for us", which leaves the facing role with BRIGHT ZENITH while the intra-group allocation stays undescribed.
points.text_zh: Enterprise 档——一个对外实体背后有多个处理实体：原文「Certain entities within our corporate group (“Corporate Group”) receive and process personal data to support the provision of the Services. These entities process Information Provided By You, Automatically Collected Information, and Information From Other Sources for us …」——它们「for us」处理，对外角色仍落在 BRIGHT ZENITH 身上，集团内部分配未作说明。

These entities process Information Provided By You, Automatically Collected Information, and Information From Other Sources for us, as necessary to provide functions such as storage, operation and maintenance of Service, security, research and development, analytics, online payments, customer and technical support.

points.text: Enterprise tier — why the entity sentence is not role evidence: "BRIGHT ZENITH PRIVATE LIMITED, a Singapore registered entity (“BRIGHT ZENITH”), collect, use, disclose, and protect your personal data." It is the policy's scope self-description and designates no controller or processor; it is kept here for the operating-entity fact.
points.text_zh: Enterprise 档——主体那句话为什么不算角色依据：「BRIGHT ZENITH PRIVATE LIMITED, a Singapore registered entity (“BRIGHT ZENITH”), collect, use, disclose, and protect your personal data.」这是政策的适用范围自述，没有指定 controller 或 processor；保留它只为记录签约主体。
points.quote: BRIGHT ZENITH PRIVATE LIMITED, a Singapore registered entity (“BRIGHT ZENITH”), collect, use, disclose, and protect your personal data.

training.quote: To research, develop and improve our Services | - User Content in a de-identified format. | Up to five years from the date of collection
