For individual and team users, Replit configures OpenRouter requests with the following privacy defaults:

*   **Paid endpoints training disabled**: Your data will not be used for training by paid model providers
*   **Free endpoints training enabled**: Free model providers may train on your prompts and completions
*   **Free endpoints publishing enabled**: Free providers may publish your prompts and completions to public datasets

points.text: 公开文档只把 ZDR 端点限定给 Enterprise；Core 没有零数据保留承诺。
points.text_zh: 公开文档只把 ZDR 端点限定给 Enterprise；Core 没有零数据保留承诺。

retention.quote: We take measures to delete your data or maintain it in a de-identified form when it is no longer necessary to be kept in identifiable form, unless we are required by law to keep this information for a longer period.

points.text: 隐私政策仅承诺不再需要可识别数据时删除或去标识化，没有公布 Core 提示词与响应的量化期限。
points.text_zh: 隐私政策仅承诺不再需要可识别数据时删除或去标识化，没有公布 Core 提示词与响应的量化期限。

points.text: The contract layer for this tier fixes no period either: on account deletion Replit deletes stored data in accordance with its data retention policy and applicable law, which leaves the length to that policy rather than to a stated number.
points.text_zh: 本档的合同层同样没有给出期限：账号删除时 Replit 按其数据保留政策与适用法律删除已存储的数据，长度交给该政策而非固定数字。
points.quote: Upon account deletion, we will delete your stored data in accordance with our data retention policy and applicable law.

processing_region.quote: Workspace geography selection is available only to Pro customers. Publishing geography selection is available to Core, Pro, and Enterprise customers. Free customers publish to North America by default.

points.text: 服务主要托管于美国；Core 可在发布时选择部署地域，但 Workspace 地域选择仅向 Pro 开放。
points.text_zh: 服务主要托管于美国；Core 可在发布时选择部署地域，但 Workspace 地域选择仅向 Pro 开放。
points.quote: Workspace geography selection is available only to Pro customers. Publishing geography selection is available to Core, Pro, and Enterprise customers. Free customers publish to North America by default.

points.text: The two settings are independent by design: Replit provides separate geography settings, so development and published app locations are managed independently of each other.
points.text_zh: 两套设置在设计上相互独立：Replit 提供分开的地域设置，开发位置与已发布 app 的位置各自管理。
points.quote: Choose where your workspace and published app infrastructure is hosted to support data residency and reduce latency. Replit provides separate geography settings, so you can manage development and published app locations independently.

points.text: DPA 并入商业协议，而公开条款只明确 Pro 与 Enterprise 适用商业协议；Core 的 controller/processor 角色未公开界定。
points.text_zh: DPA 并入商业协议，而公开条款只明确 Pro 与 Enterprise 适用商业协议；Core 的 controller/processor 角色未公开界定。
points.quote: If you use our Pro or Enterprise Service, the [Replit Commercial Agreement](https://replit.com/commercial-agreement) will apply and govern your use of our services.

training.quote: Replit will not use Customer Content to develop or improve Replit's products or services, train machine learning models, or create derivative works, except as expressly permitted in this Agreement.

points.text: The Enterprise Agreement carries an express use restriction: Replit will not use Customer Content to develop or improve its own products or services, train machine learning models, or create derivative works, except as expressly permitted in the agreement.
points.text_zh: 企业协议含明确的使用限制：除协议明确允许外，Replit 不会用客户内容开发或改进自家产品或服务、训练机器学习模型或创作衍生作品。

points.text: Replit's product documentation states the same in one line: for Enterprise users, Replit does not use customer content to train its models.
points.text_zh: Replit 的产品文档用一句话重复了同一结论：对企业用户，Replit 不会用客户内容训练其模型。
points.quote: For Enterprise users, Replit does not use customer content to train its models.

points.text: Usage Data is carved out of the restriction — de-identified interaction data that excludes Customer Content remains usable for internal analytics and business purposes.
points.text_zh: Usage Data 被排除在该限制之外——不含客户内容的去标识化交互数据仍可用于内部分析与商业目的。

points.text: The licence in B.2.c and the restriction in B.2.g sit side by side in the same section: the customer grants Replit the right to use Customer Content "including for troubleshooting, improving, and ensuring the safety and security of the Platform", while B.2.g forbids using Customer Content to develop or improve Replit's products or services "except as expressly permitted in this Agreement". Whether platform-improvement work counts as such an express permission is left for the agreement to resolve, so the no-training conclusion rests on B.2.g while the licence's improvement language remains an in-contract exception to be clarified.
points.text_zh: 同一节里 B.2.c 的许可与 B.2.g 的限制并列：客户授予 Replit 使用客户内容的权利，「包括用于排障、改进平台以及保障平台安全」；而 B.2.g 禁止用客户内容开发或改进 Replit 的产品或服务，「除本协议明确允许外」。「改进平台」是否构成这种明确许可，协议本身没有点名，因此「不训练」的结论建立在 B.2.g 上，而许可里的改进措辞属于协议内待澄清的例外。
points.quote: Only as necessary to provide the Platform and related services, Customer grants to Replit a non-exclusive, worldwide, fully paid-up, royalty-free right and license to use, copy, store, transmit, backup, archive, parse, access, modify, and display Customer Content, including for troubleshooting, improving, and ensuring the safety and security of the Platform.

zdr.quote:
For Enterprise organizations, Replit enforces stricter privacy controls:

*   **Zero Data Retention (ZDR) endpoints only**: Only models with a Zero Data Retention policy are available

points.text: For Enterprise organisations Replit enforces a routing rule rather than offering an opt-in: only models with a Zero Data Retention policy are available, so Enterprise requests are only routed to endpoints that do not retain any data.
points.text_zh: 对企业组织，Replit 强制一条路由规则而非提供自助开关：只提供带零数据保留政策的模型，企业请求只路由到不保留任何数据的端点。
points.quote: This ensures that Enterprise requests are only routed to endpoints that do not retain any data

points.text: Scope matters here: this ZDR is about which upstream endpoints Replit will route to through AI Integrations, not a statement that Replit itself retains nothing. Replit's platform-side retention (privacy policy, DPA, deletion windows) is unchanged by it, and the trade-off is a more limited model list.
points.text_zh: 适用范围要注意：这条 ZDR 讲的是 Replit 经 AI Integrations 会路由到哪些上游端点，不等于 Replit 自身什么都不留。平台侧的保留（隐私政策、DPA、删除窗口）不因此改变，代价是可用模型更少。

points.text: The rule is a premise of using AI Integrations: for Pro and Enterprise organizations Replit AI Integrations access is disabled by default, and an organization admin has to enable it from the organization settings page before requests are routed under the ZDR-only rule.
points.text_zh: 这条规则以使用 AI Integrations 为前提：Pro 与 Enterprise 组织默认关闭该功能的访问，需组织管理员在组织设置页开启后，请求才会按「仅 ZDR 端点」的规则路由。
points.quote: For Pro and Enterprise organizations, Replit AI Integrations access is disabled by default. Organization admins can control access from the organization settings page

retention.quote: We take measures to delete your data or maintain it in a de-identified form when it is no longer necessary to be kept in identifiable form, unless we are required by law to keep this information for a longer period.

points.text: The DPA's ninety-day figure is a post-termination window for the customer to request return or deletion of Customer Personal Data, not a retention period for prompt and response content: the DPA terminates with the agreement, and Replit may retain Customer Personal Data where applicable law requires.
points.text_zh: DPA 的 90 天是协议终止后客户请求返还或删除客户个人数据的窗口，不是提示词与响应正文的保留期限：DPA 随协议终止，且适用法律要求时 Replit 可以保留客户个人数据。
points.quote: Customer may request return or deletion of Customer Personal Data up to ninety (90) days after termination of the Agreement. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Company may retain Customer Personal Data where required by applicable law.

points.text: The Enterprise Agreement adds a 30-day migration window: the customer may migrate or request migration of its content for up to thirty days after termination.
points.text_zh: 企业协议另给 30 天迁移窗口：客户可在终止后 30 天内迁移或请求迁移其内容。
points.quote: Customer may migrate or request migration of its content from the Platform for up to thirty (30) days after termination of this Agreement.

points.text: Outside those windows the privacy policy's as-needed deletion rule still applies, and no period for prompt and response content is published.
points.text_zh: 在这些窗口之外，隐私政策的按需删除规则仍然适用，提示词与响应正文没有公布期限。
points.quote: We take measures to delete your data or maintain it in a de-identified form when it is no longer necessary to be kept in identifiable form, unless we are required by law to keep this information for a longer period.

points.text: Retention length also has a customer-side configuration component: the responsibility matrix assigns "data retention, deletion, and export" to Replit as the mechanism and to the customer as the configuration — a division of responsibility rather than a period, and one that sits alongside the DPA window this tier has.
points.text_zh: 保留长度也有客户侧的配置成分：责任矩阵把「数据保留、删除与导出」记为 Replit 提供机制、客户做配置——这是责任划分而非期限，且与本档另有的 DPA 窗口并存。
points.quote:
Data retention, deletion, and export | How long data is kept and how it is deleted or exported. | Replit (mechanism)
You (configuration) |

processing_region.quote: Enterprise admins can enforce a publishing geography for all projects across their organization. When a policy is set, builders in the organization publish to the configured geography.

points.text: Enterprise admins can enforce a publishing geography for all projects across the organisation; the policy applies only to projects not yet published, and already-published projects keep their geography.
points.text_zh: 企业管理员可为全组织的项目强制发布地域；该策略只对尚未发布的项目生效，已发布项目保持原地域。

points.text: Outside the residency controls, services are primarily hosted in the United States and may be hosted elsewhere.
points.text_zh: 在驻留控制之外，服务主要托管在美国，也可能托管在其他地方。
points.quote: Our Services are primarily hosted in the United States and may also be hosted in locations outside of the jurisdiction in which you live.

points.text: The subprocessor list places the AI-model entries in the USA — Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Baseten, Fireworks AI and OpenRouter are all listed as USA, which is the upstream hop this ledger has to account for separately.
points.text_zh: 子处理者清单把 AI 模型相关条目列在美国——Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、Baseten、Fireworks AI 与 OpenRouter 均标 USA，这是台账必须单独核算的上游一跳。
points.quote: | Anthropic | USA | AI models |

role.quote: To the extent Customer acts as a Controller, Customer appoints Company as a Processor with respect to the Personal Data provided by Customer to Company to perform the Services on Customer's behalf.

points.text: Customer as controller, Replit appointed as processor for the personal data provided to perform the services on the customer's behalf; processor-to-processor terms apply where the customer is itself a processor.
points.text_zh: 客户为控制者，Replit 被指定为受托处理方，处理客户为履行服务而提供的数据；客户本身是处理方时适用处理方对处理方条款。

points.text: Replit's responsibility matrix assigns the processing of prompts and model interaction — how they are logged, retained and whether used for training — to Replit, compliant with the Terms of Service and the DPA.
points.text_zh: Replit 的责任矩阵把提示词与模型交互的处理（如何记录、保留、是否用于训练）划归 Replit 负责，依据是服务条款与 DPA。
points.quote: Processing of prompts and model interaction | How prompts and generated code are logged, retained, and whether used for training.

points.text: The DPA also caps the purposes: Replit will not sell Customer Personal Data, nor use or disclose it for any purpose other than the specific purposes set forth in the Agreement and the DPA.
points.text_zh: DPA 还限定了处理目的：Replit 不会出售客户个人数据，也不会把客户个人数据用于或披露于协议与 DPA 列明目的之外的用途。
points.quote: Company will not sell Customer Personal Data, nor use or disclose Customer Personal Data for any purpose other than for the specific purposes set forth in the Agreement and this DPA.

training.quote: We use content you provide, including your prompts, instructions, context, and responses generated for you, to help develop and improve our models and AI features. This allows us to make our services more powerful.If you opt out of model improvement, new content associated with your account will not be used to develop or improve our models. Opting out of model improvement does not delete your content, remove it from your projects, or affect your ability to use the services.You can change this setting at any time.This control is available to Pro users.

points.text: Replit uses the content you provide — prompts, instructions, context and the responses generated for you — to help develop and improve its models and AI features, and the off switch is tier-gated: the docs state plainly that this control is available to Pro users.
points.text_zh: Replit 会用你提供的内容（提示词、指令、上下文与为你生成的回复）来开发和改进其模型与 AI 功能，而关闭开关按档位设限：文档直说该控制只对 Pro 用户开放。

points.text: The privacy policy grounds the same processing in legitimate interest rather than consent: product development and internal analytics, specifically to improve the accuracy of machine learning technologies such as code generation.
points.text_zh: 隐私政策把同一处理建立在正当利益而非同意之上：产品开发与内部分析，具体是为了提高代码生成等机器学习技术的准确性。
points.quote: we have a legitimate interest in using Personal Data for product development and internal analytics purposes, to improve the accuracy of our machine learning technologies such as code generation, and otherwise to improve the safety, security, and performance of our Services.

points.text: Replit separately reserves the right to access the content of private apps for troubleshooting, improving the service, and ensuring safety and security — a content-access right that is not part of the training clause.
points.text_zh: Replit 另外保留了为排障、改进服务与保障安全而访问私有 app 内容的权利——这是一项内容访问权，与训练条款不是同一件事。
points.quote: Replit reserves the right to access the content of your private apps for the purpose of troubleshooting, improving our service, and ensuring the safety and security of the Service.

points.text: No zero-data-retention commitment covers this tier. ZDR appears in Replit's documentation only as an Enterprise control over which model endpoints requests may be routed to; the free tier's terms, the privacy policy and the ToS say nothing about zero retention.
points.text_zh: 本档没有任何零数据保留承诺。ZDR 在 Replit 文档里只以「企业档限定可用端点」的形式出现；免费档的条款、隐私政策与 ToS 都没有提到零保留。

points.text: The OpenRouter privacy defaults Replit configures for self-serve users do not describe this tier: on the Starter plan Replit AI Integrations is disabled, and the documented path is the user's own API key, so free-tier prompts are not sent through the endpoints Replit configures.
points.text_zh: Replit 为自助用户配置的 OpenRouter 隐私默认值并不描述本档：Starter 档上 Replit AI Integrations 不可用，文档给出的路径是用户自带 API key，免费档的提示词因此不会经由 Replit 配置的端点发出。
points.quote: On the Starter plan, Replit AI Integrations is disabled. You can still build AI apps with your own API key.

points.text: The availability premise is tier-gated: Replit AI Integrations requires a paid plan (Core, Pro, or Enterprise), and the docs point Starter users to their own API key instead.
points.text_zh: 适用前提按档位设限：Replit AI Integrations 需要付费档（Core、Pro 或 Enterprise），文档把 Starter 用户引向自带 API key。
points.quote: Replit AI Integrations requires a paid plan (Core, Pro, or Enterprise). You can still build AI apps with your own API key on the Starter plan.

points.text: Whether a free-tier user can obtain ZDR by contract is not addressed in any public document — this is an undisclosed option, not a stated refusal.
points.text_zh: 免费档用户能否通过合同拿到 ZDR，公开文档没有涉及——这是未披露的选项，不是明确的拒绝。

retention.quote: We take measures to delete your data or maintain it in a de-identified form when it is no longer necessary to be kept in identifiable form, unless we are required by law to keep this information for a longer period.

points.text: The privacy policy commits only to deleting or de-identifying data when it is no longer needed in identifiable form, unless a longer period is required by law — no period for prompt and response content is published.
points.text_zh: 隐私政策只承诺在不再需要以可识别形式保存时删除或去标识化，法律要求更长期限的除外——提示词与响应正文没有公布任何期限。

points.text: Free accounts carry a concrete inactivity trigger: an account not used within a 1-year period may be terminated and its associated user data deleted, including the Replit Apps tied to it. Paid subscriptions are exempt from that trigger.
points.text_zh: 免费账号有一条明确的闲置触发条件：1 年内未使用的账号可被终止并删除关联用户数据，包括其下的 Replit Apps。付费订阅不受该触发条件约束。
points.quote: An inactive Replit account is one that has not been used within a **1-year** period, meaning the user has not logged in to the account during that period. Replit reserves the right to terminate inactive Replit accounts and delete associated user data. Replit will delete Replit Apps associated with inactive free accounts.

points.text: Account deletion is documented as removing all content from Replit and purging personal information from its systems, with no recovery afterwards.
points.text_zh: 账号删除被写明为移除 Replit 上的全部内容并从系统中清除个人信息，之后不可恢复。
points.quote: Deleting your account removes all of your content from Replit (including Replit Apps, templates, posts), and results in your personal information being purged from our systems.

points.text: Public-facing content is a different object with default exposure: profile, code and posts may be viewable and searchable by other users and indexed by search engines by default.
points.text_zh: 对外公开的内容是另一个对象且默认暴露：个人资料、代码与帖子默认可被其他用户查看与搜索，并被搜索引擎索引。
points.quote: Your profile, including your name, username, profile picture, code, and other profile information may be viewable and searchable by other users and search indexed by online search engines. The content you post to the Services, including your code and forum posts, may be displayed on the platform and visible to other users by default.

points.text: The contract layer for this tier fixes no period either: on account deletion Replit deletes stored data in accordance with its data retention policy and applicable law, which leaves the length to that policy rather than to a stated number.
points.text_zh: 本档的合同层同样没有给出期限：账号删除时 Replit 按其数据保留政策与适用法律删除已存储的数据，长度交给该政策而非固定数字。
points.quote: Upon account deletion, we will delete your stored data in accordance with our data retention policy and applicable law.

processing_region.quote: Our Services are primarily hosted in the United States and may also be hosted in locations outside of the jurisdiction in which you live.

points.text: Services are primarily hosted in the United States and may also be hosted outside your jurisdiction; using the Services from elsewhere means accepting transfer of your data to the US and other hosting jurisdictions for storage, access and processing.
points.text_zh: 服务主要托管在美国，也可能托管在你所在司法辖区之外；从其他地区使用服务即表示接受数据被转移到美国及其他托管地存储、访问与处理。

points.text: This tier has no geography selection at all: publishing geography selection is available to Core, Pro and Enterprise customers, and free customers publish to North America by default.
points.text_zh: 本档完全没有地域选择权：发布地域选择面向 Core、Pro 与 Enterprise 客户，免费客户默认发布到北美。
points.quote: Workspace geography selection is available only to Pro customers. Publishing geography selection is available to Core, Pro, and Enterprise customers. Free customers publish to North America by default.

points.text: The permanence rule then applies to whatever geography the project was published to: geography cannot be changed after publishing, and a published project cannot be migrated to another geography.
points.text_zh: 此后不可更改的规则作用于项目发布时所在的地域：发布后地域不能变更，已发布项目也无法迁移到其他地域。
points.quote: Geography cannot be changed after publishing.** Once you publish your project to a geography, that selection is permanent. You cannot migrate a published project to a different geography.

points.text: This tier has no controller/processor designation. The DPA is incorporated into the Replit Commercial Agreement, and the ToS states that the Commercial Agreement applies only if you use the Pro or Enterprise Service — so the free tier runs on the ToS and the privacy policy, neither of which assigns a role.
points.text_zh: 本档没有控制者/受托处理方的定性。DPA 并入的是 Replit Commercial Agreement，而 ToS 写明只有使用 Pro 或 Enterprise 服务才适用该商业协议——因此免费档只受 ToS 与隐私政策管辖，两者都未约定角色。
points.quote: forms part of and is incorporated into the Replit Commercial Agreement (the "**Agreement**") between Replit, Inc. ("**Company**") and the entity identified as Customer in the Agreement ("**Customer**") and reflects the Parties' agreement with respect to the Processing of Personal Data by Company on behalf of Customer.

points.text: The DPA's own definition of its scope points the same way: it is incorporated into the Commercial Agreement and covers processing by Replit on behalf of the Customer identified in that agreement.
points.text_zh: DPA 自己界定的适用范围也指向同一结论：它并入商业协议，覆盖 Replit 代该协议中确定的客户进行的处理。
points.quote: To the extent Customer acts as a Controller, Customer appoints Company as a Processor with respect to the Personal Data provided by Customer to Company to perform the Services on Customer's behalf.

training.quote: Replit may also use Customer Content to develop, train, and improve its models and AI Features. Customers can opt out of the use of Customer Content to develop, train, and improve models and AI Features through the settings page.

points.text: The Pro Agreement licenses the content for training and provides the exit in the same breath: Replit may also use Customer Content to develop, train, and improve its models and AI Features, and customers can opt out through the settings page.
points.text_zh: Pro 协议在同一处既给出训练许可也给出退出通道：Replit 可将客户内容用于开发、训练与改进其模型与 AI 功能，客户可通过设置页退出。

points.text: The documented path is Settings → Personalization → opt out of Model Improvement, and it applies to new content associated with the account.
points.text_zh: 文档给出的路径是 Settings → Personalization → 关闭 Model Improvement，作用于该账号此后产生的新内容。
points.quote: We use content you provide, including your prompts, instructions, context, and responses generated for you, to help develop and improve our models and AI features. This allows us to make our services more powerful.If you opt out of model improvement, new content associated with your account will not be used to develop or improve our models. Opting out of model improvement does not delete your content, remove it from your projects, or affect your ability to use the services.You can change this setting at any time.This control is available to Pro users.

points.text: Upstream endpoint behaviour is set by Replit's OpenRouter configuration, not by the user: paid endpoints have training disabled, free endpoints may train on prompts and completions and may publish them to public datasets.
points.text_zh: 上游端点行为由 Replit 的 OpenRouter 配置决定，而非用户：付费端点关闭训练，免费端点可用提示词与补全做训练，并可能发布到公开数据集。
points.quote:
For individual and team users, Replit configures OpenRouter requests with the following privacy defaults:

*   **Paid endpoints training disabled**: Your data will not be used for training by paid model providers
*   **Free endpoints training enabled**: Free model providers may train on your prompts and completions
*   **Free endpoints publishing enabled**: Free providers may publish your prompts and completions to public datasets

points.text: The Pro Agreement contains no zero-data-retention commitment, and the DPA does not mention ZDR either. In Replit's documentation ZDR exists only as an Enterprise routing rule.
points.text_zh: Pro 协议没有零数据保留承诺，DPA 也没有提到 ZDR。在 Replit 文档里 ZDR 只作为企业档的路由规则存在。
points.quote:
For Enterprise organizations, Replit enforces stricter privacy controls:

*   **Zero Data Retention (ZDR) endpoints only**: Only models with a Zero Data Retention policy are available

points.text: That Enterprise rule is explicit about being tier-specific: only models with a Zero Data Retention policy are available, so Enterprise requests are only routed to endpoints that do not retain any data — with the stated trade-off that fewer models are available.
points.text_zh: 那条企业规则明确是按档位限定的：只提供带零数据保留政策的模型，因此企业请求只路由到不保留任何数据的端点——代价是可用模型更少。
points.quote: This ensures that Enterprise requests are only routed to endpoints that do not retain any data

retention.quote: We take measures to delete your data or maintain it in a de-identified form when it is no longer necessary to be kept in identifiable form, unless we are required by law to keep this information for a longer period.

points.text: The privacy policy's commitment is only the as-needed deletion or de-identification rule; no period for prompt and response content is published.
points.text_zh: 隐私政策的承诺只有「不再需要即删除或去标识化」这一条；提示词与响应正文没有公布期限。

points.text: Pro is covered by the DPA: the customer may request return or deletion of Customer Personal Data up to ninety days after termination of the agreement, and Replit may retain it where the law requires.
points.text_zh: Pro 档受 DPA 覆盖：客户可在协议终止后 90 天内请求返还或删除客户个人数据，法律要求保留的除外。
points.quote: Customer may request return or deletion of Customer Personal Data up to ninety (90) days after termination of the Agreement. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Company may retain Customer Personal Data where required by applicable law.

points.text: Opting out of model improvement stops future training use but does not delete anything: opting out does not delete your content, remove it from your projects, or affect your ability to use the services.
points.text_zh: 退出模型改进只停止今后的训练用途，并不删除任何东西：退出不会删除你的内容、不会把它从项目中移除，也不影响你使用服务。
points.quote: Opting out of model improvement does not delete your content, remove it from your projects, or affect your ability to use the services.

points.text: Paid subscriptions are exempt from the free-tier inactivity deletion trigger.
points.text_zh: 付费订阅不受免费档闲置删除触发条件的约束。
points.quote: Replit accounts under a paid subscription plan are not subject to termination due to account inactivity.

points.text: Retention length also has a customer-side configuration component: the responsibility matrix assigns "data retention, deletion, and export" to Replit as the mechanism and to the customer as the configuration — a division of responsibility rather than a period, and one that sits alongside the DPA window this tier has.
points.text_zh: 保留长度也有客户侧的配置成分：责任矩阵把「数据保留、删除与导出」记为 Replit 提供机制、客户做配置——这是责任划分而非期限，且与本档另有的 DPA 窗口并存。
points.quote:
Data retention, deletion, and export | How long data is kept and how it is deleted or exported. | Replit (mechanism)
You (configuration) |

processing_region.quote: Pro customers can choose a Workspace location during creation.

points.text: Pro customers can choose a Workspace location when the workspace is created; the responsibility matrix assigns data residency to Replit as the mechanism with the customer configuring it.
points.text_zh: Pro 客户可在创建工作区时选择 Workspace 位置；责任矩阵把数据驻留归为 Replit 提供机制、客户做配置。

points.text: Publishing geography is chosen at publish time and cannot be changed afterwards, and the two settings need not match.
points.text_zh: 发布地域在发布时选定且之后不可更改，两个设置也不必一致。
points.quote: Geography cannot be changed after publishing.** Once you publish your project to a geography, that selection is permanent. You cannot migrate a published project to a different geography.

points.text: Outside the residency controls, services are primarily hosted in the United States and may be hosted elsewhere.
points.text_zh: 在驻留控制之外，服务主要托管在美国，也可能托管在其他地方。
points.quote: Our Services are primarily hosted in the United States and may also be hosted in locations outside of the jurisdiction in which you live.

role.quote: To the extent Customer acts as a Controller, Customer appoints Company as a Processor with respect to the Personal Data provided by Customer to Company to perform the Services on Customer's behalf.

points.text: Where the customer acts as a controller, Replit is appointed as a processor for the personal data provided to perform the services on the customer's behalf. Module 3 (processor-to-processor) applies where the customer is itself a processor.
points.text_zh: 在客户作为控制者的情况下，Replit 被指定为受托处理方，处理客户为履行服务而提供的数据；客户本身是处理方时适用 Module 3（处理方对处理方）。

points.text: The DPA reaches this tier through the Commercial Agreement, which the ToS says applies to Pro and Enterprise Services.
points.text_zh: DPA 经由商业协议覆盖本档，而 ToS 写明商业协议适用于 Pro 与 Enterprise 服务。
points.quote: forms part of and is incorporated into the Replit Commercial Agreement (the "**Agreement**") between Replit, Inc. ("**Company**") and the entity identified as Customer in the Agreement ("**Customer**") and reflects the Parties' agreement with respect to the Processing of Personal Data by Company on behalf of Customer.

points.text: The DPA also caps the purposes: Replit will not sell Customer Personal Data, nor use or disclose it for any purpose other than the specific purposes set forth in the Agreement and the DPA.
points.text_zh: DPA 还限定了处理目的：Replit 不会出售客户个人数据，也不会把客户个人数据用于或披露于协议与 DPA 列明目的之外的用途。
points.quote: Company will not sell Customer Personal Data, nor use or disclose Customer Personal Data for any purpose other than for the specific purposes set forth in the Agreement and this DPA.

points.text: Roo Code 这个牌子现在指开源扩展，云端产品叫 Roomote。Roomote 没有公布任何数据处理政策：roocode.com/legal 是个前端路由，渲染出来还是首页；docs 整站 sitemap 里没有 cloud、privacy、terms 任何一页；仓库里的 PRIVACY.md 只描述扩展自身的行为（API key 只存本机、PostHog 遥测不含代码和 prompt），全文未提及托管服务——那是沉默，不是排除。五列因此全部是「厂商未公开」，不是我们没查。
points.text_zh: Roo Code 这个牌子现在指开源扩展，云端产品叫 Roomote。Roomote 没有公布任何数据处理政策：roocode.com/legal 是个前端路由，渲染出来还是首页；docs 整站 sitemap 里没有 cloud、privacy、terms 任何一页；仓库里的 PRIVACY.md 只描述扩展自身的行为（API key 只存本机、PostHog 遥测不含代码和 prompt），全文未提及托管服务——那是沉默，不是排除。五列因此全部是「厂商未公开」，不是我们没查。

points.text: Scope note rather than an anchor for this tier: PRIVACY.md carries one vendor-level training statement, "We do not train any models on your data." (line 14, under How We Use Your Data). That file is the extension's own privacy policy and describes the extension's data flows; the hosted Roomote service this tier covers is not mentioned anywhere in it. The sentence therefore constrains the extension tier only. The two tiers are separate, so it is recorded as a known vendor statement plus its scope, not bound as evidence for this tier, and the mark stays unknown.
points.text_zh: 适用范围说明，不作本档锚点：PRIVACY.md 里唯一的厂商级训练表态是第 14 行（How We Use Your Data 一节）的「We do not train any models on your data.」。该文件是扩展自身的隐私政策，讲的全是扩展的数据流，本档覆盖的托管 Roomote 服务全文未提及，故这句话只约束扩展档。两个档位不同，这里只把它登记为「已知的厂商表态 + 适用范围」，不绑成本档的证据，mark 维持 unknown。

points.text: Separate data stream collected by the vendor: telemetry. "We use telemetry to understand feature usage and improve Roo Code." (line 12); the same section says the telemetry is powered by PostHog and covers the VS Code machine ID, feature usage patterns and exception reports, explicitly excludes personally identifiable information, your code and AI prompts, and can be turned off in settings. Under the project rule that service-improvement purposes count as training this would matter if the object were API inputs, but the object here is telemetry rather than prompts or code, so it neither supports nor contradicts a training statement about this tier and does not change the mark.
points.text_zh: 厂商自收的另一条数据流：遥测。第 12 行「We use telemetry to understand feature usage and improve Roo Code.」；同节写明遥测由 PostHog 承载，含 VS Code machine ID、功能使用模式与异常报告，明确不含个人可识别信息、你的代码与 AI prompt，且可在设置里关闭。按「用来改进服务/提高质量算训练」的口径，若对象是 API 输入就必须单独交代；但这里的对象是遥测数据而不是提示词或代码，故它既不支持也不否定本档的训练表态，不改变 mark。

points.text: 官方也没有公布 Cloud 的档次划分，所以按「不分档」收录。只有许可证里提到超过 10 个用户要 license key，那是自托管版的限制，不是云端的档位。
points.text_zh: 官方也没有公布 Cloud 的档次划分，所以按「不分档」收录。只有许可证里提到超过 10 个用户要 license key，那是自托管版的限制，不是云端的档位。

points.text: Extension-side no-store statement, not a zero-retention commitment for this tier: "We do not have access to or store this data, but AI providers may process it per their privacy policies." (PRIVACY.md line 7, under Commands). The object is the code and context of commands that the extension forwards to the AI model provider the customer selected (BYOK), and the same sentence hands that data to the upstream provider's own policy, which makes the upstream a separate hop that this statement cannot cover. It says nothing about Roomote's hosted infrastructure, so it is not a zero-retention option for this tier and the mark stays unknown. Note that the premise "this tier routes inference through the customer's own key" currently rests on our own product label, not on official text; the chain for the hosted tier has to be judged once a hosted-tier source is fetched.
points.text_zh: 扩展侧的不留存表述，不是本档的零保留承诺：PRIVACY.md 第 7 行（Commands 一节）「We do not have access to or store this data, but AI providers may process it per their privacy policies.」。对象是扩展把命令相关的代码与上下文发给客户自选的模型提供方（BYOK）；同一句把该数据交给上游厂商自己的政策处理，说明上游是另一跳，这句盖不住它。全句没有提到 Roomote 托管基础设施，因此不构成本档的零保留方案，mark 维持 unknown。另需注明：本档「推理走客户自己的 key」这一前提目前只有我们自己写的产品 label 为依据，不是官方文本；托管档的链路要等托管档来源抓回快照后再判。
points.quote: We do not have access to or store this data, but AI providers may process it per their privacy policies.

retention.summary: 按对象分列未公布期限

points.text: Extension-side statement about command code and context: "We do not have access to or store this data, but AI providers may process it per their privacy policies." (PRIVACY.md line 7). Object = the code and context of commands sent to the customer-selected model provider; context = the BYOK flow, where the data goes straight to that provider and whatever it keeps is governed by its own policy (the second hop of the chain). This describes the extension's own handling rather than Roomote's hosted infrastructure, so it is neither a retention period nor a zero-retention basis for this tier. The premise that this tier routes inference through the customer's own key comes from our own product label, not from official text.
points.text_zh: 扩展侧关于命令代码与上下文的表述：PRIVACY.md 第 7 行「We do not have access to or store this data, but AI providers may process it per their privacy policies.」。对象=发往客户自选模型提供方的命令代码与上下文；语境=BYOK，数据直接到该提供方，上游保留什么由其自身政策决定（链路第二跳）。它讲的是扩展自身的行为，不涉及 Roomote 托管基础设施，故既不构成本档的保留期限，也不构成零保留依据。本档「推理走客户自己的 key」这一前提来自我们自己写的 label，不是官方文本。
points.quote: We do not have access to or store this data, but AI providers may process it per their privacy policies.

points.text: Prompts and project context: "We do not store or process this data." (PRIVACY.md line 8, under Prompts & AI Requests). Object = prompts and the related project context sent to the customer-selected provider; the next sentence adds that those providers have their own privacy policies and may store data per their terms of service, i.e. the upstream is a separate hop. Same caveat as above: this describes the extension plus BYOK flow, so the object and context differ from the hosted tier, and this tier's object/basis stay as recorded until a hosted-tier source is fetched.
points.text_zh: 提示词与项目上下文：PRIVACY.md 第 8 行（Prompts & AI Requests 一节）「We do not store or process this data.」。对象=发往客户自选提供方的提示词与相关项目上下文；紧接的一句说明这些厂商有自己的隐私政策、可能按各自服务条款存储数据，即上游是另一跳。与上一条同样的限定：这句描述的是扩展 + BYOK 流程，对象与语境都与托管档不同，本档的 object/basis 在托管档来源抓回快照前保持不变。
points.quote: We do not store or process this data.

points.text: Extension indexing feature (customer-selected Qdrant): "**Clear Index Data**: Deletes all data from the Qdrant collection and clears the local file cache." The same page states that vectors are stored in the Qdrant instance the customer chooses, that the customer controls where data lives, and that the action cannot be undone — a manual delete rather than an automatic expiry, and the vendor discloses no automatic expiry. This constrains the extension's indexing feature and the customer-side Qdrant only, so it is not evidence of a retention period for the hosted tier. The source stays core as the extension-side reference for this product line's retention and deletion objects.
points.text_zh: 扩展的索引功能（客户自选 Qdrant）：「**Clear Index Data**: Deletes all data from the Qdrant collection and clears the local file cache.」。同页写明向量存放在客户自己选的 Qdrant 实例、数据放在哪里由客户控制，且该操作不可撤销——是手动删除而非自动到期，官方未披露自动到期。它只约束扩展的索引功能与客户侧的 Qdrant，不构成托管档保留期限的证据。该来源仍保留为 core：它是本产品线扩展侧保留与删除对象的官方文本，也是托管档的对照来源。
points.quote: **Clear Index Data**: Deletes all data from the Qdrant collection and clears the local file cache.

training.quote: is not used to train, retrain, or improve the base Models

points.text: See top-level training. Contract §4.4 covers this tier
points.text_zh: 见顶层 training。合同 §4.4 覆盖本档

points.text: The docs site data-privacy §3 and the product page state alike that Scaleway does not collect, read, reuse, or analyze the content of your inputs, prompts, or outputs generated by the API. The Free Tier discloses no different data-use terms.
points.text_zh: 文档站 data-privacy §3 与产品页同样声明不收集/读取/复用/分析输入内容。Free Tier 未披露任何不同的数据使用条款。

zdr.quote: Scaleway does not retain any requests or generated Content after processing.

points.text: See top-level zdr: "By default we apply a Zero Data Retention Policy", with no application required
points.text_zh: 见顶层 zdr：默认适用，无需申请

points.text: The exceptions are temporary retention for abuse investigation (up to 2 weeks) and storage for the duration of Batch processing (up to 24 hours).
points.text_zh: 例外为滥用临时留存（≤2 周）与 Batch 处理期间存储（≤24 小时）。

points.text: Third exception, the token cache: the data-privacy page states that caching "does not store prompt content itself (only intermediate values such as prefix hashes or KV values) and uses only ephemeral storage" and that "Caching is automatic, isolated per project, and cannot be disabled". The customer therefore cannot switch caching off, and its retention period is not disclosed.
points.text_zh: 第三类例外是 token 缓存：data-privacy 页称缓存「does not store prompt content itself (only intermediate values such as prefix hashes or KV values) and uses only ephemeral storage」，并明确「Caching is automatic, isolated per project, and cannot be disabled」。客户无法关闭缓存，其保留期亦未披露。
points.quote: Caching does not store prompt content itself (only intermediate values such as prefix hashes or KV values) and uses only ephemeral storage, solely to speed up inference processing. Caching is automatic, isolated per project, and cannot be disabled.

points.text: The two official statements about that cache diverge and are kept side by side rather than averaged: the data-privacy page says it uses "only ephemeral storage", while the FAQ says that for Serverless models "the platform persists the cache automatically and evicts it based on request frequency". Which of the two describes the cache, and how it bears on zero retention, is clarified by neither page.
points.text_zh: 关于该缓存的两条官方表述不一致，并列保留、不取平均：data-privacy 页称其「only ephemeral storage」，FAQ 则称 Serverless 档「the platform persists the cache automatically and evicts it based on request frequency」。两者哪个描述该缓存、它对零保留意味着什么，两页都没有澄清。
points.quote: the platform persists the cache automatically and evicts it based on request frequency

points.text: Conditional exception with a different object: GTC §10 provides that in the event of a Technical Incident, "Technical Support may be required to access the Client's resources in compliance with the confidentiality and security obligations incumbent upon it", for diagnosis and analysis purposes. That is event-driven support access to infrastructure resources, not a systematic read of inputs or outputs, so it does not qualify the no-retention commitment of AI Services §4.4 nor the data-privacy page's "We do not collect, read, reuse, or analyze the content of your inputs, prompts, or outputs generated by the API".
points.text_zh: 对象不同的条件性例外：GTC §10 规定发生技术事件时，为诊断与分析，「Technical Support may be required to access the Client's resources in compliance with the confidentiality and security obligations incumbent upon it」。这是事件驱动的技术支持对基础设施资源的访问，不是对输入输出的系统性读取，因此既不构成对 AI Services §4.4 不保留承诺的反证，也不构成对 data-privacy 页「We do not collect, read, reuse, or analyze the content of your inputs, prompts, or outputs generated by the API」的反证。
points.quote: Technical Support may be required to access the Client's resources in compliance with the confidentiality and security obligations incumbent upon it

retention.quote: Scaleway does not retain any requests or generated Content after processing.

points.text: See top-level retention: for standard synchronous processing, "Scaleway does not retain any requests or generated Content after processing"
points.text_zh: 见顶层 retention：标准同步处理不落数据

points.text: Under the abuse exception Scaleway may temporarily store and access the full content of HTTP requests (the docs site gives a cap of two weeks)
points.text_zh: 滥用例外可临时留存完整 HTTP 请求内容（文档站给上限两周）

points.text: Batch inputs are stored only for the duration of processing, i.e. twenty-four (24) hours
points.text_zh: Batch 输入仅存处理期间（≤24 小时）

points.text: Aggregated and anonymized API usage data: data-privacy §4, "Aggregated and anonymized data is stored for up to 6 months for performance monitoring and improvement"
points.text_zh: 聚合匿名化的 API 用量数据见 data-privacy §4「Aggregated and anonymized data is stored for up to 6 months for performance monitoring and improvement」
points.quote: Aggregated and anonymized data is stored for up to 6 months for performance monitoring and improvement.

points.text: Cockpit observability data (Scaleway metrics, logs, traces — not inference inputs/outputs): the contract layer is GTC Appendix 3 (Specific Conditions Applicable to Cockpit Services) §4.4 — "The retention period for this data is configurable. By default, Metrics are retained for thirty-one (31) days, while Logs and Traces are retained for seven (7) days." Same default (31 days) as the Cockpit concepts page.
points.text_zh: Cockpit 观测数据（Scaleway metrics / logs / traces，不是推理输入输出正文）：合同层依据是 GTC 附录 3《Specific Conditions Applicable to Cockpit Services》§4.4——「The retention period for this data is configurable. By default, Metrics are retained for thirty-one (31) days, while Logs and Traces are retained for seven (7) days.」默认值与 Cockpit 概念页一致（31 天）。
points.quote: The retention period for this data is configurable. By default, Metrics are retained for thirty-one (31) days, while Logs and Traces are retained for seven (7) days.

points.text: Two conditions attached to that Cockpit retention: "Any extension beyond the default values is subject to a charge", and reducing the retention period "will result in the immediate and permanent deletion of all data older than the new retention period", which cannot be recovered by any means.
points.text_zh: 该 Cockpit 保留期附两个条件：「Any extension beyond the default values is subject to a charge」；缩短保留期「will result in the immediate and permanent deletion of all data older than the new retention period」，且不可恢复。
points.quote: reducing the retention period of a Cockpit Data Source will result in the immediate and permanent deletion of all data older than the new retention period. This data cannot be recovered by any means. Any extension beyond the default values is subject to a charge.

points.text: The 1825-day (5-year) cap on Scaleway metrics comes only from the developer-data Cockpit concepts page (minimum and default 31 days there too); the contract clause above gives the default only, so the cap rests on the lower-authority source.
points.text_zh: Scaleway metrics 的 1825 天（5 年）上限只来自 developer_data 层的 Cockpit 概念页（该页同样给最小/默认 31 天）；上面的合同条只给默认值，所以上限的依据权威性较低。
points.quote: Default retention | 31 days | 7 days | 31 days | 7 days |

points.text: Account data is handled under the general privacy policy
points.text_zh: 账户数据按通用隐私政策

points.text: After service termination, GTC §13.3 provides for deletion within ten days, with Scaleway undertaking not to retain any copy. The token cache retention period is not disclosed.
points.text_zh: 服务终止后 GTC §13.3 十天内删除且不留副本。token 缓存保留期未披露。

points.text: Exception to that post-termination deletion, at the same contract level: DPA §13.1 requires Scaleway, at the end of the Contract and for any reason whatsoever, to cease all Data Processing of Personal Data and to delete the Personal Data as well as any copies thereof, "unless the retention of the Personal Data is required by applicable legislation or by the legitimate interests of Scaleway". Object: Personal Data; context: end of contract. DPA §14.3 gives the DPA precedence over the other provisions of the Contract for issues affecting the Processing of Personal Data, so this exception qualifies the unqualified ten-day wording of GTC §13.3 — the ten-day deletion should not be read as unconditional.
points.text_zh: 该终止后删除的例外，同在合同层：DPA §13.1 要求 Scaleway 在合同因任何原因结束时停止全部个人数据处理，并删除个人数据及其副本，「unless the retention of the Personal Data is required by applicable legislation or by the legitimate interests of Scaleway」。对象是 Personal Data，语境是合同终止。DPA §14.3 规定个人数据处理事项上 DPA 优先于合同其他条款，因此该例外限定了 GTC §13.3 的无条件表述——十天删除不应被读成绝对承诺。
points.quote: deletes the Personal Data as well as any copies thereof, unless the retention of the Personal Data is required by applicable legislation or by the legitimate interests of Scaleway

points.text: The same limitation is stated a second time in the DPA's description of the processing: "the duration of data retention depends on the Customer's choice except in the event of a legitimate request in particular from a judicial or administrative authority". So the retention duration is customer-chosen by default, with legal or administrative requests as the stated carve-out.
points.text_zh: DPA 在处理描述里第二次给出同一限定：「the duration of data retention depends on the Customer's choice except in the event of a legitimate request in particular from a judicial or administrative authority」。即保留期默认由客户选择，司法或行政机关的正当要求是明文例外。
points.quote: the duration of data retention depends on the Customer's choice except in the event of a legitimate request

processing_region.quote: Scaleway Services are located within the European Union by default.

points.text: See top-level processing_region (1) and (2).
points.text_zh: 见顶层 processing_region ①②。

role.quote: Scaleway acts as Data Processor or Sub-processor, within the meaning of the GDPR

points.text: See top-level role: for service content, "Scaleway acts as Data Processor or Sub-processor, within the meaning of the GDPR"
points.text_zh: 见顶层 role：对服务内容 Scaleway 是 Data Processor / Sub-processor

points.text: The controller layer in GTC §17 covers only contracting and account data.
points.text_zh: GTC §17 的 controller 层只覆盖缔约与账户数据。

training.quote: is not used to train, retrain, or improve the base Models

points.text: Same Contract §4.4 (§1 already lists Managed Inference under AI Services). The FAQ adds that fine-tuning or retraining requires a separate training environment on GPU Instances, i.e. this tier itself does no training.
points.text_zh: 同合同 §4.4（§1 已把 Managed Inference 列入 AI Services）。FAQ 另说明若要 fine-tune/retrain 需另用 GPU Instances 训练环境，即本档本身不做训练。

zdr.quote: Scaleway does not retain any requests or generated Content after processing.

points.text: Same Contract §4.4
points.text_zh: 同合同 §4.4

points.text: Processing on this tier takes place on the customer's dedicated, isolated resources (§2.1.2, "The processing of Inputs and the generation of Outputs take place on private resources"), but there is no separately disclosed cache retention statement for this tier.
points.text_zh: 本档处理发生在客户专属隔离资源上（§2.1.2「The processing of Inputs and the generation of Outputs take place on private resources」），但没有单独披露的、针对本档的缓存保留期说明。

points.text: Cache condition, from the data-privacy page shared by both tiers: caching "does not store prompt content itself (only intermediate values such as prefix hashes or KV values) and uses only ephemeral storage", and "Caching is automatic, isolated per project, and cannot be disabled" (that page frames Dedicated Deployments as an additional isolation layer). Nothing in the documents offers a way to switch caching off on this tier either.
points.text_zh: 缓存条件（出自两档共用的 data-privacy 页）：缓存「does not store prompt content itself (only intermediate values such as prefix hashes or KV values) and uses only ephemeral storage」，且「Caching is automatic, isolated per project, and cannot be disabled」（该页把 Dedicated Deployments 作为额外的隔离层）。文件里同样没有关闭本档缓存的开关。
points.quote: Caching does not store prompt content itself (only intermediate values such as prefix hashes or KV values) and uses only ephemeral storage, solely to speed up inference processing. Caching is automatic, isolated per project, and cannot be disabled.

points.text: Tier-specific cache text, which is about capacity rather than duration: for Dedicated Deployments "the input cache is fully dedicated to your usage and included in the price", the available size being proportional to the vRAM of the GPU Instance type. No retention period is given. The two official statements about the cache — "only ephemeral storage" (data-privacy page) versus "the platform persists the cache automatically and evicts it based on request frequency" (FAQ, stated for Serverless) — are kept side by side rather than averaged.
points.text_zh: 本档专属的缓存表述讲的是容量而非期限：Dedicated Deployments「the input cache is fully dedicated to your usage and included in the price」，可用容量与所选 GPU 实例类型的 vRAM 成正比，未给保留期。关于缓存的两条官方表述——「only ephemeral storage」（data-privacy 页）与「the platform persists the cache automatically and evicts it based on request frequency」（FAQ，明写为 Serverless）——并列保留，不取平均。
points.quote: the input cache is fully dedicated to your usage and included in the price

points.text: Conditional exception with a different object: GTC §10 provides that in the event of a Technical Incident, "Technical Support may be required to access the Client's resources in compliance with the confidentiality and security obligations incumbent upon it", for diagnosis and analysis purposes. Event-driven support access to resources, not a systematic read of inputs or outputs; it does not qualify AI Services §4.4 nor the data-privacy page's statement that Scaleway does not collect, read, reuse, or analyze the content of your inputs, prompts, or outputs.
points.text_zh: 对象不同的条件性例外：GTC §10 规定发生技术事件时，为诊断与分析，「Technical Support may be required to access the Client's resources in compliance with the confidentiality and security obligations incumbent upon it」。这是事件驱动的技术支持对资源的访问，不是对输入输出的系统性读取，不构成对 AI Services §4.4 或 data-privacy 页「不收集/读取/复用/分析输入输出内容」的反证。
points.quote: Technical Support may be required to access the Client's resources in compliance with the confidentiality and security obligations incumbent upon it

retention.quote: Scaleway does not retain any requests or generated Content after processing.

points.text: The general clause of Contract §4.4 (no retention of requests or generated Content, no logging, exception for incidents) applies to this tier
points.text_zh: 合同 §4.4 的通用条（不保留请求与生成内容、不留日志、异常例外）适用于本档

points.text: §5.2「The deletion of a deployment is an irreversible action that erases all associated data and resources」

The last paragraph of §4.4 makes the Client solely responsible for the lifecycle of its own data (backup, retention, deletion, archiving). Note: the Batch 24-hour clause is qualified by "In the context of the Generative API Service" and does not apply to Dedicated Deployment.
points.text_zh: §4.4 末段明确客户对自身数据生命周期（备份、保留、删除、归档）负全责。注意：Batch 24 小时那条限定语是「In the context of the Generative API Service」，不适用于 Dedicated Deployment。

points.text: This tier has no post-termination deletion commitment of its own: deletion here is a client action (§5.2, "The deletion of a deployment is an irreversible action that erases all associated data and resources") and §4.4 puts the data lifecycle on the Client. The Contract's end-of-contract deletion rules are written for the Services as a whole, not for this tier — GTC §13.3 (deletion within ten days, no copy retained) and DPA §13.1, which is qualified by "unless the retention of the Personal Data is required by applicable legislation or by the legitimate interests of Scaleway", the DPA taking precedence on Personal Data Processing under DPA §14.3.
points.text_zh: 本档没有自己的终止后删除承诺：本档的删除是客户动作（§5.2「The deletion of a deployment is an irreversible action that erases all associated data and resources」），§4.4 把数据生命周期交给客户。合同的终止后删除规则是针对全部服务写的、不是针对本档——GTC §13.3（十天内删除、不留副本）与 DPA §13.1，后者带例外「unless the retention of the Personal Data is required by applicable legislation or by the legitimate interests of Scaleway」，且按 DPA §14.3，个人数据处理事项上 DPA 优先。
points.quote: deletes the Personal Data as well as any copies thereof, unless the retention of the Personal Data is required by applicable legislation or by the legitimate interests of Scaleway

processing_region.quote: select the geographical region where you want to create your deployment

points.text: See top-level processing_region (2). The region on this tier is a customer-selectable option, so it cannot be written on one line with Serverless's "Paris".
points.text_zh: 见顶层 processing_region ②。本档区域是客户可选项，因此不能与 Serverless 的「巴黎」写成一行。

role.quote: Scaleway acts as Data Processor or Sub-processor, within the meaning of the GDPR

points.text: Same as top-level role: the DPA covers "the Services covered by the Contract" and does not differentiate the role by tier.
points.text_zh: 同顶层 role：DPA 覆盖「the Services covered by the Contract」，未按档位区分角色。

training.quote: 您同意授予本公司及本公司关联方免费的、全球范围内的、永久的、可分许可的许可，允许本公司或本公司关联方使用你对本产品的人工智能模型提供的信息内容来优化模型和相关服务。

points.text: §II.7 of the Additional Service Terms grants the company and its affiliates a free, worldwide, perpetual, sub-licensable licence to use the information content provided to the AI models to "optimize the models and the related services"
points.text_zh: 《附加服务条款》§二7 授权本公司及关联方使用您提供给模型的信息内容「优化模型和相关服务」
points.quote: 您同意授予本公司及本公司关联方免费的、全球范围内的、永久的、可分许可的许可，允许本公司或本公司关联方使用你对本产品的人工智能模型提供的信息内容来优化模型和相关服务。

points.text: For the trial context, Nova Privacy Policy §II.5 separately covers anonymized conversations used for algorithm research and optimization. The word "training" appears nowhere in the texts, and there is no "not used for training" commitment.
points.text_zh: 试用语境另有 Nova 隐私政策 §二5（匿名化对话用于算法研究和优化）。全文无「训练」字样，也无「不用于训练」承诺。
points.quote: 在试用产品服务使用过程中，我们将收集您在日日新平台的对话内容，但是该对话内容会做匿名化处理，不会与您的账户或其他个人信息相关联，用于算法研究和优化，改善我们的产品或服务，

zdr.quote: 商汤科技仅在一定的缓冲期（以您所订购的服务适用的专有条款、产品文档、服务说明等所载明的时限为准）内继续存储您的用户数据（如有），缓冲期届满，商汤科技将删除所有用户数据，包括所有缓存或者备份的副本，不再保留您的任何用户数据。

points.text: No ZDR commitment, switch or application method, and no public DPA
points.text_zh: 无 ZDR 承诺/开关/申请方式，无公开 DPA

points.text: The on-device offline SDK is a deployment shape, not a zero-retention commitment.
points.text_zh: 端侧离线 SDK 是部署形态而非零保留承诺。

retention.summary: 按对象分列留至服务终止
retention.quote: 商汤科技仅在一定的缓冲期（以您所订购的服务适用的专有条款、产品文档、服务说明等所载明的时限为准）内继续存储您的用户数据（如有），缓冲期届满，商汤科技将删除所有用户数据，包括所有缓存或者备份的副本，不再保留您的任何用户数据。

points.text: Object: user data. After service expiry, early termination (including termination by agreement) or non-payment, SenseTime keeps storing your user data only during a buffer period; when the buffer period ends it deletes all user data, including all cached or backup copies. The length of the buffer period is the one stated in the service-specific terms, product documentation or service description for the service you purchased — no number of days is published.
points.text_zh: 对象：用户数据。服务期届满、提前终止（含双方协商一致）或欠费后，仅在缓冲期内继续存储用户数据；缓冲期届满即删除全部用户数据，包括所有缓存或备份副本。缓冲期时长以所订购服务适用的专有条款、产品文档、服务说明所载明的时限为准，目前未公开天数。
points.quote: 商汤科技仅在一定的缓冲期（以您所订购的服务适用的专有条款、产品文档、服务说明等所载明的时限为准）内继续存储您的用户数据（如有），缓冲期届满，商汤科技将删除所有用户数据，包括所有缓存或者备份的副本，不再保留您的任何用户数据。

points.text: Object: personal information. Stored only for the minimum period required by laws and regulations — a different period type from the until-termination basis recorded on this row, so the minimum period must not be read as until termination.
points.text_zh: 对象：个人信息。仅在法律法规要求的最低时限内存储——与结论行记的「留至服务终止」不是同一种期限类型，不能把最低时限读成留至服务终止。
points.quote: 我们仅在法律法规要求的最低时限内存储您的个人信息。

points.text: Object: account data. After account cancellation SenseTime may no longer collect, store or use your personal information and data, except where laws and regulations require otherwise (invoices kept for tax compliance, transaction and billing records kept under the E-Commerce Law, account information kept for verification).
points.text_zh: 对象：账号数据。注销后无权继续收集、存储和使用您的个人信息和数据，但法律法规另有要求的情形除外（税务合规保留发票信息、电子商务法保留交易/账单信息、校验保留账号信息等）。
points.quote: 我方将无权继续收集、存储和使用您的个人信息和数据，但**法律法规另有要求的情形除外，例如：为了税务合规而保留相应的发票信息，为了遵守电子商务法保留相应交易、账单信息，为了满足第3.3条的校验而保留相应账号信息等；**

points.text: Object: usage records. Service-usage behaviour and unsafe-feature data are detected, browsed and logged as "user support data"; the same clause says user support data does not include user business data or user account information. No retention period is given for this category.
points.text_zh: 对象：使用行为记录。服务使用行为、数据不安全特征等作为「用户支持数据」被检测、浏览、记录；同条注明用户支持数据不含用户业务数据与账号信息。该类记录未给保留期限。
points.quote: 商汤科技将检测、浏览、记录您的服务使用行为、您数据的不安全特征等用户支持数据。

points.text: Object: personal information, trigger: the user's deletion request. The Nova official-website policy answers within 15 working days and says that after the data is deleted from the servers it may not be removed from backup systems immediately but is deleted when the backup is refreshed — from the platform.sensenova.cn context, not the SenseCore API terms.
points.text_zh: 对象：个人信息，触发：用户删除请求。Nova 官网政策称 15 个工作日内答复，并称从服务器删除后可能不会立即从备份系统删除相应数据、而是在备份更新时删除——出自 platform.sensenova.cn 语境，不是大装置 API 条款。
points.quote: 当我们从服务器中删除您的个人信息后，我们可能不会立即从备份系统中删除相应的数据，但会在备份更新的时候删除这些信息。

points.text: No request-level retention period, and no network-log floor wording.
points.text_zh: 无请求级保留期、无网络日志下限表述。

processing_region.quote: 我们在中华人民共和国境内收集和产生的个人信息将存储在中华人民共和国境内。

points.text: Personal information is stored within China
points.text_zh: 个人信息境内存储
points.quote: 我们在中华人民共和国境内收集和产生的个人信息将存储在中华人民共和国境内。

points.text: The region list contains only one region, Shanghai, China
points.text_zh: 地区清单只有中国上海一区

points.text: The service territory is limited to mainland China and Hong Kong
points.text_zh: 服务地域限中国大陆及香港

points.text: But the object of these clauses is personal information; nothing is stated about where API request bodies are processed.
points.text_zh: 但条款宾语是个人信息，未对 API 请求体处理地作陈述。

points.text: Cross-border transfer is possible where genuinely necessary, but only in compliance with the mandatory rules of China and other relevant jurisdictions — including China's outbound personal-information security assessment, security certification and/or signed data transfer agreements. That clause covers personal information SenseTime collects directly or indirectly through a customer while the customer serves its end users, which is the typical data path of this API tier.
points.text_zh: 如确有必要可跨境移转，但须在符合中国及其他相关司法辖区强制性规则的前提下——包括中国境内个人信息出境安全评估、经过安全认证和/或签署数据传输协议。该条覆盖「客户在向终端用户提供服务过程中商汤科技直接或间接通过客户收集的个人信息」，正是本 API 档的典型数据来源。
points.quote: 如确有必要在全球范围内转移用户的个人信息时，我们将在符合中国及其他相关司法辖区的强制性规则要求（包括但不限于中国境内的个人信息出境安全评估要求、经过安全认证和/或签署数据传输协议）前提下移转用户的个人信息。

role.quote: 我们接受客户的委托处理用户的个人信息

points.text: Scope of this verdict: for user personal information processed as entrusted by a customer, SenseTime is the entrusted party — "we accept customers' entrustment to process users' personal information" (Personal Information Protection Policy §III.2)
points.text_zh: 本结论的适用范围：按客户委托处理用户个人信息时商汤是受托方——「我们接受客户的委托处理用户的个人信息」（《SenseCore 商汤大装置个人信息保护政策》三、2）
points.quote: 我们接受客户的委托处理用户的个人信息

points.text: In the other direction: it designates itself controller where it collects and uses users' personal information directly (the contact section of the SenseCore Personal Information Protection Policy) — the two statements have different objects, not a contradiction.
points.text_zh: 反方向：直接收集和使用用户个人信息时自认控制者（《SenseCore 商汤大装置个人信息保护政策》「如何联系我们」一节）——两句适用对象不同，不构成矛盾。
points.quote: 在直接收集和使用用户的个人信息时是用户个人信息的控制者

points.text: The help-centre Privacy Protection Policy likewise names Shanghai SenseTime as the operating entity of the official website and the controller of your personal information.
points.text_zh: 帮助中心版《商汤大装置隐私保护政策》同样自认官方网站运营主体并是您个人信息的控制者。
points.quote: 上海商汤科技开发有限公司为官方网站的运营主体，亦是您个人信息的控制者，注册地址为【中国(上海)自由贸易试验区临港新片区环湖西二路888号C楼】。

points.text: The contract does not accept joint-handler status and requires that input contain no personal information. The entity is Shanghai SenseTime Technology Development Co., Ltd.
points.text_zh: 合同不认共同处理者，且要求输入不含个人信息。主体是上海商汤科技开发有限公司。

points.text: Layering possible: specific services may be provided by affiliates or other legal entities under separately agreed terms (§VI.3), and the agreement's rights and obligations may be transferred in whole or in part to affiliates (§VI.2), so the contracting and processing entity can change with the service purchased.
points.text_zh: 可能分层委托：具体服务可能由关联公司或其他法律主体提供并另订条款（六、3），协议权利义务也可能整体或部分转移给关联公司（六、2），签约与处理主体可能随所购服务变化。
points.quote: 商汤科技亦可能委托关联公司或其他法律主体向您提供商汤科技上一项或多项具体服务，同时您可能会与该等公司订立相关条款或条件

points.text: No explicit "we do not train" statement exists for this tier, so this dimension is recorded as not stated. The only clause on how API inputs and outputs may be used is ToS §7.4, and it is a purpose limitation — "we will only use your Interaction Data in compliance with applicable laws and solely for the purpose of providing Services to you" — that never names model training, and the paragraph sits under the heading "7.4. Disclaimer". Judging yes needs wording that explicitly rules model training out; the international site has none (the mainland-China site's "不会用于任何大模型的预训练、微调或其他商业用途" belongs to a different entity and site and is not used here).
points.text_zh: 本档没有「不用于训练」的明文，故本维度记「未表态」。涉及 API 输入输出用途的只有 ToS §7.4 的用途限定「we will only use your Interaction Data in compliance with applicable laws and solely for the purpose of providing Services to you」：该句未点名模型训练，整段位于「7.4. Disclaimer」标题之下。判 yes 需要明确把模型训练挡在外面的表述，国际站没有这句（国内站那句「不会用于任何大模型的预训练、微调或其他商业用途」属另一法律实体、另一站点，不能替用）。

points.text: Scope of the §7.4 wording: the carve-outs in the same sentence ("Unless otherwise required by law, agreed under specific product rules, or necessary to provide technical assistance for troubleshooting or resolving technical issues at your request") attach to the following sentence about strictly executing instructions and not accessing Interaction Data; they do not modify the purpose-limitation sentence, which starts with "Additionally" and carries no carve-out of its own.
points.text_zh: §7.4 的适用范围：同句的三个口子（法律另有要求、依据特定产品规则另行约定、或应客户要求提供故障排除的技术协助）挂在紧随其后那句「严格执行指示／不访问交互数据」上，不改变以 Additionally 另起的用途限定句的字面范围。

points.text: Opposite-facing clause in the same contract, kept side by side without picking a side: ToS §12b gives SiliconFlow the right to "use and disclose any ideas, know-how, concepts, techniques, or other Intellectual Property Rights contained in such Feedback in any manner and for any purpose", and §12a assigns those Feedback rights to SiliconFlow; Privacy Policy §3 and ToS §7.1 both list "feedback" among the ways Interaction Data comes into being. Scope limit: "Feedback" is what the user chooses to propose (ideas, suggestions, recommendations, enhancements, improvements), not the whole of API inputs and outputs.
points.text_zh: 同一合同内的相反面向，两条并列、不选边：ToS §12b 授权厂商「use and disclose any ideas, know-how, concepts, techniques, or other Intellectual Property Rights contained in such Feedback in any manner and for any purpose」，§12a 更把 Feedback 的相关权利让与厂商；隐私政策 §3 与 ToS §7.1 都把 feedback 列为交互数据的生成方式之一。范围限定：Feedback 指用户主动提交的想法、建议、推荐、改进意见，不等于全部 API 输入输出。

points.text: "training" appears in the ToS only in §3.4b, and there it is a restriction on the user (no machine-learning or AI training or development on content provided through the service), not a vendor commitment about customer data.
points.text_zh: ToS 中唯一出现 training 的是 §3.4b，且是对用户的禁止（不得把服务提供的内容用于机器学习/AI 训练或开发），不是厂商对客户数据的承诺。

points.text: Object boundary: Privacy Policy §2.2b records network log information, usage frequency, crash data, usage scenarios and performance data, used "to optimize the service experience and improve product quality" — the object is operational data, not API inputs and outputs, so it neither supports nor overturns the training conclusion for this tier; §2.2c (troubleshooting records) is the same.
points.text_zh: 对象边界：隐私政策 §2.2b 记录 network log、使用频率、崩溃数据、使用场景与性能数据，用于「optimize the service experience and improve product quality」——对象是运行数据，不是 API 输入输出正文，既撑不起也不推翻本档的训练结论；§2.2c 的故障排除记录同理。

retention.quote: We may retain your Personal Data for as long as it is necessary to fulfil the purpose for which it was collected, or as required or permitted by applicable laws.

points.text: No quantified retention period exists anywhere in the three snapshots: the 30 days, 7 days and one year that appear in these documents are the response window for access requests, the notice window for fee disputes and the liability cap — none of them is a retention period.
points.text_zh: 三份快照里没有任何量化保留期限：出现的 30 天、7 天、一年分别是访问请求答复期、费用争议通知期与责任上限，与保留无关。

points.text: Inputs and outputs (Interaction Data): no period at all. ToS §7.4 ("We are under no obligation to store Interaction Data") and Privacy Policy §3 ("we have no obligation to store your Interaction Data") are disclaimers of a storage duty, not retention commitments — they must not be read as a retention period.
points.text_zh: 输入输出（交互数据）：完全没有期限。ToS §7.4「We are under no obligation to store Interaction Data」与隐私政策 §3「we have no obligation to store your Interaction Data」是存储义务的免责，不是保留承诺，不能读成保留期限。
points.quote: We are under no obligation to store Interaction Data and will not use or disclose it without authorization.

points.text: Personal Data: kept "as long as it is necessary to fulfil the purpose for which it was collected, or as required or permitted by applicable laws" — an upper-bound style commitment with no number of days — and deleted or de-identified "as soon as it is reasonable to assume that such retention no longer serves the purpose". The object is Personal Data, not Interaction Data.
points.text_zh: 个人数据：按「为实现收集目的所必需的期间，或适用法律要求或许可的期间」保留（上限式，无天数），并在「合理认为保留不再服务于该目的」时停止保留或去关联。对象是个人数据，不是交互数据。
points.quote: We may retain your Personal Data for as long as it is necessary to fulfil the purpose for which it was collected, or as required or permitted by applicable laws.

points.text: Access, account and transaction data and communications: no period. ToS §5.11 lets them be "monitored, captured, recorded and transmitted to the authorities" in compliance with local legal requirements and without further notice.
points.text_zh: 访问/账户/交易数据与通信：无期限。ToS §5.11 允许其被「monitored, captured, recorded and transmitted to the authorities」，依当地法律要求且不再另行通知。
points.quote: any or all data (including without limitation to user access data, user account data and transaction data) and communications with the Platform may be monitored, captured, recorded and transmitted to the authorities in compliance with the local legal requirements and without further notice

points.text: Operational data (network logs, usage frequency, crash data, performance data — Privacy Policy §2.2b) and troubleshooting records (§2.2c): collected for service improvement and support, with no retention period stated. The object is operational data, not the body of API inputs and outputs.
points.text_zh: 运行数据（network log、使用频率、崩溃数据、性能数据——隐私政策 §2.2b）与故障排除记录（§2.2c）：用于服务改进与支持，未披露保留期限。对象是运行数据，不是 API 输入输出正文。
points.quote: we may record network log information, as well as information on the frequency of using our platform and related services, crash data, usage scenarios, and related performance data. This information will be used to optimize the service experience and improve product quality.

points.text: After termination: deletion is at the vendor's discretion — account content "including your Interaction Data, may be deleted from SiliconFlow’s database at SiliconFlow’s discretion" — which is not a commitment to delete, and no deadline is given.
points.text_zh: 服务终止后：删除为裁量式——账户内容「including your Interaction Data, may be deleted from SiliconFlow’s database at SiliconFlow’s discretion」，不是删除承诺，也没有期限。
points.quote: including your Interaction Data, may be deleted from SiliconFlow’s database at SiliconFlow’s discretion

points.text: No processing or storage location is disclosed for this tier, so no region code is asserted. The contracts contain no storage-location clause: Privacy Policy §5.1 allows Personal Data to be "disclosed and/or transferred to the following third parties, and used or Processed by such third parties, whether within or outside Singapore" (affiliates, service providers, and foreign authorities among the recipients), and ToS §15.7f lets SiliconFlow "delegate or subcontract" the performance of any of its functions and use any service provider, subcontractor or agent.
points.text_zh: 本档未披露处理地/存储地，故不记任何地域码。合同里没有存储地域条款：隐私政策 §5.1 允许个人数据「may be disclosed and/or transferred to the following third parties, and used or Processed by such third parties, whether within or outside Singapore」（接收方含关联公司、服务商与境外政府/监管机构），ToS §15.7f 又允许把职能「delegate or subcontract」给任意服务提供者、分包商或代理。
points.quote: may be disclosed and/or transferred to the following third parties, and used or Processed by such third parties, whether within or outside Singapore

points.text: Singapore appears only as the contracting entity, the licensed territory of use and the governing law — ToS §2.1 grants a licence "to access and use the Platform and Services for in Singapore", §4.1 sets Singapore Laws as the compliance baseline, §14.1 makes Singapore law governing, and Privacy Policy §1.1 applies the Singapore PDPA. None of these says where data is processed or stored, so SG is not recorded for this dimension.
points.text_zh: 新加坡只出现在签约主体、许可使用地域与准据法上——ToS §2.1 授予「license to access and use the Platform and Services for in Singapore」，§4.1 以新加坡法律为合规基准，§14.1 以新加坡法为准据法，隐私政策 §1.1 适用新加坡 PDPA。这些都不是数据在何处处理或存储的表述，故本维度不记 SG。
points.quote: license to access and use the Platform and Services for in Singapore

role.quote: You acknowledge and agree that we and this platform act solely as passive technical supporters or channels for Interaction Data.

points.text: For Interaction Data the vendor positions itself as "passive technical supporters or channels" and says its technical services "will strictly execute your instructions for processing Interaction Data. We will not access your Interaction Data."
points.text_zh: 对交互数据，厂商自认「passive technical supporters or channels」，并称技术服务「will strictly execute your instructions for processing Interaction Data. We will not access your Interaction Data.」。
points.quote: You acknowledge and agree that we and this platform act solely as passive technical supporters or channels for Interaction Data.

points.text: The "strictly execute instructions / will not access" sentence carries three carve-outs: "Unless otherwise required by law, agreed under specific product rules, or necessary to provide technical assistance for troubleshooting or resolving technical issues at your request". They attach to that sentence, not to the purpose-limitation sentence in §7.4.
points.text_zh: 「严格执行指示／不访问」这句带三个口子：「Unless otherwise required by law, agreed under specific product rules, or necessary to provide technical assistance for troubleshooting or resolving technical issues at your request」——除非法律另有要求、依据特定产品规则另行约定、或应客户要求提供故障排除的技术协助。例外挂在这一句上，不在 §7.4 的用途限定句上。
points.quote: Unless otherwise required by law, agreed under specific product rules, or necessary to provide technical assistance for troubleshooting or resolving technical issues at your request

points.text: "We will not access" also has a compliance-review and law-enforcement opening: ToS §3.5 reserves the right to "monitor your access to or use of the Platform or Services, check, vet and/or control any activity, content or information", and §5.11 lets access data, account data, transaction data and communications be monitored, captured, recorded and transmitted to the authorities. The object of both is access/account/transaction data and communications, not the body of API inputs and outputs.
points.text_zh: 「不访问」另带合规审查与执法口子：ToS §3.5 保留监控、检查、审查平台活动的权利，§5.11 允许访问数据、账户数据、交易数据与通信被 monitored, captured, recorded 并送交当局。两条的对象都是访问/账户/交易数据与通信，不是 API 输入输出正文。
points.quote: monitor your access to or use of the Platform or Services, check, vet and/or control any activity, content or information occurring on or through the Platform or Services, to ensure your compliance with this Agreement, or to comply with SiliconFlow’s obligations under applicable Laws or the order or requirement of a court or other Governmental Authority

points.text: On the account and Personal Data side SiliconFlow is still an independent controller (the "neutral technology service provider" wording in Privacy Policy §3 covers Interaction Data only), and no public DPA is available.
points.text_zh: 账户与个人数据一侧仍是独立控制者（隐私政策 §3 的「中立技术服务提供者」只针对交互数据），且无公开 DPA。

points.text: Contract layer (Platform ToS §4.3(b)): the clause that authorises using "user usage data" to improve and develop products carries the exclusion "interaction data is not saved or disclosed". The authorised object is the device/diagnostic "user usage data" defined in §4.3 (information about your computer, mobile device, system and software), not API prompts or outputs — so this clause is not a training authorisation for API content; it is kept here for contrast only.
points.text_zh: 合同层（《平台使用协议》§4.3(b)）：授权把「用户使用数据」用于「改进我们的产品和服务或开发新的产品或服务」的同一条款，括号内写明「用户使用数据不同于交互数据。交互数据不保存、不披露」。该授权的标的是 §4.3 定义的设备/诊断类「用户使用数据」（有关您的计算机、移动设备、系统和软件的信息），不是 API 输入输出，不构成对 API 内容的训练授权；此处仅作对照。

points.text: Scope note: the "keep improving our products" purpose in §1(6) targets device information and network logs, not API prompts or outputs — recorded only to keep the two objects apart, not as training evidence.

points.text: The no-storage promise carries three built-in qualifiers: unless laws or regulations provide otherwise; unless separately agreed under specific product rules; or when we provide technical assistance at your request for troubleshooting or to resolve technical problems. Each has an instance: content-safety review collects prompts and outputs (statutory duty), Batch result files are kept 30 days (product rule), troubleshooting assistance.
points.text_zh: 不留存承诺自带三项限定：除非法律法规另有规定／依据特定产品规则另行约定／基于您的要求为您提供技术协助进行故障排除或解决技术问题。三项各有实例：内容安全审核收集提示词与输出（法律法规另有规定）、Batch 结果文件保留 30 天（特定产品规则另行约定）、按您的要求提供故障排除协助。所以不留存不是无条件承诺。
points.quote: 除非法律法规另有规定、依据特定产品规则另行约定或基于您的要求为您提供技术协助进行故障排除或解决技术问题

points.text: Contract layer: the Platform ToS states the same twice — §3.6.1 "we will not access your interaction data ... nor will we store it" and §4.3(b) "interaction data is not saved or disclosed". training.quote: Snowflake will not use Customer Data or Usage Data (in each case, including any Inputs or Outputs) to train, re-train or fine-tune any Model that Snowflake makes available for use by other parties.

points.text: Scope of the mark: the contract-layer prohibition covers training of any Model that Snowflake makes available for use by other parties — it is not a blanket no-training commitment for every use Snowflake may make of the data.
points.text_zh: 本档 mark=yes 的范围：AI Terms §3.2 的合同层禁止只覆盖「Snowflake 对外提供给其他方使用的模型」，不是「Snowflake 对数据的任何用途都不训练」的总承诺。
points.quote: Snowflake will not use Customer Data or Usage Data (in each case, including any Inputs or Outputs) to train, re-train or fine-tune any Model that Snowflake makes available for use by other parties.

points.text: Clause pointing the other way in the same contract layer: Snowflake will only use AI Data that has been aggregated and anonymized, such that neither Customer nor its Users can be identified, to develop or improve Snowflake's products and services. Under docs/judgment.md ('using data to improve the service counts as training') this is a relevant counter-direction clause, not an irrelevant one.
points.text_zh: 同属合同层的反向条款：AI Terms §3.1 授权用 AI Data（仅限已聚合、匿名化到无法识别客户与其用户）develop or improve Snowflake 的产品与服务。按 docs/judgment.md「用来改进服务算训练」的口径，这是与本档结论方向相反的相关条款。
points.quote: Snowflake will only use AI Data that has been aggregated and anonymized, such that neither Customer nor its Users can be identified, to develop or improve Snowflake’s products and services.

points.text: Second counter-direction clause, Customer Agreement layer: Snowflake may collect and use Usage Data to develop, improve, support, and operate its products and services.
points.text_zh: 第二条反向条款，Customer Agreement 层：ToS §4.2 允许 Snowflake 收集并使用 Usage Data 做其产品与服务的 develop/improve/support/operate。
points.quote: Snowflake may collect and use Usage Data to develop, improve, support, and operate its products and services.

points.text: The docs Legal notices table classifies the Input of Cortex AI Functions as Usage Data and the Output as Customer Data, so the §4.2 authorization reaches request content, not just telemetry.

points.text: Why these clauses do not flip the mark: AI Terms §1.4 provides that in the event of any conflict between the AI Terms and the Customer Agreement, the AI Terms control with respect to the subject matter herein, so for Covered AI Features §3.2 governs over §3.1 and over ToS §4.2. §3.1 is limited to AI Data aggregated and anonymized past identifiability, §4.2 to Usage Data for product development, while §3.2 is a direct prohibition on training models made available to other parties — which is why the conclusion is scoped to those models rather than read as a blanket commitment.
points.text_zh: 为何这两条不翻转 mark：AI Terms §1.4 规定 AI Terms 与 Customer Agreement 冲突时以 AI Terms 为准，故对 Covered AI Features，§3.2 优先于 §3.1 与 ToS §4.2。§3.1 限于聚合匿名化到不可识别之后的 AI Data，§4.2 限于 Usage Data 的产品开发用途，而 §3.2 是对「训练对外提供给其他方使用的模型」的直接禁止——故结论限定到这一范围，而不是读成总承诺。
points.quote: In the event of any conflict between these AI Terms and the Customer Agreement, these AI Terms will control with respect to the subject matter herein.

points.text: Plainest wording of the same commitment, one authority layer lower (enterprise_privacy_faq, below AI Terms): "No, we do not use your Usage Data or Customer Data (in each case, including any Inputs or Outputs of Snowflake AI Features) to train any Model to be made available for use by other customers." Same scope — models made available to other customers.

processing_region.quote: For new accounts created in new organizations within commercial regions after March 9, 2026, `ANY_REGION` is the default.

points.text: Why GLOBAL: for new accounts created in new organizations within commercial regions after March 9, 2026, ANY_REGION is the default value of CORTEX_ENABLED_CROSS_REGION, so inference requests can be processed in any Snowflake-supported region, across any cloud provider.
points.text_zh: 为何记 GLOBAL：2026-03-09 之后在新组织、商业区域创建的账户，CORTEX_ENABLED_CROSS_REGION 默认 ANY_REGION，推理请求可在任意 Snowflake 支持的跨云区域处理。
