points.text: Storage stays put while processing moves: your customer data remains stored only in the region where your account is located. codes=GLOBAL therefore describes the processing location of the inference payload, not the storage location of account data.
points.text_zh: 存储不动、处理可动：客户数据只存在账户所在区域。因此 codes=GLOBAL 描述的是推理载荷的处理地，不是账户数据的存储地。
points.quote: Your customer data remains stored only in the region where your account is located.

points.text: What actually crosses the boundary: during cross-region inference the inference payload — the input prompt you send and the output response you receive — is transmitted transiently to the processing region for the duration of processing, and no customer data is persisted in the processing region.
points.text_zh: 真正跨区的是推理载荷：处理期间只有输入提示与输出响应临时传输到处理区域，处理区域不持久化客户数据。
points.quote: During cross-region inference, the inference payload—the input prompt you send and the output response you receive—is transmitted transiently to the processing region for the duration of processing. Your customer data is not persisted in the processing region.

points.text: Contract-layer limit kept alongside the above: once Customer has selected a Hosting Region, Snowflake will not Process Customer Personal Data from outside the Hosting Region except as reasonably necessary to provide the Snowflake Offerings procured by Customer, or as necessary to comply with the law or binding order of a governmental body. Cross-region inference falls under the 'reasonably necessary to provide the procured Offerings' exception.
points.text_zh: 与上述事实并列保留的合同层限定：DPA §7.1 规定客户选定 Hosting Region 后不在区外处理 Customer Personal Data，例外为「为提供所购 Offering 所合理必需」或法律/政府强制令；跨区推理落在该例外之内。

points.text: BYO 档结论：AI Features 的「不用于训练对外提供的模型」承诺**不适用于客户自带模型**——官方 FAQ「Any models (including third-party models) that you bring into your Service account (for example, using Snowpark Container Services) in accordance with the Documentation are treated as Customer Data and are not considered part of the Service.」模型本身被当作 Customer Data，适用客户数据的一般权利义务（ToS §2.1 的有限处理授权、DPA §3.1 的 processor 角色），而不是 AI Terms 的 AI Features 条款。Snowflake 是否可能读到这些模型的内容，取决于客户数据侧的通用条款与支持访问政策，不是本档的 AI 专属承诺。

points.text: Relation to the AI Trust FAQ's no-training answer: that page is about Snowflake AI Features throughout (the bullet list sits under 'USE OF YOUR DATA FOR SNOWFLAKE AI FEATURES'), and the FAQ answer's subject is 'your Usage Data or Customer Data', while the same page treats models the customer brings in as Customer Data and 'not considered part of the Service'. The commitment therefore attaches to data processed by Snowflake AI Features; a BYO model and its own inputs/outputs are outside that scope. So the mark stays unknown and is not flipped either way: the sentence is not read as a no-training commitment for this tier (the scope does not match), and its existence is not read as 'training happens'. Should it be used to flip the mark later, it must be anchored and labelled enterprise_privacy_faq (below AI Terms).
points.text_zh: 与 AI Trust FAQ 那句「不训练对外提供的模型」的关系：该页通篇讲 Snowflake AI Features（不训练那组 bullet 挂在「USE OF YOUR DATA FOR SNOWFLAKE AI FEATURES」小节下），FAQ 回答的主语是「your Usage Data or Customer Data」，而同一页又把客户自带模型界定为 Customer Data、且「not considered part of the Service」——即该承诺挂在 Snowflake AI Features 处理的数据上，自带模型本身与其输入输出不在其列。故本档仍记 unknown，两个方向都不据此改判：既不把该句当作本档的不训练承诺（范围对不上），也不因它存在就记成「会训练」。若日后据此改判，须绑该 FAQ 锚点并注明来源层级为 enterprise_privacy_faq（低于 AI Terms）。

points.text: BYO tier conclusion: the only processing-location commitment that applies is the Customer Data rule in DPA §7.1 — once Customer has selected a Hosting Region, Snowflake will not Process Customer Personal Data from outside the Hosting Region except as reasonably necessary to provide the Snowflake Offerings procured by Customer, or as necessary to comply with the law or binding order of a governmental body. Hence codes=selected: the region is the one the customer picks, not global.
points.text_zh: BYO 档结论：本档唯一适用的处理地承诺是 Customer Data 侧的 DPA §7.1——客户选定 Hosting Region 后不在区外处理 Customer Personal Data，例外为提供所购 Offering 所必需或法律要求。故 codes=selected：地域由客户选定，不是全球。

role.quote: Any models (including third-party models) that you bring into your Service account (for example, using Snowpark Container Services) in accordance with the Documentation are treated as Customer Data and are not considered part of the Service.

points.text: BYO 档结论：Snowflake 对客户自带的模型（作为 Customer Data）仍是受托处理方（DPA §3.1 processor），客户是该模型的控制者
points.text_zh: BYO 档结论：Snowflake 对客户自带的模型（作为 Customer Data）仍是受托处理方（DPA §3.1 processor），客户是该模型的控制者

points.text: 同时官方明确该模型「not considered part of the Service」，即 Snowflake 不对模型本身承担 AI Features 的专门承诺。与 api 档的差别在于：模型不是 Snowflake 提供的，Snowflake 对其运行方式、输入输出保留行为不作 AI 专属承诺。
points.text_zh: 同时官方明确该模型「not considered part of the Service」，即 Snowflake 不对模型本身承担 AI Features 的专门承诺。与 api 档的差别在于：模型不是 Snowflake 提供的，Snowflake 对其运行方式、输入输出保留行为不作 AI 专属承诺。

training.quote: Snowflake will not use Customer Data or Usage Data (in each case, including any Inputs or Outputs) to train, re-train or fine-tune any Model that Snowflake makes available for use by other parties.

points.text: Tier mapping and scope: Cortex Agents / Analyst / Search / CoWork are named on the AI Trust and Safety page as Snowflake AI Features, and AI Terms §6.4 defines Covered AI Features as the generally available Snowflake AI Features identified in the Documentation, so §3.2 applies to this tier with no evidence of a tier-level difference. But §3.2 only bars training of any Model that Snowflake makes available for use by other parties — that is the scope of this mark.
points.text_zh: 档位映射与范围：Cortex Agents / Analyst / Search / CoWork 均属 AI Trust and Safety 页点名的 Snowflake AI Features，AI Terms §6.4 把 Covered AI Features 定为文档中列明的 GA「Snowflake AI Features」，故 §3.2 覆盖本档，无档位差异证据；但 §3.2 只禁止训练「Snowflake 对外提供给其他方使用的模型」，本档 mark=yes 按这个范围读。
points.quote: Snowflake will not use Customer Data or Usage Data (in each case, including any Inputs or Outputs) to train, re-train or fine-tune any Model that Snowflake makes available for use by other parties.

points.text: Clause pointing the other way in the same contract layer: Snowflake will only use AI Data that has been aggregated and anonymized, such that neither Customer nor its Users can be identified, to develop or improve Snowflake's products and services. Under docs/judgment.md ('using data to improve the service counts as training') this is a relevant counter-direction clause, not an irrelevant one.
points.text_zh: 同属合同层的反向条款：AI Terms §3.1 授权用 AI Data（仅限已聚合、匿名化到无法识别客户与其用户）develop or improve Snowflake 的产品与服务。按 docs/judgment.md「用来改进服务算训练」的口径，这是与本档结论方向相反的相关条款。
points.quote: Snowflake will only use AI Data that has been aggregated and anonymized, such that neither Customer nor its Users can be identified, to develop or improve Snowflake’s products and services.

points.text: Second counter-direction clause, Customer Agreement layer: Snowflake may collect and use Usage Data to develop, improve, support, and operate its products and services.
points.text_zh: 第二条反向条款，Customer Agreement 层：ToS §4.2 允许 Snowflake 收集并使用 Usage Data 做其产品与服务的 develop/improve/support/operate。
points.quote: Snowflake may collect and use Usage Data to develop, improve, support, and operate its products and services.

points.text: The docs Legal notices table classifies the Input of Cortex AI Functions as Usage Data and the Output as Customer Data, so the §4.2 authorization reaches request content, not just telemetry.
points.text_zh: docs 侧 Legal notices 表把 Cortex AI Functions 的 Input 归为 Usage Data、Output 归为 Customer Data，故 §4.2 的授权落在请求内容上，而不只是遥测。
points.quote: The data classification of inputs and outputs are as set forth in the following table. | Input data classification | Output data classification | Designation | | Usage Data | Customer Data |

points.text: Why these clauses do not flip the mark: AI Terms §1.4 provides that in the event of any conflict between the AI Terms and the Customer Agreement, the AI Terms control with respect to the subject matter herein, so for Covered AI Features §3.2 governs over §3.1 and over ToS §4.2. §3.1 is limited to AI Data aggregated and anonymized past identifiability, §4.2 to Usage Data for product development, while §3.2 is a direct prohibition on training models made available to other parties — which is why the conclusion is scoped to those models rather than read as a blanket commitment.
points.text_zh: 为何这两条不翻转 mark：AI Terms §1.4 规定 AI Terms 与 Customer Agreement 冲突时以 AI Terms 为准，故对 Covered AI Features，§3.2 优先于 §3.1 与 ToS §4.2。§3.1 限于聚合匿名化到不可识别之后的 AI Data，§4.2 限于 Usage Data 的产品开发用途，而 §3.2 是对「训练对外提供给其他方使用的模型」的直接禁止——故结论限定到这一范围，而不是读成总承诺。
points.quote: In the event of any conflict between these AI Terms and the Customer Agreement, these AI Terms will control with respect to the subject matter herein.

points.text: Plainest wording of the same commitment, one authority layer lower (enterprise_privacy_faq, below AI Terms): "No, we do not use your Usage Data or Customer Data (in each case, including any Inputs or Outputs of Snowflake AI Features) to train any Model to be made available for use by other customers." Same scope — models made available to other customers.
points.text_zh: 同一承诺在最直白的一处表述，来源层级为 enterprise_privacy_faq（低于 AI Terms）：「No, we do not use your Usage Data or Customer Data (in each case, including any Inputs or Outputs of Snowflake AI Features) to train any Model to be made available for use by other customers.」范围相同——对外提供给其他方使用的模型。
points.quote: No, we do not use your Usage Data or Customer Data (in each case, including any Inputs or Outputs of Snowflake AI Features) to train any Model to be made available for use by other customers.

zdr.quote: Cortex Agents deployed through the Agent API or Snowflake CoWork log conversation threads, turns, and execution spans automatically into `SNOWFLAKE.LOCAL.AI_OBSERVABILITY_EVENTS`.

points.text: No zero-retention option or commitment is disclosed for this tier, and the tier states the opposite for conversation content: Cortex Agents deployed through the Agent API or Snowflake CoWork log conversation threads, turns, and execution spans automatically into SNOWFLAKE.LOCAL.AI_OBSERVABILITY_EVENTS.
points.text_zh: 本档没有任何「会话/提示/输出可零保留」的选项或承诺，方向相反的公开事实明示落表：经 Agent API 或 Snowflake CoWork 部署的 Cortex Agents 会把会话线程、轮次与执行跨度自动写入 SNOWFLAKE.LOCAL.AI_OBSERVABILITY_EVENTS。
points.quote: Cortex Agents deployed through the Agent API or Snowflake CoWork log conversation threads, turns, and execution spans automatically into `SNOWFLAKE.LOCAL.AI_OBSERVABILITY_EVENTS`.

points.text: The thread messages themselves are persisted rather than transient — the Threads documentation refers to the persisted user message ID and the persisted assistant message ID, and long conversations are compacted into a summary message.
points.text_zh: 会话线程消息本身是持久化的，不是临时对象：Threads 文档称消息为「persisted」（user 与 assistant 消息各有持久化 id），长会话还会写入 compaction 摘要。
points.quote: the persisted user message ID

points.text: 结论范围：会话线程与观测数据明示落表、本档无 ZDR 选项或申请方式（合同层与 docs 站均未披露）。
points.text_zh: 结论范围：会话线程与观测数据明示落表、本档无 ZDR 选项或申请方式（合同层与 docs 站均未披露）。

retention.summary: 按对象分列保留 180 天
retention.quote: Support with configurable retention (default 180 days, reducible via account parameter).

points.text: Object: the Cortex Threads conversation content itself — default 180 days, reducible via account parameter; a default value, not a ceiling. Authority note: this figure appears only in the official engineering blog, i.e. the official_blog layer, the lowest in this ledger, so it is recorded as a lead rather than as a contract-layer period; the developer docs only confirm that the messages are persisted and state no duration. The contract layer (DPA §3.5(e)) is what makes the period customer-configurable.
points.text_zh: 对象：Cortex Threads 的会话内容本身——默认 180 天，可用账户参数调低；是默认值不是上限。权威层级说明：该天数只出现在官方工程博客，即 official_blog（本台账最低层），按线索记录而不作合同层期限；developer docs 只证消息是 persisted 的，未写时长。合同层 DPA §3.5(e) 才是「期限由客户配置决定」的权威。
points.quote: Support with configurable retention (default 180 days, reducible via account parameter).

points.text: Object: the observability tables. Cortex Agents deployed through the Agent API or Snowflake CoWork log conversation threads, turns, and execution spans automatically into SNOWFLAKE.LOCAL.AI_OBSERVABILITY_EVENTS; no retention period is stated for those tables.
points.text_zh: 对象：观测表。经 Agent API 或 Snowflake CoWork 部署的 Cortex Agents 会把会话线程、轮次与执行跨度自动写入 SNOWFLAKE.LOCAL.AI_OBSERVABILITY_EVENTS；这些表没有公布保留期限。
points.quote: Cortex Agents deployed through the Agent API or Snowflake CoWork log conversation threads, turns, and execution spans automatically into `SNOWFLAKE.LOCAL.AI_OBSERVABILITY_EVENTS`.

points.text: Object: Cortex Analyst request and response telemetry, stored in SNOWFLAKE.LOCAL.CORTEX_ANALYST_REQUESTS_RAW rather than in the shared event table; no retention period is stated for it either.
points.text_zh: 对象：Cortex Analyst 的请求与响应遥测，写在 SNOWFLAKE.LOCAL.CORTEX_ANALYST_REQUESTS_RAW 而不是共享事件表；同样没有公布保留期限。
points.quote: Cortex Analyst stores **direct** Analyst request and response telemetry in `SNOWFLAKE.LOCAL.CORTEX_ANALYST_REQUESTS_RAW`, not in the shared AI observability event table.

points.text: Contract layer, object = Customer Personal Data: the period for which Customer Personal Data will be retained and the criteria used to determine that period is determined by Customer via use and configuration of the Service (DPA §3.5(e)); after termination there is a 30-day retrieval window (ToS §7.3), and then remaining Customer Data is promptly deleted (Security Addendum §8.2).
points.text_zh: 合同层，对象 = Customer Personal Data：保留期与判定标准由客户通过服务使用与配置决定（DPA §3.5(e)）；终止后 30 天取回期（ToS §7.3），之后及时删除剩余 Customer Data（Security Addendum §8.2）。
points.quote: The period for which Customer Personal Data will be retained and the criteria used to determine that period is determined by Customer during the term of the Agreement via Customer’s use and configuration of the Service.

points.text: Object: the inference payload (input prompt and output response). Not persisted in the processing region — it is transmitted transiently for the duration of processing only.
points.text_zh: 对象：推理载荷（输入提示与输出响应）。处理区域不落盘，只在处理期间临时传输。
points.quote: During cross-region inference, the inference payload—the input prompt you send and the output response you receive—is transmitted transiently to the processing region for the duration of processing. Your customer data is not persisted in the processing region.

points.text: Quantified floor on a different object: Cloud Environment infrastructure logs (host-based intrusion detection and similar monitoring tools) are securely stored to prevent tampering for at least one year. Object = infrastructure logs, not inputs/outputs; type = floor. The same section separately describes Account user logs, which Snowflake makes available to Customer for the Customer's own preservation, so the two objects must not be merged.
points.text_zh: 另一对象的量化下限：Cloud Environment 基础设施日志（主机入侵检测等监控工具）「securely stored to prevent tampering for at least one year」。对象 = 基础设施日志，不是输入输出正文；期限类型 = 下限。同页 §4.6.2 另述 Account 用户日志（Snowflake 捕获后交由客户自行保存），两者对象不同，不可合并。
points.quote: These logs are further monitored, analyzed for anomalies, and are securely stored to prevent tampering for at least one year.

points.text: Second quantified floor, again a different object: any logs Snowflake determines to be relevant to a Security Incident shall be preserved for at least one year. Object = security-incident-related logs; context = when a Security Incident occurs; type = floor. It does not change the conclusion that inputs/outputs are retained as needed, and it cannot be read backwards as 'everything is deleted after one year'.
points.text_zh: 第二条量化下限，对象又不同：Snowflake 认定与安全事件相关的日志至少保留一年。对象 = 安全事件相关日志；语境 = 发生安全事件时；期限类型 = 下限。它不改变「输入输出按需保留」的结论，也不能反推成「一年后删除全部内容」。
points.quote: Any logs determined by Snowflake to be relevant to a Security Incident, shall be preserved for at least one year.

processing_region.quote: For new accounts created in new organizations within commercial regions after March 9, 2026, `ANY_REGION` is the default.

points.text: Why GLOBAL: for new accounts created in new organizations within commercial regions after March 9, 2026, ANY_REGION is the default value of CORTEX_ENABLED_CROSS_REGION, so inference requests can be processed in any Snowflake-supported region, across any cloud provider.
points.text_zh: 为何记 GLOBAL：2026-03-09 之后在新组织、商业区域创建的账户，CORTEX_ENABLED_CROSS_REGION 默认 ANY_REGION，推理请求可在任意 Snowflake 支持的跨云区域处理。
points.quote: For new accounts created in new organizations within commercial regions after March 9, 2026, `ANY_REGION` is the default.

points.text: Storage stays put while processing moves: your customer data remains stored only in the region where your account is located. codes=GLOBAL therefore describes the processing location of the inference payload, not the storage location of account data.
points.text_zh: 存储不动、处理可动：客户数据只存在账户所在区域。因此 codes=GLOBAL 描述的是推理载荷的处理地，不是账户数据的存储地。
points.quote: Your customer data remains stored only in the region where your account is located.

points.text: What actually crosses the boundary: during cross-region inference the inference payload — the input prompt you send and the output response you receive — is transmitted transiently to the processing region for the duration of processing, and no customer data is persisted in the processing region.
points.text_zh: 真正跨区的是推理载荷：处理期间只有输入提示与输出响应临时传输到处理区域，处理区域不持久化客户数据。
points.quote: During cross-region inference, the inference payload—the input prompt you send and the output response you receive—is transmitted transiently to the processing region for the duration of processing. Your customer data is not persisted in the processing region.

points.text: Contract-layer limit kept alongside the above: once Customer has selected a Hosting Region, Snowflake will not Process Customer Personal Data from outside the Hosting Region except as reasonably necessary to provide the Snowflake Offerings procured by Customer, or as necessary to comply with the law or binding order of a governmental body. Cross-region inference falls under the 'reasonably necessary to provide the procured Offerings' exception.
points.text_zh: 与上述事实并列保留的合同层限定：DPA §7.1 规定客户选定 Hosting Region 后不在区外处理 Customer Personal Data，例外为「为提供所购 Offering 所合理必需」或法律/政府强制令；跨区推理落在该例外之内。
points.quote: Once Customer has selected a Hosting Region, Snowflake will not Process Customer Personal Data from outside the Hosting Region except as reasonably necessary to provide the Snowflake Offerings procured by Customer, or as necessary to comply with the law or binding order of a governmental body.

points.text: Upstream hop when frontier models are called: Claude (Anthropic on AWS Bedrock), GPT (Azure OpenAI) and Gemini (GCP) are served at the CSP-hosted frontier model endpoint instead of a Snowflake GPU cluster. Source level is official_blog — a discovery lead only; that hop's own ZDR has to be applied for separately and does not come together with Snowflake's.
points.text_zh: 调用 frontier 模型时的上游跳：Claude（Anthropic on AWS Bedrock）、GPT（Azure OpenAI）、Gemini（GCP）在 CSP 托管端点上完成，而不是 Snowflake GPU 集群。来源层级为 official_blog，仅作发现线索；该跳的 ZDR 需各自申请，不自动与 Snowflake 同开。
points.quote: For closed models — Claude (Anthropic on AWS Bedrock), GPT (Azure OpenAI) and Gemini (GCP) — the architecture uses the same proxy flow, terminating at the CSP-hosted frontier model endpoint instead of a Snowflake GPU cluster.

training.quote: Snowflake may use information about Customer’s use and evaluation of Previews for Snowflake’s product improvement and development.

points.text: Preview 档结论：**Snowflake 保留把客户对 Preview 的使用与评估信息用于自身产品改进与开发的权利**，且 Preview 被排除在隐私承诺之外。逐字条款：Preview Terms「Snowflake may use information about Customer's use and evaluation of Previews for Snowflake's product improvement and development.」
points.text_zh: Preview 档结论：**Snowflake 保留把客户对 Preview 的使用与评估信息用于自身产品改进与开发的权利**，且 Preview 被排除在隐私承诺之外。逐字条款：Preview Terms「Snowflake may use information about Customer's use and evaluation of Previews for Snowflake's product improvement and development.」

points.text: AI Terms §5.2 明确 Preview AI Features 在 AI Terms 范围之外（「Customer's use of any Preview AI Features is outside the scope of these AI Terms and is subject to the separate Preview Terms」），因此 AI Terms §3.2 的不训练承诺**不覆盖 Preview**

points.text: Preview 档结论：**无任何保留期或删除承诺**——Preview Terms「Previews are excluded from Snowflake's security, compliance and privacy commitments.」，并且客户被要求不得用 Preview 处理个人信息或受合规/法律要求约束的数据（「Customers shall not use Previews to process personal data or other data that is subject to any compliance or legal requirements.」）。故 DPA §3.5(e)、Security Addendum §8.2 等客户数据保留与删除条款在 Preview 上不被承诺适用（合同层面被排除）。置信度 medium：排除条款明确，但未逐字说「不适用 DPA」。

training.quote: On an [Amp Enterprise](https://ampcode.com/docs/pricing#enterprise) workspace plan (paid or trial) training can _never_ be enabled.

points.text: One lower-authority source points the other way: the privacy policy lists "product improvement" among Amp's own legitimate interests, and "plan for and enhance our service" among the uses of automatically collected data. Under this ledger's rule that improving a service counts as training, that sentence would argue the opposite; it is a consumer_privacy-level general statement, while the security page's "On an Amp Enterprise workspace plan (paid or trial) training can never be enabled." is the developer_data-level commitment and outranks it (contract > developer_data > enterprise_privacy_faq > consumer_privacy). Both facts are kept, and the mark stays yes on the security page.
points.text_zh: 有一条低位阶表述方向相反：隐私政策把「product improvement」列进 Amp 自身的合法利益，自动收集数据的用途里也有「plan for and enhance our service」。按本台账「用来改进服务算训练」的口径，这句本应推出 mark=no；但它是 consumer_privacy 层级的一般性表述，而安全页的「On an Amp Enterprise workspace plan (paid or trial) training can never be enabled.」属 developer_data 层级，按 contract > developer_data > enterprise_privacy_faq > consumer_privacy 优先。两条事实并列保留，结论仍以安全页为准记 yes。
points.quote: Legitimate interests: We use your Personal Information for our legitimate interests, such as security, abuse, and fraud prevention, product improvement, and communications about your use of our Services.

zdr.quote: It limits how long third-party model providers retain prompts and responses. It does not mean that no data is ever retained.

points.text: MDR is a qualified mechanism rather than a blanket zero-retention promise: it is "available to all Amp users when Amp sends requests through model provider connections managed by Amp and using Amp credits." Requests routed through a customer-managed connection are not covered.
points.text_zh: MDR 是有条件的机制，不是无条件的零保留承诺：官方写它「available to all Amp users when Amp sends requests through model provider connections managed by Amp and using Amp credits」。走客户自管连接的调用不在覆盖范围内。
points.quote: Minimal Data Retention (MDR) is available to all Amp users when Amp sends requests through model provider connections managed by Amp and using Amp credits.

points.text: The object is the provider hop, not Amp's own storage: "MDR only covers data handled by third-party model providers during inference (the process of generating a model response). It does not control how Amp stores thread data." Amp's own thread storage is governed by the retention row instead.
points.text_zh: 对象是模型商那一跳，不是 Amp 自己的存储：官方写「MDR only covers data handled by third-party model providers during inference (the process of generating a model response). It does not control how Amp stores thread data.」。Amp 自身的 thread 存储由 retention 列的规则管辖。
points.quote: MDR only covers data handled by third-party model providers during inference (the process of generating a model response). It does not control how Amp stores thread data.

points.text: Coverage is not uniform across models: "Certain models or features may require longer retention. A provider may retain data for up to 30 days when specified in its current documentation." 30 days is an upper bound for that subset, not a general retention period.
points.text_zh: 覆盖程度不因模型而一致：官方写「Certain models or features may require longer retention. A provider may retain data for up to 30 days when specified in its current documentation.」。这里的 30 天是该子集的上限，不是普遍保留期。
points.quote: Certain models or features may require longer retention. A provider may retain data for up to 30 days when specified in its current documentation.

points.text: And some calls cannot be limited at all: "Some models and features are not eligible for MDR." Eligibility can change as providers change their terms, so whether a given call is covered has to be checked per model and feature where it is enabled.
points.text_zh: 而且有些调用根本不在覆盖范围内：官方写「Some models and features are not eligible for MDR.」。资格会随模型商条款变化，某次调用是否受覆盖必须在启用处按模型/功能确认。
points.quote: Some models and features are not eligible for MDR.

points.text: Exception to the ordinary rule (retained only as long as needed to return a response): "Providers may retain safety and abuse monitoring data, including classifier results, trust and safety scores, and content flagged as potentially violating their usage policies. Each provider retains this data according to its abuse prevention and safety policies."
points.text_zh: 常规规则（只为返回响应所需时长保留）之外的第一条例外：官方写「Providers may retain safety and abuse monitoring data, including classifier results, trust and safety scores, and content flagged as potentially violating their usage policies. Each provider retains this data according to its abuse prevention and safety policies.」。
points.quote: Providers may retain safety and abuse monitoring data, including classifier results, trust and safety scores, and content flagged as potentially violating their usage policies. Each provider retains this data according to its abuse prevention and safety policies.

points.text: Second exception: "Providers may retain data when required by law, a court order, or a regulatory requirement."
points.text_zh: 第二条例外：官方写「Providers may retain data when required by law, a court order, or a regulatory requirement.」。
points.quote: Providers may retain data when required by law, a court order, or a regulatory requirement.

points.text: BYOK leaves the MDR regime: "Requests sent with your key are covered by the retention terms of your provider account." The MDR page says the same in its own words — the retention terms of the provider account apply instead.
points.text_zh: BYOK 不适用 MDR：官方写「Requests sent with your key are covered by the retention terms of your provider account.」。MDR 页同义表述为：客户自管连接的调用改为适用其模型账号的保留条款。
points.quote: Requests sent with your key are covered by the retention terms of your provider account.

points.text: The provider-side object is not only the prompt text: "Providers may store computational artifacts derived from prompts, such as key/value tensors or cached tokens, for a limited period. In this case, the provider does not persist the original prompt text after generating the response." KV cache / cached tokens are a separate object from Amp's thread data, and no period is given beyond "a limited period".
points.text_zh: 模型商侧的对象不只是提示词正文：官方写「Providers may store computational artifacts derived from prompts, such as key/value tensors or cached tokens, for a limited period. In this case, the provider does not persist the original prompt text after generating the response.」。KV 缓存/缓存 token 与 Amp 的 thread 数据是两个对象，期限只写了「a limited period」，没有具体天数。
points.quote: Providers may store computational artifacts derived from prompts, such as key/value tensors or cached tokens, for a limited period. In this case, the provider does not persist the original prompt text after generating the response.

retention.summary: 输入输出留至服务终止
retention.quote: When a thread is explicitly deleted, all data for that thread is removed within 30 days of thread deletion.

points.text: Enterprise-workspace threads are owned by the enterprise that owns the workspace rather than by the individual user who created the thread.
points.text_zh: 企业工作区的线程归拥有该工作区的企业所有，而不是归创建线程的个人。
points.quote: are owned by the enterprise that owns the workspace, not the individual user who created the thread.

points.text: The deletion trigger for this tier is the end of the contract rather than a fixed period: "We only delete workspace threads and associated user data when the enterprise's contract with us ends." The 30-day window applies to threads that are explicitly deleted.
points.text_zh: 本档的删除触发点是合同终止而不是固定期限：官方写「We only delete workspace threads and associated user data when the enterprise’s contract with us ends.」。30 天窗口针对的是被显式删除的线程。
points.quote: We only delete workspace threads and associated user data when the enterprise’s contract with us ends.

points.text: And the period itself is negotiable: the pricing page lists "Configurable thread retention (on request)" among the Enterprise controls.
points.text_zh: 期限本身可协商：定价页把「Configurable thread retention (on request)」列为企业档控制项之一。
points.quote: Configurable thread retention (on request)

points.text: Audit logs are a separate object from thread content, and their period is a floor: "Audit logs are retained for a minimum of 30 days." That is not a deadline for deleting inputs and outputs — the thread-deletion window is a different rule.
points.text_zh: 审计日志是与线程内容不同的对象，且期限是下限：「Audit logs are retained for a minimum of 30 days.」。这不等于输入输出在 30 天后删除——线程删除窗口是另一条规则。
points.quote: Audit logs are retained for a minimum of 30 days.

points.text: What that object is: structured application audit logs (timestamps, actor IDs, request details, event information) collected internally and monitored by Amp's security team, not exposed to Workspace Admins by default, but providable for Enterprise workspaces on request, for example during customer audits or incidents.
points.text_zh: 该对象的范围：结构化应用审计日志（时间戳、actor ID、request details、事件信息），由 Amp 安全团队内部收集与监控，默认不对工作区管理员开放，但企业工作区可按需调取（例如客户审计或事件调查）。
points.quote: Amp maintains comprehensive application audit logs for security and monitoring purposes. Logs are structured and include key fields such as timestamps, actor IDs, request details, and event information. These logs are collected internally and monitored by the Amp security team, but are not currently exposed to Workspace Admins. Application audit logs can be provided for Enterprise workspaces upon request, for example during customer audits or incidents.

points.text: Orb-side object: "Amp reuses a snapshot for at most 72 hours and then replaces it. Replaced snapshots are queued for deletion, but cannot be deleted until all orbs created from it have also been deleted - either by deleting threads, or removing a project." 72 hours is a reuse ceiling for project snapshots (cloned repository plus setup results), and deletion after replacement can be deferred until every orb derived from that snapshot is gone.
points.text_zh: Orb 侧对象：官方写「Amp reuses a snapshot for at most 72 hours and then replaces it. Replaced snapshots are queued for deletion, but cannot be deleted until all orbs created from it have also been deleted - either by deleting threads, or removing a project.」。72 小时是项目快照（克隆仓库 + setup 结果）的复用上限；替换后的删除会推迟到由该快照派生的 orb 全部消失为止。
points.quote: Amp reuses a snapshot for at most 72 hours and then replaces it. Replaced snapshots are queued for deletion, but cannot be deleted until all orbs created from it have also been deleted - either by deleting threads, or removing a project.

points.text: Orbs have no retention period of their own: "Amp does not offer a retention period for orbs that is separate from threads."
points.text_zh: Orb 没有独立保留期：官方写「Amp does not offer a retention period for orbs that is separate from threads.」。
points.quote: Amp does not offer a retention period for orbs that is separate from threads.

points.text: Deletion is not the end of retention: "After account deletion, Amp may retain information as needed to perform our contractual obligations, comply with tax, legal, and audit obligations, resolve disputes, preserve legal rights, or enforce our agreements. We retain sales inquiry records after account deletion because they are business correspondence. We keep them only as long as needed for sales follow-up, recordkeeping, legal and audit obligations, or resolving disputes." Read together with the 30-day window: that window covers thread content, while account information and sales correspondence can outlive it.
points.text_zh: 删除不等于全部信息即刻消失：官方写「After account deletion, Amp may retain information as needed to perform our contractual obligations, comply with tax, legal, and audit obligations, resolve disputes, preserve legal rights, or enforce our agreements. We retain sales inquiry records after account deletion because they are business correspondence. We keep them only as long as needed for sales follow-up, recordkeeping, legal and audit obligations, or resolving disputes.」。与 30 天窗口并读：窗口管的是线程内容，账号信息与销售往来记录可以更久。
points.quote: After account deletion, Amp may retain information as needed to perform our contractual obligations, comply with tax, legal, and audit obligations, resolve disputes, preserve legal rights, or enforce our agreements. We retain sales inquiry records after account deletion because they are business correspondence. We keep them only as long as needed for sales follow-up, recordkeeping, legal and audit obligations, or resolving disputes.

processing_region.quote: We store and process the information that we collect in the United States in accordance with this Privacy Policy, though our employees, contractors, and service providers may store and process data outside the United States.

points.text: The sentence previously bound here is about ownership, not about the contract role: the security page says Enterprise-workspace threads belong to the enterprise rather than to the individual creator. Data ownership is not a controller/processor designation, so that quote now supports the retention row and this row stays unknown.
points.text_zh: 原先绑在本条的引文讲的是归属、不是合同角色：安全页写企业工作区的线程归企业所有而非创建者个人。数据归属不是控制者/受托方的角色指定，该引文现改绑 retention 列，本条记 unknown。

points.text: The enterprise legal terms are outside the checked set: the minimal-data-retention page points Enterprise customers to "Data Retention for Enterprise Subscriptions" in the Terms of Service for the full legal terms that apply to their plan, and that document is not among the sources this ledger monitors — so even if it designates a role, it cannot be verified from the pages checked.
points.text_zh: 企业档的完整法律条款不在已核实范围内：Minimal Data Retention 页把企业客户指向 Terms of Service 里的「Data Retention for Enterprise Subscriptions」，该文档尚未纳入本台账的来源；即使其中指定了角色，也无法从已核实的页面确认。

points.text: The workspace relationship is not addressed: nothing in the pages checked states a data role between a workspace and its members. The only workspace-scoped statements are about Enterprise thread ownership and about thread visibility — not about who is controller or processor for member data.
points.text_zh: 工作区关系未约定：已核实文档没有表述工作区与其成员之间的数据角色；涉及工作区的表述只有企业档线程归属与线程可见范围，不涉及成员数据由谁控制。

points.text: Access context for workspace buyers (not a role finding): joining a workspace with the same account used for personal threads makes those existing threads visible to all workspace members, unless the user makes those threads private or signs up to the workspace with a separate account under a separate email.
points.text_zh: 工作区采购方关心的访问范围（不是角色判定）：用同一账号加入工作区后，此前创建的个人线程会对全体工作区成员可见，除非把这些线程设为 private，或改用另一个邮箱的独立账号加入。
points.quote: Note that when joining a workspace with the same account as an individual user has used to create personal threads, the user understands and acknowledges that existing personal threads will be visible in the workspace to all workspace members unless: (a) the user makes those threads “private”, or (b) the user signs up to the workspace with a separate account under a separate email.

points.text: Private is not invisible to admins: private threads remain visible to workspace admins for workspace management purposes, and every admin access to a private thread is audit-logged.
points.text_zh: private 不等于对管理员不可见：private 线程对工作区管理员仍可见（用于工作区管理），且管理员每次访问 private 线程都会被审计记录。
points.quote: Private threads are still visible to workspace admins for workspace management purposes; all workspace admin access to private threads is audit-logged.

training.quote: Neither Amp nor our subprocessors train models on your data, unless you have explicitly opted into training.

points.text: 训练是 opt-in：官方写的是「除非你显式打开训练，否则 Amp 和它的分包商都不用你的数据训练模型」，开关在 User Settings。
points.text_zh: 训练是 opt-in：官方写的是「除非你显式打开训练，否则 Amp 和它的分包商都不用你的数据训练模型」，开关在 User Settings。

points.text: 例外是挂自己的 ChatGPT/Grok 订阅跑模型——那时走的是对方的消费级账号条款，Amp 的训练开关管不着，得去对方的 Data Controls 里单独关。
points.text_zh: 例外是挂自己的 ChatGPT/Grok 订阅跑模型——那时走的是对方的消费级账号条款，Amp 的训练开关管不着，得去对方的 Data Controls 里单独关。
points.quote: When Amp uses a personal ChatGPT or Grok subscription, the model provider’s consumer account terms and data controls apply. These controls are separate from Amp’s training setting, and Amp cannot change them for you.

Both facts are kept, and the mark stays yes on the security page.

points.quote: Audit logs are retained for a minimum of 30 days.

points.text: No controller/processor designation: none of the pages checked (privacy policy, security reference, minimal data retention, pricing) names Amp's role toward its users or customers. points.text: The direction is not settled in the text either way: the policy is written as Amp setting its own purposes (it lists the legal bases it relies on, including its own legitimate interests), which reads more like a controller posture than a processor one — but that is an inference from the framing, not a designation, so the kind is recorded as unknown and has to be confirmed in the contract.

points.quote: Providers may retain data when required by law, a court order, or a regulatory requirement.

KV cache / cached tokens are a separate object from Amp's thread data, and no period is given beyond "a limited period".
points.text_zh: 模型商侧的对象不只是提示词正文：官方写「Providers may store computational artifacts derived from prompts, such as key/value tensors or cached tokens, for a limited period. In this case, the provider does not persist the original prompt text after generating the response.」。KV 缓存/缓存 token 与 Amp 的 thread 数据是两个对象，期限只写了「a limited period」，没有具体天数。
points.quote: Providers may store computational artifacts derived from prompts, such as key/value tensors or cached tokens, for a limited period. In this case, the provider does not persist the original prompt text after generating the response.

retention.summary: 输入输出留至服务终止
retention.quote: When a thread is explicitly deleted, all data for that thread is removed within 30 days of thread deletion.

points.text: Account-level retention runs with the account: "Amp retains your information while your account is active." This is the account-data clock; it is not the same object as the 30-day thread-deletion window.
points.text_zh: 账号级保留随账号存续：「Amp retains your information while your account is active.」。这是账号信息的时钟，与线程删除后 30 天的窗口不是同一对象。
points.quote: Amp retains your information while your account is active.

points.text: Audit logs are a separate object from thread content, and their period is a floor: "Audit logs are retained for a minimum of 30 days." That is not a deadline for deleting inputs and outputs — the thread-deletion window is a different rule.
points.text_zh: 审计日志是与线程内容不同的对象，且期限是下限：「Audit logs are retained for a minimum of 30 days.」。这不等于输入输出在 30 天后删除——线程删除窗口是另一条规则。
points.quote: Audit logs are retained for a minimum of 30 days.

points.text: What that object is: structured application audit logs (timestamps, actor IDs, request details, event information) collected internally and monitored by Amp's security team, not exposed to Workspace Admins by default, but providable for Enterprise workspaces on request, for example during customer audits or incidents.
points.text_zh: 该对象的范围：结构化应用审计日志（时间戳、actor ID、request details、事件信息），由 Amp 安全团队内部收集与监控，默认不对工作区管理员开放，但企业工作区可按需调取（例如客户审计或事件调查）。
points.quote: Amp maintains comprehensive application audit logs for security and monitoring purposes. Logs are structured and include key fields such as timestamps, actor IDs, request details, and event information. These logs are collected internally and monitored by the Amp security team, but are not currently exposed to Workspace Admins. Application audit logs can be provided for Enterprise workspaces upon request, for example during customer audits or incidents.

points.text: Orb-side object: "Amp reuses a snapshot for at most 72 hours and then replaces it. Replaced snapshots are queued for deletion, but cannot be deleted until all orbs created from it have also been deleted - either by deleting threads, or removing a project." 72 hours is a reuse ceiling for project snapshots (cloned repository plus setup results), and deletion after replacement can be deferred until every orb derived from that snapshot is gone.
points.text_zh: Orb 侧对象：官方写「Amp reuses a snapshot for at most 72 hours and then replaces it. Replaced snapshots are queued for deletion, but cannot be deleted until all orbs created from it have also been deleted - either by deleting threads, or removing a project.」。72 小时是项目快照（克隆仓库 + setup 结果）的复用上限；替换后的删除会推迟到由该快照派生的 orb 全部消失为止。
points.quote: Amp reuses a snapshot for at most 72 hours and then replaces it. Replaced snapshots are queued for deletion, but cannot be deleted until all orbs created from it have also been deleted - either by deleting threads, or removing a project.

points.text: Orbs have no retention period of their own: "Amp does not offer a retention period for orbs that is separate from threads."
points.text_zh: Orb 没有独立保留期：官方写「Amp does not offer a retention period for orbs that is separate from threads.」。
points.quote: Amp does not offer a retention period for orbs that is separate from threads.

points.text: Deletion is not the end of retention: "After account deletion, Amp may retain information as needed to perform our contractual obligations, comply with tax, legal, and audit obligations, resolve disputes, preserve legal rights, or enforce our agreements. We retain sales inquiry records after account deletion because they are business correspondence. We keep them only as long as needed for sales follow-up, recordkeeping, legal and audit obligations, or resolving disputes." Read together with the 30-day window: that window covers thread content, while account information and sales correspondence can outlive it.
points.text_zh: 删除不等于全部信息即刻消失：官方写「After account deletion, Amp may retain information as needed to perform our contractual obligations, comply with tax, legal, and audit obligations, resolve disputes, preserve legal rights, or enforce our agreements. We retain sales inquiry records after account deletion because they are business correspondence. We keep them only as long as needed for sales follow-up, recordkeeping, legal and audit obligations, or resolving disputes.」。与 30 天窗口并读：窗口管的是线程内容，账号信息与销售往来记录可以更久。
points.quote: After account deletion, Amp may retain information as needed to perform our contractual obligations, comply with tax, legal, and audit obligations, resolve disputes, preserve legal rights, or enforce our agreements. We retain sales inquiry records after account deletion because they are business correspondence. We keep them only as long as needed for sales follow-up, recordkeeping, legal and audit obligations, or resolving disputes.

processing_region.quote: We store and process the information that we collect in the United States in accordance with this Privacy Policy, though our employees, contractors, and service providers may store and process data outside the United States.

points.text: No controller/processor designation: none of the pages checked (privacy policy, security reference, minimal data retention, pricing) names Amp's role toward its users or customers. The only instruction-based processing described belongs to Amp's service providers — the privacy policy says those vendors process Personal Information on Amp's instructions — which describes Amp directing its own suppliers, not Amp's role toward its customers.
points.text_zh: 没有角色指定：已核实四页（隐私政策、安全参考、Minimal Data Retention、定价页）都没有写明 Amp 相对用户/客户是控制者还是受托方。唯一出现「按指示处理」的是隐私政策描述 Amp 的服务提供者按 Amp 的指示处理个人信息——那是 Amp 指挥自己的供应商，不是 Amp 相对客户的角色。

points.text: The workspace relationship is not addressed: nothing in the pages checked states a data role between a workspace and its members. The only workspace-scoped statements are about Enterprise thread ownership and about thread visibility — not about who is controller or processor for member data.
points.text_zh: 工作区关系未约定：已核实文档没有表述工作区与其成员之间的数据角色；涉及工作区的表述只有企业档线程归属与线程可见范围，不涉及成员数据由谁控制。

points.text: The direction is not settled in the text either way: the policy is written as Amp setting its own purposes (it lists the legal bases it relies on, including its own legitimate interests), which reads more like a controller posture than a processor one — but that is an inference from the framing, not a designation, so the kind is recorded as unknown and has to be confirmed in the contract.
points.text_zh: 方向在原文里并未定死：隐私政策是按「Amp 自己设定处理目的」写的（它列出自己依赖的法律基础，含自身合法利益），读起来更像控制者而非受托方；但这是从行文推出的推断、不是角色指定，故 kind 记 unknown，需在合同层面确认。

points.text: Access context for workspace buyers (not a role finding): joining a workspace with the same account used for personal threads makes those existing threads visible to all workspace members, unless the user makes those threads private or signs up to the workspace with a separate account under a separate email.
points.text_zh: 工作区采购方关心的访问范围（不是角色判定）：用同一账号加入工作区后，此前创建的个人线程会对全体工作区成员可见，除非把这些线程设为 private，或改用另一个邮箱的独立账号加入。
points.quote: Note that when joining a workspace with the same account as an individual user has used to create personal threads, the user understands and acknowledges that existing personal threads will be visible in the workspace to all workspace members unless: (a) the user makes those threads “private”, or (b) the user signs up to the workspace with a separate account under a separate email.

points.text: Private is not invisible to admins: private threads remain visible to workspace admins for workspace management purposes, and every admin access to a private thread is audit-logged.
points.text_zh: private 不等于对管理员不可见：private 线程对工作区管理员仍可见（用于工作区管理），且管理员每次访问 private 线程都会被审计记录。
points.quote: Private threads are still visible to workspace admins for workspace management purposes; all workspace admin access to private threads is audit-logged.

training.quote: Sourcegraph and Sourcegraph Partner LLMs do not use your Code to train models.

zdr.quote: Sourcegraph Partner LLMs will **not** retain any Input, Output, or Candidate Context beyond the time it takes to generate the Output (**"Zero Retention"**), except that Partner LLMs may temporarily retain Inputs and Outputs solely for the purpose of detecting and preventing abuse or serious harm, and will not use such data for model training or any other purpose, provided that you access AI Tools through Sourcegraph's Partner LLMs.

points.text: The Zero Retention definition this yes rests on is updatable by Sourcegraph alone: it "may update this definition from time to time to reflect changes in Partner LLM retention practices by updating the 'last modified' date on this page", so the scope of this verdict follows whichever version of the page is in force at the time of reading.
points.text_zh: 本档 zdr=yes 所依赖的 Zero Retention 定义可由 Sourcegraph 单方更新：它「may update this definition from time to time to reflect changes in Partner LLM retention practices by updating the 'last modified' date on this page」，改页面 last modified 日期即生效。故该 yes 的适用范围随页面当时版本变动，采购时应按当时页面版本复核。
points.quote: Sourcegraph may update this definition from time to time to reflect changes in Partner LLM retention practices by updating the 'last modified' date on this page.

retention.quote: This Zero Retention obligation does not restrict Sourcegraph from storing or persisting Inputs or Outputs to enable the functionality of the AI Tools.

points.text: ZDR 只约束 Partner LLM；同一句明确不限制 Sourcegraph 为功能持久化输入输出，且没有给期限。
points.text_zh: ZDR 只约束 Partner LLM；同一句明确不限制 Sourcegraph 为功能持久化输入输出，且没有给期限。

points.text: Scope of this verdict: the AI Terms give no retention period of their own — the object here is Sourcegraph-side storage of the collected Customer Content (Inputs, Outputs, Candidate Context, Chat Transcripts, §4) under default operation — and §6 sends the processing of Customer Content to the Security Exhibit ("Sourcegraph will process Customer Content in accordance with the Security Exhibit", i.e. https://sourcegraph.com/terms/security). That document is not registered as a [[source]] in this file and has no snapshot, so basis=undisclosed rests on the AI Terms alone.
points.text_zh: 本条结论的范围：AI Terms 自己没有给保留期限——本档对象是 Sourcegraph 侧对已收集 Customer Content（Inputs、Outputs、Candidate Context、Chat Transcripts，§4）的存储，语境为默认运行——而 §6 把 Customer Content 的处理指向 Security Exhibit（「Sourcegraph will process Customer Content in accordance with the Security Exhibit」，即 https://sourcegraph.com/terms/security）。该文件未在本文件登记为 [[source]]、也没有快照，故 basis=undisclosed 只建立在 AI Terms 之上。
points.quote: Sourcegraph will process Customer Content in accordance with the Security Exhibit.

points.text: The AI Terms state no processing region; §6 sends the processing of Customer Content to the Security Exhibit (https://sourcegraph.com/terms/security), which is not registered as a [[source]] in this file and has no snapshot, so any location commitment has to be re-checked there.
points.text_zh: AI Terms 没有处理地表述；§6 把 Customer Content 的处理指向 Security Exhibit（https://sourcegraph.com/terms/security），该文件未在本文件登记为 [[source]]、也没有快照，任何处理地承诺都需在该文件抓回后复核。
points.quote: Sourcegraph will process Customer Content in accordance with the Security Exhibit.

points.text: Part of this path is customer-side: search runs on the SG instance, which the docs describe as "managed or self-hosted" — a self-hosted instance sits in the customer's own environment, so no vendor processing region governs that hop. The sentence covers the context-retrieval hop only; it says nothing about where model inference happens.
points.text_zh: 链路有一段在客户侧：检索在 SG 实例上完成，文档写明该实例「managed or self-hosted」；自托管即客户自有环境，这一跳不由厂商处理地决定。该句只覆盖上下文检索这一跳，没有交代模型推理在哪里处理。
points.quote: Queries are sent to the SG instance (managed or self-hosted), and search is done using the SG search stack.

points.text: No role is stated for this tier: the AI Terms only limit the purpose for which Customer Content is collected ("solely to provide the Service and not for product improvement purposes") and never call Sourcegraph a processor or the Customer a controller; §6 sends the processing of Customer Content to the Security Exhibit, and no DPA, Security Exhibit or other role-bearing contract is registered as a [[source]] in this file, so the processor role cannot be anchored.
points.text_zh: 本档没有角色表述：AI Terms 只限制 Customer Content 的收集用途（「solely to provide the Service and not for product improvement purposes」），全文没有把 Sourcegraph 写成 processor、也没有把 Customer 写成 controller；§6 把 Customer Content 的处理指向 Security Exhibit，而本文件没有登记 DPA、Security Exhibit 或任何含角色条款的合同来源，processor 角色无锚点可绑，故记未表态。
points.quote: Sourcegraph collects the following **Customer Content** solely to provide the Service and not for product improvement purposes:

training.quote: For individuals using Cody via Sourcegraph.com, Sourcegraph may use your prompts and responses to enhance the user experience, but Sourcegraph does not use any of your data to train models.

points.text: Same sentence, second fact: for individuals using Cody via Sourcegraph.com the prompts and responses may also be used "to enhance the user experience" — a use that goes beyond providing the service, and its object is this tier's inputs and outputs. The no-training half is explicit in the same sentence ("does not use any of your data to train models"), which is why the mark stays yes; the improvement-use authorisation is kept beside it as a separate fact.
points.text_zh: 同一句的第二件事：Sourcegraph.com 个人档的 prompts 与 responses 还可被用于「enhance the user experience」（改进用户体验），这是超出「提供服务」的用途授权，对象就是本档的输入输出。同句后半段明确把模型训练排除（does not use any of your data to train models），故 mark 仍记 yes——判 yes 要求的是有明确把模型训练挡在外面的表述，这里满足；而「可用于改进用户体验」这条授权按台账口径「用来改进服务算训练」是 training 维度上的并列负面事实，一并保留。
points.quote: For individuals using Cody via Sourcegraph.com, Sourcegraph may use your prompts and responses to enhance the user experience, but Sourcegraph does not use any of your data to train models.

retention.quote: When you use Cody, Sourcegraph collects your prompts and responses to provide the service.

points.text: What this anchor supports is the object, not a period: it says which data is collected (prompts and responses, on default use of Cody) and contains no period or deletion statement. docs/cody sends the detail to a separate Cody Usage and Privacy policy, which is not registered as a [[source]] in this file and has no snapshot of its own, so the period is recorded as undisclosed — a sourcing gap, not a vendor denial that a period exists.
points.text_zh: 锚点句支撑的是对象而不是期限：它只说收集哪些数据（个人档的 prompts 与 responses，默认使用 Cody 时），没有期限或删除表述。docs/cody 把细节指向独立的 Cody Usage and Privacy policy，该文档未在本文件登记为 [[source]]、也没有独立快照，故期限按未披露记（对象=输入输出正文、语境=默认、期限类型=未披露）——这是溯源缺口，不是厂商否认存在保留期限。
points.quote: Read more about Cody Usage and Privacy policy here

points.text: Part of this path is customer-side: context retrieval runs on the SG instance, which the docs describe as "managed or self-hosted" — a self-hosted instance is the customer's own environment, so no Sourcegraph processing region governs that hop. The sentence covers the context-retrieval hop only; it says nothing about where model inference happens.
points.text_zh: 链路有一段在客户侧：上下文检索在 SG 实例上完成，文档写明该实例「managed or self-hosted」——自托管即客户自有环境，这一跳不由 Sourcegraph 的处理地决定。该句只覆盖上下文检索这一跳，没有交代模型推理在哪里处理。
points.quote: Queries are sent to the SG instance (managed or self-hosted), and search is done using the SG search stack.

points.text: For this tier the handling detail is delegated to the linked Cody Usage and Privacy policy, which has no snapshot in this repository; none of the documents held here states a processing region for individuals using Cody via Sourcegraph.com.
points.text_zh: 个人档的处理细节被指向同页链接的 Cody Usage and Privacy policy，该文档在本仓库没有快照；本仓库持有的文档里，Sourcegraph.com 个人档没有任何处理地表述。
points.quote: Read more about Cody Usage and Privacy policy here

role.quote: Sourcegraph may use your prompts and responses to enhance the user experience

points.text: The role reading for this tier rests on purpose determination rather than on a role label: Sourcegraph itself decides what is done with individual prompts and responses ("may use your prompts and responses to enhance the user experience"), i.e. processing for its own purposes and not only on the user's instruction. The service-only wording of the AI Terms is scoped to Customers and does not cover individuals on Sourcegraph.com.
points.text_zh: 个人档的角色读法依据的是用途决定权而不是角色标签：Sourcegraph 可自行决定个人档 prompts 与 responses 的用途（「may use your prompts and responses to enhance the user experience」），即为自身目的处理，而不是只按用户指示处理。AI Terms 里「solely to provide the Service」那套用途限制的适用对象是 Customer，不覆盖 Sourcegraph.com 个人档。

points.text: 不支持零保留（value=no，复核轮重写判断链）：①决定性＝官方 API 文档《Prompt 缓存最佳实践》——平台缓存「每次请求过程中的输入」，「完整的对话数组…System Prompt、User Message 以及 Assistant Message」进入缓存系统（图片、视频、工具调用及其结果同列）
points.text_zh: 不支持零保留（value=no，复核轮重写判断链）：①决定性＝官方 API 文档《Prompt 缓存最佳实践》——平台缓存「每次请求过程中的输入」，「完整的对话数组…System Prompt、User Message 以及 Assistant Message」进入缓存系统（图片、视频、工具调用及其结果同列）

points.text: Exception to that deletion commitment (privacy policy §4.2): the sentence on deletion or anonymisation after cancellation, voluntary deletion or expiry of the necessary period is followed verbatim by "但以下情况除外" — (1) "遵从法律法规有关信息留存的要求" and (2) "出于财务、审计、争议解决等目的需要合理延长期限的". Neither exception is quantified, so the deletion side has no fixed upper bound
points.text_zh: §四.2 删除承诺的例外：『如果您注销账户、主动删除个人信息或超出必要的期限后，我们将对您的个人信息进行删除或匿名化处理，但以下情况除外』——(1)『遵从法律法规有关信息留存的要求』、(2)『出于财务、审计、争议解决等目的需要合理延长期限的』。两条例外均未量化期限，删除侧因此没有固定上限，读者不得据 §四.2 推出「超期必删」

遵从法律法规有关信息留存的要求。
- 出于财务、审计、争议解决等目的需要合理延长期限的

points.text: Even where a deletion request stands, §6.4 closes with a fallback: "法律、行政法规规定的保存期限未届满，或者删除个人信息从技术上难以实现的，我们会停止除存储和采取必要的安全保护措施之外的处理" — the data may end up in a store-and-isolate state (storage plus necessary security measures only). This is not the same as deleted
points.text_zh: §六.4 段末兜底：删除请求成立也不等于数据已消失——『法律、行政法规规定的保存期限未届满，或者删除个人信息从技术上难以实现的，我们会停止除存储和采取必要的安全保护措施之外的处理』，即数据可转为「仅存储 + 必要的安全保护措施」的隔离状态，不得读成「已删除」
points.quote: 法律、行政法规规定的保存期限未届满，或者删除个人信息从技术上难以实现的，我们会停止除存储和采取必要的安全保护措施之外的处理

points.text: Contract-layer deletion trigger (userservice §1.1.4): "未按约定支付相应的服务费用的，我们有权单方面不经通知暂停或终止提供服务，并删除您在本平台上所有的非法律法规要求的全部数据等" — on non-payment the platform has a right, not a duty, to delete data other than what laws and regulations require, without notice
points.text_zh: 合同层删除触发（用户协议 §1.1.4）：『未按约定支付相应的服务费用的，我们有权单方面不经通知暂停或终止提供服务，并删除您在本平台上所有的非法律法规要求的全部数据等』。措辞是「平台有权」而非删除义务，且范围限于「非法律法规要求的」数据，不得写成「欠费即删除全部数据」
points.quote: 我们有权单方面不经通知暂停或终止提供服务，并删除您在本平台上所有的非法律法规要求的全部数据等

points.text: Object-level clause running parallel to the §4.2 deletion commitment (userservice §2.3.4): after an account is reclaimed or cancelled the platform still "仍有权：1）保留相关行为记录，但涉及个人信息的除外（如有）" — behavioural records may be retained, personal information excepted. The agreement does not define what counts as 行为记录
points.text_zh: 与 §四.2 删除承诺并列的对象层条款（用户协议 §2.3.4）：账户被收回或者注销后平台『仍有权：1）保留相关行为记录，但涉及个人信息的除外（如有）』——行为记录仍可保留，个人信息除外。协议未定义「行为记录」的范围
points.quote: 保留相关行为记录，但涉及个人信息的除外

points.text: Object: a cache copy of the request body. 《Prompt 缓存最佳实践》 — "完整的对话数组会进入到缓存系统当中，其中包含 System Prompt、User Message 以及 Assistant Message" (images, videos, tool-call information and results are listed alongside); caching is automatic above 256 tokens. This copy sits outside the §4.2 "necessary period for your personal information" wording
points.text_zh: 对象：请求正文的缓存副本。《Prompt 缓存最佳实践》逐字『完整的对话数组会进入到缓存系统当中，其中包含 System Prompt、User Message 以及 Assistant Message』（图片、视频、工具调用信息及其结果同列），请求超 256 Token 自动进入。该副本不受 §四.2「为提供本平台相关服务之目的所必需的期间」表述约束
points.quote: 完整的对话数组会进入到缓存系统当中，其中包含 System Prompt、User Message 以及 Assistant Message

points.text: Term type for that copy: unquantified and with no upper bound. The only time clue on the page is "缓存淘汰采用最近最少使用（LRU）策略，在系统请求高峰期，不使用的缓存会更容易被逐出；在系统请求低峰期，缓存则会拥有更长的生命周期" — eviction floats with system load; there is no TTL, so no number of days may be written from it
points.text_zh: 该副本的期限类型：无量化、无上限。唯一期限线索是『缓存淘汰采用最近最少使用（LRU）策略，在系统请求高峰期，不使用的缓存会更容易被逐出；在系统请求低峰期，缓存则会拥有更长的生命周期』——淘汰随系统负载浮动，全页无 TTL，不得据此写天数
points.quote: 缓存淘汰采用最近最少使用（LRU）策略，在系统请求高峰期，不使用的缓存会更容易被逐出；在系统请求低峰期，缓存则会拥有更长的生命周期。

points.text: Customer-side control over that copy: "目前不提供手动清除缓存的能力" — no purge API and no switch; the only way to avoid the cache is to change the Prompt. Server-side LRU eviction still applies, so this must not be written as "kept forever"
points.text_zh: 客户侧对缓存副本无控制手段：『目前不提供手动清除缓存的能力』，没有清除接口也没有关闭开关，唯一规避方式是修改 Prompt；服务端仍有 LRU 淘汰，故也不得写成「永久保留」
points.quote: 目前不提供手动清除缓存的能力

So the processing region of that entrusted hop is not disclosed

points.text: §6.5 自用授权 + §5.4 数据权属 + 隐私政策以自身为个人信息处理者 → independent controller
points.text_zh: §6.5 自用授权 + §5.4 数据权属 + 隐私政策以自身为个人信息处理者 → independent controller

points.text: 客户对最终用户个人信息另负处理者义务（§6.2）。
points.text_zh: 客户对最终用户个人信息另负处理者义务（§6.2）。

points.text: Entrusted-processing chain (privacy policy §3.2): "我们将必要信息委托给支持我们业务的合作伙伴处理，这些支持包括受我们委托提供的产品代码和数据的服务器部署以及数据库存储服务、短信发送服务、内容安全审核服务" — the platform is the entrusting party and hands necessary information to partners; content-safety review is among the listed tasks, so request content may be processed by third parties. The sentence is a list of entrusted tasks, not a statement that third parties necessarily read request bodies, so the hedge 可能 must be kept
points.text_zh: 委托链条（隐私政策 §三.2）：『我们将必要信息委托给支持我们业务的合作伙伴处理，这些支持包括受我们委托提供的产品代码和数据的服务器部署以及数据库存储服务、短信发送服务、内容安全审核服务』——平台是委托方，把必要信息交给合作伙伴处理；列举项含内容安全审核，故正文可能被第三方处理。该句是委托事项清单，不能据此写成「确定有第三方读取正文」，引用时保留「可能」这一 hedge。平台在此链条中仍是委托方（个人信息处理者一侧），与上面 §6.5/§5.4 的自身处理者结论并列
points.quote: 我们将必要信息委托给支持我们业务的合作伙伴处理，这些支持包括受我们委托提供的产品代码和数据的服务器部署以及数据库存储服务、短信发送服务、内容安全审核服务

training.quote: For the avoidance of doubt, the license granted herein specifically includes the right to use Usage Data for training, fine-tuning, and otherwise improving StepFun’s artificial intelligence models and systems.

points.text: ToS §4.1(ii) 与 §1.4 的明示训练授权以参与 StepFun Startup Program / Early Access 等项目为前提(§4.4 亦称 in certain programs)
points.text_zh: ToS §4.1(ii) 与 §1.4 的明示训练授权以参与 StepFun Startup Program / Early Access 等项目为前提(§4.4 亦称 in certain programs)

points.text: §8.1 免责声明另载明服务「MAY BE IMPROVED THROUGH THE USE OF USAGE DATA FOR MODEL TRAINING AND FINE-TUNING」,未限定项目。隐私政策 §1.3 同向:特定项目下 API 的 Prompts/Outputs/API call logs 可被保留并用于训练、微调,此时 StepFun 自认 controller
points.text_zh: §8.1 免责声明另载明服务「MAY BE IMPROVED THROUGH THE USE OF USAGE DATA FOR MODEL TRAINING AND FINE-TUNING」,未限定项目。隐私政策 §1.3 同向:特定项目下 API 的 Prompts/Outputs/API call logs 可被保留并用于训练、微调,此时 StepFun 自认 controller

points.text: ToS §4.1(iv) applies to every platform customer and is not conditioned on any program: “We may also use Content to provide, maintain, develop and improve our Services, comply with applicable laws, enforce our Terms, and ensure the security of our Services.” Content is defined in §4 as Prompts, Outputs and Feedback, so this is an unconditional statement that inputs and outputs may be used to develop and improve the Services — training under the “improving the service counts as training” rule, and a side indication for zdr that StepFun keeps the power to use Content.
points.text_zh: ToS §4.1(iv)（不限定项目、适用于全部平台客户）：「We may also use Content to provide, maintain, develop and improve our Services, comply with applicable laws, enforce our Terms, and ensure the security of our Services.」§4 定义 Content 含 Prompts、Outputs 与 Feedback，故这是「用输入输出开发与改进服务」的无条件表述；按 judgment.md「用来改进服务算训练」，它是本档 mark=no 最直接的无条件依据，同时也是厂商保留 use Content 权能（zdr 旁证）。
points.quote: We may also use Content to provide, maintain, develop and improve our Services, comply with applicable laws, enforce our Terms, and ensure the security of our Services.

points.text: The only route the ToS offers out of the §4.4 training authorisation is not to take part: “If you do not consent to the use of your Usage Data for AI training purposes, you should not participate in that program or should contact us to discuss alternative arrangements.” There is no self-serve opt-out in this tier — the authorisation travels with program participation.
points.text_zh: §4.4 末句给出训练条款附带的唯一退路：「If you do not consent to the use of your Usage Data for AI training purposes, you should not participate in that program or should contact us to discuss alternative arrangements.」——不接受训练就不要参加该项目，或联系厂商另议。档内没有自助 opt-out，训练授权随项目参与绑定。
points.quote: If you do not consent to the use of your Usage Data for AI training purposes, you should not participate in that program or should contact us to discuss alternative arrangements.

points.text: Privacy Policy §2 lists as a general purpose “To evaluate and improve our models, products, and services, where permitted by applicable law.” — a purpose statement that is not tied to any program, on the controller side where StepFun sets the purposes.
points.text_zh: 隐私政策 §2 的一般用途清单载明「To evaluate and improve our models, products, and services, where permitted by applicable law.」——不以参与任何项目为前提，属 StepFun 自任控制者一侧的用途声明。
points.quote: To evaluate and improve our models, products, and services, where permitted by applicable law.

points.text: The §12 legal basis table maps that purpose to the object “End Users’ Interaction Information” with the basis “Consent & Legitimate interests”, and §1.3(b) defines End Users’ Interaction Information to include API input data (text, images, voice messages). It sits in tension with the scope statement at the top of the same Policy (§1.3: in the processor scenario the commercial customer is the controller), so both facts are kept side by side.
points.text_zh: 同一政策 §12 法律依据表把该目的的对象写作 End Users’ Interaction Information、依据写作 Consent & Legitimate interests，而 §1.3(b) 说明该信息含 API 输入（文本、图片、语音）。它与政策开头的范围声明存在内在张力（§1.3：受托场景下由商业客户担任 controller），故两条事实并列保留。
points.quote: To evaluate and improve our models, products, and services

retention.summary: 按对象分列留至服务终止
retention.quote: Within 30 days of termination or expiration of the Agreement, StepFun will:

points.text: DPA §7 — object: all Customer Data, including Customer Personal Data; context: termination or expiration of the Agreement; the 30 days bounds the return/deletion step, it is not a retention period inside the service term, and deletion is not deferred to day 30 (the Customer may request a return or use self-service deletion within that window).
points.text_zh: DPA §7:对象＝全部 Customer Data（含 Customer Personal Data）；语境＝协议终止或到期后；「30 天内」是返还/删除这一履行动作的上限，不是服务期内的保留期限，也不是「第 30 天才删」（客户可在该窗口内要求返还或自助删除）。
points.quote: Within 30 days of termination or expiration of the Agreement, StepFun will:

points.text: The same §7 deletion obligation carries three exceptions: storage required by applicable law or regulatory requirements, retention necessary to resolve a dispute between the parties, and retention necessary to combat harmful use of the Services.
points.text_zh: 同一删除义务带三类例外：适用法或监管要求要求存储、解决当事方之间的争议所必需、打击服务的有害使用所必需。
points.quote:
applicable law or regulatory requirements require storage
- retention is necessary to resolve a dispute between the parties
- retention is necessary to combat harmful use of the Services

points.text: The contract layer gives no number of days inside the service term. Schedule 1 Part B records “Duration and frequency of processing: continuous for the duration of the Agreement, as determined by Customer’s configuration of the Services” — processing, and therefore retention, lasts at least as long as the Agreement.
points.text_zh: 合同层没有服务期内的保留天数:Schedule 1 Part B 记「Duration and frequency of processing: continuous for the duration of the Agreement, as determined by Customer’s configuration of the Services」——处理（因而保留）至少持续整个协议期。
points.quote: continuous for the duration of the Agreement, as determined by Customer’s configuration of the Services

points.text: Schedule 1 Part B “Storage limitation: compliance with legal retention requirements under applicable law” — the storage limitation points only to statutory retention requirements and sets no service-term day count. The DPA therefore cannot be read as “inputs/outputs, cache and logs are kept for 30 days”.
points.text_zh: Schedule 1 Part B「Storage limitation: compliance with legal retention requirements under applicable law」——存储限制只指向适用法下的法定保留要求,未给服务期内的天数。故本档不能读成「输入输出/缓存/日志保留 30 天」。
points.quote: compliance with legal retention requirements under applicable law

points.text: §2 另禁止将 Customer Personal Data 用于业务目的之外的保留。隐私政策 §7 为通用最小化原则（电话号码持续保留、IP 3 年、注销即删除或匿名化）。
points.text_zh: §2 另禁止将 Customer Personal Data 用于业务目的之外的保留。隐私政策 §7 为通用最小化原则（电话号码持续保留、IP 3 年、注销即删除或匿名化）。
points.quote: We adhere to retention policies for the personal information we collect to ensure that it is not retained longer than necessary for the intended purpose, for example:

points.text: Deletion on account closure is not absolute: the Privacy Policy §7 rule “If you deactivate your account, delete personal information, or the retention period is expired, we will delete or anonymize your personal information, except in the following cases:” is followed by two exceptions — compliance with legal retention requirements, and extension of the period for financial, audit, dispute resolution, or other legitimate purposes. Together with the three DPA §7 exceptions there is no absolute “delete at expiry” commitment in this tier.
points.text_zh: 注销/到期即删不是绝对承诺：隐私政策 §7 的「If you deactivate your account, delete personal information, or the retention period is expired, we will delete or anonymize your personal information, except in the following cases:」后接两条例外——适用法下的法定保留要求、为财务/审计/争议解决或其他正当目的延长保留期。与 DPA §7 的三类例外叠加后，本档没有任何「到期必删」的绝对承诺。
points.quote:
If you deactivate your account, delete personal information, or the retention period is expired, we will delete or anonymize your personal information, except in the following cases:
- Compliance with legal requirements regarding data retention according to the applicable laws.
- Extension of the period for financial, audit, dispute resolution, or other legitimate purposes.

points.text: Cache object: the prompt-cache page says caching activates automatically above 256 tokens, publishes no TTL, and lets eviction float with load — “Eviction uses LRU: during peak traffic, unused cache entries are evicted more aggressively; off-peak they live longer.”
points.text_zh: 缓存对象:prompt-cache 页说明请求超过 256 token 自动开启缓存、未公布 TTL、淘汰随负载浮动——「Eviction uses LRU: during peak traffic, unused cache entries are evicted more aggressively; off-peak they live longer.」
points.quote: Eviction uses LRU: during peak traffic, unused cache entries are evicted more aggressively; off-peak they live longer.

points.text: The only hint at a cache lifetime is the troubleshooting item “Verify calls are not spaced so far apart that the cache expires.” No number of days is given, and the page does not say whether the cached content is the original request text or a derived state.

points.text: Contract-grade support, stated as a scope inference rather than an explicit no-training wording: ToS §4.4 + §1.4 + the second paragraph of §4.1(ii) condition the training/fine-tuning license on participation in the StepFun Startup Program / Builder Program / early access projects, and Privacy Policy §1.3(b) points the same way. judgment.md asks for wording that keeps model training out; these clauses only bound the training right to programs, so mark = "yes" rests on that scope plus the tier-specific FAQ above.

The sibling entry providers/stepfun-ai.toml marks the API tier training = "no" on this same sentence.

zdr.quote: 完整的对话数组会进入到缓存系统当中，其中包含 System Prompt、User Message 以及 Assistant Message

points.text:
结论：不支持零保留（本档无 ZDR 选项/开关/申请入口，且客户请求正文会被平台跨请求留存）。本轮按「读，不要匹」重审，逐条写成「这条说的是 X，所以 Y」：
①【决定性】《Prompt 缓存最佳实践》（guides/developer 下的通用开发者文档，页内无档位限定）——「这条说的是：平台提供上下文缓存技术，把『每次请求过程中的输入』缓存起来，可缓存内容逐字包含『完整的对话数组会进入到缓存系统当中，其中包含 System Prompt、User Message 以及 Assistant Message』（图片、视频、工具调用信息及其结果同列），所以：客户提交的请求正文会进入平台缓存系统并被跨请求复用，零保留在平台侧不成立」。对象＝请求正文（System Prompt / User Message / Assistant Message、图片、视频、工具调用结果）。
②同页「如果未命中系统的缓存，系统将会进行正常的推理并在处理完成后，将 Prompt 前缀进行缓存，以供下次请求使用」——「这条说的是：响应返回之后 Prompt 前缀仍被写入缓存，所以：留存不是『为完成单次请求的短暂缓存』，而是处理完成之后的留存」。
③同页「当请求超过 256 个 Token 时，缓存会自动启用」——「这条说的是：缓存按请求长度自动开启、无客户侧 opt-in，所以：客户无法通过公开配置关掉这条留存路径」。
④同页「缓存淘汰采用最近最少使用（LRU）策略…高峰期更容易被逐出；低峰期拥有更长的生命周期」——「这条说的是：生命周期由系统负载决定，全页没有任何 TTL 天数，所以：既推不出保留上限，也不能据此写 retention 期限」。
⑤同页 FAQ「目前不提供手动清除缓存的能力。您可以通过修改 Prompt 来使请求不命中缓存」——「这条说的是：客户侧没有清除缓存的操作（唯一规避手段是改 Prompt），所以：客户无法删除已写入缓存的内容」。注意这句是**客户侧**能力（无清除接口/开关），不是『平台永不删除』——服务端仍有 LRU 淘汰，故不据此写成「永久保留」。

①【决定性】《Prompt 缓存最佳实践》（guides/developer 下的通用开发者文档，页内无档位限定）——「这条说的是：平台提供上下文缓存技术，把『每次请求过程中的输入』缓存起来，可缓存内容逐字包含『完整的对话数组会进入到缓存系统当中，其中包含 System Prompt、User Message 以及 Assistant Message』（图片、视频、工具调用信息及其结果同列），所以：客户提交的请求正文会进入平台缓存系统并被跨请求复用，零保留在平台侧不成立」。对象＝请求正文（System Prompt / User Message / Assistant Message、图片、视频、工具调用结果）。
②同页「如果未命中系统的缓存，系统将会进行正常的推理并在处理完成后，将 Prompt 前缀进行缓存，以供下次请求使用」——「这条说的是：响应返回之后 Prompt 前缀仍被写入缓存，所以：留存不是『为完成单次请求的短暂缓存』，而是处理完成之后的留存」。
③同页「当请求超过 256 个 Token 时，缓存会自动启用」——「这条说的是：缓存按请求长度自动开启、无客户侧 opt-in，所以：客户无法通过公开配置关掉这条留存路径」。
④同页「缓存淘汰采用最近最少使用（LRU）策略…高峰期更容易被逐出；低峰期拥有更长的生命周期」——「这条说的是：生命周期由系统负载决定，全页没有任何 TTL 天数，所以：既推不出保留上限，也不能据此写 retention 期限」。
⑤同页 FAQ「目前不提供手动清除缓存的能力。您可以通过修改 Prompt 来使请求不命中缓存」——「这条说的是：客户侧没有清除缓存的操作（唯一规避手段是改 Prompt），所以：客户无法删除已写入缓存的内容」。注意这句是**客户侧**能力（无清除接口/开关），不是『平台永不删除』——服务端仍有 LRU 淘汰，故不据此写成「永久保留」。

points.text:
Step Plan 推理模型接入页逐字「计费逻辑与开放平台一致，最终按开放平台实际计费金额折算为 Step Plan 总额度消耗」，而开放平台计费逻辑（定价与限速页）含『输入价格（缓存命中）/（缓存未命中）』两档——所以缓存随计费逻辑一并适用于本档。该页响应字段 prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens（『提示信息中命中缓存的 token 数量』）在同页两处出现、上下文相同，无法唯一定位，故不单列锚点，仅作接口面同一性的旁证。档位覆盖仍是跨页推导，官方没有一句『本档启用缓存』，故 confidence=medium。
⑦合同层佐证：用户协议 §5.3（锚点 zdr-content-license-includes-storage）——「这条说的是：对『您发布上传或传输的内容』，客户授予平台一项含『存储、使用、复制、修订、编辑』的许可使用（目的含『提升大模型服务体验』），所以：合同层不但没有『不留存』承诺，反而给了含存储的许可」。标的范围靠同协议回指确定：§2.1.3 定义「您或您的最终用户基于本服务输入的文字、图片、音频、视频等内容（输入内容）」，§4.3 用同一组动词描述最终用户提交内容（『上传、发布或者传输的内容』），§6.4「您使用本服务时，向我们传输的任何信息」——即 §5.3 的对象含客户经服务提交的内容（请求正文）。**但这是知识产权章的许可授予（平台『可以』做什么），不是平台实际留存行为的披露，也没有期限或删除义务**，故只作佐证、不作决定性依据（本轮已把该锚点 exact 换成自带对象的整句）。
⑧删除侧（锚点 retention-termination-deletion-right）：用户协议 §3.6「这条说的是：平台『有权』在服务终止后或『我们与您另行约定的保留期限（如有）』届满后删除『您存储在我们服务中的数据等任何信息』，所以：这是删除权而非删除义务、期限写作『如有』，公开条款里没有请求级即时删除或 ZDR 承诺」。
反向检索（读完整页，不靠关键词）：本档全部可抓文档——用户协议、隐私政策、StepPlan 付费服务协议、管理规则及公约、企业 Credit 协议、faq/common-questions、step-plan 概述/升级公告/快速开始/各工具接入页、Chat Completions 与 Messages API 参考、定价与限速——逐篇读过，**没有**「不存储」「处理完成后不保留」「不会留存」这类相反表述
