retention.quote: 我们仅在为提供本平台相关服务之目的所必需的期间内保留您的个人信息

points.text: 对象与期限分三层：①个人信息（含账号、输入信息与输出信息）——隐私政策 四.2『仅在为提供本平台相关服务之目的所必需的期间内保留您的个人信息』，注销/主动删除/超期后删除或匿名化，例外为法律法规留存要求与财务审计争议解决延长；另有 六.4 段末一条更硬的例外（见下条），两条合起来意味着删除侧没有固定上限
points.text_zh: 对象与期限分三层：①个人信息（含账号、输入信息与输出信息）——隐私政策 四.2『仅在为提供本平台相关服务之目的所必需的期间内保留您的个人信息』，注销/主动删除/超期后删除或匿名化，例外为法律法规留存要求与财务审计争议解决延长；另有 六.4 段末一条更硬的例外（见下条），两条合起来意味着删除侧没有固定上限
points.quote: 遵从法律法规有关信息留存的要求

points.text: Harder exception on the deletion side (privacy policy §6.4, closing sentence): "法律、行政法规规定的保存期限未届满，或者删除个人信息从技术上难以实现的，我们会停止除存储和采取必要的安全保护措施之外的处理" — even where a deletion request stands, the data may end up in a store-and-isolate state (storage plus necessary security measures only), which is not the same as deleted. This is the exception that fixes the real boundary of the deletion right; its subject is still 您的个人信息, so it must not be extended to API request bodies
points.text_zh: 删除侧更硬的一条例外（隐私政策 六.4 段末）：『法律、行政法规规定的保存期限未届满，或者删除个人信息从技术上难以实现的，我们会停止除存储和采取必要的安全保护措施之外的处理』——删除请求成立也不等于数据已消失，可转为「仅存储 + 必要的安全保护措施」的隔离状态。该句主语仍是『您的个人信息』，不得据此扩大到 API 请求正文
points.quote: 法律、行政法规规定的保存期限未届满，或者删除个人信息从技术上难以实现的，我们会停止除存储和采取必要的安全保护措施之外的处理

points.text: 未量化天数，属『下限/必要期间』而非上限。②API 输入正文——开发者文档《Prompt 缓存最佳实践》：对话数组（System/User/Assistant）、图片、视频进入缓存系统，按 LRU 淘汰，高峰期更易逐出、低峰期生命周期更长，无期限承诺、无关闭开关
points.text_zh: 未量化天数，属『下限/必要期间』而非上限。②API 输入正文——开发者文档《Prompt 缓存最佳实践》：对话数组（System/User/Assistant）、图片、视频进入缓存系统，按 LRU 淘汰，高峰期更易逐出、低峰期生命周期更长，无期限承诺、无关闭开关

points.text: A third class of persistent copy derived from conversation content (privacy policy §1.3 个性化能力): "我们会根据与您的对话记录，总结并形成对您的相关记忆（如您的工作习惯、偏好），以便模型参考对您的相关记忆，向您输出更适合您、更符合您需求的回答" — 相关记忆 is summarised from the conversation record and persists, so it stands alongside the cache copy and the 个人信息 necessary-period wording instead of being a sub-item of the cache. Scope: "本平台中的部分服务" (the conversational service surface), not a Step Plan API channel mechanism; the same paragraph says the user can view, edit or delete the memory or switch the memory feature off, so this is recorded as an object/context note and must not raise or lower this tier's verdict
points.text_zh: 第三类由对话内容派生的持久副本（隐私政策 一.3 个性化能力）：『我们会根据与您的对话记录，总结并形成对您的相关记忆（如您的工作习惯、偏好），以便模型参考对您的相关记忆，向您输出更适合您、更符合您需求的回答』——「相关记忆」由对话记录总结生成并长期存在，与缓存副本、个人信息必要期间并列，不是缓存的一条子项。适用服务范围：『本平台中的部分服务』（对话式服务面），不是 Step Plan API 通道的机制；同段写明用户可查看、编辑、删除记忆或关闭记忆功能，故只作对象/语境补录，不据此加重或减轻本档判定
points.quote: 我们会根据与您的对话记录，总结并形成对您的相关记忆（如您的工作习惯、偏好），以便模型参考对您的相关记忆，向您输出更适合您、更符合您需求的回答

points.text: 该副本不受 四.2『个人信息』期限表述约束。③服务终止后——用户协议 3.6 平台『有权在服务终止后或在我们与您另行约定的保留期限（如有）届满后，删除上述信息』，为权利而非义务，且保留期限『如有』，未量化。日志类：隐私政策 一.8 收集设备与日志信息（IP、操作时间、服务日志等），期限适用 四.2 一般规则，无单独期限。
points.text_zh: 该副本不受 四.2『个人信息』期限表述约束。③服务终止后——用户协议 3.6 平台『有权在服务终止后或在我们与您另行约定的保留期限（如有）届满后，删除上述信息』，为权利而非义务，且保留期限『如有』，未量化。日志类：隐私政策 一.8 收集设备与日志信息（IP、操作时间、服务日志等），期限适用 四.2 一般规则，无单独期限。
points.quote: 我们有权在服务终止后或在我们与您另行约定的保留期限（如有）届满后，删除上述信息

points.text: A second deletion context, triggered by non-payment (userservice §1.1.4): "未按约定支付相应的服务费用的，我们有权单方面不经通知暂停或终止提供服务，并删除您在本平台上所有的非法律法规要求的全部数据等" — non-payment alone lets the platform unilaterally and without notice delete 非法律法规要求的全部数据. Trigger and scope both differ from §3.6 (deletion after termination or after an agreed retention period); it is likewise a right, not a duty, so it must not be written as 欠费即删除全部数据
points.text_zh: ③-b 另一种删除语境，触发条件是欠费（用户协议 1.1.4）：『未按约定支付相应的服务费用的，我们有权单方面不经通知暂停或终止提供服务，并删除您在本平台上所有的非法律法规要求的全部数据等』——欠费即可被单方、不经通知地删除平台上「非法律法规要求的全部数据」，触发条件与删除口径都不同于 3.6 的服务终止后依约定期限删除；同样是权利而非义务，不得写成「欠费即删除全部数据」
points.quote: 我们有权单方面不经通知暂停或终止提供服务，并删除您在本平台上所有的非法律法规要求的全部数据等

points.text: An object that 注销后删除 does not cover (userservice §2.2.4): after an account is reclaimed or cancelled the platform 仍有权：1）"保留相关行为记录，但涉及个人信息的除外"（如有）— behavioural records may survive deactivation, and the 涉及个人信息的除外 carve-out must be read with the clause or it reads as unlimited retention. The object is account-level behavioural records, not API request bodies; the agreement does not define the scope of 行为记录
points.text_zh: ③-c 注销后删除覆盖不到的一类对象（用户协议 2.2.4）：账户被收回或者注销后平台『仍有权：1）保留相关行为记录，但涉及个人信息的除外（如有）』——「注销后删除」不覆盖行为记录，同时「涉及个人信息的除外」这一限定必须一并写出，否则会读成无限保留。对象是账户维度的行为记录，不是 API 请求正文；协议未定义「行为记录」的范围
points.quote: 保留相关行为记录，但涉及个人信息的除外

processing_region.quote: 我们依照法律法规的规定，将在境内运营过程中收集和产生的您的个人信息存储于中华人民共和国境内

points.text: 隐私政策 四.1 前段：『我们依照法律法规的规定，将在境内运营过程中收集和产生的您的个人信息存储于中华人民共和国境内』。codes=[CN] 的标的就是这句里的『您的个人信息』——境内运营过程中收集和产生的个人信息，存储地不等于全部 API 输入输出的处理地；条款主语限定为『您的个人信息』，对 API 输入输出等非个人信息数据未作同等地域声明，故置信度 medium。协议族内无多区域/处理地选项；同段后半句另留跨境传输开口（见下条）
points.text_zh: 隐私政策 四.1 前段：『我们依照法律法规的规定，将在境内运营过程中收集和产生的您的个人信息存储于中华人民共和国境内』。codes=[CN] 的标的就是这句里的『您的个人信息』——境内运营过程中收集和产生的个人信息，存储地不等于全部 API 输入输出的处理地；条款主语限定为『您的个人信息』，对 API 输入输出等非个人信息数据未作同等地域声明，故置信度 medium。协议族内无多区域/处理地选项；同段后半句另留跨境传输开口（见下条）

points.text: The same paragraph then leaves cross-border transfer open (privacy policy §4.1): "目前，我们不会将上述信息传输至境外，如果我们向境外传输，会严格遵守中国的相关法律、监管政策，并会遵循相关国家规定或者征求您的同意" — 目前不会传输至境外 is a statement of current practice, not an absolute bar. The agreement family states no region for API inputs/outputs and offers no multi-region or processing-location choice, so cross-border transfer remains an opening; the first sentence must not be read as 永不出境
points.text_zh: 同段紧接着留了跨境传输的开口（隐私政策 四.1 后段）：『目前，我们不会将上述信息传输至境外，如果我们向境外传输，会严格遵守中国的相关法律、监管政策，并会遵循相关国家规定或者征求您的同意』——「目前不会传输至境外」是现状陈述而非绝对不出境。协议族内未对 API 输入输出作地域声明，也没有多区域/处理地选项，跨境传输留有开口，不得把前段读成「永不出境」
points.quote: 如果我们向境外传输，会严格遵守中国的相关法律、监管政策，并会遵循相关国家规定或者征求您的同意

points.text: 用户协议 9 条约定适用中国大陆法律、争议提交公司住所地法院，可作境内运营的旁证但不构成处理地承诺。
points.text_zh: 用户协议 9 条约定适用中国大陆法律、争议提交公司住所地法院，可作境内运营的旁证但不构成处理地承诺。

role.quote: 您作为最终用户个人信息的处理者应当履行个人信息处理者的相关法定义务

points.text: Layer one — end-user personal information (userservice §6.2): "您作为最终用户个人信息的处理者应当履行个人信息处理者的相关法定义务" — for this layer the agreement does allocate a role, and it puts it on the customer/developer, not on the platform
points.text_zh: 分层一：对最终用户个人信息——用户协议 6.2『您作为最终用户个人信息的处理者应当履行个人信息处理者的相关法定义务』，即开发者/客户是处理者，这一层协议确实分配了角色，只是分配给了客户一侧
points.quote: 您作为最终用户个人信息的处理者应当履行个人信息处理者的相关法定义务

points.text: Same allocation on the consent side (userservice §6.4): "您使用本服务时，向我们传输的任何信息，如涉及到个人信息和其他数据的，必须充分取得相关主体的明示同意和授权" — the duty to obtain consent and authorization, plus liability for losses the platform suffers, sits with the customer. A customer-obligation clause with no 受托处理者/processor wording, so it corroborates that the agreement allocates roles without naming the platform's own statutory role
points.text_zh: 同一条角色分配链的同意侧（用户协议 6.4）：『您使用本服务时，向我们传输的任何信息，如涉及到个人信息和其他数据的，必须充分取得相关主体的明示同意和授权』，并须确保平台不因处理相关数据和个人信息遭受损失和投诉——取得同意与授权的责任、以及平台的赔偿请求权都在客户一侧。这是客户义务条款，不含平台自身的受托处理者字样，只能作「协议对角色有分配」的佐证，单独不足以定平台角色
points.quote: 您使用本服务时，向我们传输的任何信息，如涉及到个人信息和其他数据的，必须充分取得相关主体的明示同意和授权

points.text: 分层二：对客户自身输入/输出数据——用户协议 5.3/6.5 取得含存储、使用、复制、修订、编辑的许可使用（5.3 目的含『提升大模型服务体验』，6.5 为『为提供、诊断、改善、优化、升级本服务之目的使用、处理』），5.4 约定平台运行过程中产生的一切数据由平台享有合法权利。这三句是知识产权章的许可授予与数据权属条款，说明平台对客户数据有自身目的的处分权，但没有出现处理者/控制者这一法定角色的表述
points.text_zh: 分层二：对客户自身输入/输出数据——用户协议 5.3/6.5 取得含存储、使用、复制、修订、编辑的许可使用（5.3 目的含『提升大模型服务体验』，6.5 为『为提供、诊断、改善、优化、升级本服务之目的使用、处理』），5.4 约定平台运行过程中产生的一切数据由平台享有合法权利。这三句是知识产权章的许可授予与数据权属条款，说明平台对客户数据有自身目的的处分权，但没有出现处理者/控制者这一法定角色的表述

points.text: The platform's self-description (userservice §1.2): "本公司仅作为中立的技术服务提供者", immediately followed by pushing operational responsibility onto the customer (『您的网站、应用、软件、平台等任何产品、服务及相关内容等，由您自行运营』). This is a statement about how liability is divided, not a statement of the statutory processor/controller role
points.text_zh: 平台的自我定位（用户协议 1.2）：『本公司仅作为中立的技术服务提供者』，紧接一句把运营责任推给客户（『您的网站、应用、软件、平台等任何产品、服务及相关内容等，由您自行运营』）。这是责任划分的自述，不是对处理者/受托处理者这一法定角色的表态
points.quote: 本公司仅作为中立的技术服务提供者

points.text: Direction of privacy policy §3.2 must be read carefully: "我们可能委托授权合作伙伴处理您的个人信息，以便授权合作伙伴代表我们为您提供某些服务或履行职能" — the platform is the entrusting party and the authorized partners are the entrusted parties; the platform sets the purposes itself (『我们仅会出于本隐私政策声明的合法、正当、必要、特定、明确的目的委托其处理您的信息』). So this clause places the platform on the entrusting (personal-information-handler) side of the chain; it says nothing about whether the platform is a processor or a controller with respect to customer data
points.text_zh: 隐私政策 三.2 的方向要读准：『我们可能委托授权合作伙伴处理您的个人信息，以便授权合作伙伴代表我们为您提供某些服务或履行职能』——平台是委托方，受托方是授权合作伙伴；处理目的由平台自定（『我们仅会出于本隐私政策声明的合法、正当、必要、特定、明确的目的委托其处理您的信息』），同段还写明会与受托合作方签署处理协议并监督其使用活动。该条把平台放在委托方（个人信息处理者一侧）的位置，并不说明平台对客户数据是受托处理者还是独立控制者
points.quote: 我们可能委托授权合作伙伴处理您的个人信息，以便授权合作伙伴代表我们为您提供某些服务或履行职能

points.text: Privacy policy §3.1 limits third-party disclosure only: "一般情况下，我们不会向其他任何公司、组织和个人提供您的个人信息" — its subject is again 您的个人信息, and it says nothing about the platform's own role
points.text_zh: 隐私政策 三.1 只承诺不向第三方提供个人信息：『一般情况下，我们不会向其他任何公司、组织和个人提供您的个人信息』，主语同样是『您的个人信息』，不构成对平台自身角色的表态
points.quote: 一般情况下，我们不会向其他任何公司、组织和个人提供您的个人信息

points.text: Why the verdict stays 未约定角色 (kind=unknown): every sentence above either allocates duties to the customer or describes the entrusting chain; no clause in either snapshot characterises the platform itself as 受托处理者/processor or 独立控制者/controller for customer data, and the CN site has no DPA snapshot to confirm the split (/docs/zh/agreement/dataprocess, /legal/dpa.html, /legal/data-processing.html, /dpa, api.stepfun.com/dpa have no snapshot in snapshots/ and cannot be rechecked this round). Divergence kept side by side, not resolved: the pay-as-you-go API line (providers/stepfun.toml) records kind=controller for the same agreement family (§5.3/§5.4/§6.5/§6.2). The disputed point is whether §6.5 self-use authorization plus §5.4 data ownership plus the platform setting its own purposes in the privacy policy suffice to conclude controller; scope-wise that row covers the platform.stepfun.com pay-as-you-go API tier, this row is the Step Plan subscription tier
points.text_zh: 结论仍记「未约定角色」（kind=unknown）的理由：上述句子都在分配客户侧义务或描述委托链条，两份快照里没有一句把平台自身表述为『受托处理者/processor』或『独立控制者/controller』；中国站也没有 DPA 可据以确认角色划分（/docs/zh/agreement/dataprocess、/legal/dpa.html、/legal/data-processing.html、/dpa、api.stepfun.com/dpa 在 snapshots/ 下无快照，本轮无法复核）。分歧并列保留、不选边：同厂按量 API 档（providers/stepfun.toml）对同一协议族（含 5.3/5.4/6.5/6.2）记 kind=controller。分歧点是平台自身对客户数据的角色能否由 6.5 自用授权＋5.4 数据权属＋隐私政策自定处理目的推出 controller；适用范围上那条覆盖 platform.stepfun.com 按量 API 档，本档为 Step Plan 订阅档。国际站同路径 DPA 快照逐字写 Customer is the controller and StepFun is the processor，但那是另一实体（platform.stepfun.ai，Controller 为 STEPFUN TECHNOLOGY (HK) LIMITED）另一站点，按权威性口径只能当发现线索，不能作本档证据

points.text: 查阅范围说明：searched 里 /legal/*.html、/step-plan、/trust、/dpa 等条目本轮在 snapshots/ 下没有快照，无法复核；本档可复核的角色依据只有用户协议与隐私政策两份快照。故不据这些页面下结论，也不以「未披露」收口——缺的是可复核的 DPA，不是厂商的沉默

training.quote: 腾讯云不会将您在使用本服务过程中的输入内容用于开发、训练、微调或改进腾讯云自身的算法、模型或服务。

points.text: The Hunyuan pay-as-you-go API tier (Tencent Cloud first-party models, postpaid TokenHub calls) is governed by TokenHub Terms of Service §2.17: Tencent Cloud will not use the content you input while using the service to develop, train, fine-tune or improve Tencent Cloud's own algorithms, models or services, and there is no "may train with separate authorization" exception. Supporting evidence: the TokenHub FAQ says it "will certainly not be used for training".
points.text_zh: 混元按量 API 档（腾讯云自有模型，TokenHub 后付费调用）适用《TokenHub 服务条款》§2.17：不将输入内容用于开发、训练、微调或改进腾讯云自身算法/模型/服务，且无「另行授权即可训练」的例外。佐证：TokenHub 常见问题「更不会用于训练」

points.text: Tier scope of this verdict: the §1.5 model-classification table lists the Hunyuan series (Hy3, Hy3 preview, Hy-MT2-Pro, Hy-MT2-Plus, Hy-MT2-Lite, Hy-Role-Latest, Hy-Role) in its 「腾讯云自有模型」 (Tencent Cloud first-party models) row, so the §2.17 commitment governs this tier rather than the third-party-deployed-model carve-outs.
points.text_zh: 本档的档位界定：§1.5 的模型分类表把混元系列（Hy3、Hy3 preview、Hy-MT2-Pro、Hy-MT2-Plus、Hy-MT2-Lite、Hy-Role-Latest、Hy-Role）列在「腾讯云自有模型」一档，故本档适用 §2.17 的承诺，而不是第三方部署模型的例外。
points.quote: 由腾讯云或其关联方自主研发、运营或提供的模型。目前包括混元系列模型：Hy3、Hy3 preview、Hy-MT2-Pro、Hy-MT2-Plus、Hy-MT2-Lite、Hy-Role-Latest、Hy-Role

points.text: Parallel clause kept side by side (conflict, no picking a side): §2.18 says Tencent Cloud processes the relevant data or derived information within a reasonably necessary scope for the listed purposes, and item (4) is 「进行计费结算、账单核对、资源用量统计、系统运维和服务优化」 (billing settlement, bill reconciliation, resource-usage statistics, system operations and service optimisation). §2.17 expressly excludes using input content to develop, train, fine-tune or improve Tencent Cloud's own algorithms, models or services, while §2.18(4) lists service optimisation among the processing purposes, so the two overlap and the text does not settle whether §2.18(4) leaves a gap for improving Tencent Cloud's own service. §2.18(4) only lists processing purposes and is not an authorisation to train.
points.text_zh: 同一文档并列保留的冲突条款（不选边）：§2.18 规定腾讯云在合理必要范围内为所列目的处理相关数据或其衍生信息，其中第 (4) 项为「进行计费结算、账单核对、资源用量统计、系统运维和服务优化」。§2.17 明示排除对输入内容的训练、微调与对腾讯云自身算法/模型/服务的改进，而 §2.18(4) 把「服务优化」列为处理目的，两者范围重叠；「服务优化」是否为「改进自身服务」留下口子，原文未予澄清。§2.18(4) 只列处理目的，不构成训练授权。
points.quote: （4）进行计费结算、账单核对、资源用量统计、系统运维和服务优化。

zdr.quote: 除法律法规、监管要求、第三方协议、产品规则、您与腾讯云另行约定或为提供本服务所必需的情形外，腾讯云将仅在为提供本服务之目的所必需的期间内保留您的数据。

points.text: Same as top-level dimensions.zdr: based on doc 129852 §2.14 (anchor th-retention-2-14) and TokenHub Privacy Policy §1.1.3 (anchor th-privacy-api-input-1-1-3). This tier runs Tencent Cloud first-party models, and §1.5 already places the data-processing exception for third-party-deployed models outside its scope.
points.text_zh: 同顶层 dimensions.zdr：依据 129852 §2.14（锚点 th-retention-2-14）与 TokenHub 隐私政策 §1.1.3（锚点 th-privacy-api-input-1-1-3）。本档为腾讯云自有模型，§1.5 已把第三方部署模型的数据处理例外排除在外

points.text: The "no less than six months" log retention in §2.9 applies only to the labelling scenario where the user's request carries no explicit label, and is a statutory floor. The China site has no DPA/DPSA and no ZDR switch (the related agreement lists 1823/130105 contain 7 items in total).
points.text_zh: §2.9 的日志不少于六个月只适用于用户请求不加显式标识的标识场景，属法定下限。中国站无 DPA/DPSA，也无 ZDR 开关（相关协议清单 1823/130105 共 7 条）

points.text: The ZDR in the international-site DPSA module 1300/78953 does not apply to this tier.
points.text_zh: 国际站 DPSA 模块 1300/78953 的 ZDR 不适用于本档。

retention.quote: 除法律法规、监管要求、第三方协议、产品规则、您与腾讯云另行约定或为提供本服务所必需的情形外，腾讯云将仅在为提供本服务之目的所必需的期间内保留您的数据。

points.text: §2.14: Tencent Cloud retains your data only for the period necessary to provide the service, and after the processing period ends stops unnecessary use of the data or returns or deletes it on your lawful and valid instructions; no day count is given.
points.text_zh: §2.14 必需期间保留、期满停止不必要使用或返还/删除，未给天数

points.text: §2.14 second limb (limit on deletion): after the processing period ends Tencent Cloud stops unnecessary use of the data and returns or deletes it on your lawful and valid instructions, but where laws or regulations do not allow deletion or deletion is technically impracticable, it stops all processing other than storage, keeping records, performing statutory duties and taking necessary security protection measures. The end-of-period deletion promise is therefore not absolute.
points.text_zh: §2.14 后半（删除受限的例外）：处理期限结束后腾讯云停止不必要的数据使用，并依您的合法有效指示返还或删除数据；但法律法规不允许删除或删除在技术上难以实现时，将停止除存储、留存记录、履行法定义务和采取必要安全保护措施之外的处理。故期满删除承诺不是绝对的。
points.quote: 如果法律法规不允许腾讯云删除此类数据，或删除此类数据从技术上难以实现，腾讯云将停止除存储、留存记录、履行法定义务和采取必要安全保护措施之外的处理。

points.text: §2.9: logs relating to generated synthetic content, such as information about the party served, are retained as required by law for no less than six months.
points.text_zh: §2.9 生成合成内容相关日志依法留存不少于六个月

points.text: §2.12(1) permits processing of input content, output content and logs within a reasonably necessary scope for purposes such as model inference, content safety review, service operations, troubleshooting and compliance auditing.
points.text_zh: §2.12(1) 允许为推理/内容安全/运维/合规审计等在合理必要范围内处理输入输出与日志

points.text: Context/exception, platform side: §2.8 gives Tencent Cloud the right, where input or output content is unlawful or otherwise unsuitable, to intercept, block, delete, stop generation, stop transmission, restrict use, suspend the service, keep necessary records, report to the competent authorities or take other reasonable measures. No period and no object scope are stated — this is a record-keeping right on Tencent Cloud's side, not a retention period, and it is stated separately from the §2.14 deletion commitment. The same wording appears again in §4.10 (measures against breaching use).
points.text_zh: 语境/例外（平台侧）：§2.8 规定，输入或输出内容违法违规或不适宜时，腾讯云有权予以拦截、屏蔽、删除、停止生成、停止传输、限制使用、暂停服务、保存必要记录、向有关主管部门报告或采取其他合理措施。该条未约定期限与对象范围，属平台侧的记录保存权而非保留期限，与 §2.14 的期满删除承诺分列、不合并叙述。同一措辞另见 §4.10（对违规使用的处置措施）。
points.quote: 腾讯云有权对此予以拦截、屏蔽、删除、停止生成、停止传输、限制使用、暂停服务、保存必要记录、向有关主管部门报告或采取其他合理措施。

points.text: TokenHub Privacy Policy §2.1 (channel=consumer_privacy, a lower tier than the contract-level §2.14 — secondary corroboration only): personal information is kept only for the shortest period necessary to fulfil the purpose, with three statutory exceptions — compliance with applicable laws and regulations, compliance with court judgments, rulings or other legal process, and compliance with government enforcement requirements. The object of this clause is personal information, not input/output content.
points.text_zh: TokenHub 隐私政策 §2.1（channel=consumer_privacy，权威层级低于合同层的 §2.14，仅作次级佐证）：个人信息仅在为实现目的所必需的最短时间内保留，但有三种法定例外——为遵守适用的法律法规等有关规定、为遵守法院判决/裁定或其他法律程序的规定、为遵守相关政府机关执法的要求。该条的对象是「个人信息」，不等于输入输出正文的保留期限。
points.quote:
一般情况下，我们仅在为实现目的所必需的最短时间内保留您的个人信息，但下列情况除外：
·为遵守适用的法律法规等有关规定；
·为遵守法院判决、裁定或其他法律程序的规定；
·为遵守相关政府机关执法的要求。

points.text: Same policy, same section: if the product or service ceases operation, the user is notified and the personal information is deleted or anonymised within a reasonable period, unless the law provides otherwise. This is a deletion trigger bound to service termination, not a fixed retention period.
points.text_zh: 同一政策同节：产品或服务停止运营时，将以推送通知、公告等形式通知，并在合理期限内删除或匿名化处理个人信息，法律法规另有规定的除外。这是与服务终止绑定的删除触发条件，不是固定保留期限。
points.quote: 当我们的产品或服务发生停止运营的情形时，我们将采取例如推送通知、公告等形式通知您，并在合理的期限内删除或匿名化处理您的个人信息，法律法规另有规定的除外。

processing_region.quote: 腾讯云在本服务项下由腾讯云自身进行的数据处理地点，以您所使用的服务版本及所选择的服务地域为准：中国站服务的数据处理地点一般为中华人民共和国境内；国际站服务的数据处理地点为新加坡或根据您所选择的站点、腾讯云官网、控制台、产品文档届时展示的其他地点。

points.text: §2.13: the data processing location for China-site services is generally within the territory of the People's Republic of China.
points.text_zh: §2.13 中国站服务的数据处理地点一般为中华人民共和国境内

points.text: TokenHub Privacy Policy §2.2: stored within China, and not provided outside China for the time being.
points.text_zh: TokenHub 隐私政策 §2.2 境内存储、暂不向境外提供

role.quote: 为实现本服务目的，腾讯云基于您的委托、指令和需求并以向您提供本服务为目的处理您的输入内容，其中可能涉及您或其他人的个人信息。

points.text: §2.11: Tencent Cloud processes your input content on your mandate and instructions, and its processing may not exceed the scope of your instructions → processor (the customer is the controller).
points.text_zh: §2.11 用户委托/指示、腾讯云受托处理且不得超出指示范围 → processor（用户为 controller）

points.text: Because there is no literal "controller/processor" label and there are limited exceptions for Tencent Cloud's own compliance purposes, confidence=medium.

tencent-coding-plan.entity: 腾讯云计算（北京）有限责任公司

training.quote: 为持续提升您的用户体验，我们会采取加密和脱敏处理技术，在避免识别到特定个人的前提下，使用输入、输出内容来优化模型。

points.text: The tier-specific Tencent Cloud LLM Coding Plan Privacy Policy §1.1.2: "To keep improving your user experience, we will use encryption and de-identification techniques and, on the premise of avoiding identification of any specific individual, use input and output content to optimize models" — input and output are used to optimize models by default (that is, a model-improvement purpose), this can be turned off by submitting a ticket, and after it is turned off they are no longer used. Valuation rule = record the conservative case, "will be used for model optimization/training (on by default, opt-out by ticket)". Pointing the other way: TokenHub Terms of Service §2.17 (effective 2026-09-14), "Tencent Cloud will not use the content you input while using this service to develop, train, fine-tune or improve Tencent Cloud's own algorithms, models or services", with the TokenHub FAQ (130104) and TokenHub Privacy Policy §1.1.3 pointing the same way. Grounds for taking the tier-specific document: (1) the preamble of 129852 itself says "for specific models, plug-ins, tools, third-party services or specific features, the more specific provisions in the corresponding specific rules, third-party agreements or model list shall prevail" (anchor priority-specific-rule)
points.text_zh: 档位专属《腾讯云大模型 Coding Plan 隐私政策》§1.1.2:『为持续提升您的用户体验，我们会采取加密和脱敏处理技术，在避免识别到特定个人的前提下，使用输入、输出内容来优化模型』——默认使用输入/输出优化模型(即属于模型改进用途),可提交工单关闭,关闭后不再使用。取值口径=按保守情形记『会被用于模型优化/训练(默认开启,可工单退出)』。与之相反:TokenHub 服务条款 §2.17(2026-09-14 生效)『腾讯云不会将您在使用本服务过程中的输入内容用于开发、训练、微调或改进腾讯云自身的算法、模型或服务』,TokenHub 常见问题(130104)与 TokenHub 隐私政策 §1.1.3 同向。取档位专属文件的依据:①129852 前言自认『就特定模型、插件、工具、第三方服务、或特定功能事项，以相应特定规则、第三方协议或模型清单中更具体的约定为准』(anchor priority-specific-rule)

points.text: (2) this tier's privacy policy is registered directly as item 6 of the official China-site "related agreements" list 1823/130105, making it a rule specific to this tier
points.text_zh: ②该档位隐私政策由中国站官方『相关协议』清单 1823/130105 第 6 条直接登记,是本档专属规则

points.text: (3) the same policy line recurs in the adjacent personal subscription tier (Token Plan personal §1.1.2, word for word) and in the CodeBuddy client statement (284d...), while the enterprise tier (Token Plan enterprise §1.1.2) and the platform tier (91d5fd §1.1.3) carry no such clause — a written tier difference rather than an isolated leftover. The vendor gives no order of precedence between the two sets of documents, so confidence=medium
points.text_zh: ③同一政策线在相邻个人订阅档(Token Plan 个人版 §1.1.2 逐字相同)与 CodeBuddy 客户端声明(284d…)中重复出现,而企业档(Token Plan 企业版 §1.1.2)与平台档(91d5fd §1.1.3)均无此条款——是成文的档位差异而非孤立遗留。厂商未就两派文件给出优先级,故 confidence=medium

points.text: Also pointing the other way, and inside the same contract: 129852 §2.18 is an authorisation list — "you understand and agree that Tencent Cloud processes the relevant data or information derived from it within a reasonably necessary scope for the following purposes": (1) performing laws, regulations, regulatory requirements, industry norms or platform-governance requirements; (2) content safety review, identifying illegal, non-compliant or infringing content and handling security incidents; (3) technical support, fault localisation, ticket handling and user support at your request; (4) "billing settlement, bill reconciliation, resource-usage statistics, system operations and service optimization"; (5) statistical analysis of anonymized or non-identifiable aggregated statistics formed in the course of providing the service; (6) other reasonably necessary purposes permitted by these terms, Tencent Cloud's service rules, a separate agreement with you or laws and regulations. Under the ledger's valuation rule ("used to improve the service / raise quality" counts as training), item (4) is a retained model-improvement purpose, and it stands in the same contract as §2.17's promise not to use input content to "develop, train, fine-tune or improve Tencent Cloud's own algorithms, models or services" — the two must be stated side by side. The tension on this tier is therefore three-way: §2.17 (Tencent Cloud itself does not train) / §2.18(4) (a retained "service optimization" purpose) / the tier privacy policy §1.1.2 (input and output used to optimize models by default)
points.text_zh: 反向方向的第二条,且在同一份合同里:129852 §2.18 是授权清单——『您理解并同意，腾讯云在合理必要范围内为以下目的处理相关数据或其衍生信息』:(1)履行法律法规、监管要求、行业规范或平台治理要求;(2)内容安全审核、违法违规或侵权内容识别和安全事件处置;(3)根据您的请求提供技术支持、故障定位、工单处理和用户支持;(4)『进行计费结算、账单核对、资源用量统计、系统运维和服务优化』;(5)对提供服务形成的匿名化或无法被识别到特定个人的聚合统计信息进行统计分析;(6)本服务条款、腾讯云服务规则、您与腾讯云另行约定或法律法规允许的其他合理必要目的。按台账口径(『用来改进服务/提高质量』算训练),(4)属保留的模型改进用途,与 §2.17『不会将您在使用本服务过程中的输入内容用于开发、训练、微调或改进腾讯云自身的算法、模型或服务』并存于同一份合同,必须并列说明。故本档 training 的张力是三方:§2.17 腾讯云自身不训练 / §2.18(4) 保留『服务优化』用途 / 档位隐私政策 §1.1.2 默认用输入、输出内容优化模型(anchor training-2-18-service-optimization)
points.quote: （4）进行计费结算、账单核对、资源用量统计、系统运维和服务优化。

points.text: Scope limit on the "no training" promise (anchor training-thirdparty-caveat): the second half of §2.17 says the promise "is a promise made by Tencent Cloud in respect of the data processing activities it can itself control, and does not represent or replace any promise made by any external model service provider or other third party in respect of its own data processing activities", and that "whether a third party will use the relevant data for training, optimization, improvement, evaluation or other purposes shall be governed by the third-party agreement, service rules, data processing rules, model list or the notice displayed by Tencent Cloud from time to time". In the third-party-deployed model scenario defined in §1.5 ("currently includes the DeepSeek series of models"), the training/optimization rules are therefore set by the third-party agreement and model list, and this tier's promise covers only Tencent Cloud's own controllable activities. Whether this tier's models are third-party-deployed models is not labelled in the contract or in the tier documents, so the boundary of this promise is in doubt — the same doubt as in the zdr and processing_region points
points.text_zh: 不训练承诺的适用边界(anchor training-thirdparty-caveat):§2.17 后半『前述承诺是腾讯云就其自身可控制的数据处理活动作出的承诺，不代表或替代任何外部模型服务商或其他第三方就其自身数据处理活动作出的承诺，第三方部署模型可能涉及外部模型服务商或其他第三方的数据处理活动』,并『第三方是否会将相关数据用于训练、优化、改进、评测或其他目的，应以第三方协议、服务规则、数据处理规则、模型清单或腾讯云届时页面提示为准』。故在 §1.5 定义的第三方部署模型场景(『目前包括 DeepSeek 系列模型』)下,训练/优化口径以第三方协议与模型清单为准,本档承诺只覆盖腾讯云自身可控的数据处理活动;本档模型是否属第三方部署模型在合同与档位文件中均未标注,该承诺的边界因此存疑——与 zdr、processing_region 的存疑是同一个问题
points.quote: 第三方是否会将相关数据用于训练、优化、改进、评测或其他目的，应以第三方协议、服务规则、数据处理规则、模型清单或腾讯云届时页面提示为准。

points.text: Even if the contract clauses were taken as controlling, the flip would be only partial: §2.17's promise covers only Tencent Cloud's own controllable processing activities, while §2.18(4) keeps a "service optimization" purpose inside the same contract, so the contract is not one-sided either
points.text_zh: 即便以合同条款为准,反转也只是部分的:§2.17 的承诺只覆盖腾讯云自身可控的数据处理活动,而同一份合同的 §2.18(4) 仍保留『服务优化』用途——合同本身也不是一面倒

points.text: This round of re-review (2026-09-21) keeps the direction "zero retention not supported", but lowers confidence from medium to low — the evidence can only be written in weak form, not as a direct vendor statement about retaining or deleting request content. (1) Primary basis, 129852 §2.14 (anchor retention-necessary-period): "Except where laws and regulations, regulatory requirements, third-party agreements, product rules, a separate agreement between you and Tencent Cloud, or the provision of this service so require, Tencent Cloud will retain your data only for the period necessary for the purpose of providing this service." This line says that Tencent Cloud retains your data under this service with the period limited to what is necessary to provide the service; it states an upper bound on duration, not a quantified retention commitment
points.text_zh: 本轮重审(2026-09-21)维持方向『不支持零保留』,但 confidence 由 medium 降为 low——依据只能写成弱形式,不能写成厂商对请求内容的直陈保留/删除表态。①主依据 129852 §2.14(anchor retention-necessary-period):『除法律法规、监管要求、第三方协议、产品规则、您与腾讯云另行约定或为提供本服务所必需的情形外，腾讯云将仅在为提供本服务之目的所必需的期间内保留您的数据。』这条说的是『腾讯云会保留本服务项下的您的数据,期限限定在为提供本服务之目的所必需』,是期限上限声明,不是量化保留承诺

points.text: The second sentence, "after the data processing period ends Tencent Cloud will stop unnecessary use of the data, or return or delete the relevant data on your lawful and valid instructions", shows that deletion is not automatic
points.text_zh: 第二句『数据处理期限结束后停止不必要的数据使用行为,或者根据您的合法有效指示将相关数据返还给您或删除』表明删除并非自动

points.text: The third sentence, "if laws and regulations do not permit Tencent Cloud to delete such data, or deleting such data is technically difficult to achieve, Tencent Cloud will cease all processing other than storage, keeping records, performing statutory obligations and taking necessary security protection measures", expressly lists "storage" as one form of "processing". (2) Object chain (readable only from the surrounding clauses, not from a keyword hit): "your data" is nowhere defined in 129852 (§1.1 defines only "input content" and "output content"). Reading backwards — §2.11, "Tencent Cloud processes your input content on your mandate, instructions and requirements and for the purpose of providing this service to you"
points.text_zh: 第三句『如果法律法规不允许腾讯云删除此类数据,或删除此类数据从技术上难以实现,腾讯云将停止除存储、留存记录、履行法定义务和采取必要安全保护措施之外的处理』把『存储』明确列为『处理』的一种。②对象链(只能靠读同节上下文,非关键词命中):『您的数据』在 129852 全文无定义(§1.1 只定义『输入内容』『输出内容』)。往前读——§2.11『腾讯云基于您的委托、指令和需求并以向您提供本服务为目的处理您的输入内容』

points.text: The opening of §2.12, "Tencent Cloud will process your input content accordingly depending on the model, feature, deployment or manner of use", whose item (1) lists the objects of processing as "your input content, output content, call parameters, call time, model name, model version, account information, resource usage, error information, log information, network information and other necessary data"
points.text_zh: §2.12 开头『腾讯云将根据不同模型、功能、部署或使用方式对您的输入内容进行相应处理』,其(1)项把处理对象列为『您的输入内容、输出内容、调用参数、调用时间、模型名称、模型版本、账号信息、资源用量、错误信息、日志信息、网络信息及其他必要数据』

points.text: The last sentence of §2.14, "in the third-party-deployed model scenario, the rules for retention, deletion, return, anonymization or other processing of data", echoes the list of objects for the third-party scenario in §2.12(2). So "your data" in §2.14 = the objects of processing under this service listed in §2.12 (including input and output bodies), not boilerplate about account personal information. (3) Scenario in doubt: the contract's §1.5 definition of third-party-deployed models says "currently includes the DeepSeek series of models", but no document in this ledger states which category this tier's models fall into — the model list in 1823/130092 is not registered as a source of this file and cannot be quoted. So whether this tier's traffic falls under §2.12(1), the "Tencent Cloud first-party model and Tencent Cloud self-deployed model scenarios", or under §2.12(2), the third-party-deployed model scenario, is in doubt — the same doubt as in the processing_region points. The object chain above does not depend on which of the two applies, since §2.12(1) and §2.12(2) both cover input and output content
points.text_zh: §2.14 末句『第三方部署模型场景下对数据的留存、删除、返还、匿名化或其他处理规则』与 §2.12(2) 第三方场景的对象列举呼应。故 §2.14 的『您的数据』= §2.12 列举的本服务处理对象(含输入/输出正文),不是账户个人信息套话。③场景存疑:合同 §1.5 对『第三方部署模型』的定义是『目前包括 DeepSeek 系列模型』,但本台账内没有任何文件标注本档模型属哪一类——1823/130092 的模型清单未登记为本文件的来源、无法引证。故本档流量落入 §2.12(1)『腾讯云自有模型和腾讯云自部署模型场景』还是 §2.12(2) 第三方部署模型场景存疑——与 processing_region 依据②同一存疑。上述对象链不依赖二者中的哪一个适用,因为 §2.12(1) 与 §2.12(2) 都覆盖输入内容与输出内容

points.text: §1.11 and §6.4 further commit that intelligent routing and fallback switching will not send your data to third-party-deployed models. Contract-layer documents applicable to this tier: item 2 of the China-site "related agreements" list 1823/130105, the "LLM Service Platform TokenHub Terms of Service", points through documentation-center entry page 1823/130106 to 301/129852 (that entry page carries only a title plus "for details, see ..."). (4) §2.16 repositioned (misjudged last round, removed from anchors[] this round): §2.16 is about security obligations — "bears the corresponding security obligations for your business data within Tencent Cloud's control", "takes necessary protective measures for your data across use, storage, transmission, access, disclosure, security and other aspects", "without your consent, Tencent Cloud will not make any unauthorized access to, use of or disclosure of your business data". Within it, "data you upload, submit, transmit or store in Tencent Cloud data centers through this service" is a qualifier on the protected data, and "storage" appears in the list of stages covered by the protective measures; neither is a statement that "we will store your request content" — taking it as zdr evidence last round was a word hit with a different meaning. (5) Reverse search (by reading, not by matching): the full text of 129852, the full tier privacy policy f49e, 130092, 130103, 130104 and 131410 contain no statement of the kind "does not store", "not retained after processing completes" or "will not keep input and output". The three closest passages all fail to apply to this tier: (a) CodeBuddy statement 284d §2.7, custom-model scenario, "except where necessary to complete the user's request, effect necessary transmission, conduct security audit, troubleshoot faults or retain data as required by law and where separately notified, we will not read or store your input or the output content of your custom model during this process" — the context is client-side direct forwarding with the user's own third-party model key, not platform-side inference on this tier
points.text_zh: §1.11、§6.4 另承诺智能路由与备用切换不会把数据送往第三方部署模型。合同层为本档适用文档:中国站『相关协议』清单 1823/130105 第 2 条『大模型服务平台 TokenHub 服务条款』经文档中心条目页 1823/130106 指向 301/129852(该条目页正文只有标题+『详细信息,请参见…』)。④§2.16 重新定位(上一轮判错,本轮已从 anchors[] 删除):§2.16 讲的是安全保障义务——『对腾讯云控制范围内的您的业务数据承担相应的安全保障义务』『从使用、存储、传输、访问、披露、安全等多方面对您的数据采取必要保护措施』『未经您同意,腾讯云不会对您的业务数据进行任何未获授权的访问、使用和披露』。其中『您通过本服务上传、提交、传输或存储在腾讯云数据中心的数据』是受保护数据的定语,『存储』出现在保护措施覆盖的环节列表里,二者都不是『我们会存储您的请求内容』的声明——上一轮拿它当 zdr 依据属于词命中、义不同。⑤反向检索(读,非匹):129852 全文、档位隐私政策 f49e 全文、130092、130103、130104、131410 均无『不存储』『处理完成后不保留』『不会留存输入输出』类表述。最接近的三处均不适用本档:(a) CodeBuddy 声明 284d §2.7 自定义模型场景『除为完成用户请求、实现必要传输、安全审计、故障排查或依法留存所必需且已另行告知的情形外,此过程中我们不会读取、存储您的输入、自定义模型输出内容』——语境是用户自带第三方模型 key 的客户端直连转发,不是本档平台侧推理

points.text: (b) the same file's §2.7.3, "other than the use scenarios and purposes listed in this agreement, we will not store your code" — the object is code information inside the CodeBuddy software, a different tier
points.text_zh: (b) 同文件 §2.7.3『除本协议列举的使用场景及目的外,我们不会存储您的代码』——对象是 CodeBuddy 软件中的代码信息,档位不同

points.text: (c) the codebuddy.ai security and privacy page, "sensitive data will not be stored permanently" — "not stored permanently" is not "not stored", and "sensitive data" is left undefined. Separately, §2.9, "Tencent Cloud will retain logs such as information about the party served for no less than six months as required by law", governs logs in the generated-synthetic-content labelling scenario (a statutory floor) and cannot be read in reverse as a retention period for input and output bodies. (6) No ZDR option: the tier-specific policy f49e, the full text of 129852, the 7 items in the China-site "related agreements" list 130105 (no DPA/DPSA entry), the tier FAQ 130103, the Coding Plan overview 130092, the model list 130051, the platform FAQ 130104 and the TokenHub API docs 130078/132280 contain no occurrence of ZDR or zero data retention
points.text_zh: (c) codebuddy.ai 安全隐私页『敏感数据不会被永久存储』——『不永久存储』≠不存储,且未定义『敏感数据』。另 §2.9『腾讯云将依法留存提供对象信息等相关日志不少于六个月』管的是生成合成内容标识场景的日志(法定下限),不能反推输入输出正文的保留期。⑥无 ZDR 选项:档位专属政策 f49e、129852 全文、中国站『相关协议』清单 130105 的 7 条(无 DPA/DPSA 条目)、档位 FAQ 130103、Coding Plan 概述 130092、模型列表 130051、平台 FAQ 130104、TokenHub API 文档 130078/132280 均无 ZDR/零数据保留字样

points.text: The China-site DPSA path 301/17347 returns HTTP 404 when tested. The international-site DPSA module 1300/78953 does carry ZDR, but says it applies only to the international-site TokenHub and the enterprise Token Plan, is bound to the Singapore / Frankfurt / Silicon Valley resource regions, does not apply to this tier and must not be mixed in. (7) Why only low: "your data" is undefined within this tier's contract, and the object chain has to be derived from §2.11 → §2.12 → §2.14 within the same section
points.text_zh: 中国站 DPSA 路径 301/17347 实测 HTTP 404。国际站 DPSA 模块 1300/78953 确有 ZDR,但自述只适用于国际站 TokenHub 与 Token Plan 企业版,且绑定新加坡/法兰克福/硅谷资源地域,不适用本档,不得混入。⑦为什么只给 low:『您的数据』在本档合同内无定义,对象链必须靠 §2.11→§2.12→§2.14 同节推导

points.text: The sentence form of §2.14 is an upper bound on duration, not a direct statement that "we will store input and output". So this point can only be written in weak form: "the contract acknowledges that data under this service is retained for the necessary period, with no quantified cap, deletion is not automatic, and no zero-retention option appears anywhere on this tier". If what the ledger requires is a direct vendor statement on retaining or deleting request content, this tier should be treated as not_found. Residual uncertainty: the tier-specific privacy policy f49e does not cite the TokenHub Terms of Service, and no written document states how the Coding Plan and the platform terms connect (it can only be inferred from the 130105 list and the document attribution of 130092).
points.text_zh: §2.14 句式为期限上限、非『我们会存储输入输出』的直陈。故本条只能写成弱形式:『合同承认本服务项下数据会被保留至必要期间、无量化上限、删除非自动,且全档未见零保留选项』。若台账要求的是厂商对请求内容的直陈保留/删除表态,本档应视同 not_found。残余不确定性:档位专属隐私政策 f49e 未引用 TokenHub 服务条款,Coding Plan 与平台条款的适用衔接未见书面文件明示(仅 130105 清单与 130092 的文档归属可推)。

retention.quote: 除法律法规、监管要求、第三方协议、产品规则、您与腾讯云另行约定或为提供本服务所必需的情形外，腾讯云将仅在为提供本服务之目的所必需的期间内保留您的数据。

points.text: This tier gives no fixed number of days. (1) Object = "your data", including input and output content: 129852 §2.14, "Except where laws and regulations, regulatory requirements, third-party agreements, product rules, a separate agreement between you and Tencent Cloud, or the provision of this service so require, Tencent Cloud will retain your data only for the period necessary for the purpose of providing this service", after which it stops unnecessary use of the data, or returns or deletes it on your instructions
points.text_zh: 本档无固定天数。①对象=输入/输出内容等『您的数据』:129852 §2.14『除法律法规、监管要求、第三方协议、产品规则、您与腾讯云另行约定或为提供本服务所必需的情形外，腾讯云将仅在为提供本服务之目的所必需的期间内保留您的数据』,期满停止不必要的数据使用行为,或按指示返还/删除

points.text: Where the law does not permit deletion or deletion is technically difficult to achieve, this degrades to "ceasing all processing other than storage, keeping records, performing statutory obligations and taking necessary security protection measures". (2) Object = personal information: the tier privacy policy §2.1, "we generally retain your personal information only for the shortest time necessary to achieve the purpose" (the same wording as platform tier 91d5fd §2.1 and enterprise tier 5429d0 §2.1) — an upper bound on the period, and the same section immediately carves out three exceptions: "to comply with applicable laws and regulations and the like", "to comply with the provisions of a court judgment, ruling or other legal process", "to comply with the law-enforcement requirements of the relevant government authorities"; it adds that "when our product or service ceases operation, we will notify you by push notification, announcement or the like, and delete or anonymize your personal information within a reasonable period, unless otherwise provided by laws and regulations". (3) Exception (a floor, not a cap): §2.9, "Tencent Cloud will retain logs such as information about the party served for no less than six months as required by law", applies only to the explicit/implicit labelling scenario for generated synthetic content (the statutory retention of logs such as information about the party served), and cannot be read in reverse as "all content is deleted after six months"
points.text_zh: 法律不允许删除或技术难以实现时,降级为『停止除存储、留存记录、履行法定义务和必要安全保护措施之外的处理』。②对象=个人信息:档位隐私政策 §2.1『仅在为实现目的所必需的最短时间内保留您的个人信息』(与平台档 91d5fd §2.1、企业档 5429d0 §2.1 同口径)——这是期限上限,同节紧接着给出三项例外『为遵守适用的法律法规等有关规定』『为遵守法院判决、裁定或其他法律程序的规定』『为遵守相关政府机关执法的要求』;同节末并规定『当我们的产品或服务发生停止运营的情形时，我们将采取例如推送通知、公告等形式通知您，并在合理的期限内删除或匿名化处理您的个人信息，法律法规另有规定的除外』。③例外(下限而非上限):§2.9『腾讯云将依法留存提供对象信息等相关日志不少于六个月』仅适用生成合成内容显式/隐式标识场景(提供对象信息等日志的法定留存),不能反推『六个月后删除全部内容』
points.quote: 一般情况下，我们仅在为实现目的所必需的最短时间内保留您的个人信息，但下列情况除外：

points.text: §2.12(1) permits processing of input, output and logs within a reasonably necessary scope in the first-party and self-deployed model scenarios, for purposes such as inference, content safety review, service operations, troubleshooting, compliance auditing and billing settlement. (4) In the third-party-deployed model scenario, retention may be governed by the third party's own agreement (last sentence of §2.14, and §3.5)
points.text_zh: §2.12(1) 允许在自有/自部署模型场景为推理、内容安全审核、服务运维、故障排查、合规审计、计费结算等目的在合理必要范围内处理输入输出与日志。④第三方部署模型场景的留存可能适用第三方协议(§2.14 末句、§3.5)

points.text: (5) Context = account deletion: the same tier privacy policy §5.3, "after you delete your account, we will stop providing you with the product or service and stop processing your personal information, and delete or anonymize your personal information, unless otherwise provided by laws and regulations" — object = personal information, and it is a written deletion commitment with an explicit trigger, though it keeps the "unless otherwise provided by laws and regulations" carve-out. Parallel to the cease-of-operations deletion above; both carry that carve-out and must not be read as absolute deletion commitments
points.text_zh: ⑤语境=注销账号:同一份档位隐私政策 §5.3『在您注销账号之后，我们将停止为您提供产品或服务以及停止处理您的个人信息，并对您的个人信息进行删除或匿名化处理，法律法规另有规定的除外』——对象=个人信息,是成文的删除承诺且有明确触发时点,但同样保留『法律法规另有规定的除外』。与上面的停止运营删除并列,两条都带该限定,不能读成绝对删除承诺(anchor retention-account-deletion)
points.quote: 在您注销账号之后，我们将停止为您提供产品或服务以及停止处理您的个人信息，并对您的个人信息进行删除或匿名化处理，法律法规另有规定的除外。

points.text: (6) Context = content safety review and handling of violating content: 129852 §2.8 provides that Tencent Cloud reviews your input and output content by technical means, and where such content violates laws and regulations, regulatory requirements, these terms, third-party agreements or is otherwise deemed inappropriate, "Tencent Cloud has the right to intercept, block, delete, stop generating, stop transmission, restrict use, suspend the service, keep the necessary records, report to the relevant competent authorities or take other reasonable measures" — input/output-related records may be kept in the violation-handling scenario with no stated period. Listed alongside the statutory log floor in §2.9 and the processing scope in §2.12(1), so basis=as_needed must not be read as "deleted automatically once the period ends"
points.text_zh: ⑥语境=内容安全审核与违规内容处置:129852 §2.8 规定腾讯云以技术手段对您的输入内容及输出内容进行审核,出现违反法律法规、监管要求、本服务条款、第三方协议或腾讯云认为不适宜的内容时『腾讯云有权对此予以拦截、屏蔽、删除、停止生成、停止传输、限制使用、暂停服务、保存必要记录、向有关主管部门报告或采取其他合理措施』——违规处置场景下输入/输出相关记录可被留存,且未定期限。与 §2.9 的法定日志下限、§2.12(1) 的处理范围并列,故 basis=as_needed 不能读成『期满必删』(anchor retention-content-review-records)
points.quote: 腾讯云有权对此予以拦截、屏蔽、删除、停止生成、停止传输、限制使用、暂停服务、保存必要记录、向有关主管部门报告或采取其他合理措施。

processing_region.quote: 腾讯云在本服务项下由腾讯云自身进行的数据处理地点，以您所使用的服务版本及所选择的服务地域为准：中国站服务的数据处理地点一般为中华人民共和国境内

points.text: §2.13: "The location at which Tencent Cloud itself processes data under this service is determined by the service edition you use and the service region you select: the data processing location for China-site services is generally within the territory of the People's Republic of China" — note the wording is "generally", not an absolute commitment. Supporting: the tier privacy policy §2.2, "in accordance with laws and regulations we store user personal information collected within the territory of the People's Republic of China within the territory of the People's Republic of China. At present there is no scenario in which we provide your personal information outside the territory"
points.text_zh: §2.13:『腾讯云在本服务项下由腾讯云自身进行的数据处理地点，以您所使用的服务版本及所选择的服务地域为准：中国站服务的数据处理地点一般为中华人民共和国境内』——注意措辞是『一般』,非绝对承诺。佐证:档位隐私政策 §2.2『将中华人民共和国境内收集的用户个人信息存储于中华人民共和国境内。目前我们暂时不存在向境外提供您的个人信息的场景』

points.text: The parent platform statement 11470 §6.2 says the same. Exception: in the third-party-deployed model scenario, the third party's actual processing location, processing method, retention period and cross-border transfer arrangements may be determined by that third party's agreement, service rules or actual service deployment (second half of §2.13, and §3.5) — whether this tier's models count as third-party-deployed models is not labelled, so whether that exception lands on this tier is in doubt (see notes)
points.text_zh: 平台母声明 11470 §6.2 同口径。例外:第三方部署模型场景下,相关第三方对数据的实际处理地点、处理方式、保存期限和跨境传输安排可能由该第三方协议、服务规则或其实际服务部署决定(§2.13 后半、§3.5)——本档模型是否属第三方部署模型未标注,故该例外能否落到本档存疑(见 notes)

role.quote: 腾讯云基于您的委托、指令和需求并以向您提供本服务为目的处理您的输入内容，其中可能涉及您或其他人的个人信息。腾讯云在本服务项下的数据处理活动不能超出您的指示范围，您有权对腾讯云的数据处理行为进行监督。

points.text: §2.11: "Tencent Cloud processes your input content on your mandate, instructions and requirements and for the purpose of providing this service to you ... Tencent Cloud's data processing activities under this service may not exceed the scope of your instructions, and you have the right to supervise Tencent Cloud's data processing" — the user is the one who decides and Tencent Cloud is the entrusted processor. Supporting: the parent platform statement §5.2, "we process your personal information only on the mandate and instructions of the entrusting party"
points.text_zh: §2.11:『腾讯云基于您的委托、指令和需求并以向您提供本服务为目的处理您的输入内容…腾讯云在本服务项下的数据处理活动不能超出您的指示范围，您有权对腾讯云的数据处理行为进行监督』——用户为决定者、腾讯云为受托处理方(processor)。佐证:平台母声明 §5.2『我们仅按照委托者的委托和指示处理您的个人信息』

points.text: The tier privacy policy §4.1 only describes its own constraints, as the entrusting party, on downstream third parties. Why not high: (1) 129852 §2.6 also describes the compliance capacity as "technical supporter, service provider or such other capacity as laws and regulations provide"
points.text_zh: 档位隐私政策 §4.1 只描述其自己作为委托方对下游第三方的约束。不给 high 的原因:①129852 §2.6 又以『技术支持者、服务提供者或法律法规规定的其他身份』描述合规身份

points.text: (2) the tier privacy policy reads throughout in the voice of a personal information handler ("in accordance with laws and regulations we will store ... within the territory")
points.text_zh: ②档位隐私政策通篇是个人信息处理者口吻(『我们会按照法律法规规定，将…存储于境内』)

points.text: (3) the CodeBuddy statement §2.15 calls itself an entrusted processor in the enterprise-user scenario, and the personal tier has no corresponding wording
points.text_zh: ③CodeBuddy 声明 §2.15 在企业用户场景自称受托处理者,个人档无对应表述

points.text: (4) A boundary, not evidence of the role (anchor role-no-sharing-thirdparty): the tier privacy policy §4.2 states "at present, we will not take the initiative to share your personal information with any third party" — the qualifiers are "at present" and "take the initiative". The same chapter's §4.1 acknowledges cooperation with third parties and requires them to "strictly comply with our measures and requirements on data privacy protection, including but not limited to processing according to data protection agreements, letters of commitment and related data processing policies", and §4.5 lists six situations in which sharing, transfer or public disclosure needs no prior consent: necessary to conclude or perform a contract to which you are a party; necessary to perform statutory duties; public-health emergencies or urgent protection of a natural person's life, health and property; news reporting and public-opinion supervision in the public interest within a reasonable scope; personal information you have made public yourself or that is otherwise lawfully public, within a reasonable scope under the Personal Information Protection Law; other situations provided by laws and administrative regulations. So this sentence is only a ceiling on the scope of sharing and does not change kind=processor
points.text_zh: ④边界而非身份证据(anchor role-no-sharing-thirdparty):档位隐私政策 §4.2『目前，我们不会主动与任何第三方共享您的个人信息。』——限定词是『目前』『主动』。同章 §4.1 承认与第三方合作,并要求其『严格遵守我们关于数据隐私保护的措施与要求，包括但不限于根据数据保护协议、承诺书及相关数据处理政策进行处理』;§4.5 又列出六项无需事先征得授权同意的共享、转让、公开披露例外(为订立、履行您作为一方当事人的合同所必需;履行法定义务所必需;突发公共卫生事件或紧急情况下保护自然人的生命健康和财产安全所必需;为公共利益实施新闻报道、舆论监督等行为且在合理范围内处理;依照《个人信息保护法》在合理范围内处理您自行公开或其他已合法公开的个人信息;法律、行政法规规定的其他情形)。故该句只是共享范围的上限表述,不改变 kind=processor

points.text: The tier-specific privacy policy states in §4.2 (Sharing): "目前，我们不会主动与任何第三方共享您的个人信息。" It sits next to §4.1 (Entrusted Processing), which already acknowledges cooperation with third parties under strict restrictions — under PIPL these are two different acts, not a contradiction between the vendor's own statements. But §4.2 must not be read as "no third party is involved in this tier": the models supplied directly by third parties (DeepSeek-V4 series) receive the input, context, files, parameters and output content and process them under their own terms (TokenHub ToS §2.12(2); Third-Party Deployed Model Notice §3.5).
points.text_zh: 档位专属隐私政策 §4.2「目前，我们不会主动与任何第三方共享您的个人信息」(anchor role-personal-4-2-no-active-sharing)。它与 §4.1 委托处理框架并列(anchor role-personal-4-1-entrusted-processing)：PIPL 语境下「委托处理」与「共享」是两类行为，§4.1 已承认与第三方合作并对第三方作严格限制，故这不是厂商自相矛盾；但 §4.2 也不能读成「本档没有第三方参与」—— 套餐内 DeepSeek-V4 系列等第三方部署模型会把输入内容、上下文、文件、参数、输出内容提交给相应第三方并按第三方协议处理(合同层 §2.12(2) anchor thirdparty-2-12-2-transfer；《第三方部署模型服务特别说明》§3.5 anchor training-thirdparty-model-terms-prevail)。

points.text: Tension inside the same document, kept side by side: §2.17 is a special undertaking about input content, while §2.18 is a general list of processing purposes for “the relevant data or information derived from it”, item (4) covering system operations and service optimisation without excluding input content. Under this ledger's rule that improving the service counts as training, this wider authorisation is recorded alongside §2.17; the mark is not changed by it.
points.text_zh: 同一份条款内的张力，并列保留：§2.17 是对「输入内容」的特别承诺，§2.18 则是一般处理目的清单——腾讯云在合理必要范围内为计费结算、账单核对、资源用量统计、系统运维和服务优化处理「相关数据或其衍生信息」，未排除输入内容。按本仓库「用来改进服务/提高质量算训练」的口径值得并列保留；§2.17 为特别约定、§2.18 为一般清单，不因此改 mark。

points.quote: **Allow organization’s data for training**: off by default. Opt in to using your organization’s data for training models released by Together AI and partners.

points.quote: Unless your organization enables ZDR, Together stores the prompts you send and the responses models return, and may use them for product improvements.

points.quote: To provide, maintain, and improve our Services, including to monitor the usage of our Services.

points.text: This verdict covers the whole chain: Vercel's own gateway hop deletes prompts, outputs, and sensitive data immediately after the request is completed when ZDR is on, while the upstream provider hop is governed by each provider's own terms and carries no retention-period commitment. "Undisclosed" refers to the upstream hop, not to Vercel's own deletion promise.
points.text_zh: 本维度记的是全链：网关跳（Vercel 自己）在开启 ZDR 时于请求完成后立即永久删除 prompts / outputs / sensitive data；上游 provider 跳的保留期由各家条款决定、没有期限承诺——「未公布」指的是上游那一跳，不是 Vercel 自己的删除承诺。

points.text: 结论：部署平台档没有零保留——ZDR 在 Vercel 是 AI Gateway 的档内功能。(a) 范围界定：官方唯一的 ZDR 文档 /docs/ai-gateway/security-and-compliance/zdr 开篇即写「Zero data retention (ZDR) is available for Pro and Enterprise users on AI Gateway.」，限定语是 on AI Gateway

points.text: 整页讲的都是网关把请求转给上游模型时的保留策略（上游例外、缓存发生在上游一侧、被判滥用或安全审查的请求按上游政策保留），没有一句把这套机制延伸到部署平台上的构建产物、函数执行或可观测数据。(b) 平台档的实际口径与零保留相反：DPA §12.1「Termination or expiration of the Agreement serves as instruction for Vercel to delete all Customer Data within a commercially reasonable timeframe.」——删除的触发点是协议终止，即客户数据在合同存续期间持续保留

points.text: §12.2 另允许法律要求时继续保留。可观测数据另有固定窗口（界面保留期 Hobby 12 小时 / Pro 1 天 / Enterprise 3 天，Observability Plus 30 天），ToS §10.4 的 System Data（traffic data、telemetry、logs、usage statistics）归 Vercel 所有、合同期内与终止后都可为任何商业目的使用且未设期限。(c) 为什么记 mark=no 而不是 not_found：这不是查不到，而是官方把 ZDR 的可用范围写死在网关档，同时平台档存在明示的持续保留条款，两件事都是正面事实。(d) 边界：这只说明平台档没有公开的零保留方案与申请入口，不等于 Enterprise 合同谈不出单独安排——Enterprise 合同与 DPA 的可协商条款不公开（Enterprise Terms 未登记、本轮未核，不作为依据）。(e) 本轮查过 /docs/ai-gateway/security-and-compliance/zdr、/legal/dpa、/legal/terms、/legal/enterprise-terms、/legal/ai-product-terms 与 security.vercel.com，除网关页外没有第二处出现 zero data retention。

points.text: ToS §18.3 is the only platform-side deletion clause with a concrete number of days: within 14 calendar days of termination each party destroys or returns the other party's Proprietary Information and may keep one archival copy. Its object is confidential Proprietary Information, not Customer Data and not prompt/response content, so it only stands alongside the DPA §12.1 "commercially reasonable timeframe" clause.
points.text_zh: (b) ToS §18.3 是平台档唯一带具体天数的删除条款：终止后 14 个日历日内销毁或返还对方的 Proprietary Information，允许保留一份存档副本。对象是双方的保密信息，不是 Customer Data、也不是输入输出正文，所以只能作为合同里的删除期限事实与 DPA §12.1 的「商业上合理期限」并列，不能读成「输入输出 14 天内删除」。
points.quote: within fourteen (14) calendar days of such termination, each party shall destroy or return all Proprietary Information of the other party in its possession or control, and will not make or retain any copies of such information in any form, except that the receiving party may retain one (1) archival copy of such information solely for purposes of ensuring compliance with this Agreement

points.text: 合同层：DPA §13.1 原文「Customer acknowledges that, as of the Effective Date, Vercel's primary processing facilities are in the United States. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer acknowledges that Vercel may in connection with the provision of Services, need to transfer and process Customer Data to and in the United States and anywhere else in the world where Vercel or its Subprocessors maintain data processing operations.」
points.text_zh: 合同层：DPA §13.1 原文「Customer acknowledges that, as of the Effective Date, Vercel's primary processing facilities are in the United States. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Customer acknowledges that Vercel may in connection with the provision of Services, need to transfer and process Customer Data to and in the United States and anywhere else in the world where Vercel or its Subprocessors maintain data processing operations.」

points.text: DPA §8.3 的备份条款另说「Backups are globally replicated for resiliency against regional disasters」，基础设施跨 AWS/Azure/GCP 多个可用区。平台档没有区域选择功能（区域 pinning 是 AI Gateway 的能力，见 gateway 行）。
points.text_zh: DPA §8.3 的备份条款另说「Backups are globally replicated for resiliency against regional disasters」，基础设施跨 AWS/Azure/GCP 多个可用区。平台档没有区域选择功能（区域 pinning 是 AI Gateway 的能力，见 gateway 行）。

role.quote: The parties acknowledge and agree that with regard to the Processing of Customer Data for Customers who are on Enterprise or Pro plans, Customer acts as a Controller (or Processor) and Vercel is a Processor.

points.text: Pro/Enterprise 档：DPA §4.1 定 Vercel 为 Processor（客户为 Controller/Processor）
points.text_zh: Pro/Enterprise 档：DPA §4.1 定 Vercel 为 Processor（客户为 Controller/Processor）

points.text: ToS §10.1 splits the role by data type: Vercel processes personal information in Your Content, Account Information, and System Data as a controller or a processor, per the DPA (incorporated by reference) and the Privacy Policy. Hobby: no DPA, the Privacy Policy says Vercel acts as a data controller for information collected about you and as a data processor for personal information in Customer Data, and that notice does not apply to data processed as a processor. Service-generated data / contact data: controller (DPA §4.b). Observability System Data belongs to Vercel (ToS §10.4).
points.text_zh: ToS §10.1 按数据类型二分角色并把 DPA 与隐私政策并入：Your Content / Account Information / System Data 里的个人信息，Vercel 依 DPA 与隐私政策分别以 controller 或 processor 身份处理。Hobby 档：无 DPA，隐私政策自述「Vercel acts as a data controller for personal information that we collect about you… We act as a data processor on behalf of our Customers for the personal information contained in Customer Data.」且明确本通知不适用于其作为 processor 处理的 Customer Data。服务生成数据/账号联系数据为 controller 身份（DPA §4.b）。观测数据的 System Data 归 Vercel 所有（ToS §10.4）。
points.quote: We will process the personal information in Your Content, Account Information, and System Data as a data controller or data processor in accordance with Vercel's Data Processing Addendum ("**DPA**"), which is incorporated by reference, and our Privacy Policy as applicable.

training.quote: 本服务将不会收集和使用您的数据进行服务优化。

points.text: §1.4, enterprise edition (Coding Plan Enterprise / Agent Plan Enterprise): "this service will not collect or use your data for service optimization" — registered as written, not upgraded into "no training"
points.text_zh: §1.4 企业版(Coding Plan 企业版/Agent Plan 企业版):「本服务将不会收集和使用您的数据进行服务优化」——原文措辞是「不收集、不用于服务优化」,如实登记,不拔高成「不训练」
points.quote: 本服务将不会收集和使用您的数据进行服务优化。

points.text: Model layer: §2.12 requires compliance with the corresponding model service agreement and data processing rules; the Doubao Model Service Agreement §4.1 says "unless you separately consent, this service will not use the content you submit to the service or output from the service to train, retrain or improve the base model"
points.text_zh: 模型层:§2.12 要求「遵守对应模型服务协议和数据处理规则」;豆包模型服务协议 §4.1「除非您单独同意,本服务将不使用您提交给服务或使用服务输出的内容训练、重新训练或改进基础模型」
points.quote: 您使用本服务，您需遵守对应模型服务协议和数据处理规则

points.text: Of the two separate-consent cases in Doubao §4.1, 4.1.1 (agreeing to the Data Authorization and Use Agreement) does not apply here: the enterprise edition does not sign that agreement, whose §1.1(5) defines its object as the input and generated content within the Coding Plan / Agent Plan individual monthly subscription quota only
points.text_zh: 豆包 §4.1 的单独同意情形之一 4.1.1「同意《数据授权使用协议》」对企业版不适用:企业版不签该协议,其 §1.1(5) 把授权对象限定为【Coding Plan / Agent Plan 个人版 订阅包月套餐】额度内的输入与生成内容
points.quote: 您在 【Coding Plan / Agent Plan 个人版 订阅包月套餐】 额度内调用火山方舟指定模型服务期间因调用模型而输入和模型生成的内容

points.text: The other separate-consent case, Doubao §4.1.2 (joining the collaboration reward program, including reward resource packs or other rewards and promotions offered from time to time), is open to both tiers and arises only if the user joins on their own — the enterprise edition has no separate-consent case by default
points.text_zh: 另一种单独同意情形 4.1.2「参与火山引擎协作奖励计划,包括奖励资源包或不定期为您提供的其他奖励或优惠活动等」两档都可触发,需用户自行参与才成立——企业版默认不存在「单独同意」情形
points.quote: 除非您单独同意，本服务将不使用您提交给服务或使用服务输出的内容训练、重新训练或改进基础模型。您单独同意的情况包括：

points.text: Boundary of the "no service optimization" promise — Products and Services Agreement §6.7 (incorporated via §1.2): Volcengine may collect or produce technical and operational data (system logs, billing data, customer service conversations, lead information) and may use that operational data to optimize and improve its own products and services. This is a parallel clause about the vendor's own operational data, not an exception to §1.4, whose object is "your data (the data you exchange with this service)" — mark=yes / by_contract is unchanged
points.text_zh: 射程边界:经 §1.2 并入的《产品和服务协议》§6.7 允许火山引擎利用「运营数据」(系统日志、账单数据、客服对话、留资信息等)优化和改善其产品和服务。该条与 §1.4 并存而非例外——§1.4 的对象是「您的数据(您与本服务交互的数据)」,不改变 mark=yes / by_contract
points.quote: 火山引擎可利用该等运营数据优化和改善火山引擎的产品和服务

points.text: The plan overview page adds "does not record user requests or model response data"; platform terms §3.7.7 points the same way, but that is the pay-as-you-go API tier's authority and counts only as a cross-tier reference
points.text_zh: 套餐概览页另有「不记录用户请求与模型返回数据」佐证;平台专用条款 §3.7.7 同向,但那属按量 API 档的档位权威,只能算跨档位旁证

zdr.quote: 您的数据（您与本服务交互的数据）将不会被本服务留存，请您自行存储和备份。本服务将不会收集和使用您的数据进行服务优化。

points.text: §1.4 is a clause-level zero-retention commitment: "your data (the data you exchange with this service) will not be retained by this service, please store and back it up yourself" — stronger than the pay-as-you-go API tier's "not stored by default plus four listed exception scenarios", with no application or extra configuration needed: it applies as soon as the enterprise edition is ordered
points.text_zh: §1.4 条款级零留存:「您的数据(您与本服务交互的数据)将不会被本服务留存,请您自行存储和备份」——强于按量 API 档的「默认不存储 + 四类列明场景例外」,无需申请或额外配置,订购企业版即适用
points.quote: 您的数据（您与本服务交互的数据）将不会被本服务留存，请您自行存储和备份。本服务将不会收集和使用您的数据进行服务优化。

points.text: Scope limit — multi-hop chain, hop 2 (Moonshot; the plan model list includes Kimi-K2.7-Code / K2.8-Preview / K3): the Moonshot Model Service Agreement discloses that after termination it may "continue to store the information you kept on the Moonshot platform, on the premise of anonymizing your user information", with no period given. That does not overturn this hop's zero-retention commitment, but the chain as a whole cannot be read as "nothing is retained at any hop"
points.text_zh: 范围限定——多跳链第二跳(月之暗面,套餐模型清单含 Kimi-K2.7-Code / K2.8-Preview / K3):月之暗面模型服务协议披露协议终止后「在匿名化处理您的用户信息的前提下,继续保存您留存于Moonshot平台的各类信息」,且不给期限。它不推翻本跳的零留存承诺,但整条链不能读成「每一跳都不留存」
points.quote: 在匿名化处理您的用户信息的前提下，继续保存您留存于Moonshot平台的各类信息

points.text: Hop 2 (Zhipu; the plan model list includes GLM-5.3 / GLM-5.3-Flash) contracts with the customer directly and makes no vendor-side training or retention commitment; its §1.8 only requires the customer to follow Volcengine's website service terms, privacy policy and Ark platform agreements
points.text_zh: 第二跳(智谱,套餐模型清单含 GLM-5.3 / GLM-5.3-Flash)与客户直接签约,全文未作厂商侧训练/保留承诺;§1.8 只反向要求客户遵守火山引擎的网站服务条款、隐私政策及火山方舟大模型服务平台有关的协议
points.quote: 除本合同约定外，您还应遵循火山引擎的网站服务条款、隐私政策及火山方舟大模型服务平台有关的协议、产品使用规则等约定的内容。

retention.quote: 您的数据（您与本服务交互的数据）将不会被本服务留存，请您自行存储和备份。本服务将不会收集和使用您的数据进行服务优化。

points.text: (1) Input/output body and interaction data — §1.4: "your data (the data you exchange with this service) will not be retained by this service"; that is non-retention rather than "kept for N days", so this tier has no retention-period figure for the body
points.text_zh: 分对象登记:(1) 输入输出正文/交互数据——§1.4「您的数据(您与本服务交互的数据)将不会被本服务留存」,是不留存而非「留 N 天」,故本档无正文保留期数字
points.quote: 您的数据（您与本服务交互的数据）将不会被本服务留存，请您自行存储和备份。本服务将不会收集和使用您的数据进行服务优化。

points.text: (2) Client system and device information — §2.11: recorded, and deleted after the service expires (the only expressly stated period in this tier; the object is device information, not request content)
points.text_zh: (2) 客户端系统与设备信息——§2.11 会被记录,「服务到期后删除」(本档唯一明示期限,对象是设备信息不是请求内容)
points.quote: 您的客户端的系统和设备信息将会被记录。我们不会对该信息进行任何其他目的使用，并会服务到期后删除。

points.text: (3) Service termination — Products and Services Agreement §12.8 (incorporated via §1.2): all customer data in your Volcengine account is kept for fifteen (15) days (the "retention period")
points.text_zh: (3) 服务终止场景——经 §1.2 并入的《产品和服务协议》§12.8:账号内全部客户数据保留十五(15)天(「保留期限」)
points.quote: 火山引擎将为您保留十五（15）天

points.text: §12.8 also carries a yield clause — a different period promised in the product-specific terms or service rules prevails — and states that the data is automatically purged once the retention period expires, including all caches and backups
points.text_zh: §12.8 自带让位条款:相关产品和服务专用条款或服务规则承诺期限另有约定的从其约定;保留期限届满后自动清除该等数据,包括所有缓存或备份
points.quote: 保留期限届满后，火山引擎将自动清除该等数据，包括所有缓存或备份，不再保留您的任何客户数据和内容。

points.text: General deletion commitment (Products and Services Agreement §6.6, incorporated via §1.2, applies to both tiers): "except as necessary to provide the product and service, or as authorized by you (e.g. for troubleshooting or detection in applicable situations), Volcengine will not use your customer data at will, and will delete your customer data or anonymize it within a reasonable period after providing the service". Relationship of the three: §1.4 non-retention prevails; the fifteen days in §12.8 is the fallback for the service-termination context and yields to the specific terms; §6.6 is the general reasonable-period deletion/anonymization commitment
points.text_zh: 通用删除承诺(经 §1.2 并入的《产品和服务协议》§6.6,两档适用):「除为了提供产品和服务所必须,或经您的授权(如在适用情形下为进行故障排除、检测)外,火山引擎不会对您的客户数据进行任意使用,并在提供服务后的合理期限内删除您的客户数据或进行匿名化处理」。三者关系:§1.4 不留存优先,§12.8 的十五天是服务终止语境的兜底且让位于专用条款,§6.6 是通用的合理期限删除/匿名化承诺
points.quote: 火山引擎不会对您的客户数据进行任意使用，并在提供服务后的合理期限内删除您的客户数据或进行匿名化处理

points.text: Privacy policy §4.4: the vendor states that "we have no obligation to store your data or information" and that the storage location is "the data centre agreed between you and us". This does not overturn §1.4 or §12.8; it only shows that storage itself is not a commitment the vendor makes to the customer, and that the location needs to be agreed separately
points.text_zh: 隐私政策 §4.4:厂商声明「我们没有义务存储您的数据或信息」,存储地点为「您和我们约定的数据中心」。它不推翻 §1.4 与 §12.8,只说明「存储」不是厂商对客户作出的承诺项、存储地点需另行约定
points.quote: 我们没有义务存储您的数据或信息，亦不对您的数据存储工作或结果承担任何责任

points.text: Checked the subscription plan terms, the plan overview, the Data Authorization and Use Agreement, the Products and Services Agreement, the privacy policy, the platform-specific terms, the model service agreements (Doubao, Zhipu, Moonshot), the security whitepaper and the confidential-computing whitepaper: none contains a storage- or processing-location clause for customer content in this tier. §2.2's "authorization to use this service only within mainland China" is a use licence; no storage or inference location is inferred from it
points.text_zh: 查了订阅套餐条款、套餐概览、数据授权使用协议、产品和服务协议、隐私政策、平台专用条款、豆包/智谱/月之暗面模型服务协议、安全白皮书与互信计算白皮书,均无本档客户内容的存储地/处理地条款。订阅条款 §2.2「仅在中国大陆地区使用本服务的授权」是使用许可,不推定存储或推理地

points.text: Privacy policy 三.1(1) is conditional on choosing the mainland China service, and its object is "user personal information", not customer content
points.text_zh: 隐私政策三.1(1) 以选择中国大陆地区服务为前提,境内存储的对象是「用户个人信息」,不是客户内容
points.quote: 若您选择使用中国大陆地区服务，我们依照法律法规的规定，将在境内运营本网站和相关服务过程中收集和产生的用户个人信息存储于中华人民共和国境内

points.text: Privacy policy 三.1(2) does take "customer data" as its object and offers a selectable service region with a possible transfer of the necessary account ID, resource configuration information and customer data out of the mainland — but it is conditional on choosing a service outside mainland China, so it does not apply to this mainland-site subscription
points.text_zh: 隐私政策三.1(2) 确实以「客户数据」为对象,给出可选服务区域与「可能将必要的账号ID、资源配置信息、客户数据传输至境外」,但以选择中国大陆地区以外的服务为前提,对本档国内站套餐不适用
points.quote: 您可以选择存储客户数据的地理定义的服务区域以提供服务（“服务区域”）。在适用服务地区的情况下，火山引擎将应您的要求将客户数据存储在您选择的服务区域。同时，为向您提供服务，在遵守和符合相关法律法规要求的前提下，我们有可能将必要的账号ID、资源配置信息、客户数据传输至境外。

points.text: Privacy policy 4.4: "we have no obligation to store your data or information", and the storage location is "the data centre agreed between you and us"
points.text_zh: 隐私政策 4.4:「我们没有义务存储您的数据或信息」,存储地点为「您和我们约定的数据中心」
points.quote: 我们没有义务存储您的数据或信息，亦不对您的数据存储工作或结果承担任何责任

points.text: The Ark model service security whitepaper (p36, "the relevant data is stored only in mainland China") has its body in scanned images and cannot be machine-verified; per docs/judgment.md only the official file and page number are kept and it is not used as a formal anchor, so no processing-region verdict is drawn from it
points.text_zh: 方舟模型服务安全白皮书(p36「相关数据仅存储于中国大陆」)正文为扫描图、机器不可复核,按 docs/judgment.md 只保留官方原文件与页码、不作正式锚点,故不据它判定本档处理地

points.text: The enterprise plan overview's Base URL is ark.cn-beijing.volces.com (cn-beijing region), which is a product configuration fact and not a regional commitment
points.text_zh: 企业版套餐概览的接入 Base URL 为 ark.cn-beijing.volces.com(cn-beijing 区域)属产品配置事实,不作地域承诺

role.quote: 火山引擎是中立的技术服务提供者，仅向您提供各类技术产品和服务。

points.text: The subscription plan terms themselves contain no controller/processor clause
points.text_zh: 订阅套餐条款本身无 controller/processor 角色条款

points.text: Products and Services Agreement §1.3 (incorporated via §1.2): "Volcengine is a neutral technology service provider, providing you only with various technical products and services"; §6.6 forbids using customer data at will except as necessary to provide the service or as authorized by you, and requires deletion or anonymization within a reasonable period after the service is provided
points.text_zh: 经 §1.2 并入的《产品和服务协议》§1.3「火山引擎是中立的技术服务提供者」+ §6.6「除为了提供产品和服务所必须,或经您的授权外,火山引擎不会对您的客户数据进行任意使用,并在提供服务后的合理期限内删除或匿名化」——构成限定目的、按指示处理的受托/处理方框架
points.quote: 火山引擎不会对您的客户数据进行任意使用，并在提供服务后的合理期限内删除您的客户数据或进行匿名化处理

points.text: Privacy policy §4.1, "we will process customer data strictly on your instructions", points the same way, as do the entrusted/instruction semantics of the service terms §2.6
points.text_zh: 隐私政策 §4.1「严格执行您的指示处理客户数据」同向,服务条款 §2.6 亦为委托/指示语义
points.quote: 我们只会严格执行您的指示处理客户数据，除非法律法规另有规定、依据特定产品规则另行约定或基于您的要求为您提供技术协助进行故障排除或解决技术问题，我们不会访问客户数据，亦不会对客户数据进行任何非授权的使用或披露。

points.text: Limit: §6.8 shows that the Data Entrusted Processing Agreement applies only when separately signed, i.e. the standard terms do not claim to be a processor — hence confidence=medium. The enterprise edition does not sign the Data Authorization and Use Agreement, so there is no personal-edition style "processing for the vendor's own purposes" authorization here
points.text_zh: 限定:§6.8 表明「数据委托处理协议」只在单独签署时适用,即标准条款层未自称受托处理方,故 confidence=medium;企业版不签《数据授权使用协议》,不存在个人版那种「为厂商自身目的处理」的授权
points.quote: 如因特定产品和服务必须，您和火山引擎单独签署《个人信息和数据保护承诺函》或《数据委托处理协议》，有关数据保护约定以单独签署的内容约定为准。

volcengine-coding-plan/coding-plan-perso.entity: 北京火山引擎科技有限公司

training.quote: 您同意并授权我们和我们的关联公司存储并使用您使用大模型订阅套餐个人版服务期间因调用模型而输入以及模型输出的内容用于开发机器学习、人工智能相关技术和模型的优化、开发、使用、学术理论研究及发表等目的。

points.text: §1.3, personal edition (Coding Plan Personal / Agent Plan Personal): ordering the plan is itself consent and authorization to "store and use the content input when calling models and the content output by the models" for purposes including developing machine learning and AI related technologies and the optimization, development, use, academic research and publication of models — training is authorized by default, the opposite of §1.4 for the enterprise edition
points.text_zh: §1.3 个人版(Coding Plan 个人版/Agent Plan 个人版):订购即「同意并授权我们和我们的关联公司存储并使用…输入以及模型输出的内容用于开发机器学习、人工智能相关技术和模型的优化、开发、使用、学术理论研究及发表等目的」——默认授权用于训练/模型开发,与企业版 §1.4 相反
points.quote: 您同意并授权我们和我们的关联公司存储并使用您使用大模型订阅套餐个人版服务期间因调用模型而输入以及模型输出的内容用于开发机器学习、人工智能相关技术和模型的优化、开发、使用、学术理论研究及发表等目的。

points.text: Data Authorization and Use Agreement §2.3: the authorization term is perpetual and data already used is technically impossible to withdraw — incompatible with "not retained after the request is processed". points.text: By object: (1) input/output content — Data Authorization and Use Agreement §2.3: "the authorization term is perpetual". points.quote: 授权期限为 永久

points.text_zh: 订阅条款 §1.3 只允许通过停止使用终止后续授权、不追溯已授权内容——本档对输入输出正文无删除期限承诺
points.quote: 但终止授权的范围不涵盖您已授权我们使用的相关内容和数据。

points.text: (2) Client system and device information — subscription plan terms §2.11: "deleted after the service expires" (the only expressly stated period in this tier)
points.text_zh: (2) 客户端系统与设备信息——订阅条款 §2.11「服务到期后删除」(本档唯一明示期限)

points.quote: 火山引擎不会对您的客户数据进行任意使用，并在提供服务后的合理期限内删除您的客户数据或进行匿名化处理

points.text: Privacy policy §4.4: "we have no obligation to store your data or information", and the storage location is "the data centre agreed between you and us". This does not overturn §1.3, §12.8 or §6.6; it only shows that storage itself is not a commitment the vendor makes to the customer

points.text: The agreement does not use the terms controller or processor, but §2.1 sets the purpose of the authorization as Volcengine's own machine learning and model optimization, development, use and academic research, and §2.2 grants it the right to transmit, store, use, copy, download, modify or otherwise process AI Coding/Agent data for that purpose, sublicensable to affiliates and third-party outsourcing service providers — for the authorized data Volcengine is the party that determines the processing purpose itself, the opposite of the pay-as-you-go API tier's entrusted processing

points.text: §3.7.7(1) is one of the listed scenarios that need no separate consent: to meet legal compliance requirements Volcengine may review your use of the service, including automated filtering of what you submit to and receive from the service, and build and improve risk-filtering mechanisms and libraries of unlawful or infringing content features. That is a vendor-side use of customer input and output, but it is aimed at compliance filtering and feature-library building, not at model training, so it is recorded as a limit here rather than as a mark=no.
points.text_zh: §3.7.7(1) 是列明的无需单独同意场景之一:为履行法律法规合规要求,火山引擎可审查您使用本服务的行为及信息,包括对您提交给服务或使用服务输出的内容做自动化过滤审核、建立和改进风险过滤机制与违法违规侵权内容特征库。这是对客户输入输出的一项厂商侧使用,但目的是合规过滤与特征库建设,不等于用于模型训练,故只作限定登记,不改本行 mark

points.text: Exception that can override this tier's rule: §3.7.8 — if you use a model service without the high-grade security protection (the security-sandbox mutual-trust scheme, which keeps your data from being handed to the model provider), your data-processing rules follow the model service agreement and rules you accepted. §3.7.2 imposes the same on proprietary model services: you must read and observe the model provider's Model Service Agreement before use. The upstream hop therefore has to be checked model by model, and this tier's own promise does not carry the whole chain.
points.text_zh: 可能覆盖本档结论的例外:§3.7.8——如您使用不具备高阶安全防护(安全沙箱安全互信方案,保护数据不提供给模型服务商)的模型服务,数据处理规则改由您接受的模型服务协议与规则约定;§3.7.2 对专有模型服务同属一个要求,须先查看并遵守模型服务商的《模型服务协议》。这一跳须逐模型核实,不能由本档承诺推出全链结论

points.text: §3.7.7's default promise is scoped to training: "without your separate consent, Volcengine will not store or use your data to train or optimize models" — its object is the training or optimization of models, so on its own it does not establish default zero retention. Storage is confined to four listed scenarios (compliance review, troubleshooting, anomaly alerting, aggregate statistics).

points.text: Zero retention here is a self-service configuration, not the default: the Responses API doc states storage is on by default and can be turned off with "store": false. The cache path is the same shape — entries are dropped when the idle TTL is exceeded (object-level figures are in the retention row). The store default-on in Responses is exactly why this tier is not default zero retention.

Zero retention therefore has to be verified per upstream hop and is not implied by this tier's own terms.

points.quote: 如您选择使用不具备高阶安全防护的模型服务，那么您的数据处理规则将遵循您接受的模型服务协议与规则的约定。

points.text: Functional zero retention is achievable (store=false, and the cache can be deleted). The "zero data retention" commitment in the white paper sits inside an image and cannot be machine-verified, so confidence=medium
points.text_zh: 功能性零保留可行(store=false、缓存可删)。白皮书『数据零留存』承诺正文在图片里不可机器复核,故 confidence=medium

retention.quote: 存储时长：默认存储 3 天，可通过 expire_at 字段自定义设置，最长支持 7 天。

points.text: Input and output (Responses API): storage is on by default, a stored response is kept 3 days by default and can be extended via expire_at up to 7 days — a typical value with a 7-day ceiling, not a floor. Input and output fields are stored, the chain of thought is not; store=false turns storage off.
points.text_zh: 输入输出正文(Responses API):默认开启存储,默认存 3 天、可用 expire_at 自定义最长 7 天——典型值、上限 7 天,不是下限。存 input/output 字段、不存思维链;store=false 可关
points.quote: 存储时长：默认存储 3 天，可通过 expire_at 字段自定义设置，最长支持 7 天。

points.text: Cache: idle TTL is 1 hour to 7 days (3600-604800 s, default 86400 s), timed from creation and reset on each use, and the entry is deleted from the cache once the timer exceeds the TTL. Caveat on the source: the page carrying this figure is the developer doc titled 上下文缓存 API（已下线）(Context Cache API, retired) — a developer_data page, not a current contract commitment, so it is a supporting figure for the cache object only.
points.text_zh: 缓存:闲置 TTL 1 小时-7 天(3600-604800 秒,默认 86400 秒),创建即开始计时、每次使用重置,计时超过 ttl 即从缓存中删除。来源说明:该数字所在页面为开发者文档,标题已标『上下文缓存 API（已下线）』,属 developer_data 而非现行合同承诺,仅作缓存这一对象的佐证
points.quote: 即1小时到7天

points.text: After service termination: 15 days is the fallback retention period of Products and Services Agreement §12.8, not an unconditional promise — the same sentence adds "相关产品和服务专用条款或服务规则承诺期限另有约定的，以其专用条款或服务规则约定为准", so a product-specific special term or service rule overrides it. This tier's own special terms (Ark platform terms) state no different period, so the 15 days govern here; it is a period for customer data and customer content in the account, not a cap on the retention figures above.
points.text_zh: 服务终止后:15 天是《产品和服务协议》§12.8 的兜底保留期而非无条件承诺——同句写明『相关产品和服务专用条款或服务规则承诺期限另有约定的，以其专用条款或服务规则约定为准』,专用条款或服务规则另有约定时优先。本档专用条款(方舟平台专用条款)未另设期限,故此处适用 15 天;该期限的对象是账号内的客户数据与客户内容,不是上面各项保留数字的上限
points.quote: 火山引擎将为您保留十五（15）天

points.text: General terms §6.6: "delete your customer data or anonymize it within a reasonable period after providing the service"
points.text_zh: 通用条款 §6.6『提供服务后的合理期限内删除或匿名化』
points.quote: 并在提供服务后的合理期限内删除您的客户数据或进行匿名化处理

points.text: For the troubleshooting scenario it is "within a reasonable time", with no fixed period
points.text_zh: 排障场景为『合理时间内』无固定期限

points.text: Anomaly alerting (§3.7.7(3)): the object is the data that triggers a model anomaly alert, which Volcengine stores and reviews to guard against abnormal calls; once the alert is cleared the platform stops storing and reviewing it — a stated stop condition with no fixed number of days.
points.text_zh: 异常告警(§3.7.7(3)):对象是触发模型异常告警的数据,火山引擎为防范异常调用对其存储和审查;解除告警后平台不再继续存储和审查——有明确停止条件、无固定天数

points.text: Page 36 of the official security white paper (its existence is confirmable on the developer resources page; downloading the PDF requires being signed in), "data related to the Ark platform is stored only in mainland China", is a known disclosure, but the online doc page body is an image and r.jina.ai captures only the navigation shell, so it cannot be machine-verified
points.text_zh: 官方安全白皮书(developer 资源页可确认存在,PDF 下载需登录态)第 36 页『方舟平台相关数据仅存储于中国大陆』是已知披露,但线上文档页正文为图片、r.jina.ai 只抓到导航壳,不可机器复核

points.text: The object of the privacy policy's in-China storage clause is only "users' personal information"
