points.text: The "authorization to use this service only within mainland China" in Special Terms §3.1 and Subscription Terms §2.2 is a use licence, not a storage location, and nothing is inferred from it
points.text_zh: 专用条款 §3.1/订阅条款 §2.2 的『仅在中国大陆地区使用本服务的授权』是使用许可不是存储地,不据此推定

role.quote: 依据您的委托处理您的数据

points.text: Entrusted-processing wording: §3.7.7(2), in the troubleshooting scenario, "processes your data on your mandate", and aggregate statistics store and use no raw data
points.text_zh: 受托(委托)处理语义:§3.7.7(2) 排障场景『依据您的委托处理您的数据』、聚合统计不存储不使用任何原始数据

points.text: At the contract layer there is also Products and Services Agreement §1.3, "Volcengine is a neutral technology service provider", and §6.6, "will not use customer data at will except as necessary to provide the service or as authorized"
points.text_zh: 合同层另有产品和服务协议 §1.3『中立的技术服务提供者』与 §6.6『除提供服务所必须或经授权外不会对客户数据任意使用』

points.text: There is no standard DPA; the role is carried by the terms of service
points.text_zh: 无标准 DPA,角色载体为服务条款

points.text: Limit on the processor reading: Products and Services Agreement §6.7 lets Volcengine use the "operating data" it collects or generates while providing products and services and technical/network support (system logs, billing data, customer-service conversations, lead-capture information) to optimize and improve Volcengine's own products and services. The object is the vendor's own operating data, not customer input/output content, so it is an exception face of the processor reading and does not make the role a controller; it also means the vendor has a self-serving improvement use over that data, which the training row does not cover.
points.text_zh: 受托口径的例外面向:《产品和服务协议》§6.7 允许火山引擎把在提供产品和服务、技术和网络支持过程中自行收集或产生的『运营数据』(系统日志、账单数据、客服对话、留资信息等)用于优化和改善火山引擎自己的产品和服务。对象是厂商自身的运营数据而非客户的输入输出内容,故它不把 role 变成 controller;同时它表明厂商对这类数据有自主改善用途,不在 training 行的覆盖范围内
points.quote: 火山引擎可能会收集或产生某些技术和运营数据，例如系统日志、账单数据、客服对话、留资信息等（“运营数据”），火山引擎可利用该等运营数据优化和改善火山引擎的产品和服务。

training.quote: Customer grants W&B the right to use Customer Data to (i) provide and support the W&B Assets (including the AI Features), (ii) develop new product offerings, and (iii) improve the W&B Assets (including the AI Features), subject to any Customer configured settings, if applicable.

points.text: API tier (Serverless Inference): the contract grants a product-improvement license and never excludes model training, so under the house rule (a "service improvement / quality" grant counts as training) this is mark=no. Item by item: AI Terms §4 "Customer grants W&B the right to use Customer Data to (i) provide and support the W&B Assets (including the AI Features), (ii) develop new product offerings, and (iii) improve the W&B Assets (including the AI Features), subject to any Customer configured settings, if applicable."
points.text_zh: API 档（Serverless Inference）：合同层给的是「产品改进授权」，且全文没有把模型训练排除在外，按本仓口径（「改进服务/提高质量」类授权算训练）记 mark=no（会训练）。逐条依据：AI Terms §4「Customer grants W&B the right to use Customer Data to (i) provide and support the W&B Assets (including the AI Features), (ii) develop new product offerings, and (iii) improve the W&B Assets (including the AI Features), subject to any Customer configured settings, if applicable.」

points.text: The AI Terms expressly prevail over the MSA ("In the event of a conflict between the AI Terms and the Agreement, the AI Terms will control"). MSA §4(a) is a parallel platform-level grant ("provide and improve the W&B Assets / develop new product offerings / providing and improving AI Features"). Point of uncertainty about applicability: whether Serverless Inference falls within the "AI Features" as defined in the AI Terms (a definition covering "third-party or open source artificial intelligence technologies") is not stated by name in the public documentation
points.text_zh: AI Terms 明文优先于 MSA（「In the event of a conflict between the AI Terms and the Agreement, the AI Terms will control」）。MSA §4(a) 是并行的平台层授权（「provide and improve the W&B Assets / develop new product offerings / providing and improving AI Features」）。适用性不确定处：Serverless Inference 是否属于 AI Terms 定义的「AI Features」（该定义覆盖「third-party or open source artificial intelligence technologies」），公开文档未明确点名

points.text: If it does not, only MSA §4(a) applies and the conclusion points the same way. One further hard fact: MSA §2(e) "W&B may use Customer Data from free and academic customers for testing and development purposes" — data from Free and Academic customers may additionally be used for testing and development, a clause the paid tiers do not have. Upstream hop: AI Terms §1 states that Third-Party AI is not a W&B Asset and that its conduct is not governed by W&B
points.text_zh: 若不属，则只有 MSA §4(a) 适用，结论方向相同。另一条硬事实：MSA §2(e)「W&B may use Customer Data from free and academic customers for testing and development purposes」——Free 与 Academic 档客户的数据可另用于 testing and development，付费档无此条。上游跳：AI Terms §1 声明 Third-Party AI 不是 W&B Assets、其行为不受 W&B 约束

points.text: Second improvement-use grant, independent of §4(a): MSA §4(b) "Notwithstanding anything else to the contrary in this Agreement, W&B may collect and analyze Usage Data to develop, improve and support the W&B Assets." §1 defines Usage Data as "data and other information relating to the provision, use and performance of the Software and Service", and the same clause allows disclosure of Usage Data to affiliates, subprocessors and service providers. Whether Usage Data covers the Input/Output content of a request is not stated: the definition turns on the provision, use and performance of the service and does not exclude request content on its face.
points.text_zh: 独立于 §4(a) 的第二条改进用途授权：MSA §4(b)「Notwithstanding anything else to the contrary in this Agreement, W&B may collect and analyze Usage Data to develop, improve and support the W&B Assets.」§1 把 Usage Data 定义为「data and other information relating to the provision, use and performance of the Software and Service」，同条还允许向关联方、子处理者与服务提供者披露 Usage Data。Usage Data 是否包含请求的 Input/Output 正文未明说：定义落在「服务的提供、使用与性能」上，从文本看并未把请求内容排除在外。
points.quote: Notwithstanding anything else to the contrary in this Agreement, W&B may collect and analyze Usage Data to develop, improve and support the W&B Assets.

points.text: The subprocessor table on the Security page lists Anthropic/OpenAI as "Generative AI services" subprocessors, but whether those subprocessors sit on the open-source model inference path of Serverless Inference is not explained in the public documentation (the product page says inference "runs directly on CoreWeave infrastructure").
points.text_zh: Security 页子处理者表把 Anthropic/OpenAI 列为「Generative AI services」子处理者，但这些子处理者是否在 Serverless Inference 的开源模型推理链上，公开文档未说明（产品页称推理「runs directly on CoreWeave infrastructure」）。

points.text: None of this vendor's documents (MSA, AI Terms, DPA including Schedules 1-4 and the security annex, BAA, the Security page and Subprocessors table, the current privacy policy, the pricing page, the legal-home index, Support Policy, SLA, the inference / hosting / weave pages on docs.wandb.ai, and the site-wide llms.txt index), nor the TOS / DPA / Privacy / Trust Center of CoreWeave in the same group, contains a zero data retention (ZDR) commitment, switch or application method. The closest wording is deletion on request: DPA Annex II "deletes customer data within 30 days of a customer requesting deletion", the return or deletion in DPA §9, and deletion after termination under MSA §6(d) — all deletion-triggered, not zero retention by default, and not a ZDR tier that can be enabled. The single hit from the automated scan, "not retain, use or disclose any personal information..." (DPA Schedule 4, CCPA), is the boilerplate service-provider purpose limitation, which syntactically even allows retention in order to perform the contract, and cannot serve as ZDR evidence (the old record identified this and this round's re-check keeps it). Observations pointing the other way (not equivalent to the vendor not offering ZDR): (1) the inference prefix cache reuses the KV cache across requests on shared infrastructure by default, with only cache_salt available to isolate it
points.text_zh: 全部本家文档（MSA、AI Terms、DPA 含 Schedule 1-4 与安全附录、BAA、Security 页与 Subprocessors 表、现行隐私政策、定价页、legal-home 索引、Support Policy、SLA、docs.wandb.ai 的 inference / hosting / weave 页、llms.txt 全站索引）以及同集团 CoreWeave 的 TOS / DPA / Privacy / Trust Center，均无零保留（ZDR）承诺、开关或申请方式。最接近的表述是「应请求删除」：DPA Annex II「deletes customer data within 30 days of a customer requesting deletion」、DPA §9 的返还或删除、MSA §6(d) 终止后删除——都是删除触发型，不是默认零保留，也不是可开通的 ZDR 档。自动扫描唯一命中的「not retain, use or disclose any personal information...」（DPA Schedule 4 CCPA）是服务提供者用途限制模板句，句法上甚至允许为履约而保留，不能当 ZDR 证据（旧记录已识别此点，本轮复核维持）。反向观察（不等于厂商不提供 ZDR）：(1) 推理前缀缓存默认在共享基础设施上跨请求复用 KV cache，仅 cache_salt 可隔离

points.text: (2) LLM inputs and outputs logged in Weave are expressly counted towards "long term storage"
points.text_zh: (2) Weave 中记录的 LLM inputs/outputs 被明确计入「long term storage」

points.text: (3) The MSA / AI Terms grant W&B broad rights to use Customer Data to improve the products and the AI Features. Recorded as not_found under the rules: not disclosed in the public documents does not mean the vendor does not offer it. Unchecked: the gated portal trust.coreweave.com (a customer account is required) was not checked.
points.text_zh: (3) MSA/AI Terms 授予 W&B 使用 Customer Data 改进产品与 AI Features 的宽泛权利。按规则记 not_found：公开文档未披露 ≠ 厂商不提供。未核项：trust.coreweave.com 门禁门户（需客户账号）未核。

points.text: Object and context have to be written separately; MSA §9(c) "Input and Output are deemed to be Customer Data" must not be read straight off as "inference inputs and outputs are kept long term". (1) Inference inputs and outputs (prompt/response): the vendor discloses no retention period and makes no "deleted once processed" commitment
points.text_zh: 对象与语境必须分开写，别把 MSA §9(c)「Input and Output are deemed to be Customer Data」直接读成「推理输入输出被长期保存」。(1) 推理输入输出（prompt/response）：官方未披露任何保留期，也没有「处理完即删」承诺

points.text: All that can be cited is the classification — MSA §9(c) / AI Terms §2 treat Input and Output as Customer Data. (2) Personal Data (the part of Customer Data that is personal data): DPA Schedule 2 Annex I "The period for which the personal data will be retained... For the term of the Agreement", i.e. the life of the contract
points.text_zh: 能被引用的只有定性——MSA §9(c)/AI Terms §2 把 Input/Output 视为 Customer Data。(2) Personal Data（Customer Data 中构成个人数据的部分）：DPA Schedule 2 Annex I「The period for which the personal data will be retained... ‍For the term of the Agreement」，即合同存续期

points.text: Deleted or returned on termination or on the customer's written request (DPA §9)
points.text_zh: 终止或应客户书面请求时删除或返还（DPA §9）

points.text: DPA Annex II「Weights and Biases, LLC deletes customer data within 30 days of a customer requesting deletion」

MSA §6(d) deletion after termination, "W&B will initiate deletion within 30 days of receipt". (3) Backups: DPA Annex II "performs backups daily and retains them in accordance with a predefined schedule in the Backup Policy" — the Backup Policy itself is not public, so backup retention cannot be quantified. (4) Platform objects (run data / artifacts / logs): kept for 7 days after deletion and recoverable within that window (the Multi-tenant Cloud and Dedicated Cloud documentation and the Artifacts documentation all say the same), adjustable on Dedicated Cloud through GORILLA_DATA_RETENTION_PERIOD
points.text_zh: MSA §6(d) 终止后删除、「W&B will initiate deletion within 30 days of receipt」。(3) 备份：DPA Annex II「performs backups daily and retains them in accordance with a predefined schedule in the Backup Policy」——Backup Policy 本身不公开，故备份保留期无法量化。(4) 平台对象（run 数据 / artifacts / 日志）：删除后保留 7 天可恢复（Multi-tenant Cloud 与 Dedicated Cloud 文档、Artifacts 文档同口径），Dedicated Cloud 可用 GORILLA_DATA_RETENTION_PERIOD 调整

points.text: That is a post-deletion recovery window, not a retention period for request content. (5) Weave side: the pricing FAQ defines ingested bytes as including LLM inputs and outputs and counts them towards long term storage, but gives no number of days. Conclusion type: no quantified uniform period (unspecified), deletion-triggered plus retention for the term of the contract.
points.text_zh: 这是「删除后恢复窗口」，不是「请求内容保留期」。(5) Weave 侧：定价 FAQ 明确定义 ingested bytes 含 LLM inputs/outputs 且计入 long term storage，但未给天数。结论类型：无量化统一期限（unspecified），删除触发型 + 合同期保留。

points.text: Exception to the deletion commitment (DPA §9): "This requirement shall not apply to the extent Company is required by any applicable law to retain some or all of the Personal Data, or to Personal Data it has archived on back-up systems, which Personal Data Company shall securely isolate and protect from any further processing and eventually delete in accordance with Company's deletion policies." Personal Data that a law requires Company to keep, and Personal Data in back-up archives, are therefore outside the return/deletion commitment; for backups the promise is only isolation plus eventual deletion, with no period, and the Backup Policy itself is not public.
points.text_zh: 删除承诺的例外（DPA §9）：「This requirement shall not apply to the extent Company is required by any applicable law to retain some or all of the Personal Data, or to Personal Data it has archived on back-up systems, which Personal Data Company shall securely isolate and protect from any further processing and eventually delete in accordance with Company’s deletion policies.」即法律要求保留的 Personal Data 与备份归档中的 Personal Data 不在返还/删除承诺范围内；备份项下只承诺隔离保护与「最终删除」，没有期限，且 Backup Policy 本身不公开。
points.quote: This requirement shall not apply to the extent Company is required by any applicable law to retain some or all of the Personal Data, or to Personal Data it has archived on back-up systems, which Personal Data Company shall securely isolate and protect from any further processing and eventually delete in accordance with Company’s deletion policies.

points.text: The DPA outlives the Agreement: "This DPA will remain in effect so long as Company Processes Personal Data, notwithstanding the expiration or termination of the Agreement." It runs in parallel with the MSA §6(d) deletion-within-30-days rule — Personal Data still Processed under a legal retention requirement or held in back-up archives keeps the DPA in force.
points.text_zh: DPA 不随协议终止而失效：「This DPA will remain in effect so long as Company Processes Personal Data, notwithstanding the expiration or termination of the Agreement.」它与 MSA §6(d) 的「终止后 30 天内发起删除」并行——只要 Personal Data 仍被处理（法律要求保留或存于备份归档中），DPA 就继续有效。
points.quote: This DPA will remain in effect so long as Company Processes Personal Data, notwithstanding the expiration or termination of the Agreement.

processing_region.quote: W\&B Multi-tenant Cloud is a fully managed platform deployed in W\&B's Google Cloud account in [Google Cloud's North America regions

points.text: Terms level: Multi-tenant Cloud (the platform Serverless Inference sits on) is deployed in W&B's own Google Cloud account, in Google Cloud North America regions
points.text_zh: 条款层：Multi-tenant Cloud（含 Serverless Inference 所在平台）部署在 W&B 自己的 Google Cloud 账户、Google Cloud 北美区域
points.quote: W\&B Multi-tenant Cloud is a fully managed platform deployed in W\&B's Google Cloud account in [Google Cloud's North America regions

points.text: Artifact files are uploaded to a Google Cloud bucket
points.text_zh: artifact 文件上传到 Google Cloud bucket

points.text: Weave multi-tenant data sits in a shared ClickHouse Cloud cluster. The inference request itself has no separate regional disclosure: the docs say only that Inference is accessible from supported geographic locations (usage-limits §Geographic restrictions) and point to the geographic restrictions in the CoreWeave Terms of Use for detail — that section is in fact a statement about the availability of site content outside the United States, not a data residency rule or an eligibility list, so the pointer is broken (a documentation error on the same page). Subprocessor locations (Security page table): AWS/Azure/GCP/ClickHouse "United States or as chosen by Customer", Datadog/Hex United States, Anthropic/OpenAI "United States and other countries where X operates", Modal Labs the same. "As chosen by Customer" corresponds to the region choice on the dedicated cloud tier and is not an option on multi-tenant SaaS. By contrast: Dedicated Cloud supports multiple AWS/GCP/Azure regions (Europe and Asia-Pacific included)
points.text_zh: Weave 多租户档数据存在共享 ClickHouse Cloud 集群。推理请求本身没有独立的区域披露：docs 只写 Inference 仅可从受支持地理位置访问（usage-limits §Geographic restrictions），并把细节指向 CoreWeave Terms of Use 的 geographic restrictions——该节实际是「网站内容在美国境外可访问性」声明，不是数据驻留或资格清单，这条指路是坏的（同页文档错误）。子处理者所在地（Security 页表）：AWS/Azure/GCP/ClickHouse「United States or as chosen by Customer」、Datadog/Hex 美国、Anthropic/OpenAI「United States and other countries where X operates」、Modal Labs 同。「as chosen by Customer」对应专属云档的区域可选，不是多租户 SaaS 的可选项。对照：Dedicated Cloud 支持 AWS/GCP/Azure 多区域（含欧洲与亚太）

points.text: DPA Schedule 2 Annex I「Role: Processor (or Subprocessor as the case may be)」

DPA §8(a): the customer authorizes W&B to appoint subprocessors, with the subprocessor list on the Subprocessor Site (= the subprocessor table at wandb.ai/site/security/). points.text: For data the customer uploads, "you are the controller ... and CoreWeave is the processor". (b) In the BAA, W&B says of itself that "Business Associate generally cannot view Customer Data" (Dedicated Cloud BYOB tier only). (c) A support article acknowledges that W&B staff can access logged values with permission, and that isolation requires Self-Managed. Multi-hop: the Third-Party AI behind AI Features are subprocessors rather than W&B itself (Anthropic/OpenAI are listed as Generative AI services), their processing is governed by their own terms, and W&B's processor commitment does not automatically cover them.
points.text_zh: 对客户上传的数据则「you are the controller ... and CoreWeave is the processor」。(b) BAA 里 W&B 自述「Business Associate generally cannot view Customer Data」（仅 Dedicated Cloud BYOB 档）。(c) 支持文章承认 W&B 员工经许可可访问 logged values，隔离需 Self-Managed。多跳：AI Features 的 Third-Party AI 是子处理者而非 W&B 自身（Anthropic/OpenAI 列为 Generative AI services），其处理受各自条款约束，W&B 的 processor 承诺不自动覆盖它们。

points.text: Precedence conflict, recorded without adjudicating: MSA §14(d) ranks the documents "(a) Order Form; (b) Agreement; (c) DPA; and (d) BAA (if applicable)", while DPA §10 states "In the event of any conflict or inconsistency between this DPA and the other terms of the Agreement, this DPA will govern." The controller/processor allocation lives in the DPA (§6 and Annex I) while the deletion duties are split across both instruments, so which document controls on a given point is left unresolved by the published texts; the DPA §6 allocation is subject to both rules at once, with the scope of application still to be clarified.
points.text_zh: 优先级冲突，并列记录、不选边：MSA §14(d) 把文件排序为「(a) Order Form; (b) Agreement; (c) DPA; and (d) BAA (if applicable)」，而 DPA §10 写「In the event of any conflict or inconsistency between this DPA and the other terms of the Agreement, this DPA will govern.」角色（controller/processor）分配写在 DPA（§6 与 Annex I），删除义务则分散在两份文件里，冲突时以哪份为准，公开文本本身并未解决；DPA §6 的角色分配同时受这两条相反规则约束，适用范围待澄清。
points.quote: To the extent there is an inconsistency between the terms of this Agreement, an Order Form, the DPA or the BAA, such documents and their terms will be controlled in the following order of precedence

training.quote: Customer grants W&B the right to use Customer Data to (i) provide and support the W&B Assets (including the AI Features), (ii) develop new product offerings, and (iii) improve the W&B Assets (including the AI Features), subject to any Customer configured settings, if applicable.

points.text: The same set of contract clauses as the SaaS tiers (AI Terms §4 + MSA §4(a)), which grant use of Customer Data to develop and improve the offerings without excluding model training, so mark=no. Dedicated Cloud is an isolated deployment, but the text granting use of Customer Data does not distinguish deployment tiers

points.text: With BYOB (bring your own bucket) the file content sits in the customer's own bucket and W&B stores only metadata (Artifacts documentation: a reference-type artifact "only keeps track of the metadata associated with the files, not the files themselves").

points.text: None of this vendor's documents (MSA, AI Terms, DPA including Schedules 1-4 and the security annex, BAA, the Security page and Subprocessors table, the current privacy policy, the pricing page, the legal-home index, Support Policy, SLA, the inference / hosting / weave pages on docs.wandb.ai, and the site-wide llms.txt index), nor the TOS / DPA / Privacy / Trust Center of CoreWeave in the same group, contains a zero data retention (ZDR) commitment, switch or application method. The closest wording is deletion on request: DPA Annex II "deletes customer data within 30 days of a customer requesting deletion", the return or deletion in DPA §9, and deletion after termination under MSA §6(d) — all deletion-triggered, not zero retention by default, and not a ZDR tier that can be enabled. The single hit from the automated scan, "not retain, use or disclose any personal information..." (DPA Schedule 4, CCPA), is the boilerplate service-provider purpose limitation, which syntactically even allows retention in order to perform the contract, and cannot serve as ZDR evidence (the old record identified this and this round's re-check keeps it). Observations pointing the other way (not equivalent to the vendor not offering ZDR): (1) the inference prefix cache reuses the KV cache across requests on shared infrastructure by default, with only cache_salt available to isolate it

points.text: Express statement on the dedicated cloud tier: by default data is kept for 7 days after deletion (Runs and history / non-artifact run files / artifacts and references), and "you can change the data retention period for your Dedicated Cloud instance" (the environment variable GORILLA_DATA_RETENTION_PERIOD or Helm env.dataRetentionPeriod, in hours). Note: what is configurable is the post-deletion recovery window, not a retention period for request content.
points.text_zh: 专属云档明文：默认删除后保留 7 天（Runs and history / 非 artifact run 文件 / artifacts 与 references），且「you can change the data retention period for your Dedicated Cloud instance」（环境变量 GORILLA_DATA_RETENTION_PERIOD 或 Helm env.dataRetentionPeriod，单位小时）。这是本家唯一一处「保留期可配置」的官方表述。PHI：BAA 档终止时 PHI 必须销毁或返还。备份按 Backup Policy（不公开）。注意：可配置的是删除后恢复窗口，不是「请求内容保留期」。

points.text: Exception to the deletion commitment (DPA §9): "This requirement shall not apply to the extent Company is required by any applicable law to retain some or all of the Personal Data, or to Personal Data it has archived on back-up systems, which Personal Data Company shall securely isolate and protect from any further processing and eventually delete in accordance with Company's deletion policies." Personal Data that a law requires Company to keep, and Personal Data in back-up archives, are therefore outside the return/deletion commitment; for backups the promise is only isolation plus eventual deletion, with no period, and the Backup Policy itself is not public.
points.text_zh: 删除承诺的例外（DPA §9）：「This requirement shall not apply to the extent Company is required by any applicable law to retain some or all of the Personal Data, or to Personal Data it has archived on back-up systems, which Personal Data Company shall securely isolate and protect from any further processing and eventually delete in accordance with Company’s deletion policies.」即法律要求保留的 Personal Data 与备份归档中的 Personal Data 不在返还/删除承诺范围内；备份项下只承诺隔离保护与「最终删除」，没有期限，且 Backup Policy 本身不公开。

points.text: The DPA outlives the Agreement: "This DPA will remain in effect so long as Company Processes Personal Data, notwithstanding the expiration or termination of the Agreement." training.quote: Customer grants W&B the right to use Customer Data to (i) provide and support the W&B Assets (including the AI Features), (ii) develop new product offerings, and (iii) improve the W&B Assets (including the AI Features), subject to any Customer configured settings, if applicable.

points.text: Same source as the api tier (AI Terms §4 prevailing plus MSA §4(a) in parallel); the grant covers "develop new product offerings" and "improve the W&B Assets" and never excludes model training, so mark=no. The paid tiers (Pro/Enterprise) have no equivalent of MSA §2(e), under which data from free and academic customers may additionally be used for testing and development. The words "train models" appear nowhere, and there is no "no training" commitment.
points.text_zh: 与 api 档同源（AI Terms §4 优先 + MSA §4(a) 并行）；该授权含「develop new product offerings」与「improve the W&B Assets」且未把模型训练排除在外，按口径记 mark=no（会训练）。付费档（Pro/Enterprise）没有 MSA §2(e) 那条「free and academic customers 的数据可另用于 testing and development」。全文无「训练模型」字样，也无「不训练」承诺。

points.text: None of this vendor's documents (MSA, AI Terms, DPA including Schedules 1-4 and the security annex, BAA, the Security page and Subprocessors table, the current privacy policy, the pricing page, the legal-home index, Support Policy, SLA, the inference / hosting / weave pages on docs.wandb.ai, and the site-wide llms.txt index), nor the TOS / DPA / Privacy / Trust Center of CoreWeave in the same group, contains a zero data retention (ZDR) commitment, switch or application method. The closest wording is deletion on request: DPA Annex II "deletes customer data within 30 days of a customer requesting deletion", the return or deletion in DPA §9, and deletion after termination under MSA §6(d) — all deletion-triggered, not zero retention by default, and not a ZDR tier that can be enabled. The single hit from the automated scan, "not retain, use or disclose any personal information..." (DPA Schedule 4, CCPA), is the boilerplate service-provider purpose limitation, which syntactically even allows retention in order to perform the contract, and cannot serve as ZDR evidence (the old record identified this and this round's re-check keeps it). Observations pointing the other way (not equivalent to the vendor not offering ZDR): (1) the inference prefix cache reuses the KV cache across requests on shared infrastructure by default, with only cache_salt available to isolate it
points.text_zh: 全部本家文档（MSA、AI Terms、DPA 含 Schedule 1-4 与安全附录、BAA、Security 页与 Subprocessors 表、现行隐私政策、定价页、legal-home 索引、Support Policy、SLA、docs.wandb.ai 的 inference / hosting / weave 页、llms.txt 全站索引）以及同集团 CoreWeave 的 TOS / DPA / Privacy / Trust Center，均无零保留（ZDR）承诺、开关或申请方式。最接近的表述是「应请求删除」：DPA Annex II「deletes customer data within 30 days of a customer requesting deletion」、DPA §9 的返还或删除、MSA §6(d) 终止后删除——都是删除触发型，不是默认零保留，也不是可开通的 ZDR 档。自动扫描唯一命中的「not retain, use or disclose any personal information...」（DPA Schedule 4 CCPA）是服务提供者用途限制模板句，句法上甚至允许为履约而保留，不能当 ZDR 证据（旧记录已识别此点，本轮复核维持）。反向观察（不等于厂商不提供 ZDR）：(1) 推理前缀缓存默认在共享基础设施上跨请求复用 KV cache，仅 cache_salt 可隔离

retention.summary: 按对象分列保留 7 天
retention.quote: Multi-tenant Cloud retains the following items for 7 days after deletion:

points.text: Split by object: (a) Runs and history, non-artifact run files (media/config/log), artifacts and artifact references — kept for 7 days after deletion, recoverable within that window and purged afterwards (Multi-tenant Cloud documentation; the Artifacts documentation says the same). (b) Weave trace data (LLM inputs and outputs included) sits in a shared ClickHouse Cloud cluster and is expressly counted towards long term storage by the pricing FAQ, with no retention period in days; deletion goes through the Call delete API/UI. (c) Personal Data: DPA Annex I for the term of the contract + deletion within 30 days of a request (Annex II) + daily backups under the Backup Policy (not public). (d) Free/Pro data is entirely in shared storage; Enterprise can use BYOB (customer-controlled storage). There is no request-level commitment of the "request content deleted after X days" kind.
points.text_zh: 对象拆开：(a) Runs and history、非 artifact run 文件（media/config/log）、artifacts 与 artifact references —— 删除后保留 7 天、期内可恢复，之后清除（Multi-tenant Cloud 文档；Artifacts 文档同口径）。(b) Weave 的 trace 数据（含 LLM inputs/outputs）存于共享 ClickHouse Cloud 集群，定价 FAQ 明确计入 long term storage，未给保留天数，删除需走 Call delete API/UI。(c) Personal Data：DPA Annex I 合同存续期 + 应请求 30 天内删除（Annex II）+ 每日备份按 Backup Policy（不公开）。(d) Free/Pro 档数据全部在共享存储，Enterprise 可 BYOB（自控存储）。没有「请求内容 X 天后删除」这类请求级承诺。

points.text: Exception to the deletion commitment (DPA §9): "This requirement shall not apply to the extent Company is required by any applicable law to retain some or all of the Personal Data, or to Personal Data it has archived on back-up systems, which Personal Data Company shall securely isolate and protect from any further processing and eventually delete in accordance with Company's deletion policies." Personal Data that a law requires Company to keep, and Personal Data in back-up archives, are therefore outside the return/deletion commitment; for backups the promise is only isolation plus eventual deletion, with no period, and the Backup Policy itself is not public.
points.text_zh: 删除承诺的例外（DPA §9）：「This requirement shall not apply to the extent Company is required by any applicable law to retain some or all of the Personal Data, or to Personal Data it has archived on back-up systems, which Personal Data Company shall securely isolate and protect from any further processing and eventually delete in accordance with Company’s deletion policies.」即法律要求保留的 Personal Data 与备份归档中的 Personal Data 不在返还/删除承诺范围内；备份项下只承诺隔离保护与「最终删除」，没有期限，且 Backup Policy 本身不公开。
points.quote: This requirement shall not apply to the extent Company is required by any applicable law to retain some or all of the Personal Data, or to Personal Data it has archived on back-up systems, which Personal Data Company shall securely isolate and protect from any further processing and eventually delete in accordance with Company’s deletion policies.

points.text: The DPA outlives the Agreement: "This DPA will remain in effect so long as Company Processes Personal Data, notwithstanding the expiration or termination of the Agreement." It runs in parallel with the deletion-within-30-days rules — Personal Data still Processed under a legal retention requirement or held in back-up archives keeps the DPA in force.
points.text_zh: DPA 不随协议终止而失效：「This DPA will remain in effect so long as Company Processes Personal Data, notwithstanding the expiration or termination of the Agreement.」它与「应请求 30 天内删除」并行——只要 Personal Data 仍被处理（法律要求保留或存于备份归档中），DPA 就继续有效。
points.quote: This DPA will remain in effect so long as Company Processes Personal Data, notwithstanding the expiration or termination of the Agreement.

training.quote: W\&B Self-Managed lets you run W\&B Server in infrastructure you control, so you can meet internal policies for data residency, network isolation, and compliance

points.text: On the self-hosted tier W&B has no access to Customer Data inside the platform: the data sits in the customer's own infrastructure, and W&B touches it only during technical support with written consent (DPA Annex I). The MSA §4(a) grant to use Customer Data to improve the products is still in the contract, but its object is data "transferred to W&B"
points.text_zh: 自建档里 W&B 拿不到平台内的 Customer Data：数据在客户自有基础设施，W&B 仅在技术支持时经书面同意接触（DPA Annex I）。MSA §4(a) 的「使用 Customer Data 改进产品」授权文本仍在合同里，但其对象是「transferred to W&B」的数据
points.quote: For processor’s “Customer-Managed Single-Tenant Cloud” and “On-Premise” software offerings, only with processor’s prior written consent and when controller transmits personal data to processor during the provision of technical Support.

points.text: and the self-hosted tier has no default path for transmitting platform data to W&B. Self-Managed also supports air-gapped deployment (the docs mention an air-gapped Kubernetes deployment path). The official documentation writes no separate "no training" commitment for the self-hosted tier — the answer on this dimension is that the data does not leave the customer's environment, not a vendor training commitment — hence mode = by_deployment rather than a default rule.
points.text_zh: 自建档没有向 W&B 传输平台数据的默认路径。Self-Managed 也支持 air-gapped 部署（docs 提到 air-gapped Kubernetes 部署路径）。官方文档未就自建档单独写「不训练」承诺：本档记 mark=yes 靠的是部署形态（数据不出客户环境，W&B 拿不到内容），不是厂商的训练承诺——故 mode = by_deployment。合同层的 MSA §4(a) 授权（improve / develop new product offerings）文本仍在，但对象是「transferred to W&B」的数据，作为并列事实保留。

points.text: DPA Schedule 2 Annex I is explicit about the self-hosted tier: "only with processor's prior written consent and when controller transmits personal data to processor during the provision of technical Support" — by default there is no continuous processing on this tier, only support scenarios. Pricing FAQ: "In self-hosted mode, you're responsible for managing your data... you'll need to manage your data storage and backup." The 7-day post-deletion recovery window appears only in the Multi-tenant / Dedicated Cloud documentation and does not apply to the self-hosted tier. What W&B itself retains (license verification, pulling the spec from deploy.wandb.ai) is outside the retention disclosures in the public documentation.
points.text_zh: DPA Schedule 2 Annex I 对自建档写得很清楚：「only with processor’s prior written consent and when controller transmits personal data to processor during the provision of technical Support」——即自建档默认没有持续处理，只有支持场景。定价 FAQ：「In self-hosted mode, you’re responsible for managing your data... you’ll need to manage your data storage and backup.」删除后 7 天恢复窗口那条只写在 Multi-tenant / Dedicated Cloud 文档里，不适用于自建档。W&B 自身保留的部分（如 license 校验、deploy.wandb.ai 拉 spec）不在公开文档的保留期披露范围内。

role.quote: For processor’s “Customer-Managed Single-Tenant Cloud” and “On-Premise” software offerings, only with processor’s prior written consent and when controller transmits personal data to processor during the provision of technical Support.

points.text: The DPA role clauses do not distinguish deployment tiers (Customer = controller / Company = processor), but Annex I confines processing on the self-hosted tier to technical support scenarios.
points.text_zh: DPA 角色条款不按部署档位区分（Customer=controller / Company=processor），但 Annex I 把自建档的处理限定在技术支持场景。

training.quote: Develop new products and Service, and improve existing products and features of the Service, including by training, fine-tuning and improving the performance of models that support our AI features;

points.text: The Privacy Notice lists training and fine-tuning the models that support Warp's AI features among the purposes for which personal information is used; the consumer tier is in scope. The purpose list itself gives no route to withdraw from that purpose.
points.text_zh: 隐私政策把「training, fine-tuning 支撑 AI 功能的模型」写进用途清单，消费档适用；用途清单本身没有给退出「用于训练」这一用途的途径。
points.quote: Develop new products and Service, and improve existing products and features of the Service, including by training, fine-tuning and improving the performance of models that support our AI features;

points.text: Do not read the enterprise security page's source-code sentence as Warp's own purpose commitment for this tier: its object is your source code in the self-hosted deployment control plane (see the Enterprise row), not how consumer data is used.
points.text_zh: 别把 enterprise 安全页那句「Warp does not persistently store your source code or use it for model training」当作 Warp 对消费档数据的用途承诺——那句的对象是自托管部署控制平面里的 your source code（见 Enterprise 一行的依据）。
points.quote: Warp does not persistently store your source code or use it for model training

points.text: Collection switch: for AI features such as Active AI and Agent Mode, the prompts and outputs collected can be controlled at any time in your settings. This switch governs collection, not the training/fine-tuning purpose listed above — no opt-out from that purpose is disclosed.
points.text_zh: 采集开关：Active AI、Agent Mode 等 AI 功能的输入输出，可在设置里随时控制是否收集。该开关控制的是「采集」，不是上面那条训练/微调用途——针对训练用途没有披露退出途径。
points.quote: AI Inputs and Outputs: if you use certain AI features, such as Active AI and Agent Mode, we may collect the prompts and inputs you submit and the outputs you receive. You can control our collection of these inputs and outputs at any time in your settings.

points.text: Tier mapping note: the security page's per-plan collection switches name Free tier, Paid teams, and Business and Enterprise only; Build is not named. The verifiable switch evidence for this tier is the Privacy Notice's settings control above.
points.text_zh: 档位对应说明：安全页的采集开关按档只列 Free tier / Paid teams / Business and Enterprise，未点名 Build；本档可核的开关依据是上一条隐私政策的设置控制。

zdr.quote: Some product features — including cloud conversations and cloud agent runs — require storing conversation data to function. This data is stored to power the product experience and is separate from analytics or telemetry data collection.

points.text: Parallel fact from the same page: Warp has Zero Data Retention (ZDR) agreements with its contracted LLM providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI), meaning they do not store or train on your data, and the page says ZDR applies across all Warp plans. The subject is the contracted LLM providers, not Warp's own retention of your data, and line 44 of the same page limits those ZDR agreements to Enterprise teams. Both scopes are kept side by side; no side is picked.
points.text_zh: 同页并列事实：Warp 与上游 LLM 厂商（Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、xAI）签有 ZDR 协议，they do not store or train on your data，并自称「ZDR applies across all Warp plans」。该句约束的是上游厂商、不是 Warp 自身对数据的保留；同页第 44 行又把 ZDR 协议限定为 Enterprise teams——两种适用范围并列保留，不选边。
points.quote: Warp has Zero Data Retention (ZDR) agreements with its contracted LLM providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI), meaning they do not store or train on your data. ZDR applies across all Warp plans.

points.text: ZDR exception: some models carry provider-specific data retention requirements and are therefore not covered by ZDR. By its own wording the clause is stated for Enterprise teams only (off by default; a workspace admin must explicitly enable them in the Admin Panel); this tier is outside that wording and the page says nothing about the exception here.

points.text: API 档（SaaS）合同层结论：默认不用于训练，唯一开口是客户主动提交反馈。①服务描述 §5.1(a)：「Unless separately authorized by Client through a voluntary feedback submission, IBM will not use the Client Content or model Outputs to train the foundation models or embedding models.」（Multicloud 档 i127-9067 §5.1(a) 同文）。同节把「所有模型输入（含推理/提示、微调/提示调优内容）」界定为 Client Content，输出所有权归客户。②基础合同层：CRA §4a「such parties will access, use, provide, store, and otherwise process Content solely for the purpose of providing the Products」，CSA §2b 同旨（这两句逐字出自 IBM 交付的 PDF；Z126-6548 / Z126-6304_IBMCIBV 的 IBM Terms 页面正文需站内会话 cookie，快照只有站点框架，不可机器复核，故未绑锚点）。③文档层：SaaS 文档「IBM does not use the content that you upload to watsonx or the output that is generated by a foundation model to further train or improve any IBM-developed models.」需并列的例外与边界：(a) 自愿反馈提交（voluntary feedback submission）可授权使用，CSA 另写「IBM may use for any purpose」

points.text: 可复核性与来源登记（不改变 mark=yes / mode=by_contract）：①服务描述 §5.1(a)（含 Multicloud 档 i127-9067 同文）与 §6.1 逐字出自 IBM 交付的服务描述 PDF（i126-6883 v28）；②CRA §4a 出自 CRA PDF（Z126-6548）；③CSA §2b 出自 CSA（Z126-6304_IBMCIBV）。这三处对应的 IBM Terms 页面正文需站内会话 cookie，当前快照只有站点框架（ce9366b63a6d4410 / 1f8852264e473974），exact 机器核对 missing——这是抓取失败（关于我们的事实），不是厂商撤销承诺，故不改结论、也不写成「未披露」，mark/mode 保持上一次确认值。i127-9067 与 Z126-6304_IBMCIBV 本轮未登记为 [[source]]（仓库里没有对应快照），其引文待快照回填后再复核。本档 training 的维度锚点改绑到现行可机器复核的文档层那句（saas-fm-training-not-used-ibm-models，b67d3e7c5c1d4938 第 77 行）：它只覆盖 IBM-developed models，撑不起 by_contract；合同层的三处引文因此不再绑锚点——不可复核的锚点是坏锚点，只作为本 point 的说明保留。

zdr.quote: Text that you add to or submit in the Prompt Lab or API is not stored unless you save it.
searched: WebSearch：IBM watsonx "zero data retention" / "ZDR"（官方站点无命中，仅第三方对比站提及别家厂商的 ZDR）

points.text: API 档：官方文档声明 API 提交的提示与输出默认不被 IBM 记录、不存储（除非用户主动保存），即默认行为上等同零保留
points.text_zh: API 档：官方文档声明 API 提交的提示与输出默认不被 IBM 记录、不存储（除非用户主动保存），即默认行为上等同零保留

points.text: 但全套 IBM 材料里没有 ZDR 这个术语，也没有可申请的 ZDR 计划、开关或合同条款——它不是一项可签约的承诺。证据：SaaS 文档「Nothing that you add to the prompt editor or submit to a model from the Prompt Lab or by using the API is logged by IBM」「Text that you add to or submit in the Prompt Lab or API is not stored unless you save it.」
points.text_zh: 但全套 IBM 材料里没有 ZDR 这个术语，也没有可申请的 ZDR 计划、开关或合同条款——它不是一项可签约的承诺。证据：SaaS 文档「Nothing that you add to the prompt editor or submit to a model from the Prompt Lab or by using the API is logged by IBM」「Text that you add to or submit in the Prompt Lab or API is not stored unless you save it.」

points.text: 边界条件（IBM Cloud 通用条款，不是 watsonx 的保留控制特性）：可用的数据保护特性要客户自己开通——「You, the customer, are responsible to take necessary actions to order, enable, or use available data protection features for a IBM Cloud Service and accept responsibility for use of the IBM Cloud Services if you fail to take such actions, including meeting any data protection or other legal requirements regarding Content.」即任何数据保护特性都需客户自行 order / enable，未启用责任在客户。这句只说明「零保留靠谁保证」的边界，不证明 watsonx 存在任何保留控制或 ZDR 机制。

points.text: 反面对照：服务侧 PII 仍可能存在于服务数据源与备份中最多 30 天（见 retention ④⑤），计量数据按账户统计，CSA/CRA/DPA/Data Sheet 里没有任何「请求处理完成即不保留」的合同条款。按规则记「文档层默认不落盘、无 ZDR 机制」，不等于厂商承诺了可申请的 ZDR。

points.text: 边界（不改变「在线推理输入输出默认不落盘」的结论）：客户自行写入的深度学习训练日志文件对 IBM 可访问——SaaS 文档「Personal data must not be written to these training log files as they are accessible to other users within Client’s Enterprise as well as to IBM as necessary to support the Cloud Service.」对象是训练日志文件、语境是客户在训练过程中自行写入，性质是客户责任与访问边界：它不表示 IBM 会留存请求正文，但说明内容存在一条能被 IBM 看到的独立通道。

points.text: 边界（语境=启用某功能后）：启用 watsonx.governance 的评估与监控后，基础模型输入与输出的请求载荷会存入客户自行管理的 watsonx.governance 数据库（关闭监控或删除被监控资产/部署时清除，见 retention）。存的是客户自管库、由客户控制访问，不削弱「默认不落盘」，但「默认即零保留」这句话不覆盖该语境。

When enabled, the request payloads of foundation model input and output are stored in a watsonx.governance database that you administer.

retention.quote: The duration of Processing Content within this Cloud Service is 30 days after termination or expiration of the Cloud Service.

points.text: API 档结论：在线推理的请求内容默认不落盘（文档层声明），服务侧数据以「服务终止后 30 天」为删除窗口，备份无量化期限。分对象记：①输入输出正文（在线推理）：文档声明「Nothing that you add to the prompt editor or submit to a model from the Prompt Lab or by using the API is logged by IBM」「Text that you add to or submit in the Prompt Lab or API is not stored unless you save it.」——属默认不记录/不存储，非合同量化期限。②用户主动保存的资产：SaaS 文档给 prompt session asset「retained for 30 days」（上限式、文档层），prompt template/notebook asset「retained until they are deleted or changed by you」（客户控制，无期限）。③服务终止后 Content：Data Sheet（DPA Exhibit）§3「The duration of Processing Content within this Cloud Service is 30 days after termination or expiration of the Cloud Service.」+ §5「IBM hereby certifies that all Client Personal Data are deleted at the end of the retention period specified in section 3」——这是合同层、可执行的删除窗口（Runtime/Studio/Multicloud 三份 Data Sheet 同值 30 天）。④服务侧 PII（账户/凭据/资产元数据）：文档层「personally identifiable information and data is removed completely from all data sources, including backups, after 30 days」。⑤备份：CRA §4e / CSA §2f「IBM does not archive Content; however, some Content may remain in backup files until expiration of such files as governed by IBM's backup retention practices」——备份保留期未量化，是唯一的开口（该句逐字出自 IBM 交付的 CRA/CSA PDF，IBM Terms 快照只有站点框架、不可机器复核，故未绑锚点）。⑥计量数据：文档另声明按账户度量模型用量（billing/infrastructure planning/model lifecycle management），与内容保留是两件事。未发现任何请求级（0 天）的合同保留期承诺。

training.quote: On using the Grok Build CLI, you will also see a screen to allow us to retain data to improve the product and model. We will also provide a setting to change your choice.

points.text: This tier has no training clause of its own: free access and paid subscriptions are covered by the same consumer documents, and the opt-out lives in the grok.com / mobile data controls rather than in any free-tier text. No official text states a separate training posture for free accounts.
points.text_zh: 免费档没有自己的训练条款：免费入口与付费订阅由同一套消费档文档覆盖，退出开关在 grok.com／移动端的 data controls，不在任何免费档专属文本里；官方没有给免费账号单独的（哪怕是更宽松的）训练口径。

points.text: Disclosed exception to the opt-out: 『Please note that, even if you opt out of model training, when you subsequently decide to voluntarily provide feedback, that feedback may be used for training purposes.』
points.text_zh: 退出训练的明示例外：『Please note that, even if you opt out of model training, when you subsequently decide to voluntarily provide feedback, that feedback may be used for training purposes.』——退出后主动提交的 feedback 仍可能用于训练。
points.quote: Please note that, even if you opt out of model training, when you subsequently decide to voluntarily provide feedback, that feedback may be used for training purposes.

points.text: Same direction as mark=no: 『A limited number of our authorized personnel may review your conversations with Grok for specific business purposes, including improving model performance, investigating security incidents and potential misuse of our services, and complying with our legal obligations.』
points.text_zh: 与 mark=no 同向：『A limited number of our authorized personnel may review your conversations with Grok for specific business purposes, including improving model performance, investigating security incidents and potential misuse of our services, and complying with our legal obligations.』——消费档保留人工查看对话的权限，理由之一即改进模型表现。
points.quote: A limited number of our authorized personnel may review your conversations with Grok for specific business purposes, including improving model performance, investigating security incidents and potential misuse of our services, and complying with our legal obligations.

points.text: The free account runs on the same consumer login path as the individual subscription tier, and the consumer documents offer no zero-retention option for it; switching to XAI_API_KEY would put the call in the xAI API tier instead, which is outside this product block.
points.text_zh: 免费账号与个人订阅档走同一条消费登录路径，消费档文档没有给本档任何零保留选项；如改用 XAI_API_KEY，则属于 xAI API 档，不在本档范围内。

points.text: The one ZDR sentence about Grok Build belongs to the API-team path and presupposes ZDR already enabled, so it covers no part of this tier: 『If you are using the Grok Build CLI with ZDR enabled, no trace or code data is retained.』
points.text_zh: 文档里唯一谈 Grok Build 零保留的句子以「ZDR 已启用」为前提、属 API 团队链路，不覆盖本档：『If you are using the Grok Build CLI with ZDR enabled, no trace or code data is retained.』
points.quote: If you are using the Grok Build CLI with ZDR enabled, no trace or code data is retained.

points.text: ZDR is an API-team capability, not a subscription setting: 『Applied at a team level: If enabled, ZDR is team-wide. There is no ability to enable ZDR for specific API keys.』
points.text_zh: ZDR 是 API 团队级能力，不是订阅设置：『Applied at a team level: If enabled, ZDR is team-wide. There is no ability to enable ZDR for specific API keys.』——开关在 xAI Console，免费账号没有对应入口。
points.quote: Applied at a team level: If enabled, ZDR is team-wide. There is no ability to enable ZDR for specific API keys.

retention.quote: When using the Grok Build CLI without ZDR, privacy settings are available as a slash command (`/privacy`) and in settings (`/settings`). You can disable code data retention with these settings, even if ZDR is not enabled.

points.text: No free-tier text sets a period: this tier is covered by the same consumer documents as the individual subscription tier, and the CLI's non-ZDR code data retention can be switched off in /privacy or /settings without the default value or the period ever being published.
points.text_zh: 免费档没有自己的期限条款：本档与个人订阅档由同一套消费档文档覆盖；非 ZDR 的 CLI 代码数据留存可在 /privacy 或 /settings 关闭，但开关默认值与期限官方都没公布。
points.quote: When using the Grok Build CLI without ZDR, privacy settings are available as a slash command (`/privacy`) and in settings (`/settings`). You can disable code data retention with these settings, even if ZDR is not enabled.

points.text: The one period disclosed for consumer content is a trigger-based deletion window, not a fixed retention period: 『Also, you can delete your information when you wish. SpaceXAI retains your information for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in our Privacy Policy. If you delete conversations from your account or if you use Private Chat, conversations will be removed from our systems within 30 days, unless they have been de-identified or pseudoanonymized and disassociated from your account or we have to retain them for safety, security, or legal reasons.』 Object = account conversations (input/output); context = after deleting conversations or using Private Chat; type = upper bound on deletion, with de-identified and safety/legal carve-outs.
points.text_zh: 消费档内容唯一披露的期限是触发式删除窗口，不是固定保留期：『Also, you can delete your information when you wish. SpaceXAI retains your information for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in our Privacy Policy. If you delete conversations from your account or if you use Private Chat, conversations will be removed from our systems within 30 days, unless they have been de-identified or pseudoanonymized and disassociated from your account or we have to retain them for safety, security, or legal reasons.』——对象＝账号内的会话正文（输入输出）；语境＝删除会话或使用 Private Chat 之后；期限类型＝删除上限，例外为去标识/化名并与账号解绑，或安全、法律原因必须保留。
points.quote: Also, you can delete your information when you wish. SpaceXAI retains your information for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in our Privacy Policy. If you delete conversations from your account or if you use Private Chat, conversations will be removed from our systems within 30 days, unless they have been de-identified or pseudoanonymized and disassociated from your account or we have to retain them for safety, security, or legal reasons.

points.text: The Privacy Policy states the same window: 『Further, if you choose to delete any or all of your conversations or if you choose to delete your account, we will delete the data within 30 days unless it is necessary to retain the data for legal, compliance, or safety purposes.』
points.text_zh: 隐私政策写着同一个删除窗口：『Further, if you choose to delete any or all of your conversations or if you choose to delete your account, we will delete the data within 30 days unless it is necessary to retain the data for legal, compliance, or safety purposes.』
points.quote: Further, if you choose to delete any or all of your conversations or if you choose to delete your account, we will delete the data within 30 days unless it is necessary to retain the data for legal, compliance, or safety purposes.

points.text: The Private Chat window has limited reach for this product line: 『Unlike for regular chat, Private Chats on grok.com and mobile are not available for Build mode currently to ensure publishing and building apps across multiple sessions is possible.』
points.text_zh: Private Chat 窗口对本产品线的适用范围有限：『Unlike for regular chat, Private Chats on grok.com and mobile are not available for Build mode currently to ensure publishing and building apps across multiple sessions is possible.』——Build mode 的 chats 与 build sessions 为跨会话产品功能保留，该 30 天窗口的适用语境因此收窄。
points.quote: Unlike for regular chat, Private Chats on grok.com and mobile are not available for Build mode currently to ensure publishing and building apps across multiple sessions is possible.

points.text: The API-key path is the only place with a stated default period: 『By default, all API requests and responses are stored on our servers (encrypted at rest) for 30 days for auditing purposes in the event of suspected abuse or misuse. xAI does not train on this data, and it is automatically deleted after 30 days.』 That 30-day audit retention belongs to the pay-as-you-go API tier, not to a free account, so basis stays undisclosed for this tier.
points.text_zh: 按量 API 档是唯一给出默认期限的地方：『By default, all API requests and responses are stored on our servers (encrypted at rest) for 30 days for auditing purposes in the event of suspected abuse or misuse. xAI does not train on this data, and it is automatically deleted after 30 days.』——该 30 天审计保留属 API 档，不是免费账号的口径，故本档 basis 仍记 undisclosed。
points.quote: By default, all API requests and responses are stored on our servers (encrypted at rest) for 30 days for auditing purposes in the event of suspected abuse or misuse. xAI does not train on this data, and it is automatically deleted after 30 days.

points.text: The free entry point has even less to go on than a subscription: the Consumer FAQ and the Privacy Policy name no processing region, and no clause in the registered sources for this tier speaks to where processing happens.
points.text_zh: 免费入口比订阅档更没有可依据的处理地表述：消费 FAQ 与隐私政策都未给处理区域，本档在已登记来源里没有任何谈处理地的条款。

points.text: The only processing-region clause in the registered sources belongs to the pay-as-you-go API tier, and it is an endpoint choice rather than a blanket guarantee: 『The default endpoint, `https://api.x.ai`, does not guarantee a processing region. To keep API request handling, model inference, moderation, and retained request data in the United States, use the US regional endpoint, `https://us.api.x.ai/v1`』.
points.text_zh: 已登记来源里唯一的处理地条款属按量 API 档，而且是端点选择、不是普遍保证：『The default endpoint, `https://api.x.ai`, does not guarantee a processing region. To keep API request handling, model inference, moderation, and retained request data in the United States, use the US regional endpoint, `https://us.api.x.ai/v1`』——免费档连订阅关系都没有，更无可外推的驻留依据。
points.quote: The default endpoint, `https://api.x.ai`, does not guarantee a processing region. To keep API request handling, model inference, moderation, and retained request data in the United States, use the US regional endpoint, `https://us.api.x.ai/v1`.

role.quote: This Privacy Policy does not apply to data that we process on behalf of customers of our business offerings, such as the SpaceXAI API

points.text: This tier shares the consumer documents with the individual subscription tier and has no role clause of its own: the Consumer FAQ and the Privacy Policy never use controller or processor for SpaceXAI's own position, and the reverse delimitation 『This Privacy Policy does not apply to data that we process on behalf of customers of our business offerings, such as the SpaceXAI API』 keeps the on-behalf-of-customer path out of this relationship. Recorded as controller on that scope reading, not on a self-designation.
points.text_zh: 本档与个人订阅档共用消费档文档、没有自己的角色条款：消费 FAQ 与隐私政策都没有用 controller / processor 描述 SpaceXAI 自身，反向界定『This Privacy Policy does not apply to data that we process on behalf of customers of our business offerings, such as the SpaceXAI API』把代客处理路径排除在本关系之外。据此按范围推断记独立控制方，而非厂商自我定性。

To keep API request handling, model inference, moderation, and retained request data in the United States, use the US regional endpoint, `https://us.api.x.ai/v1`』. A subscription login path makes no such endpoint choice, so this cannot be read as a region commitment for this tier.
points.text_zh: 已登记来源里唯一的处理地条款属按量 API 档，而且是端点选择、不是普遍保证：『The default endpoint, `https://api.x.ai`, does not guarantee a processing region. To keep API request handling, model inference, moderation, and retained request data in the United States, use the US regional endpoint, `https://us.api.x.ai/v1`』——订阅登录路径不做这种端点选择，故不能读成本档的区域承诺。
points.quote: The default endpoint, `https://api.x.ai`, does not guarantee a processing region. To keep API request handling, model inference, moderation, and retained request data in the United States, use the US regional endpoint, `https://us.api.x.ai/v1`.

points.text: And that API guarantee is itself partial: 『Files, Collections, server-side tools, and the network path from your systems to the endpoint are outside the guarantee.』
points.text_zh: 而且那条 API 保证本身是部分的：『Files, Collections, server-side tools, and the network path from your systems to the endpoint are outside the guarantee.』——Files、Collections、服务端工具与网络链路都不在该保证范围内。
points.quote: Files, Collections, server-side tools, and the network path from your systems to the endpoint are outside the guarantee.

role.quote: This Privacy Policy does not apply to data that we process on behalf of customers of our business offerings, such as the SpaceXAI API

points.text: No consumer document names the role: neither the Consumer FAQ nor the Privacy Policy uses controller or processor for SpaceXAI's own position. The Privacy Policy's own purpose list treats training SpaceXAI's models as SpaceXAI's purpose (『to train our models』), and its reverse delimitation keeps the on-behalf-of-customer path out of this relationship, so the tier is recorded as controller on that scope reading — there is no processor clause to rely on here.
points.text_zh: 消费档文档没有给角色定性：消费 FAQ 与隐私政策都没有用 controller / processor 描述 SpaceXAI 自身。隐私政策把自己的目的清单写成含「to train our models」，并用反向界定把「代客处理」路径排除在本关系之外，故按范围推断记独立控制方；本档没有可依赖的受托处理条款。
points.quote: To develop and improve our Service and to conduct research: For example to develop new product features, to train our models, to identify usage trends, to operate and expand our business activities, to identify new customers, and for data analysis.

points.text: Tier attribution: the Consumer FAQ's own scope is 『This page is designed to address questions from individual users of Grok who use the Grok mobile app (iOS or Android) or the Grok.com website.』 The FAQ never names SuperGrok — it only separates limited free access from paid subscription plans. The SuperGrok attribution for Grok Build comes from the official announcement page, which is registered as a source in this file but has no snapshot yet and is therefore not citable.
points.text_zh: 档位归属：消费 FAQ 自述适用范围是使用 Grok 移动端或 grok.com 的个人用户——『This page is designed to address questions from individual users of Grok who use the Grok mobile app (iOS or Android) or the Grok.com website.』原文全文没有出现 SuperGrok，只区分有限免费入口与付费订阅计划。Grok Build 的 SuperGrok 档位归属只见于官方发布页，该页已登记为本文件的 [[source]] 但 snapshots/ 里还没有快照，故不作为引文依据。
points.quote: This page is designed to address questions from individual users of Grok who use the Grok mobile app (iOS or Android) or the Grok.com website.

training.quote: SpaceXAI will not use any User Content to train any foundation models, large language models, or other artificial intelligence systems or to develop any new products, services, or features

points.text: The no-training promise is not unconditional: the same sentence in Enterprise ToS §3.1 ends with “subject to disclosures to Customer and Customer-controlled user settings”, so the commitment is bounded by what SpaceXAI discloses to the customer and by settings the customer controls.
points.text_zh: 不训练承诺不是无条件的：Enterprise ToS §3.1 同一句末尾写「subject to disclosures to Customer and Customer-controlled user settings」——承诺受厂商向客户披露的内容与客户可控的用户设置限定，不宜读成无条件禁止。
points.quote: SpaceXAI will not use any User Content to train any foundation models, large language models, or other artificial intelligence systems or to develop any new products, services, or features

points.text: Nearest contrary provision, outside ZDR: Enterprise ToS §3.3 lets SpaceXAI create and use, “for any lawful purpose”, de-identified and/or aggregated data derived from the customer’s use of the Services, and SpaceXAI owns that De-Identified Data. It applies “Except when Customer elects to use SpaceXAI’s Zero Data Retention-enabled APIs”, so electing ZDR closes this channel. The object is De-Identified Data (irreversibly anonymized, neither containing nor revealing any User Content or Confidential Information), not User Content, so it does not overturn training = yes.
points.text_zh: 非 ZDR 语境下方向最近的相反出口：Enterprise ToS §3.3 允许 SpaceXAI 为「any lawful purpose」创建并使用从客户使用中派生的去标识化／聚合数据，且该 De-Identified Data 归 SpaceXAI 所有；该条以「Except when Customer elects to use SpaceXAI’s Zero Data Retention-enabled APIs」为前提，即启用 ZDR 后关闭。客体是不可再识别、不含也不泄露任何 User Content 或 Confidential Information 的 De-Identified Data，不是 User Content，故不足以推翻 training = yes。
points.quote: Except when Customer elects to use SpaceXAI’s Zero Data Retention-enabled APIs (“ZDR-Enabled API” or “ZDR”), SpaceXAI may create and use, for any lawful purpose, de-identified and/or aggregated data derived from Customer’s use of the Services that is irreversibly anonymized using industry-standard techniques, cannot be re-identified, and neither contains nor reveals any User Content or Confidential Information (“De-Identified Data”)

zdr.quote: when and to the extent Customer elects to use ZDR, User Content will exist in SpaceXAI systems only transiently and solely to the extent required to generate and return the real-time response

points.text: Scope and precondition (DPA §2.1, Enterprise ToS §11.2): the customer agrees to process Personal Data through the Services only using the ZDR-Enabled API, and failure to do so “will constitute a material breach of the Agreement”, with SpaceXAI “not responsible for any processing of such Personal Data outside of the ZDR Service”. §2.1 adds that when using the ZDR-Enabled API, only the customer, not SpaceXAI, will retain or have access to Personal Data. Enterprise ToS §11.2 states the same duty and adds that on the ZDR-Enabled API SpaceXAI will not retain any User Content (including Personal Data) after processing is complete, including content that might be needed to respond to government authorities, auditors or data subjects.
points.text_zh: 适用范围与前提（DPA §2.1、Enterprise ToS §11.2）：客户承诺 Personal Data 只经 ZDR-Enabled API 提交，违反「will constitute a material breach of the Agreement」，且 SpaceXAI「not responsible for any processing of such Personal Data outside of the ZDR Service」。§2.1 另写明在 ZDR-Enabled API 上只有客户、不是 SpaceXAI，保留或能访问 Personal Data。ToS §11.2 同旨，并写明「SpaceXAI will not retain any User Content (including Personal Data) after processing is complete」，包括应对政府机关、审计方或数据主体请求所需的 User Content。
points.quote: when using SpaceXAI’s ZDR-Enabled API, SpaceXAI will not retain any User Content (including Personal Data) after processing is complete

retention.summary: 按对象分列保留 30 天
retention.quote: All User Content will be automatically and permanently deleted no later than 30 days after the end of the interaction or session in which it was submitted

points.text: Contract layer, different object (DPA §9): upon termination of the Agreement SpaceXAI deletes any Personal Data in its possession, except to the extent applicable laws require retention, in which case the data is isolated and protected from further processing; the same section lets SpaceXAI continue to process information the customer instructed it to de-identify, anonymize and/or aggregate. Appendix 1 points the retention period for Personal Data at that section. This is a different object and clock from the request-level 30-day bound on User Content in Enterprise ToS §3.4 — the two must not be merged into one period.
points.text_zh: 合同层、不同对象（DPA §9）：协议终止时 SpaceXAI 删除其持有的 Personal Data，法律要求留存的须隔离并停止进一步处理；同段另允许继续处理客户指示去标识化／匿名化／聚合后的派生信息，附录 1 的保留期一栏直接指向本节。这与 Enterprise ToS §3.4 对 User Content 的请求级 30 天上限是不同对象、不同时间轴，不能合成一个期限。
points.quote: Upon termination of the Agreement, we shall delete any Personal Data in our possession in accordance with the Agreement, except to the extent that we are required to retain copies under applicable laws, in which case we shall isolate and protect such Personal Data from any further processing except to the extent required by applicable laws

points.text: Second retention permission outside the 30-day cap (Enterprise ToS §10.4): notwithstanding the return-or-destruction rule, each Party may retain copies of the other Party’s Confidential Information solely for archival, audit, legal and/or regulatory purposes, provided the retained copies remain subject to the obligations and restrictions of the Agreement and are handled consistently with the retaining Party’s routine document retention policies and procedures. The period is therefore set by each Party’s own document retention policy rather than by a fixed number, and this permission stacks with the §3.4 exceptions rather than replacing them.
points.text_zh: 30 天上限之外的第二条留存许可（Enterprise ToS §10.4）：尽管有返还或销毁规则，任一方仍可为归档、审计、法律与监管目的留存对方保密信息的副本，条件是留存副本继续受本协议义务与限制约束，且按留存方常规文档保留政策处理。期限因此由各方自身的文档保留政策决定，而非固定天数；该许可与 §3.4 的 (a)(b)(c) 例外是叠加关系，不是覆盖关系。
points.quote: Notwithstanding the foregoing, each Party will be permitted to retain copies of the other Party’s Confidential Information solely for archival, audit, legal, and/or regulatory purposes provided that any Confidential Information so retained will: (a) remain subject to the obligations and restrictions contained in this Agreement; and (b) in a manner consistent with the retaining Party’s routine document retention policies and procedures

points.text: Why User Content falls under §10.4 (Enterprise ToS §10.1(ii)): “Without any marking or further designation, subject to Sections 3 and 4 … all User Content will be deemed Customer’s Confidential Information.” The designation is expressly subject to Sections 3 and 4, so it does not override the deletion obligations in §3.4.
points.text_zh: User Content 何以落入 §10.4（Enterprise ToS §10.1(ii)）：「Without any marking or further designation, subject to Sections 3 and 4 … all User Content will be deemed Customer’s Confidential Information」——该认定明文受 Section 3 与 Section 4 约束，因此不凌驾 §3.4 的删除义务。
points.quote: all User Content will be deemed Customer’s Confidential Information

processing_region.quote: When you call `https://us.api.x.ai/v1`, SpaceXAI guarantees that the following happen in the United States

points.text: The default is the global endpoint and it does not pin a location: “https://api.x.ai is the global endpoint. SpaceXAI may route requests between regions for capacity or reliability, so the processing location is not guaranteed.” The United States location applies only when the client is pointed at the US regional endpoint.
points.text_zh: 默认走全局端点，且不承诺处理地：「https://api.x.ai is the global endpoint. SpaceXAI may route requests between regions for capacity or reliability, so the processing location is not guaranteed.」只有把客户端指向美国区域端点时才适用美国处理地。
points.quote: SpaceXAI may route requests between regions for capacity or reliability, so the processing location is not guaranteed.

points.text: The US guarantee is partial: API request handling, inference, moderation and retained request data are covered, but Files, Collections and server-side tools (web search, X search, code execution) “are outside the US guarantee and may process data outside the United States”, and the network path from the customer’s systems to the endpoint is not covered either. The endpoint is available to every team and existing API keys work on both endpoints, so it is a disclosed optional processing location rather than the tier default.
points.text_zh: 美国保证是有范围的：覆盖 API 请求处理、推理、审核与 SpaceXAI 保留的请求数据，但 Files、Collections 与服务端工具（web search、X search、code execution）「are outside the US guarantee and may process data outside the United States」，客户系统到端点之间的网络链路同样不在保证内。该端点为所有团队可用、现有 API key 在两个端点上通用，即它是厂商披露的可选处理地，不是本档默认。
points.quote: Files, Collections, and server-side tools such as web search, X search, and code execution still work on the US endpoint, but they are outside the US guarantee and may process data outside the United States

points.text: Vendor’s own caveat on the US endpoint: “A regional endpoint is not, by itself, a comprehensive data-residency guarantee. If you have contractual requirements about where your data is processed or stored, contact sales@x.ai before relying on the US endpoint for compliance.”
points.text_zh: 厂商对美国端点的自带限定：「A regional endpoint is not, by itself, a comprehensive data-residency guarantee. If you have contractual requirements about where your data is processed or stored, contact sales@x.ai before relying on the US endpoint for compliance.」区域端点本身不等于数据驻留保证。
points.quote: A regional endpoint is not, by itself, a comprehensive data-residency guarantee

points.text: Contract layer, different object (DPA §8.1; contract outranks developer docs): “SpaceXAI may transfer and process Personal Data on a global basis outside Europe as necessary to provide the Services, including in the United States and other countries where SpaceXAI and its Subprocessors maintain data processing operations.” This governs the transfer and processing range for Personal Data, while the regions page governs where request handling and inference happen; the two are kept side by side rather than merged. The DPA regime presupposes that the customer submits Personal Data only through the ZDR-Enabled API (§2.1).
points.text_zh: 合同层、不同对象（DPA §8.1；合同层权威性高于开发者文档）：「SpaceXAI may transfer and process Personal Data on a global basis outside Europe as necessary to provide the Services, including in the United States and other countries where SpaceXAI and its Subprocessors maintain data processing operations.」这一句管 Personal Data 的传输／处理范围，regions 页管请求处理与推理的发生地，两者并列保留而不互相覆盖；该合同层的适用前提是客户只经 ZDR-Enabled API 提交 Personal Data（§2.1）。
points.quote: SpaceXAI may transfer and process Personal Data on a global basis outside Europe as necessary to provide the Services, including in the United States and other countries where SpaceXAI and its Subprocessors maintain data processing operations

role.quote: SpaceXAI is a processor and you are a controller or processor of Personal Data, as applicable, under Applicable Data Protection Laws

points.text: Same layer, second source: Enterprise ToS §11.1 independently states that where data including “personal data” is submitted to the Services, “SpaceXAI will process such data as a processor on Customer’s behalf”, and the DPA is incorporated by reference automatically.
points.text_zh: 同一权威层、第二处依据：Enterprise ToS §11.1 独立写明提交含「personal data」的数据时「SpaceXAI will process such data as a processor on Customer’s behalf」，并以引用方式自动并入 DPA。
points.quote: SpaceXAI will process such data as a processor on Customer’s behalf

points.text: Scope of the role clause: the processor/controller statement in DPA §2.1 is itself unconditional, but the same section makes it the customer’s duty to process Personal Data through the Services only using the ZDR-Enabled API, makes failure to do so a material breach, and states that SpaceXAI is not responsible for processing outside the ZDR Service. The processor role is therefore not, by itself, a statement about non-ZDR API traffic.
points.text_zh: 角色条款的适用范围：DPA §2.1 的 processor/controller 声明本身是无条件的，但同节把「Personal Data 只经 ZDR-Enabled API 提交」定为客户义务，违反构成 material breach，且 SpaceXAI 对 ZDR 之外的处理不负责。故该受托角色不构成对非 ZDR API 流量的角色承诺。
points.quote: SpaceXAI is a processor and you are a controller or processor of Personal Data, as applicable, under Applicable Data Protection Laws
