points.text: Object: input and output content, i.e. the Customer Data covered by DPA §4(b). Context: default. Period type: no retention — the Company does not store the content the Customer or its End Users provide or generate, and that information is processed in real-time to provide the API Service and is not saved on the Company servers. No retention period means there is no period for this object, not a zero-day window.
points.text_zh: 对象=输入输出正文,即 DPA §4(b) 覆盖的那部分 Customer Data;语境=默认;期限类型=不留存——公司不存储客户或终端用户提供/生成的内容,该信息为提供 API 服务而实时处理、不保存在服务器上。「不留存」指该对象没有保留期可言,不是「0 天」
points.quote: This information is processed in real-time to provide the Customer and End Users with the API Service and is not saved on our servers.

points.text: Object: Customer Data other than the content covered by Section 4(b) — per the DPA definition, Customer Data is the Personal Data the Customer provides to the Company for the Company to process on the Customer behalf in order to provide the Services. Context: default. Period type: event-triggered — the Company temporarily stores such data for the purposes of providing the API Services or in compliance with applicable laws, and deletes it after the termination of the Terms unless otherwise required by applicable laws. That is neither a floor nor a fixed number of days, and it is a different object from the input/output content above, so this cell basis=none does not cover it.
points.text_zh: 对象=§4(b) 之外的其他 Customer Data(按 DPA 定义,Customer Data 是客户为让公司代其提供服务而提供给公司的 Personal Data);语境=默认;期限类型=事件触发——公司为提供 API 服务或遵守适用法律而临时存储该类数据,协议终止后删除,除非适用法律另有要求。既不是下限也不是固定天数;对象与上面那格的输入输出正文不同,故本格的 basis=none 不覆盖它
points.quote: For Customer Data other than those provided under Section 4(b), Company will temporarily store such data for the purposes of providing the API Services or in compliance with applicable laws.

processing_region.quote: Company generally provide the Services from Singapore, and our group companies and their designated service providers are typically located in Singapore. As a result, Customer Data is generally processed in Singapore.

points.text: Object: Customer Data. Context: the default place of processing, not an exclusive one. DPA §3(a) is worded as generally — the Company generally provides the Services from Singapore and Customer Data is generally processed in Singapore — while §3(b) adds that the Company implements appropriate safeguards to ensure Customer Data is transferred abroad only in compliance with applicable Data Protection Laws and legally recognized transfer mechanisms. Singapore is therefore the default processing location rather than a hard limit on where Customer Data may be processed, and codes stays ["SG"] on that reading.
points.text_zh: 对象=Customer Data;语境=默认处理地而非唯一处理地。DPA §3(a) 的措辞是 generally(通常):公司通常自新加坡提供服务、Customer Data 通常在新加坡处理;§3(b) 紧接着写明公司实施适当保障,确保仅在遵守适用数据保护法与合法传输机制的前提下向境外传输 Customer Data。故新加坡是默认处理地、不是处理地的绝对限定,codes 仍记 ["SG"]

points.text: 个人档既无 ZDR 产品能力也无 ZDR 承诺：隐私政策 §7 明示 input 随账户保留，ToU §IV.3(a)(i) 明文授权『utilization and storage of User Content that does not constitute personal data』，§IV.5 还授予永久存储许可。厂商公开文档（含 llms.txt 全量索引、WebSearch 中英文）里不存在面向 Coding Plan 的零保留页面或申请入口。DPA §4(b) 的『不存服务器』只对 business/enterprises API Customers 成立，scope 不覆盖个人订阅。

points.text: Related conditional exception: ToU §IV.3(c) 『notwithstanding any other provision within these Terms, any individual or entity with whom you have shared such content shall have the unrestricted right to access, use, save, reproduce, distribute, display, and transmit such content without limitation』. It is user-side feature triggered (public sharing), not the default state, and it makes 「content stays only with the vendor until the account is deleted」 an incomplete description.

points.text: 对象=用户输入/User Content。隐私政策 §7：『when we process your personal data to provide you with the Services, we retain it as long as you have an account. This includes your account information, input.』——期限类型是『账户存续期』（非下限也非固定上限），账户删除或违约时另行处理（违约时仍按需保留）。§2.1 对 User Content 另有『processed in real-time』措辞，但那是处理方式，不回答留存，与 §7 不冲突。上下文/KV 缓存是另一对象：help/faq 明说缓存保留时长『has not yet been announced』，cache.md 只有『reasonable time limits』。企业/API 档口径完全不同（DPA §4(b) 内容不落盘、§4(c) 终止后删除），不可套到个人档。

points.text: A deletion trigger that exists on top of 「account lifetime」: privacy policy §5 『You also are able to delete individual conversations, which will be removed immediately from your conversation history and automatically deleted from our back-end.』 Context = user-initiated deletion, so it is not a default zero-retention configuration; basis stays as_needed because this sentence describes a deletion trigger, not a period type.

Triggered by the user turning on a public-sharing feature (not the default state); the clause says so itself with notwithstanding any other provision.

points.text_zh: 隐私政策 §8：『We generally provide the Services from Singapore, and our group companies and their designated service providers are typically located in Singapore.』ToU §IV.3(a)(ii) 对 individual users 另行取得『processing and storage of such User Content in locations outside of the jurisdiction where you access or use the Services』的同意，即个人档存在跨境存储的合同授权（具体地点未列明）。企业/API 档同一结论，依据 DPA §3(a)。

points.text: The same section's own safeguard sentence, which is the exit from a hard residency reading: privacy policy §8 『We implement appropriate safeguards to ensure that your personal data remains protected in line with this Privacy Policy and applicable laws, and we only transfer your data abroad in compliance with applicable laws and legally recognized transfer mechanisms.』 Singapore is stated as 「generally」, not as an exclusive processing location.

points.text: The only two no-train sentences in the public text are scoped to API Services: Additional Terms §3(b) 『We will not use End User Content to develop or improve Services, unless you explicitly agree to such use.』 and the same-purpose sentence in ToU §IV.7, which is addressed to 『For enterprises and developers using API Services』. Additional Terms self-describes its scope as 『The use of API services (“API Services”) by business and developers on Z.ai platform』. The Team tier is a seat subscription of the Coding Plan; the vendor never states that this subscription is an API Services use under the Additional Terms or the DPA. No sentence in either snapshot therefore promises this tier that its content is not used for training, so the verdict is unknown, not yes.
points.text_zh: 厂商公开文本里仅有的两句「不训练」都自限在 API Services 上：Additional Terms §3(b)『We will not use End User Content to develop or improve Services, unless you explicitly agree to such use.』与 ToU §IV.7 的同旨句（写给『For enterprises and developers using API Services』）；Additional Terms 的 scope 句自述为『The use of API services (“API Services”) by business and developers on Z.ai platform』。Team 档是 Coding Plan 的席位订阅，厂商没有一句把该订阅写成 Additional Terms 或 DPA 意义上的 API Services 使用，故两份快照里都没有一句为本档承诺「不训练」，结论按保守假设记 unknown，不记 yes。

points.text: A clause that is not limited to individual users, recorded as a qualification: ToU §IV.3(b) 『We may collect performance and usage metrics and data pertaining to your access and/or utilization of the Services … We retain the right to use such metrics and data to enhance the quality, functionality, and other aspects of the Services and their underlying technologies.』 Unlike §IV.3(a) in the same paragraph it carries no 『For individual users』 limiter, so on its face it covers ToU users generally. Its object is performance/usage metrics and technical data rather than User Content, so it is not an independent finding on this tier either way; whether it reaches the Team tier rests on the same unconfirmed tier mapping.
points.text_zh: 一条不限 individual users、作为限定记录的条款：ToU §IV.3(b)『We may collect performance and usage metrics and data pertaining to your access and/or utilization of the Services … We retain the right to use such metrics and data to enhance the quality, functionality, and other aspects of the Services and their underlying technologies.』同段 §IV.3(a) 有『For individual users』限定而 b) 没有，文面上对 ToU 用户普遍成立。其对象是性能/使用指标与技术数据而非 User Content，故不构成本档训练与否的独立结论；它是否落到本档，同样依赖那个未获厂商确认的档位映射。

points.text: Why nothing is bound here: the only quotable no-train sentences are the API Services ones above, and binding one to this dimension would present the unconfirmed tier mapping as the vendor's own wording. The auxiliary material also has no snapshot to quote — the devpack/teamplan.md entitlement page (which lists 『Data is not used for model training by default』 as a Team-tier feature) is not part of this provider's snapshots, and neither is the subscription-terms document whose §4.3 makes the individual tier Personal-Use Only.
points.text_zh: 本档为什么没有绑引文：可引的「不训练」只有上面那两句 API Services 口径，绑到本维度等于把未获厂商确认的档位映射写成厂商原话。旁证也没有快照可引——devpack/teamplan.md 权益页（把『Data is not used for model training by default』列为 Team 档能力）未纳入本 provider 快照；把个人档定为 Personal-Use Only 的订阅套餐专用条款 §4.3 同样未纳入本 provider 快照。

This information is processed in real-time to provide the Customer and End Users with the API Service and is not saved on our servers.

points.text: The clause itself, for the record: DPA §4(b) 『The Company do not store any of the content the Customer or its End Users provide or generate while using our Services. This includes any texts, or other data you input. This information is processed in real-time to provide the Customer and End Users with the API Service and is not saved on our servers.』 For API business customers this is the default behaviour, not an application-based feature — there is no request form and no switch, hence mode=default.
points.text_zh: 条款原文（备查）：DPA §4(b)『The Company do not store any of the content the Customer or its End Users provide or generate while using our Services. This includes any texts, or other data you input. This information is processed in real-time to provide the Customer and End Users with the API Service and is not saved on our servers.』对 API 企业客户是默认行为而非申请制功能——没有申请入口、没有开关，故 mode=default。

points.text: Scope chain, step by step: the DPA states 『This Data Processing Addendum (“DPA”) governs the processing of the data provided by business and enterprises users (“Customers”) through API Services』, and what brings it in is Additional Terms §2(a) 『We will collect and process data you provide as set forth in the Data Processing Addendum for API Services.』 That is the first ring of the tier inference this cell rests on.
points.text_zh: Scope 链条逐环看：DPA 自述『This Data Processing Addendum (“DPA”) governs the processing of the data provided by business and enterprises users (“Customers”) through API Services』，而把它引入的是 Additional Terms §2(a)『We will collect and process data you provide as set forth in the Data Processing Addendum for API Services.』——这是本格所依赖的档位推断的第一环。

points.text: Explicit premise rather than a footnote: the vendor nowhere writes that a Coding Plan Team seat subscription is an API Services use or a DPA “Customer”. Whether §4(b) reaches this tier is this ledger's inference from the fact that the DPA is the only business-facing data-processing annex Z.AI publishes and the Team tier is the self-serve business subscription. If that mapping fails, this cell falls back to the personal-tier reading (input kept for the life of the account, privacy policy §7) and the verdict becomes no. Z.AI publishes no ZDR application page and no ZDR document.
points.text_zh: 这是显式前提，不是脚注：厂商从未写过 Coding Plan 的 Team 席位订阅构成 API Services 使用或 DPA 意义上的 Customer。§4(b) 是否落到本档，是本台账据「DPA 是 Z.AI 公开文档里唯一面向企业客户的数据处理附件、Team 档是面向企业的自助订阅」所作的推断。若该映射不成立，本格退回个人档口径（隐私政策 §7：input 随账户存续）并记为 no。Z.AI 没有 ZDR 申请入口，也没有 ZDR 文档页。

retention.quote: The Company do not store any of the content the Customer or its End Users provide or generate while using our Services. This includes any texts, or other data you input. This information is processed in real-time to provide the Customer and End Users with the API Service and is not saved on our servers.

points.text: Object = the request content itself (User Content / End User Content): DPA §4(b) says the content the Customer or its End Users provide or generate while using the Services is processed in real-time and is not saved on our servers, so basis=none. This cell answers only how long the request content is kept; the other object is the next point.
points.text_zh: 对象=请求内容本身（User Content / End User Content）：DPA §4(b) 写明 Customer 及其 End User 使用服务时提供或生成的内容实时处理、不存服务器，故 basis=none。本格只回答请求内容留多久，另一类对象见下一条。

points.text: The second object is not covered by 「not retained」: DPA §4(c) 『For Customer Data other than those provided under Section 4(b), Company will temporarily store such data for the purposes of providing the API Services or in compliance with applicable laws.』 followed by 『The Company will delete such data after the termination of the Terms unless otherwise required by applicable laws.』 That is an event-triggered rule — temporary storage, deletion on termination, with a legal carve-out. Neither a fixed number of days nor a lower bound.
points.text_zh: 第二类对象不适用「不留存」：DPA §4(c)『For Customer Data other than those provided under Section 4(b), Company will temporarily store such data for the purposes of providing the API Services or in compliance with applicable laws.』接着写『The Company will delete such data after the termination of the Terms unless otherwise required by applicable laws.』——事件触发：临时存储、协议终止后删除、法律要求例外；既非固定天数，也非下限。
points.quote: The Company will delete such data after the termination of the Terms unless otherwise required by applicable laws.

points.text: Scope chain for this cell: the DPA is brought in by Additional Terms §2(a) 『We will collect and process data you provide as set forth in the Data Processing Addendum for API Services.』 and self-limits to 『business and enterprises users (“Customers”) through API Services』.
points.text_zh: 本格的 scope 链条：DPA 借 Additional Terms §2(a)『We will collect and process data you provide as set forth in the Data Processing Addendum for API Services.』引入，并自限为『business and enterprises users (“Customers”) through API Services』。
points.quote: We will collect and process data you provide as set forth in the Data Processing Addendum for API Services.

points.text: Explicit premise: whether a Coding Plan Team seat subscription counts as an API Services use and a DPA “Customer” is not stated by the vendor — that mapping is this ledger's inference (the DPA is the only business-facing data-processing annex Z.AI publishes, and the Team tier is the self-serve business subscription). If the mapping fails, this cell falls back to the personal-tier reading: input retained for as long as the account exists (privacy policy §7), basis=as_needed.
points.text_zh: 显式前提：Coding Plan 的 Team 席位订阅是否算 API Services 使用、是否算 DPA 的 Customer，厂商无明文，该映射是本台账的推断（DPA 是 Z.AI 公开文档里唯一面向企业客户的数据处理附件，Team 档是面向企业的自助订阅）。映射不成立时本格退回个人档口径：input 随账户存续（隐私政策 §7），basis=as_needed。

processing_region.quote: Company generally provide the Services from Singapore, and our group companies and their designated service providers are typically located in Singapore.

points.text: DPA §3(a): 『Company generally provide the Services from Singapore, and our group companies and their designated service providers are typically located in Singapore.』 Same conclusion as §8 of the personal-tier privacy policy, on a different clause.
points.text_zh: DPA §3(a)：『Company generally provide the Services from Singapore, and our group companies and their designated service providers are typically located in Singapore.』与个人档隐私政策 §8 同结论，依据条款不同。

points.text: Singapore is 「generally」, not an exclusive commitment, and the next subsection opens the exit: DPA §3(b) 『Company implements appropriate safeguards to ensure that the Customer Data will only transfer Customer Data abroad in compliance with applicable Data Protection Laws and legally recognized transfer mechanisms.』 Transfer abroad is therefore permitted under safeguards — the codes cell records the disclosed processing location, not a residency guarantee.
points.text_zh: 新加坡是 generally 而非排他约定，紧接的 §3(b) 就留了出口：『Company implements appropriate safeguards to ensure that the Customer Data will only transfer Customer Data abroad in compliance with applicable Data Protection Laws and legally recognized transfer mechanisms.』——在合规保障与合法传输机制下可向境外传输。codes 记的是已披露的处理地，不是驻留承诺。
points.quote: Company implements appropriate safeguards to ensure that the Customer Data will only transfer Customer Data abroad in compliance with applicable Data Protection Laws and legally recognized transfer mechanisms.

points.text: Explicit premise: §3(a)/(b) speak of the Company's processing of Customer Data under the DPA, which self-limits to 『business and enterprises users (“Customers”) through API Services』. Whether the Team seat subscription falls inside that scope is not stated by the vendor; the mapping is this ledger's inference.
points.text_zh: 显式前提：§3(a)/(b) 讲的是 Company 在 DPA 下对 Customer Data 的处理，而 DPA 自限为『business and enterprises users (“Customers”) through API Services』。Team 席位订阅是否落在这个 scope 里厂商无明文，该映射是本台账的推断。

role.quote: whereas Company processes Customer Data in accordance with the Data Controller’s instructions and on behalf of the Data Controller (as a “Data Processor”)

points.text: DPA preamble: 『Customer is the person that determines the purposes and means for which Customer Data (as defined below) is processed (a “Data Controller”), whereas Company processes Customer Data in accordance with the Data Controller’s instructions and on behalf of the Data Controller (as a “Data Processor”).』
points.text_zh: DPA 前言：『Customer is the person that determines the purposes and means for which Customer Data (as defined below) is processed (a “Data Controller”), whereas Company processes Customer Data in accordance with the Data Controller’s instructions and on behalf of the Data Controller (as a “Data Processor”).』

points.text: Same direction in the operative clause: DPA §1(a) 『Process Customer Data only 1) on Customer’s behalf for the purpose of providing and supporting API Services』 (the 「1)」 is verbatim in the source, where the list mixes 1) and (ii)).
points.text_zh: 同一方向的义务条款：DPA §1(a)『Process Customer Data only 1) on Customer’s behalf for the purpose of providing and supporting API Services』（原文此处即写作「1)」，同一列表里混用了 1) 与 (ii)，照录）。
points.quote: Process Customer Data only 1) on Customer’s behalf for the purpose of providing and supporting API Services

points.text: Explicit premise: this role is stated for DPA “Customers” — 『business and enterprises users (“Customers”) through API Services』 — and the vendor nowhere says a Coding Plan Team seat subscription is such a Customer; that mapping is this ledger's inference. If it fails, this cell falls back to the personal-tier reading: the privacy policy §1 makes JINGSHENG HENGXING TECHNOLOGY PTE.LTD the controller of the user's Personal Data.
points.text_zh: 显式前提：该角色是写给 DPA 的 Customer（『business and enterprises users (“Customers”) through API Services』）的，厂商没有一句说 Coding Plan 的 Team 席位订阅就是这种 Customer，该映射是本台账的推断。映射不成立时本格退回个人档口径：隐私政策 §1 由 JINGSHENG HENGXING TECHNOLOGY PTE.LTD 作为个人数据的 controller。

points.text: 个人档恰相反（隐私政策 §1 公司为 controller）。
points.text_zh: 个人档恰相反（隐私政策 §1 公司为 controller）。

training.quote: Zed has no-training commitments from model providers, and provider agreements require zero data retention for inference requests except for [provider-designated models with safety retention](https://zed.dev/docs/ai/privacy-and-security#provider-safety-retention), such as Anthropic’s Covered Models.

points.text: 例外有两条：少数被模型厂商指定为「安全留存」的模型（如 Anthropic 的 Covered Models）不走零保留；以及你自己点了反馈或主动打开训练数据收集时，Zed 才会留 AI 数据。
points.text_zh: 例外有两条：少数被模型厂商指定为「安全留存」的模型（如 Anthropic 的 Covered Models）不走零保留；以及你自己点了反馈或主动打开训练数据收集时，Zed 才会留 AI 数据。

points.text: Business adds an org-level control the individual tier does not have: administrators on Zed Business can enforce a no-sharing policy org-wide, after which members cannot opt into Edit Prediction training data sharing or AI feedback ratings. It only strengthens the no-training verdict.
points.text_zh: Business 档多了一层个人档没有的组织级控制：管理员可在全组织范围强制 no-sharing 策略，此后成员无法 opt-in Edit Prediction 训练数据共享与 AI 反馈评级。这一条只加强「不用于训练」的判定。
points.quote: Administrators on Zed Business can enforce a no-sharing policy org-wide; members can’t opt into Edit Prediction training data sharing or AI feedback ratings.

zdr.quote: Zed has no-training commitments from model providers, and provider agreements require zero data retention for inference requests except for [provider-designated models with safety retention](https://zed.dev/docs/ai/privacy-and-security#provider-safety-retention), such as Anthropic’s Covered Models.

points.text: Provider-side safety retention is not escapable by changing endpoints: switching to your own API key or subscription does not avoid this retention for covered models, because providers apply it on every platform where those models are offered.
points.text_zh: 厂商侧的安全留存换端点也躲不掉：改用自带 key 或订阅不能绕过厂商指定安全留存模型的留存，因为厂商在其提供这些模型的所有平台上都施加该留存。
points.quote: Switching to your own API key or subscription does not avoid this retention for covered models, because providers apply it on every platform where those models are offered.

retention.quote: Zed does not retain your prompts or code context by default.

points.text: Zed 默认不留提示词/代码上下文；托管模型商也为 ZDR。例外：供应商指定的安全保留模型（如 Anthropic Covered Models）至少保留 30 天，Zed 无法关闭。
points.text_zh: Zed 默认不留提示词/代码上下文；托管模型商也为 ZDR。例外：供应商指定的安全保留模型（如 Anthropic Covered Models）至少保留 30 天，Zed 无法关闭。

points.text: Separate object from the AI input/output row: personal data (account, telemetry, communications) held by Zed as controller. It is kept as long as necessary to provide, maintain and secure the services; it is deleted or anonymised when you request deletion, unless Zed is legally required to retain it; periods are determined by the type of service, the relationship with the user, legal requirements and applicable statutes of limitations. No fixed period is stated.
points.text_zh: 与 AI 输入输出一行分开的对象：Zed 作为 controller 持有的个人数据（账号、遥测、通信等）。期限为提供服务、维护与安全所必需；收到删除请求后删除或匿名化，法律要求保留的除外；具体期限按服务类型、与用户的关系、法律要求与诉讼时效确定，未给出固定期限。
points.quote: When you request deletion, we take measures to delete your personal data or anonymize it, unless we're legally required to retain it. We determine retention periods based on the type of service, our relationship with you, legal requirements, and applicable statutes of limitations.

points.text: Further retention exceptions beyond a deletion request: personal data may be kept for backups, archiving, prevention of fraud and abuse, satisfaction of legal obligations, or where Zed otherwise reasonably believes it has a legitimate and lawful reason.
points.text_zh: 删除请求之外的进一步保留例外：个人数据可为备份、归档、防欺诈与滥用、履行法律义务，或 Zed 认为另有正当合法理由而继续保留。
points.quote: we may retain personal data for backups, archiving, prevention of fraud and abuse, satisfaction of legal obligations, or where we otherwise reasonably believe that we have a legitimate and lawful reason to do so

points.text: Edit Prediction is listed as its own request path: each keystroke can send local editing context to the selected provider; Zeta requests are processed transiently unless training data collection is enabled; third-party providers follow their own terms.
points.text_zh: Edit Prediction 在本页单列一路：每次击键都可能把本地编辑上下文发给所选 provider；Zeta 请求瞬时处理，除非开启训练数据收集；第三方 provider 按其自身条款。
points.quote: Each keystroke can send local editing context to the selected provider. Zeta requests are processed transiently unless training data collection is enabled; third-party providers follow their own terms.

points.text: Telemetry is a separate object with a downstream flow: telemetry is sent from the application to Zed's servers every 5 minutes (or when 50 events accumulate), then routed to four services — Sentry (crash monitoring, stores diagnostic events), Snowflake (data warehouse, stores diagnostic and metric events), Hex and Amplitude (dashboards, read the data stored in Snowflake). Neither a retention period nor the location of these downstream services is stated.
points.text_zh: 遥测是另一个对象、另有下游流向：遥测每 5 分钟（或累计 50 个事件）从应用发到 Zed 服务器，再路由到四个服务——Sentry（崩溃监控，存诊断事件）、Snowflake（数据仓库，存诊断与指标事件）、Hex 与 Amplitude（仪表盘，读取 Snowflake 中的数据）。这些下游服务的保留期限与所在地点均未声明。
points.quote: Telemetry is sent from the application to our servers every 5 minutes (or when 50 events accumulate), then routed to the appropriate service. We currently use: Sentry: Crash-monitoring service - stores diagnostic events; Snowflake: Data warehouse - stores both diagnostic and metric events; Hex: Dashboards and data exploration - accesses data stored in Snowflake; Amplitude: Dashboards and data exploration - accesses data stored in Snowflake

points.text: Telemetry is not necessarily anonymous: usage data is tied to a random telemetry ID, and if you are authenticated that ID may be linked to your email.
points.text_zh: 遥测不必然匿名：使用数据绑定到一个随机遥测 ID，若已登录，该 ID 可能关联到你的邮箱。
points.quote: Usage data is tied to a random telemetry ID. If you’ve authenticated, this ID may be linked to your email so Zed can analyze patterns over time and reach out for feedback.

processing_region.quote: Our websites, products, and services are hosted in the United States (“U.S.”). If you choose to use our websites or products and services from the EEA, the UK or other regions of the world with laws governing data collection and use that may differ from U.S. law, then please note that you are transferring your personal data outside of those regions to the U.S. for storage and processing.

points.text: Zed's own hosting and processing location is the United States: the services are hosted in the U.S., and personal data from the EEA, the UK and other regions is transferred to the U.S. for storage and processing.
points.text_zh: Zed 自身的托管与处理地为美国：服务托管在美国，来自 EEA、英国及其他地区的个人数据被传输到美国存储与处理。
points.quote: Our websites, products, and services are hosted in the United States (“U.S.”). If you choose to use our websites or products and services from the EEA, the UK or other regions of the world with laws governing data collection and use that may differ from U.S. law, then please note that you are transferring your personal data outside of those regions to the U.S. for storage and processing.

points.text: The U.S. is not the only location: the same paragraph allows transferring data from the U.S. to other countries or regions in connection with storage and processing of data, fulfilling requests, and operating the websites, products and services.
points.text_zh: 美国不是唯一地点：同段允许为数据存储与处理、履行请求、运营网站与产品服务，把数据从美国再转移到其他国家或地区。
points.quote: We may also transfer your data from the U.S. to other countries or regions in connection with storage and processing of data, fulfilling your requests, and operating our websites, products, and services.

points.text: Business limit, recorded as a limit rather than as an unknown region: data Zed processes as a processor on behalf of Zed Business customers is governed by the Data Processing Agreement, which the privacy policy says is available upon request. That document is not monitored here, so this row records Zed's own hosting location.
points.text_zh: Business 档的限定（以限定形式记录，而不是把处理地记成 unknown）：Zed 以 processor 身份代表 Zed Business 客户处理的数据受《数据处理协议》约束，隐私政策称该协议可应请求提供；本台账未监控该协议，因此本行记录的是 Zed 自身的托管地。
points.quote: This Privacy Policy does not apply to the extent we process personal data in the role of a processor or service provider on behalf of our Zed Business customers. Such processing is governed by our Data Processing Agreement, available upon request.

points.text: Layer this row does not cover: Zed routes Zed-hosted model requests to hosted model providers (Anthropic, Google, OpenAI), and the location where those providers process the data is not declared in the pages monitored here.
points.text_zh: 本行覆盖不到的一层：Zed 把托管模型请求路由给托管模型商（Anthropic、Google、OpenAI）执行，这些厂商在何处处理数据，本档监控的页面没有声明。
points.quote: Zed routes requests to hosted model providers

role.quote: When data is used as outlined in this Privacy Policy, Zed is the data controller and responsible for the processing of your personal data. When Zed processes personal data on behalf of Zed Business customers as a data processor, the terms of our Data Processing Agreement apply.

points.text: Disclosure under the controller role: Zed may disclose personal data to vendors that provide artificial intelligence services, for legitimate business purposes only, including website performance monitoring and sales and marketing of its products and services, and states that it does not utilize third-party services which use this information for AI training purposes. Where those vendors process the data is not stated.
points.text_zh: controller 身份下的披露面：Zed 可为合法商业目的把个人信息披露给提供 AI 服务的供应商，目的包括网站性能监控与产品服务的销售营销，并写明不使用会把这些信息用于 AI 训练的第三方服务；这些供应商在何处处理数据未说明。
points.quote: AI Service Providers - We may disclose information we receive to vendors that provide artificial intelligence services in connection with our websites, software, or services for legitimate business purposes only, including website performance monitoring and sales and marketing of our products and services. Zed does not utilize third-party services which use this information for AI training purposes.
